-- Automatic script-only performance guard. It adapts background task cadence
-- during sustained frame drops and never changes graphics or rendering settings.
do
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local state = rawget(_G, "_PrismPerfGuard")
    if type(state) ~= "table" then state = {} end
    if state.conn then pcall(function() state.conn:Disconnect() end) end
    state.enabled = true
    state.pressure = false
    state.avgDt = 1 / 60
    state.slowFor = 0
    state.recoverFor = 0
    state.fps = 60
    _G._PrismPerfGuard = state
    state.conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        if dt <= 0 or dt > 0.5 then return end
        state.avgDt = state.avgDt + (dt - state.avgDt) * 0.08
        state.fps = 1 / math.max(state.avgDt, 1 / 240)
        if state.avgDt > 1 / 30 then
            state.slowFor = state.slowFor + dt
            state.recoverFor = 0
            if state.slowFor >= 2 then state.pressure = true end
        elseif state.avgDt < 1 / 50 then
            state.recoverFor = state.recoverFor + dt
            state.slowFor = 0
            if state.recoverFor >= 6 then state.pressure = false end
        else
            state.slowFor = math.max(0, state.slowFor - dt * 0.5)
            state.recoverFor = 0
        end
    end)
end
-- PARALLAX keyframe smoothing v3.
--   Position : monotone cubic Hermite (Fritsch-Butland tangents, time aware). Never overshoots,
--              zero tangent where a motion stops or reverses, so holds stay exactly held.
--   Rotation : SQUAD (spherical cubic) with time-scaled control points. Passes exactly through
--              every key, C1 continuous, no frame mixing, shortest-path.
--   Segments are cached per keyframe list, so playback only does a few lerps per part.
--   Anything unexpected returns nil and the caller falls back to a plain linear blend.
-- OPT-IN: on with _G.PrismAnimSpline = true; loop seam blend with _G.PrismAnimSeam = true.
do
    local ID = CFrame.new()
    local EPS = 1e-4
    local cache = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
    local function isCF(v) return typeof(v) == "CFrame" end
    local function logv(rot)
        local ax, ang = rot:ToAxisAngle()
        return ax * ang
    end
    local function expv(v)
        local m = v.Magnitude
        if m < 1e-7 then return ID end
        return CFrame.fromAxisAngle(v / m, m)
    end
    local function ratio(a, b)
        if b < EPS then return 1 end
        return math.clamp(a / b, 0.25, 4)
    end
    -- monotone slope at a point; kp = slope before, kn = slope after (nil at the ends)
    local function tang(kp, kn, dtp, dtn)
        if kp == nil then return kn or 0 end
        if kn == nil then return kp end
        if kp * kn <= 0 then return 0 end
        local w1, w2 = 2 * dtn + dtp, dtn + 2 * dtp
        local m = (w1 + w2) / (w1 / kp + w2 / kn)
        local lim = 3 * math.min(math.abs(kp), math.abs(kn))
        return math.clamp(m, -lim, lim)
    end

    local function build(kf, i, part)
        local f1, f2 = kf[i], kf[i + 1]
        local c1 = f1 and f1.Data and f1.Data[part]
        local c2 = f2 and f2.Data and f2.Data[part]
        if not (isCF(c1) and isCF(c2)) then return false end
        local dt = f2.Time - f1.Time
        local seg = { c1 = c1, c2 = c2, t1 = f1.Time, t2 = f2.Time }
        if dt <= EPS then seg.lin = true return seg end
        local f0, f3 = kf[i - 1], kf[i + 2]
        local c0 = f0 and f0.Data and f0.Data[part]
        local c3 = f3 and f3.Data and f3.Data[part]
        local dtp = f0 and (f1.Time - f0.Time) or 0
        local dtn = f3 and (f3.Time - f2.Time) or 0
        if not (isCF(c0) and dtp > EPS) then c0 = nil end
        if not (isCF(c3) and dtn > EPS) then c3 = nil end

        -- position
        local p1, p2 = c1.Position, c2.Position
        local k2 = (p2 - p1) / dt
        local k1 = c0 and (p1 - c0.Position) / dtp or nil
        local k3 = c3 and (c3.Position - p2) / dtn or nil
        local m1 = Vector3.new(
            tang(k1 and k1.X, k2.X, dtp, dt),
            tang(k1 and k1.Y, k2.Y, dtp, dt),
            tang(k1 and k1.Z, k2.Z, dtp, dt))
        local m2 = Vector3.new(
            tang(k2.X, k3 and k3.X, dt, dtn),
            tang(k2.Y, k3 and k3.Y, dt, dtn),
            tang(k2.Z, k3 and k3.Z, dt, dtn))
        seg.p1, seg.p2, seg.m1, seg.m2 = p1, p2, m1 * dt, m2 * dt

        -- rotation
        local r1, r2 = c1.Rotation, c2.Rotation
        seg.r1, seg.r2 = r1, r2
        local d = logv(r1:Inverse() * r2)
        if d.Magnitude < EPS then
            seg.hold = true
        else
            local a = c0 and (logv(c0.Rotation:Inverse() * r1) * ratio(dt, dtp)) or d
            local b = c3 and (logv(r2:Inverse() * c3.Rotation) * ratio(dt, dtn)) or d
            seg.s1 = r1 * expv((a - d) / 4)
            seg.s2 = r2 * expv((d - b) / 4)
        end
        return seg
    end

    _G._PrismSplinePose = function(kf, i, part, a)
        local f1, f2 = kf[i], kf[i + 1]
        if not (f1 and f2) then return nil end
        local c1 = f1.Data and f1.Data[part]
        local c2 = f2.Data and f2.Data[part]
        if not (isCF(c1) and isCF(c2)) then return nil end
        local byKf = cache[kf]
        if not byKf then byKf = {} cache[kf] = byKf end
        local bySeg = byKf[i]
        if not bySeg then bySeg = {} byKf[i] = bySeg end
        local seg = bySeg[part]
        if not (seg and seg.c1 == c1 and seg.c2 == c2 and seg.t1 == f1.Time and seg.t2 == f2.Time) then
            seg = build(kf, i, part)
            bySeg[part] = seg
        end
        if not seg then return nil end
        if seg.lin then return c1:Lerp(c2, a) end
        local t2 = a * a
        local t3 = t2 * a
        local pos = seg.p1 * (2 * t3 - 3 * t2 + 1) + seg.m1 * (t3 - 2 * t2 + a)
            + seg.p2 * (3 * t2 - 2 * t3) + seg.m2 * (t3 - t2)
        local rot
        if seg.hold then
            rot = seg.r1
        else
            rot = seg.r1:Lerp(seg.r2, a):Lerp(seg.s1:Lerp(seg.s2, a), 2 * a * (1 - a))
        end
        return CFrame.new(pos) * rot
    end

    -- the last pose blends into the first over the final moments, so looping never pops
    _G._PrismSplineSeam = function(kf, part, pose, elapsed, total)
        local w = math.min(0.2, total * 0.15)
        if w <= EPS then return pose end
        local s = (elapsed - (total - w)) / w
        if s <= 0 then return pose end
        local first = kf[1] and kf[1].Data and kf[1].Data[part]
        if not (isCF(first) and isCF(pose)) then return pose end
        s = math.clamp(s, 0, 1)
        return pose:Lerp(first, s * s * (3 - 2 * s))
    end
end

--========================================================
--  PRISM  --  GUI CORNER ROUNDING
--  The Emote Hub rounds every corner by UIX.CORNER_SCALE (1.9), which left
--  the rest of Prism looking squarer than it.  Every CornerRadius in the
--  main GUI is multiplied by this so the whole interface matches.
--  Set _G.PrismCornerScale before executing to change it; 1 restores the
--  original corners.  Circles and pills (UDim.new(1, 0) / (0.5, 0)) are
--  left alone -- they are proportional, and scaling them breaks the shape.
--========================================================
PRISM_CORNER_SCALE = tonumber(rawget(_G, "PrismCornerScale")) or 0.6

task.spawn(function()
    pcall(function()
        local data = _G._PrismLoadArtData
        local gca = getcustomasset or getsynasset
        if type(writefile) ~= "function" or type(isfile) ~= "function" or type(readfile) ~= "function" or type(gca) ~= "function" then return end
        pcall(function()
            if type(makefolder) == "function" and (type(isfolder) ~= "function" or not isfolder("ReanimData")) then makefolder("ReanimData") end
        end)
        local ALPHA = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
        local lut = {}
        for i = 1, #ALPHA do lut[string.byte(ALPHA, i)] = i - 1 end
        local function isPng(r)
            return type(r) == "string" and #r > 100 and string.byte(r, 1) == 137 and string.byte(r, 2) == 80 and string.byte(r, 3) == 78 and string.byte(r, 4) == 71
        end
        local function decode(s)
            local fast = nil
            if type(crypt) == "table" then
                if type(crypt.base64decode) == "function" then fast = crypt.base64decode
                elseif type(crypt.base64_decode) == "function" then fast = crypt.base64_decode
                elseif type(crypt.base64) == "table" and type(crypt.base64.decode) == "function" then fast = crypt.base64.decode end
            end
            if not fast and type(base64_decode) == "function" then fast = base64_decode end
            if not fast and type(base64) == "table" and type(base64.decode) == "function" then fast = base64.decode end
            if fast then
                local ok, r = pcall(fast, s)
                if ok and isPng(r) then return r end
            end
            local out, n = {}, 0
            local band, rshift, lshift = bit32.band, bit32.rshift, bit32.lshift
            local char = string.char
            local len = #s
            local i = 1
            while i <= len do
                local c1, c2, c3, c4 = string.byte(s, i, i + 3)
                local n1, n2 = lut[c1], lut[c2]
                if not n1 or not n2 then break end
                local n3, n4 = c3 and lut[c3], c4 and lut[c4]
                local v = lshift(n1, 18) + lshift(n2, 12) + lshift(n3 or 0, 6) + (n4 or 0)
                n = n + 1
                if n3 == nil then
                    out[n] = char(band(rshift(v, 16), 255))
                elseif n4 == nil then
                    out[n] = char(band(rshift(v, 16), 255), band(rshift(v, 8), 255))
                else
                    out[n] = char(band(rshift(v, 16), 255), band(rshift(v, 8), 255), band(v, 255))
                end
                if n % 6000 == 0 then task.wait() end
                i = i + 4
            end
            return table.concat(out)
        end
        local ready = {}
        for i, src in ipairs(data) do
            local clean = string.gsub(src, "[^%w%+/=]", "")
            local pad = 0
            if string.sub(clean, -2) == "==" then pad = 2 elseif string.sub(clean, -1) == "=" then pad = 1 end
            local expect = math.floor(#clean * 3 / 4) - pad
            local path = "ReanimData/px_flower_v1_" .. i .. ".png"
            local same = false
            pcall(function()
                if isfile(path) then
                    local cur = readfile(path)
                    same = (type(cur) == "string" and #cur == expect)
                end
            end)
            if not same then
                local bin = decode(clean)
                if not isPng(bin) then return end
                writefile(path, bin)
            end
            local okA, asset = pcall(gca, path)
            if not okA or type(asset) ~= "string" or asset == "" then return end
            ready[i] = asset
            task.wait()
        end
        _G._PrismLoadArtReady = ready
    end)
end)

_G._ParallaxAssets = (function()
    local ALPHA = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
    local lut = {}
    for i = 1, #ALPHA do lut[string.byte(ALPHA, i)] = i - 1 end

    local DIR = "ReanimData"
    local DEFAULT_BG = DIR .. "/parallax_default_bg.png"
    local DEFAULT_ORB = DIR .. "/parallax_default_orb.png"
    local MARK = DIR .. "/parallax_bg_custom.txt"
    local cache = {}

    local function decode(s)
        s = string.gsub(s, "[^%w%+/=]", "")
        local fast = nil
        if type(crypt) == "table" then
            if type(crypt.base64decode) == "function" then fast = crypt.base64decode
            elseif type(crypt.base64_decode) == "function" then fast = crypt.base64_decode
            elseif type(crypt.base64) == "table" and type(crypt.base64.decode) == "function" then fast = crypt.base64.decode end
        end
        if not fast and type(base64_decode) == "function" then fast = base64_decode end
        if not fast and type(base64) == "table" and type(base64.decode) == "function" then fast = base64.decode end
        if fast then
            local ok, r = pcall(fast, s)
            -- only trust it if the result starts with the JPEG signature
            if ok and type(r) == "string" and #r > 100 and string.byte(r, 1) == 255 and string.byte(r, 2) == 216 then
                return r
            end
        end
        -- pure Lua fallback
        local out, n = {}, 0
        local band, rshift, lshift = bit32.band, bit32.rshift, bit32.lshift
        local char = string.char
        local len = #s
        local i = 1
        while i <= len do
            local c1, c2, c3, c4 = string.byte(s, i, i + 3)
            local n1, n2 = lut[c1], lut[c2]
            if not n1 or not n2 then break end
            local n3, n4 = c3 and lut[c3], c4 and lut[c4]
            local v = lshift(n1, 18) + lshift(n2, 12) + lshift(n3 or 0, 6) + (n4 or 0)
            n = n + 1
            if n3 == nil then
                out[n] = char(band(rshift(v, 16), 255))
            elseif n4 == nil then
                out[n] = char(band(rshift(v, 16), 255), band(rshift(v, 8), 255))
            else
                out[n] = char(band(rshift(v, 16), 255), band(rshift(v, 8), 255), band(v, 255))
            end
            i = i + 4
        end
        return table.concat(out)
    end

    local function gca()
        return getcustomasset or getsynasset
    end
    local function canFiles()
        return type(writefile) == "function" and type(readfile) == "function"
            and type(isfile) == "function" and type(gca()) == "function"
    end
    local function ensureDir()
        pcall(function()
            if type(makefolder) == "function" then
                if type(isfolder) ~= "function" or not isfolder(DIR) then makefolder(DIR) end
            end
        end)
    end
    local function assetOf(path)
        local ok, a = pcall(gca(), path)
        if ok and type(a) == "string" and a ~= "" then return a end
        return nil
    end
    local function writeDefault(key, path)
        local src = _G._ParallaxArt[key]
        -- size the decoded picture will have, worked out from the text, so a file that is
        -- already on disk skips the slow pure-Lua decode
        local clean = string.gsub(src, "[^%w%+/=]", "")
        local pad = 0
        if string.sub(clean, -2) == "==" then pad = 2 elseif string.sub(clean, -1) == "=" then pad = 1 end
        local expect = math.floor(#clean * 3 / 4) - pad
        local same = false
        pcall(function()
            if isfile(path) then
                local cur = readfile(path)
                same = (type(cur) == "string" and #cur == expect)
            end
        end)
        if same then return true end
        local data = decode(src)
        if type(data) ~= "string" or #data < 1000 then return false end
        return (pcall(writefile, path, data))
    end

    local api = {}

    -- path of the background the user picked, or nil when the default is in use
    function api.customPath()
        if not canFiles() then return nil end
        local ok, r = pcall(function()
            if not isfile(MARK) then return nil end
            local p = string.gsub(readfile(MARK) or "", "%s+", "")
            if p ~= "" and isfile(p) then return p end
            return nil
        end)
        if ok then return r end
        return nil
    end
    function api.isCustom()
        return api.customPath() ~= nil
    end
    function api.bg()
        if not canFiles() then return nil end
        ensureDir()
        local custom = api.customPath()
        if custom then
            local a = assetOf(custom)
            if a then return a end
        end
        if not cache.bg and writeDefault("bg", DEFAULT_BG) then
            cache.bg = assetOf(DEFAULT_BG)
        end
        return cache.bg
    end
    -- the circle button shows the square crop, or the user's own background if they set one
    function api.orb()
        if not canFiles() then return nil end
        ensureDir()
        local custom = api.customPath()
        if custom then
            local a = assetOf(custom)
            if a then return a end
        end
        if not cache.orb and writeDefault("orb", DEFAULT_ORB) then
            cache.orb = assetOf(DEFAULT_ORB)
        end
        return cache.orb
    end
    -- remember a custom file (pass "" to go back to the built-in art)
    function api.setCustom(path)
        if not canFiles() then return end
        ensureDir()
        pcall(writefile, MARK, path or "")
    end
    -- push the current images into every labeled image in every menu
    function api.refresh()
        local bgA, orbA = api.bg(), api.orb()
        local roots = {}
        pcall(function()
            local lp = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
            local pg = lp and lp:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
            if pg then roots[#roots + 1] = pg end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            if type(gethui) == "function" then
                local h = gethui()
                if h then roots[#roots + 1] = h end
            end
        end)
        -- only walk our own menus, not every GUI the game has
        local mine = {}
        for _, root in ipairs(roots) do
            pcall(function()
                for _, sg in ipairs(root:GetChildren()) do
                    local gn = sg.Name
                    if sg:IsA("ScreenGui") and (string.find(gn, "Prism", 1, true) or string.find(gn, "Reanim", 1, true)
                        or string.find(gn, "Halo", 1, true) or string.find(gn, "Tranzit", 1, true)
                        or string.find(gn, "Parallax", 1, true) or string.find(gn, "Vexora", 1, true)
                        or string.find(gn, "Emote", 1, true) or string.find(gn, "Fortnite", 1, true)) then
                        mine[#mine + 1] = sg
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
        for _, root in ipairs(mine) do
            pcall(function()
                for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
                    if d:IsA("ImageLabel") then
                        local n = d.Name
                        if n == "ParallaxOrb" then
                            if orbA then
                                d.Image = orbA
                                d.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
                            end
                        elseif n == "CustomBackground" or n == "KeyBg" or n == "VexoraBG" or (n == "Bg" and d.Parent and d.Parent.Name == "Content") then
                            if bgA then
                                d.Image = bgA
                                d.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
    end
    return api
end)()

--========================================================
--  PRISM  --  EXECUTOR COMPATIBILITY LAYER  (v7)
--  Defines safe fallbacks for every executor-only function
--  the script can touch, so it runs on ANY executor:
--    Xeno, Real, Potassium, Solara, Wave, Fluxus, Delta,
--    Codex, Arceus X, Hydrogen, Vega X, Synapse, Script-Ware,
--    Krnl, Electron, SirHurt, Oxygen U, Fluxus, Trigon, ...
--
--  Nothing here overwrites a real implementation -- it only
--  fills in what is missing so a missing function degrades
--  gracefully instead of erroring ("attempt to call a nil value").
--  The whole block is wrapped in pcall so it can never crash.
--========================================================
pcall(function()
    -- resolve the shared "getgenv" table (falls back to _G)
    local function resolveGenv()
        if type(getgenv) == "function" then
            local ok, g = pcall(getgenv)
            if ok and type(g) == "table" then return g end
        end
        return _G
    end
    local GENV = resolveGenv()

    -- ---- getgenv ----
    if type(getgenv) ~= "function" then
        getgenv = function() return GENV end
    end

    -- ---- gethui : hidden UI parent (fallback chain) ----
    if type(gethui) ~= "function" then
        gethui = function()
            local ok, cg = pcall(function() return game:GetService("CoreGui") end)
            if ok and cg then return cg end
            local ok2, pg = pcall(function()
                return game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 10)
            end)
            if ok2 then return pg end
            return nil
        end
    end

    -- ---- HTTP request (unified) ----
    local reqFn =
        (type(syn) == "table" and syn.request) or
        (type(http) == "table" and http.request) or
        (type(fluxus) == "table" and fluxus.request) or
        (type(krnl) == "table" and krnl.request) or
        (type(secure_call) == "function" and nil) or
        http_request or
        request
    if type(request) ~= "function" and type(reqFn) == "function" then request = reqFn end
    if type(http_request) ~= "function" and type(reqFn) == "function" then http_request = reqFn end

    -- ---- custom asset pipeline ----
    if type(getcustomasset) ~= "function" and type(getsynasset) == "function" then
        getcustomasset = getsynasset
    end
    if type(getsynasset) ~= "function" and type(getcustomasset) == "function" then
        getsynasset = getcustomasset
    end

    -- ---- clipboard ----
    local clip = setclipboard or toclipboard or setrbxclipboard
    if type(setclipboard) ~= "function" and type(clip) == "function" then setclipboard = clip end
    if type(toclipboard) ~= "function" and type(clip) == "function" then toclipboard = clip end

    -- ---- loadstring ----
    if type(loadstring) ~= "function" and type(load) == "function" then loadstring = load end

    -- ---- reflection / hooking (safe no-ops when absent) ----
    -- These are only used by optional features; giving them harmless
    -- fallbacks stops "clonefunction(getconnections)" style crashes.
    if type(cloneref) ~= "function" then cloneref = function(x) return x end end
    if type(clonefunction) ~= "function" then clonefunction = function(f) return f end end
    if type(getconnections) ~= "function" then getconnections = function() return {} end end
    if type(hookfunction) ~= "function" then hookfunction = function(f) return f end end
    if type(hookmetamethod) ~= "function" then hookmetamethod = function() end end
    if type(getrawmetatable) ~= "function" then getrawmetatable = function(x) return getmetatable(x) end end
    if type(setreadonly) ~= "function" then setreadonly = function() end end
    if type(getnamecallmethod) ~= "function" then getnamecallmethod = function() return "" end end
    if type(newcclosure) ~= "function" then newcclosure = function(f) return f end end
    if type(iscclosure) ~= "function" then iscclosure = function() return false end end
    if type(islclosure) ~= "function" then islclosure = function() return true end end
    if type(getgc) ~= "function" then getgc = function() return {} end end
    if type(getreg) ~= "function" then getreg = function() return {} end end
    if type(getupvalue) ~= "function" then getupvalue = function() return nil end end
    if type(setupvalue) ~= "function" then setupvalue = function() end end
    if type(getsenv) ~= "function" then getsenv = function() return {} end end
    if type(getloadedmodules) ~= "function" then getloadedmodules = function() return {} end end

    -- ---- executor identity ----
    if type(getexecutorname) ~= "function" then
        getexecutorname = function()
            if type(identifyexecutor) == "function" then
                local ok, n = pcall(identifyexecutor)
                if ok and n then return n end
            end
            return "Unknown"
        end
    end
    if type(identifyexecutor) ~= "function" then
        identifyexecutor = function() return getexecutorname() end
    end

    -- ---- misc executor helpers ----
    -- Remember whether the executor really provides setfpscap BEFORE we
    -- stub it, so the FPS changer can tell a real cap from a no-op stub.
    local _prismFpsStub = function() end
    _G._PrismFpsStub = _prismFpsStub
    _G._PrismRealFpsCap = (type(setfpscap) == "function")
    if type(setfpscap) ~= "function" then setfpscap = _prismFpsStub end
    if type(getfpscap) ~= "function" then getfpscap = function() return 60 end end
    if type(queue_on_teleport) ~= "function" then queue_on_teleport = function() end end
    if type(queueonteleport) ~= "function" then queueonteleport = function() end end
    if type(setthreadidentity) ~= "function" then setthreadidentity = function() end end
    if type(getthreadidentity) ~= "function" then getthreadidentity = function() return 8 end end
    if type(checkcaller) ~= "function" then checkcaller = function() return true end end
    if type(firetouchinterest) ~= "function" then firetouchinterest = function() end end
    if type(fireclickdetector) ~= "function" then fireclickdetector = function() end end

    -- ---- record the executor name for logging / diagnostics ----
    pcall(function()
        GENV.PrismExecutor = identifyexecutor()
        GENV.PrismCompat = true
    end)
end)

;--========================================================
--  PRISM  --  SHARED FPS CAP  (executor-aware)
--  Works on EVERY executor: tries the real setfpscap plus every
--  common alias and reports whether a real cap was actually applied.
--  Used by the main Prism Hub ("Performance") and the settings menu.
--========================================================
_G.PrismSetFPSCap = function(value)
    local target = tonumber(value) or 0
    if target <= 0 then target = 0 end
    local applied = false
    local stub = _G._PrismFpsStub
    pcall(function()
        if type(setthreadidentity) == "function" and setthreadidentity ~= _G._PrismFpsStub then
            setthreadidentity(8)
        end
    end)
    local function call(fn, n)
        if type(fn) ~= "function" or (stub ~= nil and fn == stub) then return false end
        local ok = pcall(fn, n)
        if ok then applied = true return true end
        return false
    end
    local tries = {}
    if target <= 0 then
        tries = {0, 999, 240}
    else
        tries = {target}
    end
    local names = {"setfpscap","set_fps_cap","SetFPSCap","SetFpsCap","setfpslimit","set_fps_limit"}
    for _, n in ipairs(tries) do
        if _G._PrismRealFpsCap == true then call(setfpscap, n) end
        pcall(function()
            local g = getgenv and getgenv()
            if type(g) == "table" then
                for _, name in ipairs(names) do call(g[name], n) end
            end
        end)
        for _, name in ipairs(names) do call(_G[name], n) end
        if type(syn) == "table" then call(syn.set_fps_cap, n); call(syn.setfpscap, n) end
        if type(fluxus) == "table" then call(fluxus.set_fps_cap, n) end
        if type(krnl) == "table" then call(krnl.set_fps_cap, n) end
        if applied then break end
    end
    pcall(function()
        settings().Rendering.EnableFRM = true
    end)
    pcall(function() _G._HaloFPSLimit = false end)
    local stored = target <= 0 and 0 or target
    _G._PrismFPSCap = stored
    _G._PrismFPSWanted = stored
    pcall(function() getgenv().PrismFPSCap = stored end)
    if not _G._PrismFPSReapply then
        _G._PrismFPSReapply = true
        task.spawn(function()
            while true do
                task.wait(1.5)
                local want = _G._PrismFPSWanted
                if want == nil then continue end
                local n = want <= 0 and 0 or want
                pcall(function()
                    if type(setfpscap) == "function" and setfpscap ~= _G._PrismFpsStub then
                        setfpscap(n == 0 and 999 or n)
                    end
                end)
                pcall(function()
                    local g = getgenv and getgenv()
                    if type(g) == "table" and type(g.setfpscap) == "function" and g.setfpscap ~= _G._PrismFpsStub then
                        g.setfpscap(n == 0 and 999 or n)
                    end
                end)
                pcall(function() settings().Rendering.EnableFRM = true end)
            end
        end)
    end
    return true
end
pcall(function() getgenv().PrismSetFPSCap = _G.PrismSetFPSCap end)
pcall(function() getgenv().PrismSetFPS = _G.PrismSetFPSCap end)
pcall(function() _G.PrismSetFPS = _G.PrismSetFPSCap end)
-- Auto-uncap FPS and enable max graphics quality on execute (no manual toggle needed)
pcall(function() _G.PrismSetFPSCap(9999) end)
pcall(function() settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = Enum.QualityLevel.Level21 end)
pcall(function() UserSettings():GetService("UserGameSettings").SavedQualityLevel = Enum.SavedQualitySetting.Automatic end)

--========================================================
--  PRISM  --  PERFORMANCE BOOSTS
--  Each switch saves what it changes and puts it back.
--========================================================
do
    local P = {}
    _G.PrismPerf = P
    P.on = {}
    P.buttons = {}
    local bag = {}
    local FX = { BloomEffect = true, BlurEffect = true, SunRaysEffect = true, DepthOfFieldEffect = true, ColorCorrectionEffect = true }

    local function light() return game:GetService("Lighting") end
    local function players() return game:GetService("Players") end

    local function rememberShadow()
        if bag.shadow0 == nil then bag.shadow0 = light().GlobalShadows end
    end
    local function applyShadow()
        rememberShadow()
        if P.on.shadows or P.on.bright then
            light().GlobalShadows = false
        else
            light().GlobalShadows = bag.shadow0
        end
    end

    local function isFx(d)
        return FX[d.ClassName] == true
    end

    local function otherChars(fn)
        local me = players().LocalPlayer
        for _, plr in ipairs(players():GetPlayers()) do
            if plr ~= me and plr.Character then fn(plr, plr.Character) end
        end
    end

    function P.paint()
        for id, b in pairs(P.buttons) do
            local on = P.on[id] == true
            b.BackgroundColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(55, 65, 85) or Color3.fromRGB(22, 24, 30)
            b.TextColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(220, 225, 235) or Color3.fromRGB(130, 140, 160)
        end
    end

    function P.apply(id, on)
        on = on and true or false
        P.on[id] = on
        local ok, err = pcall(function()
            if id == "shadows" or id == "bright" then
                if id == "bright" then
                    local L = light()
                    if on then
                        if not bag.bright then
                            bag.bright = { L.Brightness, L.Ambient, L.OutdoorAmbient, L.ClockTime }
                        end
                        L.Brightness = 3
                        L.Ambient = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
                        L.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
                        L.ClockTime = 14
                    elseif bag.bright then
                        L.Brightness = bag.bright[1]
                        L.Ambient = bag.bright[2]
                        L.OutdoorAmbient = bag.bright[3]
                        L.ClockTime = bag.bright[4]
                        bag.bright = nil
                    end
                end
                applyShadow()
            elseif id == "effects" then
                bag.fx = bag.fx or {}
                if on then
                    for _, d in ipairs(light():GetChildren()) do
                        if isFx(d) then
                            if bag.fx[d] == nil then bag.fx[d] = d.Enabled end
                            d.Enabled = false
                        end
                    end
                    if not bag.fxConn then
                        bag.fxConn = light().ChildAdded:Connect(function(d)
                            if P.on.effects and isFx(d) then
                                task.defer(function()
                                    if not P.on.effects then return end
                                    if bag.fx[d] == nil then bag.fx[d] = d.Enabled end
                                    pcall(function() d.Enabled = false end)
                                end)
                            end
                        end)
                    end
                else
                    for obj, en in pairs(bag.fx) do
                        pcall(function() if obj.Parent then obj.Enabled = en end end)
                    end
                    bag.fx = {}
                end
            elseif id == "particles" then
                bag.parts = bag.parts or {}
                bag.pGen = (bag.pGen or 0) + 1
                local gen = bag.pGen
                if on then
                    if not bag.pConn then
                        bag.pConn = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
                            if not P.on.particles then return end
                            if d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or d:IsA("Trail") or d:IsA("Beam") or d:IsA("Smoke") or d:IsA("Fire") or d:IsA("Sparkles") then
                                if bag.parts[d] == nil then bag.parts[d] = d.Enabled end
                                d.Enabled = false
                            end
                        end)
                    end
                    task.spawn(function()
                        local n = 0
                        for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                            if gen ~= bag.pGen then return end
                            if d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or d:IsA("Trail") or d:IsA("Beam") or d:IsA("Smoke") or d:IsA("Fire") or d:IsA("Sparkles") then
                                if bag.parts[d] == nil then bag.parts[d] = d.Enabled end
                                d.Enabled = false
                            end
                            n = n + 1
                            if n % 500 == 0 then task.wait() end
                        end
                    end)
                else
                    for obj, en in pairs(bag.parts) do
                        pcall(function() if obj.Parent then obj.Enabled = en end end)
                    end
                    bag.parts = {}
                end
            elseif id == "players" then
                local function hideChar(char, hide)
                    bag.hidden = bag.hidden or {}
                    for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                        if d:IsA("BasePart") then
                            if hide then
                                if bag.hidden[d] == nil then bag.hidden[d] = d.LocalTransparencyModifier end
                                d.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
                            elseif bag.hidden[d] ~= nil then
                                d.LocalTransparencyModifier = bag.hidden[d]
                            end
                        elseif d:IsA("Decal") or d:IsA("Texture") then
                            if hide then
                                if bag.hidden[d] == nil then bag.hidden[d] = d.Transparency end
                                d.Transparency = 1
                            elseif bag.hidden[d] ~= nil then
                                d.Transparency = bag.hidden[d]
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if on then
                    otherChars(function(_, char) hideChar(char, true) end)
                    if not bag.hideConn then
                        bag.hideConn = players().PlayerAdded:Connect(function(plr)
                            plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
                                if not P.on.players then return end
                                task.wait(0.4)
                                if P.on.players then hideChar(char, true) end
                            end)
                        end)
                        for _, plr in ipairs(players():GetPlayers()) do
                            if plr ~= players().LocalPlayer then
                                plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
                                    if not P.on.players then return end
                                    task.wait(0.4)
                                    if P.on.players then hideChar(char, true) end
                                end)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                else
                    otherChars(function(_, char) hideChar(char, false) end)
                    bag.hidden = {}
                end
            elseif id == "hats" then
                bag.hats = bag.hats or {}
                local function hats(char, hide)
                    for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                        if d:IsA("Accessory") or d:IsA("Hat") then
                            for _, p in ipairs(d:GetDescendants()) do
                                if p:IsA("BasePart") then
                                    if hide then
                                        if bag.hats[p] == nil then bag.hats[p] = p.LocalTransparencyModifier end
                                        p.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
                                    elseif bag.hats[p] ~= nil then
                                        p.LocalTransparencyModifier = bag.hats[p]
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if on then
                    otherChars(function(_, char) hats(char, true) end)
                else
                    otherChars(function(_, char) hats(char, false) end)
                    bag.hats = {}
                end
            elseif id == "draw" then
                local L = light()
                if on then
                    if not bag.fog then bag.fog = { L.FogStart, L.FogEnd, L.FogColor } end
                    L.FogStart = 20
                    L.FogEnd = 220
                elseif bag.fog then
                    L.FogStart = bag.fog[1]
                    L.FogEnd = bag.fog[2]
                    L.FogColor = bag.fog[3]
                    bag.fog = nil
                end
            elseif id == "gifs" then
                _G.PrismFreezeGifs = on
            elseif id == "grass" then
                local terrain = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("Terrain")
                if terrain then
                    if on then
                        if bag.grass == nil then bag.grass = terrain.Decoration end
                        terrain.Decoration = false
                    else
                        if bag.grass ~= nil then terrain.Decoration = bag.grass end
                        bag.grass = nil
                    end
                end
            elseif id == "water" then
                local terrain = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("Terrain")
                if terrain then
                    if on then
                        if not bag.water then
                            bag.water = { terrain.WaterWaveSize, terrain.WaterWaveSpeed, terrain.WaterReflectance, terrain.WaterTransparency }
                        end
                        terrain.WaterWaveSize = 0
                        terrain.WaterWaveSpeed = 0
                        terrain.WaterReflectance = 0
                        terrain.WaterTransparency = 0.85
                    elseif bag.water then
                        terrain.WaterWaveSize = bag.water[1]
                        terrain.WaterWaveSpeed = bag.water[2]
                        terrain.WaterReflectance = bag.water[3]
                        terrain.WaterTransparency = bag.water[4]
                        bag.water = nil
                    end
                end
            elseif id == "render" then
                pcall(function() game:GetService("RunService"):Set3dRenderingEnabled(not on) end)
            elseif id == "potato" then
                pcall(function()
                    settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = on and Enum.QualityLevel.Level01 or Enum.QualityLevel.Level21
                end)
                pcall(function()
                    UserSettings():GetService("UserGameSettings").SavedQualityLevel = on and Enum.SavedQualitySetting.QualityLevel1 or Enum.SavedQualitySetting.Automatic
                end)
                for _, k in ipairs({ "shadows", "particles", "effects", "grass", "draw", "gifs" }) do
                    P.apply(k, on)
                end
            end
        end)
        if not ok then warn("[PrismPerf] " .. tostring(id) .. " " .. tostring(err)) end
        P.paint()
    end

    function P.attach(parent, noteFn)
        local card = Instance.new("Frame")
        card.Name = "Boosts"
        card.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 448)
        card.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(692, 268)
        card.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 16, 36)
        card.BackgroundTransparency = 0.16
        card.BorderSizePixel = 0
        card.ZIndex = 7
        card.Parent = parent
        local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
        c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 16)
        c.Parent = card
        local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 14)
        title.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(400, 24)
        title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        title.TextSize = 18
        title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 225, 235)
        title.Text = "Boosts"
        title.ZIndex = 8
        title.Parent = card
        local desc = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        desc.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        desc.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 40)
        desc.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(650, 32)
        desc.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        desc.TextSize = 13
        desc.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        desc.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
        desc.TextWrapped = true
        desc.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 140, 160)
        desc.Text = "Turn these on for more FPS. Each one puts itself back when you turn it off. Potato flips the heavy ones together."
        desc.ZIndex = 8
        desc.Parent = card
        local items = {
            { "shadows", "No Shadows" },
            { "particles", "No Particles" },
            { "effects", "No Effects" },
            { "players", "Hide Players" },
            { "hats", "No Hats" },
            { "bright", "Fullbright" },
            { "draw", "Short Draw" },
            { "gifs", "Still GIFs" },
            { "grass", "No Grass" },
            { "water", "Flat Water" },
            { "render", "3D Off" },
            { "potato", "Potato" },
        }
        for i, item in ipairs(items) do
            local col = (i - 1) % 4
            local row = math.floor((i - 1) / 4)
            local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
            b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(156, 40)
            b.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20 + col * 166, 84 + row * 52)
            b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 24, 30)
            b.BorderSizePixel = 0
            b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            b.TextSize = 13
            b.Text = item[2]
            b.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 140, 160)
            b.AutoButtonColor = false
            b.ZIndex = 9
            b.Parent = card
            local bc = Instance.new("UICorner")
            bc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
            bc.Parent = b
            P.buttons[item[1]] = b
            b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                local now = not P.on[item[1]]
                P.apply(item[1], now)
                if noteFn then noteFn(item[2], now and "ON" or "OFF") end
            end)
        end
        P.paint()
    end
end

--========================================================
--  PRISM  --  KEY GATE v2
--  Keys are checked against a private JSON store (npoint),
--  never against the website. Nothing in here opens, loads or
--  links to the website.
--  Only SHA-256 hashes live in the store. Fails closed: no
--  offline bypass, a bad or unreachable check blocks the load.
--  Opt out (testing only):  getgenv().PrismRequireKey = false
--========================================================
(function()
    if getgenv and getgenv().PrismRequireKey == false then return end
    if _G.PrismRequireKey == false then return end

    local API_URL  = "https://api.npoint.io/532091e58967063a0bcc"
    local KEY_FILE = "prism_key.txt"

    local Players      = game:GetService("Players")
    local HttpService  = game:GetService("HttpService")
    local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

    local gateOk, gateErr = pcall(function()
        ----------------------------------------------------
        -- SHA-256 (matches the website)
        ----------------------------------------------------
        local band, bxor, bnot, rrotate, rshift = bit32.band, bit32.bxor, bit32.bnot, bit32.rrotate, bit32.rshift
        local K = {
            0x428a2f98,0x71374491,0xb5c0fbcf,0xe9b5dba5,0x3956c25b,0x59f111f1,0x923f82a4,0xab1c5ed5,
            0xd807aa98,0x12835b01,0x243185be,0x550c7dc3,0x72be5d74,0x80deb1fe,0x9bdc06a7,0xc19bf174,
            0xe49b69c1,0xefbe4786,0x0fc19dc6,0x240ca1cc,0x2de92c6f,0x4a7484aa,0x5cb0a9dc,0x76f988da,
            0x983e5152,0xa831c66d,0xb00327c8,0xbf597fc7,0xc6e00bf3,0xd5a79147,0x06ca6351,0x14292967,
            0x27b70a85,0x2e1b2138,0x4d2c6dfc,0x53380d13,0x650a7354,0x766a0abb,0x81c2c92e,0x92722c85,
            0xa2bfe8a1,0xa81a664b,0xc24b8b70,0xc76c51a3,0xd192e819,0xd6990624,0xf40e3585,0x106aa070,
            0x19a4c116,0x1e376c08,0x2748774c,0x34b0bcb5,0x391c0cb3,0x4ed8aa4a,0x5b9cca4f,0x682e6ff3,
            0x748f82ee,0x78a5636f,0x84c87814,0x8cc70208,0x90befffa,0xa4506ceb,0xbef9a3f7,0xc67178f2,
        }
        local function u32be(n)
            return string.char(
                math.floor(n / 16777216) % 256,
                math.floor(n / 65536) % 256,
                math.floor(n / 256) % 256,
                n % 256)
        end
        local function sha256(msg)
            local h0,h1,h2,h3 = 0x6a09e667,0xbb67ae85,0x3c6ef372,0xa54ff53a
            local h4,h5,h6,h7 = 0x510e527f,0x9b05688c,0x1f83d9ab,0x5be0cd19
            local bitlen = #msg * 8
            msg = msg .. "\128"
            while (#msg % 64) ~= 56 do msg = msg .. "\0" end
            msg = msg .. u32be(math.floor(bitlen / 4294967296)) .. u32be(bitlen % 4294967296)
            local w = {}
            for i = 1, #msg, 64 do
                for j = 0, 15 do
                    local a, b, c, d = string.byte(msg, i + j*4, i + j*4 + 3)
                    w[j+1] = ((a*256 + b)*256 + c)*256 + d
                end
                for j = 17, 64 do
                    local x, y = w[j-15], w[j-2]
                    local s0 = bxor(rrotate(x,7), rrotate(x,18), rshift(x,3))
                    local s1 = bxor(rrotate(y,17), rrotate(y,19), rshift(y,10))
                    w[j] = (w[j-16] + s0 + w[j-7] + s1) % 4294967296
                end
                local a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h = h0,h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,h7
                for j = 1, 64 do
                    local S1 = bxor(rrotate(e,6), rrotate(e,11), rrotate(e,25))
                    local ch = bxor(band(e,f), band(bnot(e),g))
                    local t1 = (h + S1 + ch + K[j] + w[j]) % 4294967296
                    local S0 = bxor(rrotate(a,2), rrotate(a,13), rrotate(a,22))
                    local maj = bxor(band(a,b), band(a,c), band(b,c))
                    local t2 = (S0 + maj) % 4294967296
                    h=g; g=f; f=e; e=(d+t1)%4294967296; d=c; c=b; b=a; a=(t1+t2)%4294967296
                end
                h0=(h0+a)%4294967296; h1=(h1+b)%4294967296; h2=(h2+c)%4294967296; h3=(h3+d)%4294967296
                h4=(h4+e)%4294967296; h5=(h5+f)%4294967296; h6=(h6+g)%4294967296; h7=(h7+h)%4294967296
            end
            local out = {}
            for _, v in ipairs({h0,h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,h7}) do
                out[#out+1] = string.format("%08x", v)
            end
            return table.concat(out)
        end

        ----------------------------------------------------
        -- Network + storage
        ----------------------------------------------------
        local function httpGet(url)
            local methods = {
                function() return game:HttpGet(url) end,
                function() return game:HttpGetAsync(url) end,
                function() return request({ Url = url, Method = "GET" }).Body end,
                function() return http_request({ Url = url, Method = "GET" }).Body end,
                function() return syn.request({ Url = url, Method = "GET" }).Body end,
            }
            local finished, okRes, body = false, false, nil
            task.spawn(function()
                for _, fn in ipairs(methods) do
                    local ok, res = pcall(fn)
                    if ok and type(res) == "string" and #res > 0 then
                        okRes, body = true, res
                        break
                    end
                end
                finished = true
            end)
            local t0 = os.clock()
            while not finished and (os.clock() - t0) < 8 do task.wait(0.05) end
            if okRes then return body end
            return nil
        end

        local function readSaved()
            local ok, res = pcall(function() return readfile(KEY_FILE) end)
            if ok and type(res) == "string" then
                local k = res:gsub("%s+", "")
                if #k > 0 then return k end
            end
            return nil
        end
        local function persist(k) pcall(function() writefile(KEY_FILE, k) end) end
        local function forget() pcall(function() writefile(KEY_FILE, "") end) end

        -- returns the key list, or nil when the store can't be reached
        local function fetchKeys()
            local res = httpGet(API_URL)
            if type(res) ~= "string" then return nil end
            local ok, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(res) end)
            if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then return nil end
            if type(data.keys) ~= "table" then return {} end
            return data.keys
        end

        -- valid when the hash is listed, not revoked and not expired
        local function matches(entered, keys)
            if type(entered) ~= "string" or type(keys) ~= "table" then return false end
            local norm = entered:gsub("%s+", ""):upper()
            if #norm == 0 then return false end
            local h = sha256(norm)
            local nowMs = math.floor(os.time() * 1000)
            for _, entry in ipairs(keys) do
                if type(entry) == "table" then
                    local hit = false
                    if type(entry.hash) == "string" and entry.hash:lower() == h then hit = true end
                    if type(entry.key) == "string" and entry.key:gsub("%s+", ""):upper() == norm then hit = true end
                    if hit then
                        if entry.revoked == true then return false end
                        local exp = tonumber(entry.expiresAt)
                        if exp and exp > 0 and nowMs > exp then return false end
                        return true
                    end
                end
            end
            return false
        end

        -- saved key still good? (needs a live answer from the store)
        local saved = readSaved()
        if saved then
            local keys = fetchKeys()
            if keys and matches(saved, keys) then return end
            if keys then forget() end
        end

        ----------------------------------------------------
        -- UI
        ----------------------------------------------------
        local parent
        pcall(function()
            local lp = Players.LocalPlayer or Players.PlayerAdded:Wait()
            parent = lp:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 10)
        end)
        if not parent then pcall(function() parent = game:GetService("CoreGui") end) end
        if not parent then pcall(function() if gethui then parent = gethui() end end) end
        if not parent then error("no gui parent") end

        local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
        local C = {
            black = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
            ink   = Color3.fromRGB(9, 9, 9),
            field = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
            line  = Color3.fromRGB(64, 64, 64),
            white = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
            dim   = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 140),
            soft  = Color3.fromRGB(190, 190, 190),
        }
        local FAST = TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

        local function round(inst, r)
            local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
            c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r)
            c.Parent = inst
        end
        local function outline(inst, col, th)
            local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
            s.Color = col; s.Thickness = th or 1
            s.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
            s.Parent = inst
            return s
        end
        local function make(class, props, par)
            local o = Instance.new(class)
            for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
            o.Parent = par
            return o
        end

        local gui = make("ScreenGui", {
            Name = "PrismAccessKey", ResetOnSpawn = false, IgnoreGuiInset = true,
            DisplayOrder = 1000000, ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling,
        }, parent)

        local back = make("Frame", {
            Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = C.black,
            BackgroundTransparency = 0, BorderSizePixel = 0, Active = true,
            ClipsDescendants = true,
        }, gui)

        -- drifting white streaks behind the card
        local bars = {}
        for i = 1, 22 do
            local f = make("Frame", {
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.new(0, (i % 4 == 0) and 2 or 1, 1.7, 0),
                Rotation = 16, BackgroundColor3 = C.white, BorderSizePixel = 0,
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.95 - (i % 3) * 0.02,
            }, back)
            bars[i] = { f = f, x = ((i - 1) * 0.618) % 1, sp = 0.010 + (i % 5) * 0.004 }
        end

        local card = make("Frame", {
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(360, 238), BackgroundColor3 = C.ink,
            BorderSizePixel = 0, ClipsDescendants = true,
        }, back)
        round(card, 6)
        local edge = outline(card, C.white, 1.5)
        local edgeGrad = make("UIGradient", {
            Color = ColorSequence.new({
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, C.white),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, C.white),
            }),
        }, edge)
        local scale = make("UIScale", { Scale = 0.92 }, card)

        -- light sweeping along the top edge
        local sweepLine = make("Frame", {
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 2), BackgroundColor3 = C.white, BorderSizePixel = 0,
        }, card)
        local sweep = make("UIGradient", {
            Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
            }),
        }, sweepLine)

        local title = make("TextLabel", {
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 26), Size = UDim2.new(1, -56, 0, 26),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, TextSize = 22,
            TextColor3 = C.white, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Text = "PARALLAX",
        }, card)
        make("TextLabel", {
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 54), Size = UDim2.new(1, -56, 0, 16),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 12,
            TextColor3 = C.dim, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            Text = "Enter your key to continue",
        }, card)

        local field = make("Frame", {
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 92), Size = UDim2.new(1, -56, 0, 42),
            BackgroundColor3 = C.field, BorderSizePixel = 0,
        }, card)
        round(field, 4)
        local fieldLine = outline(field, C.line, 1)
        local box = make("TextBox", {
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = Enum.Font.Code, TextSize = 14,
            TextColor3 = C.white, PlaceholderColor3 = C.dim,
            PlaceholderText = "XXXX-XXXX-XXXX", Text = "", ClearTextOnFocus = false,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        }, field)

        local status = make("TextLabel", {
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 142), Size = UDim2.new(1, -56, 0, 16),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 12,
            TextColor3 = C.dim, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Text = "",
        }, card)

        local go = make("TextButton", {
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 170), Size = UDim2.new(1, -56, 0, 40),
            BackgroundColor3 = C.white, BorderSizePixel = 0, AutoButtonColor = false,
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 14, TextColor3 = C.black,
            Text = "UNLOCK",
        }, card)
        round(go, 4)
        outline(go, C.white, 1)

        -- hover / focus: invert the button, light the field border
        go.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            TweenService:Create(go, FAST, { BackgroundColor3 = C.black, TextColor3 = C.white }):Play()
        end)
        go.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            TweenService:Create(go, FAST, { BackgroundColor3 = C.white, TextColor3 = C.black }):Play()
        end)
        box.Focused:Connect(function() TweenService:Create(fieldLine, FAST, { Color = C.white }):Play() end)
        box.FocusLost:Connect(function() TweenService:Create(fieldLine, FAST, { Color = C.line }):Play() end)

        TweenService:Create(scale, TweenInfo.new(0.26, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1 }):Play()

        -- one render loop drives every animation
        local t0 = os.clock()
        local conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            local t = os.clock() - t0
            for _, b in ipairs(bars) do
                b.f.Position = UDim2.fromScale((b.x + t * b.sp) % 1, 0.5)
            end
            edgeGrad.Rotation = (t * 80) % 360
            sweep.Offset = Vector2.new(((t * 0.5) % 2) - 1, 0)
            title.Text = "PARALLAX" .. ((math.floor(t * 1.6) % 2 == 0) and "_" or "")
        end)

        local done, busy = false, false
        local function say(text, col) status.Text = text; status.TextColor3 = col or C.dim end

        local function shake()
            local base = card.Position
            for _, dx in ipairs({ 9, -9, 6, -6, 3, 0 }) do
                card.Position = base + UDim2.fromOffset(dx, 0)
                task.wait(0.03)
            end
        end

        local function submit()
            if busy or done then return end
            local entered = (box.Text or ""):gsub("%s+", "")
            if #entered == 0 then say("Type your key first.", C.soft); return end
            busy = true
            go.Text = "CHECKING..."
            say("")
            task.spawn(function()
                local keys = fetchKeys()
                if keys == nil then
                    say("Can't reach the key server. Retry in a moment.", C.soft)
                elseif matches(entered, keys) then
                    persist(entered)
                    say("Access granted.", C.white)
                    go.Text = "WELCOME"
                    task.wait(0.45)
                    done = true
                    return
                else
                    say("Invalid or expired key.", C.soft)
                    task.spawn(shake)
                end
                go.Text = "UNLOCK"
                busy = false
            end)
        end

        go.MouseButton1Click:Connect(submit)
        box.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter) if enter then submit() end end)
        pcall(function() box:CaptureFocus() end)

        while not done do task.wait(0.1) end
        TweenService:Create(back, TweenInfo.new(0.3), { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(scale, TweenInfo.new(0.3), { Scale = 1.06 }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(card, TweenInfo.new(0.3), { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play()
        task.wait(0.32)
        conn:Disconnect()
        gui:Destroy()
    end)

    -- Fail closed: any error in the gate blocks the script instead of skipping the check.
    if not gateOk then
        warn("[PRISM] key gate error: " .. tostring(gateErr))
        pcall(function()
            local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
            local pg = lp and lp:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
            local g = pg and pg:FindFirstChild("PrismAccessKey")
            if g then g:Destroy() end
        end)
        error("PRISM key check failed: " .. tostring(gateErr), 0)
    end
end)()
pcall(function() loadstring("if getgenv().LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE == nil then getgenv().LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE = function(f) return f end end")() end)
pcall(function() loadstring("if getgenv().LPH_JIT == nil then getgenv().LPH_JIT = function(f) return f end end")() end)
pcall(function() loadstring("if getgenv().LPH_JIT_MAX == nil then getgenv().LPH_JIT_MAX = function(f) return f end end")() end)

if not LPS_OBFUSCATED then
    LPS_OBFUSCATED = false
    LPS_CRASH         = function() error("LPS_CRASH triggered", 2) end
    LPS_ENCRYPT       = function(v) return v end
    LPS_EQ            = function(a, b) return a == b end
    LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE = function(f) return f end
    LPH_NO_UPVALUES   = function(f) return f end
    LPS_GET_ARGUMENTS = function(...) return {...} end
end

--========================================================
--  Prism shared window helper (executor edition)
--  Adds drag-to-move + drag-to-resize to any menu frame.
--  If a `content` frame is supplied, its UIScale is kept in
--  sync so the whole layout shrinks / grows cleanly instead
--  of clipping. Works for the hub, the profile card and the
--  little standalone popups alike.
--
--  PrismMakeWindow(win, {
--      handle  = dragBar,        -- frame/button that moves the window
--      content = contentFrame,   -- frame to scale to fit (optional)
--      designW = 980, designH = 600,
--      minW = 460, minH = 320, maxW = 1600, maxH = 1000,
--      grip = true,              -- bottom-right resize handle
--  })
--========================================================
local function PrismMakeWindow(win, opts)
    if not (win and win.Parent) then return nil end
    opts = opts or {}
    local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local TS  = game:GetService("TweenService")

    local designW = opts.designW or win.AbsoluteSize.X
    local designH = opts.designH or win.AbsoluteSize.Y
    if not designW or designW <= 0 then designW = 480 end
    if not designH or designH <= 0 then designH = 320 end
    local minW = opts.minW or math.min(designW, 360)
    local minH = opts.minH or math.min(designH, 240)
    local maxW = opts.maxW or 2400
    local maxH = opts.maxH or 1600

    local content = opts.content
    local scaleObj = nil
    if content then
        scaleObj = content:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
        if not scaleObj then
            scaleObj = Instance.new("UIScale")
            scaleObj.Parent = content
        end
        -- When the window is resized to an aspect ratio different from the design,
        -- uniform UIScale leaves a gap on one side. Fill that gap by matching the
        -- content frame's background to the window background so no "black bar" shows.
        if content.BackgroundTransparency > 0.5 then
            content.BackgroundColor3 = win.BackgroundColor3
            content.BackgroundTransparency = win.BackgroundTransparency
        end
    end
    local function applyScale()
        if not scaleObj then return end
        local w, h = win.AbsoluteSize.X, win.AbsoluteSize.Y
        local s = math.min(w / designW, h / designH)
        if not s or s <= 0 then s = 1 end
        scaleObj.Scale = s
        -- Expand the content frame so that after UIScale it exactly fills the window.
        -- Without this adjustment, uniform scaling letterboxes the content and the
        -- window background shows as a dark band in the unused space.
        if content and s > 0 then
            content.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w / s, h / s)
        end
    end

    -- ---------- drag to move ----------
    if opts.drag ~= false then
        local handle = opts.handle or win
        local dragging, dragStart, startPos = false, nil, nil
        handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                dragging = true
                dragStart = input.Position
                startPos = win.Position
                input.Changed:Connect(function()
                    if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                        dragging = false
                    end
                end)
            end
        end)
        UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if not dragging or not dragStart then return end
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
                or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                local d = input.Position - dragStart
                win.Position = UDim2.new(
                    startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + d.X,
                    startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
            end
        end)
    end

    -- ---------- drag to resize ----------
    -- The window is usually anchored at its center, so growing the size
    -- alone slides the corner out from under the cursor and the drag dies.
    -- Lock the top-left and move the anchor point so the grip stays put.
    local mouse
    pcall(function()
        mouse = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:GetMouse()
    end)
    local function cursorResize(on)
        if not mouse then return end
        pcall(function()
            mouse.Icon = on and "rbxasset://SystemCursors/SizeNWSE" or ""
        end)
    end
    local function placeSized(nw, nh, topLeft)
        local parent = win.Parent
        win.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(nw, nh)
        if not parent or not topLeft then return end
        local ax, ay = win.AnchorPoint.X, win.AnchorPoint.Y
        local pPos, pSize = parent.AbsolutePosition, parent.AbsoluteSize
        local screenX = topLeft.X + ax * nw
        local screenY = topLeft.Y + ay * nh
        local pos = win.Position
        win.Position = UDim2.new(
            pos.X.Scale, screenX - pPos.X - pos.X.Scale * pSize.X,
            pos.Y.Scale, screenY - pPos.Y - pos.Y.Scale * pSize.Y
        )
    end
    if opts.grip ~= false then
        local grip = Instance.new("TextButton")
        grip.Name = "PrismResizeGrip"
        grip.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28)
        grip.Position = UDim2.new(1, -28, 1, -28)
        grip.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 65, 85)
        grip.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
        grip.Text = "↘"
        grip.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        grip.TextSize = 16
        grip.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 225, 235)
        grip.AutoButtonColor = false
        grip.Active = true
        grip.ZIndex = 2000
        grip.Parent = win
        local gc = Instance.new("UICorner"); gc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, math.floor((6) * PRISM_CORNER_SCALE + 0.5)); gc.Parent = grip
        local gs = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        gs.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 140)
        gs.Thickness = 1.5
        gs.Transparency = 0.15
        gs.Parent = grip

        local resizing, rStart, rSize, rTop = false, nil, nil, nil
        grip.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                resizing = true
                rStart = input.Position
                rSize = win.AbsoluteSize
                rTop = win.AbsolutePosition
                input.Changed:Connect(function()
                    if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                        resizing = false
                        cursorResize(false)
                    end
                end)
            end
        end)
        UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if not resizing or not rStart then return end
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
                or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                local d = input.Position - rStart
                local nw = math.clamp(rSize.X + d.X, minW, maxW)
                local nh = math.clamp(rSize.Y + d.Y, minH, maxH)
                placeSized(nw, nh, rTop)
                applyScale()
            end
        end)
        grip.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            cursorResize(true)
            TS:Create(grip, TweenInfo.new(0.12), { BackgroundTransparency = 0 }):Play()
            if gs then TS:Create(gs, TweenInfo.new(0.12), { Transparency = 0 }):Play() end
        end)
        grip.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            if not resizing then cursorResize(false) end
            TS:Create(grip, TweenInfo.new(0.12), { BackgroundTransparency = 0.15 }):Play()
            if gs then TS:Create(gs, TweenInfo.new(0.12), { Transparency = 0.15 }):Play() end
        end)
    end

    task.defer(applyScale)
    pcall(function()
        win:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(applyScale)
    end)
    return { applyScale = applyScale }
end

_G.PrismMakeWindow = PrismMakeWindow

    while true do
        local info = ContextActionService:GetBoundActionInfo("RbxCameraKeypress")
        if info and info.inputTypes then
            ContextActionService:UnbindAction("RbxCameraKeypress")
            break
        end
        task.wait()
    end
end)

-- Helper functions for parsing JSON and table animations
function toCFrame(val)
    if typeof(val) == "CFrame" then
        return val
    elseif type(val) == "table" then
        if #val == 12 then
            return CFrame.new(table.unpack(val))
        elseif #val == 7 then
            return CFrame.new(val[1], val[2], val[3], val[4], val[5], val[6], val[7])
        elseif val.Position or val.position or val.pos or val.Orientation or val.orientation or val.rotation or val.angles or val.CFrame then
            -- Handle {CFrame: {Position: [], Orientation: []}} nested structure
            local cfData = val.CFrame or val
            local pos = cfData.Position or cfData.position or cfData.pos or val.Position or val.position or val.pos or {0,0,0}
            local ori = cfData.Orientation or cfData.orientation or cfData.rotation or cfData.angles or val.Orientation or val.orientation or val.rotation or val.angles or {0,0,0}
            
            local px, py, pz = 0, 0, 0
            if typeof(pos) == "Vector3" then
                px, py, pz = pos.X, pos.Y, pos.Z
            elseif type(pos) == "table" then
                px, py, pz = pos[1] or 0, pos[2] or 0, pos[3] or 0
            end
            
            local rx, ry, rz = 0, 0, 0
            if typeof(ori) == "Vector3" then
                rx, ry, rz = ori.X, ori.Y, ori.Z
            elseif type(ori) == "table" then
                rx, ry, rz = ori[1] or 0, ori[2] or 0, ori[3] or 0
            end
            
            return CFrame.new(px, py, pz) * CFrame.fromEulerAnglesXYZ(rx, ry, rz)
        else
            local ok, cf = pcall(function() return CFrame.new(table.unpack(val)) end)
            if ok then return cf end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function parseTableAnimation(raw)
    if type(raw) ~= "table" then return nil end
    -- Unwrap root-object formats: {keyframes=[...]}, {Keyframes=[...]}, etc.
    local arrayRoot = raw
    if type(raw[1]) ~= "table" then
        for _, key in ipairs({"keyframes","Keyframes","animations","frames","data","Frames","KeyframeSequence","animData"}) do
            if type(raw[key]) == "table" then 
                local sub = raw[key]
                if key == "animData" and type(sub.KeyframeSequence) == "table" then
                    arrayRoot = sub.KeyframeSequence
                else
                    arrayRoot = sub
                end
                break 
            end
        end
    end
    local keyframes = {}

    -- Helper: extract bone CFrame data from a single keyframe entry
    local function extractSingleFrame(frame, key)
        if type(frame) ~= "table" then return end
        local t = frame.Time or frame.time or frame.timestamp or frame.t
        if t == nil and key then
            t = tonumber(key)
        end
        -- Look for poses/bones in multiple property names
        local posesRaw = frame.Poses or frame.poses or frame.joints or frame.bones or frame.Joints or frame.Data or frame.data
        if not posesRaw then posesRaw = frame end
        if t ~= nil and type(posesRaw) == "table" then
            local kf = {Time = tonumber(t) or 0, Data = {}}
            for boneName, boneData in pairs(posesRaw) do
                if type(boneName) == "string" and (boneName:lower() == "time" or boneName:lower() == "t") then continue end
                if type(boneData) ~= "table" and typeof(boneData) ~= "CFrame" then continue end
                -- If boneData is already a CFrame, use it directly — DO NOT index it with .CFrame
                -- (that throws "CFrame is not a valid member of CFrame")
                local rawVal
                if typeof(boneData) == "CFrame" then
                    rawVal = boneData
                else
                    -- Try to get CFrame from various property names
                    rawVal = boneData.CFrame or boneData.cframe or boneData.transform or boneData
                end
                local cf = toCFrame(rawVal)
                if cf then
                    kf.Data[boneName] = cf
                end
            end
            if next(kf.Data) then
                table.insert(keyframes, kf)
            end
        end
    end

    -- Yield every 50 keyframes so the game scheduler can breathe on large animations
    local processed = 0
    for key, frame in pairs(arrayRoot) do
        if type(frame) ~= "table" then continue end
        -- Format-2 support: if this value is an array of keyframe objects (named sequence),
        -- iterate through the sub-array instead of treating it as a single frame
        if type(frame[1]) == "table" then
            for subIdx, subFrame in ipairs(frame) do
                extractSingleFrame(subFrame, subIdx)
                processed = processed + 1
                if processed % 50 == 0 then task.wait() end
            end
        else
            extractSingleFrame(frame, key)
            processed = processed + 1
            if processed % 50 == 0 then task.wait() end
        end
    end
    if #keyframes == 0 then 
        warn("[AnimEditor] parseTableAnimation produced 0 keyframes from", #arrayRoot or 0, "input frames")
        return nil 
    end
    table.sort(keyframes, function(a, b) return a.Time < b.Time end)
    return keyframes
end

function parseJsonAnimation(content)
    local ok, raw = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(content) end)
    if not ok then 
        warn("[AnimEditor] JSON decode failed:", raw)
        return nil 
    end
    local result = parseTableAnimation(raw)
    if not result then
        warn("[AnimEditor] parseTableAnimation failed for JSON data. Raw structure:", typeof(raw), type(raw))
        if type(raw) == "table" then
            local keys = {}
            for k, v in pairs(raw) do table.insert(keys, tostring(k)) end
            warn("[AnimEditor] Keys in JSON:", table.concat(keys, ", "))
            if raw[1] then
                warn("[AnimEditor] First element type:", type(raw[1]))
                if type(raw[1]) == "table" then
                    local firstKeys = {}
                    for k, v in pairs(raw[1]) do table.insert(firstKeys, tostring(k)) end
                    warn("[AnimEditor] First element keys:", table.concat(firstKeys, ", "))
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return result
end

-- Load API (embedded)
local ReanimateAPI
do
    local halo = {
        services = {
            players = game:GetService("Players");
            workspace = game:GetService("Workspace");
            replicated = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage");
            run_service = game:GetService("RunService");
            http_service = game:GetService("HttpService");
        };
        flags = {
            reanimated = false;
            switching = false;
        };
        clones = {};
        connections = {
            hb = nil;
            died = nil;
            real_char_child_removed = nil;
            character_removing = nil;
            clone_died = nil;
            clone_char_child_removed = nil;
            animation_hb = nil;
            zero_delay = nil;
            zero_delay_hrp_sync = nil;
            shiftlock_hb = nil;
        };
        real_chars = {};
        callbacks = {
            on_play = nil;
            on_stop = nil;
        };
        animation = {
            cache = {};
            constraints_cache = nil;
            state = {
                is_playing = false;
                current_url = nil;
                speed = 1.0;
                keyframes = nil;
                total_duration = 0;
                elapsed_time = 0;
            };
            original_transforms = {};
            constraints = {};
        };
    };

    local API = {};

    local get_game_ragdoll_info = function(enable)
        -- 1) a ragdoll remote you picked for this game (Game Setup page)
        local okU, uRemote, uArgs, uLocal = pcall(function()
            if type(_G._PrismRagdollResolve) == "function" then return _G._PrismRagdollResolve(enable) end
        end);
        if okU and typeof(uRemote) == "Instance" then
            return uRemote, uArgs or {}, uLocal == true;
        end;
        -- 2) built-in profiles. Lookups time out instead of hanging, and a miss just means basic mode.
        local okB, bRemote, bArgs, bLocal = pcall(function()
            local place_id = game.PlaceId;
            local rep = halo.services.replicated;
            if place_id == 15546218972 or place_id == 6884319169 then
                local remote = rep:WaitForChild("event_rag", 6);
                if remote then return remote, {"Ball"}, false end;
            elseif place_id == 5991163185 then
                local remote = rep:WaitForChild("Remotes", 6);
                remote = remote and remote:WaitForChild("Physics", 6);
                remote = remote and remote:WaitForChild("Ragdoll", 6);
                if remote then return remote, {}, false end;
            elseif place_id == 5666838333 then
                local local_event = rep:WaitForChild("LocalRagdollEvent", 6);
                if local_event then return local_event, {enable}, true end;
            elseif place_id == 82743296934947 then
                local remote = rep:WaitForChild("Ragdoll", 6);
                if remote then return remote, {}, false end;
            end;
        end);
