        local wheelPages = {}
        local CustomWheelPages = {
            {"Dance Moves", "Fresh", "Electro Shuffle", "Ride The Pony", "Floss", "The Worm", "Take The L", "Boogie Down"},
            {"Hype", "Tidy", "Breakin'", "Disco Fever", "Orange Justice", "Zany", "Groove Jam", "Freestylin'"},
            {"True Heart", "Rambunctious", "Twist", "Living Large", "Llama Bell", "Fancy Feet", "Hula", "Electro Swing"},
            {"Phone It In", "Flamenco", "Backstroke", "Marsh Walk", "Scenario", "Dream Feet", "Switchstep", "Billy Bounce"},
            {"Infectious"}
        }

        local function buildWheelPages(searchQuery)
            wheelPages = {}
            local q = (searchQuery and searchQuery ~= "") and string.lower(searchQuery) or ""
            
            if q == "" then
                for i, page in ipairs(CustomWheelPages) do
                    local pageCopy = {}
                    for _, e in ipairs(page) do table.insert(pageCopy, e) end
                    table.insert(wheelPages, { page = i, emotes = pageCopy })
                end
            else
                local filtered = {}
                for _, page in ipairs(CustomWheelPages) do
                    for _, e in ipairs(page) do
                        if string.find(string.lower(e), q, 1, true) then
                            table.insert(filtered, e)
                        end
                    end
                end
                
                local pageEmotes = {}
                for i, e in ipairs(filtered) do
                    table.insert(pageEmotes, e)
                    if #pageEmotes == 8 then
                        table.insert(wheelPages, { page = #wheelPages + 1, emotes = pageEmotes })
                        pageEmotes = {}
                    end
                end
                if #pageEmotes > 0 then
                    table.insert(wheelPages, { page = #wheelPages + 1, emotes = pageEmotes })
                end
            end
            
            if #wheelPages == 0 then
                table.insert(wheelPages, { page = 1, emotes = {} })
            end
        end

        buildWheelPages("")
-- Ensure local audio and icons cache directories exist
        local audioFolder = CONFIG.FOLDER .. "/fortniteaudios"
        local iconsFolder = CONFIG.FOLDER .. "/fortniteicons"
        pcall(function() makefolder(audioFolder) end)
        pcall(function() makefolder(iconsFolder) end)

        -- Audio session tracking to prevent overlapping/stale audio
        local audioSession = 0
        local currentSound = nil

        local function stopEmoteAudio(instant)
            audioSession = audioSession + 1
            if currentSound then
                local soundObj = currentSound
                currentSound = nil
                if instant then
                    pcall(function() soundObj:Stop(); soundObj:Destroy() end)
                else
                    task.spawn(function()
                        local tween = TweenService:Create(soundObj, TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {Volume = 0})
                        tween:Play()
                        tween.Completed:Wait()
                        pcall(function() soundObj:Stop(); soundObj:Destroy() end)
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
        if ReanimateAPI then
            ReanimateAPI.stop_emote_audio = stopEmoteAudio
        end

        -- Helper to download assets locally
        local function getLocalAsset(url, folder, filename)
            local localPath = folder .. "/" .. filename
            local ok, cached = pcall(readfile, localPath)
            local get_asset = getcustomasset or getsynasset
            if ok and cached and cached ~= "" then
                if type(get_asset) == "function" then
                    local ok2, res = pcall(get_asset, localPath)
                    if ok2 then return res end
                end
                return nil
            end
            local downloaded = request_get(url)
            if downloaded and downloaded ~= "" then
                pcall(function() writefile(localPath, downloaded) end)
                if type(get_asset) == "function" then
                    local ok2, res = pcall(get_asset, localPath)
                    if ok2 then return res end
                end
            end
            return nil
        end

        local function playEmoteAudio(emoteName)
            stopEmoteAudio(true)
            local session = audioSession
            task.spawn(function()
                local url = "" .. game:GetService("HttpService"):UrlEncode(emoteName) .. ".mp3"
                local assetId = getLocalAsset(url, audioFolder, emoteName .. ".mp3")
                if assetId and audioSession == session then
                    pcall(function()
                        local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
                        sound.Name = "HaloEmoteSound"
                        sound.SoundId = assetId
                        sound.Volume = 0
                        sound.Looped = true
                        sound.Parent = game:GetService("SoundService")
                        sound:Play()
                        if audioSession ~= session then
                            sound:Stop(); sound:Destroy()
                            return
                        end
                        currentSound = sound
                        TweenService:Create(sound, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {Volume = 0.3}):Play()
                    end)
                end
            end)
        end

        -- Sound helper for menu hover/click sound effects
        local function playClickSound()
            task.spawn(function()
                local assetId = getLocalAsset("", audioFolder, "Click.mp3")
                if assetId then
                    pcall(function()
                        local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
                        sound.Name = "HaloClickSound"
                        sound.SoundId = assetId
                        sound.Volume = 0.2
                        sound.Parent = game:GetService("SoundService")
                        sound:Play()
                        task.delay(1, function()
                            pcall(function() sound:Destroy() end)
                        end)
                    end)
                end
            end)
        end

        -- Stop audio when animation stops
        if ReanimateAPI and ReanimateAPI.on_animation_stop then
            ReanimateAPI.on_animation_stop(function(stoppedName)
                stopEmoteAudio(false)
            end)
        end

        local drawWheel = function()
           
            for _, seg in ipairs(segmentFrames) do
                pcall(function() seg:Destroy() end)
            end
            segmentFrames = {}

            local pageData = wheelPages[currentPageIdx]
            if not pageData then return end
            local emotes = pageData.emotes
            local totalEmotes = #emotes

            currentHoveredEmote = nil
            centerLabel.Text = ""
            updateDots()

            local outerRadius = 155
            local segSize = math.clamp(88 - (totalEmotes - 6) * 4, 64, 92)

            for i, emoteName in ipairs(emotes) do
                local angle = ((i - 1) / totalEmotes) * 360 - 90
                local rad = math.rad(angle)
                local xOffset = math.cos(rad) * outerRadius
                local yOffset = math.sin(rad) * outerRadius

                local seg = Instance.new("TextButton", mainFrame)
                seg.Name = "Seg_" .. i
                seg.Size = UDim2.new(0, segSize, 0, segSize)
                seg.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, xOffset, 0.5, yOffset - 15)
                seg.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                seg.BackgroundColor3 = FN.bgSegment
                seg.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
                seg.Text = ""
                seg.BorderSizePixel = 0
                seg.AutoButtonColor = false
                seg.ZIndex = 6
                Instance.new("UICorner", seg).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, math.floor((14) * PRISM_CORNER_SCALE + 0.5))
                local segStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", seg)
                segStroke.Color = FN.stroke
                segStroke.Thickness = 1.8
                segStroke.Transparency = 0.35

                -- Icon
                local icon = Instance.new("ImageLabel", seg)
                icon.Name = "Icon"
                icon.Size = UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 0.6, 0)
                icon.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.38, 0)
                icon.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                icon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                icon.ImageColor3 = FN.textGray
                icon.ZIndex = 7

                task.spawn(function()
                    local url = "" .. game:GetService("HttpService"):UrlEncode(emoteName) .. ".png"
                    local assetId = getLocalAsset(url, iconsFolder, emoteName .. ".png")
                    if assetId then
                        icon.Image = assetId
                    end
                end)

                local segName = Instance.new("TextLabel", seg)
                segName.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 14)
                segName.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.82, 0)
                segName.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                segName.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                segName.Text = emoteName
                segName.TextColor3 = FN.textDim
                segName.TextSize = 8
                segName.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
                segName.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
                segName.ZIndex = 7

                seg.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                    playClickSound()
                    currentHoveredEmote = emoteName
                    centerLabel.Text = emoteName:upper()

                    for _, otherSeg in ipairs(segmentFrames) do
                        if otherSeg ~= seg and otherSeg.Parent then
                            TweenService:Create(otherSeg, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {
                                BackgroundColor3 = FN.bgSegment, BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
                            }):Play()
                            local os2 = otherSeg:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
                            if os2 then TweenService:Create(os2, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {Color = FN.stroke, Transparency = 0.35}):Play() end
                            local oi = otherSeg:FindFirstChild("Icon")
                            if oi then TweenService:Create(oi, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {ImageColor3 = FN.textGray}):Play() end
                        end
                    end

                    TweenService:Create(seg, TweenInfo.new(0.08), {
                        BackgroundColor3 = FN.bgSegmentHover, BackgroundTransparency = 0
                    }):Play()
                    TweenService:Create(segStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.08), {Color = FN.strokeHover, Transparency = 0}):Play()
                    TweenService:Create(icon, TweenInfo.new(0.08), {ImageColor3 = FN.textWhite}):Play()
                    TweenService:Create(seg, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {Size = UDim2.new(0, segSize + 6, 0, segSize + 6)}):Play()
                end)

                seg.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                    TweenService:Create(seg, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {
                        BackgroundColor3 = FN.bgSegment, BackgroundTransparency = 0.1,
                        Size = UDim2.new(0, segSize, 0, segSize)
                    }):Play()
                    TweenService:Create(segStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {Color = FN.stroke, Transparency = 0.35}):Play()
                    TweenService:Create(icon, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {ImageColor3 = FN.textGray}):Play()
                end)

                seg.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                    mainFrame.Visible = false
                    screenOverlay.Visible = false
                    triggerEmote(emoteName)
                end)

                table.insert(segmentFrames, seg)
            end
        end

        triggerEmote = function(emoteName)
            if not emoteName then return end
            task.spawn(function()
                if not ReanimateAPI.is_reanimated() then
                    Notify("Fortnite Wheel", "Please reanimate first!", 3)
                    return
                end

                stopEmoteAudio(true)

                local lowerName = emoteName:lower()
                local actualAnimName = nil
                local isCustom = false
                local animUrl = nil
                local isRaw = false

                for _, ca in ipairs(CustomAnims) do
                    if ca.name:lower() == lowerName then
                        actualAnimName = ca.name
                        isCustom = true
                        animUrl = ca.url
                        isRaw = ca.raw ~= false
                        break
                    end
                end

                if not actualAnimName then
                    for name, url in pairs(AnimationList) do
                        if name:lower() == lowerName then
                            actualAnimName = name
                            animUrl = url
                            isRaw = false
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end

                if not actualAnimName then
                    for name, url in pairs(presetList) do
                        if name:lower() == lowerName then
                            actualAnimName = name
                            animUrl = url
                            isRaw = false
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end

                if actualAnimName and animUrl then
                    local wasPlaying = State.selectedAnim == actualAnimName
                    PlayAnimation(actualAnimName, State.currentSpeed, isRaw)
                    
                    if not wasPlaying then
                        playEmoteAudio(actualAnimName)
                    end
                else
               
                    local fallbackUrl = "" .. game:GetService("HttpService"):UrlEncode(emoteName) .. ".lua"
                    local downloaded = request_get(fallbackUrl)
                    if downloaded and downloaded ~= "" then
                        AnimationList[emoteName] = fallbackUrl
                        pcall(function() writefile(GetCachePath(emoteName), downloaded) end)
                        local wasPlaying = State.selectedAnim == emoteName
                        PlayAnimation(emoteName, State.currentSpeed, false)
                        if not wasPlaying then
                            playEmoteAudio(emoteName)
                        end
                    else
                        Notify("Fortnite Wheel", "Animation not found!", 3)
                    end
                end
            end)
        end

        leftArrow.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            playClickSound()
            currentPageIdx = currentPageIdx > 1 and currentPageIdx - 1 or #wheelPages
            drawWheel()
        end)
        rightArrow.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            playClickSound()
            currentPageIdx = currentPageIdx < #wheelPages and currentPageIdx + 1 or 1
            drawWheel()
        end)

        searchBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
            buildWheelPages(searchBox.Text)
            drawWheel()
        end)

        drawWheel()

        local wheelScale = Instance.new("UIScale", mainFrame)
        wheelScale.Scale = 1

        local showWheel = function()
            mainFrame.Visible = true
            screenOverlay.Visible = true
            wheelScale.Scale = 0.85
            screenOverlay.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            TweenService:Create(wheelScale, TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Exponential, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = 1}):Play()
            TweenService:Create(screenOverlay, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundTransparency = 0.55}):Play()
            searchBox.Text = ""
            buildWheelPages("")            currentPageIdx = currentPageIdx or 1
            drawWheel()
        end

        local hideWheel = function()
            TweenService:Create(wheelScale, TweenInfo.new(0.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {Scale = 0.85}):Play()
            TweenService:Create(screenOverlay, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
            task.delay(0.1, function()
                mainFrame.Visible = false
                screenOverlay.Visible = false
            end)
        end

        _G._OpenFortniteWheel = function()
            if not ScreenGui or not ScreenGui.Parent then return end
            if mainFrame.Visible then
                hideWheel()
            else
                showWheel()
            end
        end

        local isHolding = false
        local keyBeganConn = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(i, gp)
            if gp then return end
            if not ScreenGui or not ScreenGui.Parent then return end
            if _G._FortniteWheelKey and i.KeyCode == _G._FortniteWheelKey then
                isHolding = true
                showWheel()
            end
        end)

        local keyEndedConn = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(i, gp)
            if _G._FortniteWheelKey and i.KeyCode == _G._FortniteWheelKey then
                if isHolding and mainFrame.Visible then
                    isHolding = false
                    hideWheel()
                    if currentHoveredEmote then
                        triggerEmote(currentHoveredEmote)
                    end
                end
            end
        end)

        if _G._HaloReanimGlobalConns then
            table.insert(_G._HaloReanimGlobalConns, keyBeganConn)
            table.insert(_G._HaloReanimGlobalConns, keyEndedConn)
        end
    end))

end

pcall(function()
    ScreenGui.Parent = _screenGuiTarget
    if not ScreenGui.Parent then
        warn("[Halo Reanim] Failed to parent ScreenGui to " .. tostring(_screenGuiTarget))
        ScreenGui.Parent = PlayerGui
    end
    ScreenGui.Enabled = true
    Menu.Visible = true
end)

BuildRowPool()
SwitchTab("All")

-- ============================================================
--  COMMAND BAR  (open with  ;  )
-- ============================================================
do
    local UIS        = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local TweenSvc   = game:GetService("TweenService")
    local cmdOpen    = false

    -- ── Overlay (dims + blocks game clicks when bar is open) ──────────────
    local overlay = Instance.new("Frame")
    overlay.Name              = "CmdOverlay"
    overlay.Parent            = ScreenGui
    overlay.BackgroundColor3  = Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
    overlay.BackgroundTransparency = 0
    overlay.BorderSizePixel   = 0
    overlay.Size              = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
    overlay.ZIndex            = 200
    overlay.Visible           = false
    overlay.Active            = true

    -- ── Container card ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    local container = Instance.new("Frame")
    container.Name             = "CmdBarContainer"
    container.Parent           = ScreenGui
    container.AnchorPoint      = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
    container.Position         = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.22, 0)
    container.Size             = UDim2.new(0, 520, 0, 48)
    container.BackgroundColor3 = C.bg1
    container.BackgroundTransparency = 0.06
    container.BorderSizePixel  = 0
    container.ZIndex           = 201
    container.Visible          = false
    container.ClipsDescendants = false
    do
        local corner = Instance.new("UICorner"); corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,14); corner.Parent = container
        local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke"); stroke.Color = C.glassBorder; stroke.Transparency = 0.5; stroke.Thickness = 1; stroke.Parent = container
    end

    -- icon
    local icon = Instance.new("TextLabel"); icon.Parent = container
    icon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    icon.Position = UDim2.new(0,14,0.5,0); icon.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0,0.5)
    icon.Size = UDim2.new(0,22,0,22)
    icon.Text = "⌘"; icon.TextColor3 = C.text3; icon.TextSize = 15
    icon.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold; icon.ZIndex = 202

    -- input box
    local input = Instance.new("TextBox"); input.Name = "CmdInput"; input.Parent = container
    input.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    input.Position = UDim2.new(0,44,0,0); input.Size = UDim2.new(1,-60,1,0)
    input.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    input.PlaceholderText = "Type a command…"; input.PlaceholderColor3 = C.text3
    input.Text = ""; input.TextColor3 = C.text; input.TextSize = 14
    input.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    input.ClearTextOnFocus = false; input.ZIndex = 202

    -- ── Results list (drops below the card) ───────────────────────────────
    local listFrame = Instance.new("Frame"); listFrame.Name = "CmdResults"; listFrame.Parent = container
    listFrame.BackgroundColor3 = C.bg1; listFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.06
    listFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    listFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0,0,1,6); listFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,0)
    listFrame.ZIndex = 201; listFrame.ClipsDescendants = true; listFrame.Visible = false
    do
        local corner = Instance.new("UICorner"); corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,12); corner.Parent = listFrame
        local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke"); stroke.Color = C.glassBorder; stroke.Transparency = 0.6; stroke.Thickness = 1; stroke.Parent = listFrame
        local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding"); pad.Parent = listFrame
        pad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0,6); pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0,6)
        pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0,6); pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0,6)
    end
    local listLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout"); listLayout.Parent = listFrame
    listLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    listLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0,2)
    listLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical

    -- ── Command table ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    local COMMANDS = {
        { "Open GUI",      "Show the PARALLAX window",              function() Menu.Visible = true; ScreenGui.Enabled = true end },
        { "Close GUI",     "Hide the PARALLAX window",              function() Menu.Visible = false end },
        { "Tab: All",      "Go to All animations",                  function() SwitchTab("All") end },
        { "Tab: Favs",     "Go to Favourites",                      function() SwitchTab("Favs") end },
        { "Tab: Custom",   "Go to Custom tab",                      function() SwitchTab("Custom") end },
        { "Tab: Binds",    "Go to Binds tab",                       function() SwitchTab("Binds") end },
        { "Tab: States",   "Go to States tab",                      function() SwitchTab("States") end },
        { "Tab: Speed",    "Go to Speed tab",                       function() SwitchTab("Speed") end },
        { "Tab: Settings", "Go to Settings tab",                    function() SwitchTab("Settings") end },
        { "Stop Animation","Stop the currently playing animation",  function() pcall(function() StopBtn.MouseButton1Click:Fire() end) end },
        { "Toggle ESP",    "Toggle player ESP highlights on/off",   function() pcall(function() espOn = not espOn; setEsp(espOn) end) end },
        { "Scripts",       "Open the Scripts executor panel",       function() pcall(function() switchBottomTab("Scripts") end) end },
        { "Auto Execute",  "Open the Auto Execute panel",           function() pcall(function() switchBottomTab("Auto Execute") end) end },
    }

    -- ── Row factory ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    local rowPool, activeRows, selectedIdx = {}, {}, 1

    local function makeRow()
        local row = Instance.new("TextButton"); row.BackgroundColor3 = C.bg2
        row.BackgroundTransparency = 1; row.BorderSizePixel = 0
        row.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,40); row.Text = ""; row.ZIndex = 203; row.AutoButtonColor = false
        do local c = Instance.new("UICorner"); c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,8); c.Parent = row end
        local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", row); lbl.Name = "Label"
        lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1; lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0,12,0,5)
        lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1,-16,0,17); lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
        lbl.TextColor3 = C.text; lbl.TextSize = 12; lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; lbl.ZIndex = 204
        local desc = Instance.new("TextLabel", row); desc.Name = "Desc"
        desc.BackgroundTransparency = 1; desc.Position = UDim2.new(0,12,0,22)
        desc.Size = UDim2.new(1,-16,0,13); desc.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        desc.TextColor3 = C.text3; desc.TextSize = 10; desc.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; desc.ZIndex = 204
        return row
    end

    local function hilite(row, on)
        TweenSvc:Create(row, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {
            BackgroundTransparency = on and 0.65 or 1,
            BackgroundColor3       = on and C.bg3 or C.bg2,
        }):Play()
        local lbl = row:FindFirstChild("Label")
        if lbl then lbl.TextColor3 = on and C.accent or C.text end
    end

    -- ── Close helper ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    local function closeBar()
        if not cmdOpen then return end
        cmdOpen = false
        input:ReleaseFocus()
        overlay.Visible = false
        pcall(function() ScreenGui.DisplayOrder = 0 end)
        TweenSvc:Create(container, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Position = UDim2.new(0.5,0,0.18,0),
        }):Play()
        task.delay(0.22, function()
            if not cmdOpen then
                container.Visible = false; listFrame.Visible = false
                container.BackgroundTransparency = 0.06
                container.Position = UDim2.new(0.5,0,0.22,0)
                input.Text = ""
            end
        end)
    end

    -- ── Rebuild results ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
    local function rebuildResults(query)
        for _, r in ipairs(activeRows) do r.Visible = false; r.Parent = nil; table.insert(rowPool, r) end
        activeRows = {}; selectedIdx = 1

        local q = query:lower():gsub("^%s+",""):gsub("%s+$","")
        local matches = {}
        for _, cmd in ipairs(COMMANDS) do
            if q == "" or cmd[1]:lower():find(q,1,true) or cmd[2]:lower():find(q,1,true) then
                table.insert(matches, cmd)
            end
        end

        if #matches == 0 then
            TweenSvc:Create(listFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,0)}):Play()
            task.delay(0.14, function() if #activeRows == 0 then listFrame.Visible = false end end)
            return
        end

        for i, cmd in ipairs(matches) do
            local row = table.remove(rowPool) or makeRow()
            row.Parent = listFrame; row.LayoutOrder = i; row.Visible = true
            row:FindFirstChild("Label").Text = cmd[1]
            row:FindFirstChild("Desc").Text  = cmd[2]
            hilite(row, i == 1)

            local idx = i
            row.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                selectedIdx = idx
                for j,r in ipairs(activeRows) do hilite(r, j==idx) end
            end)
            row.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                closeBar()
                task.defer(cmd[3])
            end)
            table.insert(activeRows, row)
        end

        local rows = math.min(#matches, 6)
        local h = rows*40 + (rows-1)*2 + 14
        listFrame.Visible = true
        TweenSvc:Create(listFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,h)}):Play()
    end

    -- ── Open ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    local function openBar()
        if cmdOpen then return end
        cmdOpen = true; overlay.Visible = true; container.Visible = true
        pcall(function() ScreenGui.DisplayOrder = 700 end)
        container.BackgroundTransparency = 1; container.Position = UDim2.new(0.5,0,0.18,0)
        TweenSvc:Create(container, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.06,
            Position = UDim2.new(0.5,0,0.22,0),
        }):Play()
        input.Text = ""; rebuildResults("")
        task.defer(function() input:CaptureFocus() end)
    end

    -- ── Keyboard wiring ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
    UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp, gp)
        if gp then return end
        if inp.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Semicolon then
            if cmdOpen then closeBar() else openBar() end
        elseif inp.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape and cmdOpen then
            closeBar()
        elseif inp.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Return and cmdOpen then
            if activeRows[selectedIdx] then
                local fn = COMMANDS[selectedIdx] and COMMANDS[selectedIdx][3]
                closeBar()
                if fn then task.defer(fn) end
            end
        elseif inp.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Up and cmdOpen then
            if selectedIdx > 1 then
                selectedIdx -= 1
                for i,r in ipairs(activeRows) do hilite(r, i==selectedIdx) end
            end
        elseif inp.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Down and cmdOpen then
            if selectedIdx < #activeRows then
                selectedIdx += 1
                for i,r in ipairs(activeRows) do hilite(r, i==selectedIdx) end
            end
        end
    end)

    overlay.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
        if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then closeBar() end
    end)

    input:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
        selectedIdx = 1; rebuildResults(input.Text)
    end)
end  -- command bar

function _runEmbeddedReanimation()
    if _haloReanimHasRun then
        local found = pcall(function()
            local pg = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
            local cg = game:GetService("CoreGui")
            if pg then
                for _, sg in ipairs(pg:GetChildren()) do
                    if sg:IsA("ScreenGui") and sg.Name == "ReanimHaloMenu" then
                        sg.Enabled = true
                        for _, f in ipairs(sg:GetChildren()) do
                            if f:IsA("Frame") then f.Visible = true end
                        end
                        return true
                    end
                end
            end
            if cg then
                for _, sg in ipairs(cg:GetChildren()) do
                    if sg:IsA("ScreenGui") and sg.Name == "ReanimHaloMenu" then
                        sg.Enabled = true
                        for _, f in ipairs(sg:GetChildren()) do
                            if f:IsA("Frame") then f.Visible = true end
                        end
                        return true
                    end
                end
            end
            return false
        end)
        if found then return end
    end
    _haloReanimHasRun = true
    if not _haloReanimCode then
        warn("[Halo Reanim] Code is nil - already loaded?")
        return
    end
    local ok, fn = pcall(loadstring, _haloReanimCode)
    if not ok then
        warn("[Halo Reanim] loadstring failed: " .. tostring(fn))
        return
    end
    if not fn then
        warn("[Halo Reanim] loadstring returned nil")
        return
    end
    local ok2, err = pcall(fn)
    if not ok2 then
        warn("[Halo Reanim] execution failed: " .. tostring(err))
    end
    _haloReanimCode = nil
    -- Wait a moment for the ScreenGui to be parented
    task.wait(0.1)
end
_G._HaloReanimShowMenu = _runEmbeddedReanimation


-- ============================================================
-- AUTO NOCLIP (from Infinite Yield source)
-- Always re-enables noclip if it gets turned off
-- ============================================================
-- Noclip is OFF by default. When it was ON, every character part became
-- non-collidable the moment the script loaded, so the player fell straight
-- through the floor and could not walk. Turn it on any time with
--   _G._HaloToggleAutoNoclip()
local AutoNoclipEnabled = false
local AutoNoclipConn = nil
local AutoNoclipParts = {}

local function EnableAutoNoclip()
    if AutoNoclipConn then
        pcall(function() AutoNoclipConn:Disconnect() end)
        AutoNoclipConn = nil
    end
    AutoNoclipParts = {}
    AutoNoclipConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
        if not AutoNoclipEnabled then return end
        local char = plr.Character
        if not char then return end
        for _, child in pairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if child:IsA("BasePart") and child.CanCollide == true then
                child.CanCollide = false
                AutoNoclipParts[child] = true
            end
        end
    end)
end

local function DisableAutoNoclip()
    AutoNoclipEnabled = false
    if AutoNoclipConn then
        pcall(function() AutoNoclipConn:Disconnect() end)
        AutoNoclipConn = nil
    end
    for child, _ in pairs(AutoNoclipParts) do
        if typeof(child) == "Instance" and child:IsA("BasePart") and child.Parent then
            child.CanCollide = true
        end
    end
    AutoNoclipParts = {}
end

-- Only start noclip if it was explicitly turned on (it is OFF by default so
-- the character keeps collision and can move normally).
if AutoNoclipEnabled then
    EnableAutoNoclip()
end

-- Re-enable on character respawn
plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    if AutoNoclipEnabled then
        task.wait(0.2)
        EnableAutoNoclip()
    end
end)

-- Expose toggle
_G._HaloToggleAutoNoclip = function()
    AutoNoclipEnabled = not AutoNoclipEnabled
    if AutoNoclipEnabled then
        EnableAutoNoclip()
        Notify("Auto Noclip ON", 2)
    else
        DisableAutoNoclip()
        Notify("Auto Noclip OFF", 2)
    end
end

-- ============================================================
-- INFINITE BASEPLATE (Night Grass)  -- one clean pass
-- Loads in ANY server, public or private.
--   * If the map HAS a floor, it paints it once and extends it.
--   * If the map has NO floor at all (lots of public maps are just
--     floating models), it CREATES a baseplate, so a baseplate
--     ALWAYS appears no matter what map you join.
-- Then it tiles the floor out into a huge plane so the ground runs
-- to the horizon, and keeps the night lighting in sync.
--   disable:  _G.PrismBaseplate = false   before loading
--   re-run :  _G.PrismApplyBaseplate()
-- ============================================================

local PRISM_BASEPLATE_ENABLED = true
if _G.PrismBaseplate == false then PRISM_BASEPLATE_ENABLED = false end

-- Optional allow-list. Leave EMPTY to run in every place (default).
-- Add place IDs here only if you want to restrict it again.
local INF_BASEPLATE_PLACE_IDS = {}

local function _haloPlaceAllowed()
    if next(INF_BASEPLATE_PLACE_IDS) == nil then return true end
    return INF_BASEPLATE_PLACE_IDS[game.PlaceId] == true
end

local function _haloFloorName(name)
    local n = tostring(name or ""):lower()
    return n:find("base") or n:find("floor") or n:find("ground")
        or n:find("plate") or n:find("platform") or n:find("terrain")
        or n:find("land") or n:find("tile") or n:find("arena")
end

-- the part we are treating as the floor (so the watcher can rebuild it)
local _haloFloorPart = nil

-- find the floor of the map. Tries, in order:
--   1) a part literally named "Baseplate"
--   2) any direct Workspace child that looks like a floor
--   3) the biggest floor-named part anywhere (map models nest it)
--   4) the biggest flat, anchored part sitting low in the world
local function _haloSkipFloor(d)
    if not d or not d:IsA("BasePart") then return true end
    if d.Name == "HaloInfTile" or d.Name == "HaloInfCenter" then return true end
    if d.Size.X >= 1500 or d.Size.Z >= 1500 then return true end
    local p = d
    while p and p ~= game do
        local n = p.Name
        if n == "PrismHouse" or n == "PrismPocket" or n == "PrismStage" or n == "PrismPortal" or n == "PrismCine" or n == "PrismVista" or n == "HaloInfFloor" then
            return true
        end
        p = p.Parent
    end
    return false
end

local function _haloFindBaseplate(ws)
    local bp = ws:FindFirstChild("Baseplate")
    if bp and bp:IsA("BasePart") and not _haloSkipFloor(bp) then return bp end

    for _, obj in ipairs(ws:GetChildren()) do
        if obj:IsA("BasePart") and _haloFloorName(obj.Name) and not _haloSkipFloor(obj) then return obj end
    end

    local best, bestArea
    for _, d in ipairs(ws:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("BasePart") and d.Anchored and _haloFloorName(d.Name) and not _haloSkipFloor(d) then
            local a = d.Size.X * d.Size.Z
            if a >= 64 and a < 1500 * 1500 and (not bestArea or a > bestArea) then best, bestArea = d, a end
        end
    end
    if best then return best end

    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
    local hrp = lp and lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local py = hrp and hrp.Position.Y or 0
    local lowest = math.huge
    for _, d in ipairs(ws:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("BasePart") and d.Anchored and d.Size.Y <= 16 and not _haloSkipFloor(d) then
            local a = d.Size.X * d.Size.Z
            if a >= 900 and a < 400000 and math.abs(d.Position.Y - py) < 80 and d.Position.Y < lowest then
                best, bestArea, lowest = d, a, d.Position.Y
            end
        end
    end
    return best
end

-- No floor in this map -> build one from scratch so a baseplate
-- ALWAYS shows. Sits just under the lowest thing in the map (or
-- just under the player) so it is immediately visible.
local function _haloCreateBaseplate(ws)
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
    local char = lp and lp.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    local feetY = hrp and hrp.Position.Y or nil
    local cx = hrp and hrp.Position.X or 0
    local cz = hrp and hrp.Position.Z or 0

    -- lowest bottom of any part that is not us
    local lowest
    for _, d in ipairs(ws:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("BasePart") and d ~= hrp and d.Parent ~= char then
            local bottom = d.Position.Y - d.Size.Y * 0.5
            if not lowest or bottom < lowest then lowest = bottom end
        end
    end

    local targetY
    if lowest and feetY then targetY = math.min(lowest, feetY - 4)
    elseif lowest then targetY = lowest - 1
    elseif feetY then targetY = feetY - 4
    else targetY = 0 end

    -- never drop absurdly far below the player (stray far-away parts)
    if feetY then targetY = math.max(targetY, feetY - 600) end

    local part = Instance.new("Part")
    part.Name = "Baseplate"
    part.Size = Vector3.new(2048, 4, 2048)
    part.Position = Vector3.new(cx, targetY - 2, cz)   -- top face at targetY
    part.Anchored = true
    part.CanCollide = true
    part.Locked = true
    part.Parent = ws
    return part
end

local function _haloPaintGrass(part)
    part.Material = Enum.Material.Grass
    -- Was (78, 12, 18): so dark that under this script's own night lighting
    -- the ground just read as black, and if the grass texture below fails to
    -- load this raw colour is all you see.  Lifted to a visible crimson.
    part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(44, 120, 50)
    part.Transparency = 0
    part.Reflectance = 0
    part.CastShadow = false
    pcall(function() part.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth end)
    pcall(function() part.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth end)
    for _, child in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Decal") or child:IsA("Texture") then
            pcall(function() child:Destroy() end)
        end
    end
    local grass = Instance.new("Texture")
    grass.Name = "NightGrass"
    grass.Texture = "rbxassetid://6375461772"
    grass.Face = Enum.NormalId.Top
    grass.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(78, 170, 65)
    grass.Transparency = 0.04
    grass.StudsPerTileU = 18
    grass.StudsPerTileV = 18
    grass.Parent = part
    -- user-picked floor color (Visuals > Baseplate color). Survives tile rebuilds.
    local fc = _G.PrismFloorColor
    if typeof(fc) == "Color3" then
        part.Color = fc
        grass.Color3 = fc:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.35)
        grass.Transparency = 0.55
    end
end

-- Recolor the whole floor: the center plate plus every tile. Pass nil to go back to
-- the default red grass. Returns how many parts were repainted.
_G.PrismSetFloorColor = function(c)
    _G.PrismFloorColor = c
    local parts = {}
    if _haloFloorPart and _haloFloorPart.Parent then
        parts[#parts + 1] = _haloFloorPart
    end
    local folder = game:GetService("Workspace"):FindFirstChild("HaloInfFloor")
    if folder then
        for _, p in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
            if p:IsA("BasePart") then parts[#parts + 1] = p end
        end
    end
    for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
        pcall(_haloPaintGrass, p)
    end
    return #parts
end

local function _haloNightLighting()
    return
end

local _haloFloorAnchor = nil

local function _haloBuildTiles(Workspace, anchor)
    -- Build new folder fully before destroying the old one so the player
    -- never loses footing during a live re-centre rebuild.
    local floor = Instance.new("Folder")
    floor.Name = "HaloInfFloor"
    local TILE = 2048
    local thickness = anchor.thick
    for gx = -1, 1 do
        for gz = -1, 1 do
            local tile = Instance.new("Part")
            tile.Name = (gx == 0 and gz == 0) and "HaloInfCenter" or "HaloInfTile"
            tile.Size = Vector3.new(TILE, thickness, TILE)
            tile.Position = Vector3.new(anchor.x + gx * TILE, anchor.y - 0.2, anchor.z + gz * TILE)
            tile.Anchored = true
            tile.CanCollide = true
            tile.Locked = true
            tile.Parent = floor
            _haloPaintGrass(tile)
        end
    end
    local oldFloor = Workspace:FindFirstChild("HaloInfFloor")
    floor.Parent = Workspace
    if oldFloor then oldFloor:Destroy() end
    pcall(function() Workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = -100000 end)
end

_G._PrismRestoreBaseplate = function()
    if _haloFloorAnchor then
        _haloBuildTiles(game:GetService("Workspace"), _haloFloorAnchor)
    end
end

local function _haloApplyBaseplate()
    local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
    if _haloFloorAnchor then
        _haloBuildTiles(Workspace, _haloFloorAnchor)
        return true
    end

    -- look for a real floor for a bit: public servers may stream the
    -- map in late. cheap name check runs often; the deeper (recursive)
    -- scan is throttled so we never hammer a big public workspace.
    local baseplate
    local t0 = os.clock()
    local lastDeep = 0
    while os.clock() - t0 < 12 do
        baseplate = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Baseplate")
        if baseplate and baseplate:IsA("BasePart") then break end
        if os.clock() - lastDeep > 1.2 then
            lastDeep = os.clock()
            baseplate = _haloFindBaseplate(Workspace)
            if baseplate and baseplate:IsA("BasePart") then break end
        end
        task.wait(0.35)
    end

    -- still nothing? the map has no floor -> make one so a baseplate
    -- ALWAYS appears.
    local created = false
    if not (baseplate and baseplate:IsA("BasePart")) then
        baseplate = _haloCreateBaseplate(Workspace)
        created = true
    end
    if not (baseplate and baseplate:IsA("BasePart")) then
        pcall(function() Notify("Baseplate failed", 3) end)
        return false
    end

    _haloFloorPart = baseplate

    local thickness = math.max(baseplate.Size.Y, 1)
    local baseY = baseplate.Position.Y

    -- main plate: as large as Roblox allows on X/Z (2048 per axis)
    baseplate.Size = Vector3.new(2048, thickness, 2048)
    baseplate.Anchored = true
    baseplate.CanCollide = true
    _haloPaintGrass(baseplate)

    -- Lock the anchor the first time. Later calls (and the return trip
    -- from the house) rebuild THESE tiles only. Never scan again, or the
    -- house lawn gets swallowed and turned into the floor.
    if not _haloFloorAnchor then
        _haloFloorAnchor = {
            x = baseplate.Position.X,
            y = baseY,
            z = baseplate.Position.Z,
            thick = thickness,
        }
    end
    _haloBuildTiles(Workspace, _haloFloorAnchor)

    -- remove the annoying default extra-room parts (late-loading safe)
    task.spawn(function()
        local function tryDestroy()
            local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("map") or Workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
            if not map then return false end
            local extraRoom = map:FindFirstChild("extra_room") or map:FindFirstChild("Extra_Room")
            if not extraRoom then return false end
            local children = extraRoom:GetChildren()
            pcall(function() if children[4] then children[4]:Destroy() end end)
            pcall(function() if children[3] then children[3]:Destroy() end end)
            pcall(function() if children[2] then children[2]:Destroy() end end)
            pcall(function()
                local platform = extraRoom:FindFirstChild("platform") or extraRoom:FindFirstChild("Platform")
                if platform then platform:Destroy() end
            end)
            return true
        end
        for i = 1, 12 do
            if tryDestroy() then break end
            task.wait(0.5)
        end
    end)

    return true
end

-- manual re-trigger (also handy if a map swaps mid-session)
_G.PrismApplyBaseplate = function()
    if PRISM_BASEPLATE_ENABLED and _haloPlaceAllowed() then
        task.spawn(_haloApplyBaseplate)
    end
end

if PRISM_BASEPLATE_ENABLED and _haloPlaceAllowed() and not _G._HaloInfBaseplateApplied then
    _G._HaloInfBaseplateApplied = true
    task.spawn(_haloApplyBaseplate)

    -- keep it alive AND follow the player so the floor is truly infinite:
    -- re-centres the 3x3 tile grid on the player's current 2048-stud grid
    -- cell whenever they cross into a new one.  The seamless swap in
    -- _haloBuildTiles means the player never loses footing during a rebuild.
    task.spawn(function()
        local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
        local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
        local TILE = 2048
        while true do
            task.wait(1)
            if _G._PrismTraveling then
                -- character is parked for the portal trip; do not retarget the floor
            elseif _haloFloorAnchor then
                local folder = Workspace:FindFirstChild("HaloInfFloor")
                local center = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("HaloInfCenter")
                if not center then
                    -- tile was removed by something external; restore it
                    _haloBuildTiles(Workspace, _haloFloorAnchor)
                else
                    -- follow the player: snap to nearest tile-grid cell and
                    -- rebuild whenever the cell changes (every ~1024+ studs walked)
                    local char = lp and lp.Character
                    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if hrp then
                        local px, pz = hrp.Position.X, hrp.Position.Z
                        local nx = math.floor(px / TILE + 0.5) * TILE
                        local nz = math.floor(pz / TILE + 0.5) * TILE
                        if nx ~= _haloFloorAnchor.x or nz ~= _haloFloorAnchor.z then
                            _haloFloorAnchor.x = nx
                            _haloFloorAnchor.z = nz
                            _haloBuildTiles(Workspace, _haloFloorAnchor)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

-- ============================================================
-- MOVEMENT SAFETY  -- guarantees the local character can move.
-- Noclip, a leftover anchored HumanoidRootPart (e.g. from a
-- reanimation swap), or a stray freeze can leave the player
-- stuck and unable to walk. This clears that state on load and
-- again on every respawn. It does NOT undo a deliberate admin
-- freeze: doFreeze() sets _G._PrismFrozen and we skip while it
-- is set.
-- ============================================================
local function _prismEnsureMovable()
    pcall(function()
        if _G._PrismFrozen then return end          -- respect admin freeze
        local char = plr.Character
        if not char then return end
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hum and hum.Health > 0 then
            if hum.PlatformStand then hum.PlatformStand = false end
            if hum.WalkSpeed == 0 then hum.WalkSpeed = 16 end
            if hum.JumpPower == 0 then hum.JumpPower = 50 end
            pcall(function() hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running) end)
        end
        if hrp and hrp.Anchored then hrp.Anchored = false end
    end)
end
_G.PrismEnsureMovable = _prismEnsureMovable

-- Run once shortly after load so nothing left over from startup keeps us stuck.
task.spawn(function()
    task.wait(2)
    _prismEnsureMovable()
end)

-- And again whenever we respawn.
pcall(function()
    plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        task.wait(1)
        _prismEnsureMovable()
    end)
end)

-- ============================================================
-- COMMAND SYSTEM (? prefix)
-- ?rj = rejoin server
-- ?permhide <name> = hide + mute + block a player (partial match)
-- ?unpermhide <name> = unhide a player
-- ============================================================
local PermHiddenPlayers = _G._HaloPermHiddenPlayers or {}
_G._HaloPermHiddenPlayers = PermHiddenPlayers

local function getPlayerByPartialName(partial)
    partial = partial:lower()
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= plr then
            if p.Name:lower():find(partial, 1, true) or p.DisplayName:lower():find(partial, 1, true) then
                return p
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function permHidePlayer(targetPlayer)
    if not targetPlayer or targetPlayer == plr then return end
    PermHiddenPlayers[targetPlayer.UserId] = true

    -- Hide character (robust: anchor + invisible + noncollidable)
    pcall(function()
        if targetPlayer.Character then
            for _, part in pairs(targetPlayer.Character:GetDescendants()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                    part.Anchored = true
                    part.CanCollide = false
                    part.Transparency = 1
                    part.CanQuery = false
                    part.CanTouch = false
                elseif part:IsA("Decal") or part:IsA("SurfaceGui") or part:IsA("BillboardGui") then
                    part.Enabled = false
                elseif part:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or part:IsA("Trail") or part:IsA("Beam") then
                    part.Enabled = false
                elseif part:IsA("Sound") then
                    part:Stop()
                    part.Volume = 0
                end
            end
            -- Try hiding the model itself too
            pcall(function() targetPlayer.Character.Parent = nil end)
        end
    end)

    -- Mute in legacy chat
    pcall(function()
        game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore("ChatMutePlayer", targetPlayer.Name)
    end)

    -- Mute VC
    pcall(function()
        game:GetService("SoundService").LocalMuted[targetPlayer.UserId] = true
    end)

    Notify("PermHidden: " .. targetPlayer.Name, "Character hidden + muted", 3)
end

local function unpermHidePlayer(targetPlayer)
    if not targetPlayer then return end
    PermHiddenPlayers[targetPlayer.UserId] = nil

    -- Restore character
    pcall(function()
        if targetPlayer.Character then
            -- Re-parent if hidden
            if not targetPlayer.Character.Parent then
                targetPlayer.Character.Parent = workspace
            end
            -- Restore all parts
            for _, part in pairs(targetPlayer.Character:GetDescendants()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                    part.Anchored = false
                    part.CanCollide = true
                    part.Transparency = 0
                    part.CanQuery = true
                    part.CanTouch = true
                elseif part:IsA("Decal") or part:IsA("SurfaceGui") or part:IsA("BillboardGui") then
                    part.Enabled = true
                elseif part:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or part:IsA("Trail") or part:IsA("Beam") then
                    part.Enabled = true
                elseif part:IsA("Sound") then
                    part.Volume = 1
                end
            end
        end
    end)

    -- Unmute
    pcall(function()
        game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore("ChatUnmutePlayer", targetPlayer.Name)
    end)
    pcall(function()
        game:GetService("SoundService").LocalMuted[targetPlayer.UserId] = nil
    end)

    Notify("Unhidden: " .. targetPlayer.Name, "Player restored", 2)
end

-- Hook character added for permhidden players
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(p)
    if PermHiddenPlayers[p.UserId] then
        p.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
            if PermHiddenPlayers[p.UserId] then
                task.wait(0.3)
                permHidePlayer(p)
            end
        end)
        task.wait(0.3)
        if p.Character then
            permHidePlayer(p)
        end
    end
end)

-- Re-apply hide when permhidden players respawn (existing players)
for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    if p ~= plr and PermHiddenPlayers[p.UserId] then
        p.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
            if PermHiddenPlayers[p.UserId] then
                task.wait(0.3)
                permHidePlayer(p)
            end
        end)
        if p.Character then
            permHidePlayer(p)
        end
    end
end

-- Chat filter for permhidden players (modern TextChatService)
pcall(function()
    local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")
    if TextChatService.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
        TextChatService.OnIncomingMessage = function(message)
            local props = Instance.new("TextChatMessageProperties")
            if message.TextSource then
                local senderId = message.TextSource.UserId
                if PermHiddenPlayers[senderId] then
                    props.Text = ""
                    props.PrefixText = ""
                end
            end
            return props
        end
    end
end)

-- Legacy chat filter
local function filterLegacyChat()
    local chatGui = plr:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"):FindFirstChild("Chat")
    if not chatGui then return end
    local scroller = chatGui:FindFirstChild("Scroller", true)
    if not scroller then return end

    local function checkMessage(frame)
        if not frame:IsA("Frame") then return end
        task.spawn(function()
            local textLabel = frame:WaitForChild("TextLabel", 1)
            if not textLabel then return end

            local function hideIfPermHidden()
                local text = textLabel.Text
                for userId, _ in pairs(PermHiddenPlayers) do
                    local p = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
                    if p and (text:find(p.Name, 1, true) or text:find(p.DisplayName, 1, true)) then
                        frame:Destroy()
                        return
                    end
                end
            end

            textLabel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(hideIfPermHidden)
            hideIfPermHidden()
        end)
    end

    scroller.ChildAdded:Connect(checkMessage)
    for _, child in ipairs(scroller:GetChildren()) do
        checkMessage(child)
    end
end
task.spawn(filterLegacyChat)

-- Command parser
local function processCommand(msg)
    if type(_G._HaloCmd) == "function" and _G._HaloCmd(msg) then return end
    if not msg or msg:sub(1, 1) ~= "?" then return end
    local args = {}
    for arg in msg:sub(2):gmatch("%S+") do
        table.insert(args, arg)
    end
    local cmd = args[1] and args[1]:lower() or ""

    if cmd == "rj" then
        -- Rejoin server
        Notify("Rejoining server...", 2)
        task.delay(0.5, function()
            local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
            pcall(function()
                TeleportService:Teleport(game.PlaceId, plr)
            end)
        end)

    elseif cmd == "permhide" and args[2] then
        local target = getPlayerByPartialName(args[2])
        if target then
            permHidePlayer(target)
        else
            Notify("PermHide Error", "No player matching '" .. args[2] .. "'", 3)
        end

    elseif cmd == "unpermhide" and args[2] then
        local target = getPlayerByPartialName(args[2])
        if target then
            unpermHidePlayer(target)
        else
            Notify("UnPermHide Error", "No player matching '" .. args[2] .. "'", 3)
        end
    end
end

-- Command chat hooks removed. Buttons still call run() directly.
-- (no semicolon bar, no "." / "?" chat commands)

-- ============================================================
-- AUTO 98 FOV
-- Set the camera FOV to 98 on execute and after camera/character changes.
-- ============================================================
local function apply98FOV()
    pcall(function()
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if cam then cam.FieldOfView = 98 end
    end)
end
apply98FOV()
pcall(function()
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
    if localPlayer then
        localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
            task.wait(0.05)
            apply98FOV()
        end)
    end
    workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(function()
        task.defer(apply98FOV)
    end)
    -- Reanim can swap camera subjects after CharacterAdded; apply 98 again
    -- after the reanimation call finishes and once its camera handoff settles.
    local api = rawget(_G, "_HaloReanimateAPI") or rawget(_G, "ReanimateAPI")
    if api and type(api.reanimate) == "function" and not api._ParallaxFovHooked then
        local originalReanimate = api.reanimate
        api.reanimate = function(enabled, remote, args)
            local result = originalReanimate(enabled, remote, args)
            if enabled then
                apply98FOV()
                task.defer(apply98FOV)
                task.delay(0.12, apply98FOV)
            end
            return result
        end
        api._ParallaxFovHooked = true
    end
end)

-- ============================================================
-- CYRIS ADDON: branding, slim menu, Workspace (Avatars + Import), BG
-- Safe post-load only — original script is not modified.
-- ============================================================
task.spawn(function()
    local okAddon, errAddon = pcall(function()
        local PlayersSvc = game:GetService("Players")
        local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
        local lp = PlayersSvc.LocalPlayer
        if not lp then return end

        local sg = nil
        for _ = 1, 80 do
            if ScreenGui and ScreenGui.Parent then sg = ScreenGui break end
            local pg = lp:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
            if pg then sg = pg:FindFirstChild("ReanimHaloMenu") end
            if not sg then
                pcall(function()
                    sg = game:GetService("CoreGui"):FindFirstChild("ReanimHaloMenu")
                end)
            end
            if sg then break end
            task.wait(0.1)
        end
        if not sg then return end

        local menu = (Menu and Menu.Parent) and Menu or sg:FindFirstChild("ReanimMenu")
        if not (menu and menu:IsA("GuiObject")) then return end

        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        -- SLIMMER MENU
        ----------------------------------------------------------------

        local function httpGet(url)
            local attempts = {
                function()
                    if type(request) == "function" then
                        local r = request({ Url = url, Method = "GET" })
                        return r and (r.Body or r.body)
                    end
                end,
                function()
                    if syn and type(syn.request) == "function" then
                        local r = syn.request({ Url = url, Method = "GET" })
                        return r and (r.Body or r.body)
                    end
                end,
                function()
                    if type(http_request) == "function" then
                        local r = http_request({ Url = url, Method = "GET" })
                        return r and (r.Body or r.body)
                    end
                end,
                function()
                    if type(request_get) == "function" then return request_get(url) end
                end,
                function()
                    return game:HttpGet(url, true)
                end,
            }
            for i = 1, #attempts do
                local ok, res = pcall(attempts[i])
                if ok and type(res) == "string" and #res > 5 then return res end
            end
            return nil
        end

        local applying = false

        local function fetchOutfits()
            local list = {}
            local seen = {}
            local function add(id, name)
                id = tonumber(id)
                if not id or id <= 0 or seen[id] then return end
                seen[id] = true
                list[#list + 1] = { id = id, name = tostring(name or ("Outfit " .. id)) }
            end
            local function consume(arr)
                if type(arr) ~= "table" then return end
                local counted = 0
                for _, item in ipairs(arr) do
                    if type(item) == "table" then
                        add(item.id or item.Id or item.outfitId or item.OutfitId, item.name or item.Name)
                        counted = counted + 1
                    end
                end
                if counted == 0 then
                    for _, item in pairs(arr) do
                        if type(item) == "table" then
                            add(item.id or item.Id or item.outfitId or item.OutfitId, item.name or item.Name)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            pcall(function()
                local AES = game:GetService("AvatarEditorService")
                local sources = {}
                pcall(function() sources[#sources + 1] = Enum.OutfitSource.All end)
                pcall(function() sources[#sources + 1] = Enum.OutfitSource.Created end)
                sources[#sources + 1] = nil
                local function pull(pages)
                    if not pages then return end
                    local guard = 0
                    while pages and guard < 8 do
                        guard = guard + 1
                        local page = pages:GetCurrentPage()
                        consume(page)
                        if pages.IsFinished then break end
                        pages:AdvanceToNextPageAsync()
                    end
                end
                for _, src in ipairs(sources) do
                    local ok, pages = pcall(function()
                        if src == nil then return AES:GetOutfits() end
                        return AES:GetOutfits(src)
                    end)
                    if ok then pull(pages) end
                end
                if #list == 0 then
                    local ok, pages = pcall(function() return AES:GetOutfits() end)
                    if ok then pull(pages) end
                end
            end)
            if #list == 0 then
                local uid = lp.UserId
                local urls = {
                    ("https://avatar.roblox.com/v1/users/%d/outfits?page=1&itemsPerPage=50"):format(uid),
                    ("https://avatar.roblox.com/v1/users/%d/outfits?page=1&itemsPerPage=50&isEditable=true"):format(uid),
                    ("https://avatar.roblox.com/v2/avatar/users/%d/outfits?page=1&itemsPerPage=50&outfitType=Avatar"):format(uid),
                    ("https://avatar.roproxy.com/v1/users/%d/outfits?page=1&itemsPerPage=50"):format(uid),
                    ("https://avatar.roproxy.com/v1/users/%d/outfits?page=1&itemsPerPage=50&isEditable=true"):format(uid),
                    ("https://avatar.roproxy.com/v2/avatar/users/%d/outfits?page=1&itemsPerPage=50&outfitType=Avatar"):format(uid),
                }
                for _, u in ipairs(urls) do
                    local body = httpGet(u)
                    if body then
                        local okj, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(body) end)
                        if okj and type(data) == "table" then
                            consume(data.data or data.Data or data)
                            if #list > 0 then break end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if #list == 0 then return nil end
            return list
        end

        local function getOutfitDescription(outfitId)
            local ok, desc = pcall(function()
                return PlayersSvc:GetHumanoidDescriptionFromOutfitId(outfitId)
            end)
            if ok and desc then return desc end
            ok, desc = pcall(function()
                return PlayersSvc:GetHumanoidDescriptionFromOutfitIdAsync(outfitId)
            end)
            if ok and desc then return desc end
            return nil
        end

        local function getRealHumanoid()
            local api = rawget(_G, "_HaloReanimateAPI") or ReanimateAPI
            local reanim = false
            pcall(function()
                if api and api.is_reanimated then reanim = (api.is_reanimated() == true) end
            end)
            return nil, reanim, api
        end

        local function dressFromModel(toChar, fromChar)
            local wear = rawget(_G, "PrismWearNoReset")
            if type(wear) ~= "function" then return end
            pcall(wear, toChar, fromChar)
        end
        local function applyOutfit(outfitId, outfitName)
            if applying then return end
            applying = true
            status.Text = "Applying " .. tostring(outfitName) .. "..."
            status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            task.spawn(function()
                local ok, err = pcall(function()
                    local desc = getOutfitDescription(outfitId)
                    if not desc then error("Could not load that outfit") end
                    local _, _, api = getRealHumanoid()
                    local rigType = Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15
                    local char = lp.Character
                    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if hum then rigType = hum.RigType end
                    local model = PlayersSvc:CreateHumanoidModelFromDescription(desc, rigType)
                    local targets = {}
                    local function add(m)
                        if m and not targets[m] then targets[m] = true table.insert(targets, m) end
                    end
                    add(char)
                    pcall(function()
                        if api and api.get_clone then add(api.get_clone(lp)) end
                        if api and api.get_real_character then add(api.get_real_character(lp)) end
                    end)
                    if #targets == 0 then
                        model:Destroy()
                        error("No character")
                    end
                    for _, target in ipairs(targets) do
                        dressFromModel(target, model)
                    end
                    model:Destroy()
                    pcall(function()
                        if api and api.invalidate_constraint_cache then api.invalidate_constraint_cache() end
                    end)
                end)
                if ok then
                    status.Text = "Applied: " .. tostring(outfitName)
                    status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 220, 120)
                    pcall(function()
                        if Notify then Notify("Avatars", tostring(outfitName), 2) end
                    end)
                else
                    status.Text = "Failed: " .. tostring(err)
                    status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90)
                    warn("[Avatars] " .. tostring(err))
                end
                applying = false
            end)
        end

        local function cloneMyself()
            if applying then return end
            applying = true
            status.Text = "Cloning you..."
            status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            task.spawn(function()
                local ok, err = pcall(function()
                    local _, _, api = getRealHumanoid()
                    local rigType = Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15
                    local char = lp.Character
                    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if hum then rigType = hum.RigType end
                    local model
                    local okM, m = pcall(function()
                        return PlayersSvc:CreateHumanoidModelFromUserIdAsync(lp.UserId)
                    end)
                    if okM and typeof(m) == "Instance" then model = m end
                    if not model then
                        local ok2, m2 = pcall(function()
                            return PlayersSvc:CreateHumanoidModelFromUserId(lp.UserId)
                        end)
                        if ok2 and typeof(m2) == "Instance" then model = m2 end
                    end
                    if not model then
                        local desc = PlayersSvc:GetHumanoidDescriptionFromUserId(lp.UserId)
                        model = PlayersSvc:CreateHumanoidModelFromDescription(desc, rigType)
                    end
                    local targets, seen = {}, {}
                    local function add(m)
                        if m and not seen[m] then seen[m] = true table.insert(targets, m) end
                    end
                    add(char)
                    pcall(function()
                        if api and api.get_clone then add(api.get_clone(lp)) end
                        if api and api.get_real_character then add(api.get_real_character(lp)) end
                    end)
                    if #targets == 0 then
                        model:Destroy()
                        error("No character")
                    end
                    for _, target in ipairs(targets) do
                        dressFromModel(target, model)
                    end
                    model:Destroy()
                end)
                if ok then
                    status.Text = "Cloned you. You were not reset."
                    status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 220, 120)
                    pcall(function() if Notify then Notify("Avatars", "Cloned you", 2) end end)
                else
                    status.Text = "Clone failed: " .. tostring(err)
                    status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90)
                end
                applying = false
            end)
        end
        cloneMe.MouseButton1Click:Connect(cloneMyself)
        _G._CyrisCloneMyself = cloneMyself

        end
