            if not pg then return end
            for _, child in ipairs(pg:GetChildren()) do
                local n = child.Name:lower()
                if n:find("chat") or n:find("textchat") or n:find("experiencechat") then
                    for _, d in ipairs(child:GetDescendants()) do
                        if d:IsA("Frame") and d.BackgroundTransparency < 0.95 then
                            d.BackgroundColor3 = BG
                            d.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
                            local s = d:FindFirstChild("PrismChatStroke") or Instance.new("UIStroke")
                            s.Name = "PrismChatStroke"
                            s.Color = RED
                            s.Thickness = 2.6
                            s.Transparency = 0
                            s.Parent = d
                            local s2 = d:FindFirstChild("PrismChatGlow") or Instance.new("UIStroke")
                            s2.Name = "PrismChatGlow"
                            s2.Color = RED_GLOW
                            s2.Thickness = 5
                            s2.Transparency = 0.5
                            s2.Parent = d
                            if not d:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner") then
                                Instance.new("UICorner", d).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, math.floor((12) * PRISM_CORNER_SCALE + 0.5))
                            end
                        end
                        if d:IsA("TextBox") then
                            d.BackgroundColor3 = BG_INPUT
                            d.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
                            d.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 210)
                            d.PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 55, 70)
                            local s = d:FindFirstChild("PrismInputStroke") or Instance.new("UIStroke")
                            s.Name = "PrismInputStroke"
                            s.Color = RED
                            s.Thickness = 2.8
                            s.Transparency = 0
                            s.Parent = d
                            local s2 = d:FindFirstChild("PrismInputGlow") or Instance.new("UIStroke")
                            s2.Name = "PrismInputGlow"
                            s2.Color = RED_GLOW
                            s2.Thickness = 5.5
                            s2.Transparency = 0.45
                            s2.Parent = d
                        end
                        if d:IsA("TextLabel") and d.AbsoluteSize.Y < 42 then
                            d.TextColor3 = RED_SOFT
                            d.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
                            d.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 0, 8)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        for i = 1, 8 do
            task.delay(i * 0.5, forceStyleAll)
        end
        forceStyleAll()

        local _lastForce = 0
        game.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
            -- only GUI instances matter here; skip everything else before any task is scheduled
            if not (d:IsA("GuiObject") or d:IsA("LayerCollector") or d:IsA("UIBase")) then return end
            task.defer(function()
                pcall(function()
                    local bub = d:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BillboardGui")
                    -- PrismBubbles is our own bubble and already styled; restyling it painted red outlines on every inner frame
                    if bub and bub.Name ~= "PrismBubbles" and (bub.Name:lower():find("bubble") or bub.Name:lower():find("chat")) then
                        styleBubble(bub)
                    end
                    if d:IsA("Frame") or d:IsA("TextBox") then
                        local now = os.clock()
                        if now - _lastForce > 0.75 then
                            _lastForce = now
                            forceStyleAll()
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end)
        end)
    end)
end)

task.spawn(function()
    pcall(function()
        local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
        local Players = game:GetService("Players")
        local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
        if not lp then return end

        _G._PrismStateHysteresis = function(hum, last)
            if not hum then return last or "Idle" end
            local hs = hum:GetState()
            if hs == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then return "Jump" end
            if hs == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall then
                local hrp = hum.RootPart
                if hrp and hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y > 0.4 then return "Jump" end
                return "Fall"
            end
            if hs == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing then return "Climb" end
            if hs == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming then
                return (hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.1) and "Swim" or "SwimIdle"
            end
            local hrp = hum.RootPart
            local horiz = 0
            if hrp then
                local v = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                horiz = Vector2.new(v.X, v.Z).Magnitude
            end
            if last == "Run" then
                if horiz >= 8 then return "Run" end
                if horiz >= 2.2 then return "Walk" end
                return "Idle"
            elseif last == "Walk" then
                if horiz >= 12 then return "Run" end
                if horiz >= 1.6 then return "Walk" end
                return "Idle"
            else
                if horiz >= 12 then return "Run" end
                if horiz >= 2 then return "Walk" end
                return "Idle"
            end
        end

        local function getApi()
            return rawget(_G, "_HaloReanimateAPI") or ReanimateAPI
        end

        local function isReanimated()
            local api = getApi()
            local ok, res = pcall(function()
                return api and api.is_reanimated and api.is_reanimated() == true
            end)
            return ok and res == true
        end

        local function animPlaying()
            local api = getApi()
            local ok, res = pcall(function() return api.is_animation_playing() end)
            return ok and res == true
        end

        local function getClone()
            local api = getApi()
            local clone = nil
            pcall(function()
                if api and api.get_clone then clone = api.get_clone(lp) end
            end)
            return clone or lp.Character
        end

        local function isAnimJoint(inst)
            return inst:IsA("Motor6D") or inst:IsA("AnimationConstraint")
        end

        local function capturePose(model)
            local poses = {}
            if not model then return poses end
            for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
                if isAnimJoint(d) then
                    local ok, tr = pcall(function() return d.Transform end)
                    if ok and typeof(tr) == "CFrame" then poses[d] = tr end
                end
            end
            return poses
        end

        local function jointPartName(joint)
            local nm = nil
            pcall(function()
                if joint:IsA("Motor6D") then
                    nm = joint.Part1 and joint.Part1.Name
                else
                    local att1 = joint.Attachment1
                    if att1 and att1.Parent then nm = att1.Parent.Name end
                end
            end)
            return nm
        end

        local function trackerOwns(nm)
            if not nm then return false end
            if nm == "Head" and (_G._HaloHeadTrackerEnabled or _G._HaloHeadStretching) then return true end
            if _G._HaloTrackActive and _G._HaloDoTrack and (nm == "UpperTorso" or nm == "LowerTorso" or nm == "Torso" or nm == "HumanoidRootPart") then return true end
            local stretchL = _G._HaloLeftArmStretching
            local stretchR = _G._HaloRightArmStretching
            if (_G._HaloArmAiming and _G._HaloLeftArmPointerEnabled or stretchL) and (nm == "LeftUpperArm" or nm == "LeftLowerArm" or nm == "LeftHand" or nm == "Left Arm") then return true end
            if (_G._HaloArmAiming and _G._HaloRightArmPointerEnabled or stretchR) and (nm == "RightUpperArm" or nm == "RightLowerArm" or nm == "RightHand" or nm == "Right Arm") then return true end
            local owned = _G._HaloPartTrackBones
            if owned and owned[nm] then return true end
            return false
        end

        local function smoothness()
            return math.clamp(tonumber(_G._CyrisEmoteSmoothness) or 0.65, 0, 1)
        end
        local function emoteBlend()
            local sm = smoothness()
            if sm < 0.03 then return 0 end
            return math.max(0.14, sm * 1.15)
        end
        local function stateBlend()
            local sm = smoothness()
            if sm < 0.03 then return 0 end
            return math.max(0.11, sm * 0.42)
        end

        local holdConn = nil
        local function stopHold()
            if holdConn then pcall(function() holdConn:Disconnect() end) holdConn = nil end
        end

        local blend = nil       -- active blend {from, skip, last, t0, dur, state}
        local staticConn = nil  -- only used when no animation is driving the joints

        local function stopBlend()
            blend = nil
            if staticConn then pcall(function() staticConn:Disconnect() end) staticConn = nil end
        end

        _G._PrismBlendStep = function()
            local b = blend
            if not b then return end
            local ok = pcall(function()
                local a = (os.clock() - b.t0) / b.dur
                if a >= 1 then blend = nil return end
                a = b.state and (1 - (1 - a) ^ 3) or (a * a * (3 - 2 * a))
                for joint, fromCF in pairs(b.from) do
                    if joint.Parent and not b.skip[joint] then
                        local cur = joint.Transform
                        local lw = b.last[joint]
                        if lw == nil or cur ~= lw then
                            joint.Transform = fromCF:Lerp(cur, a)
                            b.last[joint] = joint.Transform
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
            if not ok then blend = nil end
        end

        local function startCrossfade(from, duration, isState)
            stopBlend()
            stopHold()
            if not from or not next(from) then return end
            duration = tonumber(duration) or 0
            if duration < 0.05 or not isReanimated() then return end

            local skip = {}
            for joint in pairs(from) do
                if trackerOwns(jointPartName(joint)) then skip[joint] = true end
            end
            local b = { from = from, skip = skip, last = {}, t0 = os.clock(), dur = duration, state = isState and true or false }

            if animPlaying() then
                blend = b
            else
                local to = {}
                for joint in pairs(from) do
                    if joint.Parent then
                        local ok, tr = pcall(function() return joint.Transform end)
                        if ok then to[joint] = tr end
                    end
                end
                staticConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                    local a = (os.clock() - b.t0) / b.dur
                    if a >= 1 or not isReanimated() or animPlaying() then stopBlend() return end
                    a = b.state and (1 - (1 - a) ^ 3) or (a * a * (3 - 2 * a))
                    for joint, fromCF in pairs(from) do
                        local t = to[joint]
                        if t and joint.Parent and not skip[joint] then
                            pcall(function() joint.Transform = fromCF:Lerp(t, a) end)
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
        end

        _G._PrismCapturePose = function()
            if not isReanimated() then return nil end
            local p = capturePose(getClone())
            _G._PrismManualFrom = { pose = p, t = os.clock() }
            return p
        end
        _G._PrismHoldPose = function(p, maxSeconds)
            stopHold()
            if not p or not next(p) then return end
            for joint, cf in pairs(p) do
                if joint.Parent then pcall(function() joint.Transform = cf end) end
            end
            local t0 = os.clock()
            local limit = tonumber(maxSeconds) or 1.5
            holdConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                if animPlaying() or (os.clock() - t0) > limit or not isReanimated() then
                    stopHold()
                    return
                end
                for joint, cf in pairs(p) do
                    if joint.Parent then pcall(function() joint.Transform = cf end) end
                end
            end)
        end

        local function takeFrom(isState)
            local m = _G._PrismManualFrom
            if m and m.pose and next(m.pose) and (os.clock() - m.t) < (isState and 0.5 or 3) then
                _G._PrismManualFrom = nil
                return m.pose
            end
            local p = _G._HaloPendingBlendPose
            if p and next(p) and (os.clock() - (_G._HaloPendingBlendPoseTime or 0)) < 0.6 then
                _G._HaloPendingBlendPose = nil
                return p
            end
            return capturePose(getClone())
        end

        local function original(api, name)
            api._prismOrig = api._prismOrig or {}
            if api._prismOrig[name] == nil and type(api[name]) == "function" then
                api._prismOrig[name] = api[name]
            end
            return api._prismOrig[name]
        end

        local function wrapPlay(api, name)
            local old = original(api, name)
            if type(old) ~= "function" then return end
            api[name] = function(...)
                local re = isReanimated()
                local isState = currentStateAnim ~= nil
                local from = re and takeFrom(isState) or nil
                local r = old(...)
                if re and isReanimated() then
                    startCrossfade(from, isState and stateBlend() or emoteBlend(), isState)
                end
                return r
            end
        end

        local function hookApi()
            local api = getApi()
            if type(api) ~= "table" then return false end
            wrapPlay(api, "play_raw_animation")
            wrapPlay(api, "play_animation")

            local oldStop = original(api, "stop_animation_for_transition")
            if type(oldStop) == "function" then
                api.stop_animation_for_transition = function()
                    local from = nil
                    if isReanimated() and animPlaying() then from = capturePose(getClone()) end
                    local r = oldStop()
                    if from and next(from) then
                        _G._HaloPendingBlendPose = from
                        _G._HaloPendingBlendPoseTime = os.clock()
                    end
                    return r
                end
            end
            return true
        end

        if type(PlayAnimation) == "function" then
            local oldPlay = PlayAnimation
            PlayAnimation = function(animName, speed, isCustom)
                pcall(function()
                    if _G._PrismCapturePose then _G._PrismCapturePose() end
                end)
                return oldPlay(animName, speed, isCustom)
            end
        end

        for _ = 1, 80 do
            if hookApi() then break end
            task.wait(0.1)
        end

    end)
end)

-- BG FILL
task.spawn(function()
    pcall(function()
        local lp = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
        for _ = 1, 60 do
            local sg = nil
            pcall(function() if ScreenGui and ScreenGui.Parent then sg = ScreenGui end end)
            if not sg and lp then
                local pg = lp:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
                if pg then sg = pg:FindFirstChild("ReanimHaloMenu") end
            end
            local menu = sg and (sg:FindFirstChild("ReanimMenu") or (Menu and Menu.Parent and Menu))
            if menu then
                local bg = menu:FindFirstChild("CustomBackground")
                if bg and bg:IsA("ImageLabel") then
                    bg.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop
                    bg.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
                    bg.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
                    bg.ImageTransparency = 0.12
                    return
                end
            end
            task.wait(0.1)
        end
    end)
end)


-- Arm trackers: left click turns aiming on, left click again turns it off.
-- Runs even when no emote is playing, and only while aiming so smoothness stays intact.
task.spawn(function()
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
    if not lp then return end
    _G._HaloArmAiming = false

    local function armsEnabled()
        return _G._HaloLeftArmPointerEnabled or _G._HaloRightArmPointerEnabled
    end

    UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
        if gp then return end
        if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end
        if not armsEnabled() then return end
        _G._HaloArmAiming = not _G._HaloArmAiming
        pcall(function()
            if Notify then
                Notify(_G._HaloArmAiming and "Arms aiming" or "Arms off", 1.5)
            end
        end)
    end)

    local function getRig()
        local api = rawget(_G, "_HaloReanimateAPI") or rawget(_G, "ReanimateAPI")
        local clone = nil
        pcall(function()
            if api and api.get_clone then clone = api.get_clone(lp) end
        end)
        return clone or lp.Character
    end

    local function findJoint(rig, partName, r6Name)
        for _, d in ipairs(rig:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("Motor6D") and d.Part1 and (d.Part1.Name == partName or (r6Name ~= "" and d.Part1.Name == r6Name)) then
                return d
            end
            if d:IsA("AnimationConstraint") then
                local att = d.Attachment1
                if att and att.Parent and (att.Parent.Name == partName or (r6Name ~= "" and att.Parent.Name == r6Name)) then
                    return d
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local function jointWorld(joint)
        if joint:IsA("Motor6D") and joint.Part0 then
            return joint.Part0.CFrame * joint.C0
        end
        local att = joint.Attachment0
        if att and att.Parent then return att.WorldCFrame end
    end

    local function aimJoint(joint, targetPos)
        local base = jointWorld(joint)
        if not base then return end
        local aim = targetPos - base.Position
        if aim.Magnitude < 0.05 then return end
        aim = aim.Unit
        local childBone = Vector3.new(0, -1, 0)
        local localAim = base.Rotation:Inverse() * aim
        local axis = childBone:Cross(localAim)
        if axis.Magnitude > 0.001 then
            local ang = math.acos(math.clamp(childBone.Unit:Dot(localAim.Unit), -1, 1))
            joint.Transform = CFrame.fromAxisAngle(axis.Unit, ang)
        elseif childBone:Dot(localAim) < 0 then
            joint.Transform = CFrame.fromAxisAngle(Vector3.new(1, 0, 0), math.pi)
        else
            joint.Transform = CFrame.new()
        end
    end

    local function mouseWorld()
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local mouse = lp:GetMouse()
        if not cam or not mouse then return nil end
        local ray = cam:ScreenPointToRay(mouse.X, mouse.Y)
        local params = RaycastParams.new()
        params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        local filter = {}
        local rig = getRig()
        if rig then table.insert(filter, rig) end
        if lp.Character then table.insert(filter, lp.Character) end
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances = filter
        -- Clamp the AIM, not the stretch.  With the stretch limit removed,
        -- a ray that hit nothing still came back as a point 1500 studs down
        -- the ray, and the arm dutifully stretched ~1500x to reach it -- so
        -- pointing at open sky threw the arm across the map.  Now the ray
        -- only reaches MAX_AIM, and a miss returns nil so the caller falls
        -- back to the normal stretch amount instead of chasing infinity.
        -- Real targets inside MAX_AIM still stretch as far as they need to.
        local MAX_AIM = tonumber(_G._HaloMaxAimDistance) or 1000
        local hit = workspace:Raycast(ray.Origin, ray.Direction * MAX_AIM, params)
        if hit then return hit.Position end
        return nil
    end

    local function stretchLower(joint, amt)
        if not joint or not amt or amt <= 1.01 then return end
        local len = 1
        if joint:IsA("Motor6D") and joint.Part1 and joint.Part1:IsA("BasePart") then
            len = joint.Part1.Size.Y
        else
            local att = joint.Attachment1
            if att and att.Parent and att.Parent:IsA("BasePart") then
                len = att.Parent.Size.Y
            end
        end
        local extra = CFrame.new(0, -len * (amt - 1), 0)
        -- Keep the existing rotation instead of replacing the entire joint pose.
        joint.Transform = joint.Transform * extra
    end

    local function restoreHeadSize(rig)
        local head = rig and rig:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if not (head and head:IsA("BasePart")) then return end
        local api = rawget(_G, "_HaloReanimateAPI") or rawget(_G, "ReanimateAPI")
        local real = nil
        pcall(function()
            if api and api.get_real_character then real = api.get_real_character(lp) end
        end)
        local realHead = real and real:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if not (realHead and realHead:IsA("BasePart")) then return end
        if (head.Size - realHead.Size).Magnitude > 0.02 then
            head.Size = realHead.Size
        end
        local mesh = head:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
        local realMesh = realHead:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
        if mesh and realMesh then
            mesh.Scale = realMesh.Scale
        end
    end

    local function trackHead(rig)
        if rig then
            local oldNeck = rig:FindFirstChild("HaloNeck")
            if oldNeck then pcall(function() oldNeck:Destroy() end) end
            local saved = _G._HaloNeckBackup and _G._HaloNeckBackup[rig]
            if saved then
                for _, item in ipairs(saved) do
                    pcall(function()
                        if item.motor and item.motor.Parent then
                            item.motor.Part0 = item.part0
                            item.motor.Part1 = item.part1
                        elseif item.constraint and item.constraint.Parent then
                            item.constraint.Enabled = true
                        end
                    end)
                end
                _G._HaloNeckBackup[rig] = nil
            end
        end
        restoreHeadSize(rig)
        if not (_G._HaloHeadTrackerEnabled or _G._HaloHeadStretching) then return end
        local headJoint = findJoint(rig, "Head", "Head")
        if not headJoint then return end
        local rot = CFrame.new()
        if _G._HaloHeadTrackerEnabled then
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            local torso = rig:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or rig:FindFirstChild("Torso")
            if cam and torso then
                local rel = torso.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(cam.CFrame.LookVector)
                local pitch = math.clamp(math.asin(math.clamp(rel.Y, -1, 1)), math.rad(-45), math.rad(50))
                local yaw = math.clamp(math.atan2(-rel.X, -rel.Z), math.rad(-70), math.rad(70))
                local target = CFrame.Angles(pitch, yaw, 0)
                local smoothed = _G._HaloHeadTrackerSmoothedCF or target
                smoothed = smoothed:Lerp(target, 0.3)
                _G._HaloHeadTrackerSmoothedCF = smoothed
                rot = smoothed
            end
        end
        if _G._HaloHeadStretching then
            local amt = math.clamp(_G._HaloHeadStretchAmount or 1, 1, 2.2)
            headJoint.Transform = CFrame.new(0, (amt - 1) * 0.12, 0) * rot
        else
            headJoint.Transform = rot
        end
    end

    local function apply()
        if _G._HaloSpiderActive then return end
        local rig = getRig()
        if not rig then return end
        if _G._HaloTrackActive and type(_G._HaloDoTrack) == "function" then
            pcall(_G._HaloDoTrack)
        end
        local aiming = _G._HaloArmAiming and armsEnabled()
        local stretching = _G._HaloLeftArmStretching or _G._HaloRightArmStretching
        if aiming then
            local target = mouseWorld()
            if target then
                local function arm(upper, lower, hand, r6, on, stretchOn)
                    if not on and not stretchOn then return end
                    if on then
                        local sh = findJoint(rig, upper, r6)
                        if sh then aimJoint(sh, target) end
                        local el = findJoint(rig, lower, "")
                        local wr = findJoint(rig, hand, "")
                        if el then el.Transform = CFrame.new() end
                        if wr then wr.Transform = CFrame.new() end
                        if stretchOn and el then
                            stretchLower(el, (upper == "RightUpperArm" and _G._HaloRightArmStretchAmount or _G._HaloLeftArmStretchAmount) or _G._HaloArmStretchAmount or 2.5)
                        end
                    elseif stretchOn then
                        local el = findJoint(rig, lower, "")
                        if el then stretchLower(el, (upper == "RightUpperArm" and _G._HaloRightArmStretchAmount or _G._HaloLeftArmStretchAmount) or _G._HaloArmStretchAmount or 2.5) end
                    end
                end
                arm("RightUpperArm", "RightLowerArm", "RightHand", "Right Arm", _G._HaloRightArmPointerEnabled, _G._HaloRightArmStretching)
                arm("LeftUpperArm", "LeftLowerArm", "LeftHand", "Left Arm", _G._HaloLeftArmPointerEnabled, _G._HaloLeftArmStretching)
            end
        elseif stretching then
            if _G._HaloRightArmStretching then
                stretchLower(findJoint(rig, "RightLowerArm", ""), _G._HaloRightArmStretchAmount or _G._HaloArmStretchAmount or 2.5)
            end
            if _G._HaloLeftArmStretching then
                stretchLower(findJoint(rig, "LeftLowerArm", ""), _G._HaloLeftArmStretchAmount or _G._HaloArmStretchAmount or 2.5)
            end
        end
        trackHead(rig)
        if _G._HaloPartTrackOn and type(_G._HaloPartTrackApply) == "function" then
            pcall(_G._HaloPartTrackApply)
        end
    end

    local function needDrive()
        return _G._HaloHeadTrackerEnabled or _G._HaloHeadStretching or _G._HaloTrackActive
            or _G._HaloArmAiming or _G._HaloLeftArmStretching or _G._HaloRightArmStretching
            or _G._HaloPartTrackOn
    end

    local tail
    local lastHeadFix = 0
    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        local now = os.clock()
        if now - lastHeadFix > 0.5 then
            lastHeadFix = now
            pcall(function()
                restoreHeadSize(getRig())
            end)
        end
        -- Connect the driver ONCE while it is needed instead of re-creating the
        -- connection every single frame (that was a big low-end FPS drain).
        local drive = needDrive()
        if drive and not tail then
            tail = RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function() pcall(apply) end)
        elseif (not drive) and tail then
            pcall(function() tail:Disconnect() end); tail = nil
        end
    end)
end)

-- Anti-crash. On by default; Settings -> Anti Crash -> Disable turns it off.
-- Never touches player bodies. Only removes obvious crash spam.
-- On by default now (turn it off in Settings > Anti Crash, or with .crashbypass)
if _G._HaloAntiCrash == nil then _G._HaloAntiCrash = true end
task.spawn(function()
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
    local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
    if not lp then return end

    local blocked = 0
    local wasOn = false
    local lightBackup = nil
    local recent = {}
    local addCount = 0
    local addWindow = os.clock()
    local partClock = 0
    local scrubClock = 0
    local cloneClock = 0
    -- Weak-keyed set of effect instances. The periodic scrub only iterates this
    -- small set instead of walking the whole workspace every second (that full
    -- scan was stuttering the client once a second).
    local trackedEffects = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
    local function isEffect(inst)
        return inst:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or inst:IsA("Fire") or inst:IsA("Smoke")
            or inst:IsA("Trail") or inst:IsA("Beam")
    end

    -- things we must never touch (our own UI / clones)
    local KEEP = {
        PrismVoiceMeter = true, PrismNametag = true, PrismNametagCard = true,
        PrismClone = true, PrismHub = true, PrismChat = true, TranzitGreenRun = true, TranzitGreenRunRift = true,
        -- never nuke our own infinite baseplate / floor tiles
        Baseplate = true, HaloInfFloor = true, HaloInfTile = true,
    }

    local function on()
        return _G._HaloAntiCrash == true
    end

    -- Character models are tracked into a weak set by events, so membership
    -- is a cheap parent-chain walk instead of looping every player and running
    -- a pcall on every single check (that was a major lag source).
    local charSet = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
    local cloneCache = nil
    local function watchChar(p)
        if p.Character then charSet[p.Character] = true end
        p.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c) charSet[c] = true end)
        p.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(c) charSet[c] = nil end)
    end
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do watchChar(p) end
    Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(watchChar)
    Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p)
        if p.Character then charSet[p.Character] = nil end
    end)

    local function inAnyCharacter(inst)
        local p = inst
        while p do
            if charSet[p] or p == cloneCache then return true end
            p = p.Parent
        end
        return false
    end

    -- our own reanimated clone, cached (refreshed at most once a second)
    local function ownModel(inst)
        local char = lp.Character
        if char and (inst == char or inst:IsDescendantOf(char)) then return true end
        if cloneCache and (inst == cloneCache or inst:IsDescendantOf(cloneCache)) then return true end
        return false
    end

    local function bad(n)
        return type(n) ~= "number" or n ~= n or n == math.huge or n == -math.huge
    end

    local function keep(inst)
        if KEEP[inst.Name] then return true end
        local p = inst.Parent
        while p do
            if KEEP[p.Name] then return true end
            p = p.Parent
        end
        return false
    end

    local function nuke(inst)
        if not inst or not inst.Parent then return end
        if inAnyCharacter(inst) then return end
        if keep(inst) then return end
        pcall(function() inst.Parent = nil end)
        pcall(function() inst:Destroy() end)
        blocked = blocked + 1
    end

    -- biggest value inside a NumberSequence / NumberRange / plain number
    local function numMax(v)
        if type(v) == "number" then return v end
        if type(v) ~= "table" then return 0 end
        local okK, kps = pcall(function() return v.Keypoints end)
        if okK and kps then
            local m = 0
            for _, k in ipairs(kps) do
                local val = k.Value
                if type(val) == "number" and val > m then m = val end
            end
            return m
        end
        local okR, mx = pcall(function() return math.max(v.Min, v.Max) end)
        if okR and type(mx) == "number" then return mx end
        return 0
    end

    -- Heavy particle / effect abuse -- what crashers spam to lag the client.
    -- Checks the properties that actually cost performance (rate, particle
    -- size, speed, lifetime, opacity), not just Rate like the old build.
    local function particleAbuse(inst)
        if inst:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
            if inst.Rate > 45 then return true end
            if numMax(inst.Size) > 15 then return true end
            if numMax(inst.Speed) > 100 then return true end
            if numMax(inst.Lifetime) > 25 then return true end
            if inst.Rate > 15 and numMax(inst.Transparency) < 0.08 then return true end
        elseif inst:IsA("Fire") or inst:IsA("Smoke") then
            if inst.Size > 35 then return true end
            if inst.Heat > 35 then return true end
        elseif inst:IsA("Trail") then
            if bad(inst.Lifetime) or numMax(inst.Lifetime) > 30 then return true end
            if numMax(inst.WidthScale) > 25 then return true end
        elseif inst:IsA("Beam") then
            if inst.Width0 > 60 or inst.Width1 > 60 then return true end
        end
        return false
    end

    local function obviousCrash(inst)
        if inst:IsA("Explosion") then return (inst.BlastRadius or 0) > 60 end
        if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
            local s, pos = inst.Size, inst.Position
            if bad(s.X) or bad(s.Y) or bad(s.Z) or bad(pos.X) or bad(pos.Y) or bad(pos.Z) then
                return true
            end
            if math.abs(pos.X) > 100000 or math.abs(pos.Y) > 100000 or math.abs(pos.Z) > 100000 then
                return true
            end
            -- Roblox parts cap out at 2048 studs, so only >2048 is a real
            -- crash part. (The old >500 check was deleting the 2048x2048
            -- infinite baseplate the moment anti-crash auto-enabled.)
            if s.X > 2048 or s.Y > 2048 or s.Z > 2048 then return true end
        elseif inst:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or inst:IsA("Fire") or inst:IsA("Smoke")
            or inst:IsA("Trail") or inst:IsA("Beam") then
            if particleAbuse(inst) then return true end
        elseif inst:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
            local sc = inst.Scale
            if bad(sc.X) or sc.X > 200 or sc.Y > 200 or sc.Z > 200 then return true end
        elseif inst:IsA("Sound") then
            if bad(inst.PlaybackSpeed) or inst.Volume > 50 then return true end
        end
        return false
    end

    -- cheap "crash-y class" filter for the mass-dump detector
    local function spammy(inst)
        return inst:IsA("BasePart")
            or inst:IsA("ParticleEmitter")
            or inst:IsA("Fire")
            or inst:IsA("Smoke")
            or inst:IsA("Beam")
            or inst:IsA("Trail")
            or inst:IsA("Decal")
            or inst:IsA("Texture")
            or inst:IsA("Sound")
            or inst:IsA("Attachment")
    end

    local function check(inst)
        if not on() or not inst then return end
        if inAnyCharacter(inst) then
            if ownModel(inst) and (inst:IsA("BodyMover") or inst:IsA("LinearVelocity")
                or inst:IsA("AngularVelocity") or inst:IsA("VectorForce")) then
                pcall(function() inst:Destroy() end)
                blocked = blocked + 1
            end
            return
        end
        if keep(inst) then return end
        if obviousCrash(inst) then
            nuke(inst)
            return
        end
        if not spammy(inst) then return end
        if inst.Parent ~= workspace then return end
        local now = os.clock()
        recent[#recent + 1] = { now, inst }
        local n = 0
        local w = 1
        for i = 1, #recent do
            local item = recent[i]
            if now - item[1] <= 0.4 and item[2] and item[2].Parent then
                recent[w] = item
                w = w + 1
                n = n + 1
            end
        end
        for i = w, #recent do recent[i] = nil end
        if n >= 25 then
            for i = 1, n do
                local obj = recent[i][2]
                if obj and obj.Parent == workspace and not inAnyCharacter(obj) then
                    nuke(obj)
                end
            end
            table.clear(recent)
        end
    end

    -- Periodic effect scrub. Instead of scanning the entire workspace every
    -- second (which lagged the client), we keep a weak-keyed set of the effect
    -- instances and only re-check those -- a tiny, cheap loop.
    local function scrubParticles()
        for d in pairs(trackedEffects) do
            if not inAnyCharacter(d) and not keep(d) and particleAbuse(d) then
                nuke(d)
            end
        end
    end

    -- Bounded FIFO work queue. Instead of running the (comparatively heavy)
    -- check on every descendant the moment it appears -- which floods the
    -- scheduler with task.defer + pcall during a crash -- we push a cheap
    -- pre-filtered entry and drain a small batch each frame.
    local queue = {}
    local qHead, qTail = 1, 0
    local addedParts = 0

    workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(inst)
        addCount = addCount + 1
        if not on() then return end
        local cls = inst.ClassName
        if cls == "ParticleEmitter" or cls == "Fire" or cls == "Smoke"
            or cls == "Trail" or cls == "Beam" then
            trackedEffects[inst] = true
        elseif inst:IsA("BasePart") then
            if inst.Parent == workspace then addedParts = addedParts + 1 end
        elseif cls ~= "Decal" and cls ~= "Texture" and cls ~= "Sound"
            and cls ~= "Attachment" and cls ~= "Explosion" and cls ~= "SpecialMesh" then
            return
        end
        if qTail - qHead < 4000 then
            qTail = qTail + 1
            queue[qTail] = inst
        end
    end)

    -- top-level model dumps (a classic crash: spawn hundreds of models at once)
    workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(inst)
        if not on() then return end
        if inst:IsA("Model") and not inAnyCharacter(inst) then
            task.defer(function()
                if not on() then return end
                pcall(function()
                    local count = 0
                    for _, d in ipairs(inst:GetDescendants()) do
                        if d:IsA("BasePart") then count = count + 1 end
                        if count > 400 then break end
                    end
                    if count > 400 then nuke(inst) end
                end)
            end)
        end
    end)

    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        local enabled = on()
        if enabled and not wasOn then
            pcall(function()
                if _G.PrismShieldNoShadows == true then
                    lightBackup = Lighting.GlobalShadows
                    Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
                end
            end)
            table.clear(recent)
            addCount = 0
            addWindow = os.clock()
            -- seed the effect tracker once so the periodic scrub only ever
            -- iterates this small set afterwards
            pcall(function()
                local n = 0
                for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                    n = n + 1
                    if n > 20000 then break end
                    if isEffect(d) then trackedEffects[d] = true end
                end
            end)
        elseif (not enabled) and wasOn then
            pcall(function()
                if lightBackup ~= nil then Lighting.GlobalShadows = lightBackup end
            end)
        end
        wasOn = enabled
        if not enabled then return end

        -- refresh our cached reanimated-clone reference about once a second
        cloneClock = cloneClock + 1
        if cloneClock >= 60 then
            cloneClock = 0
            local api = rawget(_G, "_HaloReanimateAPI") or rawget(_G, "ReanimateAPI")
            pcall(function()
                if api and api.get_clone then cloneCache = api.get_clone(lp) end
            end)
        end

        -- drain a bounded batch of queued additions each frame
        local budget = 80
        while qHead <= qTail and budget > 0 do
            local inst = queue[qHead]
            queue[qHead] = nil
            qHead = qHead + 1
            budget = budget - 1
            if inst then pcall(check, inst) end
        end
        if qHead > qTail then qHead, qTail = 1, 0 end

        local char = lp.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hrp then
            pcall(function()
                local v = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                if bad(v.X) or bad(v.Y) or bad(v.Z) or v.Magnitude > 500 then
                    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                end
                local av = hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity
                if bad(av.X) or bad(av.Y) or bad(av.Z) or av.Magnitude > 120 then
                    hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                end
            end)
        end

        -- flood watchdog: too many things added in one second -> trim the junk
        local now = os.clock()
        if now - addWindow >= 1 then
            if addCount > 900 then
                pcall(function()
                    local removed = 0
                    for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                        if removed >= 400 then break end
                        if d:IsA("BasePart") and d.Parent == workspace
                            and not inAnyCharacter(d) and not keep(d) then
                            pcall(function() d:Destroy() end)
                            removed = removed + 1
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
            addCount = 0
            addWindow = now
        end

        -- part watchdog (~every 2s): an O(1) check of a running "parts added"
        -- counter. Only when the world is genuinely ballooning do we pay for a
        -- single workspace walk. (The old code walked the entire workspace
        -- every 2 seconds unconditionally -- that was the periodic stutter.)
        partClock = partClock + 1
        if partClock >= 120 then
            partClock = 0
            if addedParts > 1500 then
                pcall(function()
                    local removed = 0
                    for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                        if removed >= 250 then break end
                        if d:IsA("BasePart") and d.Parent == workspace
                            and not inAnyCharacter(d) and not keep(d) then
                            pcall(function() d:Destroy() end)
                            removed = removed + 1
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
            addedParts = 0
        end

        -- run the particle scrub about once a second
        scrubClock = scrubClock + 1
        if scrubClock >= 60 then
            scrubClock = 0
            pcall(scrubParticles)
        end

        if blocked > 0 then
            blocked = 0
        end
    end)
end)
-- Prism hub, commands, fly, esp. No neck.
task.defer(function()
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
    local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
    local plr = Players.LocalPlayer

    local lastMsg, lastAt = "", 0
    local flyOn, noclipOn = false, false
    local flyConn, attachWeld = nil, nil
    local espOn = false
    local espFolder = {}
    local binds = {}
    local autoexec = {}
    pcall(function()
        local raw
        if type(readfile) == "function" then raw = readfile("PrismAutoExec.json") end
        if type(raw) == "string" and raw ~= "" then
            local data = game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(raw)
            if type(data) == "table" then autoexec = data end
        end
    end)
    -- Keep the saved F teleport option backward compatible with older dashfx settings.
    _G.PrismDashEnabled = autoexec.dashfx == true
    _G.PrismDashEffectsEnabled = false

    local function note(a, b)
        pcall(function()
            if Notify then Notify(a, b, 2) else print(a, b or "") end
        end)
    end

    local function findPlayer(name)
        if not name or name == "" then return nil end
        name = name:lower()
        local best
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= plr then
                local n, d = p.Name:lower(), p.DisplayName:lower()
                if n == name or d == name then return p end
                if n:find(name, 1, true) or d:find(name, 1, true) then best = best or p end
            end
        end
        return best
    end

    local function humRoot()
        local api = rawget(_G, "_HaloReanimateAPI") or rawget(_G, "ReanimateAPI")
        local char = nil
        pcall(function()
            if api and api.get_clone then char = api.get_clone(plr) end
        end)
        if not (char and char.Parent) then
            char = workspace:FindFirstChild("Reanimation")
        end
        if not (char and char.Parent) then
            char = plr.Character
        end
        if not char then return nil, nil end
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso") or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
        return hrp, char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    end

    local function clearAttach()
        if attachWeld then pcall(function() attachWeld:Destroy() end) attachWeld = nil end
        local _, hum = humRoot()
        if hum then hum.PlatformStand = false end
    end

    local function setFly(on)
        flyOn = on
        _G._HaloFlyOn = on
        if flyConn then flyConn:Disconnect() flyConn = nil end
        if not on then
            local hrp, hum = humRoot()
            if hum then
                hum.PlatformStand = false
                pcall(function() hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp) end)
            end
            if hrp then
                pcall(function()
                    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                end)
            end
            note("Fly", "OFF")
            return
        end
        note("Fly", "ON  WASD / space / ctrl")
        local last = os.clock()
        flyConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
            if not flyOn then return end
            local now = os.clock()
            local dt = math.clamp(now - last, 0.001, 0.05)
            last = now
            local hrp, hum = humRoot()
            if not hrp then return end
            if hum then
                hum.PlatformStand = true
                pcall(function() hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics) end)
            end
            pcall(function()
                hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
            end)
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            if not cam then return end
            local dir = Vector3.zero
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then dir = dir + cam.CFrame.LookVector end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then dir = dir - cam.CFrame.LookVector end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then dir = dir - cam.CFrame.RightVector end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then dir = dir + cam.CFrame.RightVector end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then dir = dir + Vector3.yAxis end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then
                dir = dir - Vector3.yAxis
            end
            if dir.Magnitude > 0.05 then dir = dir.Unit else dir = Vector3.zero end
            local speed = _G._HaloFlySpeed or 80
            local pos = hrp.Position + dir * speed * dt
            hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos) * (cam.CFrame - cam.CFrame.Position)
        end)
    end

    RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
        if not noclipOn then return end
        local hrp = humRoot()
        local c = hrp and hrp.Parent
        if not c then return end
        for _, part in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then part.CanCollide = false end
        end
    end)

    local function setEsp(on)
        espOn = on
        for _, h in pairs(espFolder) do
            pcall(function() h:Destroy() end)
        end
        table.clear(espFolder)
        if not on then note("ESP", "OFF") return end
        local function tag(p)
            if p == plr or not p.Character then return end
            local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
            hl.Name = "HaloESP"
            hl.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 40, 70)
            hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 230)
            hl.FillTransparency = 0.55
            hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
            hl.Adornee = p.Character
            hl.Parent = p.Character
            espFolder[p.UserId] = hl
        end
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do tag(p) end
        note("ESP", "ON")
    end
    -- FIX: When a player joins and their character loads, the original code called
    -- setEsp(true) which DESTROYED and RECREATED every single Highlight for every
    -- player — a full rebuild on each join. With many players this caused a visible
    -- lag spike. Now we only add a Highlight for the new player's character.
    local function espTagPlayer(p)
        if p == plr or not p.Character then return end
        local existing = espFolder[p.UserId]
        if existing and existing.Parent then existing:Destroy() end
        local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
        hl.Name = "HaloESP"
        hl.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 40, 70)
        hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 230)
        hl.FillTransparency = 0.55
        hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
        hl.Adornee = p.Character
        hl.Parent = p.Character
        espFolder[p.UserId] = hl
    end
    Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(p)
        p.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
            if espOn then task.wait(0.4) espTagPlayer(p) end
        end)
    end)

    local hiddenSet = {}
    local function applyHide(target, hidden)
        if not target then return end
        hiddenSet[target.UserId] = hidden or nil
        local char = target.Character
        if char then
            for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                if d:IsA("BasePart") then
                    d.LocalTransparencyModifier = hidden and 1 or 0
                elseif d:IsA("Decal") or d:IsA("Texture") then
                    d.Transparency = hidden and 1 or 0
                elseif d:IsA("BillboardGui") or d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or d:IsA("Trail") then
                    d.Enabled = not hidden
                end
            end
        end
        pcall(function()
            if hidden then
                game:GetService("SoundService").LocalMuted[target.UserId] = true
            else
                game:GetService("SoundService").LocalMuted[target.UserId] = nil
            end
        end)
        if hidden and not target:GetAttribute("PrismHideHook") then
            target:SetAttribute("PrismHideHook", true)
            target.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
                if not hiddenSet[target.UserId] then return end
                task.wait(0.4)
                applyHide(target, true)
            end)
        end
    end

    local function doTp(target)
        if not target then note("TP", "No player") return end
        local char = target.Character
        local th = char and (char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:FindFirstChild("Head"))
        if not th then note("TP", "They're not spawned") return end
        local goal = th.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 3, 2)
        local hrp = humRoot()
        if not hrp then return end
        local before = hrp.Position
        hrp.CFrame = goal
        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        note("TP", target.DisplayName)
    end

    local function doView(target)
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local thum = target and target.Character and target.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not (cam and thum) then note("View", "No character") return end
        _G._HaloViewUser = target.UserId
        cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
        cam.CameraSubject = thum
        note("View", target.DisplayName)
    end

    -- F cursor teleport. Visual dash trails, vortexes, beams, particles and FOV pulses are removed.
    _G.PrismDashEnabled = _G.PrismDashEnabled or false
    _G.PrismDashEffectsEnabled = false
    local DASH_KEY=Enum.KeyCode.F
    local dashPlayer=Players.LocalPlayer
    local dashMouse=dashPlayer and dashPlayer:GetMouse()
    local dashBusy=false
    for _,key in ipairs({"_ParallaxDashCharacterConn","_ParallaxDashInputConn"}) do
        local old=rawget(_G,key); if old then pcall(function() old:Disconnect() end); _G[key]=nil end
    end
    local oldDashRigs={dashPlayer and dashPlayer.Character,workspace:FindFirstChild("Reanimation")}
    local reanimApi=rawget(_G,"_HaloReanimateAPI") or rawget(_G,"ReanimateAPI")
    pcall(function() if reanimApi and reanimApi.get_clone then table.insert(oldDashRigs,reanimApi.get_clone(dashPlayer)) end end)
    for _,oldRig in ipairs(oldDashRigs) do
        local root=oldRig and oldRig:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if root then
            for _,item in ipairs(root:GetChildren()) do
                if item:IsA("Trail") and item.Attachment0 and item.Attachment1 then
                    local a,b=item.Attachment0.Position,item.Attachment1.Position
                    if math.abs(a.Y-.65)<.08 and math.abs(b.Y+.65)<.08 then
                        local a0,a1=item.Attachment0,item.Attachment1; item:Destroy()
                        if a0 then a0:Destroy() end; if a1 then a1:Destroy() end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    for _,obj in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if obj.Name=="ParallaxDashVortex" or obj.Name=="ParallaxDashRing" or obj.Name=="ParallaxDashAnchor" then
            pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end)
        end
    end
    local function dash()
        if not _G.PrismDashEnabled or dashBusy or not dashPlayer or not dashMouse then return end
        local api=rawget(_G,"_HaloReanimateAPI") or rawget(_G,"ReanimateAPI")
        local character
        pcall(function()
            if api and type(api.is_reanimated)=="function" and api.is_reanimated() and type(api.get_clone)=="function" then
                character=api.get_clone(dashPlayer)
            end
        end)
        if not (character and character.Parent) then character=dashPlayer.Character end
        local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local root=character and (character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or character:FindFirstChild("Torso"))
        if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 or humanoid.Sit then return end
        local hit=dashMouse.Hit
        if not hit then return end
        local destination=hit.Position+Vector3.new(0,3,0)
        if (destination-root.Position).Magnitude<1 then return end
        dashBusy=true
        root.CFrame=CFrame.new(destination)*root.CFrame.Rotation
        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero
        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero
        dashBusy=false
    end
    _G._ParallaxDashInputConn=UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input,gameProcessed)
        if gameProcessed or UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
        if input.KeyCode==DASH_KEY then dash() end
    end)

    _G._PrismGoPriv = function(plr, TeleportService, noteFn)
        pcall(function()
            if type(writefile) == "function" then
                writefile("prism_priv_src.lua", "return")
                writefile("prism_priv_hop.txt", "99")
            end
        end)
        if #game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers() <= 1 then
            noteFn("Private", "You're already the only one in this server")
            return
        end
        -- Real fix: ReserveServer hands back a brand-new server instance that
        -- literally nobody else can be in yet -- that's the only way to
        -- GUARANTEE solo. The old "pick the lowest-population public server"
        -- fallback below can still land you with other people in it, so try
        -- this first and only fall back if the executor won't allow it.
        noteFn("Private", "Reserving a server just for you")
        local reserved = false
        pcall(function()
            local ts = game:GetService("TeleportService")
            local code = ts:ReserveServer(game.PlaceId)
            if type(code) == "string" and #code > 4 then
                local sent = pcall(function()
                    ts:TeleportToPrivateServer(game.PlaceId, code, { plr })
                end)
                if sent then
                    reserved = true
                    noteFn("Private", "Teleporting to your own server")
                end
            end
        end)
        if reserved then return end
        noteFn("Private", "Reserve failed, looking for the emptiest server instead")
        task.spawn(function()
            local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
            local function http(url)
                local req = (type(syn) == "table" and syn.request) or http_request or request or (type(http) == "table" and http.request)
                if type(req) == "function" then
                    local ok, res = pcall(req, { Url = url, Method = "GET" })
                    if ok and type(res) == "table" then
                        local body = res.Body or res.body
                        local code = tonumber(res.StatusCode or res.status_code) or 200
                        if type(body) == "string" and #body > 2 and code < 400 then
                            return body
                        end
                    end
                end
                local ok2, body = pcall(function()
                    return game:HttpGet(url)
                end)
                if ok2 and type(body) == "string" and #body > 2 then
                    return body
                end
                return nil
            end
            local function pull(url)
                local body = http(url)
                if not body then return nil end
                local ok, data = pcall(function()
                    return HttpService:JSONDecode(body)
                end)
                if ok and type(data) == "table" then return data end
                return nil
            end
            local place = game.PlaceId
            local universe = game.GameId
            local priv = pull("https://games.roblox.com/v1/games/" .. tostring(universe) .. "/private-servers?limit=50&sortOrder=Desc")
            if priv and type(priv.data) == "table" then
                for _, s in ipairs(priv.data) do
                    local access = s.accessCode
                    if type(access) == "string" and #access > 4 then
                        local sent = pcall(function()
                            TeleportService:TeleportToPrivateServer(place, access, { plr })
                        end)
                        if sent then
                            noteFn("Private", "Joining your private server")
                            return
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            local best
            local cursor = ""
            for _ = 1, 4 do
                local url = "https://games.roblox.com/v1/games/" .. tostring(place) .. "/servers/Public?sortOrder=Asc&excludeFullGames=true&limit=100"
                if cursor ~= "" then
                    url = url .. "&cursor=" .. cursor
                end
                local data = pull(url)
                if not data or type(data.data) ~= "table" then break end
                for _, s in ipairs(data.data) do
                    if type(s.id) == "string" and s.id ~= game.JobId and type(s.playing) == "number" then
                        if not best or s.playing < best.playing then
                            best = s
                        end
                        if s.playing == 0 then break end
                    end
                end
                if best and best.playing == 0 then break end
                cursor = tostring(data.nextPageCursor or "")
                if cursor == "" or cursor == "nil" then break end
            end
            if not best then
                noteFn("Private", "Couldn't find another server")
                return
            end
            noteFn("Private", "One teleport. Server has " .. tostring(best.playing) .. " players")
            local sent = pcall(function()
                TeleportService:TeleportToPlaceInstance(place, best.id, plr)
            end)
            if not sent then
                noteFn("Private", "Teleport was blocked by the game")
            end
        end)
    end

    local function run(raw)
        if type(raw) ~= "string" then return false end
        local msg = raw:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
        local pre = msg:sub(1, 1)
        if pre ~= "." and pre ~= "?" then return false end
        if msg == lastMsg and os.clock() - lastAt < 0.35 then return true end
        lastMsg, lastAt = msg, os.clock()
        local body = msg:sub(2)
        local name, arg = body:match("^(%S+)%s*(.*)$")
        if not name then return false end
        name = name:lower()
        arg = arg and arg:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") or ""
        local function known()
            return true
        end
        if name == "rj" or name == "rejoin" then
            note("Rejoining", "")
            task.delay(0.3, function()
                pcall(function() TeleportService:Teleport(game.PlaceId, plr) end)
            end)
            return known()
        elseif name == "priv" or name == "private" or name == "solo" then
            _G._PrismGoPriv(plr, TeleportService, note)
            return known()
        elseif name == "reanimate" or name == "emotes" then
            showMenu()
            return known()
        elseif name == "antivcbypass" then
            pcall(function()
                if _G._PrismVCOn and type(_G._PrismDisableShieldVC) == "function" then
                    _G._PrismDisableShieldVC()
                elseif type(_G._PrismEnableShieldVC) == "function" then
                    _G._PrismEnableShieldVC()
                end
            end)
            return known()
        elseif name == "crashbypass" then
            _G._HaloAntiCrash = not _G._HaloAntiCrash
            note("Anti crash", _G._HaloAntiCrash and "ON" or "OFF")
            return known()
        elseif name == "fly" then
            setFly(not flyOn)
            return known()
        elseif name == "unfly" then
            setFly(false)
            return known()
        elseif name == "flyspeed" then
            local n = tonumber(arg)
            if not n then note("Fly speed", "Type .flyspeed 80") return known() end
            _G._HaloFlySpeed = n
            note("Fly speed", tostring(n))
            return known()
        elseif name == "spin" then
            _G._HaloSpin = not _G._HaloSpin
            note("Spin", _G._HaloSpin and "ON" or "OFF")
            return known()
        elseif name == "night" then
            game:GetService("Lighting").ClockTime = 0
            note("Time", "Night")
            return known()
        elseif name == "day" then
            game:GetService("Lighting").ClockTime = 14
            note("Time", "Day")
            return known()
        elseif name == "time" then
            local n = tonumber(arg)
            if not n then note("Time", "Type .time 14") return known() end
            game:GetService("Lighting").ClockTime = n % 24
            note("Time", tostring(n))
            return known()
        elseif name == "fog" then
            local n = tonumber(arg) or 100
            local L = game:GetService("Lighting")
            L.FogStart = 0
            L.FogEnd = math.max(0, n)
            note("Fog", tostring(n))
            return known()
        elseif name == "fullbright" then
            local L = game:GetService("Lighting")
            L.Brightness = 2
            L.ClockTime = 14
            L.FogEnd = 100000
            L.GlobalShadows = false
            L.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            note("Light", "Fullbright")
            return known()
        elseif name == "invisible" then
            _G._HaloCharTrans = 1
            note("Invisible", "ON")
            return known()
        elseif name == "visible" then
            _G._HaloCharTrans = 0
            local hrp = humRoot()
            local c = hrp and hrp.Parent
            if c then
                for _, d in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do
                    if d:IsA("BasePart") then d.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0 end
                end
            end
            note("Invisible", "OFF")
            return known()
        elseif name == "sit" then
            local _, hum = humRoot()
            if hum then hum.Sit = true end
            return known()
        elseif name == "dance" then
            local _, hum = humRoot()
            if hum then
                local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
                if not animator then animator = Instance.new("Animator") animator.Parent = hum end
                local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
                anim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://507771019"
                local ok, track = pcall(function() return animator:LoadAnimation(anim) end)
                if ok and track then track.Looped = true track:Play(0.1) end
            end
            note("Dance", "ON")
            return known()
        elseif name == "fov" then
            local n = tonumber(arg)
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            if not (cam and n) then note("FOV", "Type .fov 80") return known() end
            cam.FieldOfView = math.clamp(n, 10, 120)
            note("FOV", tostring(n))
            return known()
        elseif name == "freeze" then
            local hrp, hum = humRoot()
            if hrp then hrp.Anchored = true end
            if hum then hum.WalkSpeed = 0 hum.JumpPower = 0 end
            note("Freeze", "ON")
            return known()
        elseif name == "thaw" then
            local hrp, hum = humRoot()
            if hrp then hrp.Anchored = false end
            if hum then hum.WalkSpeed = 16 hum.JumpPower = 50 end
            note("Freeze", "OFF")
            return known()
        elseif name == "heal" then
            local _, hum = humRoot()
            if hum then hum.Health = hum.MaxHealth end
            note("Heal", "Done")
            return known()
        elseif name == "noclip" then
            noclipOn = not noclipOn
            note("Noclip", noclipOn and "ON" or "OFF")
            return known()
        elseif name == "infzoom" then
            plr.CameraMaxZoomDistance = 100000
            plr.CameraMinZoomDistance = 0.5
            note("Zoom", "Unlocked")
            return known()
        elseif name == "espmenu" then
            setEsp(not espOn)
            return known()
        elseif name == "animcopier" then
            openCopier()
            return known()
        elseif name == "prismchat" then
            openPrism()
            return known()
        elseif name == "respawn" then
            pcall(function() plr:LoadCharacter() end)
            return known()
        elseif name == "re" then
            local hrp = humRoot()
            local cf = hrp and hrp.CFrame
            local conn
            conn = plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
                if conn then conn:Disconnect() end
                local r = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 8)
                if r and cf then r.CFrame = cf end
            end)
            pcall(function() plr:LoadCharacter() end)
            return known()
        elseif name == "unview" then
            _G._HaloViewUser = nil
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            local _, hum = humRoot()
            if cam and hum then
                cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
                cam.CameraSubject = hum
            end
            note("View", "Yourself")
            return known()
        elseif name == "drop" then
            clearAttach()
            note("Dropped", "")
            return known()
        elseif name == "speed" then
            local n = tonumber(arg)
            if not n then note("Speed", "Type .speed 32") return known() end
            _G._HaloSpeedLock = n
            local _, hum = humRoot()
            if hum then hum.WalkSpeed = n end
            note("Speed", tostring(n))
            return known()
        elseif name == "jumppower" then
            local n = tonumber(arg)
            if not n then note("Jump", "Type .jumppower 80") return known() end
            _G._HaloJumpLock = n
            local _, hum = humRoot()
            if hum then hum.JumpPower = n hum.UseJumpPower = true end
            note("Jump", tostring(n))
            return known()
        elseif name == "gravity" then
            local n = tonumber(arg)
            if not n then note("Gravity", "Type .gravity 196") return known() end
            workspace.Gravity = n
            note("Gravity", tostring(n))
            return known()
        end
        local target = findPlayer(arg)
        if name == "tp" or name == "to" or name == "hide" or name == "unhide" or name == "view" or name == "headsit" or name == "backback" then
            if not target then note("No player", arg) return known() end
            local hrp, hum = humRoot()
            local th = target.Character and target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local thead = target.Character and target.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
            if name == "tp" or name == "to" then
                doTp(target)
            elseif name == "hide" then
                applyHide(target, true)
                pcall(function() permHidePlayer(target) end)
                note("Hide", target.DisplayName)
            elseif name == "unhide" then
                applyHide(target, false)
                pcall(function() unpermHidePlayer(target) end)
                note("Unhide", target.DisplayName)
            elseif name == "view" then
                doView(target)
            elseif name == "headsit" and hrp and thead and hum then
                clearAttach()
                hum.PlatformStand = true
                local w = Instance.new("Weld")
                w.Name = "HaloAttach"
                w.Part0 = thead
                w.Part1 = hrp
                w.C0 = CFrame.new(0, 1.7, 0)
                w.Parent = hrp
                attachWeld = w
            elseif name == "backback" and hrp and th and hum then
                clearAttach()
                hum.PlatformStand = true
                local w = Instance.new("Weld")
                w.Name = "HaloAttach"
                w.Part0 = th
                w.Part1 = hrp
                w.C0 = CFrame.new(0, 0.4, 1.3)
                w.Parent = hrp
                attachWeld = w
            end
            return known()
        end
        return false
    end
    _G._HaloCmd = run
    task.spawn(function()
        local function try(text)
            if type(text) ~= "string" then return false end
            local cmd = text:match("^%s*[%.%?](%S+)")
            if not cmd then return false end
            cmd = cmd:lower()
            if cmd ~= "rj" and cmd ~= "rejoin" and cmd ~= "priv" and cmd ~= "private" and cmd ~= "solo" then
                return false
            end
            pcall(run, text)
            return true
        end
        pcall(function()
            local tcs = game:GetService("TextChatService")
            if tcs and tcs.SendingMessage then
                tcs.SendingMessage:Connect(function(message)
                    local text = message and message.Text
                    if try(text) then
                        pcall(function() message.Text = "" end)
                    end
                end)
            end
        end)
        plr.Chatted:Connect(function(msg)
            try(msg)
        end)
    end)

    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        -- cheap early-out: skip the whole body unless one of these is active
        if not (_G._HaloSpeedLock or _G._HaloJumpLock or _G._HaloViewUser or _G._HaloSpin) then return end
        local _, hum = humRoot()
        if not hum then return end
        if type(_G._HaloSpeedLock) == "number" then hum.WalkSpeed = _G._HaloSpeedLock end
        if type(_G._HaloJumpLock) == "number" then
            hum.UseJumpPower = true
            hum.JumpPower = _G._HaloJumpLock
        end
        local watch = _G._HaloViewUser
        if watch then
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            local who = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(watch)
            local thum = who and who.Character and who.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if cam and thum then
                cam.CameraSubject = thum
            end
        end
        if _G._HaloSpin then
            local spinRoot = humRoot()
            if spinRoot then
                spinRoot.CFrame = spinRoot.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(22), 0)
            end
        end
    end)

        -- under the nametag card (100), the mobile wheel button (550) and the
        -- emote wheel (600).  The last two live in CoreGui, which intercepts
        -- input ahead of PlayerGui, so clicks aimed at this window (the header
        -- search box most visibly) were being swallowed before they arrived.

            return c
        end
        local function stroke(o, col, th, tr)
            local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
            s.Color = col or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            s.Thickness = th or 1
            s.Transparency = tr or 0.82
            s.Parent = o
            return s
        end

            l.TextSize = size
