        local function card(parent, x, y, w, h)
            local f = Instance.new("Frame")
            f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
            f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
            f.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(14, 15, 20)
            f.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
            f.BorderSizePixel = 0
            f.ZIndex = 7
            f.Parent = parent
            corner(f, 16)
            -- [Prism] frosted-glass depth + silver edge (guarded, cosmetic)
            pcall(function()
                local g = Instance.new("UIGradient")
                g.Rotation = 90
                g.Color = ColorSequence.new({
                    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.0, Color3.fromRGB(26, 28, 36)),
                    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.45, Color3.fromRGB(18, 19, 26)),
                    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.0, Color3.fromRGB(10, 11, 15)),
                })
                g.Parent = f
                local edge = Instance.new("UIStroke")
                edge.Thickness = 1
                edge.Transparency = 0.45
                edge.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
                edge.Color = Color3.fromRGB(180, 185, 200)
                edge.Parent = f
                local bar = Instance.new("Frame")
                bar.Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 1, -20)
                bar.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 10)
                bar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 148, 165)
                bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
                bar.ZIndex = 8
                bar.Parent = f
                corner(bar, 2)
                do
                    local bg2 = Instance.new("UIGradient")
                    bg2.Color = ColorSequence.new({
                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(200, 210, 225)),
                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(160, 170, 190)),
                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(100, 120, 165)),
                    })
                    bg2.Rotation = 90
                    bg2.Parent = bar
                end
            end)
            return f
        end
        local function button(parent, text, x, y, w, h, fn)
            local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
            b.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            b.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x + w / 2, y + h / 2)
            b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
            b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(42, 46, 58)
            b.Text = text
            b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            b.TextSize = 13
            b.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 225, 235)
            b.AutoButtonColor = false
            b.ClipsDescendants = true
            b.ZIndex = 9
            b.Parent = parent
            corner(b, 10)
            local bs = stroke(b, Color3.fromRGB(160, 165, 180), 1, 0.55)
            local bscale = Instance.new("UIScale")
            bscale.Scale = 1
            bscale.Parent = b
            -- [Prism] hover glow + pop (never touches base colour, so toggles keep working)
            b.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                TweenService:Create(bscale, TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1.05 }):Play()
                if bs then TweenService:Create(bs, TweenInfo.new(0.16), { Transparency = 0.05, Thickness = 1.8 }):Play() end
            end)
            b.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                TweenService:Create(bscale, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1 }):Play()
                if bs then TweenService:Create(bs, TweenInfo.new(0.2), { Transparency = 0.55, Thickness = 1 }):Play() end
            end)
            b.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
                pcall(function()
                    local r = Instance.new("Frame")
                    r.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                    r.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
                    r.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8)
                    r.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                    r.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
                    r.BorderSizePixel = 0
                    r.ZIndex = 11
                    r.Parent = b
                    corner(r)
                    TweenService:Create(r, TweenInfo.new(0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w * 1.7, h * 3.2),
                        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    }):Play()
                    task.delay(0.55, function() if r and r.Parent then r:Destroy() end end)
                end)
            end)
            b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(fn)
            return b
        end

        local pages = {}
        local navButtons = {}
        local navOrder = {}
        -- the indicator lives in its own clipped track beside the nav list (NOT inside navHost, whose
        -- UIListLayout would treat it as a list item and pin it to the top)
        local navTrack = Instance.new("Frame")
        navTrack.Name = "NavTrack"
        navTrack.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        navTrack.BorderSizePixel = 0
        navTrack.ClipsDescendants = true
        navTrack.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 78)
        navTrack.Size = UDim2.new(0, 12, 1, -170)
        navTrack.ZIndex = 9
        navTrack.Parent = sidebar
        local navIndicator = Instance.new("Frame")
        navIndicator.Name = "NavIndicator"
        navIndicator.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 225, 235)
        navIndicator.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
        navIndicator.BorderSizePixel = 0
        navIndicator.Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0, 16)
        navIndicator.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 8)
        navIndicator.ZIndex = 9
        navIndicator.Visible = false
        navIndicator.Parent = navTrack
        corner(navIndicator, 2)
        local navSelected = nil
        local navTween = nil
        local navQuietUntil = 0
        local function navTargetY(i)
            -- item i sits at (i-1)*36 in the canvas (34px tall + 2px UIListLayout padding), minus the scroll offset; center 16px indicator in 34px button: (34-16)/2 = 9
            return 9 + (i - 1) * 38 - navHost.CanvasPosition.Y
        end
        local function navPlace(animate)
            if not navSelected then return end
            local idx
            for i, key in ipairs(navOrder) do
                if key == navSelected then idx = i break end
            end
            if not idx then return end
            local y = navTargetY(idx)
            local inView = y >= -4 and y <= navHost.AbsoluteSize.Y - 12
            navIndicator.Visible = inView
            if navTween then pcall(function() navTween:Cancel() end) navTween = nil end
            if animate and inView then
                navQuietUntil = os.clock() + 0.3
                navTween = TweenService:Create(navIndicator, TweenInfo.new(0.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                    Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, y),
                })
                navTween:Play()
            else
                navIndicator.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, y)
            end
        end
        pcall(function()
            navHost:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanvasPosition"):Connect(function()
                if os.clock() >= navQuietUntil then navPlace(false) end
            end)
            navHost:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function() navPlace(false) end)
        end)
        local function show(name)
            for n, f in pairs(pages) do
                if n == name then
                    f.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 18)
                    f.Visible = true
                    pcall(function()
                        TweenService:Create(f, TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)}):Play()
                    end)
                else
                    f.Visible = false
                    f.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
                end
            end
            for n, b in pairs(navButtons) do
                local on = (n == name)
                local btnCol = on and Color3.fromRGB(45, 52, 70) or Color3.fromRGB(22, 24, 30)
                local txtCol = on and Color3.fromRGB(220, 225, 235) or Color3.fromRGB(130, 140, 160)
                local alpha = on and 0.04 or 0.9
                pcall(function()
                    TweenService:Create(b, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                        BackgroundTransparency = alpha,
                        BackgroundColor3 = btnCol,
                        TextColor3 = txtCol,
                    }):Play()
                end)
                b.Font = on and Enum.Font.GothamBold or Enum.Font.GothamMedium
            end
            navSelected = name
            -- bring the selected tab into view if the list is scrolled away from it
            pcall(function()
                for i, key in ipairs(navOrder) do
                    if key == name then
                        local top = (i - 1) * 38
                        local cur = navHost.CanvasPosition.Y
                        local h = navHost.AbsoluteSize.Y
                        if top < cur then
                            navHost.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, top)
                        elseif top + 32 > cur + h then
                            navHost.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, top + 32 - h)
                        end
                        break
                    end
                end
            end)
            navPlace(true)
        end

        -- Neon/emissive glow helpers: add PointLights to Neon-material parts
        local _neonGlowOn = false
        local _neonGlowConn = nil
        local _NGLNAME = "PrismNeonLight"
        local function _ngAdd(p)
            if not (p and p:IsA("BasePart")) then return end
            if p.Material ~= Enum.Material.Neon
                and p.Material ~= Enum.Material.ForceField then return end
            if p:FindFirstChild(_NGLNAME) then return end
            local l = Instance.new("PointLight")
            l.Name = _NGLNAME
            l.Brightness = 2
            l.Range = 20
            l.Color = p.Color
            l.Shadows = false
            l.Parent = p
        end
        local function _neonGlowEnable()
            _neonGlowOn = true
            local descs = workspace:GetDescendants()
            for i, d in ipairs(descs) do
                pcall(_ngAdd, d)
                if i % 100 == 0 then task.wait() end
            end
            if not _neonGlowConn then
                _neonGlowConn = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
                    task.wait()
                    pcall(_ngAdd, d)
                end)
            end
        end
        local function _neonGlowDisable()
            _neonGlowOn = false
            if _neonGlowConn then
                _neonGlowConn:Disconnect()
                _neonGlowConn = nil
            end
            for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                local l = d:FindFirstChild(_NGLNAME)
                if l then pcall(function() l:Destroy() end) end
            end
        end

        local function buildToolPage()
        local tools = page()
        pages.Tools = tools

            {"Reanimation", function() showMenu() end},
            {"VC Bypass", function() run(".antivcbypass") end},
            {"Anti Crash", function() run(".crashbypass") end},

                if _neonGlowOn then
                    _neonGlowDisable()
                    note("Neon Glow", "OFF")
                else
                    task.spawn(_neonGlowEnable)
                    note("Neon Glow", "ON  - neon parts now cast real light")
                end
            end},
        }
        for i, item in ipairs(toolList) do

        -- Teleport Tool toggle card (sits in the grid alongside the other tools)
        do
            local n = #toolList
            local tpCol = n % 2
            local tpRow = math.floor(n / 2)
            local tpCard = card(tools, 8 + tpCol * 352, 8 + tpRow * 78, 340, 68)
            txt(tpCard, "Teleport Tool", 16, 16, 18, 180, 30, true).ZIndex = 8
            local tpToggleBtn
            local function _tpActive()
                local bp = plr:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
                return (bp and bp:FindFirstChild("PrismTpTool") ~= nil)
                    or (plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("PrismTpTool") ~= nil)
            end
            local function _tpSetOn(on)
                tpToggleBtn.Text = on and "Unequip" or "Equip"
                tpToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(55, 65, 85) or Color3.fromRGB(22, 24, 30)
                tpToggleBtn.TextColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(220, 225, 235) or Color3.fromRGB(130, 140, 160)
            end
            local function _buildTpTool()
                local tpTool = Instance.new("Tool")
                tpTool.Name           = "PrismTpTool"
                tpTool.ToolTip        = "Click to teleport"
                tpTool.RequiresHandle = true
                tpTool.GripPos        = Vector3.new(0, -0.4, 0)
                tpTool.GripForward    = Vector3.new(0, -1, 0)
                tpTool.GripRight      = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
                tpTool.GripUp         = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
                local handle = Instance.new("Part")
                handle.Name       = "Handle"
                handle.Size       = Vector3.new(0.28, 1.5, 0.28)
                handle.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Cyan")
                handle.Material   = Enum.Material.Neon
                handle.CanCollide = false
                handle.CastShadow = false
                handle.Parent     = tpTool
                local orb = Instance.new("Part")
                orb.Name       = "Tip"
                orb.Size       = Vector3.new(0.55, 0.55, 0.55)
                orb.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("White")
                orb.Material   = Enum.Material.Neon
                orb.CanCollide = false
                orb.CastShadow = false
                orb.Parent     = tpTool
                local tipWeld = Instance.new("Weld")
                tipWeld.Part0  = handle
                tipWeld.Part1  = orb
                tipWeld.C0     = CFrame.new(0, 0.9, 0)
                tipWeld.Parent = handle
                local glow = Instance.new("PointLight")
                glow.Color      = Color3.fromRGB(0, 210, 255)
                glow.Brightness = 5
                glow.Range      = 16
                glow.Parent     = orb
                local tpMouse = plr:GetMouse()
                local tpMarker, tpMarkerConn
                tpTool.Equipped:Connect(function()
                    tpMarker = Instance.new("Part")
                    tpMarker.Name         = "_PrismTpTarget"
                    tpMarker.Size         = Vector3.new(3.2, 0.1, 3.2)
                    tpMarker.BrickColor   = BrickColor.new("Cyan")
                    tpMarker.Material     = Enum.Material.Neon
                    tpMarker.Anchored     = true
                    tpMarker.CanCollide   = false
                    tpMarker.CanTouch     = false
                    tpMarker.CastShadow   = false
                    tpMarker.Transparency = 0.15
                    tpMarker.Parent       = workspace
                    tpMarkerConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                        local h = tpMouse.Hit
                        if h and tpMarker and tpMarker.Parent then
                            tpMarker.CFrame = CFrame.new(h.Position.X, h.Position.Y + 0.06, h.Position.Z)
                        end
                    end)
                    _tpSetOn(true)
                end)
                tpTool.Unequipped:Connect(function()
                    if tpMarkerConn then tpMarkerConn:Disconnect(); tpMarkerConn = nil end
                    if tpMarker and tpMarker.Parent then tpMarker:Destroy(); tpMarker = nil end
                    _tpSetOn(false)
                end)
                tpTool.Activated:Connect(function()
                    local char = plr.Character
                    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if not hrp then return end
                    local h = tpMouse.Hit
                    if h then
                        hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(h.Position.X, h.Position.Y + 3.5, h.Position.Z)
                    end
                end)
                return tpTool
            end
            tpToggleBtn = button(tpCard, _tpActive() and "Unequip" or "Equip", 230, 16, 90, 36, function()

                    note("Teleport Tool", "Equipped - click anywhere to teleport")

        -- Result display label

        aiResult.TextWrapped = true
        aiResult.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
        aiResult.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 180, 255)

        -- PICK toggle button
        local _aiPicking = false
        local _aiConn    = nil
        local aiBtn
        aiBtn = button(aiCard, "PICK", 590, 58, 86, 36, function()
            _aiPicking = not _aiPicking
            aiBtn.BackgroundColor3 = _aiPicking
                and Color3.fromRGB(55, 65, 85)
                or  Color3.fromRGB(22, 24, 30)
            aiBtn.TextColor3 = _aiPicking
                and Color3.fromRGB(220, 225, 235)
                or  Color3.fromRGB(130, 140, 160)
            aiBtn.Text = _aiPicking and "STOP" or "PICK"
            if _aiConn then _aiConn:Disconnect(); _aiConn = nil end
            if not _aiPicking then
                aiResult.Text = "Click PICK then click any part in the world"
                return
            end
            -- Connect a mouse click listener
            local UIS2 = game:GetService("UserInputService")
            _aiConn = UIS2.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp, gp)
                if gp then return end
                if inp.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end
                if not _aiPicking then return end
                local target = workspace.CurrentCamera
                local mouse  = lp:GetMouse()
                local hit    = mouse.Target
                if not hit then
                    aiResult.Text = "No part under cursor"
                    return
                end
                local pos  = hit.Position
                local sz   = hit.Size
                -- Find model root
                local root = hit
                while root.Parent and root.Parent ~= workspace
                    and not root.Parent:IsA("Model") == false do
                    if root.Parent:IsA("Model") then root = root.Parent; break end
                    root = root.Parent
                end
                local modelName = (root ~= hit) and root.Name or "(none)"
                aiResult.Text = string.format(
                    "Part: %s\nModel: %s\nPos  X:%.1f  Y:%.1f  Z:%.1f\nSize X:%.1f  Y:%.1f  Z:%.1f",
                    hit.Name, modelName,
                    pos.X, pos.Y, pos.Z,
                    sz.X, sz.Y, sz.Z
                )
                -- Stop picking after one hit
                _aiPicking = false
                aiBtn.Text = "PICK"
                aiBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(42, 46, 58)
                aiBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 225, 235)

            local idStr = boxId.Text
            local xStr  = boxX.Text
            local yStr  = boxY.Text
            local zStr  = boxZ.Text
            local asId  = tonumber(idStr)
            local ax    = tonumber(xStr) or 0
            local ay    = tonumber(yStr) or 0
            local az    = tonumber(zStr) or 0
            if not asId then
                note("Asset Inspector", "Enter a valid numeric asset ID first")
                return
            end
            note("Asset Inspector", "Loading " .. tostring(asId) .. "...")
            task.spawn(function()
                local model
                pcall(function()
                    local objs = game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. tostring(asId))
                    if objs and objs[1] then model = objs[1] end
                end)
                if not model then
                    pcall(function()
                        model = game:GetService("InsertService"):LoadAsset(asId)
                    end)
                end
                if model then
                    pcall(function()
                        if model.PrimaryPart then
                            model:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(CFrame.new(ax, ay, az))
                        else
                            model:MoveTo(Vector3.new(ax, ay, az))
                        end
                    end)
                    model.Parent = workspace
                    note("Asset Inspector", "Placed " .. tostring(asId) .. " at " ..
                        string.format("X:%.1f Y:%.1f Z:%.1f", ax, ay, az))
                else
                    note("Asset Inspector", "Could not load asset " .. tostring(asId))
                end
            end)
        end)

                local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

                    _G._VexFutureConn = nil

                    for _, c in ipairs(_G._VexShineHooks) do
                        pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
                    end
                end
                _G._VexShineHooks = {}
                for _, name in ipairs({ "VexoraFutureBloom", "VexoraFutureGrade", "VexoraFutureRays", "VexoraFutureAtmo", "VexoraFutureSky" }) do
                    local old = Lighting:FindFirstChild(name)

                if hud then hud:Destroy() end
                if _G._VexFutureParked then
                    for _, o in ipairs(_G._VexFutureParked) do
                        pcall(function()
                            if o and o.Parent == nil then o.Parent = Lighting end
                        end)
                    end
                    _G._VexFutureParked = nil
                end
            end
            dropFutureJunk()
            local function shinePart(p, ref)
                if not p:IsA("BasePart") then return end
                if p:FindFirstAncestor("PrismSkyLife") or p:FindFirstAncestor("PrismSkyMotion") then return end
                if p:GetAttribute("VexOldRef") == nil then
                    p:SetAttribute("VexOldRef", p.Reflectance)
                    p:SetAttribute("VexOldMat", p.Material.Name)
                end
                p.Reflectance = ref
                if p.Material == Enum.Material.Plastic then
                    p.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                end
            end
            local function shineChar(char)
                for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                    shinePart(d, 0.38)
                end
            end
            local function shineFloors()
                local n = 0
                for _, p in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                    if p:IsA("BasePart") then
                        local s = p.Size
                        local flat = s.Y <= 6 and s.X >= 8 and s.Z >= 8 and s.Y * 3 <= s.X and s.Y * 3 <= s.Z
                        local model = p:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
                        local person = model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                        if flat and not person and p.Transparency < 0.6 then
                            shinePart(p, 0.58)
                            n = n + 1
                            if n >= 280 then break end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            local function restoreShine()
                for _, p in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                    if p:IsA("BasePart") and p:GetAttribute("VexOldRef") ~= nil then
                        p.Reflectance = p:GetAttribute("VexOldRef")
                        local mat = p:GetAttribute("VexOldMat")
                        if mat then
                            pcall(function() p.Material = Enum.Material[mat] end)
                        end
                        p:SetAttribute("VexOldRef", nil)
                        p:SetAttribute("VexOldMat", nil)
                    end
                end
            end
            _G._PrismApplyFuture = function(on)
                local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
                local Players = game:GetService("Players")
                dropFutureJunk()
                if not on then
                    restoreShine()
                    local saved = _G._VexFutureSaved
                    if saved then
                        pcall(function()
                            Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = saved.spec
                            Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = saved.diff
                            Lighting.ExposureCompensation = saved.exp
                            if saved.soft ~= nil then Lighting.ShadowSoftness = saved.soft end
                        end)
                    end
                    _G._VexFutureSaved = nil
                    return
                end
                if not _G._VexFutureSaved then
                    local soft = 0
                    pcall(function() soft = Lighting.ShadowSoftness end)
                    _G._VexFutureSaved = {
                        spec = Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale,
                        diff = Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale,
                        exp = Lighting.ExposureCompensation,
                        soft = soft,
                    }
                end
                local savedNow = _G._VexFutureSaved
                local bloom = Instance.new("BloomEffect")
                bloom.Name = "VexoraFutureBloom"
                bloom.Intensity = 0.4
                bloom.Size = 24
                bloom.Threshold = 0.8
                bloom.Parent = Lighting
                local grade = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
                grade.Name = "VexoraFutureGrade"
                grade.Brightness = 0.03
                grade.Contrast = 0.15
                grade.Saturation = 0.05
                grade.TintColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 250, 245)
                grade.Parent = Lighting
                local rays = Instance.new("SunRaysEffect")
                rays.Name = "VexoraFutureRays"
                rays.Intensity = 0.045
                rays.Spread = 0.94
                rays.Parent = Lighting
                pcall(function()
                    Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = 1
                    Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = 1
                    Lighting.ExposureCompensation = math.clamp((savedNow.exp or 0) + 0.06, -1, 1)
                    Lighting.ShadowSoftness = 0.14
                    Lighting.GlobalShadows = true
                end)
                task.spawn(shineFloors)
                local function watch(plr)
                    local function onChar(char)
                        shineChar(char)
                        local con = char.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
                            if _G._PrismFuture then shinePart(d, 0.38) end
                        end)
                        table.insert(_G._VexShineHooks, con)
                    end
                    if plr.Character then onChar(plr.Character) end
                    table.insert(_G._VexShineHooks, plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(onChar))
                end
                for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                    watch(plr)
                end
                table.insert(_G._VexShineHooks, Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(watch))
            end
            if _G._PrismFuture then
                _G._PrismApplyFuture(true)
            end
            local futBtn
            futBtn = button(fcard, _G._PrismFuture and "ON" or "OFF", 530, 26, 130, 40, function()
                _G._PrismFuture = not _G._PrismFuture
                futBtn.Text = _G._PrismFuture and "ON" or "OFF"
                futBtn.BackgroundColor3 = _G._PrismFuture and Color3.fromRGB(55, 65, 85) or Color3.fromRGB(22, 24, 30)
                futBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 225, 235)
                _G._PrismApplyFuture(_G._PrismFuture)
                note("Futuristic", _G._PrismFuture and "ON" or "OFF")
            end)
        end)()

        _G._PrismTexBusy = false
        _G._PrismApplyLowTex = function(on)
            if _G._PrismTexBusy then return end
            _G._PrismTexBusy = true
            _G._PrismLowTex = on
            local texBtn = _G._PrismTexBtn
            if texBtn then
                texBtn.Text = on and "ON" or "OFF"
                texBtn.BackgroundColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(55, 65, 85) or Color3.fromRGB(22, 24, 30)
                texBtn.TextColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(220, 225, 235) or Color3.fromRGB(130, 140, 160)
            end
            task.spawn(function()
                local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
                local Players = game:GetService("Players")
                pcall(function()
                    settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = on and Enum.QualityLevel.Level01 or Enum.QualityLevel.Level21
                end)
                pcall(function()
                    UserSettings():GetService("UserGameSettings").SavedQualityLevel = on and Enum.SavedQualitySetting.QualityLevel1 or Enum.SavedQualitySetting.Automatic
                end)
                pcall(function() Lighting.GlobalShadows = not on end)
                pcall(function() workspace.Terrain.Decoration = not on end)
                local saved = _G._PrismTexSaved
                if on then
                    if type(saved) ~= "table" then
                        saved = {}
                        _G._PrismTexSaved = saved
                    end
                    local list = workspace:GetDescendants()
                    for i, d in ipairs(list) do
                        local model = d.FindFirstAncestorOfClass and d:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
                        local avatar = model and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
                        if not avatar then
                            if d:IsA("Decal") or d:IsA("Texture") then
                                if saved[d] == nil then saved[d] = {"t", d.Transparency} end
                                d.Transparency = 1
                            elseif d:IsA("MeshPart") then
                                if saved[d] == nil then saved[d] = {"mesh", d.TextureID} end
                                d.TextureID = ""
                            elseif d:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
                                if saved[d] == nil then saved[d] = {"sm", d.TextureId} end
                                d.TextureId = ""
                            elseif d:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
                                if saved[d] == nil then saved[d] = {"sa", d.Parent} end
                                d.Parent = nil
                            elseif d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or d:IsA("Trail") or d:IsA("Beam") or d:IsA("Smoke") or d:IsA("Fire") or d:IsA("Sparkles") then
                                if saved[d] == nil then saved[d] = {"en", d.Enabled} end
                                d.Enabled = false
                            elseif d:IsA("BasePart") and d.Material ~= Enum.Material.Neon and d.Material ~= Enum.Material.ForceField then
                                if saved[d] == nil then saved[d] = {"mat", d.Material, d.CastShadow} end
                                d.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                                d.CastShadow = false
                            end
                        end
                        if i % 250 == 0 then task.wait() end
                    end
                    if not _G._PrismTexConn then
                        _G._PrismTexConn = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
                            if not _G._PrismLowTex then return end
                            task.defer(function()
                                if not _G._PrismLowTex or not d.Parent then return end
                                local model = d.FindFirstAncestorOfClass and d:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
                                if model and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) then return end
                                local bag = _G._PrismTexSaved
                                if d:IsA("Decal") or d:IsA("Texture") then
                                    if bag and bag[d] == nil then bag[d] = {"t", d.Transparency} end
                                    d.Transparency = 1
                                elseif d:IsA("MeshPart") then
                                    if bag and bag[d] == nil then bag[d] = {"mesh", d.TextureID} end
                                    d.TextureID = ""
                                elseif d:IsA("BasePart") then
                                    d.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                                    d.CastShadow = false
                                end
                            end)
                        end)
                    end
                    note("Low Textures", "ON")
                else
                    if type(saved) == "table" then
                        for obj, info in pairs(saved) do
                            if typeof(obj) == "Instance" then
                                pcall(function()
                                    if info[1] == "t" then obj.Transparency = info[2]
                                    elseif info[1] == "mesh" then obj.TextureID = info[2]
                                    elseif info[1] == "sm" then obj.TextureId = info[2]
                                    elseif info[1] == "sa" and info[2] then obj.Parent = info[2]
                                    elseif info[1] == "en" then obj.Enabled = info[2]
                                    elseif info[1] == "mat" then obj.Material = info[2]; obj.CastShadow = info[3] end
                                end)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    _G._PrismTexSaved = {}
                    note("Low Textures", "OFF")
                end
                _G._PrismTexBusy = false
            end)
        end
        txt(pcard, "Low Textures", 16, 20, 176, 200, 28, true).ZIndex = 8
        local texHint = txt(pcard, "Strips map textures, decals, and shadows.", 12, 20, 204, 360, 18, false)
        texHint.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 110, 130); texHint.ZIndex = 8
        _G._PrismTexBtn = button(pcard, "OFF", 560, 180, 100, 36, function()
            _G._PrismApplyLowTex(not _G._PrismLowTex)
        end)
        if _G.PrismPerf and _G.PrismPerf.attach then
            _G.PrismPerf.attach(perf, note)
        end
        -- ============ Latency ============
        do
            local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
            local Players = game:GetService("Players")
            local Stats = game:GetService("Stats")
            local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
            local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
            local P = _G.PrismPerf
            local lat = card(perf, 8, 732, 692, 344)
            txt(lat, "Latency", 20, 20, 12, 400, 28, true).ZIndex = 8
            local ld = txt(lat, "Ping is the round trip to Roblox's server and nothing in a script can shorten it. This card removes the delay on your side and finds a closer server.", 13, 20, 40, 650, 34, false)
            ld.TextWrapped = true
            ld.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
            ld.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 140, 160)
            ld.ZIndex = 8

            local tiles = {}
            local function tile(i, title)
                local f = Instance.new("Frame")
                f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20 + (i - 1) * 166, 84)
                f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(156, 58)
                f.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 14, 18)
                f.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
                f.BorderSizePixel = 0
                f.ZIndex = 8
                f.Parent = lat
                corner(f, 10)
                local t = txt(f, title, 11, 12, 6, 130, 14, false)
                t.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 150, 160)
                t.ZIndex = 9
                local v = txt(f, "--", 22, 12, 24, 134, 28, true)
                v.ZIndex = 9
                tiles[#tiles + 1] = v
                return v
            end
            local vPing = tile(1, "PING")
            local vJit = tile(2, "JITTER")
            local vFps = tile(3, "FPS")
            local vFrm = tile(4, "FRAME TIME")
            local rating = txt(lat, "Measuring...", 13, 20, 150, 650, 20, true)
            rating.ZIndex = 8

            local status = txt(lat, "", 12, 20, 288, 650, 48, false)
            status.TextWrapped = true
            status.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
            status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 170, 185)
            status.ZIndex = 8

            -- live numbers
            local fpsAvg, frameMs = 60, 16.7
            local pings = {}
            if _G._PrismLatConn then pcall(function() _G._PrismLatConn:Disconnect() end) end
            _G._PrismLatConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
                if not lat.Parent then
                    if _G._PrismLatConn then _G._PrismLatConn:Disconnect(); _G._PrismLatConn = nil end
                    return
                end
                if dt > 0 then
                    fpsAvg = fpsAvg + (1 / dt - fpsAvg) * 0.06
                    frameMs = frameMs + (dt * 1000 - frameMs) * 0.06
                end
            end)
            local function readPing()
                local ms
                pcall(function() ms = Stats.Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue() end)
                if type(ms) ~= "number" or ms <= 0 then
                    pcall(function() ms = lp:GetNetworkPing() * 1000 end)
                end
                if type(ms) == "number" and ms > 0 then return ms end
                return nil
            end
            task.spawn(function()
                while lat.Parent do
                    local ms = readPing()
                    if ms then
                        pings[#pings + 1] = ms
                        if #pings > 20 then table.remove(pings, 1) end
                        local sum = 0
                        for _, v in ipairs(pings) do sum = sum + v end
                        local mean = sum / #pings
                        local var = 0
                        for _, v in ipairs(pings) do var = var + (v - mean) ^ 2 end
                        local jit = math.sqrt(var / #pings)
                        vPing.Text = string.format("%d ms", math.floor(ms + 0.5))
                        vJit.Text = string.format("%.0f ms", jit)
                        local word, col
                        if ms < 60 then word, col = "Excellent. You're close to the server.", Color3.fromRGB(140, 230, 90)
                        elseif ms < 100 then word, col = "Good.", Color3.fromRGB(180, 230, 90)
                        elseif ms < 150 then word, col = "Fair. You may feel a little delay.", Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 60)
                        elseif ms < 250 then word, col = "Laggy. A closer server would help a lot.", Color3.fromRGB(190, 160, 70)
                        else word, col = "Bad. Try the low-ping server finder below.", Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 70) end
                        if jit > 25 then word = word .. "  Connection is unstable (jitter is high)." end
                        rating.Text = word
                        rating.TextColor3 = col
                    else
                        vPing.Text = "--"
                        vJit.Text = "--"
                        rating.Text = "Ping not available in this game."
                    end
                    vFps.Text = string.format("%d", math.floor(fpsAvg + 0.5))
                    vFrm.Text = string.format("%.1f ms", frameMs)
                    task.wait(0.5)
                end
            end)

            -- Zero Delay
            local zd = { on = false, did = {}, prevCap = 60 }
            local zdBtn
            local function paintZd()
                if not zdBtn then return end
                zdBtn.Text = zd.on and "Zero Delay: ON" or "Zero Delay: OFF"
                zdBtn.BackgroundColor3 = zd.on and Color3.fromRGB(55, 180, 90) or Color3.fromRGB(22, 24, 30)
            end
            local function setZero(on)
                if on == zd.on then return end
                if on then
                    zd.prevCap = _G._PrismCapShown
                    if zd.prevCap == nil then zd.prevCap = 60 end
                    if _G.PrismSetFPSCap then pcall(_G.PrismSetFPSCap, 0) end
                    pcall(pHighlight, 0)
                    zd.did = {}
                    if P and P.apply then
                        for _, id in ipairs({ "shadows", "particles", "effects" }) do
                            if not P.on[id] then
                                zd.did[id] = true
                                pcall(P.apply, id, true)
                            end
                        end
                        pcall(P.paint)
                    end
                    pcall(function() settings().Network.IncomingReplicationLag = 0 end)
                    pcall(function()
                        local r = settings().Rendering
                        zd.q = r.QualityLevel
                        r.QualityLevel = Enum.QualityLevel.Level01
                    end)
                    zd.on = true
                    status.Text = "Zero Delay is on: FPS uncapped, shadows, particles and effects off, graphics at the lowest level, replication lag 0. Your ping doesn't change, but what you see and press reacts sooner."
                else
                    if P and P.apply then
                        for id in pairs(zd.did) do pcall(P.apply, id, false) end
                        pcall(P.paint)
                    end
                    zd.did = {}
                    pcall(function()
                        if zd.q ~= nil then settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = zd.q end
                    end)
                    if _G.PrismSetFPSCap then pcall(_G.PrismSetFPSCap, zd.prevCap) end
                    pcall(pHighlight, zd.prevCap)
                    zd.on = false
                    status.Text = "Zero Delay is off. Everything is back how it was."
                end
                paintZd()
            end
            zdBtn = button(lat, "Zero Delay: OFF", 20, 190, 210, 38, function() setZero(not zd.on) end)
            button(lat, "Clean Memory", 242, 190, 150, 38, function()
                local before = collectgarbage("count")
                collectgarbage("collect")
                collectgarbage("collect")
                local after = collectgarbage("count")
                status.Text = string.format("Script memory: %.1f MB to %.1f MB (freed %.1f MB).", before / 1024, after / 1024, math.max(0, before - after) / 1024)
            end)

            -- low-ping server finder
            local best = nil
            local searching = false
            local function httpGet(url)
                local req = http_request or request or (syn and syn.request) or (fluxus and fluxus.request)
                if type(req) == "function" then
                    local ok, res = pcall(req, { Url = url, Method = "GET" })
                    if ok and type(res) == "table" and res.Body and (res.Success or res.StatusCode == 200) then
                        return res.Body
                    end
                end
                local ok, body = pcall(function() return game:HttpGet(url) end)
                if ok and type(body) == "string" then return body end
                return nil
            end
            button(lat, "Find Low-Ping Server", 20, 238, 230, 38, function()
                if searching then return end
                searching = true
                best = nil
                status.Text = "Looking through public servers..."
                task.spawn(function()
                    local cursor = ""
                    local found, withPing, scanned = nil, 0, 0
                    for page = 1, 3 do
                        local url = "https://games.roblox.com/v1/games/" .. tostring(game.PlaceId) .. "/servers/Public?sortOrder=Asc&excludeFullGames=true&limit=100"
                        if cursor ~= "" then url = url .. "&cursor=" .. cursor end
                        local body = httpGet(url)
                        if not body then break end
                        local ok, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(body) end)
                        if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" or type(data.data) ~= "table" then break end
                        for _, sv in ipairs(data.data) do
                            scanned = scanned + 1
                            if sv.id ~= game.JobId and type(sv.ping) == "number" and sv.playing and sv.maxPlayers and sv.playing < sv.maxPlayers - 1 then
                                withPing = withPing + 1
                                if not found or sv.ping < found.ping then found = sv end
                            end
                        end
                        if type(data.nextPageCursor) ~= "string" then break end
                        cursor = data.nextPageCursor
                        task.wait(0.4)
                    end
                    local mine = readPing() or 0
                    if scanned == 0 then
                        status.Text = "Couldn't reach Roblox's server list from here. Your executor may block web requests."
                    elseif not found then
                        status.Text = "Checked " .. scanned .. " servers but none reported a ping. Roblox only shares it for some games."
                    elseif mine > 0 and found.ping >= mine * 0.85 then
                        status.Text = string.format("Checked %d servers. The best one is %d ms and you're at %d ms, so there's nothing worth switching to.", scanned, math.floor(found.ping + 0.5), math.floor(mine + 0.5))
                    else
                        best = found
                        status.Text = string.format("Found a server at about %d ms (%d/%d players). You're at %d ms. Press Join Best to move. The script has to be run again after you land.", math.floor(found.ping + 0.5), math.floor(found.playing), math.floor(found.maxPlayers), math.floor(mine + 0.5))
                    end
                    searching = false
                end)
            end)
            button(lat, "Join Best", 262, 238, 150, 38, function()
                if not best then
                    status.Text = "Find a server first."
                    return
                end
                status.Text = "Teleporting..."
                local ok, err = pcall(function()
                    game:GetService("TeleportService"):TeleportToPlaceInstance(game.PlaceId, best.id, lp)
                end)
                if not ok then status.Text = "Teleport failed: " .. tostring(err) end
            end)
        end

        end
        buildPerfPage()

        -- ============ Turn On  (morph into another player) ============
        local function buildTurnPage()
        local turnPage = page()
        pages.TurnOn = turnPage
        local turnPick = nil
        local function micApi()
            return _G.PrismMicUp or (getgenv and getgenv().PrismMicUp)
        end
        local tc = card(turnPage, 8, 8, 692, 152)
        txt(tc, "Turn On", 22, 22, 16, 400, 30, true).ZIndex = 8
        local tdesc = txt(tc, "Turn yourself into another player so your own nametag becomes clickable. Pick who to become, then flip the switch.", 14, 22, 52, 620, 40, false)
        tdesc.TextWrapped = true
        tdesc.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 140, 160)
        tdesc.ZIndex = 8
        local tStatus = txt(tc, "Off", 14, 22, 104, 360, 24, true)
        tStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)
        tStatus.ZIndex = 8
        local tToggle
        tToggle = button(tc, "Turn On", 470, 98, 200, 40, function()
            local api = micApi()
            if not api then note("Turn On", "Nametags not loaded yet"); return end
            local st = api.morphState and api.morphState()
            if st and st.on then
                api.morphRestore()
                tStatus.Text = "Off"
                tStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)
                tToggle.Text = "Turn On"
                note("Turn On", "Restored your avatar")
            else
                local target = turnPick
                if not target or target == plr or not target.Parent then
                    local others = {}
                    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                        if p ~= plr then others[#others + 1] = p end
                    end
                    target = others[math.random(1, math.max(1, #others))]
                end
                if not target then note("Turn On", "No other players to become"); return end
                local ok = api.morphInto(target)
                if ok then
                    tStatus.Text = "On as " .. target.DisplayName
                    tStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 230, 140)
                    tToggle.Text = "Turn Off"
                    note("Turn On", "You are now " .. target.DisplayName)
                else
                    note("Turn On", "Could not morph")
                end
            end
        end)

        local tPick = card(turnPage, 8, 172, 692, 372)
        txt(tPick, "Become", 18, 18, 12, 300, 24, true).ZIndex = 8
        local tScroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")

            if type(g.EmoteHubSetVisible) == "function" then
                g.EmoteHubSetVisible(false)
            end
        end)

        -- ── Now playing: how long the emote / keyframe is ─────────────

        npName.ZIndex = 8

        npTime.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
        npTime.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 140, 160)
        npTime.ZIndex = 8

        npBack.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 46)
        npBack.Size = UDim2.new(1, -36, 0, 5)
        npBack.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(46, 28, 34)

        npBack.ZIndex = 8
        npBack.Parent = npc
        corner(npBack, UDim.new(1, 0))
        local npFill = Instance.new("Frame")
        npFill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
        npFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 120)
        npFill.BorderSizePixel = 0
        npFill.ZIndex = 9

        corner(npFill, UDim.new(1, 0))
        task.spawn(function()
            while npc.Parent do
                local ok, n = pcall(_G._PrismGetNow)
                if ok and n then
                    npName.Text = n.name
                    local t = _G._PrismFmtLen(n.t) .. " / " .. _G._PrismFmtLen(n.len)
                    if n.frames then t = t .. "   ·   " .. tostring(n.frames) .. " keyframes" end
                    if n.speed and math.abs(n.speed - 1) > 0.01 then t = t .. "   ·   " .. string.format("%.2gx", n.speed) end
                    npTime.Text = t
                    npFill.Size = UDim2.new(math.clamp(n.t / math.max(n.len, 0.001), 0, 1), 0, 1, 0)
                else
                    npName.Text = "Nothing playing"
                    npTime.Text = ""
                    npFill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
                end
                task.wait(0.1)
            end

        -- == Player Sync card ==============================================================
        local syncCard = card(rePage, 8, 506, 692, 218)
        txt(syncCard, "Player Sync", 20, 22, 14, 400, 28, true).ZIndex = 8
        local syncDesc = txt(syncCard, "Mirror a player's emotes and teleport with them anywhere on the map in real time.", 13, 22, 46, 620, 36, false)
        syncDesc.TextWrapped = true
        syncDesc.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 140, 160)
        syncDesc.ZIndex = 8

        -- Target picker row
        txt(syncCard, "Target:", 12, 22, 92, 56, 18, true).TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 160, 200)
        local syncPickName = txt(syncCard, "nobody", 13, 84, 91, 280, 20, true)
        syncPickName.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 160)
        syncPickName.ZIndex = 8

        local function getSyncPlayers()
            local Players = game:GetService("Players")
            local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
            local out = {}
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if p ~= lp then out[#out+1] = p end
            end
            return out
        end

        local syncPickIdx = {1}
        local function refreshPick()
            local list = getSyncPlayers()
            if #list == 0 then syncPickName.Text = "nobody" return end
            if syncPickIdx[1] > #list then syncPickIdx[1] = 1 end
            local p = list[syncPickIdx[1]]
            syncPickName.Text = p.DisplayName .. " (@" .. p.Name .. ")"
        end
        refreshPick()

        local function arrowBtn(label, px, py)
            local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
            b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 22)
            b.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(px, py)
            b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(75, 28, 52)
            b.Text = label
            b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            b.TextSize = 13
            b.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 190, 220)
            b.BorderSizePixel = 0
            b.ZIndex = 9
            b.Parent = syncCard
            corner(b, 5)
            return b
        end
        local prevP = arrowBtn("<", 368, 90)
        local nextP = arrowBtn(">", 396, 90)
        prevP.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            local list = getSyncPlayers()
            if #list == 0 then return end
            syncPickIdx[1] = ((syncPickIdx[1] - 2) % #list) + 1
            refreshPick()
        end)
        nextP.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            local list = getSyncPlayers()
            if #list == 0 then return end
            syncPickIdx[1] = (syncPickIdx[1] % #list) + 1
            refreshPick()
        end)

        -- Emotes / Follow toggles
        local doSyncEmotes = {true}
        local doSyncFollow = {true}

        local function toggleBtn(label, px, py, onColor)
            local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
            b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(116, 28)
            b.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(px, py)
            b.BackgroundColor3 = onColor
            b.Text = label .. "  ON"

            b.BorderSizePixel = 0
            b.ZIndex = 9
            b.Parent = syncCard

            return b
        end

        local emoteTgl = toggleBtn("Emotes", 22, 124, Color3.fromRGB(52, 160, 90))
        local followTgl = toggleBtn("Follow", 146, 124, Color3.fromRGB(52, 130, 190))

        emoteTgl.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            doSyncEmotes[1] = not doSyncEmotes[1]
            emoteTgl.Text = "Emotes  " .. (doSyncEmotes[1] and "ON" or "OFF")
            emoteTgl.BackgroundColor3 = doSyncEmotes[1] and Color3.fromRGB(52, 160, 90) or Color3.fromRGB(70, 45, 60)
        end)
        followTgl.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            doSyncFollow[1] = not doSyncFollow[1]
            followTgl.Text = "Follow  " .. (doSyncFollow[1] and "ON" or "OFF")
            followTgl.BackgroundColor3 = doSyncFollow[1] and Color3.fromRGB(52, 130, 190) or Color3.fromRGB(45, 55, 80)
        end)

        -- Start / Stop button and status
        local syncActive = {false}
        local syncGen   = {nil}
        local syncMirror = {nil}

        local syncBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        syncBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(152, 36)
        syncBtn.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 164)
        syncBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 38, 70)
        syncBtn.Text = "Start Sync"
        syncBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        syncBtn.TextSize = 14
        syncBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 220)
        syncBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
        syncBtn.ZIndex = 9
        syncBtn.Parent = syncCard
        corner(syncBtn, 8)

        local syncStatus = txt(syncCard, "Idle", 12, 184, 173, 490, 20, false)
        syncStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(155, 135, 175)
        syncStatus.ZIndex = 8

        local function stopSync()
            syncActive[1] = false
            syncGen[1] = nil
            if syncMirror[1] then
                pcall(function() syncMirror[1]:Stop(0.2) end)
                syncMirror[1] = nil
            end
        end

        syncBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if syncActive[1] then
                stopSync()
                syncBtn.Text = "Start Sync"
                syncBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 38, 70)
                syncStatus.Text = "Stopped."
                return
            end

            local list = getSyncPlayers()
            if #list == 0 then syncStatus.Text = "No other players in the server."; return end
            if syncPickIdx[1] > #list then syncPickIdx[1] = 1 end
            local target = list[syncPickIdx[1]]
            if not target or not target.Character then
                syncStatus.Text = "That player has no character right now."
                return
            end

            syncActive[1] = true
            local gen = {}
            syncGen[1] = gen
            syncBtn.Text = "Stop Sync"
            syncBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(190, 38, 55)
            syncStatus.Text = "Syncing with " .. target.DisplayName .. "..."

            task.spawn(function()
                local Players = game:GetService("Players")
                local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
                local lastAnimId = ""

                while syncActive[1] and syncGen[1] == gen and syncCard.Parent do
                    if not target or not target.Parent then
                        syncStatus.Text = target.DisplayName .. " left the game. Stopped."
                        stopSync()
                        syncBtn.Text = "Start Sync"
                        syncBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 38, 70)
                        break
                    end

                    local char  = lp.Character
                    local tchar = target.Character

                    if char and tchar then
                        local hrp  = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        local thrp = tchar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        local hum  = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                        local thum = tchar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

                        -- Follow movement: teleport to target's exact position
                        if doSyncFollow[1] and hrp and thrp then
                            pcall(function() hrp.CFrame = thrp.CFrame end)
                        end

                        -- Emote mirror: watch target's Action-priority anim track
                        if doSyncEmotes[1] and thum and hum then
                            local tan = thum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
                            if tan then
                                local emoteId = ""
                                for _, tr in ipairs(tan:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
                                    if tr.Priority == Enum.AnimationPriority.Action then
                                        emoteId = tostring(tr.Animation.AnimationId)
                                        break
                                    end
                                end

                                if emoteId ~= lastAnimId then
                                    lastAnimId = emoteId
                                    -- Stop old mirror
                                    if syncMirror[1] then
                                        pcall(function() syncMirror[1]:Stop(0.2) end)
                                        syncMirror[1] = nil
                                    end
                                    -- Load + play new emote
                                    if emoteId ~= "" then
                                        local an = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
                                        if an then
                                            local a = Instance.new("Animation")
                                            a.AnimationId = emoteId
                                            local ok, t = pcall(function() return an:LoadAnimation(a) end)
                                            if ok and t then
                                                t.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
                                                t.Looped = true
                                                pcall(function() t:Play(0.25) end)
                                                syncMirror[1] = t
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    task.wait(0.05)
                end

                -- Final cleanup
                if syncMirror[1] then
                    pcall(function() syncMirror[1]:Stop(0.2) end)
                    syncMirror[1] = nil
                end
            end)
        end)
        end
        pcall(buildReanimPage)

        -- ======== Worlds / Custom Island ========
        local function buildWorldsPage()
        local worlds = page()
        pages.Worlds = worlds
        local _worldSavedPos = nil
        local _islandFolder = nil

        local hd = card(worlds, 8, 8, 692, 78)
        txt(hd, "Worlds", 22, 20, 14, 400, 30, true).ZIndex = 8
        local hdSub = txt(hd, "Travel to the custom island and return at any time.", 13, 20, 50, 560, 22, false)
        hdSub.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 140, 160); hdSub.ZIndex = 8

        txt(paCard, "Parallax Island", 18, 20, 14, 400, 26, true).ZIndex = 8
        local paDesc = txt(paCard, "A custom built island: grass terrain, hills, trees, a fountain, jump pads, a watchtower and a rainbow bridge. Position is saved before entry.", 13, 20, 46, 650, 36, false)
        paDesc.TextWrapped = true; paDesc.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 140, 160); paDesc.ZIndex = 8

        button(paCard, "Enter Island", 500, 20, 174, 40, function()
            task.spawn(function()
                paStatus.Text = "Building island..."
                paStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 70)
                local ok, err = pcall(function()
                    local chr = plr.Character
                    local hrp = chr and chr:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if hrp then _worldSavedPos = hrp.Position end

                    if _islandFolder then pcall(function() _islandFolder:Destroy() end) end
                    local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
                    folder.Name = "ParallaxIsland"
                    folder.Parent = workspace
                    _islandFolder = folder

                    local off = Vector3.new(50000, 500, 50000)
                    local terr = workspace.Terrain

                    terr:FillCylinder(CFrame.new(off), 12, 150, Enum.Material.Grass)
                    terr:FillSphere(CFrame.new(off + Vector3.new(0, 10, 0)), 60, Enum.Material.Grass)
                    terr:FillSphere(CFrame.new(off + Vector3.new(70, 2, 40)), 40, Enum.Material.Grass)
                    terr:FillSphere(CFrame.new(off + Vector3.new(-60, 0, -50)), 35, Enum.Material.Grass)
                    terr:FillSphere(CFrame.new(off + Vector3.new(50, -2, -70)), 30, Enum.Material.Grass)
                    terr:FillCylinder(CFrame.new(off + Vector3.new(0, -4, 0)), 8, 165, Enum.Material.Sand)
                    terr:FillCylinder(CFrame.new(off + Vector3.new(0, -8, 0)), 10, 250, Enum.Material.Water)
                    terr:FillCylinder(CFrame.new(off + Vector3.new(0, -18, 0)), 20, 148, Enum.Material.Rock)
                    task.wait(0.1)

                    local function mkpart(sz, cf, mat, col)
                        local p = Instance.new("Part")
                        p.Anchored = true
                        p.CanCollide = true
                        p.Size = sz
                        p.CFrame = cf
                        p.Material = mat or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                        p.BrickColor = BrickColor.new(col or "Medium stone grey")
                        p.Parent = folder
                        return p
                    end

                    local treePoses = {
                        {20,5,15},{-35,2,25},{10,8,-30},{-20,3,-15},
                        {45,1,-10},{-55,0,10},{30,1,-55},{-30,0,55},{65,0,30},{-70,0,-30}
                    }
                    for _, tp in ipairs(treePoses) do
                        local tx, ty, tz = tp[1], tp[2], tp[3]
                        local h = 7 + (tx * tz) % 7
                        mkpart(Vector3.new(1.8, h, 1.8),
                            CFrame.new(off + Vector3.new(tx, ty + h/2 + 2, tz)),
                            Enum.Material.Wood, "Reddish brown")
                        local ls = Instance.new("Part")
                        ls.Anchored = true; ls.CanCollide = false
                        ls.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
                        ls.Size = Vector3.new(10, 10, 10)
                        ls.CFrame = CFrame.new(off + Vector3.new(tx, ty + h + 7, tz))
                        ls.Material = Enum.Material.Grass
                        ls.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright green")
                        ls.Parent = folder
                        local ls2 = ls:Clone()
                        ls2.Size = Vector3.new(7, 7, 7)
                        ls2.CFrame = CFrame.new(off + Vector3.new(tx + 1, ty + h + 5, tz + 1))
                        ls2.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Dark green")
                        ls2.Parent = folder
                    end

                    mkpart(Vector3.new(22, 2, 22),
                        CFrame.new(off + Vector3.new(0, 16, 0)),
                        Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, "Light stone grey")

                    mkpart(Vector3.new(10, 1.5, 10),
                        CFrame.new(off + Vector3.new(0, 17.5, 0)),
                        Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, "White")
                    mkpart(Vector3.new(1.5, 5, 1.5),
                        CFrame.new(off + Vector3.new(0, 20.5, 0)),
                        Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, "Light stone grey")
                    mkpart(Vector3.new(5, 1, 5),
                        CFrame.new(off + Vector3.new(0, 23.5, 0)),
                        Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, "White")
                    terr:FillCylinder(CFrame.new(off + Vector3.new(0, 17.6, 0)), 1, 4, Enum.Material.Water)

                    local padData = {
                        {-40,5,0,"Bright red"},{40,5,0,"Bright blue"},
                        {0,5,-40,"Bright yellow"},{0,5,40,"Bright green"}
                    }
                    for _, pd in ipairs(padData) do
                        local pad = mkpart(Vector3.new(8, 1, 8),
                            CFrame.new(off + Vector3.new(pd[1], pd[2], pd[3])),
                            Enum.Material.Neon, pd[4])
                        pad.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
                            pcall(function()
                                local hum = hit.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
                                if hum then
                                    local hrpT = hit.Parent:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                                    if hrpT then
                                        local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
                                        bv.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 80, 0)
                                        bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(0, 1e6, 0)
                                        bv.Parent = hrpT
                                        game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(bv, 0.12)
                                    end
                                end
                            end)
                        end)
                    end

                    mkpart(Vector3.new(8, 24, 8),
                        CFrame.new(off + Vector3.new(-75, 14, -60)),
                        Enum.Material.Brick, "Medium stone grey")
                    mkpart(Vector3.new(12, 1.5, 12),
                        CFrame.new(off + Vector3.new(-75, 26.5, -60)),
                        Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, "Dark stone grey")
                    mkpart(Vector3.new(2, 3, 0.5),
                        CFrame.new(off + Vector3.new(-75, 18, -56)),
                        Enum.Material.Neon, "Bright blue")

                    local rbCols = {"Bright red","Bright orange","Bright yellow","Bright green","Bright blue","Medium blue","Magenta"}
                    for i = 1, 7 do
                        local ang = (i/8) * math.pi
                        local bx = math.cos(ang) * 50
                        local by = math.sin(ang) * 15 + 18
                        mkpart(Vector3.new(10, 2, 10),
                            CFrame.new(off + Vector3.new(bx - 25, by, -80)),
                            Enum.Material.Neon, rbCols[i])
                    end

                    for i = 1, 5 do
                        mkpart(Vector3.new(6, 1, 6),
                            CFrame.new(off + Vector3.new(60 + i * 12, 10 + i * 4, 60)),
                            Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, i % 2 == 0 and "Bright orange" or "Light stone grey")
                    end

                    task.wait(0.3)
                    local chr2 = plr.Character
                    local hrp2 = chr2 and chr2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if hrp2 then hrp2.CFrame = CFrame.new(off + Vector3.new(0, 20, 0)) end
                end)
                if ok then
                    paStatus.Text = "On the island!"
                    paStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 230, 90)
                    note("Worlds", "Arrived at Parallax Island")
                else
                    paStatus.Text = "Error: " .. tostring(err):sub(1, 50)
                    paStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
                end
            end)
        end)

        local retCard = card(worlds, 8, 234, 692, 78)
        txt(retCard, "Return to World", 18, 20, 14, 400, 26, true).ZIndex = 8
        local retDesc = txt(retCard, "Teleport back to your saved position in the original world.", 13, 20, 46, 560, 22, false)
        retDesc.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 140, 160); retDesc.ZIndex = 8

        button(retCard, "Return", 578, 20, 100, 40, function()
            pcall(function()
                local chr = plr.Character
                local hrp = chr and chr:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if hrp and _worldSavedPos then
                    hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(_worldSavedPos)
                    note("Worlds", "Returned to the original world")
                else
                    note("Worlds", "No saved position - enter the island first")
