        -- ======== Spectate players ========
        local function buildSpectatePage()
        local spectate = page()
        pages.Spectate = spectate

        local shd = card(spectate, 8, 8, 692, 60)
        txt(shd, "Spectate", 20, 20, 14, 300, 28, true).ZIndex = 8
        local shdSub = txt(shd, "Lock your camera onto any player in real time.", 13, 20, 38, 500, 18, false)
        shdSub.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 140, 160); shdSub.ZIndex = 8

        local infoCard = card(spectate, 8, 78, 692, 110)
        local spLbl = txt(infoCard, "Press Start to watch a player.", 15, 20, 20, 630, 24, true)
        spLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 100); spLbl.ZIndex = 8
        local spSub = txt(infoCard, "Your camera locks directly onto the target third-person.", 13, 20, 50, 630, 20, false)
        spSub.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 140, 160); spSub.ZIndex = 8
        local spNote = txt(infoCard, "Tip: press Stop before closing or switching pages.", 12, 20, 76, 630, 20, false)
        spNote.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 140, 190); spNote.ZIndex = 8

        local ctrlCard = card(spectate, 8, 198, 692, 70)
        local sIdx = {1}
        local sState = {conn = nil, active = false, origType = nil}

        local function spClean()
            sState.active = false
            if sState.conn then pcall(function() sState.conn:Disconnect() end); sState.conn = nil end
            pcall(function()
                local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
                if sState.origType then cam.CameraType = sState.origType end
                sState.origType = nil
            end)
            spLbl.Text = "Stopped. Camera restored."
            spLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 140, 160)
        end

        local function spStart()
            spClean()
            local targets = {}
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if p ~= plr then targets[#targets + 1] = p end
            end
            if #targets == 0 then
                spLbl.Text = "No other players in this server."
                spLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
                return
            end
            local idx = ((sIdx[1] - 1) % #targets) + 1
            sIdx[1] = idx
            local target = targets[idx]
            spLbl.Text = "Watching: " .. tostring(target.DisplayName) .. " (@" .. tostring(target.Name) .. ")"
            spLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 230, 255)
            sState.active = true
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            sState.origType = cam.CameraType
            cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
            sState.conn = game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped:Connect(function()
                if not sState.active then return end
                pcall(function()
                    local chr = target.Character
                    local hrp = chr and chr:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if not hrp then return end
                    local back = hrp.CFrame.LookVector * -10 + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
                    cam.CFrame = CFrame.new(hrp.Position + back, hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0))
                end)
            end)
        end

        button(ctrlCard, "< Prev", 16, 14, 110, 40, function() sIdx[1] = sIdx[1] - 1; spStart() end)
        button(ctrlCard, "Next >", 138, 14, 110, 40, function() sIdx[1] = sIdx[1] + 1; spStart() end)
        button(ctrlCard, "Start", 260, 14, 110, 40, function() spStart() end)
        button(ctrlCard, "Stop", 382, 14, 110, 40, function() spClean() end)

        spectate:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
            if not spectate.Visible then spClean() end
        end)

        end
        pcall(buildSpectatePage)

        --========================================================
        -- Custom animated cursor engine
        -- Everything here is drawn by the script itself (Frames/UIStroke/
        -- UICorner, animated every frame) -- no external images, no
        -- downloads, nothing scraped from anywhere. "Custom image" lets you
        -- plug in your own rbxassetid on top of that.
        --========================================================
        local cursorConn
        local cursorGui, cursorRoot

        local function clearCursor()
            if cursorConn then pcall(function() cursorConn:Disconnect() end) cursorConn = nil end
            if cursorGui then pcall(function() cursorGui:Destroy() end) cursorGui = nil end
            cursorRoot = nil
            _G._PrismCursorStyle = nil
            pcall(function() UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true end)
        end

        local CURSOR_COLORS = {
            Red    = Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70),
            Blue   = Color3.fromRGB(80, 160, 255),
            Green  = Color3.fromRGB(90, 230, 130),
            Purple = Color3.fromRGB(190, 110, 255),
            Gold   = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 70),
            Cyan   = Color3.fromRGB(80, 230, 230),
            Pink   = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 190),
            White  = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 245),
        }

        local function curFrame(parent, size, color, transp)
            local f = Instance.new("Frame")
            f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            f.Size = size
            f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
            f.BackgroundColor3 = color
            f.BackgroundTransparency = transp or 0
            f.BorderSizePixel = 0
            f.Parent = parent
            return f
        end
        local function curCorner(f, radius)
            local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
            c.CornerRadius = radius or UDim.new(1, 0)
            c.Parent = f
            return c
        end
        local function curRing(parent, diameter, thickness, color)
            local ring = curFrame(parent, UDim2.fromOffset(diameter, diameter), color, 1)
            curCorner(ring)
            local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
            s.Thickness = thickness
            s.Color = color
            s.Transparency = 0.15
            s.Parent = ring
            return ring, s
        end
        local function curTrailPiece(parentGui, screenPos, color, zIndex)
            local piece = Instance.new("Frame")
            piece.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            piece.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6)
            piece.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y)
            piece.BackgroundColor3 = color
            piece.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
            piece.BorderSizePixel = 0
            piece.ZIndex = zIndex
            piece.Parent = parentGui
            curCorner(piece)
            task.spawn(function()
                for i = 1, 10 do
                    if not piece.Parent then return end
                    piece.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2 + (i / 10) * 0.8
                    piece.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6 * (1 - i / 12), 6 * (1 - i / 12))
                    task.wait(0.02)
                end
                pcall(function() piece:Destroy() end)
            end)
        end

        -- Each builder takes (root, color) and returns update(dt, screenPos),
        -- called every RenderStepped frame while this style is active.
        local function buildRingPulse(root, color)
            local ring, strokeObj = curRing(root, 26, 2.5, color)
            local dot = curFrame(root, UDim2.fromOffset(5, 5), color, 0)
            curCorner(dot)
            local t = 0
            return function(dt)
                t = t + dt
                local pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(t * 3)
                ring.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22 + pulse * 10, 22 + pulse * 10)
                strokeObj.Transparency = 0.1 + pulse * 0.35
                root.Rotation = t * 40
            end
        end
        local function buildReticle(root, color)
            local dot = curFrame(root, UDim2.fromOffset(4, 4), color, 0) -- center dot
            curCorner(dot)
            local brackets = {}
            for i, c in ipairs({ { -1, -1 }, { 1, -1 }, { -1, 1 }, { 1, 1 } }) do
                local h = Instance.new("Frame")
                h.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                h.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 2)
                h.BackgroundColor3 = color
                h.BorderSizePixel = 0
                h.Parent = root
                local v = Instance.new("Frame")
                v.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                v.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 8)
                v.BackgroundColor3 = color
                v.BorderSizePixel = 0
                v.Parent = root
                brackets[i] = { h = h, v = v, bx = c[1], by = c[2] }
            end
            local t = 0
            return function(dt)
                t = t + dt
                local spread = 14 + 4 * math.sin(t * 2.4)
                for _, b in ipairs(brackets) do
                    local cx, cy = b.bx * spread, b.by * spread
                    b.h.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, cx + b.bx * 3, 0.5, cy)
                    b.v.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, cx, 0.5, cy + b.by * 3)
                end
            end
        end
        local function buildComet(root, color)
            local head = curFrame(root, UDim2.fromOffset(7, 7), color, 0)
            curCorner(head)
            local parentGui = root.Parent
            local spawnAcc = 0
            return function(dt, screenPos)
                spawnAcc = spawnAcc + dt
                if spawnAcc >= 0.025 and screenPos then
                    spawnAcc = 0
                    curTrailPiece(parentGui, screenPos, color, root.ZIndex - 1)
                end
            end
        end
        local function buildOrbit(root, color)
            local center = curFrame(root, UDim2.fromOffset(4, 4), color, 0.2)
            curCorner(center)
            local dots = {}
            for i = 1, 3 do
                local d = Instance.new("Frame")
                d.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                d.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(5, 5)
                d.BackgroundColor3 = color
                d.BorderSizePixel = 0
                d.Parent = root
                curCorner(d)
                dots[i] = d
            end
            local t = 0
            return function(dt)
                t = t + dt * 3.2
                for i, d in ipairs(dots) do
                    local a = t + (i - 1) * (math.pi * 2 / 3)
                    d.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, math.cos(a) * 13, 0.5, math.sin(a) * 13)
                end
            end
        end
        local function buildSpinner(root, color)
            for i = 1, 4 do
                local arm = Instance.new("Frame")
                arm.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                arm.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
                arm.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 16)
                arm.Rotation = (i - 1) * 45
                arm.BackgroundColor3 = color
                arm.BorderSizePixel = 0
                arm.Parent = root
                curCorner(arm, UDim.new(1, 0))
            end
            local t = 0
            return function(dt)
                t = t + dt
                root.Rotation = t * 180
            end
        end
        local function buildRainbowRing(root)
            local ring, strokeObj = curRing(root, 26, 3, Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
            local dot = curFrame(root, UDim2.fromOffset(5, 5), Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0)
            curCorner(dot)
            local t = 0
            return function(dt)
                t = t + dt
                local col = Color3.fromHSV((t * 0.25) % 1, 0.85, 1)
                strokeObj.Color = col
                dot.BackgroundColor3 = col
                local pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(t * 3)
                ring.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22 + pulse * 10, 22 + pulse * 10)
                root.Rotation = t * 50
            end
        end
        local function buildRainbowComet(root)
            local head = curFrame(root, UDim2.fromOffset(7, 7), Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0)
            curCorner(head)
            local parentGui = root.Parent
            local spawnAcc, t = 0, 0
            return function(dt, screenPos)
                t = t + dt
                local col = Color3.fromHSV((t * 0.3) % 1, 0.9, 1)
                head.BackgroundColor3 = col
                spawnAcc = spawnAcc + dt
                if spawnAcc >= 0.025 and screenPos then
                    spawnAcc = 0
                    curTrailPiece(parentGui, screenPos, col, root.ZIndex - 1)
                end
            end
        end
        local function buildCrosshair(root, color)
            local function mkSeg()
                local f = Instance.new("Frame")
                f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                f.BackgroundColor3 = color
                f.BorderSizePixel = 0
                f.Parent = root
                return f
            end
            local top, bottom, left, right = mkSeg(), mkSeg(), mkSeg(), mkSeg()
            local t = 0
            return function(dt)
                t = t + dt
                local gap = 4 + 1.5 * math.sin(t * 5) -- tiny recoil-style pulse
                local len = 7
                top.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, len);    top.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, -gap - len / 2)
                bottom.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, len);  bottom.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, gap + len / 2)
                left.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(len, 2);    left.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -gap - len / 2, 0.5, 0)
                right.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(len, 2);   right.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, gap + len / 2, 0.5, 0)
            end
        end
        local function buildPulseDot(root, color)
            local dot = curFrame(root, UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10), color, 0)
            curCorner(dot)
            local halo = curFrame(root, UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10), color, 0.6)
            curCorner(halo)
            local t = 0
            return function(dt)
                t = t + dt
                local s = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(t * 2.6)
                dot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8 + s * 4, 8 + s * 4)
                halo.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14 + s * 14, 14 + s * 14)
                halo.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45 + s * 0.45
            end
        end
        local function buildDiamond(root, color)
            local d = Instance.new("Frame")
            d.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            d.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
            d.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16)
            d.Rotation = 45
            d.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            d.BorderSizePixel = 0
            d.Parent = root
            local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
            s.Thickness = 2
            s.Color = color
            s.Transparency = 0.1
            s.Parent = d
            local t = 0
            return function(dt)
                t = t + dt
                d.Rotation = 45 + math.sin(t * 2) * 12
                local pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(t * 3)
                d.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14 + pulse * 6, 14 + pulse * 6)
            end
        end
        local function buildRainbowPulseDot(root)
            local dot = curFrame(root, UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10), Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0)
            curCorner(dot)
            local halo = curFrame(root, UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10), Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.6)
            curCorner(halo)
            local t = 0
            return function(dt)
                t = t + dt
                local col = Color3.fromHSV((t * 0.3) % 1, 0.85, 1)
                dot.BackgroundColor3 = col
                halo.BackgroundColor3 = col
                local s = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(t * 2.6)
                dot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8 + s * 4, 8 + s * 4)
                halo.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14 + s * 14, 14 + s * 14)
                halo.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45 + s * 0.45
            end
        end
        local function buildStarburst(root, color)
            local arms = {}
            for i = 1, 6 do
                local arm = Instance.new("Frame")
                arm.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
                arm.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
                arm.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 10)
                arm.Rotation = (i - 1) * 60
                arm.BackgroundColor3 = color
                arm.BorderSizePixel = 0
                arm.Parent = root
                arms[i] = arm
            end
            local t = 0
            return function(dt)
                t = t + dt
                root.Rotation = t * 30
                local pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(t * 4)
                for _, arm in ipairs(arms) do
                    arm.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 7 + pulse * 7)
                end
            end
        end
        local function buildSquareScan(root, color)
            local box = Instance.new("Frame")
            box.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            box.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
            box.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20)
            box.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            box.BorderSizePixel = 0
            box.Parent = root
            local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
            s.Thickness = 1.5
            s.Color = color
            s.Transparency = 0.2
            s.Parent = box
            local scanLine = Instance.new("Frame")
            scanLine.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            scanLine.Size = UDim2.new(0.85, 0, 0, 1.5)
            scanLine.BackgroundColor3 = color
            scanLine.BorderSizePixel = 0
            scanLine.Parent = box
            local t = 0
            return function(dt)
                t = t + dt
                scanLine.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5 + math.sin(t * 2.2) * 0.42, 0)
                box.Rotation = math.sin(t * 1.1) * 4
            end
        end
        local function buildHeartbeat(root, color)
            local ring, strokeObj = curRing(root, 22, 2, color)
            local dot = curFrame(root, UDim2.fromOffset(5, 5), color, 0)
            curCorner(dot)
            local t = 0
            return function(dt)
                t = t + dt
                local phase = t % 1
                local beat = 0
                if phase < 0.12 then beat = phase / 0.12
                elseif phase < 0.24 then beat = 1 - (phase - 0.12) / 0.12
                elseif phase < 0.32 then beat = (phase - 0.24) / 0.08 * 0.6
                elseif phase < 0.44 then beat = 0.6 - (phase - 0.32) / 0.12 * 0.6
                end
                ring.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20 + beat * 14, 20 + beat * 14)
                strokeObj.Transparency = 0.1 + beat * 0.3
            end
        end
        local function buildRainbowStarburst(root)
            local arms = {}
            for i = 1, 6 do
                local arm = Instance.new("Frame")
                arm.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
                arm.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
                arm.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 10)
                arm.Rotation = (i - 1) * 60
                arm.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
                arm.BorderSizePixel = 0
                arm.Parent = root
                arms[i] = arm
            end
            local t = 0
            return function(dt)
                t = t + dt
                local col = Color3.fromHSV((t * 0.3) % 1, 0.9, 1)
                root.Rotation = t * 30
                local pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(t * 4)
                for _, arm in ipairs(arms) do
                    arm.BackgroundColor3 = col
                    arm.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 7 + pulse * 7)
                end
            end
        end

        -- "i82" preset -- YOUR actual Roblox avatar headshot (face, hair and any
        -- equipped head accessories all come straight from Roblox's own
        -- thumbnail render, not downloaded/scraped from anywhere) as the cursor.
        -- This pulls LocalPlayer's own UserId directly rather than looking up
        -- a username -- a username lookup for "i82" could resolve to some
        -- unrelated Roblox account that happens to have that name, instead of
        -- whoever is actually running the script, which is who this is for.
        local i82Thumb, i82Fetching = nil, false
        local function fetchI82Thumb()
            if i82Fetching or i82Thumb then return end
            i82Fetching = true
            task.spawn(function()
                pcall(function()
                    local content = Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(plr.UserId, Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size420x420)
                    if type(content) == "string" and content ~= "" then i82Thumb = content end
                end)
            end)
        end
        local function buildI82(root)
            fetchI82Thumb()
            local ring = curRing(root, 34, 2, Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 70))
            local img = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
            img.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            img.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
            img.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28)
            img.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            img.Image = i82Thumb or "rbxasset://textures/ui/GuiImagePlaceholder.png"
            img.Parent = root
            curCorner(img) -- circular crop
            local t = 0
            return function(dt)
                t = t + dt
                if i82Thumb and img.Image ~= i82Thumb then img.Image = i82Thumb end
                img.Rotation = math.sin(t * 2) * 5
                local pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(t * 3)
                ring.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(32 + pulse * 6, 32 + pulse * 6)
            end
        end

        local function buildImageCursor(root, imageId)
            local img = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
            img.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            img.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 32)
            img.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
            img.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            img.Image = imageId
            img.Parent = root
            local t = 0
            return function(dt)
                t = t + dt
                img.Rotation = math.sin(t * 2) * 6
            end
        end

        local CURSOR_STYLES = {}
        do
            local ARCHETYPES = {
                { name = "Ring Pulse", build = buildRingPulse, colors = { "Red", "Blue", "Green", "Purple", "Gold", "Cyan", "Pink", "White" } },
                { name = "Reticle",    build = buildReticle,   colors = { "Red", "Blue", "Green", "Purple", "Gold", "Cyan" } },
                { name = "Comet",      build = buildComet,     colors = { "Red", "Blue", "Green", "Purple", "Gold", "Cyan" } },
                { name = "Orbit Dots", build = buildOrbit,     colors = { "Red", "Blue", "Purple", "Gold", "Cyan" } },
                { name = "Spinner",    build = buildSpinner,   colors = { "Red", "Blue", "Green", "Purple", "Gold" } },
                { name = "Crosshair",  build = buildCrosshair, colors = { "Red", "Blue", "Green", "Purple", "Gold", "Cyan", "White" } },
                { name = "Pulse Dot",  build = buildPulseDot,  colors = { "Red", "Blue", "Green", "Purple", "Gold", "Cyan", "Pink", "White" } },
                { name = "Diamond",    build = buildDiamond,   colors = { "Red", "Blue", "Green", "Purple", "Gold", "Cyan" } },
                { name = "Starburst",  build = buildStarburst, colors = { "Red", "Blue", "Green", "Purple", "Gold", "Cyan" } },
                { name = "Square Scan", build = buildSquareScan, colors = { "Red", "Blue", "Green", "Purple", "Gold", "Cyan" } },
                { name = "Heartbeat",  build = buildHeartbeat, colors = { "Red", "Blue", "Green", "Purple", "Gold", "Cyan" } },
            }
            for _, arc in ipairs(ARCHETYPES) do
                for _, cname in ipairs(arc.colors) do
                    local col = CURSOR_COLORS[cname]
                    local build = arc.build
                    CURSOR_STYLES[#CURSOR_STYLES + 1] = {
                        key = arc.name .. " " .. cname, label = arc.name .. " - " .. cname, color = col,
                        build = function(root, c) return build(root, c) end,
                    }
                end
            end
            CURSOR_STYLES[#CURSOR_STYLES + 1] = { key = "Rainbow Ring", label = "Rainbow Ring", color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), build = function(root) return buildRainbowRing(root) end }
            CURSOR_STYLES[#CURSOR_STYLES + 1] = { key = "Rainbow Comet", label = "Rainbow Comet", color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), build = function(root) return buildRainbowComet(root) end }
            CURSOR_STYLES[#CURSOR_STYLES + 1] = { key = "Rainbow Pulse Dot", label = "Rainbow Pulse Dot", color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), build = function(root) return buildRainbowPulseDot(root) end }
            CURSOR_STYLES[#CURSOR_STYLES + 1] = { key = "Rainbow Starburst", label = "Rainbow Starburst", color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), build = function(root) return buildRainbowStarburst(root) end }
            CURSOR_STYLES[#CURSOR_STYLES + 1] = { key = "i82_face", label = "i82 (face)", color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 70), build = function(root) return buildI82(root) end }
        end

        local function applyCursorStyle(entry)
            clearCursor()
            if not entry then return end
            cursorGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
            cursorGui.Name = "PrismCursor"
            cursorGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
            cursorGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
            -- Same fallback chain the dev panel uses: gethui() (an executor's
            -- hidden container, when it has one, renders above CoreGui itself --
            -- chat, leaderboard, the Roblox menu, everything) -> CoreGui ->
            -- PlayerGui as a last resort. Parenting straight to PlayerGui (the
            -- old behavior) is why the cursor could end up UNDER other UI --
            -- PlayerGui content never draws above CoreGui no matter how high
            -- DisplayOrder is set.
            cursorGui.DisplayOrder = 2000000000
            cursorGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
            pcall(function() if syn and syn.protect_gui then syn.protect_gui(cursorGui) end end)
            pcall(function() cursorGui.Parent = gethui() end)
            if not cursorGui.Parent then pcall(function() cursorGui.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui") end) end
            if not cursorGui.Parent then cursorGui.Parent = plr:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") or plr:WaitForChild("PlayerGui") end

            cursorRoot = Instance.new("Frame")
            cursorRoot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            cursorRoot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28)
            cursorRoot.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            cursorRoot.ZIndex = 2
            cursorRoot.Parent = cursorGui

            local okBuild, update = pcall(entry.build, cursorRoot, entry.color)
            if not okBuild or type(update) ~= "function" then
                clearCursor()
                return
            end
            _G._PrismCursorStyle = entry.key
            pcall(function() UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = false end)
            -- Watchdog: re-assert the parent/DisplayOrder every couple seconds.
            -- Covers gethui() not being ready yet at the instant this GUI was
            -- created (some executors wire it up a frame or two late), and the
            -- rare case of something else resetting MouseIconEnabled back on.
            local watchdogAcc = 0
            cursorConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
                local pos = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
                cursorRoot.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(pos.X, pos.Y)
                pcall(update, dt, pos)
                watchdogAcc = watchdogAcc + dt
                if watchdogAcc >= 2 then
                    watchdogAcc = 0
                    pcall(function()
                        if not cursorGui.Parent or cursorGui.Parent == plr:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") then
                            local hui
                            pcall(function() hui = gethui() end)
                            if hui then cursorGui.Parent = hui
                            else
                                local core
                                pcall(function() core = game:GetService("CoreGui") end)
                                if core then pcall(function() cursorGui.Parent = core end) end
                            end
                        end
                        if cursorGui.DisplayOrder ~= 2000000000 then cursorGui.DisplayOrder = 2000000000 end
                        if UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled then UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = false end
                    end)
                end
            end)
        end

        local function buildExtra()
            local function makeArea(name)
                local pg = page()
                pages[name] = pg
                local scroller = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
                scroller.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
                scroller.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                scroller.ScrollBarThickness = 4
                scroller.BorderSizePixel = 0
                scroller.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
                scroller.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
                scroller.ZIndex = 7
                scroller.Parent = pg
                local stack = Instance.new("UIListLayout", scroller)
                stack.Padding = UDim.new(0, 10)
                stack.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
                local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding", scroller)
                pad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 4)
                pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 12)
                pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 4)
                pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 4)
                return scroller
            end
            local resArea = makeArea("Resolution")
            local visArea = makeArea("Visuals")
            local extraArea = makeArea("Extras")
            local cursorArea = makeArea("Cursor")
            local areaHost = resArea
            local sc = resArea
            local order = 0
            local function section(h)
                order = order + 1
                local f = Instance.new("Frame")
                f.LayoutOrder = order
                f.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, h)
                f.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(14, 15, 20)
                f.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
                f.BorderSizePixel = 0
                f.ZIndex = 8
                f.Parent = areaHost
                corner(f, 14)
                stroke(f, Color3.fromRGB(180, 185, 200), 1, 0.55)
                local sg = Instance.new("UIGradient")
                sg.Rotation = 90
                sg.Color = ColorSequence.new({
                    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,    Color3.fromRGB(26, 28, 36)),
                    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.45, Color3.fromRGB(18, 19, 26)),
                    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1,    Color3.fromRGB(10, 11, 15)),
                })
                sg.Parent = f
                return f
            end
            local function heading(parent, title, sub)
                local t = txt(parent, title, 16, 16, 12, 640, 22, true)
                t.ZIndex = 9
                local s = txt(parent, sub, 12, 16, 34, 660, 16, false)
                s.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 110, 130)
                s.ZIndex = 9
            end
            local function input(parent, x, y, w, placeholder)
                local box = Instance.new("TextBox")
                box.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
                box.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, 32)

            local function applyWindow(w, h)
                local function attempt(fn)
                    if type(fn) ~= "function" then return false end
                    local ok = pcall(fn, w, h)
                    if ok then return true end
                    ok = pcall(fn, Vector2.new(w, h))
                    return ok
                end
                if attempt(setwindowsize) or attempt(setresolution) then return true end
                if type(syn) == "table" and attempt(syn.set_window_size) then return true end
                if type(fluxus) == "table" and attempt(fluxus.set_window_size) then return true end
                return false
            end

            local function applyLook(preset)
                if not preset then return false end

                clearEffects()

                    a=Instance.new("Atmosphere"); a.Name="ParallaxLookAtmosphere"; a.Parent=shaderLighting
                    originalAtmo=a; madeAtmo=true
                end

                local night=preset.clock>=19 or preset.clock<5

                        clouds.Density=math.clamp(.28+preset.haze*.7,.25,.9)
                        clouds.Color=atmosphericColor:Lerp(Color3.new(1,1,1),.22)
                    end)
                end
                local bloom=Instance.new("BloomEffect"); bloom.Name="ParallaxLookBloom"; bloom.Intensity=preset.bloom
                bloom.Size=math.clamp(24+math.floor(preset.bloom*26),24,42); bloom.Threshold=.9+(1-preset.bloom)*.45; bloom.Parent=shaderLighting
                local grade=Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect"); grade.Name="ParallaxLookColor"
                grade.TintColor=rgb(preset.tint,d*.9); grade.Saturation=math.clamp(preset.saturation+((math.floor(d)%3)*.035),-.18,.68)
                grade.Contrast=math.clamp(preset.contrast,.025,.24); grade.Brightness=.012; grade.Parent=shaderLighting
                local rays=Instance.new("SunRaysEffect"); rays.Name="ParallaxLookRays"; rays.Intensity=preset.rays; rays.Spread=.72; rays.Parent=shaderLighting
                if preset.bloom>.34 and math.floor(math.abs(d))%4==0 then
                    local dof=Instance.new("DepthOfFieldEffect"); dof.Name="ParallaxLookDepth"
                    dof.FarIntensity=.08; dof.FocusDistance=75; dof.InFocusRadius=115; dof.NearIntensity=0; dof.Parent=shaderLighting
                end
                if preset.tonemap then
                    pcall(function()
                        local tone=Instance.new("ColorGradingEffect"); tone.Name="ParallaxLookTone"
                        tone.TonemapperPreset=Enum.TonemapperPreset.Retro; tone.Parent=shaderLighting
                    end)
                end
                _G._PrismCurLookId=preset.id; _G._TranzitRestoreLook=restoreLook
                if type(note)=="function" then note("Lighting",preset.name) end
                return true
            end

            ;(function()
            local baseCard = section(196)
            heading(baseCard, "Baseplate color", "Recolors the whole floor. Reset brings back the default red grass.")
            local origBase = {}

            local function findBase()
                local found = workspace:FindFirstChild("Baseplate", true)
                if found and found:IsA("BasePart") then return found end
                -- no part called Baseplate: use the biggest flat anchored part that is not a character
                local best, bestArea = nil, 400
                for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                    if d:IsA("BasePart") and not d:IsA("Terrain") and d.Anchored and d.Size.Y <= 8 and d.Transparency < 0.9 then
                        local m = d:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
                        local isChar = m and m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                        if not isChar then
                            local area = d.Size.X * d.Size.Z
                            if area > bestArea then
                                best, bestArea = d, area
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                return best
            end

            local function setBase(c, label)
                -- the script's own tiled floor (center plate + tiles out to the horizon) first
                local n = 0
                if type(_G.PrismSetFloorColor) == "function" then
                    local ok, res = pcall(_G.PrismSetFloorColor, c)
                    if ok and type(res) == "number" then n = res end
                end
                if n > 0 then
                    note("Baseplate", label or "Changed")
                    return
                end
                -- no tiled floor in this server: recolor the map's own baseplate instead
                local part = findBase()
                if not part then
                    note("Baseplate", "Not found")
                    return
                end
                if origBase[part] == nil then origBase[part] = part.Color end
                part.Color = c
                note("Baseplate", label or "Changed")
            end

            local function resetBase()
                if type(_G.PrismSetFloorColor) == "function" then
                    pcall(_G.PrismSetFloorColor, nil)
                end
                for part, col in pairs(origBase) do
                    if part.Parent then part.Color = col end
                end
                origBase = {}
                note("Baseplate", "Reset")
            end

            local baseColors = {
                {"Concrete", Color3.fromRGB(112, 114, 118)},
                {"Asphalt", Color3.fromRGB(40, 42, 46)},
                {"Grass", Color3.fromRGB(78, 118, 58)},
                {"Sand", Color3.fromRGB(196, 174, 128)},
                {"Snow", Color3.fromRGB(236, 240, 244)},
