            local function rotOnly(cf)
                local c = {cf:GetComponents()}
                return CFrame.new(0, 0, 0, c[4], c[5], c[6], c[7], c[8], c[9], c[10], c[11], c[12])
            end
            local MOTOR_TO_PART = {
                Neck = "Head", Waist = "UpperTorso", Root = "LowerTorso", RootJoint = "Torso",
                RightShoulder = "RightUpperArm", RightElbow = "RightLowerArm", RightWrist = "RightHand",
                LeftShoulder = "LeftUpperArm", LeftElbow = "LeftLowerArm", LeftWrist = "LeftHand",
                RightHip = "RightUpperLeg", RightKnee = "RightLowerLeg", RightAnkle = "RightFoot",
                LeftHip = "LeftUpperLeg", LeftKnee = "LeftLowerLeg", LeftAnkle = "LeftFoot",
                ["Right Shoulder"] = "Right Arm", ["Left Shoulder"] = "Left Arm",
                ["Right Hip"] = "Right Leg", ["Left Hip"] = "Left Leg",
            }
            local function putPose(into, name, cf)
                if not name or name == "" then return end
                local rot = rotOnly(cf)
                if into[name] == nil then into[name] = rot end
                local mapped = MOTOR_TO_PART[name]
                if mapped and into[mapped] == nil then into[mapped] = rot end
            end
            local function addRigAliases(into)
                local map = {
                    RightUpperArm = "Right Arm", LeftUpperArm = "Left Arm",
                    RightUpperLeg = "Right Leg", LeftUpperLeg = "Left Leg",
                    UpperTorso = "Torso", LowerTorso = "Torso",
                }
                for srcName, dst in pairs(map) do
                    if into[srcName] and into[dst] == nil then
                        into[dst] = into[srcName]
                    end
                end
            end
            local function framesFromKFS(kfs)
                if not kfs or not kfs.GetKeyframes then return nil end
                local frames = {}
                local function walk(pose, into)
                    putPose(into, pose.Name, pose.CFrame)
                    for _, sub in ipairs(pose:GetSubPoses()) do
                        walk(sub, into)
                    end
                end
                for _, kf in ipairs(kfs:GetKeyframes()) do
                    local data = {}
                    for _, pose in ipairs(kf:GetPoses()) do
                        walk(pose, data)
                    end
                    data.HumanoidRootPart = nil
                    addRigAliases(data)
                    if next(data) then
                        frames[#frames + 1] = { Time = kf.Time, Data = data }
                    end
                end
                table.sort(frames, function(a, b) return a.Time < b.Time end)
                if #frames < 2 then return nil end
                if frames[#frames].Time <= frames[1].Time then
                    frames[#frames].Time = frames[1].Time + 0.1
                end
                return frames
            end
            local function sampleDummy(assetUrl, emoteId)
                local Players = game:GetService("Players")
                local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
                local char = lp and lp.Character
                local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if not hum then return nil end
                local dummy
                local okDesc, desc = pcall(function() return hum:GetAppliedDescription() end)
                if okDesc and desc then
                    local okM, model = pcall(function()
                        return Players:CreateHumanoidModelFromDescription(desc, hum.RigType)
                    end)
                    if okM then dummy = model end
                end
                if not dummy then
                    local okC, clone = pcall(function() return char:Clone() end)
                    if okC then dummy = clone end
                end
                if not dummy then return nil end
                local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
                folder.Name = "PrismKFDump"
                folder.Parent = workspace
                dummy.Name = "PrismKFDummy"
                dummy.Parent = folder
                pcall(function() dummy:PivotTo(CFrame.new(9000, -300, 9000)) end)
                for _, d in ipairs(dummy:GetDescendants()) do
                    if d:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then
                        d:Destroy()
                    elseif d:IsA("BasePart") then
                        d.CanCollide = false
                        d.Transparency = 1
                    end
                end
                local hrp = dummy:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if hrp then hrp.Anchored = true end
                local dh = dummy:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if not dh then folder:Destroy() return nil end
                pcall(function() dh.PlatformStand = true end)
                local animator = dh:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
                if not animator then
                    animator = Instance.new("Animator")
                    animator.Parent = dh
                end
                local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
                anim.AnimationId = assetUrl
                local okT, track = pcall(function() return animator:LoadAnimation(anim) end)
                if not okT or not track then folder:Destroy() return nil end
                pcall(function()
                    track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
                    track:Play(0, 1, 0)
                end)
                local length = 0
                for _ = 1, 10 do
                    length = track.Length or 0
                    if length > 0.05 then break end
                    task.wait(0.05)
                end
                if length <= 0.05 and emoteId and dh.PlayEmoteAndGetAnimTrackById then
                    pcall(function() track:Stop() end)
                    local okE, a, b = pcall(function()
                        return dh:PlayEmoteAndGetAnimTrackById(emoteId)
                    end)
                    local et
                    if okE then
                        if typeof(a) == "Instance" and a:IsA("AnimationTrack") then
                            et = a
                        elseif typeof(b) == "Instance" and b:IsA("AnimationTrack") then
                            et = b
                        end
                    end
                    if et then
                        track = et
                        for _ = 1, 12 do
                            length = track.Length or 0
                            if length > 0.05 then break end
                            task.wait(0.05)
                        end
                    end
                end
                if length <= 0.05 then
                    pcall(function() track:Stop() end)
                    folder:Destroy()
                    return nil
                end
                local motors = {}
                for _, d in ipairs(dummy:GetDescendants()) do
                    if d:IsA("Motor6D") and d.Part1 then
                        motors[#motors + 1] = d
                    end
                end
                local frames = {}
                local samples = math.clamp(math.floor(length * 10), 8, 20)
                local rs = game:GetService("RunService")
                for i = 0, samples - 1 do
                    local t = (i / samples) * length
                    track.TimePosition = t
                    rs.Heartbeat:Wait()
                    local data = {}
                    for _, m in ipairs(motors) do
                        if m.Part1 then
                            putPose(data, m.Part1.Name, m.Transform)
                            putPose(data, m.Name, m.Transform)
                        end
                    end
                    data.HumanoidRootPart = nil
                    addRigAliases(data)
                    if next(data) then
                        frames[#frames + 1] = { Time = t, Data = data }
                    end
                end
                pcall(function() track:Stop() end)
                folder:Destroy()
                if #frames < 2 then return nil end
                return frames
            end
            local function resolveClip(assetId)
                local kfs, animId
                local ok, objects = pcall(function()
                    return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. tostring(assetId))
                end)
                if ok and type(objects) == "table" then
                    for _, obj in ipairs(objects) do
                        local list = { obj }
                        if obj.GetDescendants then
                            for _, d in ipairs(obj:GetDescendants()) do
                                list[#list + 1] = d
                            end
                        end
                        for _, d in ipairs(list) do
                            if d:IsA("KeyframeSequence") and not kfs then
                                kfs = d
                            elseif d:IsA("Animation") then
                                local n = tonumber(tostring(d.AnimationId):match("%d+"))
                                if n and n > 0 then animId = n end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if not kfs then
                    pcall(function()
                        kfs = game:GetService("KeyframeSequenceProvider"):GetKeyframeSequenceAsync("rbxassetid://" .. tostring(animId or assetId))
                    end)
                end
                return kfs, animId
            end
            local function poseMoved(frames)
                if type(frames) ~= "table" or #frames < 2 then return false end
                local ident = {1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1}
                local maxd = 0
                local base = frames[1].Data or {}
                for _, fr in ipairs(frames) do
                    for _, cf in pairs(fr.Data or {}) do
                        local c = {cf:GetComponents()}
                        for k = 1, 9 do
                            local d = math.abs((c[k + 3] or 0) - ident[k])
                            if d > maxd then maxd = d end
                        end
                    end
                end
                local mid = frames[math.max(2, math.floor(#frames * 0.5))].Data or {}
                for name, cf in pairs(mid) do
                    local other = base[name]
                    if other then
                        local c1 = {cf:GetComponents()}
                        local c2 = {other:GetComponents()}
                        for k = 4, 12 do
                            local d = math.abs((c1[k] or 0) - (c2[k] or 0))
                            if d > maxd then maxd = d end
                        end
                    end
                end
                return maxd > 0.045
            end
            local function grabKFS(animId)
                if not animId then return nil end
                local provider = game:GetService("KeyframeSequenceProvider")
                local result, done = nil, false
                task.spawn(function()
                    local ok, value = pcall(function()
                        return provider:GetKeyframeSequenceAsync("rbxassetid://" .. tostring(animId))
                    end)
                    if ok and typeof(value) == "Instance" then
                        result = value
                    end
                    done = true
                end)
                local t0 = os.clock()
                while not done and os.clock() - t0 < 5 do
                    task.wait(0.05)
                end
                return result
            end
            local function readMotors(model)
                local motors = {}
                for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
                    if d:IsA("Motor6D") and d.Part1 then
                        motors[#motors + 1] = d
                    end
                end
                return motors
            end
            local function grabTrack(model, emoteId, animId)
                local hum = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if not hum then return nil end
                local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
                if not animator then
                    animator = Instance.new("Animator")
                    animator.Parent = hum
                end
                if animId then
                    local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
                    anim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(animId)
                    local ok, track = pcall(function() return animator:LoadAnimation(anim) end)
                    if ok and track then
                        pcall(function()
                            track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
                            track:Play(0, 1, 0)
                        end)
                        return track
                    end
                end
                if hum.PlayEmoteAndGetAnimTrackById then
                    local a, b
                    pcall(function()
                        a, b = hum:PlayEmoteAndGetAnimTrackById(emoteId)
                    end)
                    if typeof(a) == "Instance" and a:IsA("AnimationTrack") then return a end
                    if typeof(b) == "Instance" and b:IsA("AnimationTrack") then return b end
                    local ok2, a2, b2 = pcall(function()
                        return hum:PlayEmoteAndGetAnimTrackById(emoteId)
                    end)
                    if not ok2 then
                        a2, b2 = hum:PlayEmoteAndGetAnimTrackById(emoteId)
                    end
                    if typeof(a2) == "Instance" and a2:IsA("AnimationTrack") then return a2 end
                    if typeof(b2) == "Instance" and b2:IsA("AnimationTrack") then return b2 end
                end
                return nil
            end
            local function sampleTrack(model, track)
                local length = 0
                for _ = 1, 24 do
                    length = track.Length or 0
                    if length > 0.05 then break end
                    task.wait(0.05)
                end
                if length <= 0.05 then return nil end
                pcall(function()
                    track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
                    track.Looped = false
                    track:AdjustWeight(1, 0)
                    track:AdjustSpeed(0)
                end)
                local hum = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local animator = hum and hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
                if animator then
                    for _, tr in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
                        if tr ~= track then pcall(function() tr:Stop(0) end) end
                    end
                end
                local motors = readMotors(model)
                if #motors == 0 then return nil end
                local rs = game:GetService("RunService")
                local frames = {}
                local samples = math.clamp(math.floor(length * 14), 10, 40)
                for i = 0, samples - 1 do
                    local t = (i / math.max(samples - 1, 1)) * math.max(length - 0.03, 0)
                    track.TimePosition = t
                    rs.Heartbeat:Wait()
                    rs.Heartbeat:Wait()
                    local data = {}
                    for _, m in ipairs(motors) do
                        putPose(data, m.Part1.Name, m.Transform)
                        putPose(data, m.Name, m.Transform)
                    end
                    data.HumanoidRootPart = nil
                    addRigAliases(data)
                    frames[#frames + 1] = { Time = (i / math.max(samples - 1, 1)) * length, Data = data }
                end
                if not poseMoved(frames) then return nil end
                return frames
            end
            local function decodeEmote(assetId)
                local plr = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
                local char = plr.Character
                local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if not hum then return nil, "no character" end
                if ReanimateAPI and ReanimateAPI.stop_animation then
                    pcall(ReanimateAPI.stop_animation)
                end
                local animate = char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
                local wasOn = animate and animate.Enabled
                if animate and animate:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then
                    pcall(function() animate.Enabled = false end)
                end
                _G._PrismPauseFlingSync = true
                task.delay(4, function()
                    _G._PrismPauseFlingSync = false
                end)
                local function finish(frames, why)
                    _G._PrismPauseFlingSync = false
                    if animate and wasOn ~= nil then
                        pcall(function() animate.Enabled = wasOn end)
                    end
                    return frames, why
                end
                local a, b = hum:PlayEmoteAndGetAnimTrackById(assetId)
                local track
                if typeof(a) == "Instance" and a:IsA("AnimationTrack") then
                    track = a
                elseif typeof(b) == "Instance" and b:IsA("AnimationTrack") then
                    track = b
                end
                if not track then
                    local _, animId = resolveClip(assetId)
                    local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
                    if not animator then
                        animator = Instance.new("Animator")
                        animator.Parent = hum
                    end
                    if animId then
                        local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
                        anim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(animId)
                        local okT, loaded = pcall(function() return animator:LoadAnimation(anim) end)
                        if okT then track = loaded end
                    end
                end
                if not track then
                    return finish(nil, "Roblox would not play that emote")
                end
                pcall(function()
                    track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
                    track.Looped = false
                    track:Play(0, 1, 0)
                    track:AdjustWeight(1, 0)
                end)
                local length = 0
                for _ = 1, 10 do
                    length = track.Length or 0
                    if length > 0.05 then break end
                    task.wait(0.03)
                end
                if length <= 0.05 then
                    pcall(function() track:Stop(0) end)
                    return finish(nil, "that emote has no motion")
                end
                local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
                if animator then
                    for _, tr in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
                        if tr ~= track then pcall(function() tr:Stop(0) end) end
                    end
                end
                local motors = {}
                for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                    if d:IsA("Motor6D") and d.Part1 and d.Part1.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                        motors[#motors + 1] = d
                    end
                end
                local rs = game:GetService("RunService")
                local function snap(samples)
                    local frames = {}
                    for i = 0, samples - 1 do
                        local u = i / math.max(samples - 1, 1)
                        local t = u * math.max(length - 0.02, 0)
                        track.TimePosition = t
                        pcall(function() track:AdjustSpeed(0) end)
                        rs.Heartbeat:Wait()
                        local data = {}
                        for _, m in ipairs(motors) do
                            if m.Part1 then
                                data[m.Part1.Name] = m.Transform
                            end
                        end
                        frames[#frames + 1] = { Time = u * length, Data = data }
                    end
                    return frames
                end
                local frames = snap(12)
                if not poseMoved(frames) then
                    pcall(function()
                        track:Play(0, 1, 1)
                        track:AdjustSpeed(1)
                    end)
                    frames = {}
                    local span = math.min(length, 1.6)
                    local t0 = os.clock()
                    local nextAt = 0
                    while os.clock() - t0 < span and #frames < 14 do
                        local now = os.clock() - t0
                        if now >= nextAt then
                            nextAt = now + (span / 12)
                            local data = {}
                            for _, m in ipairs(motors) do
                                if m.Part1 then data[m.Part1.Name] = m.Transform end
                            end
                            frames[#frames + 1] = { Time = (track.TimePosition or now), Data = data }
                        end
                        rs.Heartbeat:Wait()
                    end
                end
                pcall(function() track:Stop(0) end)
                if not poseMoved(frames) then
                    return finish(nil, "the emote played but the joints did not move")
                end
                return finish(frames, nil)
            end
            local kfOutput = Instance.new("TextBox")
            kfOutput.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(660, 96)
            kfOutput.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 318)
            kfOutput.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(14, 15, 20)
            kfOutput.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 210, 240)
            kfOutput.Font = Enum.Font.Code
            kfOutput.TextSize = 11
            kfOutput.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
            kfOutput.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
            kfOutput.ClearTextOnFocus = false
            kfOutput.MultiLine = true
            kfOutput.Text = "Decoded keyframe text shows up here. Click the box, Ctrl+A, then copy."

            local function framesToText(frames)
                if not frames then return "nil" end
                local function num(x)
                    if type(x) ~= "number" or x ~= x or x > 100000 or x < -100000 then return 0 end
                    return x
                end
                local function q(s)
                    return '"' .. tostring(s):gsub("\\", "\\\\"):gsub('"', '\\"'):gsub("\n", ""):gsub("\r", "") .. '"'
                end
                local lines = {"return {"}
                for _, fr in ipairs(frames) do
                    local bits = {}
                    for limb, cf in pairs(fr.Data or {}) do
                        if typeof(cf) == "CFrame" then
                            if _G._PrismPoseForJoint then
                                cf = _G._PrismPoseForJoint(limb, cf)
                            end
                            local lname = string.lower(tostring(limb))
                            if lname ~= "humanoidrootpart" and lname ~= "hrp" and lname ~= "rootpart" then
                                local c = {cf:GetComponents()}
                                bits[#bits+1] = string.format("[%s]=CFrame.new(%.4f,%.4f,%.4f,%.4f,%.4f,%.4f,%.4f,%.4f,%.4f,%.4f,%.4f,%.4f)", q(limb), num(c[1]),num(c[2]),num(c[3]),num(c[4]),num(c[5]),num(c[6]),num(c[7]),num(c[8]),num(c[9]),num(c[10]),num(c[11]),num(c[12]))
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    lines[#lines+1] = string.format("  {Time=%.3f, Data={%s}},", num(fr.Time or 0), table.concat(bits, ", "))
                end
                lines[#lines+1] = "}"
                return table.concat(lines, "\n")
            end
            _G._PrismSaveKeyframe = function(name, packed, frames)
                if type(name) ~= "string" or name == "" or type(packed) ~= "string" or packed == "" then
                    return nil
                end
                name = name:gsub("[%c\\/]", " "):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
                if #name > 42 then name = name:sub(1, 42) end
                if name == "" then name = "Keyframe" end
                CustomAnimations[name] = packed
                local found = false
                if type(CustomAnims) == "table" then
                    for _, ca in ipairs(CustomAnims) do
                        if ca.name == name then
                            ca.url = packed
                            ca.raw = true
                            ca.isJson = false
                            found = true
                            break
                        end
                    end
                    if not found then
                        table.insert(CustomAnims, { name = name, url = packed, raw = true, isJson = false })
                    end
                end
                pcall(function()
                    if makefolder and isfolder and not isfolder("ReanimData") then makefolder("ReanimData") end
                    if writefile then
                        writefile("ReanimData/" .. name:gsub("[^%w_%-]", "_") .. ".lua", packed)
                    end
                end)
                if type(frames) == "table" and ReanimateAPI and ReanimateAPI.seed_animation_cache then
                    pcall(function() ReanimateAPI.seed_animation_cache(name, frames) end)
                end
                if type(RebuildCustomList) == "function" then
                    pcall(RebuildCustomList)
                elseif type(_G._ReanimRebuildCustomList) == "function" then
                    pcall(_G._ReanimRebuildCustomList)
                end
                return name
            end
            _G._PrismSynthMove = function(text)
                local t = string.lower(tostring(text or "dance"))
                local seed = 1
                for i = 1, #t do
                    seed = (seed + string.byte(t, i) * i) % 997
                end
                local wave = string.find(t, "wave", 1, true) or string.find(t, "hello", 1, true) or string.find(t, "salute", 1, true)
                local spin = string.find(t, "spin", 1, true) or string.find(t, "twirl", 1, true) or string.find(t, "tilt", 1, true)
                local jump = string.find(t, "jump", 1, true) or string.find(t, "hop", 1, true) or string.find(t, "happy", 1, true)
                local dance = string.find(t, "dance", 1, true) or string.find(t, "floss", 1, true) or string.find(t, "groove", 1, true) or string.find(t, "sturdy", 1, true)
                local r6 = { Head = "Head", UpperTorso = "Torso", LeftUpperArm = "Left Arm", RightUpperArm = "Right Arm", LeftUpperLeg = "Left Leg", RightUpperLeg = "Right Leg" }
                local function mirror(data)
                    local out = {}
                    for limb, cf in pairs(data) do
                        out[limb] = cf
                        local alt = r6[limb]
                        if alt and alt ~= limb then out[alt] = cf end
                    end
                    return out
                end
                local frames = {}
                local samples = 40
                for i = 0, samples - 1 do
                    local u = i / samples
                    local ang = u * math.pi * 2
                    local s1 = math.sin(ang)
                    local s2 = math.sin(ang * 2)
                    local c1 = math.cos(ang)
                    local data = {}
                    local function pose(limb, x, y, z)
                        data[limb] = CFrame.Angles(x, y, z)
                    end
                    if wave then
                        local flap = math.sin(ang * 2)
                        pose("RightUpperArm", -0.15, 0, -1.2 + flap * 0.85)
                        pose("RightLowerArm", 0, 0, -0.35 + flap * 0.45)
                        pose("RightHand", flap * 0.35, 0, 0)
                        pose("LeftUpperArm", 0.1, 0, 0.2)
                        pose("UpperTorso", 0, s1 * 0.15, 0.04)
                        pose("Head", -0.05, s1 * 0.25, 0)
                    elseif spin then
                        pose("UpperTorso", 0.05, math.sin(ang) * 0.9, s1 * 0.1)
                        pose("LowerTorso", 0, -math.sin(ang) * 0.45, 0)
                        pose("LeftUpperArm", -0.4, 0, -0.8)
                        pose("RightUpperArm", -0.4, 0, 0.8)
                        pose("Head", 0, math.sin(ang) * 0.4, 0)
                    elseif jump then
                        local tuck = (c1 > 0) and c1 or 0
                        pose("LeftUpperLeg", tuck * 1.05, 0, 0)
                        pose("RightUpperLeg", tuck * 1.05, 0, 0)
                        pose("LeftLowerLeg", -tuck * 1.25, 0, 0)
                        pose("RightLowerLeg", -tuck * 1.25, 0, 0)
                        pose("LeftUpperArm", -1.25 * (1 - tuck), 0, -0.35)
                        pose("RightUpperArm", -1.25 * (1 - tuck), 0, 0.35)
                        pose("UpperTorso", tuck * 0.3, 0, 0)
                        pose("Head", -0.15 * tuck, 0, 0)
                    else
                        local punch = dance and 1.35 or (0.85 + (seed % 5) * 0.08)
                        pose("UpperTorso", s2 * 0.1, s1 * 0.22 * punch, s1 * 0.05)
                        pose("LowerTorso", 0, -s1 * 0.16, 0)
                        pose("Head", -s1 * 0.14, -s1 * 0.2, 0)
                        pose("LeftUpperArm", s1 * punch, 0, -0.55 - s2 * 0.35)
                        pose("RightUpperArm", -s1 * punch, 0, 0.55 + s2 * 0.35)
                        pose("LeftLowerArm", 0.15, 0, -math.abs(s2) * 0.9)
                        pose("RightLowerArm", 0.15, 0, math.abs(s2) * 0.9)
                        pose("LeftHand", 0, 0, s2 * 0.4)
                        pose("RightHand", 0, 0, -s2 * 0.4)
                        pose("LeftUpperLeg", math.max(s1, 0) * 0.7, 0, 0.05)
                        pose("RightUpperLeg", math.max(-s1, 0) * 0.7, 0, -0.05)
                        pose("LeftLowerLeg", -math.max(s1, 0) * 0.9, 0, 0)
                        pose("RightLowerLeg", -math.max(-s1, 0) * 0.9, 0, 0)
                    end
                    frames[#frames + 1] = { Time = u * 2.2, Data = mirror(data) }
                end
                return frames
            end
            _G._PrismPlaySmooth = function(frames, label, statusLabel)
                if _G._PrismKFConn then
                    pcall(function() _G._PrismKFConn:Disconnect() end)
                    _G._PrismKFConn = nil
                end
                if _G._PrismEmoteCopy then
                    pcall(function() _G._PrismEmoteCopy:Disconnect() end)
                    _G._PrismEmoteCopy = nil
                end
                if _G._PrismEmoteTrack then
                    pcall(function() _G._PrismEmoteTrack:Stop(0) end)
                    _G._PrismEmoteTrack = nil
                end
                if ReanimateAPI and ReanimateAPI.stop_animation then
                    pcall(ReanimateAPI.stop_animation)
                end
                if type(frames) ~= "table" or #frames < 2 then
                    if statusLabel then statusLabel.Text = "No frames to play" end
                    return false
                end
                local plr = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
                local rigs = {}
                local function addRig(model)
                    if model and model.Parent then
                        rigs[#rigs + 1] = model
                    end
                end
                local clone
                if ReanimateAPI and ReanimateAPI.get_clone then
                    pcall(function() clone = ReanimateAPI.get_clone(plr) end)
                end
                if clone and clone.Parent then
                    addRig(clone)
                else
                    addRig(plr.Character)
                end
                if #rigs == 0 then
                    if statusLabel then statusLabel.Text = "No character to play on" end
                    return false
                end
                local motors = {}
                local function grab(rig)
                    for _, d in ipairs(rig:GetDescendants()) do
                        if d:IsA("Motor6D") and d.Part1 then
                            motors[#motors + 1] = { motor = d, part = d.Part1.Name, joint = d.Name }
                        elseif d:IsA("AnimationConstraint") then
                            local att = d.Attachment1
                            if att and att.Parent then
                                motors[#motors + 1] = { motor = d, part = att.Parent.Name, joint = d.Name }
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    local animate = rig:FindFirstChild("Animate")
                    if animate and animate:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then
                        pcall(function() animate.Disabled = true end)
                    end
                    local hum = rig:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    local animator = hum and hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
                    if animator then
                        pcall(function()
                            for _, tr in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
                                tr:Stop(0)
                            end
                        end)
                    end
                end
                for _, rig in ipairs(rigs) do
                    grab(rig)
                end
                local safe = _G._PrismSafePose or function(cf) return cf end
                local dur = frames[#frames].Time
                if not dur or dur < 0.2 then dur = 0.2 end
                local started = os.clock()
                local easeSteps = (dur / math.max(#frames - 1, 1)) > 0.12
                local rs = game:GetService("RunService")
                _G._PrismKFConn = rs.Stepped:Connect(function()
                    local elapsed = (os.clock() - started) % dur
                    _G._PrismAnimNow = { name = tostring(label or "Keyframe"), t = elapsed, len = dur, on = true, tick = os.clock(), frames = #frames }
                    local a, b = frames[1], frames[#frames]
                    for i = 1, #frames - 1 do
                        if elapsed >= frames[i].Time and elapsed < frames[i + 1].Time then
                            a = frames[i]
                            b = frames[i + 1]
                            break
                        end
                    end
                    local span = (b.Time or 0) - (a.Time or 0)
                    if span <= 0.001 then span = 0.001 end
                    local alpha = math.clamp((elapsed - (a.Time or 0)) / span, 0, 1)
                    if easeSteps then alpha = alpha * alpha * (3 - 2 * alpha) end
                    for _, slot in ipairs(motors) do
                        local motor = slot.motor
                        if motor and motor.Parent then
                            local cf = (a.Data and (a.Data[slot.part] or a.Data[slot.joint]))
                            if cf then
                                local nxt = b.Data and (b.Data[slot.part] or b.Data[slot.joint])
                                local posed = nxt and cf:Lerp(nxt, alpha) or cf
                                if _G._PrismPoseForJoint then
                                    motor.Transform = _G._PrismPoseForJoint(slot.part, posed)
                                else
                                    motor.Transform = safe(posed)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
                if statusLabel then
                    statusLabel.Text = "Playing " .. tostring(label) .. " (" .. tostring(#frames) .. " frames)"
                end
                return true
            end
            -- ============ Text to Keyframe ============
            do

                copyBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(84, 20)
