                copyBtn.Parent = TKUI
                corner(copyBtn, 6)
                local MAXSHOW = 140000
                local last = nil
                local gen = 0
                local exIdx = 0
                local useReal = true
                local emoteCache, emoteFail = {}, {}
                local decoding = false
                local preview
                local realBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
                realBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(140, 20)
                realBtn.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(440, 222)
                realBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 40, 90)
                realBtn.Text = "Real emotes: ON"
                realBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
                realBtn.TextSize = 12
                realBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 244, 252)
                realBtn.AutoButtonColor = true
                realBtn.ZIndex = 10
                realBtn.Parent = TKUI
                corner(realBtn, 6)
                local function shown(packed, frames)
                    if #packed <= MAXSHOW then return packed end
                    -- far too long to show: say so instead of showing a cut-off copy that would not load
                    return "-- This keyframe is " .. math.floor(#packed / 1024) .. " KB, too long to show. Press Copy for the full text, or Save Only and use it from Animations."
                end
                -- builds the keyframe from whatever is typed and puts it in the box
                -- real Roblox emotes this text names (words like "floss", "wave", "salute"), decoded one at a time
                local function startDecode(list)
                    if decoding or not _G._PrismDecodeEmote then return end
                    decoding = true
                    task.spawn(function()
                        for _, em in ipairs(list) do
                            if not emoteCache[em.id] and not emoteFail[em.id] then
                                local done, res = false, nil
                                local okc = pcall(_G._PrismDecodeEmote, em, function(fr)
                                    done = true
                                    res = fr
                                end)
                                local t0 = os.clock()
                                while okc and not done and os.clock() - t0 < 14 do task.wait(0.1) end
                                if res and #res >= 2 then emoteCache[em.id] = res else emoteFail[em.id] = true end
                            end
                        end
                        decoding = false
                        preview()
                    end)
                end
                function preview()
                    local text = tkIn.Text or ""
                    if string.gsub(text, "%s", "") == "" then
                        last = nil
                        tkOut.Text = ""
                        tkStatus.Text = "Ready."
                        return nil
                    end
                    local TK = _G.PrismTxtKey
                    if not TK then
                        tkStatus.Text = "Text engine missing."
                        return nil
                    end
                    local ext, pending, usedNames
                    local hubL = _G._PrismEmoteHubLive or _G._PrismEmoteHub
                    if useReal and type(hubL) == "table" and #hubL > 0 and TK.emotePlan and not string.find(text, "CFrame", 1, true) then
                        local okp, plan = pcall(TK.emotePlan, text, hubL)
                        if okp and type(plan) == "table" then
                            for i, em in pairs(plan) do
                                if emoteFail[em.id] then
                                    -- could not be read, built by hand instead
                                elseif emoteCache[em.id] then
                                    ext = ext or {}
                                    ext[i] = { frames = emoteCache[em.id], name = em.name }
                                else
                                    pending = pending or {}
                                    pending[#pending + 1] = em
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    local ok, frames, info = pcall(TK.auto, text, ext)
                    if not ok then
                        tkStatus.Text = "Couldn't build that: " .. tostring(frames)
                        return nil
                    end
                    if not frames or #frames < 2 then
                        last = nil
                        tkOut.Text = ""
                        tkStatus.Text = (info and info.text) or "Couldn't build that."
                        return nil
                    end
                    local okT, packed = pcall(TK.toText, frames)
                    if not okT then
                        tkStatus.Text = "Couldn't write the keyframe: " .. tostring(packed)
                        return nil
                    end
                    last = { text = text, frames = frames, info = info, packed = packed }
                    tkOut.Text = shown(packed, frames)
                    tkStatus.Text = info.text or ""
                    if pending then
                        tkStatus.Text = tkStatus.Text .. "\nReading the real '" .. tostring(pending[1].name) .. "' emote to make it better..."
                        startDecode(pending)
                    end
                    return last
                end
                realBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                    useReal = not useReal
                    realBtn.Text = useReal and "Real emotes: ON" or "Real emotes: OFF"
                    realBtn.BackgroundColor3 = useReal and Color3.fromRGB(60, 40, 90) or Color3.fromRGB(40, 36, 46)
                    preview()
                end)
                tkIn:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
                    gen = gen + 1
                    local mine = gen
                    task.delay(0.3, function()
                        if mine == gen then preview() end
                    end)
                end)

                local function commit(play)
                    local cur = last
                    if not cur or cur.text ~= tkIn.Text then cur = preview() end
                    if not cur then
                        if string.gsub(tkIn.Text or "", "%s", "") == "" then
                            tkStatus.Text = "Type something first, for example: wave, then bow, then spin twice"
                        end
                        return
                    end
                    local label = tkName.Text
                    if string.gsub(label, "%s", "") == "" then label = cur.info.name or "Text Keyframe" end
                    local saved = _G._PrismSaveKeyframe and _G._PrismSaveKeyframe(label, cur.packed, cur.frames)
                    local msg = cur.info.text or ""
                    if saved then msg = msg .. "\nSaved as '" .. saved .. "' in Animations." end
                    if play and _G._PrismPlaySmooth then
                        local proxy = { Text = "" }
                        local played = _G._PrismPlaySmooth(cur.frames, saved or label, proxy)
                        if played then msg = msg .. "\nPlaying now (loops)." else msg = msg .. "\n" .. proxy.Text end
                    end
                    tkStatus.Text = msg
                end
                copyBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                    local cur = last
                    if not cur or cur.text ~= tkIn.Text then cur = preview() end
                    if not cur then
                        tkStatus.Text = "Nothing to copy yet. Type something first."
                        return
                    end
                    local cb = setclipboard or toclipboard or set_clipboard or (syn and syn.write_clipboard) or (Clipboard and Clipboard.set)
                    if type(cb) == "function" and pcall(cb, cur.packed) then
                        tkStatus.Text = "Copied the full keyframe (" .. math.floor(#cur.packed / 1024) .. " KB). Paste it into Custom Animations."
                    else
                        tkStatus.Text = "This executor has no clipboard access. Click the box, press Ctrl+A, then Ctrl+C."
                    end
                end)
                button(TKUI, "Make + Play", 252, 150, 150, 34, function() commit(true) end)
                button(TKUI, "Save Only", 412, 150, 110, 34, function() commit(false) end)
                button(TKUI, "Stop", 532, 150, 70, 34, function()
                    if _G._PrismKFConn then
                        pcall(function() _G._PrismKFConn:Disconnect() end)
                        _G._PrismKFConn = nil
                    end
                    pcall(function()
                        local plr = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
                        local rigs = { plr.Character }
                        if ReanimateAPI and ReanimateAPI.get_clone then
                            local okc, cl = pcall(ReanimateAPI.get_clone, plr)
                            if okc and cl then rigs[#rigs + 1] = cl end
                        end
                        for _, rig in ipairs(rigs) do
                            for _, d in ipairs(rig:GetDescendants()) do
                                if d:IsA("Motor6D") or d:IsA("AnimationConstraint") then
                                    pcall(function() d.Transform = CFrame.new() end)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                    tkStatus.Text = "Stopped."
                end)
                button(TKUI, "Ideas", 612, 150, 60, 34, function()
                    local ex = _G.PrismTxtKey and _G.PrismTxtKey.examples
                    if not ex then return end
                    exIdx = exIdx % #ex + 1
                    tkIn.Text = ex[exIdx]
                end)
            end

            _G._PrismMirrorEmote = function(track)
                if _G._PrismEmoteCopy then
                    pcall(function() _G._PrismEmoteCopy:Disconnect() end)
                    _G._PrismEmoteCopy = nil
                end
                local plr = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
                local char = plr.Character
                local clone
                if ReanimateAPI and ReanimateAPI.get_clone then
                    pcall(function() clone = ReanimateAPI.get_clone(plr) end)
                end
                if not track or not char or not clone or not clone.Parent or clone == char then return end
                local function mapMotors(model)
                    local t = {}
                    for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
                        if d:IsA("Motor6D") and d.Part1 then
                            t[d.Part1.Name] = d
                        end
                    end
                    return t
                end
                local realM = mapMotors(char)
                local cloneM = mapMotors(clone)
                local rs = game:GetService("RunService")
                _G._PrismEmoteCopy = rs.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                    if not track.IsPlaying then
                        if _G._PrismEmoteCopy then
                            _G._PrismEmoteCopy:Disconnect()
                            _G._PrismEmoteCopy = nil
                        end
                        return
                    end
                    for name, m in pairs(realM) do
                        local c = cloneM[name]
                        if c and c.Parent and m.Parent then
                            c.Transform = (_G._PrismPoseForJoint and _G._PrismPoseForJoint(name, m.Transform)) or m.Transform
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
            local function onPick(emote, button, onDone)
                local quiet = onDone ~= nil
                if not quiet then kfStatus.Text = "Reading " .. emote.name end
                task.spawn(function()
                    local plr = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
                    local char = plr.Character
                    if not char then
                        if quiet then onDone(nil, "No character") return end
                        kfStatus.Text = "No character"
                        return
                    end
                    if _G._PrismEmoteTrack and not quiet then
                        pcall(function() _G._PrismEmoteTrack:Stop(0) end)
                        _G._PrismEmoteTrack = nil
                    end
                    if _G._PrismEmoteCopy and not quiet then
                        pcall(function() _G._PrismEmoteCopy:Disconnect() end)
                        _G._PrismEmoteCopy = nil
                    end
                    local function resetRig(model)
                        if not model or quiet then return end
                        local hum = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                        local animator = hum and hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
                        if animator then
                            pcall(function()
                                for _, tr in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
                                    tr:Stop(0)
                                end
                            end)
                        end
                        for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
                            if d:IsA("Motor6D") or d:IsA("AnimationConstraint") then
                                pcall(function() d.Transform = CFrame.new() end)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    local function sanitize(frames)
                        local pose = _G._PrismPoseForJoint
                        if not pose then return frames end
                        for _, fr in ipairs(frames) do
                            local data = {}
                            for name, cf in pairs(fr.Data or {}) do
                                if typeof(cf) == "CFrame" then
                                    local lname = string.lower(tostring(name))
                                    if lname ~= "humanoidrootpart" and lname ~= "hrp" and lname ~= "rootpart" then
                                        data[name] = pose(name, cf)
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                            fr.Data = data
                        end
                        return frames
                    end
                    local real
                    if ReanimateAPI and ReanimateAPI.get_real_character then
                        pcall(function() real = ReanimateAPI.get_real_character(plr) end)
                    end
                    resetRig(char)
                    if real and real ~= char then resetRig(real) end
                    local frames
                    local kfs = grabKFS(emote.id)
                    if kfs then
                        frames = framesFromKFS(kfs)
                    end
                    if (not frames or not poseMoved(frames)) and char then
                        local dummy
                        pcall(function()
                            dummy = char:Clone()
                            for _, d in ipairs(dummy:GetDescendants()) do
                                if d:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then
                                    d:Destroy()
                                end
                            end
                            local hrp = dummy:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                            if hrp then
                                hrp.Anchored = true
                                hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, -500, 0)
                            end
                            dummy.Parent = workspace
                            local track = grabTrack(dummy, emote.id, emote.id)
                            if track then
                                frames = sampleTrack(dummy, track)
                                pcall(function() track:Stop(0) end)
                            end
                        end)
                        if dummy then
                            pcall(function() dummy:Destroy() end)
                        end
                    end
                    resetRig(char)
                    if real and real ~= char then resetRig(real) end
                    if not frames or not poseMoved(frames) then
                        if quiet then onDone(nil, "could not read that emote") return end
                        kfStatus.Text = emote.name .. " — could not read that emote without breaking the rig"
                        return
                    end
                    sanitize(frames)
                    decoded[emote.id] = frames
                    if quiet then onDone(frames) return end
                    local packed = framesToText(frames)
                    if kfOutput then kfOutput.Text = packed end
                    if _G._PrismSaveKeyframe then
                        _G._PrismSaveKeyframe(emote.name, packed, frames)
                    end
                    button.Text = "  " .. emote.name .. "   ·   " .. tostring(#frames) .. " keyframes"
                    if _G._PrismPlaySmooth then
                        _G._PrismPlaySmooth(frames, emote.name, kfStatus)
                    end
                end)
            end
            _G._PrismDecodeEmote = function(emote, cb)
                onPick(emote, nil, cb)
            end
            local function addEmote(emote)
                if seen[emote.id] then return end
                seen[emote.id] = true
                local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
                b.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 28)
                b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(48, 32, 68)
                b.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
                b.Text = "  " .. emote.name
                b.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
                b.TextSize = 13
                b.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 244, 252)
                b.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
                b.AutoButtonColor = true
                b.ZIndex = 10
                b.LayoutOrder = #rows + 1
                b.Parent = scroll
                corner(b, 8)
                rows[#rows + 1] = { button = b, key = string.lower(emote.name), emote = emote }
                b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                    onPick(emote, b)
                end)
            end
            showHub = function()
                local q = string.lower(search.Text or "")
                for _, row in ipairs(rows) do
                    if row.button then row.button:Destroy() end
                end
                table.clear(rows)
                table.clear(seen)
                local shown = 0
                for _, em in ipairs(hub) do
                    if q == "" or string.find(string.lower(em.name), q, 1, true) then
                        addEmote(em)
                        shown = shown + 1
                        if shown >= 70 then break end
                    end
                end
                scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0, math.max(shown, 1) * 32)
                if #hub == 0 then
                    kfStatus.Text = "Loading the Emote Hub list..."
                else
                    kfStatus.Text = shown .. " shown · " .. #hub .. " emotes in the hub. Click one."
                end
            end
            kfStatus.Text = "Loading the Emote Hub list..."
            local quick = {
                { id = 3360686498, name = "Stadium" },
                { id = 3360692915, name = "Tilt" },
                { id = 3576968026, name = "Shrug" },
                { id = 3360689775, name = "Salute" },
            }
            if type(_G._PrismEmoteHub) == "table" and #_G._PrismEmoteHub > 0 then
                for i, e in ipairs(_G._PrismEmoteHub) do
                    hub[i] = e
                end
                showHub()
            else
                for i, e in ipairs(quick) do
                    hub[i] = e
                end
                showHub()
            end
            task.spawn(function()
                local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
                local function pull(url)
                    local req = (type(syn) == "table" and syn.request) or http_request or request or (type(http) == "table" and http.request)
                    if type(req) == "function" then
                        local ok, res = pcall(req, { Url = url, Method = "GET" })
                        if ok and type(res) == "table" then
                            local body = res.Body or res.body
                            if type(body) == "string" and #body > 2 then return body end
                        end
                    end
                    local ok2, body = pcall(function() return game:HttpGet(url) end)
                    if ok2 and type(body) == "string" then return body end
                    return nil
                end
                local raw
                if isfile and readfile then
                    local okF, body = pcall(function()
                        if isfile("EmoteHub/EmoteList.json") then return readfile("EmoteHub/EmoteList.json") end
                        return nil
                    end)
                    if okF and type(body) == "string" and #body > 2 then raw = body end
                end
                if not raw then
                    raw = pull("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/7yd7/sniper-Emote/refs/heads/test/EmoteSniper.json")
                end
                if not raw then
                    kfStatus.Text = "Couldn't load the Emote Hub list."
                    return
                end
                local okJ, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(raw) end)
                if not okJ or type(data) ~= "table" then
                    kfStatus.Text = "Emote Hub list was not valid."
                    return
                end
                local list = data.data or data
                local n = 0
                table.clear(hub)
                for _, item in pairs(list) do
                    local id = tonumber(type(item) == "table" and (item.id or item[1]) or nil)
                    local name = type(item) == "table" and (item.name or item[2]) or nil
                    if id and id > 0 and name then
                        n = n + 1
                        hub[n] = { id = id, name = tostring(name) }
                    end
                end
                _G._PrismEmoteHub = hub
                showHub()
                task.spawn(function()
                    table.sort(hub, function(a, b) return a.name:lower() < b.name:lower() end)
                    showHub()
                end)
            end)

        end

        _G._PrismBuildKeyframePage()


        local function buildSkyPage()
        -- ============ Skies  (custom sky chooser) ============
        local skyPage = page()
        pages.Skies = skyPage
        local skyCard = card(skyPage, 8, 8, 692, 430)
        txt(skyCard, "Sky Changer", 20, 20, 14, 420, 28, true).ZIndex = 8
        local skydesc = txt(skyCard, "Pick a sky. It wraps the map. Clouds and weather drift across it. Get close to the big one and press E.", 13, 20, 46, 640, 20, false)
        skydesc.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 140, 160); skydesc.ZIndex = 8
        local skyStatus = txt(skyCard, "Current: Default", 13, 20, 70, 360, 20, true)
        skyStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 170, 185); skyStatus.ZIndex = 8

        local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
        local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
        local skyObj, atmoObj, gradeObj, bloomObj, raysObj
        local lifeFolder, lifeConn, mountConn
        local parkedSkies
        pcall(function()
            local oldMotion = workspace:FindFirstChild("PrismSkyMotion")
            if oldMotion then oldMotion:Destroy() end
            local terrain = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("Terrain")
            local oldClouds = terrain and terrain:FindFirstChild("PrismClouds")
            if oldClouds then oldClouds:Destroy() end
        end)

        local FACE = { "SkyboxBk", "SkyboxDn", "SkyboxFt", "SkyboxLf", "SkyboxRt", "SkyboxUp" }
        local NIGHT  = { 12064107, 12064152, 12064121, 12063984, 12064115, 12064131 }
        local CLOUD  = { 570557514, 570557775, 570557559, 570557620, 570557672, 570557727 }
        local DARK   = { 570555736, 570555964, 570555800, 570555840, 570555882, 570555929 }
        local NEBULA = { 159454299, 159454296, 159454293, 159454286, 159454300, 159454288 }
        local TWILIT = { 264908339, 264907909, 264909420, 264909758, 264908886, 264907379 }
        local ALIEN  = { 7123385217, 7123387679, 7123390433, 7123394786, 7123402505, 7123412196 }
        local VAPOR  = { 1417494030, 1417494146, 1417494253, 1417494402, 1417494499, 1417494643 }
        local SPACE  = { 149397692, 149397686, 149397697, 149397684, 149397688, 149397702 }
        local LAKE   = { 6823523318, 6823525702, 6823482923, 6823530023, 6823531746, 6823528533 }

        local function rgb(r, g, b) return Color3.fromRGB(r, g, b) end

        local ride = { on = false, seat = nil, hum = nil, origin = nil }

        if not _G._PrismColorAt then
            local PAL = {
                Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 120),
                Color3.fromRGB(255, 96, 64),
                Color3.fromRGB(255, 64, 156),
                Color3.fromRGB(154, 86, 255),
                Color3.fromRGB(64, 198, 255),
                Color3.fromRGB(72, 255, 178),
            }
            _G._PrismColorAt = function(t)
                local n = #PAL
                local x = (tonumber(t) or 0) % n
                if x < 0 then x = x + n end
                local i = math.floor(x) + 1
                local j = (i % n) + 1
                return PAL[i]:Lerp(PAL[j], x - math.floor(x))
            end
        end

        local _beatWhite = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        local _beatBase2, _beatKick2, _beatBolt2, _beatFlash2, _beatBeat2, _beatHit2
        local function _beatFixSpec()
            Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = 1
            Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = 1
        end
        local function _beatFixExp()
            if not _beatBase2 then return end
            Lighting.ExposureCompensation = (_beatBase2.exp or 0) + _beatKick2 * 0.3 + _beatBolt2 * 0.25
            if _beatBase2.fog then Lighting.FogColor = _beatBase2.fog:Lerp(_beatFlash2, math.clamp(_beatBeat2 * 0.85 + _beatHit2 * 0.3, 0, 1)) end
        end
        local _beatSky, _beatAtmo, _beatRays, _beatBloom = nil, nil, nil, nil
        if not _G._PrismBeatConn then
            local beatPunch = Lighting:FindFirstChild("PrismBeatPunch")
            if not beatPunch then
                beatPunch = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
                beatPunch.Name = "PrismBeatPunch"
                beatPunch.Parent = Lighting
            end
            _G._PrismBeatConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
                local beat = 0
                if _G._PrismSampleSongBeat then
                    beat = _G._PrismSampleSongBeat() or 0
                else
                    local song = _G._PrismSong
                    if typeof(song) == "Instance" and song.Parent and song.IsPlaying then
                        local loud = song.PlaybackLoudness or 0
                        if loud > 10 then beat = math.clamp((loud - 10) / 220, 0, 1) end
                    end
                    _G._PrismBeat = beat
                end
                if _G._PrismFuture then
                    pcall(_beatFixSpec)
                end
                if not _G._PrismSkyHold then
                    beatPunch.Brightness = 0
                    beatPunch.Contrast = 0
                    beatPunch.TintColor = _beatWhite
                    return
                end
                local base = _G._PrismSkyBase
                if not base or base.gen ~= (_G._PrismSkyGen or 0) or not base.bright then
                    return
                end
                local hit = _G._PrismHit or 0
                local kick = math.clamp(beat * beat + hit, 0, 1)
                local flash = (_G._PrismColorAt and _G._PrismColorAt(os.clock() * 1.4)) or (_G._PrismSkyTint or _beatWhite)
                local bolt = math.max(_G._PrismFlash or 0, hit)
                beatPunch.Brightness = kick * 0.2 + bolt * 0.12
                beatPunch.Contrast = beat * 0.2 + hit * 0.1
                beatPunch.Saturation = beat * 0.3
                beatPunch.TintColor = _beatWhite:Lerp(flash, math.clamp(beat * 0.5 + bolt * 0.4, 0, 0.5))
                Lighting.Brightness = base.bright + beat * 0.9 + bolt * 1.2
                Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = base.out:Lerp(flash, math.clamp(beat * 0.3 + hit * 0.15, 0, 0.4))
                Lighting.Ambient = base.amb:Lerp(flash, beat * 0.25)
                _beatBase2, _beatKick2, _beatBolt2, _beatFlash2, _beatBeat2, _beatHit2 = base, kick, bolt, flash, beat, hit
                pcall(_beatFixExp)
                if not _beatSky or not _beatSky.Parent then _beatSky = Lighting:FindFirstChild("PrismSky") end
                local sky = _beatSky
                if sky and sky:IsA("Sky") then
                    local hit = _G._PrismHit or 0
                    local yaw = ((_G._PrismSkyYaw or 0) + hit * 14) % 360
                    _G._PrismSkyYaw = yaw
                    sky.SkyboxOrientation = Vector3.new(hit * 7, yaw * 0.08, hit * 5)
                    if base.sun then sky.SunAngularSize = math.clamp(base.sun * (1 + kick * 2.2), 0, 21) end
                    sky.StarCount = math.clamp(3000 + math.floor(kick * 2000), 0, 5000)
                end
                if not _beatAtmo or not _beatAtmo.Parent then _beatAtmo = Lighting:FindFirstChild("PrismAtmo") end
                local atmo = _beatAtmo
                if atmo and atmo:IsA("Atmosphere") and base.haze then
                    atmo.Haze = math.clamp(base.haze * (1 + beat * 0.5), 0, 10)
                    atmo.Glare = math.clamp((base.glare or 0.08) + kick * 0.2, 0, 1)
                    atmo.Color = (base.atmo or atmo.Color):Lerp(flash, math.clamp(beat * 0.7, 0, 1))
                end
                if not _beatRays or not _beatRays.Parent then _beatRays = Lighting:FindFirstChild("PrismSkyRays") end
                local rays = _beatRays
                if rays and rays:IsA("SunRaysEffect") then
                    rays.Intensity = math.clamp((base.rays or 0.04) + kick * 0.25, 0, 1)
                end
                if not _beatBloom or not _beatBloom.Parent then _beatBloom = Lighting:FindFirstChild("PrismSkyBloom") end
                local bloom = _beatBloom
                if bloom and bloom:IsA("BloomEffect") and base.bloom then
                    bloom.Intensity = base.bloom * (1 + beat * 1.1 + hit * 0.5)
                    bloom.Size = 28 + kick * 12
                    bloom.Threshold = math.clamp(0.95 - beat * 0.15, 0.6, 1.1)
                end
            end)
        end

        local function clearLife()
            if ride.hum then pcall(function() ride.hum.PlatformStand = false end) end
            ride.on = false
            ride.seat = nil
            ride.hum = nil
            ride.origin = nil
            if lifeConn then pcall(function() lifeConn:Disconnect() end) lifeConn = nil end
            if mountConn then pcall(function() mountConn:Disconnect() end) mountConn = nil end
            if lifeFolder then pcall(function() lifeFolder:Destroy() end) lifeFolder = nil end
            local leftover = workspace:FindFirstChild("PrismSkyLife")
            if leftover then pcall(function() leftover:Destroy() end) end
        end

        local function clearSkyFx()
            clearLife()
            for _, name in ipairs({ "PrismSky", "PrismAtmo", "PrismSkyGrade", "PrismSkyBloom", "PrismSkyRays" }) do
                local old = Lighting:FindFirstChild(name)
                if old then pcall(function() old:Destroy() end) end
            end
            skyObj, atmoObj, gradeObj, bloomObj, raysObj = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
            if ride.motion then pcall(function() ride.motion:Disconnect() end) ride.motion = nil end
            local motion = workspace:FindFirstChild("PrismSkyMotion")
            if motion then pcall(function() motion:Destroy() end) end
            pcall(function()
                local terrain = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("Terrain")
                local clouds = terrain and terrain:FindFirstChild("PrismClouds")
                if clouds then clouds:Destroy() end
            end)
            _G._PrismSkyTint = nil
            _G._PrismSkyBase = nil
            _G._PrismFlash = 0
        end

        local function parkWorldSky()
            if parkedSkies then return end
            parkedSkies = {}
            for _, ch in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
                if ch:IsA("Sky") and ch.Name ~= "PrismSky" then
                    parkedSkies[#parkedSkies + 1] = ch
                    pcall(function() ch.Parent = nil end)
                end
            end
        end

        local function restoreWorldSky()
            if not parkedSkies then return end
            for _, s in ipairs(parkedSkies) do
                pcall(function()
                    if s and s.Parent == nil then s.Parent = Lighting end
                end)
            end
            parkedSkies = nil
        end

        local function putSky(ids, stars, sun, moon, bodies)
            parkWorldSky()
            local sky = Instance.new("Sky")
            sky.Name = "PrismSky"
            for i, face in ipairs(FACE) do
                sky[face] = "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(ids[i])
            end
            sky.StarCount = stars or 3000
            sky.SunAngularSize = math.clamp(sun or 11, 0, 14)
            sky.MoonAngularSize = math.clamp(moon or 8, 0, 12)
            sky.CelestialBodiesShown = bodies ~= false
            sky.Parent = Lighting
            skyObj = sky
        end

        local function mood(preset)
            local at = preset.at
            if at then
                local atmo = Instance.new("Atmosphere")
                atmo.Name = "PrismAtmo"
                atmo.Density = math.clamp(at[4] or 0.1, 0.02, 0.12)
                atmo.Haze = math.clamp(at[5] or 0.4, 0.05, 0.55)
                atmo.Glare = math.clamp(at[6] or 0.12, 0, 0.22)
                atmo.Color = rgb(at[1], at[2], at[3])
                atmo.Decay = rgb(at[7] or at[1], at[8] or at[2], at[9] or at[3])
                atmo.Offset = 0
                atmo.Parent = Lighting
                atmoObj = atmo
            end
            local g = preset.grade
            if g then
                local cc = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
                cc.Name = "PrismSkyGrade"
                cc.TintColor = rgb(g[1], g[2], g[3])
                cc.Contrast = math.clamp(g[4] or 0.04, -0.04, 0.08)
                cc.Saturation = math.clamp(g[5] or 0.08, -0.08, 0.22)
                cc.Brightness = math.clamp(g[6] or 0, -0.02, 0.06)
                cc.Parent = Lighting
                gradeObj = cc
            end
            if preset.bloom then
                local b = Instance.new("BloomEffect")
                b.Name = "PrismSkyBloom"
                b.Intensity = math.clamp((preset.bloom or 0.15) * 0.45, 0.03, 0.18)
                b.Size = 10
                b.Threshold = 1.05
                b.Parent = Lighting
                bloomObj = b
            end
            if preset.rays then
                local r = Instance.new("SunRaysEffect")
                r.Name = "PrismSkyRays"
                r.Intensity = math.clamp(preset.rays, 0.02, 0.14)
                r.Spread = 0.85
                r.Parent = Lighting
                raysObj = r
            end
            pcall(function()
                Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = preset.diff or 0.7
                Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = preset.spec or 1
                Lighting.ExposureCompensation = preset.exp or 0
            end)
        end

        local life = {}

        local function part(parent, size, cf, color, mat, shape)
            local p = Instance.new("Part")
            p.Size = size
            p.CFrame = cf
            p.Color = color
            p.Material = mat or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
            p.Anchored = true
            p.CanCollide = false
            p.CanQuery = false
            p.CanTouch = false
            p.CastShadow = false
            p.Massless = true
            if shape then p.Shape = shape end
            p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
            p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
            p.Parent = parent
            return p
        end

        local function puff(host, color, tex, rate)
            local pe = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
            pe.Texture = tex or "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
            pe.Rate = rate or 14
            pe.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.45, 1.1)
            pe.Speed = NumberRange.new(1, 5)
            pe.Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360)
            pe.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-40, 40)
            pe.Size = NumberSequence.new({
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1.6),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
            })
            pe.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.2, 1)
            pe.LightEmission = 0.75
            pe.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
            pe.Parent = host
            return pe
        end

        local function trail(host, color)
            local a0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
            a0.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0, -host.Size.Z * 0.45)
            a0.Parent = host
            local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
            a1.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0, host.Size.Z * 0.45)
            a1.Parent = host
            local tr = Instance.new("Trail")
            tr.Attachment0 = a0
            tr.Attachment1 = a1
            tr.Lifetime = 0.55
            tr.MinLength = 0.05
            tr.LightEmission = 0.6
            tr.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
            tr.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.25, 1)
            tr.WidthScale = NumberSequence.new(1, 0)
            tr.Parent = host
        end

        local function glow(host, color, range)
            local l = Instance.new("PointLight")
            l.Color = color
            l.Brightness = 2.2
            l.Range = range or 22
            l.Shadows = false
            l.Parent = host
        end

        local function clearRide()
            if ride.hum then pcall(function() ride.hum.PlatformStand = false end) end
            ride.on = false
            ride.seat = nil
            ride.hum = nil
            ride.origin = nil
        end

        local function shade(c, f)
            return Color3.new(
                math.clamp(c.R * f, 0, 1),
                math.clamp(c.G * f, 0, 1),
                math.clamp(c.B * f, 0, 1)
            )
        end

        local function makeHead(kind, color, accent, scale, mount)
            local m = Instance.new("Model")
            m.Name = mount and "PrismMount" or "PrismFlyer"
            local bones = {}
            local belly = shade(color, 1.35)
            local dark = shade(color, 0.62)
            local function bit(size, cf, col, shape, trans, mat)
                local p = part(m, size, cf, col or color, mat or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, shape)
                p.Transparency = trans or 0
                p.Reflectance = 0.04
                p.CastShadow = true
                return p
            end
            local function ball(size, cf, col, trans)
                return bit(size, cf, col, Enum.PartType.Ball, trans)
            end
            local function track(p, kindName, index, hinge, fromHinge, side)
                bones[#bones + 1] = {
                    part = p,
                    kind = kindName,
                    index = index or 1,
                    hinge = hinge,
                    fromHinge = fromHinge,
                    base = p.CFrame,
                    side = side or 1,
                }
            end
            local function saddle(cf)
                local seat = Instance.new("Seat")
                seat.Name = "PrismMount"
                seat.Size = Vector3.new(3.4, 0.45, 4.2) * math.clamp(scale, 1, 3)
                seat.CFrame = cf
                seat.Anchored = true
                seat.CanCollide = false
                seat.CanQuery = true
                seat.CanTouch = false
                seat.Transparency = 0.2
                seat.Color = accent
                seat.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                seat.Parent = m
                local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
                prompt.ActionText = "Mount"
                prompt.ObjectText = "Get close"
                prompt.KeyboardKeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.E
                prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 32
                prompt.HoldDuration = 0
                prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
                prompt.Enabled = false
                prompt.Parent = seat
                local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
                bb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(160, 40)
                bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 7, 0)
                bb.AlwaysOnTop = false
                bb.Enabled = false
                bb.MaxDistance = 32
                bb.Parent = seat
                local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                lbl.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
                lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
                lbl.TextSize = 16
                lbl.Text = "E  MOUNT"
                lbl.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
                lbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.35
                lbl.Parent = bb
                prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(who)
                    local players = game:GetService("Players")
                    if who ~= players.LocalPlayer then return end
                    local char = who.Character
                    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if ride.on and ride.seat == seat then
                        if hum then hum.PlatformStand = false end
                        ride.on = false
                        ride.seat = nil
                        ride.hum = nil
                        ride.origin = nil
                        prompt.ActionText = "Mount"
                        lbl.Text = "E  MOUNT"
                        return
                    end
                    if not hum then return end
                    if ride.hum and ride.hum ~= hum then pcall(function() ride.hum.PlatformStand = false end) end
                    ride.on = true
                    ride.seat = seat
                    ride.hum = hum
                    hum.PlatformStand = true
                    prompt.ActionText = "Dismount"
                    lbl.Text = "E  GET OFF"
                end)
                return seat
            end

            local root
            local seat
            local s = scale

            if kind == "whale" then
                root = ball(Vector3.new(7.2, 5.2, 11) * s, CFrame.new(), color)
                ball(Vector3.new(6.2, 4.2, 8) * s, CFrame.new(0, -0.4 * s, 2.2 * s), shade(color, 0.8))
                ball(Vector3.new(5.2, 4.4, 6) * s, CFrame.new(0, 0.5 * s, -6.2 * s), belly)
                ball(Vector3.new(1.1, 1.1, 1.1) * s, CFrame.new(1.5 * s, 1.3 * s, -8.2 * s), Color3.new(0.05, 0.05, 0.06))
                ball(Vector3.new(1.1, 1.1, 1.1) * s, CFrame.new(-1.5 * s, 1.3 * s, -8.2 * s), Color3.new(0.05, 0.05, 0.06))
                local finL = bit(Vector3.new(4.2, 0.28, 1.8) * s, CFrame.new(-3.6 * s, -0.4 * s, -2 * s), accent)
                local finR = bit(Vector3.new(4.2, 0.28, 1.8) * s, CFrame.new(3.6 * s, -0.4 * s, -2 * s), accent)
                track(finL, "fin", 1, CFrame.new(-3.6 * s, -0.4 * s, -2 * s), CFrame.new(), -1)
                track(finR, "fin", 1, CFrame.new(3.6 * s, -0.4 * s, -2 * s), CFrame.new(), 1)
                for i = 1, 5 do
                    local k = 1 - (i - 1) * 0.16
                    local tail = ball(Vector3.new(4.4 * k, 3.4 * k, 4.2 * k) * s, CFrame.new(0, -0.2 * i * s, (6 + i * 3.1) * s), shade(color, 0.9 - i * 0.06))
                    track(tail, "tail", i)
                end
                local fluke = bit(Vector3.new(6.5, 0.28, 2.2) * s, CFrame.new(0, 0.2 * s, 22 * s), accent)
                track(fluke, "tail", 6)
                puff(root, rgb(210, 230, 255), "rbxasset://textures/particles/smoke_main.dds", 5)
                if mount then seat = saddle(CFrame.new(0, 3.3 * s, -1 * s)) end
            elseif kind == "bird" or kind == "bat" or kind == "crow" then
                local wide = kind == "bat" and 1.35 or 1
                root = ball(Vector3.new(1.3, 0.85, 2.1) * s, CFrame.new(), color)
                ball(Vector3.new(0.72, 0.62, 0.72) * s, CFrame.new(0, 0.28 * s, -1.25 * s), belly)
                bit(Vector3.new(0.22, 0.16, 0.55) * s, CFrame.new(0, 0.18 * s, -1.7 * s), accent)
                ball(Vector3.new(0.16, 0.16, 0.16) * s, CFrame.new(0.16 * s, 0.38 * s, -1.45 * s), Color3.new(0.05, 0.05, 0.05))
                ball(Vector3.new(0.16, 0.16, 0.16) * s, CFrame.new(-0.16 * s, 0.38 * s, -1.45 * s), Color3.new(0.05, 0.05, 0.05))
                for i = 1, 3 do
                    local feather = bit(Vector3.new(0.35, 0.08, 0.9) * s, CFrame.new((i - 2) * 0.28 * s, 0.05 * s, 1.35 * s), dark)
                    track(feather, "tail", i)
                end
                local span = (kind == "bat" and 5.4 or kind == "crow" and 3.2 or 4.2) * s * wide
                for _, side in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
                    local hinge = CFrame.new(side * 0.55 * s, 0.15 * s, -0.15 * s)
                    local inner = bit(Vector3.new(span * 0.48, 0.08 * s, 1.15 * s), CFrame.new(), accent, nil, kind == "bat" and 0.05 or 0)
                    local outer = bit(Vector3.new(span * 0.42, 0.06 * s, 0.85 * s), CFrame.new(), shade(accent, 0.85), nil, 0.08)
                    track(inner, "wing", 0, hinge, CFrame.new(side * span * 0.26, 0, 0), side)
                    track(outer, "wing", 1, hinge, CFrame.new(side * span * 0.62, -0.05 * s, 0.08 * s), side)
                end
                if mount then seat = saddle(CFrame.new(0, 1.15 * s, 0)) end
            elseif kind == "ghost" then
                root = ball(Vector3.new(3.2, 3.6, 3.2) * s, CFrame.new(), accent, 0.4)
                root.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
                ball(Vector3.new(1.6, 1.6, 1.6) * s, CFrame.new(0, 2.2 * s, -0.2 * s), Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.25).Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
                for i = 1, 6 do
                    local wisp = ball(Vector3.new(2.4 - i * 0.28, 2.6 - i * 0.3, 2.2) * s, CFrame.new(0, -i * 1.15 * s, i * 0.35 * s), accent, 0.45 + i * 0.05)
                    wisp.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
                    track(wisp, "tail", i)
                end
                glow(root, accent, 18)
                puff(root, accent, "rbxasset://textures/particles/smoke_main.dds", 6)
                if mount then seat = saddle(CFrame.new(0, 1.2 * s, 0)) end
            elseif kind == "ender" then
                root = bit(Vector3.new(3.2, 2.2, 4.4) * s, CFrame.new(), color)
                bit(Vector3.new(2.2, 1.6, 2.4) * s, CFrame.new(0, 1.3 * s, -3.2 * s), dark)
                bit(Vector3.new(1.4, 1.1, 2.2) * s, CFrame.new(0, 1.5 * s, -5 * s), accent)
                bit(Vector3.new(0.45, 1.8, 0.45) * s, CFrame.new(0.55 * s, 2.6 * s, -3.4 * s), accent)
                bit(Vector3.new(0.45, 1.8, 0.45) * s, CFrame.new(-0.55 * s, 2.6 * s, -3.4 * s), accent)
                local eyeL = ball(Vector3.new(0.38, 0.38, 0.38) * s, CFrame.new(0.35 * s, 1.7 * s, -5.8 * s), rgb(190, 140, 255))
                local eyeR = ball(Vector3.new(0.38, 0.38, 0.38) * s, CFrame.new(-0.35 * s, 1.7 * s, -5.8 * s), rgb(190, 140, 255))
                eyeL.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                eyeR.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                for i = 1, 7 do
                    local k = 1 - (i - 1) * 0.1
                    local tail = bit(Vector3.new(2.4 * k, 1.7 * k, 2.6 * k) * s, CFrame.new(0, -0.15 * i * s, (2.6 + i * 2.3) * s), i % 2 == 0 and dark or color)
                    track(tail, "tail", i)
                end
                for _, side in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
                    local hinge = CFrame.new(side * 1.5 * s, 0.7 * s, -0.4 * s)
                    local inner = bit(Vector3.new(6.2 * s, 0.35 * s, 3.2 * s), CFrame.new(), dark)
                    local outer = bit(Vector3.new(4.4 * s, 0.28 * s, 2.2 * s), CFrame.new(), accent, nil, 0.05)
                    track(inner, "wing", 0, hinge, CFrame.new(side * 3.2 * s, 0, 0), side)
                    track(outer, "wing", 1, hinge, CFrame.new(side * 7.4 * s, -0.2 * s, 0.2 * s), side)
                end
                if mount then seat = saddle(CFrame.new(0, 1.8 * s, 0)) end
            else
                -- dragon / phoenix / serpent: overlapping body, long neck, real wing bones
                root = ball(Vector3.new(2.6, 2.05, 3.6) * s, CFrame.new(), color)
                ball(Vector3.new(2.15, 1.45, 2.8) * s, CFrame.new(0, -0.45 * s, 0.2 * s), belly)
                ball(Vector3.new(1.7, 1.45, 1.9) * s, CFrame.new(0, 0.55 * s, -2.5 * s), color)
                ball(Vector3.new(1.35, 1.2, 1.55) * s, CFrame.new(0, 1.05 * s, -3.9 * s), color)
                local head = ball(Vector3.new(1.55, 1.25, 2.05) * s, CFrame.new(0, 1.35 * s, -5.35 * s), dark)
                ball(Vector3.new(0.85, 0.55, 1.25) * s, CFrame.new(0, 1.15 * s, -6.55 * s), shade(color, 0.8))
                bit(Vector3.new(0.55, 0.22, 0.9) * s, CFrame.new(0, 0.82 * s, -6.3 * s), belly)
                local eye = rgb(255, 220, 120)
                ball(Vector3.new(0.28, 0.28, 0.28) * s, CFrame.new(0.38 * s, 1.55 * s, -6.15 * s), eye, 0).Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                ball(Vector3.new(0.28, 0.28, 0.28) * s, CFrame.new(-0.38 * s, 1.55 * s, -6.15 * s), eye, 0).Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                bit(Vector3.new(0.22, 1.15, 0.22) * s, CFrame.new(0.42 * s, 2.15 * s, -5.1 * s) * CFrame.Angles(0.4, 0, -0.5), accent)
                bit(Vector3.new(0.22, 1.15, 0.22) * s, CFrame.new(-0.42 * s, 2.15 * s, -5.1 * s) * CFrame.Angles(0.4, 0, 0.5), accent)
                for i = 1, 8 do
                    local k = 1 - (i - 1) * 0.09
                    local tail = ball(Vector3.new((2.15 * k), (1.7 * k), (2.3 * k)) * s, CFrame.new(0, -0.12 * i * s, (2.2 + i * 1.85) * s), i > 5 and dark or color)
                    track(tail, "tail", i)
                end
                local fin = bit(Vector3.new(1.6, 1.4, 0.18) * s, CFrame.new(0, 0.3 * s, (2.2 + 8 * 1.85) * s), accent, nil, 0.05)
                track(fin, "tail", 9)
                local span = (kind == "phoenix" and 8.4 or 7.2) * s
                for _, side in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
                    local hinge = CFrame.new(side * 1.15 * s, 0.45 * s, -0.35 * s)
                    local arm = bit(Vector3.new(span * 0.42, 0.22 * s, 0.55 * s), CFrame.new(), dark)
                    local hand = bit(Vector3.new(span * 0.38, 0.16 * s, 0.4 * s), CFrame.new(), shade(dark, 0.8))
                    local membrane = bit(Vector3.new(span * 0.7, 0.08 * s, 2.4 * s), CFrame.new(), accent, nil, kind == "phoenix" and 0.18 or 0.1)
                    membrane.Material = kind == "phoenix" and Enum.Material.Neon or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                    track(arm, "wing", 0, hinge, CFrame.new(side * span * 0.22, 0, 0), side)
                    track(hand, "wing", 1, hinge, CFrame.new(side * span * 0.58, -0.08 * s, 0.05 * s), side)
                    track(membrane, "wing", 0, hinge, CFrame.new(side * span * 0.36, -0.15 * s, 0.55 * s), side)
                end
                -- tucked legs so it doesn't look like a floating sausage
                bit(Vector3.new(0.35, 1.1, 0.35) * s, CFrame.new(0.7 * s, -1.15 * s, -0.4 * s), dark)
                bit(Vector3.new(0.35, 1.1, 0.35) * s, CFrame.new(-0.7 * s, -1.15 * s, -0.4 * s), dark)
                bit(Vector3.new(0.32, 0.9, 0.32) * s, CFrame.new(0.55 * s, -1.05 * s, 1.3 * s), dark)
                bit(Vector3.new(0.32, 0.9, 0.32) * s, CFrame.new(-0.55 * s, -1.05 * s, 1.3 * s), dark)
                if kind == "phoenix" then
                    puff(head, accent, "rbxasset://textures/particles/fire_main.dds", 18)
                    glow(head, accent, 26)
                else
                    puff(head, accent, "rbxasset://textures/particles/fire_main.dds", 8)
                    glow(head, accent, 16)
                end
                trail(root, accent)
                if mount then seat = saddle(CFrame.new(0, 1.7 * s, -0.2 * s)) end
            end

            m.PrimaryPart = root
            return m, bones, seat
        end

        local function makeIsland(scale, seed)
            local m = Instance.new("Model")
            m.Name = "PrismIsland"
            local S = 4 * scale
            local grassC = rgb(106, 168, 48)
            local dirtC = rgb(134, 96, 54)
            local stoneC = rgb(128, 128, 132)
            local logC = rgb(108, 84, 48)
            local leafC = rgb(58, 148, 42)
            local plankC = rgb(196, 156, 92)
            local waterC = rgb(46, 92, 214)
            local function cube(x, y, z, color, mat, tall)
                local h = tall or 1
                local p = part(m, Vector3.new(S * 0.98, S * h * 0.98, S * 0.98), CFrame.new(x * S, y * S + (h - 1) * S * 0.5, z * S), color, mat)
                p.CastShadow = true
                if not m.PrimaryPart and y == 0 then m.PrimaryPart = p end
                return p
            end
            local function filled(x, z, r)
                return x * x + z * z <= r * r
            end
            local radius = 3.1 + (seed % 2) * 0.4
            for x = -4, 4 do
                for z = -4, 4 do
                    if filled(x, z, radius) then
                        cube(x, 0, z, grassC, Enum.Material.Grass)
                        cube(x, -1, z, dirtC, Enum.Material.Ground)
                        if filled(x, z, radius - 0.8) then
                            cube(x, -2, z, dirtC, Enum.Material.Ground)
                        end
                        if filled(x, z, radius - 1.5) then
                            cube(x, -3, z, stoneC, Enum.Material.Slate)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            cube(0, -4, 0, stoneC, Enum.Material.Slate)
            cube(1, -4, 0, stoneC, Enum.Material.Slate)
            cube(0, -5, 0, stoneC, Enum.Material.Slate)
            local oreCol = (seed % 2 == 0) and rgb(64, 214, 196) or rgb(232, 196, 48)
            local ore = cube(1, -3, 1, oreCol, Enum.Material.Neon)
            glow(ore, oreCol, 6)
            local function tree(tx, tz, h)
                for n = 1, h do
                    cube(tx, n, tz, logC, Enum.Material.Wood)
                end
                for ox = -2, 2 do
                    for oz = -2, 2 do
                        if math.abs(ox) + math.abs(oz) <= 3 then
                            cube(tx + ox, h, tz + oz, leafC, Enum.Material.Grass)
                        end
                    end
                end
                for ox = -1, 1 do
                    for oz = -1, 1 do
                        cube(tx + ox, h + 1, tz + oz, leafC, Enum.Material.Grass)
                    end
                end
                cube(tx, h + 2, tz, leafC, Enum.Material.Grass)
            end
            tree(0, -1, 4 + (seed % 2))
            if seed % 2 == 0 then
                tree(-2, 2, 3)
            end
            if seed % 4 == 1 then
                for x = 2, 4 do
                    for z = -1, 1 do
                        cube(x, 1, z, plankC, Enum.Material.Wood)
                    end
                end
                cube(2, 2, -1, plankC, Enum.Material.Wood)
                cube(2, 2, 1, plankC, Enum.Material.Wood)
                cube(4, 2, -1, plankC, Enum.Material.Wood)
                cube(4, 2, 1, plankC, Enum.Material.Wood)
                cube(3, 2, 0, rgb(196, 220, 235), Enum.Material.Glass)
                cube(3, 3, 0, plankC, Enum.Material.Wood)
                cube(2, 3, 0, plankC, Enum.Material.Wood)
                cube(4, 3, 0, plankC, Enum.Material.Wood)
            elseif seed % 4 == 3 then
                for y = 1, 4 do
                    cube(3, y, -1, rgb(22, 14, 32), Enum.Material.Slate)
                    cube(3, y, 1, rgb(22, 14, 32), Enum.Material.Slate)
                end
                cube(3, 5, -1, rgb(22, 14, 32), Enum.Material.Slate)
                cube(3, 5, 0, rgb(22, 14, 32), Enum.Material.Slate)
                cube(3, 5, 1, rgb(22, 14, 32), Enum.Material.Slate)
                cube(3, 3, 0, rgb(22, 14, 32), Enum.Material.Slate)
            else
                cube(2, 0, 1, waterC, Enum.Material.Glass)
                cube(2, 0, 2, waterC, Enum.Material.Glass)
                local pond = cube(3, 0, 1, waterC, Enum.Material.Glass)
                pond.Transparency = 0.25
            end
            local edgeX = math.floor(radius)
            for n = 0, 9 do
                local fall = cube(edgeX, -n, 0, waterC, Enum.Material.Glass)
                fall.Transparency = 0.3
                fall.CastShadow = false
            end
            local lip = cube(edgeX, 0, 0, waterC, Enum.Material.Glass)
            lip.Transparency = 0.2
            puff(lip, rgb(200, 230, 255), "rbxasset://textures/particles/smoke_main.dds", 6)
            local post = cube(-2, 1, -2, logC, Enum.Material.Wood)
            local lamp = part(m, Vector3.new(S * 0.45, S * 0.55, S * 0.45), CFrame.new(-2 * S, 1.9 * S, -2 * S), rgb(255, 186, 70), Enum.Material.Neon)
            glow(lamp, rgb(255, 170, 50), 14)
            cube(1, 1, 2, rgb(214, 48, 56), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
            cube(-1, 1, 2, rgb(255, 220, 70), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
            cube(0, 1, 2, rgb(255, 255, 255), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
            for i = 1, 7 do
                local cloud = part(m, Vector3.new(S * (2.2 + (i % 3)), S * 0.9, S * (1.6 + (i % 2))), CFrame.new((i - 4) * S * 0.7, -7.2 * S, ((i % 3) - 1) * S * 0.55), rgb(250, 252, 255), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Enum.PartType.Ball)
                cloud.Name = "PrismCloud"
                cloud.Transparency = 0.08
                cloud.CastShadow = false
            end
            cube(2, -6, 1, stoneC, Enum.Material.Slate)
            cube(-1, -6, -1, stoneC, Enum.Material.Slate)
            cube(0, -6, 1, dirtC, Enum.Material.Ground)
            local chest = part(m, Vector3.new(S * 0.8, S * 0.6, S * 0.5), CFrame.new(-1 * S, 0.8 * S, 1.4 * S), rgb(120, 78, 36), Enum.Material.Wood)
            chest.CastShadow = true
            part(m, Vector3.new(S * 0.84, S * 0.12, S * 0.52), CFrame.new(-1 * S, 1.05 * S, 1.4 * S), rgb(92, 58, 28), Enum.Material.Wood)
            for _, d in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do
                if d:IsA("BasePart") and d.Name ~= "PrismCloud" then
                    d.CanCollide = true
                    d.CanQuery = true
                    d.CanTouch = true
                end
            end
            if not m.PrimaryPart then
                m.PrimaryPart = m:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
            end
            return m
        end

        local function push(model, radius, height, speed, phase, bones, seat, mode)
            life[#life + 1] = {
                model = model,
                radius = radius,
                height = height,
                speed = speed,
                phase = phase,
                bob = 0.55,
                bobAmp = mode == "island" and 6 or 5,
                bones = bones,
                seat = seat,
                flapHz = mode == "bat" and 7.5 or mode == "bird" and 4.2 or 2.1,
                amp = mode == "bat" and 0.85 or mode == "bird" and 0.65 or 0.42,
                mode = mode or "fly",
            }
        end

        local meshCache = {}
        local MESH_IDS = {
            dragon = { 259354522, 4856318970, 16846561797 },
            phoenix = { 130572527, 16846561797 },
            bird = { 338570948, 238756392 },
            crow = { 338570948, 238756392 },
            whale = { 5478035643, 5202614458 },
            ghost = { 303025714, 1805939 },
            bat = { 4856318970, 259354522 },
            ender = { 6711262979, 259354522 },
        }

        local function unwrapAsset(inst)
            if typeof(inst) ~= "Instance" then return nil end
            if inst:IsA("Model") then
                local kids = inst:GetChildren()
                if #kids == 1 and kids[1]:IsA("Model") then return kids[1] end
            end
            return inst
        end

        local function fetchAsset(id)
            local url = "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(id)
            local function first(res)
                if typeof(res) == "Instance" then return unwrapAsset(res) end
                if type(res) == "table" then return unwrapAsset(res[1]) end
            end
            if type(getobjects) == "function" then
                local ok, res = pcall(getobjects, url)
                local inst = ok and first(res)
                if inst then return inst end
            end
            local ok, res = pcall(function()
                if type(game.GetObjects) == "function" then
                    return game:GetObjects(url)
                end
            end)
            local inst = ok and first(res)
            if inst then return inst end
            local ok2, loaded = pcall(function()
                return game:GetService("InsertService"):LoadAsset(id)
            end)
            if ok2 then return unwrapAsset(loaded) or loaded end
        end

        local function prepareMesh(id, length)
            if meshCache[id] == "bad" then return nil end
            if meshCache[id] then return meshCache[id] end
            local src = fetchAsset(id)
            if not src then return nil end
            local model = src
            if not model:IsA("Model") then
                local wrap = Instance.new("Model")
                model.Parent = wrap
                model = wrap
            end
            local parts = 0
            for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
                if d:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or d:IsA("Humanoid") or d:IsA("ClickDetector") or d:IsA("ProximityPrompt") or d:IsA("BillboardGui") or d:IsA("SurfaceGui") or d:IsA("Sound") or d:IsA("Dialog") then
                    d:Destroy()
                elseif d:IsA("BasePart") then
                    parts = parts + 1
                    d.Anchored = true
                    d.CanCollide = false
                    d.CanQuery = false
                    d.CanTouch = false
                    d.Massless = true
                end
            end
            if parts == 0 or parts > 900 then
                model:Destroy()
                meshCache[id] = "bad"
                return nil
            end
            model:PivotTo(CFrame.new())
            local pre = model:GetExtentsSize()
            local thin = math.min(pre.X, pre.Y, pre.Z)
            local wide = math.max(pre.X, pre.Y, pre.Z)
            if wide > 0 and thin / wide < 0.12 then
                model:Destroy()
                meshCache[id] = "bad"
                return nil
            end
            local best, vol
            for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
                if d:IsA("BasePart") then
                    local v = d.Size.X * d.Size.Y * d.Size.Z
                    if not best or v > vol then best, vol = d, v end
                end
            end
            if best then model.PrimaryPart = best end
            pcall(function()
                model:PivotTo(CFrame.new())
                local size = model:GetExtentsSize()
                local longest = math.max(size.X, size.Y, size.Z)
                if longest > 0.5 then
                    model:ScaleTo(model:GetScale() * (length / longest))
                end
            end)
            model:PivotTo(CFrame.new())
            local size = model:GetExtentsSize()
            local face = CFrame.new()
            for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
                if d:IsA("BasePart") and not d:IsA("Seat") then
                    local n = string.lower(d.Name)
                    if n == "baseplate" or n == "base" or string.find(n, "spawn", 1, true) then
                        d:Destroy()
                    end
                end
            end
            meshCache[id] = { model = model, face = face }
            return meshCache[id]
        end

        local function meshFor(kind, length)
            local ids = MESH_IDS[kind] or MESH_IDS.dragon
            for _, id in ipairs(ids) do
                local got = prepareMesh(id, length)
                if got then return got end
            end
        end

        local function addSeat(model, accent)
            local cf, size = model:GetBoundingBox()
            local seat = Instance.new("Seat")
            seat.Name = "PrismMount"
            seat.Size = Vector3.new(math.clamp(size.X * 0.35, 1.6, 3.2), 0.3, math.clamp(size.Z * 0.35, 1.6, 3.2))
            seat.CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(0, size.Y * 0.35, 0)
            seat.Anchored = true
            seat.CanCollide = false
            seat.CanQuery = true
            seat.CanTouch = false
            seat.Transparency = 1
            seat.Parent = model
            local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
            prompt.ActionText = "Mount"
            prompt.ObjectText = "Mount"
            prompt.KeyboardKeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.E
            prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 14
            prompt.HoldDuration = 0
            prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
            prompt.Enabled = false
            prompt.Parent = seat
            local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
            bb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(140, 36)
            bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, size.Y * 0.5 + 1.5, 0)
            bb.AlwaysOnTop = false
            bb.Enabled = false
            bb.MaxDistance = 32
            bb.Parent = seat
            local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
            lbl.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 10, 16)
            lbl.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
            lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            lbl.TextSize = 15
            lbl.Text = "E  MOUNT"
            lbl.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            lbl.Parent = bb
            local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
            corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
            corner.Parent = lbl
            prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(who)
                local players = game:GetService("Players")
                if who ~= players.LocalPlayer then return end
                local char = who.Character
                local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if ride.on and ride.seat == seat then
                    if hum then hum.PlatformStand = false end
                    ride.on = false
                    ride.seat = nil
                    ride.hum = nil
                    ride.origin = nil
                    prompt.ActionText = "Mount"
                    lbl.Text = "E  MOUNT"
                    return
                end
                if not hum or not prompt.Enabled then return end
                if ride.hum and ride.hum ~= hum then pcall(function() ride.hum.PlatformStand = false end) end
                ride.on = true
                ride.seat = seat
                ride.hum = hum
                hum.PlatformStand = true
                prompt.ActionText = "Dismount"
                lbl.Text = "E  GET OFF"
            end)
            return seat
        end

        local function tintModel(model, color, accent)
            for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
                if d:IsA("Highlight") or d:IsA("SelectionBox") then
                    d:Destroy()
                end
            end
            local body = model.PrimaryPart or model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
            if body and not body:FindFirstChild("PrismBodyLight") then
                local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
                light.Name = "PrismBodyLight"
                light.Color = color:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.25)
                light.Brightness = 1.4
                light.Range = 36
                light.Parent = body
            end
        end
