        ride.rigWings = function(model, accent, color)
            local pivot = model:GetPivot()
            local _, size = model:GetBoundingBox()
            local reach = math.clamp(math.max(size.X, size.Z) * 0.42, 7, 16)
            local wings = {}
            local function sideWing(side)
                local segs = 5
                for i = 1, segs do
                    local along = (i - 0.35) / segs
                    local chord = reach * (0.72 - along * 0.38)
                    local membrane = Instance.new("Part")
                    membrane.Name = "PrismWing"
                    membrane.Size = Vector3.new(reach / segs * 0.98, 0.16, math.max(chord, 1.2))
                    membrane.Color = color:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(18, 16, 20), 0.25)
                    membrane.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                    membrane.Transparency = 0.12
                    membrane.Anchored = true
                    membrane.CanCollide = false
                    membrane.CanQuery = false
                    membrane.CanTouch = false
                    membrane.CastShadow = true
                    membrane.Parent = model
                    local edge = Instance.new("Part")
                    edge.Name = "PrismWingEdge"
                    edge.Size = Vector3.new(reach / segs * 1.02, 0.34, 0.34)
                    edge.Color = accent
                    edge.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                    edge.Anchored = true
                    edge.CanCollide = false
                    edge.CanQuery = false
                    edge.CanTouch = false
                    edge.CastShadow = false
                    edge.Parent = model
                    wings[#wings + 1] = {
                        membrane = membrane,
                        edge = edge,
                        side = side,
                        index = i,
                        along = along,
                    }
                end
                local claw = Instance.new("Part")
                claw.Name = "PrismWingClaw"
                claw.Size = Vector3.new(0.45, 0.45, 1.1)
                claw.Color = Color3.fromRGB(230, 220, 200)
                claw.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                claw.Anchored = true
                claw.CanCollide = false
                claw.CanQuery = false
                claw.Parent = model
                wings[#wings + 1] = { claw = claw, side = side, index = segs, along = 1, tip = true }
            end
            sideWing(1)
            sideWing(-1)
            return { list = wings, reach = reach }
        end

        ride.poseWings = function(rig, cf, t, phase)
            if not rig then return 0 end
            local beat = 1 + (_G._PrismBeat or 0) * 1.7
            local cycle = t * 2.6 * beat + phase
            local period = math.pi * 2
            local wrapped = cycle % period
            local flap
            if wrapped < 1.15 then
                flap = math.cos(wrapped / 1.15 * math.pi)
            else
                local u = (wrapped - 1.15) / (period - 1.15)
                flap = -1 + u * 2
            end
            local glide = math.sin(t * 0.33 + phase) > 0.55
            local lift = (glide and 0.22 or flap * 0.95) * beat
            for _, w in ipairs(rig.list) do
                local wave = lift * (1 - w.along * 0.25) + math.sin(cycle - w.along * 0.8) * (glide and 0.02 or 0.12)
                local shoulder = cf * CFrame.new(w.side * 1.4, 0.35, 0)
                local swept = shoulder * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, w.side * wave) * CFrame.new(w.side * rig.reach * w.along, -math.abs(wave) * w.along * 0.6, w.along * 0.4)
                if w.tip then
                    w.claw.CFrame = swept * CFrame.Angles(0.4, 0, 0)
                else
                    w.membrane.CFrame = swept * CFrame.Angles(0.25 + wave * 0.15, w.side * 0.18, 0)
                    w.edge.CFrame = w.membrane.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.12, -w.membrane.Size.Z * 0.48)
                end
            end
            return glide and 0 or flap
        end

        ride.captureWings = function(model)
            local pivot = model:GetPivot()
            local _, size = model:GetBoundingBox()
            local half = math.max(size.X * 0.5, 1)
            local wings = {}
            for _, p in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
                if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Transparency < 0.95 and not string.find(p.Name, "Prism", 1, true) then
                    local localPos = pivot:PointToObjectSpace(p.Position)
                    local named = string.find(string.lower(p.Name), "wing", 1, true) ~= nil
                    if named or math.abs(localPos.X) > half * 0.46 then
                        local side = localPos.X >= 0 and 1 or -1
                        wings[#wings + 1] = {
                            part = p,
                            rest = pivot:ToObjectSpace(p.CFrame),
                            side = side,
                            along = math.clamp(math.abs(localPos.X) / half, 0, 1.4),
                        }
                    end
                end
            end
            if #wings < 2 then return nil end
            return wings
        end

        ride.poseMeshWings = function(model, wings, t, phase)
            if not wings then return end
            local pivot = model:GetPivot()
            local beat = 1 + (_G._PrismBeat or 0) * 0.65
            local cycle = t * 3.1 * beat + phase
            local s = math.sin(cycle)
            local flap = (s >= 0 and s * 0.42 or s * 0.78)
            for _, w in ipairs(wings) do
                if w.part and w.part.Parent then
                    local amp = flap * (0.25 + w.along * 0.7)
                    w.part.CFrame = pivot * CFrame.Angles(amp * 0.15, 0, w.side * amp) * w.rest
                end
            end
        end

        ride.tryMesh = function(kind, color, accent)
            if true then return nil end
            local ids = { 9932775928, 5472478735 }
            if kind == "ender" then
                ids = { 5472478735, 6711262979 }
            elseif kind == "phoenix" then
                ids = { 5472478735 }
            end
            local function fetch(id)
                local asset = "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(id)
                local ok, result = false, nil
                if type(getobjects) == "function" then
                    ok, result = pcall(getobjects, asset)
                    if not ok or type(result) ~= "table" then
                        ok, result = pcall(getobjects, game, asset)
                    end
                end
                if not ok or type(result) ~= "table" then
                    ok, result = pcall(function()
                        return game:GetObjects(asset)
                    end)
                end
                if not ok or type(result) ~= "table" then return nil end
                return result[1]
            end
            for _, id in ipairs(ids) do
                local inst = fetch(id)
                if inst then
                    local model = inst
                    if not model:IsA("Model") then
                        local wrap = Instance.new("Model")
                        model.Parent = wrap
                        model = wrap
                    end
                    model.Name = "PrismMount"
                    local junk = {}
                    for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
                        if d:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or d:IsA("Sound") or d:IsA("Tool") or d:IsA("Humanoid") or d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or d:IsA("Fire") or d:IsA("Smoke") or d:IsA("Sparkles") or d:IsA("Highlight") or d:IsA("SelectionBox") then
                            junk[#junk + 1] = d
                        end
                    end
                    for _, d in ipairs(junk) do
                        d:Destroy()
                    end
                    local parts = {}
                    for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
                        if d:IsA("BasePart") then
                            parts[#parts + 1] = d
                            d.Anchored = true
                            d.CanCollide = false
                            d.CanTouch = false
                            d.CanQuery = false
                            d.Massless = true
                        end
                    end
                    local mags = {}
                    for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
                        mags[#mags + 1] = p.Size.Magnitude
                    end
                    table.sort(mags)
                    local mid = mags[math.max(1, math.ceil(#mags * 0.5))] or 4
                    local drop = {}
                    for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
                        local n = string.lower(p.Name)
                        local mag = p.Size.Magnitude
                        local ball = p:IsA("Part") and p.Shape == Enum.PartType.Ball
                        local named = string.find(n, "fire", 1, true) or string.find(n, "orb", 1, true) or string.find(n, "ball", 1, true) or string.find(n, "explosion", 1, true) or string.find(n, "projectile", 1, true) or string.find(n, "blast", 1, true)
                        local roundish = false
                        if p:IsA("Part") then
                            local s = p.Size
                            local big = math.max(s.X, s.Y, s.Z)
                            local small = math.min(s.X, s.Y, s.Z)
                            roundish = small > 0 and big / small < 1.7
                        end
                        if named or (ball and mag > mid * 1.5) or (roundish and mag > mid * 2.2) then
                            drop[#drop + 1] = p
                        end
                    end
                    for _, p in ipairs(drop) do
                        p:Destroy()
                    end
                    local meshCount, partCount = 0, 0
                    for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
                        if d:IsA("BasePart") then
                            partCount = partCount + 1
                            if d:IsA("MeshPart") or d:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh") then
                                meshCount = meshCount + 1
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if partCount < 1 or (meshCount < 1 and partCount < 6) then
                        model:Destroy()
                    else
                        model.WorldPivot = model:GetBoundingBox()
                        model:PivotTo(CFrame.new())
                        local function points()
                            local pts = {}
                            for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
                                if d:IsA("BasePart") and d.Transparency < 0.92 then
                                    pts[#pts + 1] = d.Position
                                end
                            end
                            return pts
                        end
                        local pts = points()
                        local hi, lo = 0, 0
                        for _, p in ipairs(pts) do
                            if p.Y >= 0 then hi = hi + 1 else lo = lo + 1 end
                        end
                        if lo > hi * 1.2 and lo > 3 then
                            model:PivotTo(CFrame.Angles(math.pi, 0, 0))
                            pts = points()
                        end
                        local _, size = model:GetBoundingBox()
                        local longest = math.max(size.X, size.Y, size.Z)
                        if longest > 0.4 and longest < 4000 then
                            pcall(function()
                                model:ScaleTo(model:GetScale() * (78 / longest))
                            end)
                        end
                        local _, size2 = model:GetBoundingBox()
                        for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
                            if d:IsA("BasePart") then
                                local tex = ""
                                if d:IsA("MeshPart") then tex = d.TextureID or "" end
                                local sm = d:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
                                if sm and sm.TextureId ~= "" then tex = sm.TextureId end
                                if tex == "" then
                                    d.Color = color
                                    d.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                                end
                                d.Reflectance = 0.04
                                local lum = d.Color.R * 0.3 + d.Color.G * 0.59 + d.Color.B * 0.11
                                if lum < 0.28 then
                                    d.Color = d.Color:Lerp(color, 0.78)
                                end
                                if d.Material == Enum.Material.ForceField or d.Material == Enum.Material.Glass then
                                    d.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                                end
                                d.CastShadow = true
                            end
                        end
                        local lamp = Instance.new("Part")
                        lamp.Name = "PrismBodyLight"
                        lamp.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
                        lamp.Transparency = 1
                        lamp.Anchored = true
                        lamp.CanCollide = false
                        lamp.CanQuery = false
                        lamp.CanTouch = false
                        lamp.Parent = model
                        local bodyLight = Instance.new("PointLight")
                        bodyLight.Color = color:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.3)
                        bodyLight.Brightness = 2.2
                        bodyLight.Range = 48
                        bodyLight.Parent = lamp
                        pts = points()
                        local head = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
                        local bestScore = -1e9
                        for _, p in ipairs(pts) do
                            local flat = Vector3.new(p.X, 0, p.Z)
                            local dist = flat.Magnitude
                            if dist > 1.2 then
                                local dir = flat.Unit
                                local opp, cluster = 0, 0
                                for _, q in ipairs(pts) do
                                    local qf = Vector3.new(q.X, 0, q.Z)
                                    if qf.Magnitude > 1.2 and qf.Unit:Dot(dir) < -0.5 then
                                        opp = opp + 1
                                    end
                                    if (q - p).Magnitude < dist * 0.38 then
                                        cluster = cluster + 1
                                    end
                                end
                                local score = cluster * 3 + math.max(p.Y, 0) * 0.35 - opp * 0.45
                                if score > bestScore then
                                    bestScore = score
                                    head = flat
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        if head.Magnitude < 0.2 then head = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end
                        local face = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(), head.Unit):Inverse()
                        local seat = Instance.new("Seat")
                        seat.Name = "PrismMount"
                        seat.Size = Vector3.new(3.2, 0.4, 3.4)
                        seat.Anchored = true
                        seat.CanCollide = false
                        seat.CanQuery = true
                        seat.CanTouch = false
                        seat.Transparency = 1
                        seat.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, size2.Y * 0.16, 0)
                        seat.Parent = model
                        local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
                        prompt.ActionText = "Mount"
                        prompt.ObjectText = kind == "ender" and "Ender Dragon" or (kind == "phoenix" and "Phoenix" or "Dragon")
                        prompt.KeyboardKeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.E
                        prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 18
                        prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
                        prompt.Enabled = false
                        prompt.Parent = seat
                        local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
                        bb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(140, 36)
                        bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 6, 0)
                        bb.Enabled = false
                        bb.MaxDistance = 40
                        bb.Parent = seat
                        local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                        lbl.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
                        lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
                        lbl.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 10, 16)
                        lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
                        lbl.TextSize = 14
                        lbl.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
                        lbl.Text = "E  MOUNT"
                        lbl.Parent = bb
                        local mouth = Instance.new("Part")
                        mouth.Name = "PrismMouth"
                        mouth.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
                        mouth.Transparency = 1
                        mouth.Anchored = true
                        mouth.CanCollide = false
                        mouth.CanQuery = false
                        mouth.CanTouch = false
                        mouth.CFrame = CFrame.new(head.Unit * (head.Magnitude + 1.2))
                        mouth.Parent = model
                        local pe = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
                        pe.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/fire_main.dds"
                        pe.Rate = 0
                        pe.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.35, 0.8)
                        pe.Speed = NumberRange.new(40, 72)
                        pe.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(11, 11)
                        pe.LightEmission = 1
                        pe.Size = NumberSequence.new({
                            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1.6),
                            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.35, 5.2),
                            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.4),
                        })
                        pe.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.05, 1)
                        pe.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 236, 170), accent)
                        pe.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Front
                        pe.Parent = mouth
                        local flame = Instance.new("Part")
                        flame.Name = "PrismFlame"
                        flame.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
                        flame.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                        flame.Color = accent
                        flame.Size = Vector3.new(2.2, 2.2, 3.2)
                        flame.Transparency = 1
                        flame.Anchored = true
                        flame.CanCollide = false
                        flame.CanQuery = false
                        flame.CFrame = mouth.CFrame
                        flame.Parent = model
                        local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
                        light.Color = accent
                        light.Brightness = 0
                        light.Range = 24
                        light.Parent = flame
                        ride.lastRig = nil
                        ride.lastSpine = nil
                        ride.lastFace = face
                        ride.lastWings = ride.captureWings(model)
                        ride.lastBreath = { emitter = pe, flame = flame, light = light }
                        return model, seat
                    end
                end
            end
            return nil
        end

        ride.buildMount = function(kind, color, accent)
            local meshed, meshSeat = ride.tryMesh(kind, color, accent)
            if meshed then
                return meshed, nil, meshSeat
            end
            ride.lastFace = CFrame.new()
            ride.lastWings = nil
            local m = Instance.new("Model")
            m.Name = "PrismMount"
            local ender = kind == "ender"
            local phoenix = kind == "phoenix"
            local hide = color
            local belly = color:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(232, 214, 190), 0.62)
            local leather = phoenix and accent:Lerp(hide, 0.22) or hide:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(28, 18, 16), 0.42)
            local hornCol = Color3.fromRGB(92, 78, 62):Lerp(accent, ender and 0.5 or 0.22)
            local scaleCol = hide:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.38)
            local ivory = Color3.fromRGB(236, 228, 210)
            local function bit(size, cf, col, shape, mat)
                local p = part(m, size, cf, col or hide, mat or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, shape)
                p.CastShadow = true
                return p
            end
            local function box(sx, sy, sz, col, mat)
                return bit(Vector3.new(sx, sy, sz), CFrame.new(), col, nil, mat)
            end
            local function tube(length, diameter, col, mat)
                return bit(Vector3.new(length, diameter, diameter), CFrame.new(), col, Enum.PartType.Cylinder, mat)
            end
            local function ball(d, col, mat)
                return bit(Vector3.new(d, d, d), CFrame.new(), col, Enum.PartType.Ball, mat)
            end
            local rig = { stuck = {}, neck = {}, tail = {}, wings = {}, headExtras = {} }
            local function stick(p, offset)
                rig.stuck[#rig.stuck + 1] = { part = p, offset = offset }
            end
            local chest = box(9, 6.4, 15, hide)
            rig.chest = chest
            stick(box(7.4, 2.2, 11, belly), CFrame.new(0, -2.5, 0.6))
            stick(box(2.4, 1.2, 9, scaleCol), CFrame.new(0, 3.5, -0.4))
            stick(box(3.6, 3.2, 4.4, hide), CFrame.new(-5.2, 1.1, -2.2))
            stick(box(3.6, 3.2, 4.4, hide), CFrame.new(5.2, 1.1, -2.2))
            for i = 1, 4 do
                local w = 5.4 - i * 0.55
                local seg = { part = box(w, w * 0.82, w * 1.2, hide), extras = {} }
                rig.neck[i] = seg
            end
            local function headBit(p, offset)
                rig.headExtras[#rig.headExtras + 1] = { part = p, offset = offset }
            end
            headBit(box(5.2, 4.2, 5.4, hide), CFrame.new(0, 0.6, -2.4))
            headBit(box(2.8, 2.2, 6.8, hide), CFrame.new(0, 0.1, -7.2))
            headBit(box(2.4, 1.15, 4.6, belly), CFrame.new(0, -1.35, -6.2))
            for side = -1, 1, 2 do
                headBit(tube(4.4, 0.72, hornCol), CFrame.new(side * 1.7, 2.8, -0.6) * CFrame.Angles(0.2, 0, side * 0.95))
                headBit(tube(2.4, 0.4, hornCol), CFrame.new(side * 2.2, 1.1, -4.2) * CFrame.Angles(0.1, 0, side * 1.1))
            end
            local eyeL = ball(1.35, accent, Enum.Material.Neon)
            local eyeR = ball(1.35, accent, Enum.Material.Neon)
            glow(eyeL, accent, 10)
            glow(eyeR, accent, 10)
            headBit(eyeL, CFrame.new(-1.5, 1.15, -4.2))
            headBit(eyeR, CFrame.new(1.5, 1.15, -4.2))
            headBit(ball(0.45, Color3.new(0.02, 0.02, 0.02)), CFrame.new(-1.5, 1.15, -4.8))
            headBit(ball(0.45, Color3.new(0.02, 0.02, 0.02)), CFrame.new(1.5, 1.15, -4.8))
            for i = 1, 8 do
                local w = math.max(4.8 - i * 0.48, 0.7)
                local seg = { part = box(w, w * 0.62, w * 1.35, hide), extras = {} }
                rig.tail[i] = seg
            end
            rig.tail[8].extras[1] = { part = box(0.3, 3.2, 2.2, leather), offset = CFrame.new(-0.8, 0.4, 0.2) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0.6) }
            rig.tail[8].extras[2] = { part = box(0.3, 3.2, 2.2, leather), offset = CFrame.new(0.8, 0.4, 0.2) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -0.6) }
            local function makeWing(side)
                local wing = { side = side, parts = {} }
                local function wpart(p, offset, lag)
                    wing.parts[#wing.parts + 1] = { part = p, offset = offset, lag = lag or 0 }
                end
                wpart(tube(16, 0.85, hornCol), CFrame.new(side * 9, 0.2, -1), 0)
                wpart(tube(12, 0.55, hornCol), CFrame.new(side * 20, -0.6, 2) * CFrame.Angles(0, side * 0.35, 0), 0.2)
                local skin = box(14, 0.28, 16, leather)
                skin.Transparency = 0.04
                wpart(skin, CFrame.new(side * 12, -0.3, 0.5), 0.08)
                local skin2 = box(10, 0.24, 11, leather)
                skin2.Transparency = 0.08
                wpart(skin2, CFrame.new(side * 22, -1, 3), 0.22)
                rig.wings[#rig.wings + 1] = wing
            end
            makeWing(1)
            makeWing(-1)
            local function leg(side, z, back)
                local x = side * (back and 3.8 or 4.6)
                local hip = back and -1 or 1.2
                stick(ball(3.3, hide), CFrame.new(x, hip, z))
                stick(tube(6.2, 1.55, hide), CFrame.new(x, hip - 4.2, z) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -math.pi / 2))
                stick(ball(2.2, hide), CFrame.new(x, hip - 7.4, z + 0.4))
                stick(tube(5.4, 1.05, hide), CFrame.new(x, hip - 10.2, z + 0.8) * CFrame.Angles(0.25, 0, -math.pi / 2))
                stick(ball(1.7, hide), CFrame.new(x, hip - 12.4, z - 0.6))
                stick(bit(Vector3.new(0.22, 0.22, 1.5), CFrame.new(), ivory), CFrame.new(x - 0.45, hip - 12.6, z - 1.8))
                stick(bit(Vector3.new(0.22, 0.22, 1.7), CFrame.new(), ivory), CFrame.new(x, hip - 12.6, z - 2))
                stick(bit(Vector3.new(0.22, 0.22, 1.4), CFrame.new(), ivory), CFrame.new(x + 0.45, hip - 12.6, z - 1.7))
            end
            leg(1, -3.5, false)
            leg(-1, -3.5, false)
            leg(1, 6.5, true)
            leg(-1, 6.5, true)
            local seat = Instance.new("Seat")
            seat.Name = "PrismMount"
            seat.Size = Vector3.new(3.4, 0.4, 3.6)
            seat.Anchored = true
            seat.CanCollide = false
            seat.CanQuery = true
            seat.CanTouch = false
            seat.Transparency = 1
            seat.Parent = m
            local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
            prompt.ActionText = "Mount"
            prompt.ObjectText = ender and "Ender Dragon" or (phoenix and "Phoenix" or "Dragon")
            prompt.KeyboardKeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.E
            prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 18
            prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
            prompt.Enabled = false
            prompt.Parent = seat
            local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
            bb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(140, 36)
            bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 7, 0)
            bb.Enabled = false
            bb.MaxDistance = 36
            bb.Parent = seat
            local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            lbl.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
            lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
            lbl.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 10, 16)
            lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            lbl.TextSize = 14
            lbl.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            lbl.Text = "E  MOUNT"
            lbl.Parent = bb
            stick(seat, CFrame.new(0, 8.2, -1))
            local mouth = bit(Vector3.new(1, 1, 1), CFrame.new(), hide)
            mouth.Transparency = 1
            mouth.Name = "PrismMouth"
            local pe = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
            pe.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/fire_main.dds"
            pe.Rate = 0
            pe.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.4, 0.9)
            pe.Speed = NumberRange.new(42, 74)
            pe.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(10, 10)
            pe.LightEmission = 1
            pe.Size = NumberSequence.new({
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1.8),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.3, 5.5),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.5),
            })
            pe.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.04, 1)
            pe.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 244, 190), accent)
            pe.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Front
            pe.Parent = mouth
            local flame = bit(Vector3.new(2.4, 2.4, 4.2), CFrame.new(), accent, Enum.PartType.Ball, Enum.Material.Neon)
            flame.Transparency = 1
            flame.Name = "PrismFlame"
            local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
            light.Color = accent
            light.Brightness = 0
            light.Range = 26
            light.Parent = flame
            headBit(mouth, CFrame.new(0, -1.1, -12.2))
            headBit(flame, CFrame.new(0, -1.1, -14.2))
            ride.lastRig = rig
            ride.lastSpine = rig
            ride.lastSpan = nil
            ride.lastBreath = { emitter = pe, flame = flame, light = light }
            m.WorldPivot = CFrame.new()
            return m, nil, seat
        end

        ride.poseSpine = function(e, cf, t)
            local rig = e.rig or e.spine
            if not rig or not rig.chest then return end
            local phase = e.phase or 0
            rig.chest.CFrame = cf
            for _, s in ipairs(rig.stuck) do
                s.part.CFrame = cf * s.offset
            end
            local prev = cf
            local neckN = #rig.neck
            for i, seg in ipairs(rig.neck) do
                local along = i / neckN
                local sway = math.sin(t * 0.55 + phase) * (0.7 * along)
                local lift = 2.4 + along * 7.2 + math.sin(t * 0.45 + phase) * 0.35
                local pos = (cf * CFrame.new(sway, lift, -8 - along * 12)).Position
                local frame = CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + cf.LookVector * 10 + cf.UpVector * (2.2 - along))
                seg.part.CFrame = frame
                for _, ex in ipairs(seg.extras) do
                    ex.part.CFrame = frame * ex.offset
                end
                prev = frame
            end
            local headPos = prev.Position + prev.LookVector * 5.5 + prev.UpVector * 0.3
            local head = CFrame.lookAt(headPos, headPos + prev.LookVector * 12 + prev.UpVector * -1.1)
            for _, ex in ipairs(rig.headExtras) do
                ex.part.CFrame = head * ex.offset
            end
            local tailN = #rig.tail
            for i, seg in ipairs(rig.tail) do
                local along = i / tailN
                local sway = math.sin(t * 0.9 + phase + along * 2.4) * (1.2 + along * 5)
                local dip = -along * 2.2
                local pos = (cf * CFrame.new(sway, dip, 9 + i * 3.05)).Position
                local frame = CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos - cf.LookVector * 6 + cf.RightVector * sway * 0.35)
                seg.part.CFrame = frame
                for _, ex in ipairs(seg.extras) do
                    ex.part.CFrame = frame * ex.offset
                end
            end
            local s = math.sin(t * (1.15 * (1 + (_G._PrismBeat or 0) * 1.8)) + phase)
            local flap = ((s >= 0) and (s * 0.32) or (s * 0.9)) * (1 + (_G._PrismBeat or 0) * 0.95)
            for _, wing in ipairs(rig.wings) do
                local side = wing.side
                local root = cf * CFrame.new(side * 5.5, 3.1, -2) * CFrame.Angles(flap * 0.18, side * 0.12, side * (-0.18 + flap))
                for _, wp in ipairs(wing.parts) do
                    local lag = math.sin(t * 1.15 + phase - (wp.lag or 0)) * 0.08
                    wp.part.CFrame = root * CFrame.Angles(lag, 0, 0) * wp.offset
                end
            end
        end

        ride.makeHome = function()
            if ride.houseMoved then return end
            local old = workspace:FindFirstChild("PrismHouse")
            if old then old:Destroy() end
            local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
            local char = player and player.Character
            local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not hrp then return end
            ride.houseMoved = true
            local origin = hrp.Position
            local dest = origin + Vector3.new(160, 0, 90)
            local params = RaycastParams.new()
            params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
            params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char }
            local hit = workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(dest.X, origin.Y + 80, dest.Z), Vector3.new(0, -400, 0), params)
            local ground = hit and hit.Position.Y or origin.Y
            local m = Instance.new("Model")
            m.Name = "PrismHouse"
            local function wall(size, cf, color, mat)
                local p = Instance.new("Part")
                p.Size = size
                p.CFrame = cf
                p.Anchored = true
                p.CanCollide = true
                p.Material = mat or Enum.Material.Brick
                p.Color = color or Color3.fromRGB(128, 72, 58)
                p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
                p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
                p.Parent = m
                return p
            end
            local brick = Color3.fromRGB(132, 74, 60)
            local trim = Color3.fromRGB(236, 230, 220)
            local wood = Color3.fromRGB(110, 76, 46)
            wall(Vector3.new(28, 1, 22), CFrame.new(0, 0.5, 0), wood, Enum.Material.WoodPlanks)
            wall(Vector3.new(28, 1, 22), CFrame.new(0, 14.5, 0), brick)
            wall(Vector3.new(1.2, 14, 22), CFrame.new(-13.4, 7.5, 0), brick)
            wall(Vector3.new(1.2, 14, 22), CFrame.new(13.4, 7.5, 0), brick)
            wall(Vector3.new(26, 14, 1.2), CFrame.new(0, 7.5, 10.4), brick)
            wall(Vector3.new(9, 14, 1.2), CFrame.new(-9.2, 7.5, -10.4), brick)
            wall(Vector3.new(9, 14, 1.2), CFrame.new(9.2, 7.5, -10.4), brick)
            wall(Vector3.new(8, 5.5, 1.2), CFrame.new(0, 11.2, -10.4), brick)
            wall(Vector3.new(8.4, 0.6, 1.4), CFrame.new(0, 8.2, -10.5), trim, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
            wall(Vector3.new(0.5, 8, 0.5), CFrame.new(-4, 4, -10.6), trim, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
            wall(Vector3.new(0.5, 8, 0.5), CFrame.new(4, 4, -10.6), trim, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
            wall(Vector3.new(6, 0.4, 3), CFrame.new(0, 0.2, -12.2), Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 154), Enum.Material.Concrete)
            wall(Vector3.new(4, 3, 0.3), CFrame.new(-6, 6, -10.7), Color3.fromRGB(160, 210, 230), Enum.Material.Glass).Transparency = 0.35
            wall(Vector3.new(4, 3, 0.3), CFrame.new(6, 6, -10.7), Color3.fromRGB(160, 210, 230), Enum.Material.Glass).Transparency = 0.35
            wall(Vector3.new(10, 4, 1), CFrame.new(-16, 2, 2), Color3.fromRGB(46, 120, 52), Enum.Material.Grass)
            wall(Vector3.new(10, 4, 1), CFrame.new(16, 2, 2), Color3.fromRGB(46, 120, 52), Enum.Material.Grass)
            local rug = wall(Vector3.new(10, 0.15, 8), CFrame.new(0, 1.1, 1), Color3.fromRGB(120, 42, 46), Enum.Material.Fabric)
            rug.CanCollide = false
            wall(Vector3.new(5, 0.3, 3), CFrame.new(0, 2.4, 2), wood, Enum.Material.Wood)
            wall(Vector3.new(0.4, 1.2, 0.4), CFrame.new(-2, 1.6, 0.8), wood, Enum.Material.Wood)
            wall(Vector3.new(0.4, 1.2, 0.4), CFrame.new(2, 1.6, 0.8), wood, Enum.Material.Wood)
            wall(Vector3.new(0.4, 1.2, 0.4), CFrame.new(-2, 1.6, 3.2), wood, Enum.Material.Wood)
            wall(Vector3.new(0.4, 1.2, 0.4), CFrame.new(2, 1.6, 3.2), wood, Enum.Material.Wood)
            wall(Vector3.new(6, 1.2, 3), CFrame.new(0, 1.7, 7), wood, Enum.Material.Wood)
            local lamp = wall(Vector3.new(2, 0.3, 2), CFrame.new(0, 13.6, 0), Color3.fromRGB(255, 196, 120), Enum.Material.Neon)
            lamp.CanCollide = false
            local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
            light.Brightness = 2
            light.Range = 24
            light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 140)
            light.Parent = lamp
            m.Parent = workspace
            m:PivotTo(CFrame.new(dest.X, ground, dest.Z))
        end

        local function addFlyer(folder, kind, color, accent, scale, phase, radius, height, speed, mount)
            local length = mount and 16 or 6
            local built = mount and (kind == "dragon" or kind == "ender" or kind == "phoenix")
            local packed = (mount and not built) and meshFor(kind, length) or nil
            local model, bones, seat, face
            if built then
                model, bones, seat = ride.buildMount(kind, color, accent)
                face = (ride.lastFace) or CFrame.new()
            elseif packed then
                model = packed.model:Clone()
                model.Name = mount and "PrismMount" or "PrismFlyer"
                if not mount then
                    pcall(function()
                        model:ScaleTo(model:GetScale() * 0.42)
                    end)
                end
                face = packed.face
                for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
                    if d:IsA("BasePart") then
                        d.Anchored = true
                        d.CanCollide = false
                        d.CanQuery = false
                        d.CanTouch = false
                    end
                end
                if mount then seat = addSeat(model, accent) end
                tintModel(model, color, accent)
                bones = nil
            else
                model, bones, seat = makeHead(kind, color, accent, scale * 0.42, mount)
                face = CFrame.new()
            end
            model.Parent = folder
            push(model, radius, height, speed, phase, bones, seat, kind == "crow" and "bird" or kind)
            local e = life[#life]
            do
                local rawFace = face or CFrame.new()
                local c = {rawFace:GetComponents()}
                e.face = CFrame.new(0, 0, 0, c[4], c[5], c[6], c[7], c[8], c[9], c[10], c[11], c[12])
            end
            e.swoop = false
            e.pos = nil
            e.rig = built and ride.lastRig or nil
            e.spine = e.rig
            e.span = nil
            e.breath = (built and ride.lastBreath) or (mount and addBreath(model, accent, color) or nil)
            e.wings = nil
            e.meshWings = built and ride.lastWings or nil
            e.nextFire = os.clock() + 3 + math.random() * 4
            e.fireUntil = 0
            if mount then
                e.radius = 90
                e.height = 108
                e.speed = 0.7
                e.bobAmp = 4
                e.amp = kind == "ender" and 0.7 or 1.15
                e.flapHz = kind == "ender" and 1.4 or 1.9
            end
        end

        local function spawnLife(preset)
            clearLife()
            clearRide()
            if not preset.life then return end
            life = {}
            lifeFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
            lifeFolder.Name = "PrismSkyLife"
            lifeFolder.Parent = workspace
            local c = rgb(preset.lc[1], preset.lc[2], preset.lc[3])
            local a = rgb(preset.ac[1], preset.ac[2], preset.ac[3])
            local kind = preset.life
            if kind == "minecraft" then
                addFlyer(lifeFolder, "ender", rgb(92, 40, 160), rgb(190, 120, 255), 1, 0, 70, 86, 0.16, true)
                for i = 1, 4 do
                    local island = makeIsland(0.85 + i * 0.22, i)
                    island.Parent = lifeFolder
                    push(island, 200 + i * 48, 120 + i * 28, 0.03, i * 1.7, nil, nil, "island")
                end
                for i = 1, 4 do
                    addFlyer(lifeFolder, "bird", rgb(70, 170, 60), rgb(240, 210, 70), 0.45, i * 1.3, 130 + i * 16, 88 + i * 8, 0.36, false)
                end
            elseif kind == "whale" then
                addFlyer(lifeFolder, "whale", c, a, 1, 0, 78, 80, 0.1, true)
                for i = 1, 4 do
                    addFlyer(lifeFolder, "bird", c, a, 0.4, i, 120, 100, 0.34, false)
                end
            elseif kind == "birds" then
                addFlyer(lifeFolder, "bird", c, a, 1, 0, 64, 78, 0.2, true)
                for i = 1, 6 do
                    addFlyer(lifeFolder, "bird", c, a, 0.5, i * 0.9, 100 + i * 14, 80 + (i % 3) * 16, 0.4, false)
                end
            elseif kind == "bats" then
                addFlyer(lifeFolder, "dragon", rgb(42, 46, 64), a, 1, 0, 68, 84, 0.16, true)
                for i = 1, 6 do
                    addFlyer(lifeFolder, "bat", c, a, 0.48, i * 0.85, 96 + i * 12, 72 + (i % 3) * 14, 0.52, false)
                end
            elseif kind == "ghosts" then
                addFlyer(lifeFolder, "ghost", c, a, 1, 0, 66, 80, 0.14, true)
                for i = 1, 4 do
                    addFlyer(lifeFolder, "ghost", c, a, 0.48, i * 1.2, 110, 90 + i * 8, 0.26, false)
                end
                for i = 1, 3 do
                    addFlyer(lifeFolder, "bat", rgb(24, 18, 32), a, 0.4, i, 140, 64, 0.58, false)
                end
            elseif kind == "crows" then
                addFlyer(lifeFolder, "crow", c, a, 1, 0, 64, 76, 0.22, true)
                for i = 1, 6 do
                    addFlyer(lifeFolder, "crow", c, a, 0.46, i * 0.8, 100 + i * 10, 70 + (i % 4) * 12, 0.46, false)
                end
            elseif kind == "serpent" then
                addFlyer(lifeFolder, "dragon", c, a, 1, 0, 72, 86, 0.15, true)
                for i = 1, 4 do
                    addFlyer(lifeFolder, "bird", a, c, 0.42, i * 1.1, 140, 100, 0.33, false)
                end
            elseif kind == "phoenix" then
                addFlyer(lifeFolder, "phoenix", c, a, 1, 0, 68, 84, 0.17, true)
                for i = 1, 5 do
                    addFlyer(lifeFolder, "bird", a, c, 0.48, i * 1.15, 120 + i * 8, 86 + (i % 3) * 14, 0.4, false)
                end
            else
                addFlyer(lifeFolder, "dragon", c, a, 1, 0, 68, 84, 0.16, true)
                for i = 1, 5 do
                    addFlyer(lifeFolder, "bird", c, a, 0.45, i * 1.05, 115 + i * 12, 82 + (i % 3) * 18, 0.38, false)
                end
            end

            lifeConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
                local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
                if not cam or not lifeFolder then return end
                if ride.on and (not ride.seat or not ride.seat.Parent or not ride.hum or ride.hum.Health <= 0) then
                    clearRide()
                end
                local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
                local char = player and player.Character
                local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if ride.on and not ride.origin then
                    ride.origin = (hrp and hrp.Position) or cam.CFrame.Position
                end
                local body = (hrp and hrp.Position) or ride.origin or cam.CFrame.Position
                local t = os.clock() - (_G._PrismRewind or 0)
                for _, e in ipairs(life) do
                    if e.model and e.model.Parent then
                        local origin
                        if e.seat then
                            if not e.anchor then
                                local map = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                                local spawn = workspace:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpawnLocation", true)
                                if spawn and spawn:IsA("BasePart") then
                                    map = spawn.Position
                                end
                                local away = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
                                if hrp then
                                    local flat = Vector3.new(hrp.Position.X - map.X, 0, hrp.Position.Z - map.Z)
                                    if flat.Magnitude > 8 then
                                        away = flat.Unit
                                    end
                                end
                                e.anchor = Vector3.new(map.X, 0, map.Z) - away * 420
                            end
                            origin = e.anchor
                        else
                            if not e.anchor then
                                e.anchor = body
                            end
                            origin = e.anchor
                        end
                        local rush = 1 + (_G._PrismBeat or 0) * 0.35
                        e.ang = (e.ang or (t * e.speed + e.phase)) + dt * e.speed * rush
                        local ang = e.ang
                        local cf
                        if e.mode == "island" then
                            local bob = math.sin(t * 0.15 + e.phase) * 2
                            local pos = origin + Vector3.new(math.cos(ang) * e.radius, e.height + bob, math.sin(ang) * e.radius)
                            cf = CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(0, t * 0.03 + e.phase, 0)
                        elseif e.seat then
                            local soar = math.sin(t * 0.25 + e.phase) * 7
                            local rx, rz = e.radius, e.radius * 0.72
                            local pos = origin + Vector3.new(math.cos(ang) * rx, e.height + soar, math.sin(ang) * rz)
                            local ahead = origin + Vector3.new(math.cos(ang + 0.18) * rx, e.height + math.sin(t * 0.25 + e.phase + 0.18) * 7, math.sin(ang + 0.18) * rz)
                            local bank = -math.cos(ang) * 0.16
                            local pitch = math.cos(t * 0.25 + e.phase) * 0.05
                            cf = CFrame.lookAt(pos, ahead) * CFrame.Angles(pitch, 0, bank) * (e.face or CFrame.new())
                        else
                            local flap = math.sin(t * (e.flapHz or 5) + e.phase)
                            local pos = origin + Vector3.new(math.cos(ang) * e.radius, e.height + math.sin(t * 0.5 + e.phase) * 6, math.sin(ang) * e.radius)
                            local tangent = Vector3.new(-math.sin(ang), flap * 0.35, math.cos(ang))
                            if tangent.Magnitude < 0.05 then tangent = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end
                            local desired = CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + tangent) * CFrame.Angles(flap * 0.18, 0, -flap * 0.12) * (e.face or CFrame.new())
                            cf = desired
                        end
                        e.model:PivotTo(cf)
                        if e.wings then
                            local beat = ride.poseWings(e.wings, cf, t, e.phase)
                            local posed = cf * CFrame.Angles(beat * 0.05, 0, 0)
                            e.model:PivotTo(posed)
                            ride.poseWings(e.wings, posed, t, e.phase)
                            cf = posed
                        end
                        if e.mode == "island" and hrp and not ride.on and e.lastCF then
                            local params = RaycastParams.new()
                            params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
                            params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { e.model }
                            local hit = workspace:Raycast(hrp.Position, Vector3.new(0, -12, 0), params)
                            if hit then
                                local delta = cf * e.lastCF:Inverse()
                                hrp.CFrame = delta * hrp.CFrame
                            end
                        end
                        e.lastCF = cf
                        if e.breath then
                            pcall(function()
                                if t > (e.nextFire or 0) and t > (e.fireUntil or 0) then
                                    e.fireUntil = t + 1.2
                                    e.nextFire = t + 4 + math.random() * 5
                                    if e.breath.emitter then e.breath.emitter:Emit(100) end
                                    if e.breath.flame then e.breath.flame.Transparency = 0.1 end
                                    if e.breath.light then e.breath.light.Brightness = 10 end
                                elseif t > (e.fireUntil or 0) then
                                    if e.breath.flame then e.breath.flame.Transparency = 1 end
                                    if e.breath.light then e.breath.light.Brightness = 0 end
                                end
                            end)
                        end
                        if e.spine then
                            pcall(ride.poseSpine, e, cf, t)
                            if e.seat and ride.on and ride.seat == e.seat and _G._PrismCopyDance then
                                pcall(_G._PrismCopyDance, e, cf)
                            end
                        elseif e.bones then
                            local flap = math.sin(t * (e.flapHz or 2) + e.phase)
                            for _, b in ipairs(e.bones) do
                                if b.part and b.part.Parent then
                                    if b.kind == "wing" and b.hinge and b.fromHinge then
                                        local s = math.sin(t * (e.flapHz or 1.7) + e.phase)
                                        local lift = (s > 0 and s * 0.85 or s * 0.4) * (e.amp or 1) * (0.55 + b.index * 0.28)
                                        b.part.CFrame = cf * b.hinge * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, b.side * lift) * b.fromHinge
                                    elseif b.kind == "tail" then
                                        local wave = math.sin(t * 2.2 + b.index * 0.65) * (0.18 + b.index * 0.03)
                                        b.part.CFrame = cf * b.base * CFrame.new(wave * b.index * 0.25, 0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(wave, 0, 0)
                                    elseif b.kind == "fin" and b.hinge then
                                        b.part.CFrame = cf * b.hinge * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, b.side * flap * 0.35)
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        if e.seat then
                            local prompt = e.seat:FindFirstChildOfClass("ProximityPrompt")
                            local board = e.seat:FindFirstChildOfClass("BillboardGui")
                            local camDist = (cam.CFrame.Position - e.seat.Position).Magnitude
                            local bodyDist = hrp and (hrp.Position - e.seat.Position).Magnitude or 999
                            local ridingThis = ride.on and ride.seat == e.seat
                            local near = (not ride.on) and (bodyDist < 16 or camDist < 24)
                            if prompt then
                                prompt.Enabled = near or ridingThis
                                prompt.MaxActivationDistance = near and 600 or 12
                            end
                            if board then board.Enabled = near end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if ride.on and ride.seat and ride.hum and ride.hum.Parent then
                    local mountRoot = ride.hum.Parent:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if mountRoot then
                        mountRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                        mountRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                        mountRoot.CFrame = ride.seat.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 2.2, 0)
                    end
                end
            end)
        end

        ride.startMotion = function(preset)
            local kind = ({
                Midnight = "stars", ["Blood Moon"] = "embers", Toxic = "toxic", Halloween = "embers",
                Sunset = "dust", Dawn = "dust", Neon = "neon", Void = "stars", Foggy = "fog",

                Arctic = "snow", Peaks = "snow", Mesa = "dust", Horizon = "dust", Eclipse = "stars",
                Sakura = "petals", Ember = "embers", Rain = "rain", Royal = "stars", Snow = "snow",
            })[preset.n] or "dust"
            local ac = preset.ac or preset.o or { 255, 255, 255 }
            local tint = rgb(ac[1], ac[2], ac[3])
            _G._PrismSkyTint = tint
            local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
            folder.Name = "PrismSkyMotion"
            folder.Parent = workspace
            local host = Instance.new("Part")
            host.Name = "Host"
            host.Anchored = true
            host.CanCollide = false
            host.CanQuery = false
            host.CanTouch = false
            host.Transparency = 1
            host.Size = Vector3.new(980, 90, 980)
            host.Parent = folder
            local flat = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
            local cam0 = workspace.CurrentCamera
            if cam0 then flat = Vector3.new(cam0.CFrame.Position.X, 0, cam0.CFrame.Position.Z) end
            host.CFrame = CFrame.new(flat.X, 190, flat.Z)
            local pe = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
            pe.LightEmission = 0.35
            pe.Rate = 46
            pe.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(3.5, 6)
            pe.Speed = NumberRange.new(4, 10)
            pe.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(35, 35)
            pe.Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360)
            pe.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-30, 30)
            pe.Size = NumberSequence.new(1.4, 2.4)
            pe.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.25),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
            })
            pe.Color = ColorSequence.new(tint)
            pe.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
            pe.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Bottom
            pe.Parent = host
            pe.Drag = 0.5
            if kind == "embers" then
                pe.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/fire_main.dds"
                pe.LightEmission = 0.85
                pe.Rate = 14
                pe.Speed = NumberRange.new(6, 14)
                pe.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(2.4, 4)
                pe.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top
                pe.Size = NumberSequence.new(1.5, 0.12)
                pe.Acceleration = Vector3.new(12, 8, 3)
            elseif kind == "snow" then
                pe.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/smoke_main.dds"
                pe.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(248, 250, 255))
                pe.Rate = 28
                pe.Speed = NumberRange.new(3, 7)
                pe.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(4, 7)
                pe.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.45, 0.9)
                pe.LightEmission = 0.12
                pe.Acceleration = Vector3.new(8, -6, 2)
            elseif kind == "rain" or kind == "storm" then
                pe.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/smoke_main.dds"
                pe.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(198, 208, 220))
                pe.Rate = kind == "storm" and 64 or 36
                pe.Speed = NumberRange.new(40, 70)
                pe.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.8, 1.3)
                pe.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.15, 0.28)
                pe.LightEmission = 0.05
                pe.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(0, 0)
                pe.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Bottom
                pe.Acceleration = Vector3.new(22, -80, 6)
                pcall(function()
                    pe.Squash = NumberSequence.new(kind == "storm" and 9 or 6)
                    pe.Orientation = Enum.ParticleOrientation.VelocityParallel
                end)
            elseif kind == "petals" then
                pe.Rate = 12
                pe.Speed = NumberRange.new(2, 6)
                pe.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(5, 8)
                pe.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.9, 1.4)
                pe.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-40, 40)
                pe.Acceleration = Vector3.new(10, -3, 4)
            elseif kind == "toxic" then

                pe.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top
                pe.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.6, 1.3)
                pe.Acceleration = Vector3.new(4, 4, 1)
            elseif kind == "neon" then
                pe.LightEmission = 1
                pe.Rate = 12
                pe.Speed = NumberRange.new(18, 32)
                pe.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.7, 1.4)
                pe.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.25, 0.8)
                pe.Acceleration = Vector3.new(30, 2, 0)
                pe.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(8, 8)
            elseif kind == "stars" then
                pe.LightEmission = 1
                pe.Rate = 6
                pe.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.4, 1.6)
                pe.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(3, 6)
                pe.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.2, 0.55)
                pe.Acceleration = Vector3.new(1.5, 0, 0.4)
            elseif kind == "fog" then
                pe.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/smoke_main.dds"
                pe.LightEmission = 0
                pe.Rate = 6
                pe.Speed = NumberRange.new(1, 3)

                pe.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.62, 1)
                pe.Acceleration = Vector3.new(6, 0, 2)

                pe.LightEmission = 0.45

            local profiles = {

                rain = { 0.84, 0.55, Color3.fromRGB(70, 76, 88) },

                clouds.Parent = terrain

                if not folder.Parent then return end
                dt = dt or 0.016
                local t = os.clock()
                local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
                if cam then
                    local goal = cam.CFrame.Position + Vector3.new(0, 90, 0)
                    host.CFrame = CFrame.new(host.Position:Lerp(goal, 0.18))
                end
                if clouds and clouds.Parent then
                    local beat = (_G._PrismBeat or 0) * 0.28
                    local breathe = math.sin(t * 0.08) * 0.035

                    clouds.Cover = math.clamp(prof[1] + breathe + beat * 0.04, 0, 1)
                    clouds.Density = math.clamp(prof[2] + math.sin(t * 0.05) * 0.03 + beat * 0.02, 0, 1)
                    clouds.Color = prof[3]:Lerp(tint, 0.18 + beat * 0.12)
                end

                    _G._PrismFlash = 1
                end
                if (_G._PrismFlash or 0) > 0 then
                    _G._PrismFlash = _G._PrismFlash * 0.86
                end
            end)
        end

        local function applySky(preset)
            pcall(function()
                clearSkyFx()
                _G._PrismSkyGen = (_G._PrismSkyGen or 0) + 1
                _G._PrismSkyHold = not preset.restore
                if preset.restore then
                    Lighting.FogEnd = 100000
                    Lighting.FogStart = 0
                    Lighting.ClockTime = 14
                    Lighting.Brightness = 2
                    Lighting.Ambient = rgb(70, 70, 70)
                    Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = rgb(128, 128, 128)
                    pcall(function()
                        Lighting.ExposureCompensation = 0
                        Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = 1
                        Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = 1
                    end)
                    restoreWorldSky()
                    skyStatus.Text = "Current: Default"
                    note("Sky", "Default")
                    return
                end
                Lighting.ClockTime = preset.t or 14
                Lighting.Brightness = preset.b or 2
                local am = preset.a or { 70, 70, 70 }
                Lighting.Ambient = rgb(am[1], am[2], am[3])
                local ou = preset.o or { 128, 128, 128 }
                Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = rgb(ou[1], ou[2], ou[3])
                Lighting.FogStart = 0
                Lighting.FogEnd = 100000
                if preset.sky then
                    putSky(preset.sky, preset.stars, preset.sun, preset.moon, preset.bodies)
                end
                mood(preset)
                pcall(function()
                    for _, ch in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
                        if ch:IsA("Atmosphere") and ch.Name ~= "PrismAtmo" then
                            ch.Parent = nil
                        elseif ch.Name == "HaloNightGrade" or ch.Name == "HaloNightBloom" then
                            ch:Destroy()
                        end
                    end
                    local horizon = (atmoObj and atmoObj.Color) or Lighting.OutdoorAmbient
                    local function lift(c, minv)
                        return Color3.new(math.max(c.R, minv), math.max(c.G, minv), math.max(c.B, minv))
                    end
                    local night = Lighting.ClockTime < 6 or Lighting.ClockTime > 18.5
                    if night then
                        Lighting.Brightness = math.max(Lighting.Brightness, 1.9)
                        Lighting.Ambient = lift(Lighting.Ambient, 0.16)
                        Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = lift(Lighting.OutdoorAmbient, 0.24)
                        Lighting.ExposureCompensation = math.max(Lighting.ExposureCompensation or 0, 0.08)
                    else
                        Lighting.Brightness = math.max(Lighting.Brightness, 2)
                        Lighting.Ambient = lift(Lighting.Ambient, 0.12)
                        Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = lift(Lighting.OutdoorAmbient, 0.2)
                        Lighting.ExposureCompensation = math.max(Lighting.ExposureCompensation or 0, 0)
                    end
                    Lighting.FogColor = horizon
                    Lighting.FogStart = 18000
                    Lighting.FogEnd = 100000
                    Lighting.ColorShift_Top = horizon
                    Lighting.ColorShift_Bottom = Lighting.Ambient
                    Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = 1
                    Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = 0.45
                    Lighting.GlobalShadows = true
                end)
                spawnLife(preset)
                ride.startMotion(preset)
                _G._PrismSkyBase = {
                    gen = _G._PrismSkyGen,
                    bright = Lighting.Brightness,
                    out = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient,
                    amb = Lighting.Ambient,
                    exp = Lighting.ExposureCompensation,
                    bloom = bloomObj and bloomObj.Intensity or nil,
                    fog = Lighting.FogColor,
                    sun = skyObj and skyObj.SunAngularSize or nil,
                    haze = atmoObj and atmoObj.Haze or nil,
                    glare = atmoObj and atmoObj.Glare or nil,
                    atmo = atmoObj and atmoObj.Color or nil,
                    rays = raysObj and raysObj.Intensity or nil,
                }
                skyStatus.Text = "Current: " .. preset.n
                note("Sky", preset.n .. "  ·  moving")
            end)
        end

        -- ===== LARP: client-side avatar try-on (catalog search + wear any item id) =====
        pcall(function(page, pages, corner, stroke, txt, button, plr, TweenService)
            local Players = game:GetService("Players")
            local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
            local lp = page()
            pages["Larp"] = lp

            local ACC = Color3.fromRGB(160, 170, 185)
            local PANEL = Color3.fromRGB(12, 13, 18)

            ---------------------------------------------------------------
            -- state
            ---------------------------------------------------------------
            local worn = {}            -- list of records: {id, name, pieces, live, replaced}
            local keepOnRespawn = true
            local gen = 0              -- search generation (ignore stale async results)
            local pagesObj, httpCursor = nil, nil
            local finished, busy = true, false
            local chipTypes, sortName = nil, "Relevance"
            local chipLabel = "All"
            local cells = {}           -- id -> cell button (for highlight)
            local statusLbl, refreshWorn

            local function say(t, bad)
                if statusLbl then
                    statusLbl.Text = t
                    statusLbl.TextColor3 = bad and Color3.fromRGB(255, 130, 120) or Color3.fromRGB(130, 140, 160)
                end
            end

            ---------------------------------------------------------------
            -- wearing items (client side only: nobody else sees this)
            ---------------------------------------------------------------
            local function getChar()
                local c = plr.Character
                local h = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if c and h and h.Health > 0 then return c, h end
                return nil
            end

            local function loadPieces(id)
                local objs
                local ok, r = pcall(function() return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. id) end)
                if ok and type(r) == "table" and #r > 0 then objs = r end
                if not objs then
                    local ok2, m = pcall(function() return game:GetService("InsertService"):LoadAsset(id) end)
                    if ok2 and m then objs = m:GetChildren() end
                end
                if not objs then return nil end
                local pieces = {}
                local function consider(o)
                    if o:IsA("Accessory") or o:IsA("Shirt") or o:IsA("Pants") or o:IsA("ShirtGraphic") then
                        pieces[#pieces + 1] = o
                        return true
                    end
                    return false
                end
                for _, o in ipairs(objs) do
                    if not consider(o) then
                        for _, d in ipairs(o:GetDescendants()) do consider(d) end
                        if o:IsA("Decal") then pieces[#pieces + 1] = o end
                        if o:IsA("Model") or o:IsA("Folder") then
                            local face = o:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Decal", true)
                            if face and #pieces == 0 then pieces[#pieces + 1] = face end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if #pieces == 0 then return nil end
                return pieces
            end

            local function weldAccessory(char, acc)
                local handle = acc:FindFirstChild("Handle")
                if not handle or not handle:IsA("BasePart") then return end
                for _, a in ipairs(handle:GetChildren()) do
                    if a:IsA("Attachment") then
                        local m = char:FindFirstChild(a.Name, true)
                        if m and m:IsA("Attachment") and m.Parent and m.Parent:IsA("BasePart") then
                            handle.Anchored = false
                            handle.CanCollide = false
                            handle.Massless = true
                            local w = Instance.new("Weld")
                            w.Name = "AccessoryWeld"
                            w.Part0 = m.Parent
                            w.Part1 = handle
                            w.C0 = m.CFrame
                            w.C1 = a.CFrame
                            w.Parent = handle
                            return
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            local function applyRecord(rec)
                local char, hum = getChar()
                if not char then return false end
                rec.live = {}
                rec.replaced = {}
                for _, piece in ipairs(rec.pieces) do
                    if piece:IsA("Accessory") then
                        local c = piece:Clone()
                        c:SetAttribute("PXLarp", true)
                        local ok = pcall(function() hum:AddAccessory(c) end)
                        if not ok or c.Parent ~= char then
                            c.Parent = char
                            pcall(weldAccessory, char, c)
                        end
                        rec.live[#rec.live + 1] = c
                    elseif piece:IsA("Shirt") or piece:IsA("Pants") or piece:IsA("ShirtGraphic") then
                        local old = char:FindFirstChildOfClass(piece.ClassName)
                        if old then
                            rec.replaced[#rec.replaced + 1] = { inst = old }
                            old.Parent = nil
                        end
                        local c = piece:Clone()
                        c:SetAttribute("PXLarp", true)
                        c.Parent = char
                        rec.live[#rec.live + 1] = c
                    elseif piece:IsA("Decal") then
                        local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
                        local face = head and head:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Decal")
                        if face then
                            rec.replaced[#rec.replaced + 1] = { face = face, tex = face.Texture }
                            face.Texture = piece.Texture
                        end
                    end
                end
                return true
            end

            local function unapplyRecord(rec)
                for _, i in ipairs(rec.live or {}) do pcall(function() i:Destroy() end) end
                for _, r in ipairs(rec.replaced or {}) do
                    if r.inst then
                        local char = plr.Character
                        if char then pcall(function() r.inst.Parent = char end) end
                    elseif r.face then
                        pcall(function() r.face.Texture = r.tex end)
                    end
                end
                rec.live, rec.replaced = {}, {}
            end

            local function findWorn(id)
                for i, r in ipairs(worn) do
                    if r.id == id then return i, r end
                end
            end

            local function wearItem(id, name)
                id = tonumber(id)
                if not id then say("That is not a valid item id.", true) return end
                if findWorn(id) then say("Already wearing that one.", false) return end
                if not getChar() then say("You need a living character first.", true) return end
                say("Loading " .. (name or id) .. "...")
                task.spawn(function()
                    local pieces = loadPieces(id)
                    if not pieces then say("Couldn't load item " .. id .. ". It may not be an accessory or clothing item.", true) return end
                    if findWorn(id) then return end
                    local rec = { id = id, name = name or ("Item " .. id), pieces = pieces }
                    if applyRecord(rec) then
                        worn[#worn + 1] = rec
                        say("Wearing " .. rec.name .. ". Only you can see this.")
                        refreshWorn()
                        if cells[id] then
                            local st = cells[id]:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
                            if st then st.Color = ACC st.Transparency = 0.1 end
                        end
                    else
                        say("No character to put it on.", true)
                    end
                end)
            end

            local function removeItem(id)
                local i, rec = findWorn(id)
                if not i then return end
                unapplyRecord(rec)
                table.remove(worn, i)
                if cells[id] then
                    local st = cells[id]:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
                    if st then st.Color = Color3.fromRGB(160, 170, 185) st.Transparency = 0.8 end
                end
                refreshWorn()
                say("Removed " .. rec.name .. ".")
            end

            local function clearAll()
                for i = #worn, 1, -1 do
                    unapplyRecord(worn[i])
                    local id = worn[i].id
                    worn[i] = nil
                    if cells[id] then
                        local st = cells[id]:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
                        if st then st.Color = Color3.fromRGB(160, 170, 185) st.Transparency = 0.8 end
                    end
                end
                refreshWorn()
                say("Cleared everything you were wearing.")
            end

                    pcall(function() char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10) end)
                    task.wait(1.2)
                    for _, rec in ipairs(worn) do pcall(applyRecord, rec) end
                end)
            end)

            -- searching: AvatarEditorService first, web catalog as fallback

            local ALL_TYPES = { "Hat", "HairAccessory", "FaceAccessory", "NeckAccessory", "ShoulderAccessory", "FrontAccessory",
                "BackAccessory", "WaistAccessory", "Shirt", "Pants", "TShirt", "Face", "TShirtAccessory", "ShirtAccessory",

                "RightShoeAccessory", "DressSkirtAccessory", "EyebrowAccessory", "EyelashAccessory" }
            local NUM = { Hat = 8, HairAccessory = 41, FaceAccessory = 42, NeckAccessory = 43, ShoulderAccessory = 44,
                FrontAccessory = 45, BackAccessory = 46, WaistAccessory = 47, Shirt = 11, Pants = 12, TShirt = 2, Face = 18,
                TShirtAccessory = 64, ShirtAccessory = 65, PantsAccessory = 66, JacketAccessory = 67, SweaterAccessory = 68,
                ShortsAccessory = 69, LeftShoeAccessory = 70, RightShoeAccessory = 71, DressSkirtAccessory = 72,
                EyebrowAccessory = 76, EyelashAccessory = 77 }

                { "All", ALL_TYPES },
                { "Hats", { "Hat" } },
