                { "Face", { "FaceAccessory" } },
                { "Neck", { "NeckAccessory" } },
                { "Shoulder", { "ShoulderAccessory" } },
                { "Front", { "FrontAccessory" } },
                { "Back", { "BackAccessory" } },
                { "Waist", { "WaistAccessory" } },
                { "Shirts", { "Shirt", "TShirt" } },
                { "Pants", { "Pants" } },
                { "Layered", { "TShirtAccessory", "ShirtAccessory", "PantsAccessory", "JacketAccessory", "SweaterAccessory", "ShortsAccessory", "DressSkirtAccessory" } },
                { "Shoes", { "LeftShoeAccessory", "RightShoeAccessory" } },
                { "Faces", { "Face" } },
                { "Brows", { "EyebrowAccessory", "EyelashAccessory" } },
            }
            local SORTS = { "Relevance", "MostFavorited", "Bestselling", "RecentlyCreated", "PriceLowToHigh", "PriceHighToLow" }
            local SORT_LABEL = { Relevance = "Relevance", MostFavorited = "Most favorited", Bestselling = "Best selling",
                RecentlyCreated = "Newest", PriceLowToHigh = "Price low-high", PriceHighToLow = "Price high-low" }
            local HTTP_SORT = { Relevance = 0, MostFavorited = 1, Bestselling = 2, RecentlyCreated = 3, PriceLowToHigh = 4, PriceHighToLow = 5 }

            local AES = nil
            pcall(function() AES = game:GetService("AvatarEditorService") end)
            local httpFn = (type(request) == "function" and request) or (type(http_request) == "function" and http_request)
                or (type(syn) == "table" and syn.request) or nil

            local function typeSet(names)
                local out = {}
                for _, n in ipairs(names) do
                    local ok, e = pcall(function() return Enum.AvatarAssetType[n] end)
                    if ok and e then out[#out + 1] = e end
                end
                return out
            end

            local function pushItems(items, myGen)
                if myGen ~= gen then return 0 end
                local n = 0
                for _, it in ipairs(items) do
                    local id = it.Id or it.id
                    local kind = it.ItemType or it.itemType or "Asset"
                    if id and tostring(kind) == "Asset" then
                        addCell(tonumber(id), it.Name or it.name, it.Price or it.price)
                        n = n + 1
                    end
                end
                return n
            end

            local function httpPage(myGen, first)
                if not httpFn then return false end
                local kw = search.Text
                if kw == "" then kw = (chipLabel == "All") and "accessory" or chipLabel end
                local url = "https://catalog.roblox.com/v1/search/items/details?Limit=30&SortType=" .. tostring(HTTP_SORT[sortName] or 0)
                    .. "&Keyword=" .. HttpService:UrlEncode(kw)
                if httpCursor then url = url .. "&Cursor=" .. HttpService:UrlEncode(httpCursor) end
                local ok, res = pcall(function() return httpFn({ Url = url, Method = "GET" }) end)
                if not ok or not res or not res.Body then return false end
                local ok2, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(res.Body) end)
                if not ok2 or type(data) ~= "table" or type(data.data) ~= "table" then return false end
                httpCursor = data.nextPageCursor
                finished = (httpCursor == nil)
                local want = {}
                for _, n in ipairs(chipTypes or ALL_TYPES) do if NUM[n] then want[NUM[n]] = true end end
                local filtered = {}
                for _, it in ipairs(data.data) do
                    if it.assetType == nil or want[it.assetType] then filtered[#filtered + 1] = it end
                end
                pushItems(filtered, myGen)
                return true
            end

            local function loadMore(myGen)
                if busy or finished then return end
                busy = true
                task.spawn(function()
                    local ok = false
                    if pagesObj then
                        local good, items = pcall(function() return pagesObj:GetCurrentPage() end)
                        if good and type(items) == "table" then
                            pushItems(items, myGen)
                            finished = pagesObj.IsFinished
                            if not finished then
                                local adv = pcall(function() pagesObj:AdvanceToNextPageAsync() end)
                                if not adv then finished = true end
                            end
                            ok = true
                        end
                    else
                        ok = httpPage(myGen, false)
                    end
                    if myGen == gen then
                        if not ok then
                            finished = true
                            say("Search failed. This executor may block the catalog; you can still wear anything by item id.", true)
                        end
                        local n = 0
                        for _ in pairs(cells) do n = n + 1 end
                        countLbl.Text = n .. " items" .. (finished and "" or "  (scroll for more)")
                    end
                    busy = false
                end)
            end

            local function runSearch()
                gen = gen + 1
                local myGen = gen
                clearGrid()
                pagesObj, httpCursor, finished, busy = nil, nil, false, false
                countLbl.Text = "searching..."
                task.spawn(function()
                    local started = false
                    if AES then
                        local ok = pcall(function()
                            local params = CatalogSearchParams.new()
                            params.SearchKeyword = search.Text or ""
                            params.AssetTypes = typeSet(chipTypes or ALL_TYPES)
                            params.IncludeOffSale = true
                            local s = nil
                            pcall(function() s = Enum.CatalogSortType[sortName] end)
                            if s then params.SortType = s end
                            local p = AES:SearchCatalog(params)
                            if p then pagesObj = p started = true end
                        end)
                        if not ok then pagesObj = nil end
                    end
                    if myGen ~= gen then return end
                    -- first page
                    busy = false
                    loadMore(myGen)
                end)
            end

            for i, c in ipairs(CHIPS) do

                b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(#c[1] * 8 + 22, 28)
                b.BackgroundColor3 = (i == 1) and Color3.fromRGB(92, 18, 24) or Color3.fromRGB(34, 18, 20)
                b.Text = c[1]
                b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold

                end)
            end

                runSearch()
            end)
            button(lp, "Search", 358, 0, 112, 34, runSearch)
            search.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter) if enter then runSearch() end end)

            -- first search happens the first time the page is opened

                if lp.Visible and not started then
                    started = true
                    runSearch()
                end
            end)
        end, page, pages, corner, stroke, txt, button, plr, TweenService)

        -- ===== CLONE SELF page (talks to _G.PrismCloneSelf, defined at the end of the file) =====
        pcall(function(page, pages, corner, stroke, txt, button, plr)
            local cp = page()

            button(card, "Remove", 468, 118, 100, 38, function()

                spawnBtn.Text = "Clone Self"
            end)
            local keepBtn

                local a = api()
                local on = not (a and a.state().keep)
                if a then a.setKeepOnRespawn(on) end
                keepBtn.Text = on and "Rebuild on respawn: on" or "Rebuild on respawn: off"
            end)
            keepBtn.TextSize = 10
            spawnBtn.TextSize = 12
        end, page, pages, corner, stroke, txt, button, plr)

        -- ===== LAB: a pile of client-side toys (effects, freecam, HUD, photo mode, ...) =====
        pcall(function(page, pages, corner, stroke, txt, button, plr, TweenService)
            local Players = game:GetService("Players")
            local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
            local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
            local CAS = game:GetService("ContextActionService")
            local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
            local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
            local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
            local lab = page()
            pages["Lab"] = lab

            local GOLD = Color3.fromRGB(160, 170, 185)
            local F = {}            -- features by id: {state, on, off, charBound}
            local order = {}
            local cards = {}
            local statusLbl

            local function say(t, bad)
                if statusLbl then
                    statusLbl.Text = t
                    statusLbl.TextColor3 = bad and Color3.fromRGB(255, 130, 120) or Color3.fromRGB(130, 140, 160)
                end
            end
            local function char() return plr.Character end
            local function part(name)
                local c = plr.Character
                return c and c:FindFirstChild(name)
            end
            local function root() return part("HumanoidRootPart") end

            ---------------------------------------------------------------
            -- character effects (re-applied after respawn)
            ---------------------------------------------------------------
            local fx = { halo = nil, aura = nil, trail = nil, outline = nil, rainbow = nil }

            local function clearHalo()
                if fx.halo then pcall(function() fx.halo:Destroy() end) fx.halo = nil end
            end
            local function applyHalo()
                clearHalo()
                local head = part("Head")
                if not head then return end
                local m = Instance.new("Model")
                m.Name = "PXHalo"
                local n = 16
                for i = 1, n do
                    local a = (i / n) * math.pi * 2
                    local seg = Instance.new("Part")
                    seg.Size = Vector3.new(0.16, 0.1, 0.52)
                    seg.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                    seg.Color = GOLD
                    seg.CanCollide = false
                    seg.CanQuery = false
                    seg.CanTouch = false
                    seg.Massless = true
                    seg.Parent = m
                    local w = Instance.new("Weld")
                    w.Part0 = head
                    w.Part1 = seg
                    w.C0 = CFrame.new(0, 1.45, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, a, 0) * CFrame.new(1.05, 0, 0)
                    w.Parent = seg
                    if i == 1 then
                        local l = Instance.new("PointLight")
                        l.Color = GOLD
                        l.Range = 9
                        l.Brightness = 1.2
                        l.Parent = seg
                    end
                end
                m.Parent = plr.Character
                fx.halo = m
            end

            local function clearAura()
                if fx.aura then pcall(function() fx.aura:Destroy() end) fx.aura = nil end
            end
            local function applyAura()
                clearAura()
                local r = root()
                if not r then return end
                local p = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
                p.Name = "PXAura"
                p.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
                p.Rate = 28
                p.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1.1, 1.9)
                p.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.5, 2.2)
                p.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
                p.Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.7), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) })
                p.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.2), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) })
                p.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 200), Color3.fromRGB(120, 200, 255))
                p.LightEmission = 1
                p.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
                p.Parent = r
                fx.aura = p
            end

            local function clearTrail()
                if fx.trail then for _, o in ipairs(fx.trail) do pcall(function() o:Destroy() end) end fx.trail = nil end
            end
            local function applyTrail()
                clearTrail()
                local r = root()
                if not r then return end
                local a0 = Instance.new("Attachment") a0.Name = "PXTrailA" a0.Position = Vector3.new(0, 1.1, 0) a0.Parent = r
                local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment") a1.Name = "PXTrailB" a1.Position = Vector3.new(0, -1.9, 0) a1.Parent = r
                local t = Instance.new("Trail")
                t.Name = "PXTrail"
                t.Attachment0 = a0
                t.Attachment1 = a1
                t.Lifetime = 0.7
                t.LightEmission = 1
                t.MinLength = 0.05
                t.Color = ColorSequence.new({
                    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 160)),
                    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 110)),
                    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(90, 180, 255)),
                })
                t.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) })
                t.Parent = r
                fx.trail = { a0, a1, t }
            end

            local function clearOutline()
                if fx.outline then pcall(function() fx.outline:Destroy() end) fx.outline = nil end
            end
            local function applyOutline()
                clearOutline()
                local c = char()
                if not c then return end
                local h = Instance.new("Highlight")
                h.Name = "PXOutline"
                h.FillTransparency = 1
                h.OutlineColor = GOLD
                h.OutlineTransparency = 0
                h.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
                h.Parent = c
                fx.outline = h
            end

            -- rainbow skin (restores your real colors when turned off)
            local rainbow = { conn = nil, saved = {}, acc = 0 }
            local BODY = { Head = true, Torso = true, UpperTorso = true, LowerTorso = true, LeftArm = true, RightArm = true, LeftLeg = true, RightLeg = true,
                LeftHand = true, RightHand = true, LeftFoot = true, RightFoot = true, LeftUpperArm = true, RightUpperArm = true, LeftLowerArm = true,
                RightLowerArm = true, LeftUpperLeg = true, RightUpperLeg = true, LeftLowerLeg = true, RightLowerLeg = true }
            local function rainbowRestore()
                for p, col in pairs(rainbow.saved) do
                    if p.Parent then pcall(function() p.Color = col end) end
                end
                rainbow.saved = {}
            end
            local function rainbowOff()
                if rainbow.conn then rainbow.conn:Disconnect() rainbow.conn = nil end
                rainbowRestore()
            end
            local function rainbowOn()
                rainbowOff()
                local c = char()
                if not c then return end
                for _, p in ipairs(c:GetChildren()) do
                    if p:IsA("BasePart") and BODY[p.Name] then rainbow.saved[p] = p.Color end
                end
                rainbow.conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
                    rainbow.acc = rainbow.acc + dt
                    if rainbow.acc < 0.05 then return end
                    rainbow.acc = 0
                    local h = (os.clock() * 0.25) % 1
                    local col = Color3.fromHSV(h, 0.75, 1)
                    for p in pairs(rainbow.saved) do
                        if p.Parent then p.Color = col end
                    end
                end)
            end

            ---------------------------------------------------------------
            -- camera toys
            ---------------------------------------------------------------
            local fc = { conns = {}, speed = 26 }
            local function freecamOff()
                for _, c in ipairs(fc.conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
                fc.conns = {}
                pcall(function() CAS:UnbindAction("PXFreecamSink") end)
                pcall(function() UIS.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default end)
                local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
                if cam then
                    cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
                    local c = char()
                    local h = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if h then cam.CameraSubject = h end
                end
            end
            local function freecamOn()
                local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
                if not cam then error("no camera") end
                local pitch, yaw = cam.CFrame:ToOrientation()
                local pos = cam.CFrame.Position
                cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
                local K = Enum.KeyCode
                CAS:BindActionAtPriority("PXFreecamSink", function() return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink end, false, 3000,
                    K.W, K.A, K.S, K.D, K.Q, K.E, K.Space, K.LeftShift)
                fc.conns[#fc.conns + 1] = UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
                    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and UIS:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2) then
                        yaw = yaw - input.Delta.X * 0.004
                        pitch = math.clamp(pitch - input.Delta.Y * 0.004, -1.5, 1.5)
                    elseif input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel then
                        fc.speed = math.clamp(fc.speed * (1.15 ^ input.Position.Z), 4, 400)
                    end
                end)
                fc.conns[#fc.conns + 1] = UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then UIS.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCurrentPosition end
                end)
                fc.conns[#fc.conns + 1] = UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
                    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then UIS.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default end
                end)
                fc.conns[#fc.conns + 1] = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
                    local cf = CFrame.fromOrientation(pitch, yaw, 0)
                    local mv = Vector3.zero
                    if UIS:IsKeyDown(K.W) then mv = mv + Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end
                    if UIS:IsKeyDown(K.S) then mv = mv + Vector3.new(0, 0, 1) end
                    if UIS:IsKeyDown(K.A) then mv = mv + Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0) end
                    if UIS:IsKeyDown(K.D) then mv = mv + Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) end
                    if UIS:IsKeyDown(K.E) or UIS:IsKeyDown(K.Space) then mv = mv + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
                    if UIS:IsKeyDown(K.Q) then mv = mv + Vector3.new(0, -1, 0) end
                    local sp = fc.speed * (UIS:IsKeyDown(K.LeftShift) and 3 or 1)
                    if mv.Magnitude > 0 then pos = pos + (cf * mv.Unit) * sp * dt end
                    local c2 = Workspace.CurrentCamera
                    if c2 then
                        c2.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
                        c2.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos) * cf
                    end
                end)
            end

            local fov = { old = nil, conn = nil, busy = false }
            local function fovOff()
                if fov.conn then fov.conn:Disconnect() fov.conn = nil end
                local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
                if cam and fov.old then cam.FieldOfView = fov.old end
                fov.old = nil
            end
            local function fovOn()
                local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
                if not cam then error("no camera") end
                fov.old = cam.FieldOfView
                cam.FieldOfView = 100
                fov.conn = cam:GetPropertyChangedSignal("FieldOfView"):Connect(function()
                    if fov.busy then return end
                    if math.abs(cam.FieldOfView - 100) > 0.5 then
                        fov.busy = true
                        cam.FieldOfView = 100
                        fov.busy = false
                    end
                end)
            end

            local bars = { gui = nil }
            local function barsOff()
                local g = bars.gui
                bars.gui = nil
                if g then
                    for _, f in ipairs(g:GetChildren()) do
                        if f:IsA("Frame") then
                            TweenService:Create(f, TweenInfo.new(0.4), { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0) }):Play()
                        end
                    end
                    task.delay(0.45, function() pcall(function() g:Destroy() end) end)
                end
            end
            local function barsOn()
                barsOff()
                local g = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
                g.Name = "PXLabBars"
                g.IgnoreGuiInset = true
                g.ResetOnSpawn = false
                g.DisplayOrder = 900
                pcall(function() g.Parent = (type(gethui) == "function" and gethui()) or plr:WaitForChild("PlayerGui") end)
                for i = 1, 2 do
                    local f = Instance.new("Frame")
                    f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, i == 1 and 0 or 1)
                    f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, i == 1 and 0 or 1)
                    f.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
                    f.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
                    f.BorderSizePixel = 0
                    f.Parent = g
                    TweenService:Create(f, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.11, 0) }):Play()
                end
                bars.gui = g
            end

            ---------------------------------------------------------------
            -- HUD (fps, ping, time, speed, position)
            ---------------------------------------------------------------
            local hud = { gui = nil, conn = nil }
            local function hudOff()
                if hud.conn then hud.conn:Disconnect() hud.conn = nil end
                if hud.drag then hud.drag:Disconnect() hud.drag = nil end
                if hud.gui then pcall(function() hud.gui:Destroy() end) hud.gui = nil end
            end
            local function hudOn()
                hudOff()
                local g = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
                g.Name = "PXLabHud"
                g.ResetOnSpawn = false
                g.DisplayOrder = 899
                pcall(function() g.Parent = (type(gethui) == "function" and gethui()) or plr:WaitForChild("PlayerGui") end)
                local f = Instance.new("Frame")
                f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12)
                f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(170, 92)
                f.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 16)
                f.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
                f.BorderSizePixel = 0
                f.Active = true
                f.Parent = g
                corner(f, 12)
                stroke(f, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), 1, 0.85)
                local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                l.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -14)
                l.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 7)
                l.Font = Enum.Font.Code
                l.TextSize = 13
                l.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 245)
                l.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
                l.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
                l.Text = ""
                l.Parent = f
                -- drag
                local dragging, off = false, Vector2.zero
                f.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
                    if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        dragging = true
                        off = Vector2.new(i.Position.X, i.Position.Y) - f.AbsolutePosition
                    end
                end)
                f.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
                    if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then dragging = false end
                end)
                hud.drag = UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
                    if dragging and f.Parent and (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
                        local p = Vector2.new(i.Position.X, i.Position.Y) - off
                        f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(p.X, p.Y)
                    end
                end)
                local frames, acc, fps = 0, 0, 60
                hud.conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
                    frames = frames + 1
                    acc = acc + dt
                    if acc < 0.5 then return end
                    fps = math.floor(frames / acc + 0.5)
                    frames, acc = 0, 0
                    local ping = 0
                    pcall(function() ping = math.floor(plr:GetNetworkPing() * 1000 + 0.5) end)
                    local r = root()
                    local spd, pos = 0, Vector3.zero
                    if r then spd = r.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude pos = r.Position end
                    l.Text = string.format("FPS   %d\nPING  %d ms\nTIME  %s\nSPEED %.0f\nPOS   %d %d %d", fps, ping, os.date("%H:%M:%S"), spd, pos.X, pos.Y, pos.Z)
                end)
                hud.gui = g
            end

            ---------------------------------------------------------------
            -- photo mode (hide every GUI, P brings it back)
            ---------------------------------------------------------------
            local photo = { saved = {}, conn = nil, token = 0 }
            local setCard
            local function photoOff()
                photo.token = photo.token + 1
                if photo.conn then photo.conn:Disconnect() photo.conn = nil end
                for _, e in ipairs(photo.saved) do
                    if e.i and e.i.Parent then pcall(function() e.i.Enabled = e.was end) end
                end
                photo.saved = {}
                pcall(function() StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.All, true) end)
            end
            local function photoOn()
                photoOff()
                local seen = {}
                local function grab(root0)
                    if not root0 then return end
                    for _, g in ipairs(root0:GetChildren()) do
                        if (g:IsA("ScreenGui") or g:IsA("BillboardGui")) and g.Enabled and not seen[g] then
                            seen[g] = true
                            photo.saved[#photo.saved + 1] = { i = g, was = true }
                            g.Enabled = false
                        end
                    end
                end
                grab(plr:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui"))
                pcall(function() if type(gethui) == "function" then grab(gethui()) end end)
                pcall(function() StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.All, false) end)
                local my = photo.token
                photo.conn = UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
                    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.P and not UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() then
                        photoOff()
                        if setCard then setCard("photo", false) end
                    end
                end)
                task.delay(120, function()
                    if photo.token == my and #photo.saved > 0 then
                        photoOff()
                        if setCard then setCard("photo", false) end
                    end
                end)
            end

            ---------------------------------------------------------------
            -- cursor trail
            ---------------------------------------------------------------
            local trail = { gui = nil, conn = nil }
            local function cursorOff()
                if trail.conn then trail.conn:Disconnect() trail.conn = nil end
                if trail.gui then pcall(function() trail.gui:Destroy() end) trail.gui = nil end
            end
            local function cursorOn()
                cursorOff()
                local g = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
                g.Name = "PXLabCursor"
                g.IgnoreGuiInset = true
                g.ResetOnSpawn = false
                g.DisplayOrder = 998
                pcall(function() g.Parent = (type(gethui) == "function" and gethui()) or plr:WaitForChild("PlayerGui") end)
                local N = 16
                local dots, pos = {}, {}
                local start = UIS:GetMouseLocation()
                for i = 1, N do
                    local d = Instance.new("Frame")
                    d.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                    local s = math.max(3, 14 - i)
                    d.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(s, s)
                    d.BorderSizePixel = 0
                    d.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2 + (i / N) * 0.75
                    d.Parent = g
                    corner(d, UDim.new(1, 0))
                    dots[i] = d
                    pos[i] = start
                end
                trail.conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
                    local m = UIS:GetMouseLocation()
                    local a = 1 - math.exp(-24 * dt)
                    local now = os.clock()
                    pos[1] = pos[1]:Lerp(m, a)
                    for i = 2, N do pos[i] = pos[i]:Lerp(pos[i - 1], a) end
                    for i = 1, N do
                        dots[i].Position = UDim2.fromOffset(pos[i].X, pos[i].Y)
                        dots[i].BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHSV((now * 0.35 + i * 0.03) % 1, 0.65, 1)
                    end
                end)
                trail.gui = g
            end

            ---------------------------------------------------------------
            -- world toys
            ---------------------------------------------------------------
            local grav = { old = nil }
            local function gravOff() if grav.old then Workspace.Gravity = grav.old grav.old = nil end end
            local function gravOn() grav.old = Workspace.Gravity Workspace.Gravity = 55 end

            local tl = { old = nil, conn = nil }
            local function tlOff()
                if tl.conn then tl.conn:Disconnect() tl.conn = nil end
                if tl.old then Lighting.ClockTime = tl.old tl.old = nil end
            end
            local function tlOn()
                tlOff()
                tl.old = Lighting.ClockTime
                tl.conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
                    Lighting.ClockTime = (Lighting.ClockTime + dt * 0.8) % 24
                end)
            end

            ---------------------------------------------------------------
            -- stationary lock: camera stays put, the mouse turns the character,
            -- hold right mouse and the camera follows you again
            ---------------------------------------------------------------
            local sl = { conns = {}, yaw = 0, rot = nil, off = nil, ctrl = nil, ctrlTry = 0, manual = false, engaged = false, rmb = false, alt = false, sink = false, lastRoot = nil, oldIcon = nil }
            local K2 = Enum.KeyCode
            local function slSink(on)
                if on == sl.sink then return end
                sl.sink = on
                if on then
                    CAS:BindActionAtPriority("PXStationarySink", function() return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink end, false, 3000,
                        K2.W, K2.A, K2.S, K2.D)
                else
                    pcall(function() CAS:UnbindAction("PXStationarySink") end)
                end
            end
            local function slFree()
                return sl.rmb or sl.alt or UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() ~= nil
            end
            -- is Roblox's own shift lock switched on? (read from the PlayerModule, Shift key as a fallback)
            local function slLocked()
                if not sl.ctrl and os.clock() - sl.ctrlTry > 2 then
                    sl.ctrlTry = os.clock()
                    pcall(function()
                        local ps = plr:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
                        local pm = ps and ps:FindFirstChild("PlayerModule")
                        if pm then
                            local cams = require(pm):GetCameras()
                            if cams and cams.activeMouseLockController then sl.ctrl = cams.activeMouseLockController end
                        end
                    end)
                end
                if sl.ctrl then
                    local ok2, v = pcall(function() return sl.ctrl:GetIsMouseLocked() end)
                    if ok2 then return v == true end
                end
                return sl.manual
            end
            local function slRelease()
                sl.engaged = false
                slSink(false)
                sl.rot = nil
                if sl.oldIcon ~= nil then pcall(function() UIS.MouseIconEnabled = sl.oldIcon end) sl.oldIcon = nil end
                local c = plr.Character
                local hum = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if hum then
                    hum.AutoRotate = true
                    pcall(function() hum:Move(Vector3.zero, false) end)
                end
                local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
                if cam and cam.CameraType == Enum.CameraType.Scriptable then
                    cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
                    if hum then cam.CameraSubject = hum end
                end
                pcall(function() UIS.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default end)
            end
            local function slFrame(dt)
                local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
                if not cam then return end
                local c = plr.Character
                local hum = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local r = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                -- only active while shift lock is on; otherwise Roblox's normal camera is left alone
                if not slLocked() then
                    if sl.engaged then slRelease() end
                    return
                end
                if not sl.engaged then
                    sl.engaged = true
                    sl.rot = nil
                    if sl.oldIcon == nil then sl.oldIcon = UIS.MouseIconEnabled end
                end
                if slFree() then
                    slSink(false)
                    if hum and not hum.AutoRotate then hum.AutoRotate = true end
                    if sl.rmb then
                        -- camera follows the character (normal Roblox camera) while right mouse is held
                        if cam.CameraType ~= Enum.CameraType.Custom then
                            cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
                            if hum then cam.CameraSubject = hum end
                        end
                    else
                        UIS.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
                    end
                    return
                end
                if cam.CameraType ~= Enum.CameraType.Scriptable then cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable end
                -- the camera keeps its angle but follows the character around
                if not sl.rot then
                    sl.rot = cam.CFrame.Rotation
                    sl.off = (r and (cam.CFrame.Position - r.Position)) or sl.off or Vector3.new(0, 5, 10)
                end
                local target = r and (r.Position + sl.off) or cam.CFrame.Position
                local cpos = cam.CFrame.Position:Lerp(target, 1 - math.exp(-25 * dt))
                cam.CFrame = CFrame.new(cpos) * sl.rot
                UIS.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
                slSink(true)
                if not (hum and r) then return end
                if hum.AutoRotate then hum.AutoRotate = false end
                if r ~= sl.lastRoot then
                    sl.lastRoot = r
                    local _, y = r.CFrame:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()
                    sl.yaw = y
                end
                r.CFrame = CFrame.new(r.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, sl.yaw, 0)
                local fwd = (UIS:IsKeyDown(K2.W) and 1 or 0) - (UIS:IsKeyDown(K2.S) and 1 or 0)
                local side = (UIS:IsKeyDown(K2.D) and 1 or 0) - (UIS:IsKeyDown(K2.A) and 1 or 0)
                local dir = r.CFrame.LookVector * fwd + r.CFrame.RightVector * side
                hum:Move(dir.Magnitude > 0 and dir.Unit or Vector3.zero, false)
            end
            local function slOff()
                for _, c in ipairs(sl.conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
                sl.conns = {}
                pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("PXStationary") end)
                slSink(false)
                pcall(function() UIS.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default end)
                if sl.oldIcon ~= nil then pcall(function() UIS.MouseIconEnabled = sl.oldIcon end) sl.oldIcon = nil end
                local c = plr.Character
                local hum = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if hum then hum.AutoRotate = true pcall(function() hum:Move(Vector3.zero, false) end) end
                local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
                if cam then
                    cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
                    if hum then cam.CameraSubject = hum end
                end
                sl.rot, sl.off, sl.lastRoot, sl.rmb, sl.alt, sl.engaged = nil, nil, nil, false, false, false
            end
            local function slOn()
                slOff()
                local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
                if not cam then error("no camera") end
                sl.rot = nil
                sl.oldIcon = UIS.MouseIconEnabled
                local sens = 1
                pcall(function() sens = UserSettings():GetService("UserGameSettings").MouseSensitivity end)
                local k = 0.0028 * (sens or 1)
                sl.conns[#sl.conns + 1] = UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
                    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and not slFree() then
                        sl.yaw = sl.yaw - input.Delta.X * k
                    elseif input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel and sl.off and not slFree() then
                        local o = sl.off * (1.12 ^ -input.Position.Z)
                        local m = o.Magnitude
                        if m < 3 then o = o.Unit * 3 elseif m > 120 then o = o.Unit * 120 end
                        sl.off = o
                    end
                end)
                sl.conns[#sl.conns + 1] = UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
                    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
                        sl.rmb = true
                    elseif input.KeyCode == K2.LeftAlt then
                        sl.alt = true
                    elseif (input.KeyCode == K2.LeftShift or input.KeyCode == K2.RightShift) and not sl.ctrl and not UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() then
                        sl.manual = not sl.manual
                    end
                end)
                sl.conns[#sl.conns + 1] = UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
                    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
                        sl.rmb = false
                        -- keep whatever angle the camera ended up at
                        sl.rot = nil
                    elseif input.KeyCode == K2.LeftAlt then
                        sl.alt = false
                    end
                end)
                RunService:BindToRenderStep("PXStationary", Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value, function(dt)
                    local ok2, e = pcall(slFrame, dt)
                    if not ok2 then warn("[PARALLAX lab] stationary: " .. tostring(e)) end
                end)
            end

            ---------------------------------------------------------------
            -- MORE TOYS: wings, orbiting orbs, magic circle, afterimages, flames, electricity,
            -- shockwaves, fireflies, snow, synthwave sky, speed FOV, spin, hover
            ---------------------------------------------------------------
            local fold = nil
            local function fxFolder()
                if not fold or not fold.Parent then
                    fold = Instance.new("Folder")
                    fold.Name = "PXLabFx"
                    fold.Parent = Workspace
                end
                return fold
            end
            local function hue(h, s, v) return Color3.fromHSV(h % 1, s or 0.7, v or 1) end

            -- one shared loop drives every animated toy, and only exists while one is on
            local dyn, dynConn = {}, nil
            local function dynAdd(id, fn)
                dyn[id] = fn
                if not dynConn then
                    dynConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
                        local t = os.clock()
                        for k, f in pairs(dyn) do
                            local ok2, e = pcall(f, dt, t)
                            if not ok2 then dyn[k] = nil warn("[PARALLAX lab] " .. tostring(k) .. ": " .. tostring(e)) end
                        end
                        if next(dyn) == nil and dynConn then dynConn:Disconnect() dynConn = nil end
                    end)
                end
            end
            local function dynRemove(id)
                dyn[id] = nil
                if next(dyn) == nil and dynConn then dynConn:Disconnect() dynConn = nil end
            end
            local function groundAt(pos, ignore)
                local params = RaycastParams.new()
                params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
                params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { ignore or plr.Character, fold }
                local hit = Workspace:Raycast(pos, Vector3.new(0, -14, 0), params)
                return hit and (hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.06, 0)) or (pos - Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
            end
            local function destroyList(list)
                for _, o in ipairs(list) do pcall(function() o:Destroy() end) end
            end

            -- wings
            local wings = { parts = {}, welds = {} }
            local function wingsOff()
                dynRemove("wings")
                destroyList(wings.parts)
                wings.parts, wings.welds = {}, {}
            end
            local function wingsOn()
                wingsOff()
                local torso = part("UpperTorso") or part("Torso")
                if not torso then error("no torso") end
                for side = -1, 1, 2 do
                    for i = 1, 6 do
                        local L = 3.4 - i * 0.38
                        local p = Instance.new("Part")
                        p.Size = Vector3.new(L, 0.07, 0.42)
                        p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                        p.Color = Color3.fromHSV(0.58 + i * 0.015, 0.25, 1)
                        p.Transparency = 0.12
                        p.CanCollide = false p.CanQuery = false p.CanTouch = false p.Massless = true
                        local w = Instance.new("Weld")
                        w.Part0 = torso
                        w.Part1 = p
                        w.Parent = p
                        p.Parent = char()
                        wings.parts[#wings.parts + 1] = p
                        wings.welds[#wings.welds + 1] = { w = w, side = side, i = i, L = L }
                    end
                end
                dynAdd("wings", function(dt, t)
                    local flap = math.sin(t * 4.2)
                    for _, e in ipairs(wings.welds) do
                        if e.w.Parent then
                            e.w.C0 = CFrame.new(e.side * 0.35, 0.7 - e.i * 0.12, 0.55)
                                * CFrame.Angles(0, e.side * (-0.55 - e.i * 0.13), e.side * (0.25 + flap * 0.5 + e.i * 0.05))
                                * CFrame.new(e.side * e.L / 2, 0, 0)
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end

            -- orbiting orbs with trails
            local orbs = { parts = {} }
            local function orbsOff()
                dynRemove("orbs")
                destroyList(orbs.parts)
                orbs.parts = {}
            end
            local function orbsOn()
                orbsOff()
                for i = 1, 6 do
                    local p = Instance.new("Part")
                    p.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
                    p.Size = Vector3.new(0.7, 0.7, 0.7)
                    p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                    p.Color = hue(i / 6, 0.75, 1)
                    p.Anchored = true
                    p.CanCollide = false p.CanQuery = false p.CanTouch = false
                    local a0 = Instance.new("Attachment") a0.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0.3, 0) a0.Parent = p
                    local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment") a1.Position = Vector3.new(0, -0.3, 0) a1.Parent = p
                    local tr = Instance.new("Trail")
                    tr.Attachment0, tr.Attachment1 = a0, a1
                    tr.Lifetime = 0.45
                    tr.LightEmission = 1
                    tr.Color = ColorSequence.new(p.Color, Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
                    tr.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) })
                    tr.Parent = p
                    p.Parent = fxFolder()
                    orbs.parts[i] = p
                end
                dynAdd("orbs", function(dt, t)
                    local r = root()
                    if not r then return end
                    for i, p in ipairs(orbs.parts) do
                        local ang = t * (1.5 + i * 0.12) + i * (math.pi * 2 / 6)
                        local rad = 3.3 + math.sin(t * 0.8 + i) * 0.5
                        p.CFrame = CFrame.new(r.Position + Vector3.new(math.cos(ang) * rad, math.sin(t * 1.6 + i * 2) * 1.3, math.sin(ang) * rad))
                    end
                end)
            end

            -- magic circle under your feet
            local ring = { parts = {}, cfs = {} }
            local function ringOff()
                dynRemove("ring")
                destroyList(ring.parts)
                ring.parts, ring.cfs = {}, {}
            end
            local function ringOn()
                ringOff()
                local layout = { { 36, 4.2, 1 }, { 20, 2.8, -1.6 }, { 8, 1.3, 2.4 } }
                for li, L in ipairs(layout) do
                    for i = 1, L[1] do
                        local p = Instance.new("Part")
                        p.Size = Vector3.new(0.18, 0.06, li == 1 and 0.7 or 0.45)
                        p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                        p.Color = hue(li * 0.17 + 0.5, 0.8, 1)
                        p.Anchored = true
                        p.CanCollide = false p.CanQuery = false p.CanTouch = false
                        p.Transparency = 0.1
                        p.Parent = fxFolder()
                        ring.parts[#ring.parts + 1] = p
                    end
                end
                dynAdd("ring", function(dt, t)
                    local r = root()
                    if not r then return end
                    local c = groundAt(r.Position)
                    local k = 0
                    for li, L in ipairs(layout) do
                        for i = 1, L[1] do
                            k = k + 1
                            local a = (i / L[1]) * math.pi * 2 + t * L[3]
                            ring.cfs[k] = CFrame.new(c) * CFrame.Angles(0, a, 0) * CFrame.new(L[2], 0, 0)
                        end
                    end
                    local ok2 = pcall(function() Workspace:BulkMoveTo(ring.parts, ring.cfs, Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged) end)
                    if not ok2 then
                        for j, p in ipairs(ring.parts) do p.CFrame = ring.cfs[j] end
                    end
                end)
            end

            -- afterimages while moving
            local ghost = { acc = 0 }
            local function ghostOff() dynRemove("ghost") end
            local function ghostOn()
                ghostOff()
                dynAdd("ghost", function(dt, t)
                    ghost.acc = ghost.acc + dt
                    if ghost.acc < 0.07 then return end
                    ghost.acc = 0
                    local c, r = char(), root()
                    if not (c and r) or r.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude < 7 then return end
                    local col = hue(t * 0.3, 0.7, 1)
                    for _, p in ipairs(c:GetChildren()) do
                        if p:IsA("BasePart") and BODY[p.Name] then
                            local g = Instance.new("Part")
                            g.Size = p.Size
                            g.CFrame = p.CFrame
                            g.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                            g.Color = col
                            g.Transparency = 0.45
                            g.Anchored = true
                            g.CanCollide = false g.CanQuery = false g.CanTouch = false
                            g.Parent = fxFolder()
                            TweenService:Create(g, TweenInfo.new(0.55, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), { Transparency = 1 }):Play()
                            game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(g, 0.6)
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end

            -- flames and electricity (particles on your root part)
            local emit = {}
            local function emitOff(id)
                if emit[id] then for _, o in ipairs(emit[id]) do pcall(function() o:Destroy() end) end emit[id] = nil end
            end
            local function flameOn()
                emitOff("flame")
                local r = root()
                if not r then return end
                local p = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
                p.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/fire_main.dds"
                p.Rate = 55
                p.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 0.95)
                p.Speed = NumberRange.new(2, 4)
                p.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(28, 28)
                p.Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1.7), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) })
                p.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) })
                p.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 70), Color3.fromRGB(255, 40, 10))
                p.LightEmission = 1
                p.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
                p.Parent = r
                local l = Instance.new("PointLight") l.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 40) l.Range = 12 l.Brightness = 1.5 l.Parent = r
                emit.flame = { p, l }
            end
            local function electricOn()
                emitOff("electric")
                local r = root()
                if not r then return end
                local p = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
                p.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
                p.Rate = 70
                p.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.15, 0.35)
                p.Speed = NumberRange.new(9, 16)
                p.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
                p.Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.55), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) })
                p.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(170, 230, 255), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
                p.LightEmission = 1
                p.Parent = r
                local l = Instance.new("PointLight") l.Color = Color3.fromRGB(130, 200, 255) l.Range = 14 l.Brightness = 1.4 l.Parent = r
                emit.electric = { p, l }
            end

            -- shockwave rings on jump and landing
            local shock = { conn = nil }
            local function shockwave(pos, col)
                local p = Instance.new("Part")
                p.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
                p.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 1, 1)
                p.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.pi / 2)
                p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                p.Color = col
                p.Transparency = 0.15
                p.Anchored = true
                p.CanCollide = false p.CanQuery = false p.CanTouch = false
                p.Parent = fxFolder()
                TweenService:Create(p, TweenInfo.new(0.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                    { Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 20, 20), Transparency = 1 }):Play()
                game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(p, 0.7)
            end
            local function shockOff()
                if shock.conn then shock.conn:Disconnect() shock.conn = nil end
            end
            local function shockOn()
                shockOff()
                local c = char()
                local h = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if not h then error("no humanoid") end
                shock.conn = h.StateChanged:Connect(function(_, new)
                    local r = root()
                    if not r then return end
                    if new == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then
                        shockwave(groundAt(r.Position), Color3.fromRGB(120, 200, 255))
                    elseif new == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed then
                        shockwave(groundAt(r.Position), Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 90))
                    end
                end)
            end

            -- fireflies / snow that follow the camera
            local sky = { parts = {} }
            local function skyOff(id)
                dynRemove(id)
                if sky.parts[id] then pcall(function() sky.parts[id]:Destroy() end) sky.parts[id] = nil end
            end
            local function skyOn(id, size, up, setup)
                skyOff(id)
                local p = Instance.new("Part")
                p.Size = size
                p.Transparency = 1
                p.Anchored = true
                p.CanCollide = false p.CanQuery = false p.CanTouch = false
                local e = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
                e.Shape = Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Box
                e.ShapeStyle = Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeStyle.Volume
                setup(e)
                e.Parent = p
                p.Parent = fxFolder()
                sky.parts[id] = p
                dynAdd(id, function()
                    local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
                    if cam then p.CFrame = CFrame.new(cam.CFrame.Position + Vector3.new(0, up, 0)) end
                end)
            end
            local function firefliesOn()
                skyOn("fireflies", Vector3.new(90, 26, 90), 4, function(e)
                    e.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
                    e.Rate = 22
                    e.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(4, 7)
                    e.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.4, 1.6)
                    e.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
                    e.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.45)
                    e.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.2, 0.2), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.8, 0.2), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) })
                    e.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(230, 255, 120), Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 90))
                    e.LightEmission = 1
                end)
            end
            local function snowOn()
                skyOn("snow", Vector3.new(110, 2, 110), 38, function(e)
                    e.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
                    e.Rate = 140
                    e.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(7, 9)
                    e.Speed = NumberRange.new(3, 5)
                    e.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Bottom
                    e.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(18, 18)
                    e.Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.35), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.2) })
                    e.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.2)
                    e.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-60, 60)
                    e.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0.6, -1, 0.4)
                    e.LightEmission = 0.4
                end)
            end

            -- synthwave look (restores every changed value)
            local syn = { saved = nil, made = {} }
            local function synOff()
                if syn.saved then
                    local s = syn.saved
                    pcall(function() Lighting.Ambient = s.amb Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = s.out Lighting.ClockTime = s.clock Lighting.Brightness = s.bright end)
                    if s.atmo and s.atmo.Parent then
                        pcall(function()
                            s.atmo.Color, s.atmo.Decay, s.atmo.Density = s.acolor, s.adecay, s.adens
                            s.atmo.Haze, s.atmo.Glare, s.atmo.Offset = s.ahaze, s.aglare, s.aoff
                        end)
                    end
                    syn.saved = nil
                end
                destroyList(syn.made)
                syn.made = {}
            end
            local function synOn()
                synOff()
                local a = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
                syn.saved = { amb = Lighting.Ambient, out = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient, clock = Lighting.ClockTime, bright = Lighting.Brightness, atmo = a }
                if a then
                    local s = syn.saved
                    s.acolor, s.adecay, s.adens, s.ahaze, s.aglare, s.aoff = a.Color, a.Decay, a.Density, a.Haze, a.Glare, a.Offset
                else
                    a = Instance.new("Atmosphere")
                    a.Name = "PXSynthAtmosphere"
                    a.Parent = Lighting
                    syn.made[#syn.made + 1] = a
                end
                a.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 200)
                a.Decay = Color3.fromRGB(130, 50, 190)
                a.Density = 0.32
                a.Haze = 1.6
                a.Glare = 0.5
                a.Offset = 0.2
                Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(90, 45, 130)
                Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(110, 60, 150)
                Lighting.ClockTime = 18.6
                Lighting.Brightness = 1.6
                local cc = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
                cc.Name = "PXSynthColor"
                cc.TintColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 255)
                cc.Saturation = 0.25
                cc.Contrast = 0.12
                cc.Parent = Lighting
                local bl = Instance.new("BloomEffect")
                bl.Name = "PXSynthBloom"
                bl.Intensity = 0.8
                bl.Size = 36
                bl.Threshold = 0.85
                bl.Parent = Lighting
                syn.made[#syn.made + 1] = cc
                syn.made[#syn.made + 1] = bl
            end

            -- FOV grows with your speed
            local sf = { old = nil }
            local function sfOff()
                dynRemove("speedfov")
                local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
                if cam and sf.old then cam.FieldOfView = sf.old end
                sf.old = nil
            end
            local function sfOn()
                sfOff()
                local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
                if not cam then error("no camera") end
                sf.old = cam.FieldOfView
                dynAdd("speedfov", function(dt)
                    local c2 = Workspace.CurrentCamera
                    local r = root()
                    if not (c2 and r) then return end
                    local goal = sf.old + math.clamp(r.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude - 16, 0, 60) * 0.55
                    c2.FieldOfView = c2.FieldOfView + (goal - c2.FieldOfView) * (1 - math.exp(-6 * dt))
                end)
            end

            -- spin and hover
            local function spinOff() dynRemove("spin") end
            local function spinOn()
                dynAdd("spin", function(dt)
                    local r = root()
                    if r then r.CFrame = r.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, dt * 11, 0) end
                end)
            end
            local hov = { old = nil, hum = nil }
            local function hoverOff()
                dynRemove("hover")
                if hov.hum and hov.hum.Parent and hov.old then hov.hum.HipHeight = hov.old end
                hov.old, hov.hum = nil, nil
            end
            local function hoverOn()
                hoverOff()
                local c = char()
                local h = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if not h then error("no humanoid") end
                hov.hum, hov.old = h, h.HipHeight
                dynAdd("hover", function(dt, t)
                    if h.Parent then h.HipHeight = hov.old + 3 + math.sin(t * 2) * 0.35 end
                end)
            end

                order[#order + 1] = id
            end

                    local ok2, e = pcall(f.off)
                    f.state = false
                    paint(id)
                    say(f.title .. " off.")
                    if not ok2 then say(f.title .. ": " .. tostring(e), true) end
                else
                    local ok2, e = pcall(f.on)
                    if ok2 then
                        f.state = true
                        paint(id)
                        say(f.title .. " on.")
                    else
                        f.state = false
                        paint(id)
                        say(f.title .. " couldn't start: " .. tostring(e), true)
                    end
                end

                    if type(d) == "table" and type(d.path) == "table" and #d.path > 0 then cfg = d end
                end

            local function isRemote(i)
                return typeof(i) == "Instance" and (i:IsA("RemoteEvent") or i:IsA("RemoteFunction") or i:IsA("BindableEvent"))
            end
            local function resolve(list)
                local cur = game
                for i, name in ipairs(list) do
                    local nxt
                    if i == 1 then
                        pcall(function() nxt = game:GetService(name) end)
                        if not nxt then nxt = game:FindFirstChild(name) end
                    else
                        nxt = cur:FindFirstChild(name) or cur:WaitForChild(name, 3)
                    end
                    if not nxt then return nil end
                    cur = nxt
                end
                return cur
            end
            -- used by the reanimation when it turns on / off

                if not cfg then return nil end
                local inst = resolve(cfg.path)
                if not isRemote(inst) then return nil end
                local args = {}
                local okA, decoded = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(cfg.args or "[]") end)
                if okA and type(decoded) == "table" then
                    for i, v in ipairs(decoded) do
                        if v == "$enable" then args[i] = (enable == true) else args[i] = v end
                    end
                end
                return inst, args, inst:IsA("BindableEvent")
            end

                    if trimmed ~= "" then list[#list + 1] = trimmed end
                end
                if #list == 0 then say("Type or pick a remote first.", true) return end
                local argText = (argBox.Text ~= "" and argBox.Text) or "[]"

            local scanning = false

                if scanning then return end

                    if ch:IsA("Frame") then ch:Destroy() end
                end
                local word = string.lower(filterBox.Text or "")
                local keys = (word ~= "") and { word } or { "rag", "physics", "limp", "knock", "fall" }
                local found, seen = 0, 0
                for _, svc in ipairs({ "ReplicatedStorage", "ReplicatedFirst", "Workspace" }) do
                    local root = game:FindFirstChild(svc)
                    if root then
                        for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
                            seen = seen + 1
                            if seen % 1500 == 0 then task.wait() end
                            if isRemote(d) then
                                local ln = string.lower(d.Name)
                                local hit = false
                                for _, k in ipairs(keys) do
                                    if string.find(ln, k, 1, true) then hit = true break end
                                end
                                if hit and found < 60 then
                                    found = found + 1
                                    local row = Instance.new("Frame")
                                    row.LayoutOrder = found
                                    row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 30)
                                    row.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(34, 20, 22)

                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                scanning = false
                say(found == 0 and "Nothing matched. Try another word, such as the name you see in the game's ragdoll code." or (found .. " found. Pick the one that ragdolls your character."), found == 0)
            end

                            posL.Text = string.format("X: %.1f  Y: %.1f  Z: %.1f", p.X, p.Y, p.Z)
                        end)
                    end
                    coordHud.Enabled = true
                else
                    if coordHud then coordHud.Enabled = false end
                    if coordConn then coordConn:Disconnect(); coordConn = nil end
                end
            end)

            local function stopTrack()
                if mps.snd then
                    pcall(function() mps.snd:Stop() end)
                    pcall(function() mps.snd:Destroy() end)
                    mps.snd = nil
                end
                mps.playing = false
                if npPlay then npPlay.Text = "PLAY" end
                if npFill then npFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0,1) end
            end

            local function setRow(i)
                for j,r in ipairs(songRows) do
                    if r then
                        r.BackgroundColor3 = j==i and Color3.fromRGB(255,140,0) or Color3.fromRGB(28,20,36)
                    end
                end
            end

            local function updSky()
                if not skyGui or not skyLbl then return end
                local t = TRACKS[mps.idx]
                if skyOn and t then
                    skyGui.Enabled = true
                    skyLbl.Text = t.n.."  --  "..t.a
                    pcall(function()
                        skyLbl.TextTransparency = 1
                        local tw = TweenService:Create(skyLbl,
                            TweenInfo.new(0.55, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                            {TextTransparency = 0})
                        tw:Play()
                    end)
                else
                    pcall(function()
                        local tw = TweenService:Create(skyLbl,
                            TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
                            {TextTransparency = 1})
                        tw:Play()
                        tw.Completed:Connect(function()
                            if not skyOn then skyGui.Enabled = false end
                        end)
                    end)
                end
            end

            local function playTrack(idx)
                stopTrack()
                mps.idx = idx
                setRow(idx)
                local t = TRACKS[idx]
                if not t then return end
                if npTit then npTit.Text = t.n end
                if npArt then npArt.Text = t.a end
                updSky()
                local aid
                pcall(function()
                    if type(getcustomasset)=="function" then
                        aid = getcustomasset(MFOLD.."/"..t.f)
                    end
                end)
                if not aid then
                    if npTit then npTit.Text = t.n.." (place file in Parallax/music/)" end
                    return
                end
                local snd = Instance.new("Sound")
                snd.SoundId = aid
                snd.Volume = mps.vol
                snd.Parent = workspace
                mps.snd = snd
                mps.playing = true
                if npPlay then npPlay.Text = "PAUSE" end
                pcall(function() snd:Play() end)
                snd.Ended:Connect(function()
                    if mps.loop then
                        playTrack(idx)
                    elseif mps.shuf then
                        playTrack(math.random(1,#TRACKS))
                    elseif idx < #TRACKS then
                        playTrack(idx+1)
                    else
                        stopTrack()
                    end
                end)
            end

            local function pauseResume()
                if not mps.snd then playTrack(mps.idx); return end
                if mps.playing then
                    pcall(function() mps.snd:Pause() end)
                    mps.playing = false
                    if npPlay then npPlay.Text = "PLAY" end
                else
                    pcall(function() mps.snd:Resume() end)
                    mps.playing = true
                    if npPlay then npPlay.Text = "PAUSE" end
                end
            end

        local function openShell()
            if shell.Visible then return end
            shell.Visible = true
            pcall(function()
                contentScale.Scale = 0.9
                shell.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.54, 0)
                TweenService:Create(contentScale, TweenInfo.new(0.34, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1 }):Play()
                TweenService:Create(shell, TweenInfo.new(0.34, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5) }):Play()
            end)
        end
        local function closeShell()
            if not shell.Visible then return end
            local ok = pcall(function()
                TweenService:Create(contentScale, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), { Scale = 0.92 }):Play()
                local tw = TweenService:Create(shell, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), { Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.55, 0) })
                tw.Completed:Connect(function()
                    shell.Visible = false
                    contentScale.Scale = 1
                    shell.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
                end)
                tw:Play()
            end)
            if not ok then shell.Visible = false end
        end
        local function toggle()
            if loader.Visible then return end
            if shell.Visible then closeShell() else openShell() end
        end
        dock.MouseButton1Click:Connect(openShell)  -- dock only opens; use X button to close
        close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(closeShell)

        -- Click anywhere off the hub to close it, with the same animation the X
        -- button plays.  Hit-test the shell's rectangle rather than trusting
        -- gameProcessedEvent, which is true for a click on ANY gui, this one
        -- included, so it cannot tell inside from outside.
        do
            local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
            local function inside(o, x, y)
                if not (o and o.Visible) then return false end
                local p, sz = o.AbsolutePosition, o.AbsoluteSize
                return x >= p.X and x <= p.X + sz.X and y >= p.Y and y <= p.Y + sz.Y
            end
            UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                    and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                    return
                end
                if not shell.Visible then return end
                if loader and loader.Visible then return end
                local x, y = input.Position.X, input.Position.Y
                if inside(shell, x, y) then return end
                if inside(dock, x, y) then return end
                closeShell()
            end)
        end

        task.spawn(function()
