local function startSkyLyrics()
    local old = workspace:FindFirstChild("PrismSkyWords")
    if old then pcall(function() old:Destroy() end) end
    _G._PrismLyricPack = nil
end
startSkyLyrics()

--========================================================
--  Avatar appearance helpers
--    (fixes "copy avatar removes accessories / hair"):
--    we apply the full HumanoidDescription AND mirror the
--    target's live accessories, then force-attach every
--    accessory so nothing ends up hidden inside the head.
--========================================================

-- keep only the pieces that match `pred`, cloned from tChar onto char
local function mirrorCategory(char, tChar, pred)
    local src = {}
    for _, o in ipairs(tChar:GetChildren()) do
        if pred(o) then src[#src + 1] = o end
    end
    if #src == 0 then return false end
    for _, o in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        if pred(o) then pcall(function() o:Destroy() end) end
    end
    for _, o in ipairs(src) do
        pcall(function() o:Clone().Parent = char end)
    end
    return true
end

-- Weld a hat by its attachment, the same way Roblox does.
-- Putting the handle on the attachment's world position sinks the
-- mesh into the head, which is why hair looked stuck in the wrong spot.
local function attachAccessory(char, acc)
    local handle = acc:FindFirstChild("Handle")
    if not handle or not handle:IsA("BasePart") then return end
    for _, j in ipairs(handle:GetChildren()) do
        if j:IsA("Weld") or j:IsA("WeldConstraint") or j:IsA("Motor6D") then
            pcall(function() j:Destroy() end)
        end
    end
    for _, a in ipairs(handle:GetChildren()) do
        if a:IsA("Attachment") then
            local match = char:FindFirstChild(a.Name, true)
            if match and match:IsA("Attachment") and match.Parent and match.Parent:IsA("BasePart") and match:IsDescendantOf(char) then
                handle.Anchored = false
                handle.CanCollide = false
                handle.Massless = true
                local w = Instance.new("Weld")
                w.Name = "AccessoryWeld"
                w.Part0 = match.Parent
                w.Part1 = handle
                w.C0 = match.CFrame
                w.C1 = a.CFrame
                w.Parent = handle
                return
            end
        end
    end
end

local function ensureAccessoriesAttached(char)
    if not char then return end
    for _, acc in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        if acc:IsA("Accessory") or acc:IsA("Hat") then
            pcall(attachAccessory, char, acc)
        end
    end
end

-- Puts clothes, hair, face and colors onto a rig that is ALREADY alive.
-- Never calls ApplyDescription, LoadCharacter, or ApplyMesh. Those three
-- are what respawn you. Body parts stay where they are so the humanoid
-- never dies and a dance does not get cut off.
local function wearCharacterNoReset(toChar, fromChar, clothesOnly)
    return false
end
_G.PrismWearNoReset = function() return false end

local function prismRigTargets()
    local list, seen = {}, {}
    local function add(m)
        if typeof(m) == "Instance" and m:IsA("Model") and m.Parent and not seen[m] then
            seen[m] = true
            list[#list + 1] = m
        end
    end
    add(LocalPlayer.Character)
    pcall(function()
        local api = rawget(_G, "_HaloReanimateAPI") or rawget(_G, "ReanimateAPI")
        if api then
            if type(api.get_clone) == "function" then add(api.get_clone(LocalPlayer)) end
            if type(api.get_real_character) == "function" then add(api.get_real_character(LocalPlayer)) end
        end
    end)
    return list
end

local function buildAvatarDummy(userId, rigType)
    if not userId then return nil end
    local model
    local ok, m = pcall(function()
        return Players:CreateHumanoidModelFromUserIdAsync(userId)
    end)
    if ok and typeof(m) == "Instance" then model = m end
    if not model then
        ok, m = pcall(function()
            return Players:CreateHumanoidModelFromUserId(userId)
        end)
        if ok and typeof(m) == "Instance" then model = m end
    end
    if not model then
        local desc
        ok, desc = pcall(function()
            return Players:GetHumanoidDescriptionFromUserId(userId)
        end)
        if ok and desc then
            ok, m = pcall(function()
                return Players:CreateHumanoidModelFromDescription(desc, rigType or Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15)
            end)
            if ok and typeof(m) == "Instance" then model = m end
        end
    end
    if model and model.Parent == workspace then
        model.Parent = nil
    end
    return model
end

local function buildDummyFromDesc(desc, rigType)
    if not desc then return nil end
    local ok, model = pcall(function()
        return Players:CreateHumanoidModelFromDescription(desc, rigType or Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15)
    end)
    if ok and typeof(model) == "Instance" then
        if model.Parent == workspace then model.Parent = nil end
        return model
    end
    return nil
end

local function lookFromModel(model)
    local look = { t = os.time() }
    local function numId(text)
        local n = tostring(text or ""):match("(%d+)")
        return tonumber(n) or 0
    end
    local shirt = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Shirt")
    local pants = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Pants")
    local graphic = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("ShirtGraphic")
    look.Shirt = shirt and numId(shirt.ShirtTemplate) or 0
    look.Pants = pants and numId(pants.PantsTemplate) or 0
    look.GraphicTShirt = graphic and numId(graphic.Graphic) or 0
    local head = model:FindFirstChild("Head")
    local faceTex = ""
    if head then
        for _, d in ipairs(head:GetChildren()) do
            if d:IsA("Decal") and d.Name:lower() == "face" then faceTex = d.Texture break end
        end
    end
    look.Face = numId(faceTex)
    local hum = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum then
        pcall(function()
            local desc = hum:GetAppliedDescription()
            if not desc then return end
            for _, p in ipairs({
                "HairAccessory", "HatAccessory", "FaceAccessory", "NeckAccessory",
                "ShouldersAccessory", "FrontAccessory", "BackAccessory", "WaistAccessory",
            }) do
                local v = desc[p]
                if v ~= nil then look[p] = v end
            end
            local fid = tonumber(desc.Face) or 0
            if (tonumber(look.Face) or 0) == 0 and fid > 0 then look.Face = fid end
            for _, p in ipairs({ "HeadColor", "TorsoColor", "LeftArmColor", "RightArmColor", "LeftLegColor", "RightLegColor" }) do
                local v = desc[p]
                if typeof(v) == "Color3" then
                    look[p] = { __c = true, r = v.R, g = v.G, b = v.B }
                end
            end
        end)
    end
    return look
end

local function publishLook()
    return
end

local function wearOntoAll(fromChar, clothesOnly)
    local any = false
    for _, rig in ipairs(prismRigTargets()) do
        local ok, wore = pcall(wearCharacterNoReset, rig, fromChar, clothesOnly)
        if ok and wore then any = true end
    end
    if any and not clothesOnly then
        pcall(publishLook, fromChar)
    end
    return any
end

local function copyOutfitManual(target, char)
    local tChar = target and target.Character
    if not (tChar and char) then return false end
    return wearCharacterNoReset(char, tChar)
end

-- Copy a player's avatar onto the living rig. The character is never
-- replaced, so you stay where you are and you do not die.
local function copyAvatarInPlace(target)
    if not target then return false end
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not (char and hum) then
        local t0 = os.clock()
        while os.clock() - t0 < 2 and not (char and hum) do
            char = LocalPlayer.Character
            hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if char and hum then break end
            task.wait(0.1)
        end
    end
    if not (char and hum) then return false end

    local tChar = target.Character
    if target ~= LocalPlayer and not (tChar and tChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")) then
        local t0 = os.clock()
        while os.clock() - t0 < 2.5 do
            tChar = target.Character
            if tChar and tChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then break end
            task.wait(0.1)
        end
    end

    local rigType = hum.RigType
    local any = false

    local function liveMesh(model)
        if not model then return false end
        for _, obj in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
            if obj:IsA("Accessory") or obj:IsA("Hat") then
                local handle = obj:FindFirstChild("Handle")
                if handle and handle:IsA("MeshPart") and type(handle.MeshId) == "string" and handle.MeshId ~= "" and handle.MeshId ~= "rbxassetid://0" then
                    return true
                end
                local sm = handle and handle:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
                if sm and type(sm.MeshId) == "string" and sm.MeshId ~= "" then
                    return true
                end
            end
        end
        return false
    end

    -- Hats on other players often stream in with an empty mesh. Build a
    -- separate dummy (this is NOT your character) and copy off of that.
    -- If the live rig already has real meshes, skip the dummy so the
    -- in-game outfit wins.
    local dummyWore = false
    if target.UserId then
        local dummy = buildAvatarDummy(target.UserId, rigType)
        if dummy then
            dummyWore = wearOntoAll(dummy) or dummyWore
            any = dummyWore or any
            pcall(function() dummy:Destroy() end)
        end
    end
    -- live clothes go on last. If the dummy already gave us the hair,
    -- only copy the shirt, pants and face so we don't rip the hair back off.
    if tChar and tChar ~= char then
        any = wearOntoAll(tChar, dummyWore) or any
    end
    return any
end

-- ---------- "Turn On": morph the local player into another player ----------
local MorphState = { on = false, target = nil, original = nil }

local function morphInto(target)
    if not target then return false end
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not (char and hum) then return false end
    if not MorphState.original then
        pcall(function()
            MorphState.original = Players:GetHumanoidDescriptionFromUserId(LocalPlayer.UserId)
        end)
    end
    MorphState.target = target
    MorphState.on = true
    return copyAvatarInPlace(target)
end

local function morphRestore()
    local desc = MorphState.original
    MorphState.on = false
    MorphState.target = nil
    if not desc then
        pcall(function()
            desc = Players:GetHumanoidDescriptionFromUserId(LocalPlayer.UserId)
        end)
    end
    if not desc then return false end
    local hum = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local dummy = buildDummyFromDesc(desc, hum and hum.RigType or Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15)
    if not dummy then return false end
    local ok = wearOntoAll(dummy)
    pcall(function() dummy:Destroy() end)
    return ok
end

--========================================================
--  Self Copy  (save / show / re-apply YOUR OWN avatars)
--========================================================
local DESC_PROPS = {
    "Head", "Face", "Torso", "RightArm", "LeftArm", "RightLeg", "LeftLeg",
    "ClimbAnimation", "FallAnimation", "IdleAnimation", "JumpAnimation",
    "RunAnimation", "SwimAnimation", "WalkAnimation",
    "BackAccessory", "WaistAccessory", "Shirt", "Pants", "GraphicTShirt",
    "HairAccessory", "HatAccessory", "FaceAccessory", "NeckAccessory",
    "ShoulderAccessory", "ShouldersAccessory", "FrontAccessory",
    "HeadColor", "LeftArmColor", "LeftLegColor", "RightArmColor", "RightLegColor", "TorsoColor",
    "HeightScale", "WidthScale", "DepthScale", "HeadScale", "BodyTypeScale", "ProportionScale",
}

local function myAvFile()
    local ok, p = pcall(function() return fpath("PrismMyAvatars.json") end)
    if ok and type(p) == "string" then return p end
    return "PrismMyAvatars.json"
end

local function loadMyAvatars()
    local list = {}
    pcall(function()
        if readfile then
            local raw = readfile(myAvFile())
            if type(raw) == "string" and #raw > 0 then
                local data = jsonDecode(raw)
                if type(data) == "table" then list = data end
            end
        end
    end)
    return list
end

local MyAvatarsList = loadMyAvatars()

local function persistMyAvatars()
    pcall(function()
        if writefile then writefile(myAvFile(), jsonEncode(MyAvatarsList)) end
    end)
end

local function nowStamp()
    local t
    pcall(function() t = os.time() end)
    return tonumber(t) or 0
end

local function defaultName()
    local n
    pcall(function() n = os.date("%b %d  %H:%M") end)
    if type(n) ~= "string" or n == "" then n = "Avatar " .. tostring(#MyAvatarsList + 1) end
    return n
end

-- grab the description currently applied to our rig (includes accessories / clothing)
local function snapshotDesc()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return nil end
    local desc
    pcall(function() desc = hum:GetAppliedDescription() end)
    if not desc then
        pcall(function() desc = Players:GetHumanoidDescriptionFromUserId(LocalPlayer.UserId) end)
    end
    return desc
end

local function serializeDesc(desc)
    if not desc then return nil end
    local t = {}
    for _, p in ipairs(DESC_PROPS) do
        local ok, v = pcall(function() return desc[p] end)
        if ok and v ~= nil and v ~= "" and v ~= 0 then
            if typeof(v) == "Color3" then
                t[p] = { __c = true, r = v.R, g = v.G, b = v.B }
            else
                t[p] = v
            end
        end
    end
    return t
end

local function deserializeDesc(t)
    if type(t) ~= "table" then return nil end
    local d = Instance.new("HumanoidDescription")
    for k, v in pairs(t) do
        if type(v) == "table" and v.__c then
            pcall(function() d[k] = Color3.new(v.r or 0, v.g or 0, v.b or 0) end)
        else
            pcall(function() d[k] = v end)
        end
    end
    return d
end

-- apply a description to our rig IN PLACE (no reset) and re-attach accessories
local function applyDescInPlace(desc)
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not (char and hum and desc) then return false end
    local dummy = buildDummyFromDesc(desc, hum.RigType)
    if not dummy then return false end
    local ok = wearOntoAll(dummy)
    pcall(function() dummy:Destroy() end)
    return ok
end

local function saveMyAvatar(name)
    local desc = snapshotDesc()
    if not desc then return nil end
    local ser = serializeDesc(desc)
    if not ser then return nil end
    local entry = {
        name = (type(name) == "string" and name ~= "" and name) or defaultName(),
        when = nowStamp(),
        desc = ser,
        shirt = ser.Shirt,
        pants = ser.Pants,
        graphic = ser.GraphicTShirt,
    }
    table.insert(MyAvatarsList, 1, entry)
    while #MyAvatarsList > 30 do table.remove(MyAvatarsList) end
    persistMyAvatars()
    return entry
end

local function applyMyAvatar(i)
    local entry = MyAvatarsList[tonumber(i) or 0]
    if not entry then return false end
    local desc = deserializeDesc(entry.desc)
    if not desc then return false end
    return applyDescInPlace(desc)
end

local function deleteMyAvatar(i)
    i = tonumber(i) or 0
    if not MyAvatarsList[i] then return false end
    table.remove(MyAvatarsList, i)
    persistMyAvatars()
    return true
end

-- re-apply the player's own avatar (in place) -> "copy my avatar"
local function copySelfInPlace()
    local desc
    pcall(function() desc = Players:GetHumanoidDescriptionFromUserId(LocalPlayer.UserId) end)
    if not desc then return false end
    return applyDescInPlace(desc)
end

local function refreshMyAvatars()
    MyAvatarsList = loadMyAvatars()
    return MyAvatarsList
end

-- ---------- carry system (Grab / Drag / Left shoulder / Release) ----------
local Carried = {}   -- [player] = { mode = , conn = }

local function stopCarry(target)
    local c = Carried[target]
    if not c then return end
    if c.conn then pcall(function() c.conn:Disconnect() end) end
    local tChar = target.Character
    local tHum = tChar and tChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if tHum then pcall(function() tHum.PlatformStand = false end) end
    Carried[target] = nil
end

local function startCarry(target, mode)
    if not target then return false end
    stopCarry(target)
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myHRP = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myHRP then return false end
    local conn
    conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        local tChar = target.Character
        local tHRP = tChar and tChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local base = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not tHRP or not base then stopCarry(target) return end
        local hum = tChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then pcall(function() hum.PlatformStand = true end) end
        local cf
        if mode == "shoulder" then
            cf = base.CFrame * CFrame.new(-1.7, 1.5, -0.2)
        elseif mode == "drag" then
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            local mp = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
            local ray = cam:ViewportPointToRay(mp.X, mp.Y)
            local params = RaycastParams.new()
            params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
            params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { tChar, myChar }
            local hit = workspace:Raycast(ray.Origin, ray.Direction * 600, params)
            if hit then
                cf = CFrame.new(hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
            else
                cf = base.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -9)
            end
        else -- grab: hold them just in front of you
            cf = base.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.7, -3.4)
        end
        pcall(function() tHRP.CFrame = cf end)
    end)
    Carried[target] = { mode = mode, conn = conn }
    return true
end

-- ---------- clone avatar (spawn a follow-clone of another player) ----------
local Clones = {}
local function spawnClone(target)
    local tChar = target.Character
    if not tChar then return false end
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myHRP = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myHRP then return false end
    local old = Clones[target]
    if old and old.model and old.model.Parent then pcall(function() old.model:Destroy() end) end
    if old and old.conn then pcall(function() old.conn:Disconnect() end) end
    local ok, model = pcall(function() return tChar:Clone() end)
    if not ok or not model then return false end
    model.Name = "PrismClone"
    local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if root then model.PrimaryPart = root end
    for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("Script") or d:IsA("LocalScript") or d:IsA("Humanoid") then
            pcall(function() d:Destroy() end)
        elseif d:IsA("BasePart") then
            d.Anchored = true
            d.CanCollide = false
        end
    end
    pcall(function() model:PivotTo(myHRP.CFrame * CFrame.new(3.5, 0, 0)) end)
    model.Parent = workspace
    local conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        local base = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not base or not model.Parent then
            if conn then conn:Disconnect() end
            return
        end
        pcall(function() model:PivotTo(base.CFrame * CFrame.new(3.5, 0, 0)) end)
    end)
    Clones[target] = { model = model, conn = conn }
    return true
end

-- ---------- voice / tools volume ----------
local function setPlayerVoiceVolume(target, vol)
    vol = math.clamp(tonumber(vol) or 1, 0, 10)
    local n = 0
    pcall(function()
        local char = target.Character
        if char then
            for _, s in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                if s:IsA("Sound") then s.Volume = vol; n = n + 1 end
            end
        end
        for _, s in ipairs(SoundService:GetDescendants()) do
            if s:IsA("Sound") then
                local nm = s.Name:lower()
                if nm:find("voice") or nm:find("mic") or nm:find("vc") then
                    s.Volume = vol; n = n + 1
                end
            end
        end
    end)
    return n
end

-- ---------- public API (the hub + players page reach it through this) ----------
local MicUpAPI = {
    copyAvatar   = function(target) return copyAvatarInPlace(target) end,
    morphInto    = function(target) return morphInto(target) end,
    morphRestore = function() return morphRestore() end,
    morphState   = function() return MorphState end,
    grab         = function(target) return startCarry(target, "grab") end,
    drag         = function(target) return startCarry(target, "drag") end,
    shoulder     = function(target) return startCarry(target, "shoulder") end,
    release      = function(target) stopCarry(target) end,
    isCarrying   = function(target) return Carried[target] ~= nil end,
    clone        = function(target) return spawnClone(target) end,
    albumArt     = function(q) return fetchAlbumArt(q) end,
    voiceVolume  = function(target, v) return setPlayerVoiceVolume(target, v) end,
    -- self copy
    copySelf       = function() return copySelfInPlace() end,
    myAvatars      = function() return MyAvatarsList end,
    refreshMyAvatars = function() return refreshMyAvatars() end,
    saveMyAvatar   = function(name) return saveMyAvatar(name) end,
    applyMyAvatar  = function(i) return applyMyAvatar(i) end,
    deleteMyAvatar = function(i) return deleteMyAvatar(i) end,
    myAvatarImage  = function() return "rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id=" .. LocalPlayer.UserId .. "&w=420&h=420" end,
    myAvatarRender = function() return "rbxthumb://type=Avatar&id=" .. LocalPlayer.UserId .. "&w=420&h=420" end,
}
_G.PrismMicUp = MicUpAPI
pcall(function() getgenv().PrismMicUp = MicUpAPI end)

    -- Slider helper: big invisible hit-box so it stays easy to grab at any window scale
    local sliderConns = {}
    gui.Destroying:Connect(function()

    local function makeSlider(par, pos, size, z, onChange)
        local hit = Instance.new("TextButton")
        hit.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
        hit.Position = pos
        hit.Size = size
        hit.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        hit.Text = ""
        hit.AutoButtonColor = false
        hit.Active = true
        hit.ZIndex = z
        hit.Parent = par
        local trk = Instance.new("Frame")
        trk.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
        trk.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.5)
        trk.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 4)
        trk.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(44, 48, 68)
        trk.BorderSizePixel = 0
        trk.ZIndex = z + 1
        trk.Parent = hit
        corner(trk, 2)
        local fil = Instance.new("Frame")
        fil.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        fil.BackgroundColor3 = accent
        fil.BorderSizePixel = 0
        fil.ZIndex = z + 2
        fil.Parent = trk
        corner(fil, 2)
        local thm = Instance.new("Frame")
        thm.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        thm.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0)
        thm.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14)
        thm.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        thm.BorderSizePixel = 0
        thm.ZIndex = z + 3
        thm.Parent = trk
        corner(thm, UDim.new(1, 0))
        stroke(thm, accent, 2, 0)
        local dragging = false
        local function set(f, silent)
            f = math.clamp(f, 0, 1)
            fil.Size = UDim2.fromScale(f, 1)
            thm.Position = UDim2.new(f, 0, 0.5, 0)
            if not silent and onChange then onChange(f) end
        end
        local function fromX(x)
            local w = trk.AbsoluteSize.X
            if w <= 0 then return end
            set((x - trk.AbsolutePosition.X) / w)
        end
        local function isPress(inp)
            return inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
        end
        hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
            if isPress(inp) then
                dragging = true
                TweenService:Create(thm, TweenInfo.new(0.1), { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18) }):Play()
                fromX(inp.Position.X)
            end
        end)
        sliderConns[#sliderConns + 1] = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
            if dragging and (inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
                or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
                fromX(inp.Position.X)
            end
        end)
        sliderConns[#sliderConns + 1] = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
            if dragging and isPress(inp) then
                dragging = false
                TweenService:Create(thm, TweenInfo.new(0.1), { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14) }):Play()
            end
        end)
        return { set = set }
    end

    end

    -- Lyric row management
    local lyricRows = {}
    local ROW_H = 26

    local function clearLyrics()
        for _, r in ipairs(lyricRows) do
            if r and r.Parent then r:Destroy() end
        end
        lyricRows = {}
        if EqState then
            EqState.lyrics = nil
            EqState.lyricRows = nil
            EqState.lyricIdx = 0
        end
    end

    local function lyricPlaceholder(text)
        clearLyrics()
        local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        lbl.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        lbl.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        lbl.TextSize = 11
        lbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 98, 120)
        lbl.Text = text
        lbl.TextWrapped = true
        lbl.ZIndex = 7
        lbl.Parent = lyricsInner
        lyricRows[1] = lbl
        lyricsInner.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, lyricPanelH)
    end

    local function showLyrics(lyr)
        clearLyrics()
        if not lyr then
            lyricPlaceholder("Lyrics unavailable")
            return
        end
        local lines = lyr.synced
        if lines and #lines > 0 then
            _G._PrismLyricPack = {
                lines = lines,
                accent = { accent.R, accent.G, accent.B },
            }
            for i, ln in ipairs(lines) do
                local row = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                row.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, (i - 1) * ROW_H)
                row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, ROW_H)
                row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                row.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
                row.TextSize = 11
                row.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(135, 145, 172)
                row.TextTransparency = 0.4
                row.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
                row.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
                row.Text = ln.text
                row.ZIndex = 7
                row.Parent = lyricsInner
                lyricRows[i] = row
            end
            lyricsInner.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, #lines * ROW_H)
            if EqState then
                EqState.lyrics = lines
                EqState.lyricRows = lyricRows
                EqState.lyricIdx = 0
                EqState.lyricsInner = lyricsInner
                EqState.lyricRowH = ROW_H
                EqState.lyricClipH = lyricPanelH
                EqState.accent = accent
            end
        else
            local text = lyr.plain or ""
            local n = 0
            for line in tostring(text):gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do
                line = line:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
                if line ~= "" then
                    n = n + 1
                    local row = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                    row.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, (n - 1) * ROW_H)
                    row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, ROW_H)
                    row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                    row.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
                    row.TextSize = 11
                    row.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(135, 145, 172)
                    row.TextTransparency = 0.25
                    row.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
                    row.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
                    row.Text = line
                    row.ZIndex = 7
                    row.Parent = lyricsInner
                    lyricRows[n] = row
                end
            end
            lyricsInner.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, math.max(lyricPanelH, n * ROW_H))
            if n > 0 then
                local timed = {}
                local clock = 0
                for line in tostring(text):gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do
                    line = line:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
                    if line ~= "" then
                        timed[#timed + 1] = { t = clock, text = line }
                        clock = clock + 3.4
                    end
                end
                _G._PrismLyricPack = {
                    lines = timed,
                    accent = { accent.R, accent.G, accent.B },
                }
            end
        end
    end

    -- Wire EqState
    EqState = {
        playing    = false,
        bars       = bars,
        progress   = progress,
        track      = track,
        timeLabel  = timeLbl,
        titleLabel = titleLbl,
        subLabel   = subLbl,
        accent     = accent,
    }

    -- Playback
    local isMuted = false
    local link = musicLink(tag)

    local function startPlayback()
        isMuted = false
        mutedChip.Text = "MUTED"
        mutedChip.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 52, 68)
        titleLbl.Text = (link and TitleCache[link]) or tag.songTitle or tag.title or tag.song or "Now playing"
        subLbl.Text = "Starting full song"
        lyricPlaceholder("Lyrics loading")
        startFullSong(tag, {
            owner  = player,
            accent = accent,
            title  = function(disp)
                if disp and titleLbl.Parent then titleLbl.Text = disp end
            end,
            status = function(s)
                if subLbl.Parent then subLbl.Text = s end
            end,
            meta   = function(meta, disp)
                task.spawn(function()
                    local lyr = fetchLyrics(
                        (meta and meta.query) or disp or "",
                        meta and meta.artist,
                        meta and meta.title)
                    if not (titleLbl and titleLbl.Parent) then return end
                    if lyr then
                        showLyrics(lyr)
                    else
                        lyricPlaceholder("Lyrics unavailable for this track")
                    end
                end)
            end,
        })
    end

    if musicOn then
        startPlayback()
        mutedChip.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            isMuted = not isMuted
            if isMuted then
                stopMusic()
                mutedChip.Text = "PLAY"
                mutedChip.BackgroundColor3 = accent
                if EqState then EqState.playing = false end
            else
                startPlayback()
            end
        end)
    else
        titleLbl.Text = "No music"
        subLbl.Text = ""
        timeLbl.Text = ""
        lyricPlaceholder("No music configured")
        mutedChip.Visible = false
    end

    local rightW = CARD_W - SIDE_W - 1

    -- Tab 1: Mic Up grid

            local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")

            btn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(cw, ch)

        if type(menuItems) == "table" then
            local mi = 0
            local gridRowCount = math.ceil(#gridItems / COLS)

                if type(item) == "table" and item.label and mi < 2 then
                    mi = mi + 1

                    btn2.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(

    -- Tabs 2-5: live Roblox character data
    local function buildItemList(page, items, noItemText)
        for _, c in ipairs(page:GetChildren()) do c:Destroy() end
        if not items or #items == 0 then
            local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            lbl.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
            lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
            lbl.TextSize = 11
            lbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 112, 150)
            lbl.Text = noItemText
            lbl.TextWrapped = true
            lbl.ZIndex = 6
            lbl.Parent = page
            return
        end
        local scroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
        scroll.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        scroll.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        scroll.BorderSizePixel = 0
        scroll.ScrollBarThickness = 4
        scroll.ScrollBarImageColor3 = accent
        scroll.ScrollBarImageTransparency = 0.2
        scroll.ScrollingEnabled = true
        scroll.Active = true
        scroll.ElasticBehavior = Enum.ElasticBehavior.Never
        scroll.ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y
        scroll.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
        scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
        scroll.ZIndex = 6
        scroll.Parent = page
        local padInst = Instance.new("UIPadding")
        padInst.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 6)
        padInst.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 6)
        padInst.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 6)
        padInst.Parent = scroll
        local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
        layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
        layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)
        layout.Parent = scroll
        for idx, itemName in ipairs(items) do
            local row = Instance.new("Frame")
            row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
            row.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 25, 42)
            row.BackgroundTransparency = 0.0
            row.BorderSizePixel = 0
            row.LayoutOrder = idx
            row.ZIndex = 7
            row.Parent = scroll
            corner(row, 6)
            stroke(row, accent, 1, 0.5)
            local bDot = Instance.new("Frame")
            bDot.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 11)
            bDot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8)
            bDot.BackgroundColor3 = accent
            bDot.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
            bDot.BorderSizePixel = 0
            bDot.ZIndex = 8
            bDot.Parent = row
            corner(bDot, UDim.new(1, 0))
            local nLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            nLbl.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 0)
            nLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 1, 0)
            nLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            nLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
            nLbl.TextSize = 11
            nLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 228, 255)
            nLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
            nLbl.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
            nLbl.Text = tostring(itemName)
            nLbl.ZIndex = 8
            nLbl.Parent = row
        end
    end
    local function buildLoading(page, msg)
        local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        lbl.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
        lbl.TextSize = 11
        lbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 112, 150)
        lbl.Text = msg
        lbl.TextWrapped = true
        lbl.ZIndex = 6
        lbl.Parent = page
        return lbl
    end
    -- Tab 2: Anim Packs
    do
        local page = tabPages[2]
        local ll = buildLoading(page, "Loading...")
        task.spawn(function()
            local ok, info = pcall(function()
                return Players:GetCharacterAppearanceInfoAsync(player.UserId)
            end)
            if not (page and page.Parent) then return end
            if ok and info and info.assets then
                local list = {}
                for _, a in ipairs(info.assets) do
                    if a.assetType and a.assetType.name == "Animation" then
                        list[#list + 1] = a.name
                    end
                end
                if ll and ll.Parent then ll:Destroy() end
                buildItemList(page, list, "No animation packs equipped")
            else
                if ll and ll.Parent then ll.Text = "Could not load" end
            end
        end)
    end
    -- Tab 3: Emotes
    do
        local page = tabPages[3]
        local ll = buildLoading(page, "Loading...")
        task.spawn(function()
            local ok, hd2 = pcall(function()
                return Players:GetHumanoidDescriptionFromUserId(player.UserId)
            end)
            if not (page and page.Parent) then return end
            if ok and hd2 then
                local emotes = {}
                local ej = hd2.EmotesAnimations
                local eok, etbl = pcall(function()
                    return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(ej)
                end)
                if eok and type(etbl) == "table" then
                    for eName, _ in pairs(etbl) do
                        emotes[#emotes + 1] = eName
                    end
                    table.sort(emotes)
                end
                if ll and ll.Parent then ll:Destroy() end
                buildItemList(page, emotes, "No emotes equipped")
            else
                if ll and ll.Parent then ll.Text = "Could not load" end
            end
        end)
    end
    -- Tab 4: Bundles
    do
        local page = tabPages[4]
        local ll = buildLoading(page, "Loading...")
        task.spawn(function()
            local ok, info = pcall(function()
                return Players:GetCharacterAppearanceInfoAsync(player.UserId)
            end)
            if not (page and page.Parent) then return end
            if ok and info and info.assets then
                local bundleTypes = { Package = true, Head = true, Face = true, DynamicHead = true }
                local list = {}
                for _, a in ipairs(info.assets) do
                    if a.assetType and bundleTypes[a.assetType.name] then
                        list[#list + 1] = a.assetType.name .. ": " .. a.name
                    end
                end
                if ll and ll.Parent then ll:Destroy() end
                buildItemList(page, list, "Using default character")
            else
                if ll and ll.Parent then ll.Text = "Could not load" end
            end
        end)
    end
    -- Tab 5: Clothing
    do
        local page = tabPages[5]
        local ll = buildLoading(page, "Loading...")
        task.spawn(function()
            local ok, info = pcall(function()
                return Players:GetCharacterAppearanceInfoAsync(player.UserId)
            end)
            if not (page and page.Parent) then return end
            if ok and info and info.assets then
                local wearTypes = {
                    Shirt = true, Pants = true, TShirt = true,
                    Hat = true, HairAccessory = true, FaceAccessory = true,
                    NeckAccessory = true, ShoulderAccessory = true,
                    FrontAccessory = true, BackAccessory = true,
                    WaistAccessory = true,
                }
                local list = {}
                for _, a in ipairs(info.assets) do
                    if a.assetType and wearTypes[a.assetType.name] then
                        list[#list + 1] = a.name
                    end
                end
                if ll and ll.Parent then ll:Destroy() end
                buildItemList(page, list, "No clothing or accessories")
            else
                if ll and ll.Parent then ll.Text = "Could not load" end
            end
        end)
    end

    -- Tab switching
    for i, tb in ipairs(tabBtns) do
