            for j, tb2 in ipairs(tabBtns) do
                local isActive = (j == i)
                tb2.BackgroundColor3 = isActive and accent or Color3.fromRGB(18, 20, 36)
                tb2.BackgroundTransparency = isActive and 0.1 or 0.3
                tb2.TextColor3 = isActive
                    and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                    or Color3.fromRGB(150, 162, 198)
                tb2.Font = isActive and Enum.Font.GothamBold or Enum.Font.Gotham
                tabPages[j].Visible = isActive
            end
        end)
    end

    -- ===== AURORA EFFECTS =====
    local function aurora(parent, speed)
        local g = Instance.new("UIGradient")
        g.Color = ColorSequence.new({
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,    aLight),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.25, accent),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5,  aDark2),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.75, accent),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1,    aLight),
        })
        g.Parent = parent
        NTFx[#NTFx + 1] = { kind = "spin", obj = g, speed = speed, ph = 0 }
    end
    aurora(cardStroke, 55)
    aurora(ringStroke, -120)

    -- Shimmer on the name
    NTFx[#NTFx + 1] = { kind = "wave", obj = nameGrad, speed = 1.1, ph = 0 }

    -- Floating motes
    for i = 1, 14 do
        local m = Instance.new("Frame")
        m.Name = "Mote"
        m.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        local sz = 2 + (i % 3)
        m.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sz, sz)
        m.BackgroundColor3 = (i % 2 == 0) and aLight or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        m.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        m.BorderSizePixel = 0
        m.ZIndex = 4
        m.Parent = card
        corner(m, UDim.new(1, 0))
        NTFx[#NTFx + 1] = {
            kind  = "mote", obj = m, scale = true,
            speed = 0.05 + math.random() * 0.07, ph = math.random(),
            x = 0.04 + 0.92 * math.random(), y0 = 1.03, rise = 1.08, sway = 0.02, max = 0.7,
        }
    end

    -- Drifting blobs in the top bar
    local cols = {
        accent,
        Color3.fromHSV((h_ + 0.12) % 1, math.max(sat_, 0.5), math.max(val_, 0.8)),
        Color3.fromHSV((h_ - 0.12) % 1, math.max(sat_, 0.5), math.max(val_, 0.8)),
    }
    for i, col in ipairs(cols) do
        local blob = Instance.new("Frame")
        blob.Name = "Blob"
        blob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        local d = 80 + i * 24
        blob.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(d, d)
        blob.BackgroundColor3 = col
        blob.BackgroundTransparency = 0.86
        blob.BorderSizePixel = 0
        blob.ZIndex = 4
        blob.Parent = topBar
        corner(blob, UDim.new(1, 0))
        local ph = i * 2.1
        NTFx[#NTFx + 1] = { kind = "fn", obj = blob, fn = function(now)
            blob.Position = UDim2.new(
                0.5 + math.sin(now * 0.31 + ph) * 0.42, 0,
                0.5 + math.cos(now * 0.23 + ph * 1.7) * 0.4, 0)
        end }
    end

    -- Holographic foil across top bar
    local foil = Instance.new("Frame")
    foil.Name = "Foil"
    foil.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    foil.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    foil.BackgroundTransparency = 0.9
    foil.BorderSizePixel = 0
    foil.Active = false
    foil.ZIndex = 4
    foil.Parent = topBar
    local fg = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    fg.Color = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,   cols[2]),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, aLight),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1,   cols[3]),
    })
    fg.Parent = foil
    NTFx[#NTFx + 1] = { kind = "spin", obj = fg, speed = 25, ph = 0 }

    -- Scanlines and brackets
    addScanlines(card, 3)
    addBrackets(card, CARD_W, CARD_H, aLight, 9, 16, 2, 11)

    -- Corner orbit dots on the full card
    addOrbit(card, CARD_W, CARD_H, 28, aLight, nil, 150, 12, 0)
    addOrbit(card, CARD_W, CARD_H, 28, accent, nil, 150, 12, 1400)

    -- Avatar orbit dots (parented to card, offset to hero center)
    local avatarCX = SIDE_W / 2
    local avatarCY = TOP_H + AV_H / 2
    for i = 1, 3 do
        local dot = Instance.new("Frame")
        dot.Name = "Mote"
        dot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        dot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(i == 1 and 7 or 4, i == 1 and 7 or 4)
        dot.BackgroundColor3 = (i == 2) and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or aLight
        dot.BorderSizePixel = 0
        dot.ZIndex = 8
        dot.Parent = card
        corner(dot, UDim.new(1, 0))
        NTFx[#NTFx + 1] = {
            kind  = "orbit", obj = dot,
            base  = UDim2.new(0, avatarCX, 0, avatarCY),
            r     = 50 + i * 2,
            speed = (i % 2 == 0 and -1 or 1) * (1.0 + i * 0.4),
            ph    = i * 2.09,
        }
    end

    -- Beat-sync glow + ring pulse + shockwaves
    local lastWave = 0
    NTFx[#NTFx + 1] = { kind = "fn", obj = glow, fn = function(now)
        local on = _G._PrismSongOn
        local b = 0
        if on then
            b = (_G._PrismSampleSongBeat and _G._PrismSampleSongBeat()) or _G._PrismBeat or 0
        end
        local a = math.sin(now * 1.8) * 0.5 + 0.5
        glow.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(0.6 + a * 0.18 - b * 0.3, 0.2, 1)
        cardStroke.Thickness = 1.5 + b * 2.2
        ringStroke.Transparency = math.clamp(0.2 - b * 0.18, 0, 0.9)
        if on and (_G._PrismHit or 0) > 0.55 and now - lastWave > 0.3 then
            lastWave = now
            local w = Instance.new("Frame")
            w.Name = "Mote"
            w.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            w.Position = UDim2.new(0, avatarCX, 0, avatarCY)
            w.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(80, 80)
            w.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            w.ZIndex = 5
            w.Parent = card
            corner(w, UDim.new(1, 0))
            local ws = stroke(w, aLight, 3, 0.1)
            TweenService:Create(w,
                TweenInfo.new(0.8, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(192, 192) }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(ws, TweenInfo.new(0.8), { Transparency = 1 }):Play()
            game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(w, 0.9)
        end
    end }

    -- Light sweep across the card
    local sweep = Instance.new("Frame")
    sweep.Name = "Sweep"
    sweep.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    sweep.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    sweep.BorderSizePixel = 0
    sweep.Active = false
    sweep.ZIndex = 10
    sweep.Parent = card
    local sg = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    sg.Rotation = 28
    sg.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.4, 1),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.93),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.6, 1),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
    })
    sg.Parent = sweep
    NTFx[#NTFx + 1] = { kind = "sweep", obj = sg, speed = 0.16, ph = 0 }

    -- Wire shared CardFx
    CardFx = {
        glow       = glow,
        cardStroke = cardStroke,
        ringStroke = ringStroke,
        shimmer    = nil,
    }

    -- ===== DRAG (top bar grabs the whole card) =====
    local dragging, dragStart, startPos = false, nil, nil
    local function beginDrag(input)
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = card.Position
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end
        end)
    end
    local function updateDrag(input)
        if dragging and dragStart then
            local delta = input.Position - dragStart
            card.Position = UDim2.new(
                startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
                startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
            shadow.Position = card.Position
            glow.Position   = card.Position
        end
    end
    topBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            beginDrag(input)
        end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            updateDrag(input)
        end
    end)

    -- ===== RESIZABLE WINDOW WRAPPER =====
    do
        local content = Instance.new("Frame")
        content.Name = "PrismCardContent"
        content.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        content.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(CARD_W, CARD_H)
        content.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
        content.ClipsDescendants = true
        content.ZIndex = card.ZIndex + 1
        content.Parent = card
        local keep = {
            UICorner = true, UIStroke = true, UIGradient = true, UIScale = true,
            UIPadding = true, UIListLayout = true, UIGridLayout = true,
            UIAspectRatioConstraint = true, UISizeConstraint = true,
        }
        for _, ch in ipairs(card:GetChildren()) do
            if ch ~= content and not keep[ch.ClassName] then
                ch.Parent = content
            end
        end
        if _G.PrismMakeWindow then
            _G.PrismMakeWindow(card, {
                drag    = false,
                content = content,
                designW = CARD_W, designH = CARD_H,
                minW = 420, minH = 320,
                maxW = 1200, maxH = 900,
            })
        end
    end

    -- ===== STAGGERED ENTRANCE =====
    task.defer(function()
        local content = card:FindFirstChild("PrismCardContent")
        if not content then return end
        local list = {}
        for _, ch in ipairs(content:GetChildren()) do
            if ch:IsA("GuiObject") and ch ~= topBar and ch.Name ~= "Mote" and ch.Name ~= "Sweep"
                and ch.Size.Y.Scale < 0.9 and ch.Size.X.Scale < 1.5 then
                list[#list + 1] = { ch, ch.Position }
            end
        end
        table.sort(list, function(a, b) return a[1].Position.Y.Offset < b[1].Position.Y.Offset end)
        for i, it in ipairs(list) do
            local ch, pos = it[1], it[2]
            ch.Position = pos + UDim2.fromOffset(0, 20)
            task.delay(math.min(i * 0.035, 0.5), function()
                if ch.Parent then
                    TweenService:Create(ch,
                        TweenInfo.new(0.42, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                        { Position = pos }):Play()
                end
            end)
        end
    end)
end

--========================================================
-- Build / remove a single nametag (BillboardGui)
--========================================================
--========================================================
-- Duplicate guard
--  A player must only ever have ONE PrismNametag billboard.
--  Stale billboards (from a previous execution, a respawn, or a
--  character swap) used to linger and draw the same person's tag
--  twice -- once where they are and once across the map.
--========================================================
local function prismPlayerGui()
    return LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
end

local function destroyAllPrismNametags()
    local pg = prismPlayerGui()
    if not pg then return end
    for _, d in ipairs(pg:GetChildren()) do
        if d:IsA("BillboardGui") and d.Name == "PrismNametag" then
            pcall(function() d:Destroy() end)
        end
    end
end

-- keep only the billboards we currently track; nuke every other one
local function sweepDuplicateNametags()
    local pg = prismPlayerGui()
    if not pg then return end
    local keep = {}
    for _, b in pairs(ActiveGuis) do keep[b] = true end
    for _, d in ipairs(pg:GetChildren()) do
        if d:IsA("BillboardGui") and d.Name == "PrismNametag" and not keep[d] then
            pcall(function() d:Destroy() end)
        end
    end
end

local function removeNametag(player)
    local gui = ActiveGuis[player]
    if gui then
        pcall(function() gui:Destroy() end)
    end
    ActiveGuis[player] = nil
    LastHash[player] = nil
    -- also sweep any stray tag still hanging on this player's body
    local pg = prismPlayerGui()
    if pg then
        local char = player and player.Character
        for _, d in ipairs(pg:GetChildren()) do
            if d:IsA("BillboardGui") and d.Name == "PrismNametag" then
                local ad = d.Adornee
                if ad == nil or (char and ad:IsDescendantOf(char)) then
                    pcall(function() d:Destroy() end)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

-- ===== NAMETAG (default style; set _G.PrismTagStyle = "classic" for the old busy one) =====
-- Idle: only the profile picture shows. Hover: a pill slides out from behind it carrying the
-- banner, name, @user, verified badge and play button, and the role chip fades in above.
local function buildCleanNametag(player, tag, head, roleKey, roleDef, json)
    local TextService = game:GetService("TextService")
    local accent   = toColor(tag.accentColor, Color3.fromRGB(110, 160, 255))
    local light    = accent:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.65)
    local verified = roleDef and roleDef.verified
    local function nz(v) return (type(v) == "string" and v:match("%S")) and v or nil end
    local shown    = tostring(nz(tag.displayName) or nz(tag.robloxUsername) or player.Name)
    local user     = tostring(nz(tag.robloxUsername) or player.Name)
    local hasUser  = user ~= shown
    local music    = hasMusic(tag)
    local pfp      = (type(tag.profilePicture) == "string" and tag.profilePicture:match("%S")) and tag.profilePicture or nil

    local function measure(text, size, font)
        local ok, v = pcall(function()
            return TextService:GetTextSize(text, size, font, Vector2.new(1000, size + 4)).X
        end)
        return (ok and v) or (#text * size * 0.74)
    end

    -- ---------- layout (design pixels) ----------
    local M        = 4                       -- outer margin
    local ROLE_H   = 18                      -- role chip height
    local GAP      = 4
    local PFP_D    = 46                      -- profile picture diameter
    local CAP_H    = 40                      -- pill height
    local PC       = M + PFP_D / 2           -- x of the pfp centre
    local TEXT_X   = PFP_D / 2 + 10          -- text starts here inside the pill
    local RIGHT    = music and 42 or 16
    local BADGE_W  = verified and 19 or 0
    local nameW    = measure(shown, 14, Enum.Font.GothamBold)
    local userW    = hasUser and measure("@" .. user, 11, Enum.Font.GothamMedium) or 0
    local textW    = math.clamp(math.max(nameW + BADGE_W, userW), 60, 190)
    local CAP_FULL = TEXT_X + textW + RIGHT  -- pill width when open, measured from the pfp centre
    local TOTAL_W  = PC + CAP_FULL + M
    local TOTAL_H  = ROLE_H + GAP + PFP_D + M
    local BB_W     = 2 * (TOTAL_W - PC)      -- keeps the pfp centred on the head
    local pfpTop   = ROLE_H + GAP
    local cy       = pfpTop + PFP_D / 2

    local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    billboard.Name = "PrismNametag"
    billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(BB_W, TOTAL_H)
    local baseOffset = Vector3.new(0, CONFIG.NAMETAG_OFFSET + 0.2, 0)
    billboard.StudsOffset = baseOffset

    -- stage: pfp centre sits exactly on the billboard centre; distance scaling grows/shrinks around it
    local stage = Instance.new("Frame")
    stage.Name = "Stage"
    stage.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(PC / TOTAL_W, 0.5)
    stage.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
    stage.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(TOTAL_W, TOTAL_H)
    stage.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    stage.Parent = billboard
    local distScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
    distScale.Parent = stage

    local body = Instance.new("Frame")
    body.Name = "Body"
    body.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(PC / TOTAL_W, 0.5)
    body.Position = UDim2.new(PC / TOTAL_W, 0, 0.5, 0)
    body.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    body.Parent = stage
    local pop = Instance.new("UIScale")
    pop.Scale = 0.6
    pop.Parent = body

    -- soft drop shadow + glow behind the pfp
    local shadow = Instance.new("Frame")
    shadow.Name = "Shadow"
    shadow.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    shadow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(PC, cy + 2)
    shadow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(PFP_D + 8, PFP_D + 8)
    shadow.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
    shadow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.7
    shadow.BorderSizePixel = 0
    shadow.ZIndex = 1
    shadow.Parent = body
    corner(shadow, UDim.new(1, 0))

    local glow = Instance.new("Frame")
    glow.Name = "Glow"
    glow.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    glow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(PC, cy)
    glow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(PFP_D + 10, PFP_D + 10)
    glow.BackgroundColor3 = accent
    glow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.6
    glow.BorderSizePixel = 0
    glow.ZIndex = 2
    glow.Parent = body
    corner(glow, UDim.new(1, 0))

    -- ---------- the pill (banner) ----------
    local capsule = Instance.new("Frame")
    capsule.Name = "Banner"
    capsule.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(PC, cy - CAP_H / 2)
    capsule.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, CAP_H)              -- closed: hidden behind the pfp
    capsule.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)         -- white, so the gradient shows its true colours
    capsule.BorderSizePixel = 0
    capsule.ClipsDescendants = true
    capsule.ZIndex = 3
    capsule.Parent = body
    corner(capsule, UDim.new(1, 0))
    local capGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    capGrad.Rotation = 20
    capGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(accent, light)
    capGrad.Parent = capsule
    local capStroke = stroke(capsule, light, 1.5, 1)

    -- banner picture: sits at full size inside the pill, so the pill just reveals it.
    -- The image loads in the background (GIF decoding can take a moment) and is dropped in when ready.
    local function addGradientBanner()
        local gf = Instance.new("Frame")
        gf.Name = "BannerGradient"
        gf.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(CAP_FULL, CAP_H)
        gf.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        gf.BorderSizePixel = 0
        gf.ZIndex = 2
        gf.Parent = capsule
        local gg = Instance.new("UIGradient")
        gg.Color = ColorSequence.new(toColor(tag.bannerGradientFrom, accent), toColor(tag.bannerGradientTo, light))
        gg.Rotation = 18
        gg.Parent = gf
    end
    local bannerSrc = _G.PrismFindBanner(tag, player == LocalPlayer)
    local bannerLabel
    if bannerSrc then
        bannerLabel = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
        bannerLabel.Name = "BannerImage"
        bannerLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(CAP_FULL, CAP_H)
        bannerLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        bannerLabel.ImageTransparency = 0
        bannerLabel.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        bannerLabel.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop
        bannerLabel.ZIndex = 2
        bannerLabel.Parent = capsule
    elseif tag.bannerType == "gradient" then
        addGradientBanner()
    end

    -- name / @user / verified / play button (fixed positions inside the pill)
    local nameY = hasUser and 5 or 11
    local nameLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    nameLabel.Name = "Name"
    nameLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    nameLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(TEXT_X, nameY)
    nameLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(textW - BADGE_W, 18)
    nameLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    nameLabel.TextSize = 14
    nameLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    nameLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    nameLabel.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
    nameLabel.Text = shown
    nameLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
    nameLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.5
    nameLabel.ZIndex = 6
    nameLabel.Parent = capsule

    if hasUser then
        local sub = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        sub.Name = "User"
        sub.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        sub.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(TEXT_X, 23)
        sub.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(textW, 13)
        sub.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
        sub.TextSize = 11
        sub.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 238, 248)
        sub.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        sub.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
        sub.Text = "@" .. user
        sub.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
        sub.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.6
        sub.ZIndex = 6
        sub.Parent = capsule
    end

    if verified then
        local badge = makeCheckBadge(capsule, 13, accent)
        badge.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(TEXT_X + math.min(nameW, textW - BADGE_W) + 5, nameY + 3)
        badge.ZIndex = 7
    end

    local play
    if music then
        play = Instance.new("TextButton")
        play.Name = "PrismPlay"
        play.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
        play.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(CAP_FULL - 8, CAP_H / 2)
        play.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 26)
        play.BackgroundColor3 = accent
        play.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
        play.Text = (_G._PrismBeatOwner == player and _G._PrismSongOn) and "II" or ">"
        play.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        play.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        play.TextSize = 12
        play.AutoButtonColor = true
        play.ZIndex = 10
        play.Parent = capsule
        corner(play, UDim.new(1, 0))
        stroke(play, light, 1.5, 0.1)
        play.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if _G._PrismBeatOwner == player and _G._PrismSongOn then
                stopMusic()
                play.Text = ">"
                return
            end
            play.Text = "..."
            startFullSong(tag, {
                owner  = player,
                accent = accent,
                status = function(s)
                    if not play.Parent then return end
                    play.Text = (s == "Full song") and "II" or "..."
                end,
                started = function()
                    if play.Parent then play.Text = "II" end
                end,
            })
        end)
    end

    -- ---------- profile picture (always visible) ----------
    local pfpFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
    pfpFrame.Name = "PfpBg"
    pfpFrame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(M, pfpTop)
    pfpFrame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(PFP_D, PFP_D)
    pfpFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(14, 14, 20)
    pfpFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    pfpFrame.ZIndex = 6
    pfpFrame.Parent = body
    corner(pfpFrame, UDim.new(1, 0))
    local rim = stroke(pfpFrame, light, 2.5, 0)

    local pfpImg = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
    pfpImg.Name = "Avatar"
    pfpImg.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    pfpImg.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
    pfpImg.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(PFP_D - 4, PFP_D - 4)
    pfpImg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8, 8, 20)
    pfpImg.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
    pfpImg.ZIndex = 7
    pfpImg.Parent = pfpFrame
    corner(pfpImg, UDim.new(1, 0))
    setImage(pfpImg, pfp, resolveAvatar(player, tag), { box = CONFIG.GIF_AVATAR_BOX })

    -- ---------- role chip (fades in on hover) ----------
    local roleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    roleLabel.Name = "RoleChip"
    roleLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
    roleLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(PC, 0)
    roleLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    roleLabel.TextSize = 9
    roleLabel.BorderSizePixel = 0
    roleLabel.ZIndex = 8
    roleLabel.Parent = body
    corner(roleLabel, UDim.new(1, 0))
    local roleStroke = stroke(roleLabel, light, 1.5, 0.05)
    local roleBgShow
    if roleDef then
        local roleText = string.upper(roleDef.label)
        roleLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.clamp(measure(roleText, 9, Enum.Font.GothamBold) + 18, 44, 128), ROLE_H)
        roleLabel.Text = roleText
        roleLabel.BackgroundColor3 = roleDef.color
        local lum = roleDef.color.R * 0.3 + roleDef.color.G * 0.59 + roleDef.color.B * 0.11
        roleLabel.TextColor3 = (lum <= 0.62) and Color3.fromRGB(255, 248, 242) or Color3.fromRGB(24, 12, 8)
        roleBgShow = 0
    else
        roleLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(56, ROLE_H)
        roleLabel.Text = "PLAYER"
        roleLabel.BackgroundColor3 = accent
        roleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        roleBgShow = 0.1
    end
    roleLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    roleLabel.TextTransparency = 1
    roleStroke.Transparency = 1

    -- ---------- hover: pfp only <-> pill out ----------
    local click = Instance.new("TextButton")
    click.Name = "PrismNametagClick"
    click.Text = ""
    click.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    click.AutoButtonColor = false
    click.Active = true
    click.Selectable = false
    click.ZIndex = 2   -- under the pill, so the play button stays clickable
    click.Parent = body
    local CLOSED_W, OPEN_W = PFP_D + 4, PC + CAP_FULL - (M - 2)
    click.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(M - 2, pfpTop - 2)
    click.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(CLOSED_W, PFP_D + 4)

    local expanded = false
    local EXP = TweenInfo.new(0.26, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
    local COL = TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
    local function setExpanded(on)
        if on == expanded then return end
        expanded = on
        local info = on and EXP or COL
        click.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(on and OPEN_W or CLOSED_W, PFP_D + 4)
        TweenService:Create(capsule, info, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(on and CAP_FULL or 0, CAP_H) }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(capStroke, info, { Transparency = on and 0.1 or 1 }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(roleLabel, info, { BackgroundTransparency = on and roleBgShow or 1, TextTransparency = on and 0 or 1 }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(roleStroke, info, { Transparency = on and 0.05 or 1 }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(pop, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), { Scale = on and 1.05 or 1 }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(rim, TweenInfo.new(0.18), { Thickness = on and 3.5 or 2.5 }):Play()
    end
    local overClick, overPlay = false, false
    local closeGen = 0
    local function scheduleClose()
        closeGen = closeGen + 1
        local gen = closeGen
        task.delay(3, function()
            if gen ~= closeGen then return end
            if not billboard.Parent then return end
            if overClick or overPlay then return end
            setExpanded(false)
        end)
    end
    click.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        overClick = true
        closeGen = closeGen + 1
        setExpanded(true)
    end)
    click.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        overClick = false
        if not overPlay then scheduleClose() end
    end)
    if play then
        play.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            overPlay = true
            closeGen = closeGen + 1
            setExpanded(true)
        end)
        play.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            overPlay = false
            if not overClick then scheduleClose() end
        end)
    end
    if CONFIG.ENABLE_CLICK_MENU then
        click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            openProfileCard(player, tag)
        end)
    end

    -- ---------- per-frame: distance scale, idle glow, beat pulse ----------
    local wasBeat = false
    NTFx[#NTFx + 1] = { kind = "fn", obj = capsule, bb = billboard, fn = function(now)
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if cam and head and head.Parent then
            local d = (cam.CFrame.Position - head.Position).Magnitude
            local sc = math.clamp(1.12 - d / 220, 0.62, 1)
            if math.abs(distScale.Scale - sc) > 0.01 then distScale.Scale = sc end
        end
        local idle = math.sin(now * 1.1) * 0.5 + 0.5
        local mine = _G._PrismSongOn and _G._PrismBeatOwner == player
        if mine then
            local b = (_G._PrismSampleSongBeat and _G._PrismSampleSongBeat()) or _G._PrismBeat or 0
            rim.Thickness = (expanded and 3.5 or 2.5) + b * 4
            glow.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(0.4 - b * 0.35, 0.05, 0.6)
            wasBeat = true
        else
            glow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.66 - idle * 0.14
            if wasBeat then
                wasBeat = false
                rim.Thickness = expanded and 3.5 or 2.5
            end
        end
    end }
    NTBob[#NTBob + 1] = { bb = billboard, base = baseOffset, ph = math.random() * 6.28 }

    billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
    billboard.LightInfluence = 0
    billboard.MaxDistance = perfMaxDistance()
    pcall(function()
        if not Perf.low and (not billboard.MaxDistance or billboard.MaxDistance < 1e6) then
            billboard.MaxDistance = math.huge
        end
    end)
    billboard.ResetOnSpawn = false
    billboard.Adornee = head
    billboard.Active = true
    local pg = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
    if not pg then pg = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 10) end
    billboard.Parent = pg or head

    TweenService:Create(pop, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1 }):Play()

    ActiveGuis[player] = billboard
    LastHash[player] = json

    if bannerLabel then
        task.spawn(function()
            local ok, why = setImage(bannerLabel, bannerSrc, nil, { box = CONFIG.GIF_BANNER_BOX })
            if not ok then
                if bannerLabel.Parent then bannerLabel:Destroy() end
                if tag.bannerType == "gradient" and capsule.Parent then addGradientBanner() end
                if player == LocalPlayer then
                    _G.PrismImgDebug("Your banner could not be shown: " .. tostring(why))
                else
                    pcall(warn, "[PARALLAX] banner for " .. player.Name .. ": " .. tostring(why))
                end
            end
        end)
    end
end
local function buildNametag(player, tag)
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return end
    local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head") or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not head then return end

    local roleKey, roleDef = resolveRole(player, tag)
    local json = HttpService:JSONEncode(tag) .. "|" .. tostring(roleKey) .. "|" .. tostring(rawget(_G, "PrismTagStyle") or "clean")
    if ActiveGuis[player] and ActiveGuis[player].Adornee == head and LastHash[player] == json then
        return
    end
    removeNametag(player)

    if (rawget(_G, "PrismTagStyle") or "clean") ~= "classic" then
        local okc = pcall(buildCleanNametag, player, tag, head, roleKey, roleDef, json)
        if okc and ActiveGuis[player] then return end
        pcall(removeNametag, player)
    end

    local userId = tostring(player.UserId)
    local accent = toColor(tag.accentColor, Color3.fromRGB(90, 150, 255))

    local function filled(v)
        return type(v) == "string" and v:match("%S") ~= nil
    end
    local hasPfp = filled(tag.profilePicture) or (type(tag.profilePictureAssetId) == "string" and tag.profilePictureAssetId:match("^%d+$") ~= nil)

    local W = hasPfp and 236 or 204
    local H = 64
    local verified = roleDef and roleDef.verified
    local shown = tag.displayName or tag.robloxUsername or player.Name
    local user = tag.robloxUsername or player.Name
    local baseOffset = Vector3.new(0, CONFIG.NAMETAG_OFFSET + 0.3, 0)
    local dark = accent:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.55)
    local light = accent:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.5)

    local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    billboard.Name = "PrismNametag"
    billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W, H + 10)
    billboard.StudsOffset = baseOffset
    NTScale[#NTScale + 1] = { bb = billboard, w = W, h = H + 10 }

    -- soft colored aura behind the whole tag
    local halo = Instance.new("Frame")
    halo.Name = "Halo"
    halo.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-5, -4)
    halo.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W + 10, H + 8)
    halo.BackgroundColor3 = accent
    halo.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    halo.BorderSizePixel = 0
    halo.ZIndex = 0
    halo.Parent = billboard
    corner(halo, 20)

    -- little pointer that anchors the tag to the player's head (drawn first so the card hides its top half)
    local tip = Instance.new("Frame")
    tip.Name = "Tip"
    tip.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    tip.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, H)
    tip.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(13, 13)
    tip.Rotation = 45
    tip.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(9, 8, 13)
    tip.BorderSizePixel = 0
    tip.ZIndex = 1
    tip.Parent = billboard
    stroke(tip, accent, 1.6, 0.1)

    local glow = Instance.new("Frame")
    glow.Name = "Glow"
    glow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W, H)
    glow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    glow.ZIndex = 1
    glow.Parent = billboard
    corner(glow, 15)
    local glowStroke = stroke(glow, accent, 6, 1)
    local glowGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    glowGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(accent, light)
    glowGrad.Parent = glowStroke

    local card = Instance.new("Frame")
    card.Name = "Card"
    card.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W, H)
    card.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    card.BackgroundTransparency = 0.04
    card.BorderSizePixel = 0
    card.ClipsDescendants = true
    card.ZIndex = 2
    card.Parent = billboard
    corner(card, 15)
    local bodyGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    bodyGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(32, 30, 44), Color3.fromRGB(9, 8, 13))
    bodyGrad.Rotation = 90
    bodyGrad.Parent = card
    local cardStroke = stroke(card, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 1.7, 0)
    local edge = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    edge.Color = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, light),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.3, accent),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.55, dark),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.8, accent),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, light),
    })
    edge.Parent = cardStroke
    Pulse[#Pulse + 1] = cardStroke

    local banner = Instance.new("Frame")
    banner.Name = "Banner"
    banner.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    banner.BackgroundColor3 = toColor(tag.bannerColor, Color3.fromRGB(18, 14, 24))
    banner.BackgroundTransparency = (tag.bannerType == "gradient" or tag.bannerType == "image") and 0 or 1
    banner.BorderSizePixel = 0
    banner.ClipsDescendants = true
    banner.ZIndex = 2
    banner.Parent = card

    if tag.bannerType == "gradient" then
        local grad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
        grad.Color = ColorSequence.new(
            toColor(tag.bannerGradientFrom, accent),
            toColor(tag.bannerGradientTo, Color3.fromRGB(18, 10, 16)))
        grad.Rotation = 18
        grad.Parent = banner
    elseif tag.bannerType == "image" then
        local bimg = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
        bimg.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        bimg.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        bimg.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop
        bimg.ZIndex = 2
        bimg.Parent = banner
        local okImg = setImage(bimg, tag.bannerImageAssetId or tag.bannerImage, nil, { box = CONFIG.GIF_BANNER_BOX })
        if not okImg then setImage(bimg, tag.bannerImage, nil, { box = CONFIG.GIF_BANNER_BOX }) end
    end

    local shade = Instance.new("Frame")
    shade.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    shade.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
    shade.BorderSizePixel = 0
    shade.ZIndex = 3
    shade.Parent = banner
    local shadeGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    shadeGrad.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.4),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.58),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.8),
    })
    shadeGrad.Rotation = 90
    shadeGrad.Parent = shade

    -- accent light rising from the bottom edge
    local rise = Instance.new("Frame")
    rise.Name = "Rise"
    rise.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.4)
    rise.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.6)
    rise.BackgroundColor3 = accent
    rise.BorderSizePixel = 0
    rise.ZIndex = 3
    rise.Parent = card
    local riseGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    riseGrad.Rotation = 90
    riseGrad.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.7),
    })
    riseGrad.Parent = rise

    -- bright hairline along the top edge, fading out to both sides
    local hair = Instance.new("Frame")
    hair.Name = "Hair"
    hair.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 2)
    hair.BackgroundColor3 = light
    hair.BorderSizePixel = 0
    hair.ZIndex = 6
    hair.Parent = card
    local hairGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    hairGrad.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.05),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
    })
    hairGrad.Parent = hair

    -- vertical accent bar on the left
    local bar = Instance.new("Frame")
    bar.Name = "Bar"
    bar.Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 1, 0)
    bar.BackgroundColor3 = accent
    bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
    bar.ZIndex = 6
    bar.Parent = card
    local barGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    barGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(light, dark)
    barGrad.Rotation = 90
    barGrad.Parent = bar

    -- slow light sweep
    local sheen = Instance.new("Frame")
    sheen.Name = "Sheen"
    sheen.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    sheen.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    sheen.BorderSizePixel = 0
    sheen.ZIndex = 4
    sheen.Parent = card
    local sheenGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    sheenGrad.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.42, 1),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.86),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.58, 1),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
    })
    sheenGrad.Rotation = 20
    sheenGrad.Parent = sheen
    Shine[#Shine + 1] = sheenGrad

    local textX = 16
    if hasPfp then
        textX = 62
        local ring = Instance.new("Frame")
        ring.Name = "Ring"
        ring.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(9, 9)
        ring.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(46, 46)
        ring.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        ring.ZIndex = 6
        ring.Parent = billboard
        corner(ring, UDim.new(1, 0))
        local ringStroke = stroke(ring, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 2.6, 0)
        local ringGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
        ringGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, light),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, accent),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, light),
        })
        ringGrad.Parent = ringStroke
        Pulse[#Pulse + 1] = ringStroke

        local avatar = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
        avatar.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(13, 13)
        avatar.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(38, 38)
        avatar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 10, 16)
        avatar.ZIndex = 7
        avatar.Parent = billboard
        corner(avatar, UDim.new(1, 0))
        setImage(avatar, tag.profilePicture, resolveAvatar(player, tag), { box = CONFIG.GIF_AVATAR_BOX })
    end

    local rightPad = hasMusic(tag) and 46 or 14
    local nameW = W - textX - rightPad - (verified and 20 or 0)
    local nameLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    nameLabel.Name = "Name"
    nameLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(textX, 8)
    nameLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(nameW, 20)
    nameLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    nameLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
    nameLabel.TextSize = 16
    nameLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    nameLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = dark
    nameLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.55
    nameLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    pcall(function() nameLabel.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd end)
    nameLabel.ZIndex = 8
    nameLabel.Text = shown
    nameLabel.Parent = billboard
    local nameGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    nameGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), accent:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.55))
    nameGrad.Parent = nameLabel

    local hasUser = user ~= shown
    if hasUser then
        local sub = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        sub.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(textX, 28)
        sub.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W - textX - rightPad, 13)
        sub.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        sub.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
        sub.TextSize = 11
        sub.TextColor3 = light
        sub.TextTransparency = 0.1
        sub.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        pcall(function() sub.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd end)
        sub.ZIndex = 8
        sub.Text = "@" .. user
        sub.Parent = billboard
    end

    if verified then
        local tw = nameW
        pcall(function()
            tw = math.min(nameW, game:GetService("TextService"):GetTextSize(shown, 16, Enum.Font.GothamBlack, Vector2.new(1000, 20)).X)
        end)
        local badge = makeCheckBadge(billboard, 14, accent)
        badge.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(textX + tw + 6, 11)
        badge.ZIndex = 9
    end

    if roleDef then
        local pill = makeRolePill(billboard, roleDef, hasUser and 44 or 32, 9)
        pill.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
        pill.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(textX, hasUser and 44 or 32)
        pill.ZIndex = 8
    end

    -- ===== aurora upgrade: spinning outer aura, name shimmer, rising sparkles, spawn ping =====
    do
        local aura = Instance.new("Frame")
        aura.Name = "Aura"
        aura.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-4, -4)
        aura.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W + 8, H + 8)
        aura.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        aura.ZIndex = 0
        aura.Parent = billboard
        corner(aura, 19)
        local auraStroke = stroke(aura, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 3, 0.5)
        local auraGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
        auraGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, light),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.25, accent),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, dark),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.75, accent),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, light),
        })
        auraGrad.Parent = auraStroke
        NTFx[#NTFx + 1] = { kind = "spin", obj = auraGrad, speed = -80, ph = 0, bb = billboard }

        nameGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, light),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.new(1, 1, 1)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, light),
        })
        NTFx[#NTFx + 1] = { kind = "wave", obj = nameGrad, speed = 1.3, ph = math.random() * 6, bb = billboard }

        for i = 1, 6 do
            local m = Instance.new("Frame")
            m.Name = "Mote"
            m.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            local sz = (i % 2 == 0) and 4 or 3
            m.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sz, sz)
            m.BackgroundColor3 = (i % 2 == 0) and light or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            m.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            m.BorderSizePixel = 0
            m.ZIndex = 9
            m.Parent = billboard
            corner(m, UDim.new(1, 0))
            NTFx[#NTFx + 1] = {
                kind = "mote", obj = m, bb = billboard,
                speed = 0.16 + math.random() * 0.16, ph = math.random(),
                x = W * (0.08 + 0.84 * (i - 1) / 5), y0 = H * 0.75, rise = H * 1.0, sway = 6, max = 0.85,
            }
        end

        -- holo layer: scanlines, corner brackets, an orbiting light trail and a glitching name
        addScanlines(card, 5)
        addBrackets(billboard, W, H, light, 5, 9, 2, 12)
        addOrbit(billboard, W, H, 15, light, billboard, 120, 13, 0)
        addOrbit(billboard, W, H, 15, accent, billboard, 120, 13, 400)
        addGlitch(nameLabel, billboard)

        local ping = Instance.new("Frame")
        ping.Name = "Ping"
        ping.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        ping.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(W / 2, H / 2)
        ping.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W, H)
        ping.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        ping.ZIndex = 10
        ping.Parent = billboard
        corner(ping, 15)
        local pingStroke = stroke(ping, light, 2.5, 0.05)
        TweenService:Create(ping, TweenInfo.new(0.85, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W + 50, H + 34) }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(pingStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.85), { Transparency = 1 }):Play()
        game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(ping, 1)

        -- holographic scan line sweeping down the tag
        local scan = Instance.new("Frame")
        scan.Name = "Scan"
        scan.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 2)
        scan.BackgroundColor3 = light
        scan.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
        scan.BorderSizePixel = 0
        scan.ZIndex = 5
        scan.Visible = false
        scan.Parent = card
        local scanGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
        scanGrad.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
        })
        scanGrad.Parent = scan
        local scanPh = math.random() * 2
        NTFx[#NTFx + 1] = { kind = "fn", obj = scan, bb = billboard, fn = function(now)
            local u = (now * 0.4 + scanPh) % 1.7
            if u > 1 then
                if scan.Visible then scan.Visible = false end
            else
                scan.Visible = true
                scan.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, u, -1)
            end
        end }

        -- targeting brackets on the four corners
        for _, c in ipairs({ { 0, 0 }, { 1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 1, 1 } }) do
            local ax, ay = c[1], c[2]
            local function piece(w, h)
                local f = Instance.new("Frame")
                f.Name = "Bracket"
                f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay)
                f.Position = UDim2.new(ax, ax == 0 and 5 or -5, ay, ay == 0 and 5 or -5)
                f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
                f.BackgroundColor3 = light
                f.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
                f.BorderSizePixel = 0
                f.ZIndex = 7
                f.Parent = card
            end
            piece(9, 2)
            piece(2, 9)
        end

        -- a bright dot circling the profile picture
        if hasPfp then
            local dot = Instance.new("Frame")
            dot.Name = "Orbiter"
            dot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            dot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6)
            dot.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            dot.BorderSizePixel = 0
            dot.ZIndex = 9
            dot.Parent = billboard
            corner(dot, UDim.new(1, 0))
            stroke(dot, light, 2, 0.4)
            NTFx[#NTFx + 1] = { kind = "orbit", obj = dot, bb = billboard, base = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 32), r = 26, speed = 2.2, ph = math.random() * 6 }
        end

        -- the tag whose song is playing pulses with the beat
        local wasBeat = false
        NTFx[#NTFx + 1] = { kind = "fn", obj = aura, bb = billboard, fn = function(now)
            local mine = _G._PrismSongOn and _G._PrismBeatOwner == player
            if mine then
                local b = (_G._PrismSampleSongBeat and _G._PrismSampleSongBeat()) or _G._PrismBeat or 0
                auraStroke.Thickness = 3 + b * 6
                auraStroke.Transparency = math.clamp(0.5 - b * 0.4, 0, 1)
                halo.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(0.86 - b * 0.3, 0, 1)
                wasBeat = true
            elseif wasBeat then
                wasBeat = false
                auraStroke.Thickness = 3
                auraStroke.Transparency = 0.5
                halo.BackgroundTransparency = 0.86
            end
        end }
    end

    -- gentle idle float so tags feel alive
    NTBob[#NTBob + 1] = { bb = billboard, base = baseOffset, ph = math.random() * 6.28 }
    -- fade the aura and rim in
    TweenService:Create(halo, TweenInfo.new(0.5), { BackgroundTransparency = 0.86 }):Play()
    TweenService:Create(glowStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.5), { Transparency = 0.62 }):Play()

    if hasMusic(tag) then
        local play = Instance.new("TextButton")
        play.Name = "PrismPlay"
        play.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
        play.Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0.5, 0)
        play.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 26)
        play.BackgroundColor3 = accent
        play.BackgroundTransparency = 0
        play.Text = (_G._PrismBeatOwner == player and _G._PrismSongOn) and "II" or ">"
        play.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        play.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        play.TextSize = 13
        play.AutoButtonColor = true
        play.ZIndex = 80
        play.Parent = billboard
        corner(play, 13)
        play.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if _G._PrismBeatOwner == player and _G._PrismSongOn then
                stopMusic()
                play.Text = ">"
                return
            end
            play.Text = "..."
            startFullSong(tag, {
                owner = player,
                accent = accent,
                status = function(s)
                    if not play.Parent then return end
                    play.Text = (s == "Full song") and "II" or "..."
                end,
                started = function()
                    if play.Parent then play.Text = "II" end
                end,
            })
        end)
    end
    billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
    billboard.LightInfluence = 0
    billboard.MaxDistance = perfMaxDistance()
    -- Belt-and-braces: force an uncapped render distance so the nametag is
    -- visible clearly across the entire map (unless low-end mode culls it).
    pcall(function()
        if not Perf.low and (not billboard.MaxDistance or billboard.MaxDistance < 1e6) then
            billboard.MaxDistance = math.huge
        end
    end)
    billboard.ResetOnSpawn = false
    billboard.Adornee = head
    billboard.Active = true   -- required so the click button receives mouse input
    -- parent to PlayerGui (not the Head) so the voice-bypass sweep can't delete it
    local pg = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
    if not pg then pg = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 10) end
    billboard.Parent = pg or head

    -- click area: the WHOLE nametag is a button -> opens the profile card + music
    if CONFIG.ENABLE_CLICK_MENU then
        local click = Instance.new("TextButton")
        click.Name = "PrismNametagClick"
        click.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        click.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        click.Text = ""
        click.AutoButtonColor = false
        click.Active = true
        click.Selectable = false
        click.ZIndex = 50
        click.Parent = billboard
        click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            openProfileCard(player, tag)
        end)
        click.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            TweenService:Create(halo, TweenInfo.new(0.18), { BackgroundTransparency = 0.6 }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(glowStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.18), { Transparency = 0.25, Thickness = 8 }):Play()
        end)
        click.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            TweenService:Create(halo, TweenInfo.new(0.25), { BackgroundTransparency = 0.86 }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(glowStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.25), { Transparency = 0.62, Thickness = 6 }):Play()
        end)
    end

    ActiveGuis[player] = billboard
    LastHash[player] = json
end

--========================================================
-- Default nametag for players with no website tag data
--========================================================
local function loadEmbeddedArt(key, filename)
    local src = _G._ParallaxArt and _G._ParallaxArt[key]
    if type(src) ~= "string" or #src < 100 then return nil end
    local gca = getcustomasset or getsynasset
    if type(writefile) ~= "function" or type(gca) ~= "function" then return nil end
    local cache = rawget(_G, "_PrismDefaultArtCache") or {}
    _G._PrismDefaultArtCache = cache
    if cache[key] then return cache[key] end
    local okDec, data = pcall(function()
        if type(_G.PrismB64Decode) == "function" then
            return _G.PrismB64Decode(src)
        end
        return nil
    end)
    if not okDec or type(data) ~= "string" or #data < 100 then return nil end
    local path = "prism_default_" .. filename
    local wOk = pcall(writefile, path, data)
    if not wOk then return nil end
    local aOk, asset = pcall(gca, path)
    if aOk and type(asset) == "string" and asset ~= "" then
        cache[key] = asset
        return asset
    end
    return nil
end

--========================================================
-- Exec-flag helpers: only show nametags for players also running the script

local EXEC_FLAG = "_PrismExec"
local function hasExecFlag(player)
    local char = player and player.Character
    return char ~= nil and char:FindFirstChild(EXEC_FLAG) ~= nil
end
local function plantExecFlag(char)
    if not char then return end
    if char:FindFirstChild(EXEC_FLAG) then return end
    local v = Instance.new("BoolValue")
    v.Name = EXEC_FLAG
    v.Value = true
    v.Parent = char
end

--========================================================
-- Presence: who else is running the script right now
-- Uses the same shared event channel the admin panel already pings.
-- Anyone who has executed recently gets the default nametag if they
-- have no website tag.
--========================================================
local PRESENCE_URL = "https://api.npoint.io/8a895e57d387731e130d"
local PRESENCE_TTL = 25
local Presence = {}   -- [tostring(userId)] = os.clock()
Presence[tostring(LocalPlayer.UserId)] = os.clock()

local function hasPresence(player)
    if not player then return false end
    if player == LocalPlayer then return true end
    local ts = Presence[tostring(player.UserId)]
    return ts ~= nil and (os.clock() - ts) <= PRESENCE_TTL
end

local function pollPresence()
    local res = httpGet(PRESENCE_URL, 8)
    if type(res) ~= "string" or #res == 0 then return end
    local ok2, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(res) end)
    if not ok2 or type(data) ~= "table" or type(data.events) ~= "table" then return end
    local now = os.clock()
    local nowMs = os.time() * 1000
    for _, ev in ipairs(data.events) do
        if type(ev) == "table" and ev.from then
            local ageOk = true
            if type(ev.t) == "number" then
                ageOk = (nowMs - ev.t) <= (PRESENCE_TTL * 1000)
            end
            if ageOk then
                Presence[tostring(ev.from)] = now
            end
        end
    end
    -- drop stale
    for uid, ts in pairs(Presence) do
        if uid ~= tostring(LocalPlayer.UserId) and (now - ts) > PRESENCE_TTL then
            Presence[uid] = nil
        end
    end
end

local function pingPresence()
    -- A failed read must not post an empty list. That was wiping everyone
    -- else's execution ping, so their nametags never appeared.
    local res = httpGet(PRESENCE_URL, 8)
    if type(res) ~= "string" or #res == 0 then return end
    local ok2, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(res) end)
    if not ok2 or type(data) ~= "table" then return end
    local events = {}
    local uid = tostring(LocalPlayer.UserId)
    local nowMs = os.time() * 1000
    if type(data.events) == "table" then
        for _, e in ipairs(data.events) do
            if type(e) == "table" then
                local mine = tostring(e.from) == uid and e.action == "ntping"
                local stale = e.action == "ntping" and type(e.t) == "number" and (nowMs - e.t) > 40000
                if not mine and not stale then
                    events[#events + 1] = e
                end
            end
        end
    end
    events[#events + 1] = {
        id = "nt-" .. tostring(LocalPlayer.UserId) .. "-" .. tostring(os.time()) .. "-" .. tostring(math.random(1000, 9999)),
        t = math.floor(os.time() * 1000),
        from = tostring(LocalPlayer.UserId),
        fromName = LocalPlayer.Name,
        fromDisplayName = LocalPlayer.DisplayName,
        to = "*",
        action = "ntping",
        args = {},
    }
    while #events > 80 do table.remove(events, 1) end
    local body = HttpService:JSONEncode({ seq = (tonumber(data.seq) or 0) + 1, events = events })
    if body then
        httpPost({
            Url = PRESENCE_URL,
            Method = "POST",
            Timeout = 8,
            Headers = { ["Content-Type"] = "application/json" },
            Body = body,
        })
    end
end

--========================================================
-- Refresh loop: match players to nametag data
--========================================================
local function isExecuted(player)
    if not player then return false end
    if player == LocalPlayer then return true end
    if hasExecFlag(player) then return true end
    return hasPresence(player)
end

local function refreshAll()
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer or CONFIG.SHOW_LOCAL_PLAYER then
            -- No execution ping, no nametag. A website tag is not enough.
            if not isExecuted(player) then
                removeNametag(player)
            else
                local tag = NametagData[tostring(player.UserId)]
                if tag then
                    buildNametag(player, tag)
                else
                    buildDefaultNametag(player)
                end
            end
            task.wait()
        end
    end
    sweepDuplicateNametags()
end

_G._PrismRefreshTags = refreshAll

--========================================================
-- Wire up players
--========================================================
local function onPlayerAdded(player)
    if not prismCurrent() then return end
    if player == LocalPlayer and not CONFIG.SHOW_LOCAL_PLAYER then return end
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        if not prismCurrent() then return end
        task.wait(1)
        if not prismCurrent() then return end
        if not isExecuted(player) then
            removeNametag(player)
            return
        end
        local tag = NametagData[tostring(player.UserId)]
        if tag then
            buildNametag(player, tag)
        else
            buildDefaultNametag(player)
        end
    end)
    if player.Character then
        if not isExecuted(player) then
            removeNametag(player)
            return
        end
        local tag = NametagData[tostring(player.UserId)]
        if tag then
            buildNametag(player, tag)
        else
            buildDefaultNametag(player)
        end
    end
end

-- FIX: Two separate PlayerAdded handlers were firing on every join.
-- The second one fired a fetchNametags() HTTP request (external API call) after
-- a 2-second delay, then called refreshAll() to rebuild ALL nametags. This made
-- every player-join trigger a network round-trip + full UI rebuild. Combined into
-- one handler: only the nametag-specific CharacterAdded hook is needed per join;
-- the periodic refresh loop in boot() already keeps nametags up to date.
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    if prismCurrent() then onPlayerAdded(player) end
end)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
    if prismCurrent() then removeNametag(player) end
end)

local function applyRemoteLooks()
    return
end

--========================================================
-- Boot
--========================================================
local function boot()
    log("starting...")
    -- mark this client as running the script so others can detect us
    plantExecFlag(LocalPlayer.Character)
    LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char) task.delay(0, plantExecFlag, char) end)
    -- wipe any tags left behind by a previous execution before we rebuild
    destroyAllPrismNametags()
    fetchNametags()
    refreshAll()
    pcall(applyRemoteLooks)

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        onPlayerAdded(player)
    end

    -- stepAnimations runs at most ~30 hz: NTFx sweeps, pulses and orbit dots
    -- don't need every frame, and batching dt reduces pcall overhead.
    -- GIF frame advances are timer-gated inside stepAnimations so they still
    -- fire at their natural cadence regardless of how often we call this.
    local _ntStepAcc = 0
    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        if not prismCurrent() then return end
        _ntStepAcc = _ntStepAcc + dt
        if _ntStepAcc >= 0.033 then
            local ok, err = pcall(stepAnimations, _ntStepAcc)
            if not ok then log("anim error", err) end
            _ntStepAcc = 0
        end
    end)

    task.spawn(function()
        pcall(pingPresence)
        while prismCurrent() do
            task.wait(4)
            if not prismCurrent() then return end
            pcall(pollPresence)
            pcall(refreshAll)
            task.wait(5)
            if not prismCurrent() then return end
            pcall(pingPresence)
        end
    end)
    task.spawn(function()
        while prismCurrent() do
            task.wait(CONFIG.REFRESH_INTERVAL)
            if prismCurrent() and fetchNametags() then
                refreshAll()
                pcall(applyRemoteLooks)
            end
        end
    end)
end

boot()

    return resolveAsset(url, { box = box or CONFIG.GIF_AVATAR_BOX })
end)
    end)
    if not ok then
        warn("[Vexora] module failed to start:", err)
    end
end)

--========================================================
-- Executor-aware HTTP
--========================================================
local function httpGet(url)
    local methods = {
        function() return game:HttpGet(url) end,
        function() return game:HttpGetAsync(url) end,
        function() return request({ Url = url, Method = "GET" }).Body end,
        function() return http_request({ Url = url, Method = "GET" }).Body end,
        function() return syn.request({ Url = url, Method = "GET" }).Body end,
    }
    for _, fn in ipairs(methods) do
        local ok, res = pcall(fn)
        if ok and type(res) == "string" and #res > 0 then return true, res end
    end
    return false, nil
end

local function httpPost(url, body)
    local headers = { ["Content-Type"] = "application/json" }
    local methods = {
        function() return request({ Url = url, Method = "POST", Headers = headers, Body = body }) end,
        function() return http_request({ Url = url, Method = "POST", Headers = headers, Body = body }) end,
        function() return syn.request({ Url = url, Method = "POST", Headers = headers, Body = body }) end,
        function() return game:HttpPost(url, body, "application/json") end,
        function() return HttpService:PostAsync(url, body, Enum.HttpContentType.ApplicationJson) end,
    }
    for _, fn in ipairs(methods) do
        local ok, res = pcall(fn)
        if ok and res ~= nil then return true, res end
    end
    return false, nil
end

local function jdec(s) local ok, v = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(s) end); if ok then return v end; return nil end
local function jenc(t) local ok, v = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONEncode(t) end); if ok then return v end; return nil end

local ROLE_LABEL = {
    owner = "Owner", coowner = "Co-Owner", admin = "Admin",
    moderator = "Moderator", support = "Support", dev = "Developer",
    vip = "VIP", verified = "Verified", none = "Member",
}
local ROLE_LEVEL = {
    owner = 3, dev = 3, coowner = 2,
    admin = 1, moderator = 1, support = 1,
    vip = 0, verified = 0, none = 0,
}
-- the panel itself (not just the buttons inside it) only opens for Support and up.
-- VIP, Verified and no role at all never see it, no matter what they press.
local STAFF_LEVEL = 1
local ROLE_ALIASES = {
    owner = "owner", ["co-owner"] = "coowner", coowner = "coowner", ["co owner"] = "coowner", co = "coowner",
    admin = "admin", administrator = "admin", ["head admin"] = "admin",
    mod = "moderator", moderator = "moderator",
    support = "support", staff = "support",
    dev = "dev", developer = "dev",
    vip = "vip", premium = "vip",
    verified = "verified",
}
local function normRole(raw)
    if type(raw) ~= "string" then return nil end
    local k = raw:lower():gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if ROLE_LEVEL[k] then return k end
    return ROLE_ALIASES[k]
end

-- State

local myRole, myLevel = "none", 0
local function hasStaffAccess() return myLevel >= STAFF_LEVEL end
local bans = {}

-- Event de-duplication. The set lives on getgenv()/_G so it SURVIVES a
-- re-execution: an action that already fired once will never fire again just
-- because the script was stopped and started again.
local _prismGlobal = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G

-- Generation guard: every execution bumps this counter and remembers its own
-- number. All the panel's background while-true loops check isCurrentGen()
-- each lap and quietly stop the moment a newer execution takes over. Without
-- this, re-executing the script never killed the previous run's loops --
-- they just kept polling forever in the background, so after a few
-- re-executes you'd have several copies of the same loops all running at
-- once (real source of lag that gets WORSE the more you re-execute), and the
-- dev panel GUI from the old run was never torn down either, so you'd see a
-- stale panel instead of the new one.
_prismGlobal._PrismAdminGen = (_prismGlobal._PrismAdminGen or 0) + 1
local myAdminGen = _prismGlobal._PrismAdminGen
local function isCurrentGen() return _prismGlobal._PrismAdminGen == myAdminGen end

local seen = _prismGlobal._PrismSeenEvents
if type(seen) ~= "table" then seen = {}; _prismGlobal._PrismSeenEvents = seen end
local _seenCount = 0
for _ in pairs(seen) do _seenCount = _seenCount + 1 end
local function markSeen(id)
    if seen[id] then return end
    seen[id] = true
    _seenCount = _seenCount + 1
    if _seenCount > 1000 then          -- keep the set bounded
        local remove = _seenCount - 500
        for k in pairs(seen) do
            seen[k] = nil
            remove = remove - 1
            if remove <= 0 then break end
        end
        _seenCount = 500
    end
end

local panel, panelOpen = nil, false
local uiBuilt = false
local lastBuiltLevel = -1      -- level the action rows were last built for
local rebuildActions = nil     -- set by buildUI(); rebuilds the action rows for the CURRENT role
local listHolder, searchBox, roleBadgeLbl, statusLbl, toastLbl
-- userId(string) -> os.clock() of the last time we saw them send/receive an
-- event, i.e. proof their copy of the script is actually running. The search
-- list only shows players with a fresh timestamp here (plus yourself).
local scriptPresence = {}
local PRESENCE_TTL = 20
local crossNames   = {}          -- userId string -> { name, displayName, role } for cross-server players
local crossPlayers = {}          -- userId string -> stable virtual player table (reused across rebuilds)

--========================================================
-- Role / ban fetch
--========================================================
local function fetchRole()
    if CFG.OFFLINE then
        myRole = "dev"
        myLevel = ROLE_LEVEL.dev
        return
    end
    local ok, res = httpGet(CFG.API_URL)
    if not ok or type(res) ~= "string" then return end
    local data = jdec(res); if type(data) ~= "table" then return end
    local list = data.nametags or data.data
    local found
    if type(list) == "table" then
        for _, tag in ipairs(list) do
            if type(tag) == "table" and tostring(tag.robloxId) == tostring(LP.UserId) then
                found = normRole(tag.role); break
            end
        end
    end
    myRole = found or "none"
    myLevel = ROLE_LEVEL[myRole] or 0
    log("role =", myRole, "level =", myLevel)
end

local function fetchBans()
    if CFG.OFFLINE then return end
    local ok, res = httpGet(CFG.API_URL)
    if not ok or type(res) ~= "string" then return end
    local data = jdec(res); if type(data) ~= "table" then return end
    bans = type(data.bans) == "table" and data.bans or {}
end

local function isBanned(uid)
    uid = tostring(uid)
    for _, b in ipairs(bans) do
        if type(b) == "table" and tostring(b.userId) == uid then return b end
    end
    return nil
end

local COL = {
    -- simple black & white theme
    bg = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0), bg2 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 18),
    panel = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 24), line = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
    accent = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), text = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
    text2 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 160, 160), good = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
    bad = Color3.fromRGB(210, 210, 210), warn = Color3.fromRGB(210, 210, 210),
}
local function corner(o, r)
    local c = Instance.new("UICorner"); c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, math.floor((r or 8) * PRISM_CORNER_SCALE + 0.5)); c.Parent = o; return c
end
local function stroke(o, col, t)
    local s = Instance.new("UIStroke"); s.Color = col or COL.line; s.Thickness = t or 1; s.Transparency = 0.4; s.Parent = o; return s
end
local function notify(text, col)
    pcall(function()
        StarterGui:SetCore("ChatMakeSystemMessage", {
            Text = "[Prism] " .. text, Color = col or COL.accent, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
        })
    end)
    if toastLbl then pcall(function() toastLbl.Text = tostring(text) end) end
end

--========================================================
-- Local effects (run on the TARGET's client)
--========================================================
local function getChar() return LP.Character end
local function getHRP()
    local c = getChar(); if not c then return nil end
    return c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or c.PrimaryPart
end
local function getHum()
    local c = getChar(); if not c then return nil end
    return c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end

local function doFreeze()
    local hrp, hum = getHRP(), getHum()
    if not hrp or not hum then return end
    _G._PrismFrozen = true          -- tell the movement-safety layer to stand down
    -- Remember the REAL movement values only once. Freezing twice (or crucifying
    -- someone who is already frozen) used to store the frozen 0s as the
    -- "original" values, so unfreezing left you unable to move.
    if frozenState.hum ~= hum or not frozenState.active then
        frozenState.hum = hum; frozenState.active = true
        frozenState.ws = hum.WalkSpeed; frozenState.jp = hum.JumpPower
        pcall(function() frozenState.jh = hum.JumpHeight end)
        if (frozenState.ws or 0) <= 0 then frozenState.ws = 16 end
        if (frozenState.jp or 0) <= 0 then frozenState.jp = 50 end
        if (frozenState.jh or 0) <= 0 then frozenState.jh = 7.2 end
    end
    hum.WalkSpeed = 0; hum.JumpPower = 0
    pcall(function() hum.JumpHeight = 0 end)
    hrp.Anchored = true
end
local function doUnfreeze()
    local hrp, hum = getHRP(), getHum()
    _G._PrismFrozen = false         -- allow the movement-safety layer to run again
    frozenState.active = false
    if hrp then hrp.Anchored = false end
    if hum then
        hum.WalkSpeed = frozenState.ws or 16
        hum.JumpPower = frozenState.jp or 50
        pcall(function() hum.JumpHeight = frozenState.jh or 7.2 end)
        pcall(function() hum.PlatformStand = false; hum.Sit = false end)
        pcall(function() hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp) end)
    end
end

-- Arm pose for the cross: arms straight out to the sides.
local function armPose(motor)
    local n = motor.Name
    if n == "Right Shoulder" or n == "Left Shoulder" then        -- R6
        return CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0)
    elseif n == "RightShoulder" then                             -- R15
        return CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
    elseif n == "LeftShoulder" then
        return CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(-90))
    end
    return nil
end

-- Removes the cross (and its fire) and puts the arms back how they were.
local function clearCross()
    local obj = crucifyObj
    crucifyObj = nil
    if not obj then return end
    obj.alive = false
    for _, j in ipairs(obj.joints or {}) do
        pcall(function() if j.motor and j.motor.Parent then j.motor.C0 = j.c0 end end)
    end
    if obj.model then pcall(function() obj.model:Destroy() end) end
end

local function doCrucify()
    local char, hrp = getChar(), getHRP()
    if not char or not hrp then return end
    clearCross()                    -- restore arms / remove an old cross first
    doFreeze()

    local model = Instance.new("Model"); model.Name = "PrismCross"
    local function wood(size)
        local p = Instance.new("Part")
        p.Size = size; p.Anchored = true; p.CanCollide = false
        p.Material = Enum.Material.Wood; p.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Brown")
        p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth; p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
        p.Parent = model; return p
    end
    local function fire(part, size, heat)
        local f = Instance.new("Fire")
        f.Size = size; f.Heat = heat
        f.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 30); f.SecondaryColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 0)
        f.Parent = part
        return f
    end

    -- The cross stands BEHIND the player (+Z is behind a character), so the
    -- player's back is against it and they face away from it.
    local base = hrp.CFrame
    local beam = wood(Vector3.new(1, 8, 1)); beam.CFrame = base * CFrame.new(0, 1, 1.1)
    local bar  = wood(Vector3.new(5.5, 1, 1)); bar.CFrame  = base * CFrame.new(0, 1.3, 1.1)
    model.PrimaryPart = beam

    -- fire (client side only): on the wood plus a burning patch at the foot
    fire(beam, 9, 12)
    fire(bar, 6, 10)
    local ground = Instance.new("Part")
    ground.Size = Vector3.new(4, 0.4, 4); ground.Transparency = 1
    ground.Anchored = true; ground.CanCollide = false
    ground.CFrame = base * CFrame.new(0, -2.8, 0.8); ground.Parent = model
    fire(ground, 8, 10)
    local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
    light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 40); light.Range = 20; light.Brightness = 2
    light.Parent = beam
    model.Parent = Workspace

    -- arms out to the sides (remember the originals so uncrucify can restore them)
    local joints = {}
    pcall(function()
        for _, m in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if m:IsA("Motor6D") then
                local pose = armPose(m)
                if pose then
                    joints[#joints + 1] = { motor = m, c0 = m.C0 }
                    m.C0 = m.C0 * pose
                end
            end
        end
    end)

    local obj = { model = model, joints = joints, alive = true }
    crucifyObj = obj
    task.spawn(function()        -- flickering firelight
        while obj.alive and model.Parent do
            light.Brightness = 1.5 + math.random() * 1.8
            task.wait(0.08)
        end
    end)
end
local function doUncrucify()
    clearCross()
    doUnfreeze()
    -- some games reset speed a moment later; make sure you can move again
    task.delay(0.15, function()
        local hum = getHum()
        if hum and not frozenState.active then
            if hum.WalkSpeed <= 0 then hum.WalkSpeed = frozenState.ws or 16 end
            pcall(function() if hum.UseJumpPower and hum.JumpPower <= 0 then hum.JumpPower = frozenState.jp or 50 end end)
            local hrp = getHRP(); if hrp then hrp.Anchored = false end
        end
    end)
end

local function overlay(color, dur, blink)
    local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    gui.Name = "PrismFx"; gui.ResetOnSpawn = false; gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    gui.DisplayOrder = 99999; gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
    local f = Instance.new("Frame")
    f.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1); f.BackgroundColor3 = color; f.BorderSizePixel = 0
    f.BackgroundTransparency = 0; f.Parent = gui
    gui.Parent = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") or LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    fxGuis[#fxGuis + 1] = gui
    if blink then
        task.spawn(function()
            local t = 0
            while t < dur do
                f.BackgroundTransparency = (f.BackgroundTransparency == 0) and 1 or 0
                task.wait(0.07); t += 0.07
            end
            pcall(function() gui:Destroy() end)
        end)
    else
        task.delay(dur, function() pcall(function() gui:Destroy() end) end)
    end
    return gui
end
