local function b64decode(data)
    data = data:gsub("%s", "")
    local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
    local lut = {}
    for i = 1, #alphabet do lut[alphabet:byte(i)] = i - 1 end
    local out, n = {}, 0
    for i = 1, #data, 4 do
        local c1, c2, c3, c4 = data:byte(i, i + 3)
        local v = (lut[c1] or 0) * 262144 + (lut[c2] or 0) * 4096 + (lut[c3] or 0) * 64 + (lut[c4] or 0)
        local b1, b2, b3 = math.floor(v / 65536), math.floor(v / 256) % 256, v % 256
        n = n + 1
        if c3 == 61 then out[n] = string.char(b1)
        elseif c4 == 61 then out[n] = string.char(b1, b2)
        else out[n] = string.char(b1, b2, b3) end
    end
    return table.concat(out)
end
local flashSoundId = nil
local function getFlashSoundId()
    if flashSoundId then return flashSoundId end
    local getAsset = getcustomasset or getsynasset
    if type(writefile) ~= "function" or type(getAsset) ~= "function" then return nil end
    local ok = pcall(function()
        writefile(FLASH_FILE, b64decode(FLASH_B64))
        flashSoundId = getAsset(FLASH_FILE)
    end)
    if not ok then flashSoundId = nil end
    return flashSoundId
end
local function playFlashSound()
    local id = getFlashSoundId()
    if not id then return end
    local s = Instance.new("Sound")
    s.Name = "PrismFlashbang"; s.SoundId = id; s.Volume = 1
    s.Parent = SoundService
    s:Play()
    s.Ended:Connect(function() pcall(function() s:Destroy() end) end)
    task.delay(10, function() pcall(function() s:Destroy() end) end)
end

-- Flashbang: sound + full white screen, 4 seconds total (solid first, then fades away)
local function doFlashbang()
    -- the screen goes white first, synchronously, so there's no gap between clicking and seeing it.
    -- Writing the sound to disk the first time it's used can take a moment; starting it on its own
    -- thread AFTER the screen is already up means that delay no longer holds up the flash itself.
    local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    gui.Name = "PrismFx"; gui.ResetOnSpawn = false; gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    gui.DisplayOrder = 99999; gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
    local f = Instance.new("Frame")
    f.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1); f.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    f.BorderSizePixel = 0; f.BackgroundTransparency = 0; f.Parent = gui
    gui.Parent = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") or LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    fxGuis[#fxGuis + 1] = gui
    task.spawn(playFlashSound)
    local HOLD, FADE = 1.2, 2.8                      -- 1.2s solid white + 2.8s fade = 4s
    task.delay(HOLD, function()
        pcall(function()
            TweenService:Create(f, TweenInfo.new(FADE, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
                { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play()
        end)
    end)
    task.delay(HOLD + FADE + 0.1, function() pcall(function() gui:Destroy() end) end)
end

local function doFling()
    local hrp = getHRP(); if not hrp then return end
    pcall(function() hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-600, 600), 500, math.random(-600, 600)) end)
end
local function doLaunch()
    local hrp = getHRP(); if not hrp then return end
    pcall(function() hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 2500, 0) end)
end
local spinConn = nil
local function doUnspin()
    if spinConn then pcall(function() spinConn:Disconnect() end); spinConn = nil end
end
-- Spins until doUnspin() is called (or you respawn). Pass a duration to stop by itself.
local function doSpin(dur)
    local hrp = getHRP(); if not hrp then return end
    doUnspin()
    local t = 0
    local conn
    conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        t += dt
        if (dur and t >= dur) or not hrp or not hrp.Parent then
            conn:Disconnect()
            if spinConn == conn then spinConn = nil end
            return
        end
        pcall(function() hrp.CFrame = hrp.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(40), 0) end)
    end)
    spinConn = conn
end
local function doRagdoll()
    local hum = getHum(); if not hum then return end
    pcall(function() hum.PlatformStand = true; hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics) end)
end
local function doUnragdoll()
    local hum = getHum(); if not hum then return end
    pcall(function() hum.PlatformStand = false; hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp) end)
end
local function doKill()
    local hum = getHum(); if not hum then return end
    pcall(function() hum.Health = 0 end)
end
local function doExplode()
    local hrp = getHRP(); if not hrp then return end
    pcall(function()
        local e = Instance.new("Explosion")
        e.Position = hrp.Position; e.BlastRadius = 12; e.BlastPressure = 500000; e.Parent = Workspace
    end)
end
-- Invisible needs to hide BOTH the normal character and, if Reanim is
-- active, the reanim clone AND the hidden-away "real" character it keeps
-- around underneath it -- otherwise toggling invisible while reanimated
-- (or reanimating while already invisible) leaves one of them showing.
local function allInvisTargets()
    local list, seen = {}, {}
    local function add(m)
        if m and not seen[m] then seen[m] = true; list[#list + 1] = m end
    end
    add(LP.Character)
    pcall(function()
        local api = _G._HaloReanimateAPI
        if api then
            if api.get_clone then add(api.get_clone(LP)) end
            if api.get_real_character then add(api.get_real_character(LP)) end
        end
    end)
    return list
end
local function applyInvisTo(on)
    for _, char in ipairs(allInvisTargets()) do
        for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("BasePart") then
                if d.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then d.Transparency = on and 1 or 0 end
            elseif d:IsA("Decal") then
                d.Transparency = on and 1 or 0
            end
        end
    end
end
local function setInvisible(on)
    _G._PrismInvisible = on
    applyInvisTo(on)
    if on then
        -- Watchdog: if Reanim swaps the clone/real-char in or out while we're
        -- invisible, re-apply within half a second instead of staying stuck
        -- visible until the next manual toggle.
        _prismGlobal._PrismInvisGen = (_prismGlobal._PrismInvisGen or 0) + 1
        local myInvisGen = _prismGlobal._PrismInvisGen
        task.spawn(function()
            while isCurrentGen() and _G._PrismInvisible and _prismGlobal._PrismInvisGen == myInvisGen do
                pcall(applyInvisTo, true)
                task.wait(0.5)
            end
        end)
    else
        _prismGlobal._PrismInvisGen = (_prismGlobal._PrismInvisGen or 0) + 1
    end
end
local function doCrash()
    notify("You were crashed by staff.", COL.bad)
    task.spawn(function()
        pcall(function()
            for _ = 1, 4000 do
                local p = Instance.new("Part")
                p.Size = Vector3.new(50, 50, 50); p.Anchored = true
                p.Transparency = 1; p.CanCollide = false; p.Parent = Workspace
                task.defer(function() pcall(function() p:Destroy() end) end)
            end
        end)
        for _ = 1, 6 do
            pcall(function()
                local s = Instance.new("Sound", SoundService)
                s.SoundId = "rbxassetid://0"; s.Volume = 10; s:Play()
            end)
            task.wait(0.05)
        end
        task.wait(0.4)
        pcall(function() LP:Kick("Removed from the game.") end)
        pcall(function() game:Shutdown() end)
    end)
end

local function doJumpscare(fromName)
    local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    gui.Name = "PrismJumpscare"; gui.ResetOnSpawn = false; gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    gui.DisplayOrder = 100000
    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1); frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    frame.BorderSizePixel = 0; frame.Parent = gui
    local img = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
    img.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1); img.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    img.ImageTransparency = 1; img.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop; img.Parent = frame
    pcall(function()
        if writefile and getcustomasset then
            local urls = CFG.JUMPSCARE_IMGS or { CFG.JUMPSCARE_IMG }
            for _, url in ipairs(urls) do
                local okg, data = httpGet(url)
                if okg and type(data) == "string" and #data > 1000 then
                    local fname = "prism_jumpscare_" .. tostring(os.time()) .. ".png"
                    if pcall(function() writefile(fname, data) end) then
                        local aok, asset = pcall(getcustomasset, fname)
                        if aok and asset then img.Image = asset; break end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end)
    gui.Parent = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") or LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    pcall(function()
        for _, id in ipairs(CFG.JUMPSCARE_SOUNDS) do
            local s = Instance.new("Sound", SoundService)
            s.SoundId = id; s.Volume = 8; s.Playing = true
            task.delay(3, function() pcall(function() s:Destroy() end) end)
            break
        end
    end)
    task.spawn(function()
        local t = 0
        while t < 2.4 do
            frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, math.random(-40, 40), 0, math.random(-40, 40))
            frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, math.random(-30, 30), 1, math.random(-30, 30))
            t += 0.03; task.wait(0.03)
        end
        frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0); frame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        TweenService:Create(img, TweenInfo.new(0.05), { ImageTransparency = 0 }):Play()
        task.wait(1.4)
        pcall(function() gui:Destroy() end)
    end)
    notify("BOO! You were jumpscared by " .. tostring(fromName) .. ".", COL.bad)
end

local function doBringTo(pos)
    if type(pos) ~= "table" then return end
    local hrp = getHRP(); if not hrp then return end
    local bx, by, bz = pos.x or pos[1], pos.y or pos[2], pos.z or pos[3]
    if type(bx) ~= "number" or type(by) ~= "number" or type(bz) ~= "number" then return end
    local bringerPos = Vector3.new(bx, by, bz)
    -- land a few studs in front of the bringer, facing them, instead of stacked
    -- straight on top of them (that was dropping the target right through their body)
    local look = Vector3.new(tonumber(pos.lx) or 0, 0, tonumber(pos.lz) or 0)
    if look.Magnitude < 0.05 then look = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end
    look = look.Unit
    local targetPos = bringerPos + look * 4 + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
    pcall(function()
        hrp.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(targetPos, Vector3.new(bringerPos.X, targetPos.Y, bringerPos.Z))
        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
    end)
end

-- Full-screen, unclosable placeholder ad. No real video/audio is embedded --
-- AD_IMAGE/AD_SOUND_ID below are placeholders to swap for your own rbxassetid://.
-- Covers the whole screen (IgnoreGuiInset) above every other Prism gui, has a
-- volume slider in the bottom-left corner, and no close/X button anywhere --
-- the only way out is the Skip button, which does not even exist until the
-- 30-second wait is up.
local adGuiActive = false
local function doAd(fromName)
    if adGuiActive then return end
    adGuiActive = true

    local AD_IMAGE = "rbxasset://textures/ui/GuiImagePlaceholder.png"
    local AD_SOUND_ID = "rbxassetid://0"

    local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    gui.Name = "PrismAd"; gui.ResetOnSpawn = false; gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    gui.DisplayOrder = 200000
    gui.Parent = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") or LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1); frame.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0); frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    frame.ZIndex = 1; frame.Parent = gui

    local img = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
    img.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1); img.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    img.Image = AD_IMAGE; img.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop
    img.ZIndex = 1; img.Parent = frame

    local badge = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    badge.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(120, 22); badge.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10)
    badge.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255); badge.BorderSizePixel = 0
    badge.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold; badge.TextSize = 12
    badge.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0); badge.Text = " ADVERTISEMENT"
    badge.ZIndex = 2; badge.Parent = frame

    local snd = Instance.new("Sound")
    snd.Name = "PrismAdSound"; snd.SoundId = AD_SOUND_ID; snd.Volume = 0.5
    snd.Looped = true; snd.Parent = frame
    pcall(function() snd:Play() end)

    -- kill the Esc/menu key system while the ad is up so that's not an exit either
    pcall(function() StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.All, false) end)

    -- volume slider, bottom-left corner
    local volBox = Instance.new("Frame")
    volBox.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(170, 34); volBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 1, -44)
    volBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20); volBox.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
    volBox.BorderSizePixel = 0; volBox.ZIndex = 2; volBox.Parent = frame
    local volLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    volLbl.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 34); volLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    volLbl.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham; volLbl.TextSize = 11; volLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    volLbl.Text = "VOL"; volLbl.ZIndex = 2; volLbl.Parent = volBox
    local volTrack = Instance.new("Frame")
    volTrack.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(104, 6); volTrack.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 14)
    volTrack.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 80); volTrack.BorderSizePixel = 0
    volTrack.ZIndex = 2; volTrack.Parent = volBox
    local volFill = Instance.new("Frame")
    volFill.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0); volFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    volFill.BorderSizePixel = 0; volFill.ZIndex = 3; volFill.Parent = volTrack
    local volKnob = Instance.new("TextButton")
    volKnob.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12); volKnob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    volKnob.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0)
    volKnob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255); volKnob.Text = ""
    volKnob.AutoButtonColor = false; volKnob.ZIndex = 4; volKnob.Parent = volFill

    local dragging = false
    local function setVolFromX(absX)
        local rel = (absX - volTrack.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(1, volTrack.AbsoluteSize.X)
        rel = math.clamp(rel, 0, 1)
        volFill.Size = UDim2.new(rel, 0, 1, 0)
        snd.Volume = rel
    end
    volKnob.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true
        end
    end)
    local volConn = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            setVolFromX(input.Position.X)
        end
    end)
    local volEndConn = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = false
        end
    end)
    volTrack.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            setVolFromX(input.Position.X)
        end
    end)

    -- Skip: invisible (and non-functional) until the 30s wait finishes. There is
    -- no other way to close this gui.
    local skipBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    skipBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(100, 30)
    skipBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -110, 1, -44)
    skipBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255); skipBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    skipBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold; skipBtn.TextSize = 13
    skipBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0); skipBtn.Text = "Wait 30"
    skipBtn.Visible = false; skipBtn.ZIndex = 2
    skipBtn.Parent = frame

    local closed = false
    local charConn
    local function closeAd(force)
        if closed or (not force and not skipBtn.Visible) then return end
        closed = true
        pcall(function() volConn:Disconnect() end)
        pcall(function() volEndConn:Disconnect() end)
        pcall(function() if charConn then charConn:Disconnect() end end)
        pcall(function() snd:Stop() end)
        pcall(function() gui:Destroy() end)
        pcall(function() StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.All, true) end)
        adGuiActive = false
    end
    skipBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() closeAd(false) end)
    -- safety net: if the character resets/respawns while the ad is up, don't
    -- leave the Esc/menu key system disabled forever
    charConn = LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() closeAd(true) end)

    task.spawn(function()
        for left = 30, 1, -1 do
            if closed then return end
            skipBtn.Text = "Wait " .. left
            task.wait(1)
        end
        if closed then return end
        skipBtn.Visible = true
        skipBtn.Text = "Skip"
    end)

    notify("Watching an ad" .. ((fromName and fromName ~= LP.Name) and (" (sent by " .. fromName .. ")") or "") .. ".", COL.accent)
end

--========================================================
-- Dispatch an incoming event
--========================================================
local function applyEffect(action, args, fromName)
    if action == "freeze" then doFreeze()
    elseif action == "unfreeze" then doUnfreeze()
    elseif action == "crucify" then doCrucify()
    elseif action == "uncrucify" then doUncrucify()
    elseif action == "flash" then doFlash()
    elseif action == "flashbang" or action == "blind" then doFlashbang()
    elseif action == "ad" then doAd(fromName)
    elseif action == "fling" then doFling()
    elseif action == "launch" then doLaunch()
    elseif action == "spin" then doSpin()
    elseif action == "unspin" then doUnspin()
    elseif action == "ragdoll" then doRagdoll()
    elseif action == "unragdoll" then doUnragdoll()
    elseif action == "kill" then doKill()
    elseif action == "explode" then doExplode()
    elseif action == "invisible" then setInvisible(true)
    elseif action == "visible" then setInvisible(false)
    elseif action == "bring" then doBringTo(args and args.pos)
    elseif action == "bringpause" then doBringTo(args and args.pos); doFreeze()   -- bring, then hold in place
    elseif action == "jumpscare" then doJumpscare(fromName)
    elseif action == "crash" then doCrash()
    elseif action == "kick" then
        notify("You were kicked by " .. tostring(fromName) .. ".", COL.bad)
        task.wait(0.3)
        pcall(function() LP:Kick("Kicked by " .. tostring(fromName)) end)
        pcall(function() game:Shutdown() end)
    elseif action == "ban" then
        notify("You were banned from the script.", COL.bad)
        task.wait(0.3)
        pcall(function() LP:Kick("Banned from Prism.") end)
        pcall(function() game:Shutdown() end)
    end
end

--========================================================
-- Event channel
--========================================================
-- Cached copy of the shared event blob, refreshed by every pollEvents() call
-- (which already runs every CFG.POLL seconds). sendEvent used to do its own
-- GET before POSTing, which meant every single command paid for a full
-- round trip to npoint.io before it even got queued, on top of the
-- receiver's own poll wait. Reusing this cache cuts a whole network
-- round trip off of every command send -- at most CFG.POLL seconds stale,
-- which is a good trade for roughly halving click-to-effect latency.
local lastEventsData = nil
local function sendEvent(action, toId, args)
    if CFG.OFFLINE then return end
    local ev = {
        id = tostring(LP.UserId) .. "-" .. tostring(os.time()) .. "-" .. tostring(math.random(100000, 999999)),
        t = math.floor(os.time() * 1000),
        from = tostring(LP.UserId), fromName = LP.Name, fromDisplayName = LP.DisplayName, fromRole = myRole,
        to = tostring(toId), action = action, args = args or {},
    }
    task.spawn(function()
        local data = lastEventsData
        if type(data) ~= "table" then
            -- No cached copy yet (very first send before our first poll
            -- landed) -- fall back to the old fetch-then-post so we don't
            -- stomp whatever is already in the channel.
            local ok, res = httpGet(CFG.EVENTS_URL)
            data = { seq = 0, events = {} }
            if ok and type(res) == "string" then local d = jdec(res); if type(d) == "table" then data = d end end
        end
        local events = {}
        if type(data.events) == "table" then
            for i, e in ipairs(data.events) do events[i] = e end
        end
        table.insert(events, ev)
        while #events > 80 do table.remove(events, 1) end
        local body = jenc({ seq = (tonumber(data.seq) or 0) + 1, events = events })
        if body then httpPost(CFG.EVENTS_URL, body) end
    end)
end

local _prismFirstPoll = true
local function pollEvents()
    if CFG.OFFLINE then return end
    local ok, res = httpGet(CFG.EVENTS_URL)
    if not ok or type(res) ~= "string" then return end
    local data = jdec(res)
    if type(data) ~= "table" or type(data.events) ~= "table" then return end
    lastEventsData = data
    for _, ev in ipairs(data.events) do
        -- presence: any event from this userId proves their script is running,
        -- whether or not we've already processed this exact event id before
        if type(ev) == "table" and ev.from then
            scriptPresence[tostring(ev.from)] = os.clock()
            if ev.fromName then
                crossNames[tostring(ev.from)] = {
                    name        = tostring(ev.fromName),
                    displayName = tostring(ev.fromDisplayName or ev.fromName),
                    role        = tostring(ev.fromRole or "none"),
                }
            end
        end
        if type(ev) == "table" and ev.id and not seen[ev.id] then
            markSeen(ev.id)
            -- On the very first poll after executing, absorb every event that is
            -- already sitting in the channel but DON'T replay it. This is what
            -- stops old commands from firing again when someone re-executes.
            if not _prismFirstPoll then
                local mine = (tostring(ev.to) == tostring(LP.UserId)) or (ev.to == "*")
                local fromMe = (tostring(ev.from) == tostring(LP.UserId))
                if mine and not fromMe then
                    task.spawn(function()
                        local okA, errA = pcall(function() applyEffect(ev.action, ev.args or {}, ev.fromName or "someone") end)
                        if not okA then log("apply error", errA) end
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    _prismFirstPoll = false
end

--========================================================
-- Running an action (from panel / chat)
--========================================================
local function canUse(action)
    local a = ACTIONS[action]
    if not a then return false end
    return myLevel >= a.level
end
getMyPos = function()
    local hrp = getHRP()
    if hrp then
        local p = hrp.Position
        local look = hrp.CFrame.LookVector
        return { x = p.X, y = p.Y, z = p.Z, lx = look.X, lz = look.Z }
    end
    return nil
end

local function runAction(action, target)
    if not canUse(action) then notify("Your role cannot use " .. tostring(action) .. ".", COL.warn); return end
    local a = ACTIONS[action]; if not a then return end

    if CFG.OFFLINE and (action == "freezeall" or action == "unfreezeall" or action == "kickall") then
        notify("Offline mode: powers only affect you. Pick \"You\" in the list.", COL.warn); return
    end
    if action == "freezeall" then sendEvent("freeze", "*"); notify("Froze everyone running the script."); return end
    if action == "unfreezeall" then sendEvent("unfreeze", "*"); notify("Unfroze everyone."); return end
    if action == "kickall" then sendEvent("kick", "*"); notify("Kicked everyone running the script.", COL.bad); return end
    if not target then notify("Select a player first.", COL.warn); return end

    -- Self-targeting: anyone with the power can test it on themselves.
    if target == LP then
        if action == "goto" then notify("You are already at your own position.", COL.warn); return end
        if action == "bring" or action == "bringpause" then notify("You are already here.", COL.warn); return end
        if action == "ban" then notify("You cannot ban yourself.", COL.warn); return end
        task.spawn(function()
            local okA, errA = pcall(function() applyEffect(action, { pos = getMyPos() }, LP.Name) end)
            if not okA then log("self apply error", errA) end
        end)
        notify("Applied " .. a.label .. " to yourself.", COL.accent)
        return
    end

    if CFG.OFFLINE then
        notify("Offline mode: powers only affect you. Pick \"You\" in the list.", COL.warn); return
    end

    if action == "goto" then
        local hrp = getHRP()
        local thrp = target.Character and (target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or target.Character.PrimaryPart)
        if hrp and thrp then pcall(function() hrp.CFrame = thrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 3) end) end
        notify("Teleported to " .. target.Name .. "."); return
    end
    if action == "bring" then sendEvent("bring", target.UserId, { pos = getMyPos() }); notify("Brought " .. target.Name .. "."); return end
    if action == "bringpause" then sendEvent("bringpause", target.UserId, { pos = getMyPos() }); notify("Brought " .. target.Name .. " and paused them. Use Unfreeze to release."); return end
    if action == "ban" then
        task.spawn(function()
            local ok, res = httpGet(CFG.API_URL)
            local data = {}
            if ok and type(res) == "string" then local d = jdec(res); if type(d) == "table" then data = d end end
            if type(data.bans) ~= "table" then data.bans = {} end
            local already = false
            for _, b in ipairs(data.bans) do
                if type(b) == "table" and tostring(b.userId) == tostring(target.UserId) then already = true end
            end
            if not already then
                table.insert(data.bans, {
                    userId = tostring(target.UserId), name = target.Name,
                    reason = "Banned by " .. LP.Name, by = LP.Name, t = math.floor(os.time() * 1000),
                })
                local body = jenc(data); if body then httpPost(CFG.API_URL, body) end
            end
            bans = data.bans
        end)
        sendEvent("ban", target.UserId)
        notify("Banned " .. target.Name .. " from the script.", COL.bad); return
    end

    -- Set / remove nametag: edits the shared API endpoint so ALL clients see it
    if action == "settag" or action == "removetag" then
        local tUserId = tostring(target.UserId)
        local tName   = target.DisplayName or target.Name

        -- Helper: open a small in-game input dialog and call back with the text
        local function openTagDialog(cb)
            local pg2 = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") or LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
            local dlg = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
            dlg.Name = "PrismTagDialog"
            dlg.ResetOnSpawn = false
            dlg.IgnoreGuiInset = true
            dlg.DisplayOrder = 9999
            dlg.Parent = pg2

            local bg = Instance.new("Frame")
            bg.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
            bg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
            bg.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45
            bg.BorderSizePixel = 0
            bg.Parent = dlg

            local panel2 = Instance.new("Frame")
            panel2.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            panel2.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
            panel2.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(400, 260)
            panel2.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 14)
            panel2.BorderSizePixel = 0
            panel2.Parent = dlg
            local c2 = Instance.new("UICorner"); c2.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 18); c2.Parent = panel2
            local s2 = Instance.new("UIStroke"); s2.Color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 100, 200); s2.Thickness = 1.5; s2.Transparency = 0.3; s2.Parent = panel2

            local title2 = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            title2.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            title2.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 18)
            title2.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26)
            title2.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            title2.TextSize = 16
            title2.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            title2.Text = "Set Nametag for " .. tName
            title2.Parent = panel2

            local function field(y, hint)
                local box2 = Instance.new("TextBox")
                box2.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, y)
                box2.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 32)
                box2.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 20, 30)
                box2.BorderSizePixel = 0
                box2.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
                box2.TextSize = 13
                box2.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
                box2.PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 110, 130)
                box2.PlaceholderText = hint
                box2.Text = ""
                box2.ClearTextOnFocus = false
                box2.Parent = panel2
                local cf = Instance.new("UICorner"); cf.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8); cf.Parent = box2
                local sf = Instance.new("UIStroke"); sf.Color = Color3.fromRGB(100, 80, 160); sf.Thickness = 1; sf.Transparency = 0.5; sf.Parent = box2
                return box2
            end

            local nameBox2  = field(58,  "Display name  (e.g. " .. tName .. ")")
            local roleBox2  = field(100, "Role  (owner / admin / vip / none)")
            local colorBox2 = field(142, "Accent color hex  (e.g. #7060ff)")

            local saveBtn2 = Instance.new("TextButton")
            saveBtn2.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 190)
            saveBtn2.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(170, 36)
            saveBtn2.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 60, 180)
            saveBtn2.BorderSizePixel = 0
            saveBtn2.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            saveBtn2.TextSize = 14
            saveBtn2.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            saveBtn2.Text = "Save"
            saveBtn2.Parent = panel2
            local cs = Instance.new("UICorner"); cs.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10); cs.Parent = saveBtn2

            local cancelBtn2 = Instance.new("TextButton")
            cancelBtn2.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(210, 190)
            cancelBtn2.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(170, 36)
            cancelBtn2.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 38, 50)
            cancelBtn2.BorderSizePixel = 0
            cancelBtn2.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            cancelBtn2.TextSize = 14
            cancelBtn2.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 190, 210)
            cancelBtn2.Text = "Cancel"
            cancelBtn2.Parent = panel2
            local cc = Instance.new("UICorner"); cc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10); cc.Parent = cancelBtn2

            saveBtn2.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                local dname = nameBox2.Text ~= "" and nameBox2.Text or tName
                local role2  = roleBox2.Text  ~= "" and roleBox2.Text:lower() or "none"
                local hex2   = colorBox2.Text
                pcall(function() dlg:Destroy() end)
                cb(dname, role2, hex2)
            end)
            cancelBtn2.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                pcall(function() dlg:Destroy() end)
            end)
            bg.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                pcall(function() dlg:Destroy() end)
            end)
        end

        -- Helper: hex string -> Color3
        local function hexToColor(h)
            h = (h or ""):gsub("^#", "")
            if #h == 6 then
                local r = tonumber(h:sub(1,2), 16)
                local g2 = tonumber(h:sub(3,4), 16)
                local b2 = tonumber(h:sub(5,6), 16)
                if r and g2 and b2 then return Color3.fromRGB(r, g2, b2) end
            end
            return nil
        end

        if action == "removetag" then
            task.spawn(function()
                local ok, res = httpGet(CFG.API_URL)
                local data = {}
                if ok and type(res) == "string" then local d = jdec(res); if type(d) == "table" then data = d end end
                local list = data.nametags or data.data or {}
                if type(data.nametags) ~= "table" then data.nametags = {} end
                local newList = {}
                for _, t2 in ipairs(list) do
                    if type(t2) == "table" and tostring(t2.robloxId) ~= tUserId then
                        newList[#newList + 1] = t2
                    end
                end
                data.nametags = newList
                data.data = nil
                local body = jenc(data)
                if body then
                    httpPost(CFG.API_URL, body)
                    notify("Removed nametag for " .. target.Name .. ". Other players will see the change in ~10 s.", COL.good)
                    -- also update local cache immediately
                    if _G._PrismRefreshTags then
                        task.delay(0.5, function() pcall(_G._PrismRefreshTags) end)
                    end
                else
                    notify("Failed to remove nametag (encode error).", COL.bad)
                end
            end)
        else
            -- settag: show dialog then POST
            openTagDialog(function(dname, role2, hex2)
                task.spawn(function()
                    local col = hexToColor(hex2)
                    local colStr = col and string.format("#%02x%02x%02x",
                        math.floor(col.R * 255), math.floor(col.G * 255), math.floor(col.B * 255)) or "#7060ff"
                    local ok, res = httpGet(CFG.API_URL)
                    local data = {}
                    if ok and type(res) == "string" then local d = jdec(res); if type(d) == "table" then data = d end end
                    local list = type(data.nametags) == "table" and data.nametags
                              or (type(data.data) == "table" and data.data) or {}
                    -- remove existing entry for this user
                    local newList = {}
                    for _, t2 in ipairs(list) do
                        if type(t2) == "table" and tostring(t2.robloxId) ~= tUserId then
                            newList[#newList + 1] = t2
                        end
                    end
                    -- add the new entry
                    table.insert(newList, 1, {
                        robloxId       = tonumber(tUserId) or tUserId,
                        robloxUsername = target.Name,
                        displayName    = dname,
                        role           = role2,
                        accentColor    = colStr,
                        addedBy        = LP.Name,
                        addedAt        = math.floor(os.time() * 1000),
                    })
                    data.nametags = newList
                    data.data     = nil
                    local body = jenc(data)
                    if body then
                        httpPost(CFG.API_URL, body)
                        notify("Nametag set for " .. target.Name .. ". Others will see it in ~10 s.", COL.good)
                        -- refresh local cache immediately
                        if _G._PrismRefreshTags then
                            task.delay(0.5, function() pcall(_G._PrismRefreshTags) end)
                        end
                    else
                        notify("Failed to save nametag (encode error).", COL.bad)
                    end
                end)
            end)
        end
        return
    end

    sendEvent(action, target.UserId)
    notify(a.label .. " -> " .. target.Name)
end

--========================================================
-- Chat commands
--========================================================
local CMD_LEVEL = {
    reset = 0, r = 0, re = 0, die = 0, tp = 0,
    freeze = 0, unfreeze = 0, crucify = 0, uncrucify = 0, flash = 0,
    fling = 0, spin = 0, unspin = 0, flashbang = 0, ragdoll = 0, unragdoll = 0,
    kick = 1, ad = 1,
    ban = 2, crash = 2, kill = 2, explode = 2, launch = 2, invisible = 2, visible = 2,
    bring = 3, bringpause = 3, goto = 3, jumpscare = 3, freezeall = 3, unfreezeall = 3, kickall = 3,
}
local function editDistance(a, b)
    local la, lb = #a, #b
    if la == 0 then return lb end
    if lb == 0 then return la end
    local prev, cur = {}, {}
    for j = 0, lb do prev[j] = j end
    for i = 1, la do
        cur[0] = i
        for j = 1, lb do
            local cost = (a:byte(i) == b:byte(j)) and 0 or 1
            cur[j] = math.min(prev[j] + 1, cur[j - 1] + 1, prev[j - 1] + cost)
        end
        prev, cur = cur, prev
    end
    return prev[lb]
end

-- Finds the player whose name (or display name) is CLOSEST to what you typed:
-- exact > starts with > contains > nearest spelling. "me" / "self" = you.
-- strict = true skips the nearest-spelling step (used for plain chat).
local function findPlayer(name, strict)
    if not name or name == "" then return nil end
    local q = name:lower()
    if q == "me" or q == "self" or q == LP.Name:lower() or q == LP.DisplayName:lower() then return LP end
    local best, bestScore
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local score
        if tostring(p.UserId) == q then
            score = -1
        else
            for _, nm in ipairs({ p.Name:lower(), p.DisplayName:lower() }) do
                local sc
                if nm == q then sc = 0
                elseif nm:sub(1, #q) == q then sc = 1
                elseif nm:find(q, 1, true) then sc = 2
                elseif not strict then
                    local d = math.min(editDistance(q, nm), editDistance(q, nm:sub(1, #q)))
                    if d <= math.max(1, math.floor(#q / 2)) then sc = 10 + d end
                end
                if sc and (not score or sc < score) then score = sc end
            end
        end
        if score then
            if p == LP then score = score + 0.5 end      -- other players win ties
            if not bestScore or score < bestScore or (score == bestScore and #p.Name < #best.Name) then
                best, bestScore = p, score
            end
        end
    end
    return best
end

-- Reset YOUR OWN character (respawn). Works from the client by killing the
-- Humanoid, with a BreakJoints fallback for games that block Health changes.
local function doResetSelf()
    local char = LP.Character
    if not char then
        pcall(function() LP:LoadCharacter() end)
        return
    end
    -- The reanim death protection turns the Dead state off; release it, or
    -- nothing here can kill the character.  Prefer the instant path.
    local _genv = (typeof(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv()) or _G
    if type(_genv.PrismInstantReset) == "function" then
        local okIR = pcall(_genv.PrismInstantReset)
        if okIR then return end
    end
    pcall(function()
        if type(_genv.PrismReleaseDeathProtect) == "function" then
            _genv.PrismReleaseDeathProtect()
        end
    end)
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum then
        pcall(function()
            local mh = hum.MaxHealth
            if mh == math.huge or mh ~= mh or mh <= 0 then
                hum.MaxHealth = 100
            end
        end)
        pcall(function() hum.Health = 0 end)
        pcall(function() hum:TakeDamage(hum.MaxHealth) end)
    end
    task.delay(0.15, function()
        local c = LP.Character
        if c == char then
            local h = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if h and h.Health > 0 then
                pcall(function() c:BreakJoints() end)
            end
        end
    end)
end
local RESET_ALIASES = { r = true, re = true, reset = true, die = true }

-- commands that take no player (only usable with a . ! / prefix in chat)
local NO_TARGET = { freezeall = true, unfreezeall = true, kickall = true, help = true, cmds = true }

local function handleCommand(msg)
    if type(msg) ~= "string" then return end
    msg = (msg:gsub("^%s+", ""))
    local prefix = msg:sub(1, 1)
    local hasPrefix = (prefix == "." or prefix == "!" or prefix == "/")
    local body = hasPrefix and msg:sub(2) or msg
    local cmd, rest = body:match("^(%S+)%s*(.*)$")
    if not cmd then return end
    cmd = cmd:lower()
    if cmd == "blind" then cmd = "flashbang" end   -- old name
    rest = rest:match("^(%S+)") or ""          -- the player name is the first word

    -- Plain chat such as "crucify bob" also works, but only for player commands
    -- you are allowed to use and only when the name clearly matches someone.
    if not hasPrefix then
        local l = CMD_LEVEL[cmd]
        if not l or myLevel < l or rest == "" or NO_TARGET[cmd] or RESET_ALIASES[cmd] then return end
        if not findPlayer(rest, true) then return end
    end

    if cmd == "help" or cmd == "cmds" then
        local list = {}
        for k, lvl in pairs(CMD_LEVEL) do if myLevel >= lvl then list[#list + 1] = k end end
        table.sort(list)
        notify("Your commands (" .. (ROLE_LABEL[myRole] or "Member") .. "): ." .. table.concat(list, " ."), COL.accent)
        return
    end

    -- .r / .re / .reset / .die -> reset your own character
    if RESET_ALIASES[cmd] then
        doResetSelf()
        notify("Resetting your character...", COL.accent)
        if cmd == "re" then
            task.delay(1.6, function()
                local genv = (typeof(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv()) or _G
                pcall(function()
                    if type(genv.PrismReanim) == "function" then genv.PrismReanim()
                    elseif type(genv._PrismReanim) == "function" then genv._PrismReanim()
                    end
                end)
            end)
        end
        return
    end

    -- .tp <player> -> teleport yourself to that player
    if cmd == "tp" then
        local t = rest ~= "" and findPlayer(rest) or nil
        if not t then notify("Player not found: " .. tostring(rest), COL.warn); return end
        local myChar = LP.Character
        local tChar  = t.Character
        if not myChar or not tChar then notify("Character not loaded.", COL.warn); return end
        local hrp  = myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local thrp = tChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp or not thrp then notify("Cannot find character parts.", COL.warn); return end
        pcall(function() hrp.CFrame = thrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(3, 0, 0) end)
        notify("Teleported to " .. t.Name, COL.accent)
        return
    end

    -- .goto <player> at non-admin level -> personal teleport
    if cmd == "goto" and myLevel < 3 then
        local t = rest ~= "" and findPlayer(rest) or nil
        if not t then notify("Player not found: " .. tostring(rest), COL.warn); return end
        local myChar = LP.Character
        local tChar  = t.Character
        if not myChar or not tChar then notify("Character not loaded.", COL.warn); return end
        local hrp  = myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local thrp = tChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp or not thrp then notify("Cannot find character parts.", COL.warn); return end
        pcall(function() hrp.CFrame = thrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(3, 0, 0) end)
        notify("Goto " .. t.Name, COL.accent)
        return
    end

    local lvl = CMD_LEVEL[cmd]
    if not lvl then return end
    if myLevel < lvl then notify("Your role cannot use ." .. cmd .. ".", COL.warn); return end

    if CFG.OFFLINE and (cmd == "freezeall" or cmd == "unfreezeall" or cmd == "kickall") then
        notify("Offline mode: powers only affect you.", COL.warn); return
    end
    if cmd == "freezeall" then sendEvent("freeze", "*"); notify("Froze everyone."); return end
    if cmd == "unfreezeall" then sendEvent("unfreeze", "*"); notify("Unfroze everyone."); return end
    if cmd == "kickall" then sendEvent("kick", "*"); notify("Kicked everyone running the script.", COL.bad); return end

    local target = findPlayer(rest)
    if not target then notify("Player not found: " .. tostring(rest), COL.warn); return end
    runAction(cmd, target)
end

--========================================================
-- UI  (simple black & white)
--========================================================
local function roleTitle()
    if myRole == "owner" then return "OWNER PANEL"
    elseif myRole == "coowner" then return "CO-OWNER PANEL"
    elseif myRole == "admin" then return "ADMIN PANEL"
    elseif myRole == "moderator" then return "MODERATOR PANEL"
    elseif myRole == "support" then return "SUPPORT PANEL"
    elseif myRole == "dev" then return "DEVELOPER PANEL"
    else return "POWERS PANEL" end
end

local FONT = Enum.Font.Code

local function mk(class, props, parent)
    local o = Instance.new(class)
    for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
    o.Parent = parent
    return o
end

local function outline(o, thickness, col)
    return mk("UIStroke", {
        Color = col or COL.text, Thickness = thickness or 1,
        ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
    }, o)
end

local function tween(o, props)
    pcall(function() TweenService:Create(o, TweenInfo.new(0.1), props):Play() end)
end

-- black button, white text; inverts on hover
local function styleButton(b)
    b.BackgroundColor3 = COL.bg; b.TextColor3 = COL.text; b.BorderSizePixel = 0
    b.AutoButtonColor = false; b.Font = FONT; b.TextSize = 13
    outline(b)
    b.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tween(b, { BackgroundColor3 = COL.text, TextColor3 = COL.bg }) end)
    b.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween(b, { BackgroundColor3 = COL.bg, TextColor3 = COL.text }) end)
end

local function setToast(text)
    if toastLbl then toastLbl.Text = text end
end

local function updateStatus()
    if statusLbl then statusLbl.Text = selected and ("target: " .. (selected == LP and "You" or selected.Name)) or "target: none" end
    if roleBadgeLbl then roleBadgeLbl.Text = (ROLE_LABEL[myRole] or "Member") .. "  |  Lv " .. tostring(myLevel) end
end

-- Row buttons are pooled per-Player and reused across rebuilds (just moved/
-- recolored/re-texted) instead of being destroyed and recreated every time --
-- that destroy+recreate+reconnect churn, happening on every keystroke in the
-- search box and every 2s while the panel is open, was the main source of lag.
local rowPool = {}
local function rebuildList()
    if not listHolder then return end
    local term = (searchBox and searchBox.Text or ""):lower()
    local y = 0
    local plrs = { LP }
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LP then
            if CFG.OFFLINE then
                -- no event channel to prove presence with offline, so don't hide everyone
                plrs[#plrs + 1] = p
            else
                local ts = scriptPresence[tostring(p.UserId)]
                if ts and (os.clock() - ts) <= PRESENCE_TTL then plrs[#plrs + 1] = p end
            end
        end
    end
    -- Cross-server players: appeared in the event channel but aren't in THIS server.
    -- We reuse a STABLE virtual table per uid so that rowPool keys remain valid
    -- across every 2-second rebuildList() call and selection is preserved.
    if not CFG.OFFLINE then
        local localIds = { [tostring(LP.UserId)] = true }
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do localIds[tostring(p.UserId)] = true end
        local now = os.clock()
        -- Expire stale cross-server entries so their rowPool buttons get destroyed
        for uid, vp in pairs(crossPlayers) do
            local ts = scriptPresence[uid]
            if not ts or (now - ts) > PRESENCE_TTL or localIds[uid] then
                vp.Parent = nil  -- signals the cleanup loop below to destroy the button
                crossPlayers[uid] = nil
            end
        end
        -- Add or refresh active cross-server players
        for uid, ts in pairs(scriptPresence) do
            if not localIds[uid] and (now - ts) <= PRESENCE_TTL then
                local info = crossNames[uid] or {}
                local vp = crossPlayers[uid]
                if not vp then
                    vp = {
                        UserId      = tonumber(uid) or 0,
                        Name        = info.name or uid,
                        DisplayName = info.displayName or info.name or uid,
                        Character   = nil,
                        Parent      = Players,
                        _cross      = true,
                    }
                    crossPlayers[uid] = vp
                else
                    vp.Name        = info.name or uid
                    vp.DisplayName = info.displayName or info.name or uid
                end
                plrs[#plrs + 1] = vp
            end
        end
    end
    local shown = {}
    for _, p in ipairs(plrs) do
        local disp
        if p == LP then
            disp = "You"
        elseif p.DisplayName ~= "" and p.DisplayName ~= p.Name then
            disp = p.DisplayName .. "  @" .. p.Name
        else
            disp = p.Name
        end
        if p._cross then disp = "[CS]  " .. disp end  -- cross-server tag
        local show = term == ""
            or disp:lower():find(term, 1, true) ~= nil
            or p.Name:lower():find(term, 1, true) ~= nil
            or (p.DisplayName ~= "" and p.DisplayName:lower():find(term, 1, true) ~= nil)
            or tostring(p.UserId):find(term, 1, true) ~= nil
        if show then
            shown[p] = true
            local isSel = (selected == p)
            local b = rowPool[p]
            if not b then
                b = mk("TextButton", {
                    BorderSizePixel = 0, AutoButtonColor = false, Font = FONT, TextSize = 12,
                    TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                }, listHolder)
                b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                    selected = p; updateStatus(); rebuildList()
                end)
                rowPool[p] = b
            end
            b.Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 24)
            b.Position = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0, y)
            b.BackgroundColor3 = isSel and COL.text or COL.bg
            b.TextColor3 = isSel and COL.bg or COL.text
            b.Text = " " .. disp
            b.Visible = true
            y = y + 26
        end
    end
    -- players no longer shown (filtered out or search mismatch) get hidden;
    -- players who actually left the game get their pooled row destroyed
    for p, b in pairs(rowPool) do
        if not shown[p] then
            if p.Parent then
                b.Visible = false
            else
                pcall(function() b:Destroy() end)
                rowPool[p] = nil
            end
        end
    end
    listHolder.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, y)
end

-- Tears down any PrismDevPanel left behind by a previous execution, wherever
-- it ended up (gethui()/CoreGui/PlayerGui), so re-executing replaces the old
-- panel with the new one instead of leaving a stale copy sitting on top of
-- (or under) the fresh one.
local function destroyOldDevPanel()
    local containers = {}
    pcall(function() containers[#containers + 1] = gethui() end)
    pcall(function() containers[#containers + 1] = game:GetService("CoreGui") end)
    pcall(function() containers[#containers + 1] = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") end)
    for _, c in ipairs(containers) do
        if c then
            local old = c:FindFirstChild("PrismDevPanel")
            if old then pcall(function() old:Destroy() end) end
        end
    end
end

local function buildUI()
    if uiBuilt then return end
    uiBuilt = true
    if not selected then selected = LP end
    destroyOldDevPanel()

    -- ScreenGui: use the executor's hidden-GUI container when it has one,
    -- then CoreGui, then PlayerGui as the last resort.
    local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    gui.Name = "PrismDevPanel"; gui.ResetOnSpawn = false; gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    gui.DisplayOrder = 999999; gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
    pcall(function() if syn and syn.protect_gui then syn.protect_gui(gui) end end)
    pcall(function() gui.Parent = gethui() end)
    if not gui.Parent then pcall(function() gui.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui") end) end
    if not gui.Parent then gui.Parent = LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui") end

    local main = mk("Frame", {
        Name = "Main", Size = UDim2.fromOffset(560, 424),
        Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -280, 0.5, -212),
        BackgroundColor3 = COL.bg, BorderSizePixel = 0, Visible = false,
    }, gui)
    outline(main, 1)
    panel = main

    -- header (drag handle)
    local header = mk("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32), BackgroundColor3 = COL.text, BorderSizePixel = 0 }, main)
    local title = mk("TextLabel", {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 260, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = FONT, TextSize = 15, TextColor3 = COL.bg,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Text = roleTitle(),
    }, header)
    roleBadgeLbl = mk("TextLabel", {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -250, 0, 0),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = FONT, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = COL.bg,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, Text = "",
    }, header)
    local closeBtn = mk("TextButton", {
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 32), Position = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 0),
        BackgroundColor3 = COL.bg, TextColor3 = COL.text, BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Font = FONT, TextSize = 16, Text = "X", AutoButtonColor = false,
    }, header)

    local dragging, dragStart, startPos = false, nil, nil
    header.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true; dragStart = i.Position; startPos = main.Position
            i.Changed:Connect(function()
                if i.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end
            end)
        end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
        if dragging and (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            local d = i.Position - dragStart
            main.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + d.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
        end
    end)

    -- left column: search + player list + target
    searchBox = mk("TextBox", {
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(190, 26), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 40),
        BackgroundColor3 = COL.bg, TextColor3 = COL.text, PlaceholderText = "search players",
        PlaceholderColor3 = COL.text2, Text = "", ClearTextOnFocus = false,
        Font = FONT, TextSize = 12, BorderSizePixel = 0, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
    }, main)
    outline(searchBox)
    -- coalesce rapid keystrokes (typing fast) into a single rebuild per frame
    -- instead of rebuilding the whole list on every character
    local searchPending = false
    searchBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
        if searchPending then return end
        searchPending = true
        task.defer(function() searchPending = false; rebuildList() end)
    end)

    listHolder = mk("ScrollingFrame", {
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(190, 268), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 72),
        BackgroundColor3 = COL.bg, BorderSizePixel = 0, ScrollBarThickness = 3,
        ScrollBarImageColor3 = COL.text, CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
    }, main)
    outline(listHolder)

    statusLbl = mk("TextLabel", {
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(190, 18), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 344),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = FONT, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = COL.text2,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Text = "",
    }, main)

    -- right column: tabs
    local tabPowers = mk("TextButton", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(171, 26), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(206, 40), Text = "POWERS" }, main)
    local tabCmds   = mk("TextButton", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(171, 26), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(381, 40), Text = "COMMANDS" }, main)
    for _, t in ipairs({ tabPowers, tabCmds }) do
        t.BorderSizePixel = 0; t.AutoButtonColor = false; t.Font = FONT; t.TextSize = 13
        outline(t)
    end

    local function newPage()
        local p = mk("ScrollingFrame", {
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(346, 290), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(206, 72),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ScrollBarThickness = 3,
            ScrollBarImageColor3 = COL.text, CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
            AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Visible = false,
        }, main)
        mk("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 6), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, p)
        return p
    end
    local powersPage, cmdsPage = newPage(), newPage()

    local function showTab(which)
        local isP = (which == "powers")
        powersPage.Visible = isP; cmdsPage.Visible = not isP
        tabPowers.BackgroundColor3 = isP and COL.text or COL.bg
        tabPowers.TextColor3 = isP and COL.bg or COL.text
        tabCmds.BackgroundColor3 = isP and COL.bg or COL.text
        tabCmds.TextColor3 = isP and COL.text or COL.bg
    end
    tabPowers.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() showTab("powers") end)
    tabCmds.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() showTab("cmds") end)

    -- bottom: message line + command bar
    toastLbl = mk("TextLabel", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 18), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 366),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = FONT, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = COL.text2,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
        Text = "ready",
    }, main)
    local cmdBox = mk("TextBox", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -100, 0, 28), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 388),
        BackgroundColor3 = COL.bg, TextColor3 = COL.text, PlaceholderText = "command  e.g.  freeze me   |   kick Bob   |   flashbang me",
        PlaceholderColor3 = COL.text2, Text = "", ClearTextOnFocus = false,
        Font = FONT, TextSize = 13, BorderSizePixel = 0, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
    }, main)
    outline(cmdBox)
    local runBtn = mk("TextButton", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(76, 28), Position = UDim2.new(1, -84, 0, 388), Text = "RUN" }, main)
    styleButton(runBtn)
    styleButton(closeBtn); closeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = COL.bg

    local function runCommandLine()
        local text = (cmdBox.Text or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
        text = text:gsub("^[%.!/]", "")
        if text == "" then return end
        cmdBox.Text = ""
        setToast("> " .. text)
        handleCommand("." .. text)
    end
    runBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(runCommandLine)
    cmdBox.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter) if enter then runCommandLine() end end)

    -- Saved reset-pose animation ID (nil = disabled)
    local resetPoseAnimId = nil

    -- POWERS tab: rebuilt whenever the role/level changes
    local function buildPowers()
        for _, c in ipairs(powersPage:GetChildren()) do
            if not c:IsA("UIListLayout") then c:Destroy() end
        end
        local order = 0
        local function section(titleText, keys)
            local usable = {}
            for _, k in ipairs(keys) do
                if ACTIONS[k] and canUse(k) then usable[#usable + 1] = k end
            end
            if #usable == 0 then return end
            mk("TextLabel", {
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = FONT, TextSize = 12,
                TextColor3 = COL.text2, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                Text = "-- " .. titleText, LayoutOrder = order,
            }, powersPage)
            order = order + 1
            local grid = mk("Frame", {
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
                BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = order,
            }, powersPage)
            order = order + 1
            mk("UIGridLayout", {
                CellSize = UDim2.fromOffset(106, 28), CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6),
                SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
            }, grid)
            for _, k in ipairs(usable) do
                local b = mk("TextButton", { Text = ACTIONS[k].label }, grid)
                styleButton(b)
                b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                    setToast(ACTIONS[k].label .. " -> " .. (selected == LP and "You" or (selected and selected.Name or "no target")))
                    runAction(k, selected)
                end)
            end
        end
        for _, s in ipairs(POWER_SECTIONS) do section(s[1], s[2]) end
        -- self
        mk("TextLabel", {
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = FONT, TextSize = 12,
            TextColor3 = COL.text2, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            Text = "-- SELF", LayoutOrder = order,
        }, powersPage)
        order = order + 1
        local selfGrid = mk("Frame", {
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
            BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = order,
        }, powersPage)
        mk("UIGridLayout", { CellSize = UDim2.fromOffset(106, 28), CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6) }, selfGrid)
        local rb = mk("TextButton", { Text = "Reset" }, selfGrid)
        styleButton(rb)
        rb.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            setToast("Resetting your character...")
            local wasReanimated = State.isReanimated
            if wasReanimated then
                pcall(function() ReanimateAPI.reanimate(false) end)
                State.isReanimated = false
                UpdateToggleBtn()
            end
            doResetSelf()
            if wasReanimated or resetPoseAnimId then
                local respawnConn
                respawnConn = LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
                    respawnConn:Disconnect()
                    task.wait(0.5)
                    if wasReanimated then
                        pcall(function() ReanimateAPI.reanimate(true) end)
                        State.isReanimated = ReanimateAPI and ReanimateAPI.is_reanimated() or false
                        UpdateToggleBtn()
                    end
                    if resetPoseAnimId then
                        task.wait(0.1)
                        local poseTarget = (State.isReanimated and ReanimateAPI and ReanimateAPI.get_clone and ReanimateAPI.get_clone(LP)) or LP.Character
                        if poseTarget then
                            local poseHum = poseTarget:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                            if poseHum then
                                local a = Instance.new("Animation")
                                a.AnimationId = resetPoseAnimId
                                pcall(function()
                                    local track = poseHum:LoadAnimation(a)
                                    track:Play()
                                end)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
        end)
        -- Reset Pose section
        order = order + 1
        mk("TextLabel", {
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = FONT, TextSize = 11,
            TextColor3 = COL.text2, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            Text = "-- RESET POSE", LayoutOrder = order,
        }, powersPage)
        order = order + 1
        local poseRow = mk("Frame", {
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 28), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = order,
        }, powersPage)
        mk("UIListLayout", {
            FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
            Padding = UDim.new(0, 4),
            SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
        }, poseRow)
        local poseBox = mk("TextBox", {
            Size = UDim2.new(0, 148, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = COL.bg2,
            TextColor3 = COL.text, Font = FONT, TextSize = 12,
            PlaceholderText = "anim ID...", PlaceholderColor3 = COL.text2,
            BorderSizePixel = 0, ClearTextOnFocus = false,
            Text = (resetPoseAnimId and resetPoseAnimId:match("%d+$")) or "",
            LayoutOrder = 1,
        }, poseRow)
        outline(poseBox)
        local setPoseBtn = mk("TextButton", { Text = "Set", Size = UDim2.new(0, 42, 1, 0), LayoutOrder = 2 }, poseRow)
        styleButton(setPoseBtn)
        local clearPoseBtn = mk("TextButton", { Text = "Clear", Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 1, 0), LayoutOrder = 3 }, poseRow)
        styleButton(clearPoseBtn)
        setPoseBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            local raw = poseBox.Text:gsub("%s+", "")
            local num = raw:match("%d+$")
            if num then
                resetPoseAnimId = "rbxassetid://" .. num
                setToast("Reset pose set: " .. num)
            else
                setToast("Enter a valid animation ID")
            end
        end)
        clearPoseBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            resetPoseAnimId = nil
            poseBox.Text = ""
            setToast("Reset pose cleared")
        end)
        lastBuiltLevel = myLevel
    end

    -- COMMANDS tab: every command your role can use; click one to fill the command bar
    local function buildCommands()
        for _, c in ipairs(cmdsPage:GetChildren()) do
            if not c:IsA("UIListLayout") then c:Destroy() end
        end
        local n = 0
        for _, info in ipairs(CMD_INFO) do
            local lvl = CMD_LEVEL[info[1]] or 0
            if myLevel >= lvl then
                n = n + 1
                local row = mk("TextButton", {
                    Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 36), BackgroundColor3 = COL.bg, BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", LayoutOrder = n,
                }, cmdsPage)
                outline(row)
                mk("TextLabel", {
                    Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 18), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 2),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = FONT, TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = COL.text,
                    TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                    Text = "." .. info[1] .. (info[2] ~= "" and ("  " .. info[2]) or ""),
                }, row)
                mk("TextLabel", {
                    Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 14), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 20),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = FONT, TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = COL.text2,
                    TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Text = info[3],
                }, row)
                row.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tween(row, { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(38, 38, 38) }) end)
                row.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween(row, { BackgroundColor3 = COL.bg }) end)
                row.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                    cmdBox.Text = info[1] .. (info[2] ~= "" and " " or "")
                    cmdBox:CaptureFocus()
                end)
            end
        end
    end

    local function rebuildAll()
        buildPowers(); buildCommands()
        title.Text = roleTitle()
        updateStatus()
    end
    rebuildActions = rebuildAll
    rebuildAll()
    showTab("powers")
    rebuildList()

    -- no floating corner button anymore -- the panel only opens via the F5
    -- keybind (CFG.KEYBIND), and only for Staff and up (see setOpen below).
    local function setOpen(v)
        if v and not hasStaffAccess() then return end
        panelOpen = v; main.Visible = v
        if v then rebuildList(); updateStatus() end
    end
    closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() setOpen(false) end)
    uiSetOpen = setOpen

    -- These two connections live on the Players SERVICE, not on this panel's
    -- own GUI instance, so destroying the old panel on re-execute does NOT
    -- auto-disconnect them. Without the isCurrentGen() guard they'd pile up
    -- across re-executions the same way the while-loops below used to.
    local paConn, prConn
    paConn = Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function()
        if not isCurrentGen() then if paConn then paConn:Disconnect() end return end
        if panelOpen then rebuildList() end
    end)
    prConn = Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p)
        if not isCurrentGen() then if prConn then prConn:Disconnect() end return end
        if selected == p then selected = LP; updateStatus() end
        if panelOpen then task.defer(rebuildList) end
    end)

    task.spawn(function()
        while isCurrentGen() do
            task.wait(2)
            if not isCurrentGen() then return end
            if myLevel ~= lastBuiltLevel and rebuildActions then
                pcall(rebuildActions)
                setToast("role updated: " .. (ROLE_LABEL[myRole] or "Member") .. " (Lv " .. tostring(myLevel) .. ")")
            end
            -- the role poll can change access mid-session: if someone was demoted
            -- while the panel was open, close it on them
            pcall(function()
                local access = hasStaffAccess()
                if panelOpen and not access then setOpen(false) end
            end)
            if panelOpen then pcall(rebuildList); pcall(updateStatus) end
        end
    end)
end

local function togglePanel()
    if not hasStaffAccess() then return end
    if not uiBuilt then buildUI() end
    if uiSetOpen then uiSetOpen(not panelOpen) end
end

--========================================================
-- Boot
--========================================================
local function boot()
    -- Absorb whatever is already in the event channel BEFORE we start listening,
    -- so a re-execution never replays commands that fired in a previous run.
    pcall(pollEvents)
    fetchRole()
    -- If the very first role fetch failed (slow endpoint / cold executor),
    -- retry a few times so the panel opens with the correct powers already.
    for _ = 1, 4 do
        if myRole ~= "none" then break end
        task.wait(0.5)
        pcall(fetchRole)
    end
    fetchBans()
    if isBanned(LP.UserId) then
        notify("You are banned from this script.", COL.bad)
        task.wait(0.4)
        pcall(function() LP:Kick("Banned from Prism.") end)
        return
    end

    task.spawn(function() pcall(getFlashSoundId) end)   -- prepare the flashbang sound

    -- Build the UI and connect F5 for everyone. Non-staff are blocked inside
    -- togglePanel() (hasStaffAccess check) and setOpen() so the panel never
    -- actually opens for them, even if the role fetch was slow at boot.
    local okUI, errUI = pcall(buildUI)
    if not okUI then
        warn("[Prism] GUI failed to build: " .. tostring(errUI))
        notify("GUI failed to build: " .. tostring(errUI), COL.bad)
    end

    local keyConn
    keyConn = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
        if not isCurrentGen() then if keyConn then keyConn:Disconnect() end return end
        if gp then return end
        if input.KeyCode == CFG.KEYBIND then
            togglePanel()
        end
    end)
    local chatConn
    chatConn = LP.Chatted:Connect(function(msg)
        if not isCurrentGen() then if chatConn then chatConn:Disconnect() end return end
        handleCommand(msg)
    end)

    task.spawn(function()
        while isCurrentGen() do task.wait(CFG.POLL); if isCurrentGen() then pcall(pollEvents) end end
    end)
    task.spawn(function()
        while isCurrentGen() do
            task.wait(CFG.BAN_POLL)
            if not isCurrentGen() then return end
            pcall(fetchBans)
            if isBanned(LP.UserId) then
                notify("You have been banned from the script.", COL.bad)
                task.wait(0.4)
                pcall(function() LP:Kick("Banned from Prism.") end)
                return
            end
        end
    end)
    task.spawn(function()
        while isCurrentGen() do task.wait(CFG.ROLE_POLL); if isCurrentGen() then pcall(fetchRole) end end
    end)
    -- announce yourself on the shared event channel every few seconds so
    -- other clients' player-search lists know your script is actually running,
    -- even if no power has fired recently
    scriptPresence[tostring(LP.UserId)] = os.clock()
    task.spawn(function()
        while isCurrentGen() do
            task.wait(8)
            if not isCurrentGen() then return end
            scriptPresence[tostring(LP.UserId)] = os.clock()
            pcall(function() sendEvent("ping", "*") end)
        end
    end)

    local function setGlobal(k, v)
        local ok2 = pcall(function() getgenv()[k] = v end)
        if not ok2 then _G[k] = v end
    end
    setGlobal("PrismAdminOpen", togglePanel)
    setGlobal("PrismAdminAction", runAction)
    setGlobal("PrismAdminRole", function() return myRole end)

    -- Auto-spawn hotel at designated coordinates every time the script loads
    task.spawn(function()
        task.wait(1)
        local ok2, container = pcall(function()
            return game:GetService("InsertService"):LoadAsset(78522698529078)
        end)
        if ok2 and container then
            local model = container:FindFirstChildOfClass("Model") or container
            pcall(function()
                if model.PrimaryPart then
                    model:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(CFrame.new(-144, 3.90, 72259.72))
                else
                    model:MoveTo(Vector3.new(-144, 3.90, 72259.72))
                end
            end)
            model.Parent = workspace
        end
    end)

    if hasStaffAccess() then
        notify("Prism loaded. Role: " .. (ROLE_LABEL[myRole] or myRole) .. " (Lv " .. tostring(myLevel) .. ") -- press F5 for the panel.", COL.good)
    end
    log("booted. role=", myRole)
end

boot()

    end)
    if not ok then
        warn("[Vexora] module failed to start:", err)
    end
end)

--========================================================
--  PRISM  --  EMOTE HUB  (appended module)
--  Emotes / Anim Packs / Favourites / Binds / Settings.
--
--  Opened from the hub's Animations page ("Open Emote Hub").
--  It starts hidden and publishes getgenv().EmoteHubSetVisible(bool)
--  and getgenv().EmoteHubToggle().
--
--  PURE APPEND: nothing above this line was changed by this module.
--  The whole thing runs inside task.spawn + pcall, and every local it
--  declares is scoped to that function, so it can never collide with
--  Prism's own names or stop the main script from loading.
--========================================================
task.spawn(function()
    local ok, err = pcall(function()

--[[
    Emote Hub - standalone GUI version (v2)
    ---------------------------------------
    Tabs
      Emotes     - scrolling thumbnail grid, click to play
      Favorites  - everything you starred
      Anim Packs - animation packs; click one to apply it, click it again to reset.
                   Chips at the bottom (All / Idle / Walk / Run / Jump / Fall) choose
                   whether a click applies the whole pack or just that part
      Binds      - keybinds you saved for emotes / packs

    How to make a keybind
      Press the small BIND button on any card (or right-click the card),
      then press the key you want. Esc cancels. Press the key in-game to run it.
      Pressing a bound emote's key again while it plays stops it.
      Reserved keys: W A S D Space Tab /

    Performance
      * Cards are pooled and reused as you scroll
      * The grid is virtualised: only the rows on screen exist, however long the list
      * Scrolling and resizing only touch the few cards on screen
      * Pack data is cached to disk after the first time you use a pack

    Emote / animation lists come from the same JSON sources as the original script.
    Emotes use Humanoid:PlayEmoteAndGetAnimTrackById, so they need an R15 character.
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local UIX = {} -- holds many helpers/widgets (Luau allows only 200 locals per chunk)

local env = (typeof(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv()) or _G
-- Re-executing unloads the previous copy first: it resets animations, walk speed,
-- noclip, antifling and head movement to normal, stops emotes, and removes the old GUI.
if type(env.EmoteHubCleanup) == "function" then
    pcall(env.EmoteHubCleanup)
    env.EmoteHubCleanup = nil
end
if env.EmoteHubGui then
    pcall(function() env.EmoteHubGui:Destroy() end)
    env.EmoteHubGui = nil
end
-- sweep for any leftover window from an older copy that can't clean itself up
pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("EmoteHubStillHead") end)
for _, getRoot in ipairs({
    function() return typeof(gethui) == "function" and gethui() or nil end,
    function() return game:GetService("CoreGui") end,
    function() return LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") end,
}) do
    pcall(function()
        local root = getRoot()
        local old = root and root:FindFirstChild("EmoteHubGUI")
        while old do
            old:Destroy()
            old = root:FindFirstChild("EmoteHubGUI")
        end
    end)
end
