updateChips()
do
    local startTab = saved.tab
    if startTab ~= "Emotes" and startTab ~= "Favorites" and startTab ~= "Packs" and startTab ~= "Binds" and startTab ~= "Settings" then
        startTab = "Emotes"
    end
    setTab(startTab)
end

-- Emote and anim pack lists are saved to the workspace (EmoteHub/EmoteList.json and
-- PackList.json) the first time they download. After that they load straight from
-- disk (works offline) and the script only refreshes them in the background.
function UIX.toEmoteItems(list)
    local out, n = {}, 0
    for _, item in pairs(list) do
        local id = tonumber(item.id or item[1])
        if id and id > 0 then
            local name = item.name or item[2]
            n = n + 1
            out[n] = decorate({
                kind = "emote",
                id = id,
                name = tostring(name or ("Emote_" .. id)),
            })
        end
    end
    return out
end

task.spawn(function()
    setStatus("Loading emotes...", true)
    local haveSaved = false

    if type(_G._PrismEmoteHub) == "table" and #_G._PrismEmoteHub > 100 then
        local items = UIX.toEmoteItems(_G._PrismEmoteHub)
        if #items > 0 then
            state.emotes = items
            state.loadingEmotes = false
            if gui.Parent and state.tab == "Emotes" then render() end
            setStatus(("Loaded %d emotes"):format(#items))
            return
        end
    end

    local saved = readJson(UIX.EMOTELIST_FILE)
    if saved then
        local items = UIX.toEmoteItems(saved)
        if #items > 0 then
            haveSaved = true
            state.emotes = items
            state.loadingEmotes = false
            if gui.Parent and state.tab == "Emotes" then render() end
            setStatus(("Loaded %d emotes from your saved copy"):format(#items))
        end
    end

    local list = UIX.fetchList(UIX.EMOTE_URL)
    if list then
        local fresh = UIX.toEmoteItems(list)
        if #fresh > 0 then
            local changed = (not haveSaved) or #fresh ~= #state.emotes
            if changed then
                state.emotes = fresh
                state.loadingEmotes = false
                if gui.Parent and state.tab == "Emotes" then render() end
                local packed = {}
                for i, e in ipairs(fresh) do packed[i] = { e.id, e.name } end
                writeJson(UIX.EMOTELIST_FILE, packed)
            end
            setStatus(("Loaded %d emotes"):format(#fresh))
        end
    end

    if #state.emotes == 0 then
        state.emotes = {
            decorate({ kind = "emote", id = 3360686498, name = "Stadium" }),
            decorate({ kind = "emote", id = 3360692915, name = "Tilt" }),
            decorate({ kind = "emote", id = 3576968026, name = "Shrug" }),
            decorate({ kind = "emote", id = 3360689775, name = "Salute" }),
        }
        setStatus("Offline - showing a few default emotes")
    end
    state.loadingEmotes = false
    if gui.Parent and state.tab == "Emotes" and not haveSaved then render() end
end)

function UIX.toPackItems(list, seen, out)
    local n = 0
    for _, item in pairs(list) do
        local id = tonumber(item.id)
        if id and id > 0 and not seen[id] and item.bundledItems then
            seen[id] = true
            table.insert(out, decorate({
                kind = "pack",
                id = id,
                name = tostring(item.name or ("Animation_" .. id)),
                bundledItems = item.bundledItems,
            }))
            n = n + 1
            if n % 2000 == 0 then task.wait() end
        end
    end
end

task.spawn(function()
    local haveSaved = false

    local saved = readJson(UIX.PACKLIST_FILE)
    if saved then
        local items = {}
        UIX.toPackItems(saved, {}, items)
        if #items > 0 then
            haveSaved = true
            state.packs = items
            refreshChipLabels()
            state.loadingPacks = false
            if gui.Parent and state.tab == "Packs" then render() end
        end
    end

    local packs, seen = {}, {}
    for _, url in ipairs(UIX.PACK_URLS) do
        local list = UIX.fetchList(url)
        if list then UIX.toPackItems(list, seen, packs) end
    end

    if #packs > 0 and ((not haveSaved) or #packs ~= #state.packs) then
        state.packs = packs
        refreshChipLabels()
        state.loadingPacks = false
        if gui.Parent and state.tab == "Packs" then render() end
        local out = {}
        for i, pk in ipairs(packs) do
            out[i] = { id = pk.id, name = pk.name, bundledItems = pk.bundledItems }
        end
        writeJson(UIX.PACKLIST_FILE, out)
    end

    state.loadingPacks = false
    if gui.Parent and state.tab == "Packs" and not haveSaved then render() end
end)

    end)
    if not ok then
        warn("[Prism Emote Hub] module failed to start:", err)
    end
end)

--========================================================
--  Halloween extras: music-reactive sky, dragon
--  copies where you look, rewind ghost on B.
--========================================================
task.spawn(function()
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
    local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
    local plr = Players.LocalPlayer
    local pg = plr:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 20)
    if not pg then return end


    pcall(function() UIS.MouseIconEnabled = true end)
    local extrasGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    extrasGui.Name = "PrismExtras"
    extrasGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    extrasGui.DisplayOrder = 6
    extrasGui.Parent = pg

    local toast = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    toast.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
    toast.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -28)
    toast.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(280, 28)
    toast.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 8, 12)
    toast.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
    toast.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 176, 90)
    toast.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    toast.TextSize = 14
    toast.Text = ""
    toast.Visible = false
    toast.Parent = extrasGui
    local toastCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    toastCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
    toastCorner.Parent = toast

    local function say(msg)
        toast.Text = msg
        toast.Visible = true
        task.delay(1.6, function()
            if toast.Text == msg then toast.Visible = false end
        end)
    end

    local history = {}
    local rewinding = false
    local lastSample = 0

    local function rootOf()
        local char = plr.Character
        return char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    end

    local function ghostOf(cf)
        local char = plr.Character
        if not char then return end
        local ok, model = pcall(function() return char:Clone() end)
        if not ok or not model then return end
        model.Name = "PrismRewindGhost"
        for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("Script") or d:IsA("LocalScript") or d:IsA("Humanoid") then
                pcall(function() d:Destroy() end)
            elseif d:IsA("BasePart") then
                d.Anchored = true
                d.CanCollide = false
                d.Transparency = math.clamp(d.Transparency + 0.45, 0.45, 0.85)
                d.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 40)
            elseif d:IsA("Decal") or d:IsA("Texture") then
                d.Transparency = 0.55
            end
        end
        pcall(function() model:PivotTo(cf) end)
        model.Parent = workspace
        task.delay(1.2, function()
            pcall(function() model:Destroy() end)
        end)
    end

    UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
        if processed then return end
        if input.KeyCode ~= Enum.KeyCode.B then return end
        if rewinding or #history < 4 then
            say("Not enough path yet")
            return
        end
        rewinding = true
        local startCf = history[#history]
        ghostOf(startCf)
        _G._PrismRewind = (_G._PrismRewind or 0) + 3
        local from = rootOf()
        local goal = history[math.max(1, #history - 18)]
        local steps = 10
        for i = 1, steps do
            local hrp = rootOf()
            if hrp and goal then
                hrp.CFrame = hrp.CFrame:Lerp(goal, i / steps)
                hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            end
            task.wait(0.03)
        end
        history = {}
        rewinding = false
        say("Rewound")
    end)

    local loudCache = 0
    local function sampleLoud()
        local best = 0
        local function consider(inst)
            if inst:IsA("Sound") and inst.IsPlaying then
                local l = inst.PlaybackLoudness or 0
                if l > best then best = l end
            end
        end
        pcall(function()
            for _, d in ipairs(game:GetService("SoundService"):GetDescendants()) do
                consider(d)
            end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            for _, d in ipairs(pg:GetDescendants()) do
                consider(d)
            end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            local char = plr.Character
            if char then
                for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                    consider(d)
                end
            end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            local named = workspace:FindFirstChild("PrismNametagMusic", true)
            if named then consider(named) end
        end)
        loudCache = best
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        while extrasGui.Parent do
            sampleLoud()
            task.wait(0.12)
        end
    end)

    local base = {}
    local punch = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
    punch.Name = "PrismBeatPunch"
    punch.Enabled = true
    punch.Parent = Lighting

    local function captureSky()
        base.gen = _G._PrismSkyGen or 0
        base.bright = Lighting.Brightness
        base.exp = Lighting.ExposureCompensation
        base.fog = Lighting.FogColor
        base.out = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient
        local bloom = Lighting:FindFirstChild("PrismSkyBloom")
        base.bloom = bloom and bloom:IsA("BloomEffect") and bloom.Intensity or nil
        local grade = Lighting:FindFirstChild("PrismSkyGrade")
        if grade and grade:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") then
            base.contrast = grade.Contrast
            base.sat = grade.Saturation
            base.gbright = grade.Brightness
        else
            base.contrast, base.sat, base.gbright = nil, nil, nil
        end
        local atmo = Lighting:FindFirstChild("PrismAtmo")
        base.haze = atmo and atmo:IsA("Atmosphere") and atmo.Haze or nil
        base.density = atmo and atmo:IsA("Atmosphere") and atmo.Density or nil
        local rays = Lighting:FindFirstChild("PrismSkyRays")
        base.rays = rays and rays:IsA("SunRaysEffect") and rays.Intensity or nil
    end

    local function pulseSky(beat)
        beat = math.clamp(beat or 0, 0, 1)
        local hit = _G._PrismHit or 0
        if base.gen ~= (_G._PrismSkyGen or 0) or base.bright == nil then
            captureSky()
        end
        local kick = math.clamp(beat * beat + hit * 0.85, 0, 1)
        local flash = (_G._PrismColorAt and _G._PrismColorAt(os.clock() * 1.3)) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 80)
        local flash2 = (_G._PrismColorAt and _G._PrismColorAt(os.clock() * 1.3 + 2.1)) or flash
        punch.Brightness = kick * 0.85 + hit * 0.4
        punch.Contrast = beat * 0.42 + hit * 0.2
        punch.Saturation = beat * 0.7
        punch.TintColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255):Lerp(flash, math.clamp(0.2 + beat * 0.7, 0, 0.92))
        Lighting.Brightness = (base.bright or 2) + beat * 3.4 + hit * 2
        Lighting.ExposureCompensation = (base.exp or 0) + kick * 1.35
        if base.fog then
            Lighting.FogColor = base.fog:Lerp(flash2, math.clamp(beat * 0.72, 0, 1))
        end
        if base.out then
            Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = base.out:Lerp(flash, math.clamp(beat * 0.6, 0, 1))
        end
        local bloom = Lighting:FindFirstChild("PrismSkyBloom")
        if bloom and bloom:IsA("BloomEffect") and base.bloom then
            bloom.Intensity = base.bloom * (1 + beat * 4.2 + hit * 2)
            bloom.Size = 24 + kick * 40
            bloom.Threshold = math.clamp(0.8 - beat * 0.4, 0.25, 1)
        end
        local grade = Lighting:FindFirstChild("PrismSkyGrade")
        if grade and grade:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") and base.contrast then
            grade.Contrast = base.contrast + beat * 0.28
            grade.Saturation = base.sat + beat * 0.45
            grade.Brightness = (base.gbright or 0) + kick * 0.22
            grade.TintColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1):Lerp(flash, 0.12 + beat * 0.4)
        end
        local atmo = Lighting:FindFirstChild("PrismAtmo")
        if atmo and atmo:IsA("Atmosphere") and base.haze then
            atmo.Haze = math.clamp(base.haze * (1 + beat * 1.8), 0, 8)
            atmo.Glare = math.clamp(0.1 + kick * 0.7, 0, 1)
            if base.density then
                atmo.Density = math.clamp(base.density + kick * 0.12, 0, 0.85)
            end
        end
        local rays = Lighting:FindFirstChild("PrismSkyRays")
        if rays and rays:IsA("SunRaysEffect") and base.rays then
            rays.Intensity = math.clamp(base.rays * (1 + beat * 2.4) + hit * 0.3, 0, 1)
        end
    end

    _G._PrismCopyDance = function(e, cf)
        if not e or not e.model or not cf then return end
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not cam then return end
        local look = cam.CFrame.LookVector
        local head = e.head
        if not (head and head.Parent) then
            head = e.model:FindFirstChild("Head", true)
        end
        if head and head:IsA("BasePart") and head.Size.Magnitude < 18 then
            local face = cf.LookVector
            local yaw = math.clamp(math.atan2(look.X, look.Z) - math.atan2(face.X, face.Z), -0.7, 0.7)
            local pitch = math.clamp(-look.Y, -0.45, 0.45)
            head.CFrame = head.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(pitch, yaw * 0.65, 0)
        end
        local hum = plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local tracks = {}
        pcall(function()
            local animator = hum and hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
            if animator then tracks = animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks() end
        end)
        local energy = 0
        for _, tr in ipairs(tracks) do
            local n = string.lower(tr.Name or "")
            if tr.IsPlaying and tr.WeightCurrent > 0.4 and not string.find(n, "idle", 1, true) then
                energy = math.max(energy, tr.WeightCurrent)
            end
        end
        if energy > 0 then
            _G._PrismBeat = math.max(_G._PrismBeat or 0, 0.45 + energy * 0.4)
        end
    end

    local function dressMenu()
        local hub = pg:FindFirstChild("PrismHub")
        if not hub then return end
        if hub:FindFirstChild("HallowBats") then return end
        local holder = Instance.new("Folder")
        holder.Name = "HallowBats"
        holder.Parent = hub
        local side = nil
        for _, d in ipairs(hub:GetDescendants()) do
            if d.Name == "Side" and d:IsA("Frame") then side = d break end
        end
        if not side then return end
        for i = 1, 3 do
            local bat = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            bat.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            bat.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 22)
            bat.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8 + i * 6, 1, -40 - i * 18)
            bat.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            bat.TextSize = 16
            bat.Text = ">"
            bat.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 60)
            bat.ZIndex = 8
            bat.Parent = side
            task.spawn(function()
                while bat.Parent do
                    local y = -30 - i * 16 + math.sin(os.clock() * (1.2 + i * 0.2) + i) * 10
                    bat.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10 + (i % 2) * 18, 1, y)
                    task.wait(0.05)
                end
            end)
        end
    end

    RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
        dt = dt or 0.016
        local beat = (_G._PrismSampleSongBeat and _G._PrismSampleSongBeat()) or (_G._PrismBeat or 0)
        if not _G._PrismSongOn then
            beat = beat * 0.82
            _G._PrismBeat = beat
        end


        local hit = _G._PrismHit or 0
        local yaw = ((_G._PrismSkyYaw or 0) + dt * (0.25 + hit * 36)) % 360
        _G._PrismSkyYaw = yaw
        local pitch = hit * 6
        local roll = hit * 4
        local nowSky = os.clock()
        if not _G._PrismSkyCache or nowSky - (_G._PrismSkyCacheAt or 0) > 1 then
            local list = {}
            for _, o in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
                if o:IsA("Sky") then list[#list + 1] = o end
            end
            _G._PrismSkyCache = list
            _G._PrismSkyCacheAt = nowSky
        end
        for _, sky in ipairs(_G._PrismSkyCache) do
            if sky.Parent then
                sky.SkyboxOrientation = Vector3.new(pitch, yaw, roll)
                local baseSun = sky:GetAttribute("PrismSunBase")
                if baseSun == nil then
                    sky:SetAttribute("PrismSunBase", sky.SunAngularSize)
                    baseSun = sky.SunAngularSize
                end
                sky.SunAngularSize = math.clamp((baseSun or 11) * (1 + beat * 1.6), 0, 21)
            end
        end
        if _G._PrismSongOn or beat > 0.02 then
            pcall(pulseSky, beat)
        end

        local now = os.clock()
        if not rewinding and now - lastSample > 0.1 then
            lastSample = now
            local hrp = rootOf()
            if hrp then
                history[#history + 1] = hrp.CFrame
                if #history > 40 then table.remove(history, 1) end
            end
        end
        if now % 1 < 0.05 then dressMenu() end
    end)

    task.delay(1.5, dressMenu)
end)


--========================================================
--  Smooth look + motion blur + dark chat bubbles
--  Motion blur is only on while the camera is actually moving.
--========================================================
task.spawn(function()
    local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local TextChat = game:GetService("TextChatService")
    local Chat = game:GetService("Chat")
    local TextService = game:GetService("TextService")
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

    if typeof(rawget(_G, "PrismBubbleColor")) ~= "Color3" then
        _G.PrismBubbleColor = Color3.fromRGB(186, 42, 58)
    end
    _G.PrismMotionBlur = false
    pcall(function()
        local old = Lighting:FindFirstChild("PrismMotion")
        if old then old:Destroy() end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        settings().Rendering.EnableFRM = true
    end)
    pcall(function()
        if type(_G.PrismSetFPSCap) == "function" then
            _G.PrismSetFPSCap(0)
        end
    end)

    pcall(function() Chat.BubbleChatEnabled = false end)
    pcall(function()
        if TextChat.BubbleChatConfiguration then
            TextChat.BubbleChatConfiguration.Enabled = false
        end
    end)

    local stacks = {}
    local recent = {}
    local live = {}
    -- one shared loop animates every live bubble: the border highlight runs around the edge, the glow pulses
    local acc = 0
    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        if #live == 0 then return end
        acc = acc + dt
        if acc < 1 / 30 then return end
        acc = 0
        local t = os.clock()
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local camPos = cam and cam.CFrame.Position
        for i = #live, 1, -1 do
            local it = live[i]
            if not it.frame.Parent then
                table.remove(live, i)
            elseif it.grad and it.newest and not it.fading then
                local near = true
                if camPos and it.head and it.head.Parent then
                    near = (it.head.Position - camPos).Magnitude < 90
                end
                if near then it.grad.Rotation = (t * 120 + it.phase) % 360 end
            end
        end
    end)

    local function hideDefault()
        pcall(function() Chat.BubbleChatEnabled = false end)
        pcall(function()
            if TextChat.BubbleChatConfiguration then
                TextChat.BubbleChatConfiguration.Enabled = false
            end
        end)
    end

    local function layout(stack)
        local y = 0
        local n = #stack.items
        for i = n, 1, -1 do
            local it = stack.items[i]
            if it.frame.Parent then
                y = y + it.h
                local pos = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -y)
                if it.placed then
                    TweenService:Create(it.frame, TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Position = pos }):Play()
                    if it.sc and not it.fading and i ~= n then
                        TweenService:Create(it.sc, TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 0.92 }):Play()
                    end
                else
                    it.frame.Position = pos
                    it.placed = true
                end
                it.newest = (i == n)
                y = y + 4
            end
        end
    end

    local function showBubble(player, text)
        if typeof(player) ~= "Instance" or not player:IsA("Player") then return end
        if type(text) ~= "string" then return end
        text = text:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
        if text == "" or #text > 180 then return end
        local head3 = text:sub(1, 3)
        if text:sub(1, 1) == "/" or head3 == "pcS" or head3 == "pcY" or head3 == "pcX" or head3 == "pcB" then return end
        local key = tostring(player.UserId) .. "\0" .. text
        local now = os.clock()
        if recent[key] and now - recent[key] < 0.35 then return end
        recent[key] = now

        local char = player.Character
        local head = char and (char:FindFirstChild("Head") or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
        if not head then return end

        local accent = _G.PrismBubbleColor
        if typeof(accent) ~= "Color3" then
            accent = Color3.fromRGB(186, 42, 58)
        end
        local who = player.DisplayName
        if type(who) ~= "string" or who == "" then
            who = player.Name
        end

        local stack = stacks[player]
        if not stack or not stack.gui.Parent then
            local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
            bb.Name = "PrismBubbles"
            bb.AlwaysOnTop = false
            bb.LightInfluence = 0
            bb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(320, 230)
            bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 6.7, 0)
            bb.MaxDistance = 170
            bb.ResetOnSpawn = false
            bb.Adornee = head
            bb.Parent = head
            stack = { gui = bb, items = {} }
            stacks[player] = stack
        end
        stack.gui.Adornee = head

        local bodySize = TextService:GetTextSize(text, 15, Enum.Font.GothamMedium, Vector2.new(210, 150))
        local nameSize = TextService:GetTextSize(string.upper(who), 9, Enum.Font.Michroma, Vector2.new(260, 20))
        local w = math.clamp(math.max(bodySize.X, nameSize.X + 16) + 74, 128, 300)
        local h = math.clamp(bodySize.Y + 40, 58, 132)

        while #stack.items >= 3 do
            local old = table.remove(stack.items, 1)
            if old and old.frame then old.frame:Destroy() end
        end

        local WHITE, BLACK = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
        local fades = {}
        local function track(obj, prop, final)
            fades[#fades + 1] = { obj, prop, final }
        end
        local function mk(class, parent, props)
            local o = Instance.new(class)
            for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
            o.Parent = parent
            return o
        end

        -- body: dark glass
        local frame = mk("Frame", stack.gui, {
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 0.58,
            BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h),
        })
        mk("UICorner", frame, { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10) })
        mk("UIGradient", frame, { Rotation = 90, Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 38), Color3.fromRGB(6, 6, 9)) })
        track(frame, "BackgroundTransparency", 0.58)

        -- glow underlay (pulses)
        local glow = mk("UIStroke", frame, { ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border, Color = accent, Thickness = 5, Transparency = 0.76 })
        track(glow, "Transparency", 0.76)

        -- border: a bright segment runs around the edge
        local stroke = mk("UIStroke", frame, { ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border, Color = WHITE, Thickness = 1.6, Transparency = 0 })
        local sgrad = mk("UIGradient", stroke, {})
        track(stroke, "Transparency", 0)

        -- glass sheen on the top half
        local sheen = mk("Frame", frame, { BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0), ZIndex = 2 })
        mk("UICorner", sheen, { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10) })
        mk("UIGradient", sheen, { Rotation = 90, Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.9), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) }) })
        track(sheen, "BackgroundTransparency", 0)

        -- avatar with an accent ring
        local avSize = 34
        local av = mk("ImageLabel", frame, {
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 24), BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, math.floor((h - avSize) / 2)), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(avSize, avSize),
            Image = "rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id=" .. tostring(player.UserId) .. "&w=150&h=150", ZIndex = 3,
        })
        mk("UICorner", av, { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) })
        local ring = mk("UIStroke", av, { Color = accent, Thickness = 1.5, Transparency = 0.1 })
        track(av, "ImageTransparency", 0)
        track(av, "BackgroundTransparency", 0)
        track(ring, "Transparency", 0.1)

        local name = mk("TextLabel", frame, {
            BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(52, 8), Size = UDim2.new(1, -62, 0, 12),
            Font = Enum.Font.Michroma, TextSize = 10, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextColor3 = accent, Text = string.upper(who), ZIndex = 3,
        })
        track(name, "TextTransparency", 0)
        local label = mk("TextLabel", frame, {
            BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(52, 22), Size = UDim2.new(1, -64, 1, -34),
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextSize = 15, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(244, 246, 250),
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
            TextWrapped = true, Text = text, ZIndex = 3, TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), TextStrokeTransparency = 0.6,
        })
        track(label, "TextTransparency", 0)

        -- time-left bar along the bottom
        local barHolder = mk("Frame", frame, {
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1), BackgroundColor3 = accent, BackgroundTransparency = 0.86,
            BorderSizePixel = 0, Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 1, -5), Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 2), ZIndex = 3,
        })
        mk("UICorner", barHolder, { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) })
        local bar = mk("Frame", barHolder, { BackgroundColor3 = accent, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), ZIndex = 4 })
        mk("UICorner", bar, { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) })
        track(barHolder, "BackgroundTransparency", 0.86)
        track(bar, "BackgroundTransparency", 0)

        -- corner marks, same language as the menus
        local marks = {}
        local function mark(ax, ay, px, py, mw, mh)
            local m = mk("Frame", frame, {
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay), Position = UDim2.new(px, ax == 0 and 5 or -5, py, ay == 0 and 5 or -5),
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(mw, mh), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 0.45,
                BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 4,
            })
            marks[#marks + 1] = m
            track(m, "BackgroundTransparency", 0.45)
        end
        mark(1, 0, 1, 0, 9, 1); mark(1, 0, 1, 0, 1, 9)
        mark(0, 1, 0, 1, 9, 1); mark(0, 1, 0, 1, 1, 9)

        -- tail
        local tail = mk("Frame", frame, {
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8, 8, 11), BackgroundTransparency = 0.58, BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -1), Rotation = 45, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12), ZIndex = 0,
        })
        local tailStroke = mk("UIStroke", tail, { Color = accent, Thickness = 1.2, Transparency = 0.08 })
        track(tail, "BackgroundTransparency", 0.58)
        track(tailStroke, "Transparency", 0.08)

        -- one light sweep across the glass when it appears
        local sweep = mk("Frame", frame, { BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), ZIndex = 5 })
        mk("UICorner", sweep, { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10) })
        local sweepG = mk("UIGradient", sweep, {
            Rotation = 20, Offset = Vector2.new(-1, 0),
            Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.42, 1),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.55), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.58, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
            }),
        })

        local function paint(c)
            local light = c:Lerp(WHITE, 0.75)
            local dim = c:Lerp(BLACK, 0.55)
            sgrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, c), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.2, light),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.4, c), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.7, dim), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, c),
            })
            glow.Color = c
            ring.Color = c
            name.TextColor3 = c
            barHolder.BackgroundColor3 = c
            bar.BackgroundColor3 = c
            tailStroke.Color = c
        end
        paint(accent)

        -- time on screen follows how long the message takes to read
        local life = math.clamp(2.6 + #text * 0.055, 3.6, 10)
        -- ALL CAPS or "!!" counts as shouting: bigger pop, brighter text and glow
        local letters = string.gsub(text, "[^%a]", "")
        local upper = string.gsub(letters, "[^%u]", "")
        local shout = (#letters >= 4 and #upper >= #letters * 0.7) or string.find(text, "!!", 1, true) ~= nil
        if shout then
            label.TextColor3 = accent:Lerp(WHITE, 0.6)
            glow.Thickness = 8
            glow.Transparency = 0.6
        end
        local sc = mk("UIScale", frame, { Scale = shout and 0.4 or 0.55 })
        frame.Rotation = -3
        local item = {
            frame = frame, h = h + 8, stroke = stroke, glow = glow,
            bar = bar, name = name, tail = tail, tailStroke = tailStroke, label = label,
            grad = sgrad, phase = math.random() * 360, recolor = paint, fading = false,
            head = head, sc = sc, placed = false, newest = true,
        }
        stack.items[#stack.items + 1] = item
        live[#live + 1] = item
        layout(stack)

        -- appear
        local function fade(toHidden, info)
            for _, t in ipairs(fades) do
                local goal = toHidden and 1 or t[3]
                if info then
                    TweenService:Create(t[1], info, { [t[2]] = goal }):Play()
                else
                    t[1][t[2]] = goal
                end
            end
        end
        fade(true)
        fade(false, TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out))
        if shout then
            TweenService:Create(sc, TweenInfo.new(0.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Elastic, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1 }):Play()
        else
            TweenService:Create(sc, TweenInfo.new(0.36, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1 }):Play()
        end
        TweenService:Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Rotation = 0 }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(sweepG, TweenInfo.new(0.8, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Offset = Vector2.new(1, 0) }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(bar, TweenInfo.new(life, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), { Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0) }):Play()
        task.delay(0.9, function() if sweep.Parent then sweep:Destroy() end end)

        -- text types in
        task.spawn(function()
            local n = utf8.len(text) or #text
            pcall(function() label.MaxVisibleGraphemes = 0 end)
            local dur = math.clamp(n * 0.016, 0.15, 0.85)
            local t0 = os.clock()
            while label.Parent do
                local a = math.clamp((os.clock() - t0) / dur, 0, 1)
                pcall(function() label.MaxVisibleGraphemes = math.floor(n * a + 0.5) end)
                if a >= 1 then break end
                RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
            end
            pcall(function() label.MaxVisibleGraphemes = -1 end)
        end)

        -- leave
        task.delay(life + 0.2, function()
            if not frame.Parent then return end
            item.fading = true
            local info = TweenInfo.new(0.32, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
            fade(true, info)
            TweenService:Create(sc, info, { Scale = 0.9 }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(frame, info, { Rotation = 2 }):Play()
            task.delay(0.36, function()
                if frame.Parent then frame:Destroy() end
                for i, it in ipairs(stack.items) do
                    if it == item then table.remove(stack.items, i) break end
                end
                if stack.gui.Parent then layout(stack) end
            end)
        end)
    end

    local hooked = {}
    local function hookPlayer(plr)
        if hooked[plr] then return end
        hooked[plr] = true
        plr.Chatted:Connect(function(msg)
            showBubble(plr, msg)
        end)
    end
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        hookPlayer(plr)
    end
    Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(hookPlayer)

    pcall(function()
        TextChat.MessageReceived:Connect(function(message)
            local src = message.TextSource
            if not src then return end
            local plr = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(src.UserId)
            if plr then showBubble(plr, message.Text) end
        end)
    end)

    task.spawn(function()
        while true do
            hideDefault()
            for plr, stack in pairs(stacks) do
                local char = plr.Parent and plr.Character
                local head = char and (char:FindFirstChild("Head") or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
                if head and stack.gui.Parent then
                    stack.gui.Adornee = head
                    if stack.gui.Parent ~= head then stack.gui.Parent = head end
                    local col = _G.PrismBubbleColor
                    if typeof(col) == "Color3" then
                        for _, it in ipairs(stack.items) do
                            if it.recolor then pcall(it.recolor, col) end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            task.wait(1.5)
        end
    end)
end)

--========================================================
--  Stage. Photo mode, spectate, weather, time of day.
--  Outfit changing is gone.
--========================================================
task.defer(function()
    if _G.PrismStage then return end
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
    local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
    local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
    if not lp then return end
    local pg = lp:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") or lp:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 10)
    if not pg then return end

    local toastGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    toastGui.Name = "PrismToasts"
    toastGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    toastGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    toastGui.DisplayOrder = 80
    toastGui.Parent = pg
    local stack = 0
    local function toast(text, image)
        stack = stack + 1
        local y = stack
        local row = Instance.new("Frame")
        row.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
        row.Position = UDim2.new(0, 18, 1, -18 - (y - 1) * 58)
        row.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(280, 50)
        row.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 10, 22)
        row.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
        row.BorderSizePixel = 0
        row.Parent = toastGui
        local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
        c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
        c.Parent = row
        local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        s.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 40)
        s.Transparency = 0.4
        s.Parent = row
        if image and image ~= "" then
            local img = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
            img.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            img.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 7)
            img.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(36, 36)
            img.Image = image
            img.Parent = row
            local ic = Instance.new("UICorner")
            ic.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
            ic.Parent = img
        end
        local lab = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        lab.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        lab.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(image and 52 or 12, 0)
        lab.Size = UDim2.new(1, image and -60 or -20, 1, 0)
        lab.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
        lab.TextSize = 14
        lab.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        lab.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 244, 236)
        lab.Text = text
        lab.Parent = row
        task.delay(3.2, function()
            if row.Parent then row:Destroy() end
            stack = math.max(0, stack - 1)
        end)
    end


    local photo = false
    local photoGui, photoStep
    local savedType, savedFov, savedSubject, savedMouse
    local hiddenGuis, hiddenTags, hiddenCore = {}, {}, {}
    local pos, yaw, pitch = Vector3.zero, 0, 0
    local keys = {}
    local fov = 70

    local function setCore(on)
        for _, kind in ipairs({ "PlayerList", "Chat", "Backpack", "Health" }) do
            pcall(function()
                StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType[kind], on)
            end)
        end
    end

    local function stopPhoto()
        if not photo then return end
        photo = false
        if photoStep then photoStep:Disconnect() photoStep = nil end
        if photoGui then photoGui:Destroy() photoGui = nil end
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if cam then
            pcall(function()
                cam.CameraType = savedType or Enum.CameraType.Custom
                cam.FieldOfView = savedFov or 70
                if savedSubject then cam.CameraSubject = savedSubject end
            end)
        end
        -- Always hand the mouse back free, never back to whatever Photo Mode's own
        -- freelook (RMB -> LockCurrentPosition) happened to leave it at. Restoring
        -- that stale locked value was what made the cursor look stuck like shift
        -- lock after leaving -- if real shift lock (or our own shift lock mod) is
        -- still actually toggled on, it re-locks the mouse itself off its own
        -- keybind state, it doesn't need us to hand it a locked value.
        pcall(function() UIS.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default end)
        pcall(function() UIS.MouseIconEnabled = true end)
        for _, g in ipairs(hiddenGuis) do
            if g and g.Parent then pcall(function() g.Enabled = true end) end
        end
        for _, t in ipairs(hiddenTags) do
            if t and t.Parent then pcall(function() t.Enabled = true end) end
        end
        hiddenGuis, hiddenTags = {}, {}
        setCore(true)
        toast("Photo mode off")
    end

    local function startPhoto()
        if photo then stopPhoto() return end
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not cam then return end
        photo = true
        savedType = cam.CameraType
        savedFov = cam.FieldOfView
        savedSubject = cam.CameraSubject
        savedMouse = UIS.MouseBehavior
        fov = cam.FieldOfView
        pos = cam.CFrame.Position
        local look = cam.CFrame.LookVector
        yaw = math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z)
        pitch = math.asin(math.clamp(look.Y, -1, 1))
        cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
        hiddenGuis, hiddenTags = {}, {}
        for _, g in ipairs(pg:GetChildren()) do
            if g:IsA("ScreenGui") and g.Enabled and g ~= toastGui and g.Name ~= "PrismStageHint" then
                hiddenGuis[#hiddenGuis + 1] = g
                g.Enabled = false
            end
        end
        for _, d in ipairs(pg:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("BillboardGui") and d.Name == "PrismNametag" and d.Enabled then
                hiddenTags[#hiddenTags + 1] = d
                d.Enabled = false
            end
        end
        setCore(false)
        photoGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        photoGui.Name = "PrismStageHint"
        photoGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
        photoGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
        photoGui.DisplayOrder = 90
        photoGui.Parent = pg
        local function bar(y, h)
            local f = Instance.new("Frame")
            f.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, h)
            f.Position = y
            f.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
            f.BorderSizePixel = 0
            f.Parent = photoGui
        end
        bar(UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0), 54)
        bar(UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -54), 54)
        local hint = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        hint.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        hint.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 54)
        hint.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -54)
        hint.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        hint.TextSize = 14
        hint.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 230)
        hint.Text = "WASD move   RMB look   wheel FOV   H hide yourself   P leave"
        hint.Parent = photoGui
        local charHidden = false
        photoStep = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
            local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
            if not camera or not photo then return end
            if UIS:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2) then
                UIS.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCurrentPosition
                local d = UIS:GetMouseDelta()
                yaw = yaw - d.X * 0.0035
                pitch = math.clamp(pitch - d.Y * 0.0035, -1.45, 1.45)
            else
                UIS.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
            end
            local rot = CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0) * CFrame.Angles(pitch, 0, 0)
            local move = Vector3.zero
            if keys.W then move = move + Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end
            if keys.S then move = move + Vector3.new(0, 0, 1) end
            if keys.A then move = move + Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0) end
            if keys.D then move = move + Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) end
            if keys.Space then move = move + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
            if keys.LeftControl then move = move + Vector3.new(0, -1, 0) end
            local speed = keys.LeftShift and 90 or 32
            if move.Magnitude > 0 then
                pos = pos + rot:VectorToWorldSpace(move.Unit) * speed * dt
            end
            camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos) * rot
            camera.FieldOfView = fov
            if keys.H then
                keys.H = false
                charHidden = not charHidden
                local char = lp.Character
                if char then
                    for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                            pcall(function() part.LocalTransparencyModifier = charHidden and 1 or 0 end)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    local specList = {}
    local specAt = 0
    local function watch(player)
        if photo then stopPhoto() end
        if not player or not player.Character then
            toast("They're not spawned")
            return
        end
        local hum = player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if cam and hum then
            cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
            cam.CameraSubject = hum
            toast("Watching " .. player.DisplayName, "rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id=" .. player.UserId .. "&w=150&h=150")
        end
    end
    local function nextPlayer()
        specList = {}
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= lp and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
                specList[#specList + 1] = p
            end
        end
        if #specList == 0 then
            toast("Nobody else to watch")
            return
        end
        specAt = specAt % #specList + 1
        watch(specList[specAt])
    end
    local function stopWatch()
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local char = lp.Character
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if cam and hum then
            cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
            cam.CameraSubject = hum
        end
        toast("Back on you")
    end

    local weatherPart, weatherConn
    local function weather(kind)
        if weatherConn then weatherConn:Disconnect() weatherConn = nil end
        if weatherPart then weatherPart:Destroy() weatherPart = nil end
        if kind == "off" or kind == nil then
            toast("Scene clear")
            return
        end
        local part = Instance.new("Part")
        part.Name = "PrismStageWeather"
        part.Anchored = true
        part.CanCollide = false
        part.CanQuery = false
        part.CanTouch = false
        part.Transparency = 1
        part.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 2)
        part.Parent = workspace
        weatherPart = part
        local em = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
        em.LightInfluence = 0
        em.LockedToPart = false
        if kind == "rain" then
            em.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
            em.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(180, 200, 230))
            em.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.15)
            em.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.25)
            em.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.7, 1.1)
            em.Rate = 400
            em.Speed = NumberRange.new(40, 60)
            em.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Bottom
            em.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(6, 6)
            em.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -30, 0)
        elseif kind == "snow" then
            em.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
            em.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
            em.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.25)
            em.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.15)
            em.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(3, 5)
            em.Rate = 180
            em.Speed = NumberRange.new(4, 8)
            em.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Bottom
            em.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(30, 30)
            em.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -2, 0)
            em.Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360)
            em.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-40, 40)
        else
            em.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
            em.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 90))
            em.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.18)
            em.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.1)
            em.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(2, 4)
            em.Rate = 40
            em.Speed = NumberRange.new(1, 3)
            em.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
            em.LightEmission = 1
        end
        em.Parent = part
        weatherConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            if cam and part.Parent then
                part.CFrame = cam.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, kind == "flies" and 2 or 18, kind == "flies" and -6 or -10)
            end
        end)
        toast(kind == "rain" and "Rain on" or kind == "snow" and "Snow on" or "Fireflies on")
    end

    UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
        if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then return end
        local name = input.KeyCode.Name
        if name == "W" or name == "A" or name == "S" or name == "D" or name == "Space" or name == "LeftShift" or name == "LeftControl" or name == "H" then
            if photo then keys[name] = true end
        end
        if processed then return end
        if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.P then
            startPhoto()
        end
    end)
    UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then return end
        keys[input.KeyCode.Name] = nil
    end)
    UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if not photo then return end
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel then
            fov = math.clamp(fov - input.Position.Z * 4, 20, 100)
        end
    end)

    _G.PrismStage = {
        photo = startPhoto,
        next = nextPlayer,
        stop = stopWatch,
        watch = watch,
        weather = weather,
        clock = function(t)
            Lighting.ClockTime = t
            toast("Time set")
        end,
    }
end)

-- Prism pack: simple rail, stage, portal trips, house.
-- Appended after the main script. Safe to re-execute.
task.defer(function()
	local okPack, packErr = pcall(function()
		local Players = game:GetService("Players")
		local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
		local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
		local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
		if not lp then
			return
		end

		local VEX_B64 = ""
		local SWIRL_B64 = ""
		local SFX_B64 = ""
		local THEME_B64 = ""
		local MARS_B64 = ""
		local JUP_B64 = ""
		local SAT_B64 = ""
		local NEP_B64 = ""
		local STAR_B64 = ""
		local PORTAL_B64 = ""
		local SUN_B64 = ""
		local RING_B64 = ""

		local function b64dec(data)
			local b = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
			data = string.gsub(data, "[^" .. b .. "=]", "")
			return (data:gsub(".", function(x)
				if x == "=" then
					return ""
				end
				local r, f = "", (string.find(b, x, 1, true) - 1)
				for i = 6, 1, -1 do
					r = r .. (f % 2 ^ i - f % 2 ^ (i - 1) > 0 and "1" or "0")
				end
				return r
			end):gsub("%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?", function(x)
				if #x ~= 8 then
					return ""
				end
				local c = 0
				for i = 1, 8 do
					c = c + (x:sub(i, i) == "1" and 2 ^ (8 - i) or 0)
				end
				return string.char(c)
			end))
		end

		local ASSET_URLS = {
			["vexora.jpg"] = {"https://x0.at/tn0j.jpg", "https://n.uguu.se/osyZVetq.jpg"},
			["swirl.jpg"] = {"https://x0.at/QLXS.jpg", "https://h.uguu.se/fULnXmQB.jpg"},
			["portal.mp3"] = {"https://x0.at/8VbJ.mp3", "https://n.uguu.se/WXwSDxLf.mp3"},
			["theme.mp3"] = {"https://x0.at/7cRg.mp3", "https://d.uguu.se/dcbmURDG.mp3"},
			["mars.jpg"] = {"https://x0.at/dEmf.jpg", "https://h.uguu.se/nDWiBnYJ.jpg"},
			["jupiter.jpg"] = {"https://x0.at/p1Hn.jpg", "https://n.uguu.se/JpTzaoWc.jpg"},
			["saturn.jpg"] = {"https://x0.at/W7uW.jpg", "https://h.uguu.se/hLfenoag.jpg"},
			["neptune.jpg"] = {"https://x0.at/ICbF.jpg", "https://h.uguu.se/FqVXJFbO.jpg"},
			["stars.jpg"] = {"https://x0.at/8Paa.jpg", "https://h.uguu.se/wxYAcaEJ.jpg"},
			["portal.png"] = {"https://x0.at/5khT.png", "https://h.uguu.se/kejJAQTm.png"},
			["sun.jpg"] = {"https://x0.at/iXXD.jpg", "https://n.uguu.se/aLLrqlVF.jpg"},
			["rings.png"] = {"https://x0.at/fSiu.png", "https://n.uguu.se/BmXQcGxC.png"},
		}
		local function httpBody(url)
			if type(url) ~= "string" or #url < 8 or string.find(url, "__URL_", 1, true) then
				return nil
			end
			local okH, res = pcall(function()
				return game:HttpGet(url, true)
			end)
			if okH and type(res) == "string" and #res > 32 then
				return res
			end
			local req = request or http_request
			if type(syn) == "table" and type(syn.request) == "function" then
				req = syn.request
			end
			if type(req) == "function" then
				local okR, resR = pcall(req, { Url = url, Method = "GET" })
				if okR and type(resR) == "table" then
					local b = resR.Body or resR.body
					if type(b) == "string" and #b > 32 then
						return b
					end
				end
			end
			return nil
		end
		local function fileAsset(name, b64)
			if type(writefile) ~= "function" or type(getcustomasset) ~= "function" then
				return nil
			end
			local path = "prism_" .. tostring(name)
			local have = false
			if type(isfile) == "function" then
				local okF, exists = pcall(isfile, path)
				have = okF and exists == true
			end
			if not have then
				local got = nil
				local urls = ASSET_URLS[name]
				if type(urls) == "table" then
					for i = 1, #urls do
						got = httpBody(urls[i])
						if got then break end
					end
				end
				if not got and type(b64) == "string" and #b64 > 64 and not string.find(b64, "@@", 1, true) then
					local bin = b64dec(b64)
					if type(bin) == "string" and #bin > 32 then
						got = bin
					end
				end
				if got then
					local wrote = pcall(writefile, path, got)
					if not wrote then
						return nil
					end
				else
					return nil
				end
			end
			local asset
			pcall(function()
				asset = getcustomasset(path)
			end)
			return asset
		end

		local vexId, swirlId, sfxId, themeId, marsTex, jupTex, satTex, nepTex, starTex
		local function loadAssets()
			vexId = (_G._ParallaxAssets and _G._ParallaxAssets.bg()) or fileAsset("vexora.jpg", VEX_B64)
			swirlId = fileAsset("swirl.jpg", SWIRL_B64)
			sfxId = fileAsset("portal.mp3", SFX_B64)
			themeId = nil
			pcall(function()
				if type(getcustomasset) == "function" then
					themeId = getcustomasset("Parallax/music/call_on_me.mp3")
				end
			end)
			if not themeId then themeId = fileAsset("theme.mp3", THEME_B64) end
			marsTex = fileAsset("mars.jpg", MARS_B64)
			jupTex = fileAsset("jupiter.jpg", JUP_B64)
			satTex = fileAsset("saturn.jpg", SAT_B64)
			nepTex = fileAsset("neptune.jpg", NEP_B64)
			starTex = fileAsset("stars.jpg", STAR_B64)
			portalTex = fileAsset("portal.png", PORTAL_B64)
			sunTex = fileAsset("sun.jpg", SUN_B64)
			ringTex = fileAsset("rings.png", RING_B64)
		end

		local function wipe(name)
			local inst = workspace:FindFirstChild(name)
			if inst then
				inst:Destroy()
			end
		end
		wipe("PrismStage")
		wipe("PrismHouse")
		wipe("PrismPocket")
		wipe("PrismPortal")
		wipe("PrismCine")

		local pg = lp:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
		local oldRail = pg:FindFirstChild("PrismSimpleRail")
		if oldRail then
			oldRail:Destroy()
		end

		local CREAM = Color3.fromRGB(236, 226, 204)
		local BRICK = Color3.fromRGB(158, 72, 64)
		local ROOF = Color3.fromRGB(96, 64, 46)
		local ROOF_DARK = Color3.fromRGB(72, 48, 34)
		local LAWN = Color3.fromRGB(118, 176, 70)
		local CONC = Color3.fromRGB(198, 190, 172)
		local STREET = Color3.fromRGB(54, 58, 62)
		local TRIM = Color3.fromRGB(92, 64, 48)
		local PINK = Color3.fromRGB(255, 47, 125)

		local function part(parent, cf, size, color, mat, collide)
			local p = Instance.new("Part")
			p.Anchored = true
			p.CanCollide = collide ~= false
			p.CanQuery = collide ~= false
			p.CanTouch = false
			p.CastShadow = false
			p.Size = size
			p.CFrame = cf
			p.Color = color
			p.Material = mat or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
			p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
			p.Parent = parent
			return p
		end

		-- Stage ----------------------------------------------------------------
		local stageBars = {}
		local stageLights = {}
		local stageTiles = {}
		local stageFx = {}
		local stageRings = {}
		local stageScreens = {}
		local stageJumbo = {}
		local stageCenter = Vector3.new()
		local stageRadius = 90
		local stageBusy = false
		local stageAgain = false
		local function buildStage()
			if stageBusy then
				stageAgain = true
				return
			end
			stageBusy = true
			local oldStage = workspace:FindFirstChild("PrismStage")
			if oldStage then
				oldStage:Destroy()
			end
			local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
			folder.Name = "PrismStage"
			folder.Parent = workspace
			local hrp = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local origin = hrp and hrp.Position or Vector3.new(0, 8, 0)
			local function banned(inst)
				local a = inst
				while a and a ~= workspace do
					local n = a.Name
					if n == "PrismStage" or n == "PrismHouse" or n == "PrismPocket" or n == "PrismPortal" or n == "PrismCine" or n == "PrismVista" or n == "HaloInfFloor" then
						return true
					end
					a = a.Parent
				end
				return false
			end
			local pts = {}
			local counts = { 0, 0, 0, 0 }
			local sx, sz, n = 0, 0, 0
			for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
				if d:IsA("BasePart") and d.Anchored and not banned(d) and d.Size.X < 400 and d.Size.Z < 400 and d.Size.Y < 60 then
					local p = d.Position
					local flat = (Vector3.new(p.X, 0, p.Z) - Vector3.new(origin.X, 0, origin.Z)).Magnitude
					if math.abs(p.X) < 8000 and math.abs(p.Z) < 8000 and p.Y > -200 and p.Y < 700 then
						n = n + 1
						sx = sx + p.X
						sz = sz + p.Z
						pts[n] = p
					end
				end
			end
			local look = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
			local spot = origin + Vector3.new(0, 0, -260)
			if n >= 12 then
				local cx, cz = sx / n, sz / n
				local minX, maxX, minZ, maxZ = math.huge, -math.huge, math.huge, -math.huge
				for i = 1, n do
					local p = pts[i]
					if p.X < cx then counts[1] = counts[1] + 1 else counts[2] = counts[2] + 1 end
					if p.Z < cz then counts[3] = counts[3] + 1 else counts[4] = counts[4] + 1 end
					if p.X < minX then minX = p.X end
					if p.X > maxX then maxX = p.X end
					if p.Z < minZ then minZ = p.Z end
					if p.Z > maxZ then maxZ = p.Z end
				end
				local best, bi = math.huge, 1
				for i = 1, 4 do
					if counts[i] < best then
						best = counts[i]
						bi = i
					end
				end
				local dir
				if bi == 1 then
					dir = Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0)
					spot = Vector3.new(minX - 400, origin.Y, cz)
				elseif bi == 2 then
					dir = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
					spot = Vector3.new(maxX + 400, origin.Y, cz)
				elseif bi == 3 then
					dir = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
					spot = Vector3.new(cx, origin.Y, minZ - 400)
				else
					dir = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
					spot = Vector3.new(cx, origin.Y, maxZ + 400)
				end
				look = -dir
			end
			local params = RaycastParams.new()
			params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { lp.Character, folder }
			local hit = workspace:Raycast(spot + Vector3.new(0, 200, 0), Vector3.new(0, -800, 0), params)
			local ground = hit and hit.Position or Vector3.new(spot.X, origin.Y - 3, spot.Z)
			local shared = _G._PrismSharedPose
			if type(shared) == "table" and typeof(shared.p) == "Vector3" and typeof(shared.l) == "Vector3" and shared.l.Magnitude > 0.2 then
				look = Vector3.new(shared.l.X, 0, shared.l.Z).Unit
				ground = shared.p
			end
			local right = Vector3.new(-look.Z, 0, look.X)
			local center = ground
			stageCenter = center + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
			if not (type(shared) == "table" and typeof(shared.p) == "Vector3") and not _G._PrismPoseTime then
				local tnow = 0
				pcall(function()
					tnow = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
				end)
				if tnow == 0 then
					tnow = os.clock()
				end
				_G._PrismPoseTime = tnow
				local px = math.floor(center.X + 0.5)
				local py = math.floor(center.Y + 0.5)
				local pz = math.floor(center.Z + 0.5)
				local lx = math.floor(look.X + 0.5)
				local lz = math.floor(look.Z + 0.5)
				task.defer(function()
					if type(_G._PrismSyncSend) == "function" then

				return center + right * localX + Vector3.new(0, localY, 0) + look * localZ
			end

				local cf = CFrame.lookAt(wp(lx, ly, lz), wp(lx, ly, lz) + look)

			end

			end

				p.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
				return p
			end

		local function openTab(name)
			if type(_G._PrismOpenFullMenu) == "function" then

				_G._PrismSwitchTab(name)

		local function refreshReanim()
			local on = false
			local api = rawget(_G, "_HaloReanimateAPI") or rawget(_G, "ReanimateAPI")
			pcall(function()
				if api and type(api.is_reanimated) == "function" then on = api.is_reanimated() == true end
			end)
			if reanimLabel then
				reanimLabel.Text = on and "ON" or "OFF"
				reanimLabel.TextColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(112, 255, 145) or Color3.fromRGB(160, 166, 184)
			end
			if reanimLight then
				reanimLight.BackgroundColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(85, 255, 120) or Color3.fromRGB(70, 77, 90)
				reanimLight.BackgroundTransparency = on and 0 or 0.1
			end
			if reanimLightStroke then
				reanimLightStroke.Color = on and Color3.fromRGB(110, 255, 145) or Color3.fromRGB(105, 112, 128)
				reanimLightStroke.Transparency = on and 0.1 or 0.65
			end
		end

		local function applyBrick(char)
			if not char then
				return
			end
			for _, p in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
				if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
					if brickSaved[p] == nil then
						brickSaved[p] = { p.Color, p.Material }
					end
					p.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
					p.Color = BRICK_COLORS[p.Name] or Color3.fromRGB(196, 40, 28)
				end
			end
		end

		local function clearBrick()
			for p, saved in pairs(brickSaved) do
				if p and p.Parent then
					p.Color = saved[1]
					p.Material = saved[2]
				end
			end
			brickSaved = {}
		end

			protectOn = false
			if protectLabel then
				protectLabel.Text = "PROTECTION"
				protectLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			end
			local api = _G._HaloReanimateAPI
			local wasReanim = api and type(api.is_reanimated) == "function" and api.is_reanimated()
			local savedCF = nil
			pcall(function()
				local character = wasReanim and api.get_clone and api.get_clone(lp) or lp.Character
				local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if root then savedCF = root.CFrame end
			end)
			if wasReanim then
				pcall(function() api.reanimate(false) end)
				State.isReanimated = false
				pcall(UpdateToggleBtn)
			end
			local oldCharacter = lp.Character
			local oldHumanoid = oldCharacter and oldCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if oldHumanoid then pcall(function() oldHumanoid.Health = 0 end) end
			task.spawn(function()
				local deadline = os.clock() + 10
				local newCharacter
				repeat
					task.wait(0.1)
					if lp.Character and lp.Character ~= oldCharacter
						and lp.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
						newCharacter = lp.Character
					end
				until newCharacter or os.clock() >= deadline
				local root = newCharacter and newCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if root and savedCF then root.CFrame = savedCF end
				if wasReanim and api then
					task.wait(0.35)
					pcall(function() api.reanimate(true) end)
					State.isReanimated = api.is_reanimated and api.is_reanimated() or false
					pcall(UpdateToggleBtn)
				end
			end)
		end)

			"Hey. Let me ask you a question real quick.",

		local guideBusy = false
		local function pointAtGun()
			if not gunPad or not gunPad.Parent then return end
			if gunPad:FindFirstChild("GunMark") then return end
			local h = Instance.new("Highlight")
			h.Name = "GunMark"
			h.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(80, 255, 110)
			h.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(210, 255, 210)
			h.Parent = gunPad
			local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
			bb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(160, 36)
			bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
			bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
			bb.Parent = gunPad
			local tl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			tl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			tl.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
			tl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
			tl.TextSize = 16
			tl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 255, 180)
			tl.Text = "Return gun"
			tl.Parent = bb
		end
		local function startGuide()
			if guideBusy then return end
			guideBusy = true
			task.spawn(function()
				for i, line in ipairs(GUIDE) do
					if subtitle then
						subtitle.Visible = true
						subtitle.Text = line
				end
				if i >= 5 then pointAtGun() end
				task.wait(2.7)
			end
				task.wait(1.4)
				if subtitle then subtitle.Visible = false subtitle.Text = "" end
				guideBusy = false
			end)
		end
		local function addTalk(model)
			local host = model:FindFirstChild("Head", true) or model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
			if not host then return end
			local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
			prompt.ActionText = "Talk"
			prompt.ObjectText = model.Name ~= "" and model.Name or "Guide"
			prompt.HoldDuration = 0
			prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 12
			prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
			prompt.Parent = host
			prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(who)
				if who ~= lp then return end
				startGuide()
			end)
		end
		local function applyVistaLight()
			local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
			if not savedLight then
				savedLight = {
					ClockTime = Lighting.ClockTime,
					Brightness = Lighting.Brightness,
					Ambient = Lighting.Ambient,
					OutdoorAmbient = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient,
					FogColor = Lighting.FogColor,
					FogEnd = Lighting.FogEnd,
				}
				local at = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
				if at then
					savedLight.at = at
					savedLight.atState = { at.Density, at.Color, at.Haze, at.Glare }
				end
			end
			Lighting.ClockTime = 17.2
			Lighting.Brightness = 2.4
			Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(90, 70, 120)
			Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(255, 196, 120)
			Lighting.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 90)
			Lighting.FogEnd = 5000
			local at = Lighting:FindFirstChild("PrismVistaAtmo") or Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
			if not at then
				at = Instance.new("Atmosphere")
				at.Name = "PrismVistaAtmo"
				at.Parent = Lighting
				savedLight.made = at
			end
			at.Density = 0.22
			at.Color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 220, 140)
			at.Haze = 2.2
			at.Glare = 0.4
			pcall(function()
				at.Decay = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 80)
			end)
		end
		local function popVistaLight()
			if not savedLight then return end
			local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
			Lighting.ClockTime = savedLight.ClockTime
			Lighting.Brightness = savedLight.Brightness
			Lighting.Ambient = savedLight.Ambient
			Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = savedLight.OutdoorAmbient
			Lighting.FogColor = savedLight.FogColor
			Lighting.FogEnd = savedLight.FogEnd
			if savedLight.made then savedLight.made:Destroy()
			elseif savedLight.at and savedLight.atState then
				local a = savedLight.atState
				savedLight.at.Density = a[1]
				savedLight.at.Color = a[2]
				savedLight.at.Haze = a[3]
				savedLight.at.Glare = a[4]
			end
			savedLight = nil
		end

		local function buildPocket()
			wipe("PrismPocket")
			local f = Instance.new("Folder")
			f.Name = "PrismPocket"
			f.Parent = workspace
			local kinds = {
				{
					title = "Pet Plaza",
					floor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 130),
					wall = Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 186),

				},
				{
					title = "Target Range",

					wall = Color3.fromRGB(40, 44, 40),
					lines = { "Range is cold.", "Targets don't shoot back.", "Stay behind the line." },
				},
				{
					title = "Storm Pad",
					floor = Color3.fromRGB(70, 78, 96),
					wall = Color3.fromRGB(150, 160, 180),
					lines = { "Wind picks up at night.", "Pad stays put.", "Don't stand on the edge." },
				},
				{
					title = "Hotel Hall",
					floor = Color3.fromRGB(150, 48, 48),
					wall = Color3.fromRGB(230, 220, 200),
					lines = { "Elevator is fake.", "Rooms are unlocked.", "Checkout is never." },
				},
				{
					title = "Neon Lobby",
					floor = Color3.fromRGB(16, 16, 22),
					wall = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 28),
					lines = { "Lobby never closes.", "The desk is empty.", "Neon is the only light." },
				},
				{
					title = "Farm Plot",
					floor = Color3.fromRGB(96, 150, 64),
					wall = Color3.fromRGB(150, 110, 70),
					lines = { "Rows are straight.", "Nothing is planted.", "Fence is the whole map." },
				},
				{
					title = "Campus Court",
					floor = Color3.fromRGB(190, 190, 186),
					wall = Color3.fromRGB(210, 206, 196),
					lines = { "Fountain is on.", "Class isn't.", "Benches are dry." },
				},
			}
			local spec = kinds[math.random(1, #kinds)]
			local o = Vector3.new(-2600, 220, 2600)
			local function q(x, y, z, sx, sy, sz, color, mat)
				return part(f, CFrame.new(o + Vector3.new(x, y, z)), Vector3.new(sx, sy, sz), color, mat or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, true)
			end
			q(0, -0.5, 0, 90, 1, 90, spec.floor, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
			q(0, 8, -44, 90, 16, 1.2, spec.wall)
			q(-44, 8, 0, 1.2, 16, 90, spec.wall)
			q(44, 8, 0, 1.2, 16, 90, spec.wall)
			q(0, 6, 30, 16, 8, 1, spec.wall)
			-- a few props so each place feels different
			if spec.title == "Pet Plaza" then
				for i = 1, 5 do
					local pet = part(f, CFrame.new(o + Vector3.new(-20 + i * 7, 2, -10)), Vector3.new(3, 3, 3), Color3.fromHSV(i / 6, 0.6, 1), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, false)

			elseif spec.title == "Target Range" then
				for i = 1, 4 do
					q(-15 + i * 8, 4, -30, 3, 5, 0.4, Color3.fromRGB(180, 40, 40))
				end
			elseif spec.title == "Storm Pad" then
				q(0, 8, 0, 8, 16, 8, Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 80), Enum.Material.Neon)
			elseif spec.title == "Hotel Hall" then
				for i = 1, 6 do
					q(-30 + i * 9, 4, -20, 3, 7, 0.4, Color3.fromRGB(92, 58, 40), Enum.Material.Wood)
				end
			elseif spec.title == "Neon Lobby" then
				q(0, 1, 0, 20, 0.3, 8, PINK, Enum.Material.Neon)
				q(0, 6, -20, 14, 6, 0.4, Color3.fromRGB(80, 180, 255), Enum.Material.Neon)
			elseif spec.title == "Farm Plot" then
				for i = 1, 5 do
					q(0, 0.4, -20 + i * 5, 40, 0.3, 1.2, Color3.fromRGB(92, 64, 36), Enum.Material.Ground)
				end
			else
				local water = q(0, 1.2, 0, 10, 1, 10, Color3.fromRGB(80, 170, 220), Enum.Material.Glass)
				water.Transparency = 0.3
			end
			local function pocketNpc(i)
				local model = Instance.new("Model")
				model.Name = "Guide"
				model.Parent = f
				local pos = o + Vector3.new((i - 2) * 8, 0, 10)
				local torso = part(model, CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)), Vector3.new(2, 2, 1), Color3.fromHSV(i / 4, 0.5, 0.85), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, false)
				part(model, CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, 4.7, 0)), Vector3.new(1.2, 1.2, 1.2), Color3.fromRGB(236, 204, 170), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, false)
				part(model, CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(-0.5, 1, 0)), Vector3.new(0.8, 2, 0.8), Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 40), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, false)
				part(model, CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0.5, 1, 0)), Vector3.new(0.8, 2, 0.8), Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 40), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, false)
				local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
				bb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 48)
				bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3.2, 0)
				bb.AlwaysOnTop = true

				tl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				tl.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
				tl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
				tl.TextSize = 13
				tl.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
				tl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
				tl.Text = spec.lines[1]
				tl.Parent = bb
				npcs[#npcs + 1] = { part = torso, label = tl, name = spec.title, lines = spec.lines, i = i, base = torso.CFrame }
			end
			for i = 1, 3 do
				pocketNpc(i)
			end
			pocketCF = CFrame.lookAt(o + Vector3.new(0, 4, 24), o + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
			return spec.title
		end

		local function openPortal(pos, normal, isReturn)
			if portalFolder then
				portalFolder:Destroy()
			end
			portalFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
			portalFolder.Name = "PrismPortal"
			portalFolder.Parent = workspace
			local flat = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, 0.45, 0))
			local disc = Instance.new("Part")
			disc.Name = "Swirl"
			disc.Anchored = true
			disc.CanCollide = false
			disc.CanTouch = false
			disc.CastShadow = false
			disc.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			disc.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 12, 0)
			disc.Size = Vector3.new(13, 0.12, 13)
			disc.CFrame = flat * CFrame.new(0, 0.28, 0)
			disc.Parent = portalFolder
			if portalTex then
				local top = Instance.new("Decal")
				top.Face = Enum.NormalId.Top
				top.Texture = portalTex
				top.Parent = disc
				local bot = top:Clone()
				bot.Face = Enum.NormalId.Bottom
				bot.Parent = disc
				disc.Transparency = 1
			else
				disc.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
				disc.Color = Color3.fromRGB(40, 255, 80)
				disc.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
				disc.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 11, 11)
				disc.CFrame = flat * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
			end
			local glow = Instance.new("Part")
			glow.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
			glow.Anchored = true
			glow.CanCollide = false
			glow.CastShadow = false
			glow.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
			glow.Color = Color3.fromRGB(70, 255, 90)
			glow.Transparency = 0.78
			glow.Size = Vector3.new(0.12, 13.6, 13.6)
			glow.CFrame = flat * CFrame.new(0, -0.2, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
			glow.Parent = portalFolder
			local well = Instance.new("Part")
			well.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
			well.Anchored = true
			well.CanCollide = false
			well.CastShadow = false
			well.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			well.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
			well.Size = Vector3.new(0.08, 5.4, 5.4)
			well.CFrame = flat * CFrame.new(0, -0.05, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
			well.Parent = portalFolder
			local dripHost = part(portalFolder, flat * CFrame.new(0, 0.4, 0), Vector3.new(1, 0.2, 1), Color3.fromRGB(80, 255, 100), Enum.Material.Neon, false)
			dripHost.Transparency = 1
			local fall = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
			fall.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/smoke_main.dds"
			fall.Rate = 28
			fall.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.6, 1.2)
			fall.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.4, 1.6)
			fall.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(30, 30)
			fall.Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.55), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) })
			fall.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.15), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) })
			fall.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(140, 255, 150), Color3.fromRGB(10, 70, 20))
			fall.LightEmission = 0.9
			fall.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-120, 120)
			fall.Parent = dripHost
			local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
			light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(90, 255, 120)
			light.Brightness = 6
			light.Range = 26
			light.Parent = disc
			_G._PrismPortalSpin = { pos = flat.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.28, 0), disc = disc, glow = glow, light = light, t = 0 }
			local trigger = part(portalFolder, flat, Vector3.new(9, 3, 9), Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, false)
			trigger.Transparency = 1
			trigger.CanTouch = false
			trigger.CanCollide = false
			task.delay(0.4, function()
				if trigger.Parent then
					trigger.CanTouch = true
				end
			end)
			local last = 0
			trigger.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
				if traveling then
					return
				end
				if os.clock() - last < 1.2 then
					return
				end
				local char = lp.Character
				if not char or not hit:IsDescendantOf(char) then
					return
				end
				last = os.clock()
				_G._PrismPortalTrip(isReturn)
			end)
			playSfx()
		end

		local function shoot(isReturn)
			local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
			if not cam then
				return
			end
			local mouse = lp:GetMouse()
			local origin = cam.CFrame.Position
			local dir = mouse.Hit.Position - origin
			if dir.Magnitude < 1 then
				dir = cam.CFrame.LookVector * 40
			end
			local params = RaycastParams.new()
			params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			local ignore = { lp.Character }
			if portalFolder then
				ignore[#ignore + 1] = portalFolder
			end
			params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore
			local hit = workspace:Raycast(origin, dir.Unit * 500, params)
			local pos = hit and hit.Position or (origin + dir.Unit * 24)
			local normal = hit and hit.Normal or -dir.Unit
			openPortal(pos, normal, isReturn and true or false)
		end

		local function makeGun(isReturn)
			local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
			tool.Name = isReturn and "Return Portal Gun" or "Portal Gun"
			tool.RequiresHandle = true
			tool.CanBeDropped = false
			local handle = Instance.new("Part")
			handle.Name = "Handle"
			handle.Size = Vector3.new(0.3, 0.85, 0.3)
			handle.Color = Color3.fromRGB(230, 232, 226)
			handle.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			handle.Parent = tool
			local function weld(p, cf)
				p.Anchored = false
				p.CanCollide = false
				p.Massless = true
				p.Parent = tool
				local w = Instance.new("Weld")
				w.Part0 = handle
				w.Part1 = p
				w.C0 = cf
				w.Parent = handle
				return p
			end
			local body = Instance.new("Part")
			body.Size = Vector3.new(1.15, 0.48, 2.15)
			body.Color = Color3.fromRGB(238, 240, 236)
			body.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			weld(body, CFrame.new(0, 0.55, -0.55))
			local collar = Instance.new("Part")
			collar.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
			collar.Size = Vector3.new(0.16, 0.62, 0.62)
			collar.Color = Color3.fromRGB(210, 214, 208)
			collar.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			weld(collar, CFrame.new(0, 0.82, -0.35) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)))
			local vial = Instance.new("Part")
			vial.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
			vial.Size = Vector3.new(0.95, 0.46, 0.46)
			vial.Color = Color3.fromRGB(90, 255, 70)
			vial.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
			vial.Transparency = 0.15
			weld(vial, CFrame.new(0, 1.15, -0.35) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)))
			local glow = Instance.new("PointLight")
			glow.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 255, 90)
			glow.Range = 8
			glow.Brightness = 1.4
			glow.Parent = vial
			for i = 1, 3 do
				local b = Instance.new("Part")
				b.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
				b.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
				b.Color = Color3.fromRGB(40, 210, 60)
				b.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
				weld(b, CFrame.new(-0.62, 0.55, -1.15 + (i - 1) * 0.38))
			end
			local red = Instance.new("Part")
			red.Size = Vector3.new(0.42, 0.08, 0.26)
			red.Color = Color3.fromRGB(176, 42, 32)
			red.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			weld(red, CFrame.new(0.18, 0.84, -0.95))
			tool.Activated:Connect(function()
				shoot(isReturn)
			end)
			local backpack = lp:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") or lp:WaitForChild("Backpack")
			local existing = backpack:FindFirstChild(tool.Name) or (lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChild(tool.Name))
			if existing then
				existing:Destroy()
			end
			tool.Parent = backpack
			local hum = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if hum then
				pcall(function()
					hum:EquipTool(tool)
				end)
			end
		end

		local function flyAndArrive(destCF, title, playTheme)
			popVistaLight()
			local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
			local hrp = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not cam or not hrp then
				traveling = false
				return
			end
			local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
			_G._PrismTraveling = true
			local flight = {
				ClockTime = Lighting.ClockTime,
				Brightness = Lighting.Brightness,
				Ambient = Lighting.Ambient,
				OutdoorAmbient = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient,
				FogColor = Lighting.FogColor,
				FogEnd = Lighting.FogEnd,
				FogStart = Lighting.FogStart,
			}
			local oldSky = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Sky")
			local atmo = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
			local atmoState
			if atmo then
				atmoState = { atmo.Density, atmo.Haze, atmo.Glare }
				atmo.Density = 0.02
				atmo.Haze = 0
				atmo.Glare = 0
			end
			local starSky
			if starTex then
