				starSky = Instance.new("Sky")
				starSky.Name = "PrismStarSky"
				for _, face in ipairs({ "Bk", "Dn", "Ft", "Lf", "Rt", "Up" }) do
					starSky["Skybox" .. face] = starTex
				end
				if oldSky then
					oldSky.Parent = nil
				end
				starSky.Parent = Lighting
			end
			Lighting.ClockTime = 6.2
			Lighting.Brightness = 2.6
			Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(10, 12, 20)
			Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(36, 40, 58)
			Lighting.FogColor = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
			Lighting.FogStart = 12000
			Lighting.FogEnd = 40000
			local bloom = Instance.new("BloomEffect")
			bloom.Name = "PrismBloom"
			bloom.Intensity = 0.55
			bloom.Size = 28
			bloom.Threshold = 0.85
			bloom.Parent = Lighting
			local grade = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
			grade.Name = "PrismGrade"
			grade.Contrast = 0.14
			grade.Saturation = 0.18
			grade.Parent = Lighting
			local themeSound
			if playTheme and themeId then
				themeSound = Instance.new("Sound")
				themeSound.Name = "PrismTheme"
				themeSound.SoundId = themeId
				themeSound.Volume = 0.9
				themeSound.Looped = false
				themeSound.Parent = pg
				pcall(function()
					themeSound:Play()
				end)
			end
			cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
			hrp.Anchored = true
			hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, -400, 0)
			local cine = Instance.new("Folder")
			cine.Name = "PrismCine"
			cine.Parent = workspace
			local function planet(pos, diameter, texture, clouds, tint)
				local body = Instance.new("Part")
				body.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
				body.Anchored = true
				body.CanCollide = false
				body.CastShadow = false
				body.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
				body.Color = tint
				body.Reflectance = 0.12
				body.Size = Vector3.new(diameter, diameter, diameter)
				body.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos)
				body.Parent = cine
				local shown = body
				if texture then
					pcall(function()
						local mp = Instance.new("MeshPart")
						mp.Name = "Surface"
						mp.Anchored = true
						mp.CanCollide = false
						mp.CastShadow = false
						mp.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
						mp.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
						mp.MeshId = "rbxassetid://453515873"
						mp.TextureID = texture
						mp.Size = Vector3.new(diameter, diameter, diameter)
						mp.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos)
						mp.Parent = cine
						body.Transparency = 1
						shown = mp
					end)
				end
				if clouds then
					pcall(function()
						local shell = Instance.new("MeshPart")
						shell.Name = "Clouds"
						shell.Anchored = true
						shell.CanCollide = false
						shell.CastShadow = false
						shell.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
						shell.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
						shell.Transparency = 0.42
						shell.MeshId = "rbxassetid://453515873"
						shell.TextureID = clouds
						shell.Size = Vector3.new(diameter, diameter, diameter) * 1.025
						shell.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos)
						shell.Parent = cine
					end)
				end
				local air = Instance.new("Part")
				air.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
				air.Size = Vector3.new(diameter, diameter, diameter) * 1.08
				air.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
				air.Color = tint
				air.Transparency = 0.95
				air.Anchored = true
				air.CanCollide = false
				air.CastShadow = false
				air.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos)
				air.Parent = cine
				return shown
			end
			local function rings(pos, diameter)
				local disc = Instance.new("Part")
				disc.Name = "Rings"
				disc.Anchored = true
				disc.CanCollide = false
				disc.CastShadow = false
				disc.Transparency = 1
				disc.Size = Vector3.new(diameter * 2.45, 0.8, diameter * 2.45)
				disc.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(24), math.rad(18), 0)
				disc.Parent = cine
				if ringTex then
					for _, face in ipairs({ Enum.NormalId.Top, Enum.NormalId.Bottom }) do
						local d = Instance.new("Decal")
						d.Face = face
						d.Texture = ringTex
						d.Parent = disc
					end
				else
					disc.Transparency = 0.35
					disc.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
					disc.Color = Color3.fromRGB(214, 186, 130)
				end
			end
			local root = Vector3.new(400, 12000, -200)
			local gap = 1600
			local order = {
				{ "Sun", 320, sunTex, nil, Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 60) },
				{ "Earth", 150, "rbxassetid://1281855679", "rbxassetid://1098044476", Color3.fromRGB(40, 90, 170) },
				{ "Moon", 40, "rbxassetid://8159103611", nil, Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 166) },
				{ "Mars", 86, marsTex, nil, Color3.fromRGB(168, 72, 40) },
				{ "Jupiter", 280, jupTex, nil, Color3.fromRGB(196, 150, 96) },
				{ "Saturn", 210, satTex, nil, Color3.fromRGB(214, 186, 140) },
				{ "Neptune", 100, nepTex, nil, Color3.fromRGB(24, 60, 170) },
			}
			local nodes = {}
			for i, spec in ipairs(order) do
				local pos = root + Vector3.new((i - 1) * gap, math.sin(i * 0.6) * 20, 0)
				if spec[1] == "Moon" and nodes[2] then
					pos = nodes[2].pos + Vector3.new(260, 36, -80)
				end
				local body = planet(pos, spec[2], spec[3], spec[4], spec[5])
				if spec[1] == "Sun" then
					body.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
					body.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 70)
					local L = Instance.new("PointLight")
					L.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 60)
					L.Brightness = 8
					L.Range = 60
					L.Parent = body
					for _, layer in ipairs({ { 1.08, 0.45, Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 40) }, { 1.35, 0.72, Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 30) }, { 1.7, 0.88, Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 20) } }) do
						local corona = Instance.new("Part")
						corona.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
						corona.Anchored = true
						corona.CanCollide = false
						corona.CastShadow = false
						corona.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
						corona.Color = layer[3]
						corona.Transparency = layer[2]
						corona.Size = Vector3.new(spec[2], spec[2], spec[2]) * layer[1]
						corona.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos)
						corona.Parent = cine
					end
				elseif spec[1] == "Saturn" then
					rings(pos, spec[2])
				end
				nodes[i] = { pos = pos, name = spec[1], size = spec[2], part = body }
			end
			local streak = Instance.new("Part")
			streak.Anchored = true
			streak.CanCollide = false
			streak.Transparency = 1
			streak.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
			streak.Parent = cine
			local em = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
			em.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
			em.Rate = 90
			em.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.2, 0.5)
			em.Speed = NumberRange.new(50, 110)
			em.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Back
			em.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(10, 10)
			em.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.1, 0)
			em.LightEmission = 1
			em.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
			em.Parent = streak
			subtitle.Visible = true
			local t0 = os.clock()
			local dur = 24
			local spin = 0
			while os.clock() - t0 < dur do
				if not hrp.Parent then
					break
				end
				local a = (os.clock() - t0) / dur
				local span = math.max(#nodes - 1, 1)
				local travel = a * span * gap
				local camPos = root + Vector3.new(travel - 80, 220 + math.sin(a * math.pi) * 40, 1100)
				local nearest, best = nodes[1], 1e9
				for _, n in ipairs(nodes) do
					local d = math.abs(n.pos.X - camPos.X)
					if d < best then
						nearest, best = n, d
					end
				end
				cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(camPos, nearest.pos + Vector3.new(0, nearest.size * 0.05, 0))
				streak.CFrame = cam.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 12)
				spin = spin + 0.22
				for _, n in ipairs(nodes) do
					if n.part and n.part.Parent and n.name ~= "Sun" then
						n.part.CFrame = CFrame.new(n.pos) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(8), math.rad(spin * (n.name == "Jupiter" and 2.2 or 0.45)), 0)
					end
				end
				subtitle.Text = nearest.name
				task.wait()
			end
			if hrp.Parent then
				hrp.CFrame = destCF
				hrp.Anchored = false
			end
			subtitle.Text = title or ""
			cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
			task.delay(1.4, function()
				subtitle.Visible = false
				subtitle.Text = ""
			end)
			if themeSound then
				themeSound:Stop()
				themeSound:Destroy()
			end
			if cine then
				cine:Destroy()
			end
			if bloom then
				bloom:Destroy()
			end
			if grade then
				grade:Destroy()
			end
			Lighting.ClockTime = flight.ClockTime
			Lighting.Brightness = flight.Brightness
			Lighting.Ambient = flight.Ambient
			Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = flight.OutdoorAmbient
			Lighting.FogColor = flight.FogColor
			Lighting.FogEnd = flight.FogEnd
			Lighting.FogStart = flight.FogStart
			if atmo and atmoState then
				atmo.Density = atmoState[1]
				atmo.Haze = atmoState[2]
				atmo.Glare = atmoState[3]
			end
			if starSky then
				starSky:Destroy()
			end
			if oldSky and oldSky.Parent == nil then
				oldSky.Parent = Lighting
			end
			traveling = false
			_G._PrismTraveling = false
			if type(_G._PrismRestoreBaseplate) == "function" then
				pcall(_G._PrismRestoreBaseplate)
			end
		end

		function _G._PrismPortalTrip(isReturn)
			if traveling then
				return
			end
			traveling = true
			task.spawn(function()
				local arrived = pcall(function()
					local hrp = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					if not hrp then
						return
					end
					local dest
					local title
					if isReturn and savedCF then
						dest = savedCF
						title = "Back"
					else
						savedCF = hrp.CFrame
						if math.random() < 0.32 then
							title = buildPocket()
							dest = pocketCF
						else
							ensureHouse()
							dest = houseCF
							title = "Home"
						end
					end
					playSfx()
					flyAndArrive(dest, title, title == "Home")
				end)
				if not arrived then
					traveling = false
					_G._PrismTraveling = false
					if type(_G._PrismRestoreBaseplate) == "function" then
						pcall(_G._PrismRestoreBaseplate)
					end
					local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
					if cam then
						cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
					end
					local hrp = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					if hrp then
						hrp.Anchored = false
					end
				end
			end)
		end

		-- heartbeat: stage bars, npc lines, portal spin, protection
		local micAnalyzer
		local micWire
		local micBound
		local micQuiet = 0
		local function readSpec(an)
			local ok, spec = pcall(function()
				return an:GetSpectrum()
			end)
			if not ok or spec == nil then
				return nil
			end
			if type(spec) == "table" then
				return spec
			end
			if type(spec) == "buffer" then
				local n = math.floor(buffer.len(spec) / 4)
				if n <= 0 then
					return nil
				end
				local t = table.create(n)
				for i = 0, n - 1 do
					t[i + 1] = buffer.readf32(spec, i * 4)
				end
				return t
			end
			return nil
		end
		local function bindMic(device)
			if not device or not device:IsA("AudioDeviceInput") then
				return false
			end
			local linked = false
			pcall(function()
				linked = micBound == device and micAnalyzer and micAnalyzer.Parent and micWire and micWire.Parent and micWire.SourceInstance == device and micWire.TargetInstance == micAnalyzer and micWire.Enabled ~= false
			end)
			if linked then
				pcall(function()
					device.Muted = false
				end)
				return true
			end
			pcall(function()
				if micWire then
					micWire:Destroy()
				end
			end)
			pcall(function()
				if micAnalyzer then
					micAnalyzer:Destroy()
				end
			end)
			local host = device.Parent or pg
			local an = Instance.new("AudioAnalyzer")
			an.Name = "Mix"
			an.Parent = host
			local w = Instance.new("Wire")
			w.Name = "MixLink"
			pcall(function()
				w.SourceInstance = device
			end)
			pcall(function()
				w.TargetInstance = an
			end)
			pcall(function()
				w.Enabled = true
			end)
			w.Parent = an
			micAnalyzer = an
			micWire = w
			micBound = device
			pcall(function()
				device.Muted = false
			end)
			return true
		end
		local function mixHost()
			local host = workspace:FindFirstChild("PrismMixHost")
			if not (host and host:IsA("BasePart")) then
				if host then
					pcall(function()
						host:Destroy()
					end)
				end
				host = Instance.new("Part")
				host.Name = "PrismMixHost"
				host.Anchored = true
				host.CanCollide = false
				host.CanQuery = false
				host.CanTouch = false
				host.Transparency = 1
				host.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
				host.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, -80, 0)
				host.Parent = workspace
			end
			return host
		end
		local function ensureLocalMic()
			-- Off by default. This used to put a second AudioDeviceInput on you and call joinVoice() / PublishPause(),
			-- which dropped your VC and rejoined it on every execute. Opt in with _G._PrismStageMic = true.
			if _G._PrismStageMic ~= true then
				if micBound or micAnalyzer or micWire then
					pcall(function() if micWire then micWire:Destroy() end end)
					pcall(function() if micAnalyzer then micAnalyzer:Destroy() end end)
					micWire, micAnalyzer, micBound = nil, nil, nil
				end
				pcall(function()
					local old = workspace:FindFirstChild("PrismMixHost")
					if old then old:Destroy() end
				end)
				return nil
			end
			local host = mixHost()
			local device = host:FindFirstChild("In")
			if not (device and device:IsA("AudioDeviceInput")) then
				if device then
					pcall(function()
						device:Destroy()
					end)
				end
				device = Instance.new("AudioDeviceInput")
				device.Name = "In"
				device:SetAttribute("PrismStageMic", true)
				pcall(function()
					device.Player = lp
				end)
				pcall(function()
					device.Muted = false
				end)
				device.Parent = host
			end
			pcall(function()
				if device.Player ~= lp then
					device.Player = lp
				end
				device.Muted = false
			end)
			bindMic(device)
			local quiet = true
			pcall(function()
				local rms = micAnalyzer and (micAnalyzer.RmsLevel or 0) or 0
				local peak = micAnalyzer and (micAnalyzer.PeakLevel or 0) or 0
				if rms > 0.0004 or peak > 0.0004 then
					quiet = false
				end
			end)
			if quiet then
				micQuiet = micQuiet + 1
				-- no voice rejoin here any more; it kicked people out of VC
			else
				micQuiet = 0
			end
			return device
		end

		pcall(function()
			RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("PrismMicArm")
		end)
		RunService:BindToRenderStep("PrismMicArm", Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value, function()
			local d = micBound
			if d and d.Parent then
				pcall(function()
					if d.Muted then
						d.Muted = false
					end
				end)
			end
		end)
		pcall(ensureLocalMic)
		local acc = 0
		local loudAcc = 0
		local loud = 0
		local loudSmooth = 0
		local lineAcc = 0
		conns[#conns + 1] = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
			acc = acc + dt
			if acc < 0.05 then
				return
			end
			local step = acc
			acc = 0
			loudAcc = loudAcc + step
			if loudAcc > 0.12 then
				loudAcc = 0
				local best = 0
				-- the scan walks your whole character and every player's head, so only do it when the stage
				-- bars are in range or music is actually playing
				local scanNeeded = false
				do
					local song, cine = _G._PrismSong, _G._PrismCinemaSound
					if (song and song.Parent and song.IsPlaying) or (cine and cine.Parent and cine.IsPlaying) then
						scanNeeded = true
					elseif #stageBars > 0 then
						local hrp0 = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
						if hrp0 then
							local d0 = hrp0.Position - stageCenter
							local reach0 = (stageRadius or 115) + 30
							if Vector3.new(d0.X, 0, d0.Z).Magnitude < reach0 and math.abs(d0.Y) < 80 then
								scanNeeded = true
							end
						end
					end
				end
				if scanNeeded then pcall(function()
					ensureLocalMic()
					local function consider(s)
						if s and s:IsA("Sound") and s.IsPlaying then
							local l = 0
							pcall(function()
								l = s.PlaybackLoudness or 0
							end)
							if l > best then
								best = l
							end
						end
					end
					consider(_G._PrismSong)
					consider(_G._PrismCinemaSound)
					local bags = { game:GetService("SoundService") }
					local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
					if cam then
						bags[#bags + 1] = cam
					end
					if lp.Character then
						bags[#bags + 1] = lp.Character
					end
					for _, bag in ipairs(bags) do
						local list
						local deep = bag == lp.Character
						pcall(function()
							list = deep and bag:GetDescendants() or bag:GetChildren()
						end)
						if list then
							for _, s in ipairs(list) do
								consider(s)
							end
						end
					end
					for _, plr in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
						local head = plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
						if head then
							for _, s in ipairs(head:GetChildren()) do
								consider(s)
							end
						end
					end
					if micAnalyzer and micAnalyzer.Parent then
						local rms, peak = 0, 0
						pcall(function()
							rms = micAnalyzer.RmsLevel or 0
							peak = micAnalyzer.PeakLevel or 0
						end)
						local micLoud = math.max(rms or 0, peak or 0)
						if micLoud > 0 and micLoud < 0.05 then
							micLoud = micLoud * 8000
						elseif micLoud <= 2 then
							micLoud = micLoud * 1800
						elseif micLoud < 40 then
							micLoud = micLoud * 28
						end
						if micLoud > best then
							best = micLoud
						end
						local spec = readSpec(micAnalyzer)
						if spec then
							local sum, n = 0, math.min(#spec, 32)
							for i = 1, n do
								sum = sum + math.abs(spec[i] or 0)
							end
							if n > 0 and sum > 0.004 then
								_G._PrismSpectrum = spec
								local specLoud = sum / n
								if specLoud <= 2 then
									specLoud = specLoud * 900
								end
								if specLoud > best then
									best = specLoud
								end
							end
						end
					end
					local net = tonumber(_G._PrismNetLoud) or 0
					if net > 0 and os.clock() - (tonumber(_G._PrismNetAt) or 0) < 2.8 and net > best then
						best = net
					end
					local cineSnd = _G._PrismCinemaSound
					if best < 8 and cineSnd and cineSnd.Parent and cineSnd.IsPlaying then
						local tp = 0
						pcall(function()
							tp = cineSnd.TimePosition or 0
						end)
						local pulse = math.abs(math.sin(tp * 7.2)) * 0.65 + math.abs(math.sin(tp * 2.2)) * 0.35
						best = math.max(best, 42 + pulse * 150)
						local spec = table.create(24)
						for i = 1, 24 do
							spec[i] = math.abs(math.sin(tp * (2.2 + i * 0.27) + i)) * (0.32 + pulse)
						end
						_G._PrismSpectrum = spec
					end
					if best > 22 and type(_G._PrismSyncLoud) == "function" then
						_G._PrismSyncLoud(best)
					end
					local beat = tonumber(_G._PrismBeat) or 0
					if beat > 0.08 then
						local fromBeat = beat * 240
						if fromBeat > best then
							best = fromBeat
						end
					end
				end) else pcall(ensureLocalMic) end
				loudSmooth = loudSmooth + (best - loudSmooth) * 0.5
				loud = loudSmooth
				_G._PrismStageLoud = loud
			end
			local hrp = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if hrp and #stageBars > 0 then
				local delta = hrp.Position - stageCenter
				local reach = (stageRadius or 115) + 30
				local on = (Vector3.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z)).Magnitude < reach and math.abs(delta.Y) < 80
				if on then
					local t = os.clock()
					local spec = _G._PrismSpectrum
					local cols = 24
					local function unitBin(b)
						if type(b) ~= "number" or b <= 0 then
							return 0
						end
						if b <= 1.5 then
							return b * 5
						end
						if b <= 30 then
							return b / 10
						end
						return math.clamp(b / 180, 0, 1.3)
					end
					local loudN = math.clamp(loud / 160, 0, 1.35)
					local colN = table.create(cols)
					for c = 1, cols do
						local bin = 0
						if type(spec) == "table" and #spec > 0 then
							local idx = math.clamp(math.floor((c - 1) / cols * #spec) + 1, 1, #spec)
							bin = unitBin(spec[idx])
						end
						local shape = (0.42 + 0.58 * math.abs(math.sin(c * 0.62 + t * (5.5 + loudN * 6)))) * loudN
						colN[c] = math.max(shape, bin)
					end
					local reel = _G._PrismReel
					if type(reel) ~= "table" or #reel == 0 then
						reel = {}
						if marsTex then
							reel[#reel + 1] = marsTex
						end
						if jupTex then
							reel[#reel + 1] = jupTex
						end
						if satTex then
							reel[#reel + 1] = satTex
						end
						if nepTex then
							reel[#reel + 1] = nepTex
						end
						if starTex then
							reel[#reel + 1] = starTex
						end
						_G._PrismReel = reel
					end
					if #reel > 0 and not _G._PrismCinemaHold then
						local frame = reel[(math.floor(t / 4.5) % #reel) + 1]
						for _, img in ipairs(stageScreens) do
							if img and img.Parent and img.Image ~= frame then
								img.Image = frame
							end
						end
					end
					if _G._PrismCinemaStatus and _G._PrismCinemaCap and _G._PrismCinemaStatus.Text ~= _G._PrismCinemaCap.Text then
						_G._PrismCinemaStatus.Text = _G._PrismCinemaCap.Text
					end
					local cover = _G._PrismCoverAsset
					local title = _G._PrismCinemaTitle
					local hold = _G._PrismCinemaHold
					for _, j in ipairs(stageJumbo) do
						if j.img and j.img.Parent then
							if hold and type(cover) == "string" and cover ~= "" then
								if j.img.Image ~= cover then
									j.img.Image = cover
								end
							elseif #reel > 0 then
								local frame = reel[(math.floor(t / 4.5) % #reel) + 1]
								if j.img.Image ~= frame then
									j.img.Image = frame
								end
							end
						end
						if j.cap and j.cap.Parent then
							local tx = "LIVE"
							if hold and type(title) == "string" and title ~= "" then
								tx = title
							end
							if j.cap.Text ~= tx then
								j.cap.Text = tx
							end
						end
					end
					for _, bar in ipairs(stageBars) do
						local e = colN[bar.col] or 0
						local need = (bar.row or 1) / 8
						local level = 0
						if e > 0.05 then
							level = math.clamp((e - need + 0.2) / 0.5, 0, 1)
						end
						bar.shown = (bar.shown or 0) + (level - (bar.shown or 0)) * 0.55
						local shown = bar.shown
						local colr
						if shown < 0.08 then
							colr = Color3.fromRGB(22, 8, 14)
						elseif (bar.row or 1) >= 7 or (bar.meter and shown > 0.72) then
							colr = Color3.fromRGB(255, 236, 220)
						elseif (bar.row or 1) >= 4 or (bar.meter and shown > 0.4) then
							colr = Color3.fromRGB(255, 54, 112)
						else
							colr = Color3.fromRGB(120, 18, 46)
						end
						if bar.gui and bar.gui.Parent then
							bar.gui.BackgroundColor3 = colr
							bar.gui.BackgroundTransparency = 0.86 - shown * 0.82
						end
						local p3 = bar.part
						if p3 and p3.Parent and bar.meter and bar.base then
							local maxH = bar.maxH or 8
							local h = math.max(0.18, shown * maxH)
							p3.Size = Vector3.new(bar.width or 0.6, h, bar.depth or 0.3)
							p3.CFrame = bar.base * CFrame.new(0, h * 0.5, 0)
							p3.Color = colr
							p3.Transparency = shown > 0.05 and 0.08 or 0.55
						elseif p3 and p3.Parent and bar.cell then
							p3.Color = colr
							p3.Transparency = 0.88 - shown * 0.8
						end
					end
					local kick = math.clamp(loud / 340, 0, 1)
					for _, tile in ipairs(stageTiles) do
						if tile and tile.Parent then
							tile.Transparency = math.clamp(0.55 - kick * 0.4, 0.08, 0.92)
						end
					end
					for _, L in ipairs(stageLights) do
						local lp2 = L.part
						if lp2 and lp2.Parent and L.base then
							local spd = L.speed * (1 + kick * 2.4)
							if L.laser then
								lp2.CFrame = L.base * CFrame.Angles(0, math.sin(t * spd) * (0.35 + kick * 0.5), 0)
								lp2.Transparency = 0.15 + (1 - kick) * 0.45
							else
								lp2.CFrame = L.base * CFrame.Angles(math.sin(t * spd) * 0.45, math.cos(t * spd * 0.8) * 0.6, 0)
								if L.spot then
									L.spot.Brightness = 1.4 + kick * 6
								end
							end
						end
					end
					for i, ring in ipairs(stageRings) do
						if ring and ring.Parent then
							ring.Transparency = 0.08 + (1 - kick) * 0.45
							if ring.Name == "HaloSpin" then
								ring.CFrame = CFrame.new(ring.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, t * (1.2 + kick * 3), math.rad(90))
							end
						end
					end
					for _, em in ipairs(stageFx) do
						if em and em.Parent then
						em.Rate = 2 + kick * 6
						end
					end
				end
			end
			local spin = _G._PrismPortalSpin
			if type(spin) == "table" and spin.disc and spin.disc.Parent and spin.pos then
				spin.t = (spin.t or 0) + step
				spin.disc.CFrame = CFrame.new(spin.pos) * CFrame.Angles(0, spin.t * 1.3, 0)
				if spin.light then
					spin.light.Brightness = 5 + math.sin(spin.t * 6) * 1.4
				end
			end
			if protectOn then
				local hum = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if hum and hum.Health > 0 and hum.Health < hum.MaxHealth then
					hum.Health = hum.MaxHealth
				end
			end
			lineAcc = lineAcc + step
			if lineAcc > 3.5 and hrp then
				lineAcc = 0
				for _, entry in ipairs(npcs) do
					local p = entry.part
					if p and p.Parent and (p.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude < 50 then
						entry.i = entry.i % #entry.lines + 1
						entry.label.Text = entry.name .. ": " .. entry.lines[entry.i]
						p.CFrame = entry.base * CFrame.new(0, math.sin(os.clock() * 2) * 0.15, 0)
					elseif p and p.Parent then
						entry.label.Text = entry.name
					end
				end
			end
		end)

		-- Protection used to only get re-applied by the heartbeat loop below,
		-- which could let a big hit show on the healthbar for a frame before
		-- it got healed back. Hooking HealthChanged directly makes it heal
		-- back the instant any damage lands.
		local function hookProtectHealth(char)
			local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if not hum then return end
			conns[#conns + 1] = hum.HealthChanged:Connect(function(h)
				if protectOn and h > 0 and h < hum.MaxHealth then
					hum.Health = hum.MaxHealth
				end
			end)
		end
		hookProtectHealth(lp.Character)

		conns[#conns + 1] = lp.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
			hookProtectHealth(char)
			if brickOn then
				task.wait(0.4)
				applyBrick(char)
			end
		end)

		local function paint(frame)
			if not vexId or not frame or frame:FindFirstChild("VexoraBG") then
				return
			end
			frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			local img = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
			img.Name = "VexoraBG"
			img.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			img.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
			img.Image = vexId
			img.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop
			img.ZIndex = 30
			img.Parent = frame
			local veil = Instance.new("Frame")
			veil.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
			veil.BackgroundTransparency = 0.42
			veil.BorderSizePixel = 0
			veil.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
			veil.ZIndex = 30
			veil.Parent = img
		end

		task.spawn(function()
			loadAssets()
			if sfxId then
				local s = Instance.new("Sound")
				s.Name = "PrismPortalSfx"
				s.SoundId = sfxId
				s.Volume = 1
				s.Parent = pg
				sfxSound = s
			end
			local menu = findGui("ReanimMenu")
			paint(menu)
			if type(_G._PrismHideFullMenu) == "function" then
				_G._PrismHideFullMenu()
			end
		end)


		local cineGen = 0
		local function cineHttp(url, method, headers, body)
			local req = request or http_request or (syn and syn.request) or (http and http.request)
			if type(req) == "function" then
				local opts = {
					Url = url,
					Method = method or "GET",
					Headers = headers or {},
				}
				if body ~= nil then
					opts.Body = body
				end
				local ok, resp = pcall(req, opts)
				if ok and type(resp) == "table" then
					local b = resp.Body or resp.body
					if type(b) == "string" and #b > 0 then
						return b
					end
				end
			end
			if (method or "GET") == "GET" then
				local ok, b = pcall(function()
					return game:HttpGet(url, true)
				end)
				if ok and type(b) == "string" and #b > 0 then
					return b
				end
			end
			return nil
		end
		local function cineJson(s)
			if type(s) ~= "string" or s == "" then return nil end
			local ok, data = pcall(function()
				return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(s)
			end)
			if ok and type(data) == "table" then
				return data
			end
			return nil
		end
		local function cineId(raw)
			raw = tostring(raw or ""):gsub("%s+", "")
			if raw == "" then return nil end
			local id = raw:match("[?&]v=([%w_%-]+)")
				or raw:match("youtu%.be/([%w_%-]+)")
				or raw:match("shorts/([%w_%-]+)")
				or raw:match("embed/([%w_%-]+)")
				or raw:match("^([%w_%-]+)$")
			if id and #id >= 11 then
				return id:sub(1, 11)
			end
			return nil
		end
		local function cinePick(list, mux, audio)
			if type(list) ~= "table" then return mux, audio end
			for _, s in ipairs(list) do
				local u = s.url
				if type(u) == "string" and #u > 24 and not u:find("manifest") then
					local itag = tonumber(s.itag) or 0
					local mime = tostring(s.mimeType or "")
					if itag == 18 then
						mux = u
					elseif itag == 22 and not mux then
						mux = u
					elseif mime:find("video/mp4") and mime:find("audio") and not mux then
						mux = u
					elseif mime:find("audio/") and not audio then
						audio = u
					end
				end
			end
			return mux, audio
		end
		local function cineStreams(id)
			local clients = {
				{ name = "ANDROID", ver = "20.10.38", num = "3", extra = '"androidSdkVersion":34,', ua = "com.google.android.youtube/20.10.38 (Linux; U; Android 14) gzip" },
				{ name = "ANDROID_VR", ver = "1.60.19", num = "28", extra = '"androidSdkVersion":32,', ua = "com.google.android.apps.youtube.vr.oculus/1.60.19 (Linux; U; Android 12; GB) gzip" },
			}
			for _, c in ipairs(clients) do
				local payload = '{"context":{"client":{"clientName":"'
					.. c.name
					.. '","clientVersion":"'
					.. c.ver
					.. '",'
					.. c.extra
					.. '"hl":"en","gl":"US"}},"videoId":"'
					.. id
					.. '","contentCheckOk":true,"racyCheckOk":true}'
				local body = cineHttp("https://www.youtube.com/youtubei/v1/player?key=AIzaSyAO_FJ2SlqU8Q4STEHLGCilw_Y9_11qcW8&prettyPrint=false", "POST", {
					["Content-Type"] = "application/json",
					["User-Agent"] = c.ua,
					["X-YouTube-Client-Name"] = c.num,
					["X-YouTube-Client-Version"] = c.ver,
				}, payload)
				local data = cineJson(body)
				local sd = data and data.streamingData
				if sd then
					local mux, audio = nil, nil
					mux, audio = cinePick(sd.formats, mux, audio)
					mux, audio = cinePick(sd.adaptiveFormats, mux, audio)
					local title = data.videoDetails and data.videoDetails.title
					if mux or audio then
						return mux, audio, title
					end
				end
			end
			local hosts = {
				"https://api.piped.private.coffee",
				"https://pipedapi.adminforge.de",
				"https://api.piped.projectsegfau.lt",
			}
			for _, host in ipairs(hosts) do
				local data = cineJson(cineHttp(host .. "/streams/" .. id))
				if type(data) == "table" then
					local mux, audio
					if type(data.videoStreams) == "table" then
						for _, s in ipairs(data.videoStreams) do
							if s.videoOnly == false and type(s.url) == "string" then
								mux = s.url
								break
							end
						end
					end
					if type(data.audioStreams) == "table" then
						for _, s in ipairs(data.audioStreams) do
							if type(s.url) == "string" then
								audio = s.url
								break
							end
						end
					end
					if mux or audio then
						return mux, audio, data.title
					end
				end
			end
			return nil, nil, nil
		end
		local function cineSave(url, name)
			local body = cineHttp(url, "GET", {
				["User-Agent"] = "com.google.android.youtube/20.10.38 (Linux; U; Android 14) gzip",
				["Referer"] = "https://www.youtube.com/",
				["Origin"] = "https://www.youtube.com",
			})
			if type(body) ~= "string" or #body < 20000 or #body > 42000000 then
				return nil
			end
			if body:sub(1, 1) == "<" or body:sub(1, 1) == "{" then
				return nil
			end
			if tostring(name):find("mp4") and not body:find("ftyp", 1, true) then
				return nil
			end
			local path = "prism_" .. name
			local ok = pcall(function()
				writefile(path, body)
			end)
			if not ok or type(getcustomasset) ~= "function" then
				return nil
			end
			local asset
			pcall(function()
				asset = getcustomasset(path)
			end)
			if type(asset) == "string" and #asset > 5 then
				return asset
			end
			return nil
		end
		local function cineStop(quiet)
			cineGen = cineGen + 1
			_G._PrismCinemaHold = false
			_G._PrismCinemaTitle = nil
			local s = _G._PrismCinemaSound
			if s then
				pcall(function()
					s:Stop()
					s:Destroy()
				end)
			end
			_G._PrismCinemaSound = nil
			local vid = _G._PrismCinemaVideo
			if vid then
				pcall(function()
					vid:Pause()
				end)
				vid.Visible = false
			end
			if _G._PrismCinemaCap then
				_G._PrismCinemaCap.Text = "WALK TO THE BOOTH  ·  PASTE A YOUTUBE LINK"
			end
			if not quiet and type(_G._PrismSyncSend) == "function" then
				_G._PrismSyncSend(string.format("pcX %d", lp.UserId))
			end
		end
		function _G._PrismPlayCinema(raw, quiet)
			local id = cineId(raw)
			if not id then
				if _G._PrismCinemaCap then
					_G._PrismCinemaCap.Text = "NEED A YOUTUBE LINK"
				end
				return
			end
			cineGen = cineGen + 1
			local gen = cineGen
			local seek = tonumber(_G._PrismCinemaSeek) or 0
			_G._PrismCinemaSeek = 0
			if not quiet and type(_G._PrismSyncSend) == "function" then
				local tnow = 0
				pcall(function()
					tnow = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
				end)
				_G._PrismSyncSend(string.format("pcY %d %s %.2f", lp.UserId, id, tnow))
			end
			task.spawn(function()
				local waited = 0
				while not (_G._PrismCinemaScreen and _G._PrismCinemaScreen.Parent) and waited < 8 do
					task.wait(0.2)
					waited = waited + 0.2
				end
				if gen ~= cineGen then return end
				_G._PrismCinemaHold = true
				_G._PrismCinemaTitle = "LOADING"
				local thumb = "https://i.ytimg.com/vi/" .. id .. "/hqdefault.jpg"
				_G._PrismCoverAsset = thumb
				if _G._PrismCinemaPoster then
					_G._PrismCinemaPoster.Image = thumb
				end
				if _G._PrismCinemaPoster2 then
					_G._PrismCinemaPoster2.Image = thumb
				end
				if _G._PrismCinemaCap then
					_G._PrismCinemaCap.Text = "LOADING"
				end
				local mux, audio, title = cineStreams(id)
				if gen ~= cineGen then return end
				if type(title) == "string" and title ~= "" then
					_G._PrismCinemaTitle = title
					if _G._PrismCinemaCap then
						_G._PrismCinemaCap.Text = title
					end
				end
				local fileUrl = mux or audio
				if not fileUrl then
					if _G._PrismCinemaCap then
						_G._PrismCinemaCap.Text = "COULD NOT LOAD THAT VIDEO"
					end
					return
				end
				local asset = cineSave(fileUrl, mux and "cine.mp4" or "cine.mp3")
				if gen ~= cineGen then return end
				if not asset then
					if _G._PrismCinemaCap then
						_G._PrismCinemaCap.Text = "DOWNLOAD FAILED"
					end
					return
				end
				local screen = _G._PrismCinemaScreen
				local old = screen and screen:FindFirstChild("PrismCinemaSound")
				if old then
					old:Destroy()
				end
				local snd = Instance.new("Sound")
				snd.Name = "PrismCinemaSound"
				snd.SoundId = asset
				snd.Volume = 1.35
				snd.Looped = false
				snd.RollOffMode = Enum.RollOffMode.Linear
				snd.RollOffMinDistance = 30
				snd.RollOffMaxDistance = 280
				snd.Parent = (screen and screen.Parent and screen) or workspace
				_G._PrismCinemaSound = snd
				local function armVideo(vid)
					if not vid then return end
					vid.Video = asset
					vid.Visible = true
					vid.Volume = 0
					vid.Looped = true
					pcall(function()
						vid:Play()
					end)
					pcall(function()
						vid.Playing = true
					end)
				end
				if mux then
					armVideo(_G._PrismCinemaVideo)
					armVideo(_G._PrismCinemaVideo2)
					if _G._PrismCinemaCap then
						_G._PrismCinemaCap.Text = "PLAYING"
					end
				else
					if _G._PrismCinemaVideo then
						_G._PrismCinemaVideo.Visible = false
					end
					if _G._PrismCinemaVideo2 then
						_G._PrismCinemaVideo2.Visible = false
					end
					if _G._PrismCinemaCap then
						_G._PrismCinemaCap.Text = "AUDIO ONLY"
					end
				end
				snd.Looped = true
				snd.Volume = 1.6
				snd.Parent = game:GetService("SoundService")
				snd:Play()
				task.spawn(function()
					for _ = 1, 12 do
						if gen ~= cineGen then return end
						if mux then
							armVideo(_G._PrismCinemaVideo)
							armVideo(_G._PrismCinemaVideo2)
						end
						if snd.Parent and not snd.IsPlaying then
							pcall(function()
								snd:Play()
							end)
						end
						task.wait(0.45)
					end
				end)

				if seek > 1.2 then
					pcall(function()
						snd.TimePosition = seek
						if vid then
							vid.TimePosition = seek
						end
					end)
				end
			end)
		end
		function _G._PrismOpenCinema()
		end
		local function syncTopic()
			if type(_G._PrismSyncTopic) == "string" then
				return _G._PrismSyncTopic
			end
			local raw = tostring(game.PlaceId) .. ":" .. tostring(game.JobId)
			local h = 0
			for i = 1, #raw do
				h = (h * 131 + string.byte(raw, i)) % 1000000007
			end
			_G._PrismSyncTopic = "prism" .. tostring(h)
			return _G._PrismSyncTopic
		end
		local function ntfyPost(body)
			cineHttp("https://ntfy.sh/" .. syncTopic(), "POST", { Title = "prism", ["User-Agent"] = "prism" }, body)
		end
		_G._PrismSyncSend = function(body)
			task.spawn(function()
				pcall(ntfyPost, body)
			end)
		end
		_G._PrismSyncLoud = function(n)
			local now = os.clock()
			if now - (tonumber(_G._PrismLoudSent) or 0) < 1.15 then
				return
			end
			_G._PrismLoudSent = now
			task.spawn(function()
				pcall(ntfyPost, string.format("pcB %d %d", lp.UserId, math.clamp(math.floor(n + 0.5), 0, 999)))
			end)
		end
		local function onSync(text)
			if type(text) ~= "string" then return end
			local kind = text:sub(1, 3)
			if kind ~= "pcS" and kind ~= "pcY" and kind ~= "pcX" and kind ~= "pcB" then
				return
			end
			if kind ~= "pcB" then
				if text == _G._PrismLastSync then return end
				_G._PrismLastSync = text
			end
			if kind == "pcS" then
				local uid, x, y, z, lx, lz, t = text:match("^pcS (%d+) ([%-]?%d+) ([%-]?%d+) ([%-]?%d+) ([%-]?%d+) ([%-]?%d+) ([%d%.%-]+)")
				uid = tonumber(uid)
				if not uid or uid == lp.UserId then return end
				t = tonumber(t) or 0
				if _G._PrismPoseTime and t >= _G._PrismPoseTime - 0.02 then return end
				local lookv = Vector3.new(tonumber(lx) or 0, 0, tonumber(lz) or 1)
				if lookv.Magnitude < 0.4 then
					lookv = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
				else
					lookv = lookv.Unit
				end
				local pos = Vector3.new(tonumber(x) or 0, tonumber(y) or 0, tonumber(z) or 0)
				_G._PrismSharedPose = { p = pos, l = lookv }
				_G._PrismPoseTime = t
				if (stageCenter - (pos + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0))).Magnitude > 8 then
					buildStage()
				end
			elseif kind == "pcY" then
				local uid, id, t = text:match("^pcY (%d+) ([%w_%-]+) ([%d%.%-]+)")
				uid = tonumber(uid)
				if not uid or uid == lp.UserId or not id then return end
				local startAt = tonumber(t) or 0
				local nowt = 0
				pcall(function()
					nowt = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
				end)
				local seek = 0
				if nowt > 0 and startAt > 0 then
					seek = math.max(0, nowt - startAt)
				end
				if seek > 1800 then return end
				_G._PrismCinemaSeek = seek
				_G._PrismPlayCinema(id, true)
			elseif kind == "pcX" then
				local uid = tonumber(text:match("^pcX (%d+)"))
				if not uid or uid == lp.UserId then return end
				cineStop(true)
			elseif kind == "pcB" then
				local uid, n = text:match("^pcB (%d+) (%d+)")
				uid = tonumber(uid)
				if not uid or uid == lp.UserId then return end
				_G._PrismNetLoud = tonumber(n) or 0
				_G._PrismNetAt = os.clock()
			end
		end
		_G._PrismOnSync = onSync
		pcall(function()
			local tcs = game:GetService("TextChatService")
			if not _G._PrismChatHide then
				_G._PrismChatHide = true
				local prev = tcs.OnIncomingMessage
				tcs.OnIncomingMessage = function(message)
					local props
					if type(prev) == "function" then
						local ok, res = pcall(prev, message)
						if ok and typeof(res) == "Instance" then
							props = res
						end
					end
					if not props then
						props = Instance.new("TextChatMessageProperties")
					end
					local tx = tostring(message.Text or "")
					local h3 = tx:sub(1, 3)
					if h3 == "pcS" or h3 == "pcY" or h3 == "pcX" or h3 == "pcB" then
						props.Text = " "
					end
					return props
				end
			end
			if not _G._PrismChatHook then
				_G._PrismChatHook = true
				task.spawn(function()
					local folder = tcs:FindFirstChild("TextChannels") or tcs:WaitForChild("TextChannels", 8)
					local ch = folder and (folder:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral") or folder:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextChannel"))
					if ch then
						ch.MessageReceived:Connect(function(msg)
							if type(_G._PrismOnSync) == "function" then
								_G._PrismOnSync(msg.Text)
							end
						end)
					end
				end)
			end
		end)
		if not _G._PrismLegacySync then
			_G._PrismLegacySync = true
			local function hookTalk(plr)
				plr.Chatted:Connect(function(msg)
					if type(_G._PrismOnSync) == "function" then
						_G._PrismOnSync(msg)
					end
				end)
			end
			for _, plr in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
				hookTalk(plr)
			end
			game:GetService("Players").PlayerAdded:Connect(hookTalk)
		end
		if not _G._PrismSyncLoop then
			_G._PrismSyncLoop = true
			task.spawn(function()
				local since = "all"
				while true do
					local topic = _G._PrismSyncTopic or syncTopic()
					local body = cineHttp("https://ntfy.sh/" .. topic .. "/json?poll=1&since=" .. since)
					if type(body) == "string" then
						for line in body:gmatch("[^\n]+") do
							local data = cineJson(line)
							if type(data) == "table" and data.event == "message" and type(data.message) == "string" then
								if type(_G._PrismOnSync) == "function" then
									_G._PrismOnSync(data.message)
								end
								if type(data.id) == "string" and data.id ~= "" then
									since = data.id
								end
							end
						end
					end
					task.wait(2)
				end
			end)
		end

		pcall(buildStage)
		task.delay(1, function()
			if type(_G._PrismHideFullMenu) == "function" then
				_G._PrismHideFullMenu()
			end
			refreshReanim()
		end)
	end)
	if not okPack then
		warn("[Prism pack] " .. tostring(packErr))
	end
end)

-- Tranzit lands. Rifts are physical doors on the map, not a menu.
task.defer(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		local Players = game:GetService("Players")
		local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
		local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
		local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
		if not lp then return end
		local pg = lp:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 20)
		if not pg then return end

		for _, n in ipairs({ "PrismCinemaGui", "PrismCursor", "PrismCursorWall", "PrismCursorDock", "TranzitCursorDraw", "PrismWorlds" }) do
			local old = pg:FindFirstChild(n)
			if old then old:Destroy() end
		end
		local oldLands = workspace:FindFirstChild("TranzitLands")
		if oldLands then oldLands:Destroy() end
		for _, name in ipairs({ "TranzitGreenRunRift", "PrismPortal", "PrismHouse", "PrismPocket", "PrismVista", "PrismCinema" }) do
			local old = workspace:FindFirstChild(name)
			if old then old:Destroy() end
		end
		for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
			if d.Name == "Rift" then d:Destroy() end
		end
		do return end

		local root = Instance.new("Folder")
		root.Name = "TranzitLands"
		root.Parent = workspace

		local function part(parent, size, cf, color, mat, collide)
			local p = Instance.new("Part")
			p.Size = size
			p.CFrame = cf
			p.Color = color
			p.Material = mat or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			p.Anchored = true
			p.CanCollide = collide ~= false
			p.CastShadow = true
			p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
			p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
			p.Parent = parent
			return p
		end


		local hud = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
		hud.Name = "TranzitAnim"
		hud.ResetOnSpawn = false
		hud.IgnoreGuiInset = true
		hud.DisplayOrder = 30
		hud.Parent = pg
		local bar = Instance.new("Frame")
		bar.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
		bar.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 10)
		bar.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(340, 36)
		bar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 18, 14)
		bar.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
		bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
		bar.Parent = hud
		Instance.new("UICorner", bar).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
		local an = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		an.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		an.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 2)
		an.Size = UDim2.new(1, -120, 0, 18)
		an.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
		an.TextSize = 13
		an.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		an.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(236, 214, 186)
		an.Text = "No animation"
		an.Parent = bar
		local tm = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		tm.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		tm.Position = UDim2.new(1, -110, 0, 2)
		tm.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(100, 18)
		tm.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
		tm.TextSize = 12
		tm.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
		tm.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(186, 150, 120)
		tm.Text = "0:00  /  0:00"
		tm.Parent = bar
		local track = Instance.new("Frame")
		track.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 26)
		track.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 4)
		track.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 36, 28)
		track.BorderSizePixel = 0
		track.Parent = bar
		Instance.new("UICorner", track).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
		local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
		fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
		fill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(168, 52, 36)
		fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
		fill.Parent = track
		Instance.new("UICorner", fill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
		local function fmt(s)
			s = math.max(0, tonumber(s) or 0)
			return string.format("%d:%02d", math.floor(s / 60), math.floor(s % 60))
		end
		task.spawn(function()
			while hud.Parent do
				local name, tpos, len = "No animation", 0, 0
				local infoNow = _G._PrismAnimNow
				if type(infoNow) == "table" and infoNow.on and (os.clock() - (infoNow.tick or 0)) < 0.4 then
					name = tostring(infoNow.name or "Animation")
					tpos = infoNow.t or 0
					len = infoNow.len or 0
				else
					local char = lp.Character
					local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
					local animator = hum and hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
					if animator then
						local best
						for _, tr in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
							if tr.IsPlaying and (not best or tr.TimePosition > best.TimePosition) then
								best = tr
							end
						end
						if best then
							name = best.Name
							local okName, animName = pcall(function()
								return best.Animation and best.Animation.Name
							end)
							if okName and animName and animName ~= "" then
								name = animName
							end
							tpos = best.TimePosition
							len = best.Length
						end
					end
				end
				if #name > 36 then
					name = name:sub(1, 34) .. ".."
				end
				an.Text = name
				tm.Text = fmt(tpos) .. "  /  " .. fmt(len)
				fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale((len > 0) and math.clamp(tpos / len, 0, 1) or 0, 1)
				task.wait(0.15)
			end
		end)

		local function tp(cf)
			local char = lp.Character
			local r = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not r then return end
			pcall(function()
				r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
				r.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
			end)
			pcall(function()
				char:PivotTo(cf)
			end)
		end

		local spinRings = {}
		local function makeRift(parent, pos, look, title, accent, destFn)
			local model = Instance.new("Model")
			model.Name = "Rift"
			model.Parent = parent
			local baseCf = CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + look)
			part(model, Vector3.new(28, 1.1, 28), baseCf * CFrame.new(0, 0.4, 0), Color3.fromRGB(38, 40, 44), Enum.Material.DiamondPlate, true)
			part(model, Vector3.new(18, 0.25, 18), baseCf * CFrame.new(0, 1.05, 0), Color3.fromRGB(18, 22, 26), Enum.Material.Metal, false)
			local nseg = 26
			local radius = 9.2
			for i = 1, nseg do
				local a = (i / nseg) * math.pi * 2
				local y = math.sin(a) * radius
				local x = math.cos(a) * radius
				local seg = part(model, Vector3.new(1.35, 1.55, 1.7), baseCf * CFrame.new(x, y + radius + 1.4, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, a), Color3.fromRGB(28, 30, 34), Enum.Material.Metal, false)
				if i % 3 == 0 then
					seg.Color = accent
					seg.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
				end
			end
			local ring = Instance.new("Model")
			ring.Name = "Spin"
			ring.Parent = model
			for i = 1, 18 do
				local a = (i / 18) * math.pi * 2
				local y = math.sin(a) * 7.2
				local x = math.cos(a) * 7.2
				part(ring, Vector3.new(0.7, 0.35, 1.5), baseCf * CFrame.new(x, y + radius + 1.4, 0.6) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, a), accent, Enum.Material.Neon, false)
			end
			spinRings[#spinRings + 1] = { model = ring, cf = baseCf, radius = radius }
			local sheet = part(model, Vector3.new(12.5, 15.5, 0.35), baseCf * CFrame.new(0, radius + 1.2, 0), accent, Enum.Material.ForceField, false)
			sheet.Transparency = 0.45
			sheet.CanCollide = false
			local gate = part(model, Vector3.new(8, 12, 3), baseCf * CFrame.new(0, 7.2, 0), accent, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, false)
			gate.Transparency = 1
			gate.CanTouch = true
			local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
			light.Color = accent
			light.Brightness = 2.4
			light.Range = 22
			light.Parent = sheet
			local beam = part(model, Vector3.new(1.2, 70, 1.2), baseCf * CFrame.new(0, 46, 0), accent, Enum.Material.Neon, false)
			beam.Transparency = 0.78
			local em = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
			em.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
			em.Rate = 14
			em.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.8, 1.6)
			em.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.4, 2)
			em.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
			em.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.35, 0)
			em.Color = ColorSequence.new(accent, Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
			em.LightEmission = 0.7
			em.Parent = sheet
			local plaque = part(model, Vector3.new(10, 1.6, 0.3), baseCf * CFrame.new(0, 0.9, -8), Color3.fromRGB(22, 18, 16), Enum.Material.Metal, false)
			local sg = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
			sg.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
			sg.Parent = plaque
			local lab = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			lab.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			lab.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
			lab.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
			lab.TextScaled = true
			lab.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(236, 220, 196)
			lab.Text = title
			lab.Parent = sg
			local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
			prompt.ActionText = "Enter"
			prompt.ObjectText = title
			prompt.HoldDuration = 0
			prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 16
			prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
			prompt.Parent = plaque
			local function go(who)
				if who and who ~= lp then return end
				local char = lp.Character
				local r = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if r and title ~= "RETURN" then
					_G._TranzitReturn = r.CFrame
				end
				local target = destFn()
				if typeof(target) == "CFrame" then
					tp(target)
				end
			end
			prompt.Triggered:Connect(go)
			gate.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
				local char = lp.Character
				if char and hit:IsDescendantOf(char) then
					if model:GetAttribute("Cool") and os.clock() - model:GetAttribute("Cool") < 1.2 then
						return
					end
					model:SetAttribute("Cool", os.clock())
					go(lp)
				end
			end)
			return model
		end

		local function tree(folder, cf, s)
			s = s or 1
			local trunk = part(folder, Vector3.new(7 * s, 1.2 * s, 1.2 * s), cf * CFrame.new(0, 3.5 * s, 0), Color3.fromRGB(92, 64, 42), Enum.Material.Wood, true)
			trunk.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
			trunk.CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(0, 3.5 * s, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
			local leaf = part(folder, Vector3.new(7 * s, 5.5 * s, 7 * s), cf * CFrame.new(0, 8.2 * s, 0), Color3.fromRGB(54, 92, 48), Enum.Material.Grass, false)
			leaf.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
		end

		local function building(folder, cf, w, d, h, wall)
			part(folder, Vector3.new(w, h, d), cf * CFrame.new(0, h / 2, 0), wall, Enum.Material.Brick, true)
			part(folder, Vector3.new(w + 1.4, 1.1, d + 1.4), cf * CFrame.new(0, h + 0.4, 0), Color3.fromRGB(46, 48, 52), Enum.Material.Slate, true)
			part(folder, Vector3.new(w * 0.72, math.clamp(h * 0.16, 1.4, 3), 0.35), cf * CFrame.new(0, h * 0.62, -d / 2 - 0.05), Color3.fromRGB(168, 196, 204), Enum.Material.Glass, false)
			part(folder, Vector3.new(3.4, 6.4, 0.4), cf * CFrame.new(0, 3.3, -d / 2 - 0.15), Color3.fromRGB(54, 38, 28), Enum.Material.Wood, true)
		end

		local function sign(folder, cf, text)
			part(folder, Vector3.new(0.5, 5, 0.5), cf * CFrame.new(-4.2, 2.5, 0), Color3.fromRGB(92, 64, 42), Enum.Material.Wood, true)
			part(folder, Vector3.new(0.5, 5, 0.5), cf * CFrame.new(4.2, 2.5, 0), Color3.fromRGB(92, 64, 42), Enum.Material.Wood, true)
			local board = part(folder, Vector3.new(10, 2.4, 0.35), cf * CFrame.new(0, 5.2, 0), Color3.fromRGB(214, 186, 146), Enum.Material.Wood, false)
			local sg = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
			sg.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
			sg.Parent = board
			local lab = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			lab.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			lab.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
			lab.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
			lab.TextScaled = true
			lab.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(48, 28, 18)
			lab.Text = text
			lab.Parent = sg
		end

		local function placeHouse(folder, cf)
			local inst
			pcall(function()
				local objs = game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://17383957280")
				inst = objs and objs[1]
			end)
			if not inst then
				pcall(function()
					local m = game:GetService("InsertService"):LoadAsset(17383957280)
					inst = m and (m:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Model") or m:GetChildren()[1])
				end)
			end
			if not inst then
				building(folder, cf, 28, 22, 14, Color3.fromRGB(214, 206, 190))
				sign(folder, cf * CFrame.new(0, 0, -16), "i82's fun house")
				return
			end
			if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
				local wrap = Instance.new("Model")
				inst.Parent = wrap
				inst = wrap
			end
			inst.Name = "i82s fun house"
			inst.Parent = folder
			pcall(function()
				for _, d in ipairs(inst:GetDescendants()) do
					if d:IsA("BasePart") then
						d.Anchored = true
					end
					if d:IsA("Script") or d:IsA("LocalScript") then
						d.Disabled = true
					end
				end
			end)
			local bbCf, bbSize = inst:GetBoundingBox()
			local wide = math.max(bbSize.X, bbSize.Z)
			if wide > 160 or wide < 18 then
				pcall(function()
					local cur = inst:GetScale()
					inst:ScaleTo(cur * (72 / wide))
				end)
				bbCf, bbSize = inst:GetBoundingBox()
			end
			local pivot = inst:GetPivot()
			local bottom = bbCf.Position.Y - bbSize.Y / 2
			local want = cf.Position
			inst:PivotTo(pivot + Vector3.new(want.X - bbCf.Position.X, want.Y - bottom, want.Z - bbCf.Position.Z))
			sign(folder, cf * CFrame.new(0, 0, -math.max(18, bbSize.Z / 2 + 8)), "i82's fun house")
		end

		local function makeBot(folder, cf, name)
			local m = Instance.new("Model")
			m.Name = name
			m.Parent = folder
			local function limb(sz, c, col)
				local p = Instance.new("Part")
				p.Size = sz
				p.Color = col
				p.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
				p.Anchored = false
				p.CanCollide = false
				p.CFrame = c
				p.Parent = m
				return p
			end
			local torso = limb(Vector3.new(2, 2, 1), cf * CFrame.new(0, 3, 0), Color3.fromRGB(48, 86, 140))
			torso.Name = "Torso"
			local head = limb(Vector3.new(1.2, 1.2, 1.2), cf * CFrame.new(0, 4.6, 0), Color3.fromRGB(234, 196, 160))
			head.Name = "Head"
			local hrp = limb(Vector3.new(2, 2, 1), cf * CFrame.new(0, 3, 0), Color3.fromRGB(48, 86, 140))
			hrp.Name = "HumanoidRootPart"
			hrp.Transparency = 1
			local hum = Instance.new("Humanoid")
			hum.Parent = m
			m.PrimaryPart = hrp
			local function weld(a, b)
				local w = Instance.new("Weld")
				w.Part0 = a
				w.Part1 = b
				w.C0 = a.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(b.CFrame)
				w.Parent = a
			end
			weld(hrp, torso)
			weld(torso, head)
			for _, off in ipairs({ Vector3.new(-1.5, 3, 0), Vector3.new(1.5, 3, 0) }) do
				local arm = limb(Vector3.new(1, 2, 1), cf * CFrame.new(off), Color3.fromRGB(234, 196, 160))
				weld(torso, arm)
			end
			for _, off in ipairs({ Vector3.new(-0.5, 1, 0), Vector3.new(0.5, 1, 0) }) do
				local leg = limb(Vector3.new(1, 2, 1), cf * CFrame.new(off), Color3.fromRGB(36, 40, 48))
				weld(hrp, leg)
			end
			pcall(function()
				hum:MoveTo(cf.Position)
			end)
			return m, hum
		end

		local worlds = {}
		local function buildWorld(name, origin, kind)
			local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
			folder.Name = name
			folder.Parent = root
			local function cf(x, y, z)
				return CFrame.new(origin + Vector3.new(x, y, z))
			end
			local grassCol = kind == "night" and Color3.fromRGB(28, 42, 32) or Color3.fromRGB(86, 122, 62)
			part(folder, Vector3.new(720, 2, 720), cf(0, -1, 0), grassCol, Enum.Material.Grass, true)
			part(folder, Vector3.new(18, 0.2, 220), cf(0, 0.15, 40), Color3.fromRGB(120, 116, 108), Enum.Material.Concrete, true)
			if kind == "fun" then
				part(folder, Vector3.new(16, 0.15, 50), cf(0, 0.2, -20), Color3.fromRGB(70, 72, 76), Enum.Material.Asphalt, true)
				placeHouse(folder, cf(0, 0.2, -48))
				for i = 1, 8 do
					local side = (i % 2 == 0) and 1 or -1
					local h = 16 + (i % 4) * 6
					local wall = (i % 3 == 0) and Color3.fromRGB(176, 150, 128) or Color3.fromRGB(150, 86, 72)
					building(folder, cf(side * 28, 0, 30 + i * 22), 16, 14, h, wall)
				end
				part(folder, Vector3.new(70, 0.2, 18), cf(0, 0.2, 120), Color3.fromRGB(62, 64, 68), Enum.Material.Asphalt, true)
				local water = part(folder, Vector3.new(80, 3, 50), cf(-90, -0.4, 40), Color3.fromRGB(48, 110, 130), Enum.Material.Glass, false)
				water.Transparency = 0.35
				for i = 1, 10 do
					tree(folder, cf(-40 + (i % 5) * 16, 0, -80 - math.floor(i / 5) * 16), 0.8 + (i % 3) * 0.25)
				end
				local pts = {}
				for i = 0, 28 do
					local t = i / 28
					local ang = t * math.pi * 1.35
					pts[#pts + 1] = origin + Vector3.new(120 + math.cos(ang) * 55, 6 + math.sin(t * math.pi) * 18, -20 + math.sin(ang) * 55)
				end
				for i = 1, #pts - 1 do
					local a, b = pts[i], pts[i + 1]
					local mid = (a + b) / 2
					local len = (b - a).Magnitude
					local rail = part(folder, Vector3.new(0.45, 0.35, len), CFrame.lookAt(mid, b), Color3.fromRGB(180, 184, 188), Enum.Material.Metal, false)
					rail.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(mid, b)
					if i % 4 == 0 then
						part(folder, Vector3.new(1.1, mid.Y - origin.Y, 1.1), CFrame.new(mid.X, origin.Y + (mid.Y - origin.Y) / 2, mid.Z), Color3.fromRGB(90, 92, 96), Enum.Material.Metal, true)
					end
				end
				local cart = part(folder, Vector3.new(4, 1.2, 6), CFrame.new(pts[1] + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)), Color3.fromRGB(176, 48, 36), Enum.Material.Metal, false)
				local seat = Instance.new("Seat")
				seat.Size = Vector3.new(2, 0.6, 2)
				seat.Anchored = true
				seat.CanCollide = true
				seat.CFrame = cart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.1, 0)
				seat.Parent = folder
				local ci = 1
				task.spawn(function()
					while cart.Parent do
						ci = ci % (#pts - 1) + 1
						local a, b = pts[ci], pts[ci + 1] or pts[1]
						pcall(function()
							local look = CFrame.lookAt(a + Vector3.new(0, 2.2, 0), b + Vector3.new(0, 2.2, 0))
							cart.CFrame = look
							seat.CFrame = look * CFrame.new(0, 1.1, 0)
						end)
						task.wait(0.18)
					end
				end)
				for i = 1, 3 do
					local bot, hum = makeBot(folder, cf(-12 + i * 8, 3, 70), "Townsfolk" .. i)
					task.spawn(function()
						local spots = { cf(20, 3, 80).Position, cf(-20, 3, 100).Position, cf(10, 3, 50).Position }
						local k = 1
						while bot.Parent do
							pcall(function()
								hum:MoveTo(spots[k])
							end)
							k = k % #spots + 1
							task.wait(4)
						end
					end)
				end
			elseif kind == "night" then
				for i = 1, 7 do
					local side = (i % 2 == 0) and 1 or -1
					building(folder, cf(side * 26, 0, 20 + i * 24), 18, 14, 18 + (i % 3) * 8, Color3.fromRGB(62, 64, 72))
					local win = part(folder, Vector3.new(2, 2, 0.3), cf(side * 26, 10, 20 + i * 24 - 7.2), Color3.fromRGB(255, 186, 96), Enum.Material.Neon, false)
					local pl = Instance.new("PointLight")
					pl.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 90)
					pl.Brightness = 1.2
					pl.Range = 16
					pl.Parent = win
				end
				for i = 1, 6 do
					local lamp = part(folder, Vector3.new(0.4, 12, 0.4), cf(-8, 6, 16 + i * 28), Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 44), Enum.Material.Metal, true)
					local bulb = part(folder, Vector3.new(1.2, 0.6, 1.2), lamp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 6, 0), Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 150), Enum.Material.Neon, false)
					local pl = Instance.new("PointLight")
					pl.Brightness = 1.5
					pl.Range = 24
					pl.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 140)
					pl.Parent = bulb
				end
			else
				for i = 1, 14 do
					local ang = (i / 14) * math.pi * 2
					tree(folder, cf(math.cos(ang) * 40, 0, 30 + math.sin(ang) * 28), 0.7 + (i % 3) * 0.2)
					local flower = part(folder, Vector3.new(1.1, 0.6, 1.1), cf(math.cos(ang) * 18, 0.4, 20 + math.sin(ang) * 12), Color3.fromRGB(190 + (i % 3) * 20, 80 + (i % 4) * 20, 90), Enum.Material.Grass, false)
					flower.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
				end
				local pond = part(folder, Vector3.new(36, 2, 24), cf(50, -0.3, 20), Color3.fromRGB(70, 130, 140), Enum.Material.Glass, false)
				pond.Transparency = 0.4
				building(folder, cf(-30, 0, 10), 18, 14, 9, Color3.fromRGB(168, 140, 102))
			end
			local spawn = cf(0, 5, 18)
			worlds[name] = { folder = folder, spawn = spawn, origin = origin }
			return spawn
		end

		local funSpawn = buildWorld("Fun Land", Vector3.new(18000, 0, 18000), "fun")
		local nightSpawn = buildWorld("Midnight Mile", Vector3.new(-18000, 0, 18000), "night")
		local gardenSpawn = buildWorld("Garden Drift", Vector3.new(18000, 0, -18000), "garden")

		local function ret()
			return _G._TranzitReturn or CFrame.new(0, 8, 0)
		end
		makeRift(worlds["Fun Land"].folder, funSpawn.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0, -12), Vector3.new(0, 0, 1), "RETURN", Color3.fromRGB(186, 210, 220), ret)
		makeRift(worlds["Midnight Mile"].folder, nightSpawn.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0, -12), Vector3.new(0, 0, 1), "RETURN", Color3.fromRGB(186, 210, 220), ret)
		makeRift(worlds["Garden Drift"].folder, gardenSpawn.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0, -12), Vector3.new(0, 0, 1), "RETURN", Color3.fromRGB(186, 210, 220), ret)

		local function groundAt(x, z, hint)
			local params = RaycastParams.new()
			params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			local ignore = { root }
			if lp.Character then
				ignore[#ignore + 1] = lp.Character
			end
			params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore
			local hit = workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(x, hint + 500, z), Vector3.new(0, -1600, 0), params)
			if hit then
				return hit.Position
			end
			return Vector3.new(x, hint, z)
		end

		task.spawn(function()
			local char = lp.Character or lp.CharacterAdded:Wait()
			local hrp = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
			if not hrp then return end
			local spots = {
				{ ang = 35, dist = 170, title = "FUN LAND", color = Color3.fromRGB(92, 196, 150), spawn = funSpawn },
				{ ang = 155, dist = 210, title = "MIDNIGHT MILE", color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 160, 255), spawn = nightSpawn },
				{ ang = 265, dist = 190, title = "GARDEN DRIFT", color = Color3.fromRGB(214, 168, 92), spawn = gardenSpawn },
			}
			for _, s in ipairs(spots) do
				local rad = math.rad(s.ang)
				local x = hrp.Position.X + math.cos(rad) * s.dist
				local z = hrp.Position.Z + math.sin(rad) * s.dist
				local g = groundAt(x, z, hrp.Position.Y)
				local look = Vector3.new(math.cos(rad), 0, math.sin(rad))
				local captured = s.spawn
				makeRift(root, g, look, s.title, s.color, function()
					return captured + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
				end)
			end
		end)

	end)
	if not ok then
		warn("[Tranzit] " .. tostring(err))
	end
end)


-- Postcard on the loader and menus, loading song, realistic lighting.
-- Zombies map is not started. This block cannot build Green Run.
task.defer(function()
	print("[TRANZIT] menus: starting")
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		local Players = game:GetService("Players")
		local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
		local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
		if not lp then
			warn("[TRANZIT] menus: no LocalPlayer")
			return
		end

		pcall(function()
			local old = workspace:FindFirstChild("TranzitGreenRun")
			if old then old:Destroy() end
			local rift = workspace:FindFirstChild("TranzitGreenRunRift")
			if rift then rift:Destroy() end
			local hud = lp:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
			local zui = hud and hud:FindFirstChild("TranzitZHUD")
			if zui then zui:Destroy() end
		end)

		local CARD_URLS = {
			"https://x0.at/tn0j.jpg",
			"https://n.uguu.se/osyZVetq.jpg",
		}
		local SONG_URLS = {
			"https://x0.at/AkfL.mp3",
			"https://n.uguu.se/qlhWHUUR.mp3",
		}

		local function grab(urls, minLen)
			for i = 1, #urls do
				local url = urls[i]
				local body = nil
				if type(request) == "function" then
					local okR, res = pcall(request, { Url = url, Method = "GET" })
					if okR and type(res) == "table" then
						body = res.Body or res.body
					end
				end
				if type(body) ~= "string" or #body < minLen then
					local okH, res = pcall(function()
						return game:HttpGet(url, true)
					end)
					if okH and type(res) == "string" then
						body = res
					end
				end
				if type(body) == "string" and #body >= minLen then
					return body
				end
			end
			return nil
		end

		local function assetFrom(path, urls, minLen)
			if type(writefile) ~= "function" or type(getcustomasset) ~= "function" then
				return nil
			end
			local have = false
			if type(isfile) == "function" then
				local okF, exists = pcall(isfile, path)
				have = okF and exists == true
			end
			if not have then
				local body = grab(urls, minLen)
				if not body then
					return nil
				end
				local wrote = pcall(writefile, path, body)
				if not wrote then
					return nil
				end
			end
			local okA, asset = pcall(getcustomasset, path)
			if okA and type(asset) == "string" and asset ~= "" then
				return asset
			end
			return nil
		end

		pcall(function()
			if makefolder then
				makefolder("ReanimData")
				makefolder("Tranzit")
			end
		end)

		local card = _G._ParallaxAssets and _G._ParallaxAssets.bg() or nil
		if card then
			print("[TRANZIT] menus: postcard ready")
		else
			warn("[TRANZIT] menus: postcard download failed, menus still open")
		end

		local function host()
			local pg = lp:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
			if pg then return pg end
			local okH, h = pcall(function()
				if type(gethui) == "function" then return gethui() end
			end)
			if okH then return h end
			return nil
		end

		local function fitMenu(menu)
			if not card or not menu or not menu:IsA("GuiObject") then return end
			local bg = menu:FindFirstChild("CustomBackground")
			if not (bg and bg:IsA("ImageLabel")) then
				bg = menu:FindFirstChild("Bg")
			end
			if not (bg and bg:IsA("ImageLabel")) then
				bg = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
				bg.Name = "CustomBackground"
				bg.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				bg.BorderSizePixel = 0
				bg.Active = false
				bg.Parent = menu
			end
			bg.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
			bg.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
			bg.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
			bg.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop
			bg.ImageTransparency = 0.05
			bg.Image = card
			bg.Visible = true
			bg.ZIndex = 1
			pcall(function()
				menu.ClipsDescendants = true
				if menu.BackgroundTransparency < 0.2 then
					menu.BackgroundTransparency = 0.42
				end
			end)
		end

		task.spawn(function()
			task.wait(1.2)
			local ss = game:GetService("SoundService")
			if ss:FindFirstChild("TranzitLoader") then
				print("[TRANZIT] menus: loading song already playing")
				return
			end
			local song = assetFrom("Tranzit/loader_v3.mp3", SONG_URLS, 5000)
			if not song then
				warn("[TRANZIT] menus: loading song failed")
				return
			end
			local parent = host() or game:GetService("SoundService")
			local s = Instance.new("Sound")
			s.Name = "TranzitLoaderSong"
			s.SoundId = song
			s.Volume = 0.45
			s.Looped = true
			s.Parent = parent
			pcall(function() s:Play() end)
			print("[TRANZIT] menus: loading song playing")
			local t0 = os.clock()
			while os.clock() - t0 < 45 do
				local root = host()
				local loader = root and root:FindFirstChild("Loader", true)
				if loader and loader.Visible == false then
					break
				end
				task.wait(0.4)
			end
			pcall(function()
				s:Stop()
				s:Destroy()
			end)
		end)

		task.spawn(function()
			local n = 0
			while n < 80 do
				n = n + 1
				local root = host()
				local A = _G._ParallaxAssets
				if A then card = A.bg() or card end
				if root and card then
					for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
						if d.Name == "ReanimMenu" or d.Name == "Loader" then
							fitMenu(d)
						elseif d.Name == "Bg" and d:IsA("ImageLabel") and d.Parent and d.Parent.Name == "Content" then
							d.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop
							d.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
							d.Image = card
						elseif d.Name == "KeyBg" and d:IsA("ImageLabel") then
							d.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop
							d.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
							d.Image = card
						end
					end
				end
				task.wait(n < 20 and 0.6 or 2)
			end
		end)

		if not _G._TranzitLookSaved then
			local saved = {
				shadows = Lighting.GlobalShadows,
				bright = Lighting.Brightness,
				ambient = Lighting.Ambient,
				outdoor = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient,
				fogStart = Lighting.FogStart,
				fogEnd = Lighting.FogEnd,
				fogColor = Lighting.FogColor,
			}
			pcall(function() saved.exposure = Lighting.ExposureCompensation end)
			pcall(function() saved.soft = Lighting.ShadowSoftness end)
			pcall(function() saved.diff = Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale end)
			pcall(function() saved.spec = Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale end)
			pcall(function() saved.tech = Lighting.Technology end)
			local atmo = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
			if atmo then
				saved.atmo = {
					inst = atmo,
					Density = atmo.Density,
					Offset = atmo.Offset,
					Color = atmo.Color,
					Decay = atmo.Decay,
					Glare = atmo.Glare,
					Haze = atmo.Haze,
				}
			end
			_G._TranzitLookSaved = saved
		end

		local function effect(className, name)
			local inst = Lighting:FindFirstChild(name)
			if inst and not inst:IsA(className) then
				inst:Destroy()
				inst = nil
			end
			if not inst then
				inst = Instance.new(className)
				inst.Name = name
				inst.Parent = Lighting
			end
			return inst
		end

		local function applyLook()
			pcall(function() Lighting.ClockTime = 15 end)
			pcall(function()
				local tech = Lighting.Technology
				if tech == Enum.Technology.Compatibility or tech == Enum.Technology.Voxel then
					Lighting.Technology = Enum.Technology.ShadowMap
				end
			end)
			pcall(function() Lighting.GlobalShadows = true end)
			pcall(function() Lighting.ShadowSoftness = 0.35 end)
			pcall(function() Lighting.Brightness = 2.4 end)
			pcall(function() Lighting.ExposureCompensation = 0 end)
			pcall(function() Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(72, 76, 84) end)
			pcall(function() Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(120, 125, 134) end)
			pcall(function() Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = 1 end)
			pcall(function() Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = 1 end)
			pcall(function() Lighting.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(196, 206, 220) end)
			pcall(function() Lighting.FogStart = 0 end)
			pcall(function() Lighting.FogEnd = 100000 end)
			local atmo = Lighting:FindFirstChild("TranzitAtmo")
			if not atmo then
				atmo = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
			end
			if not atmo then
				atmo = Instance.new("Atmosphere")
				atmo.Name = "TranzitAtmo"
				atmo.Parent = Lighting
			end
			pcall(function()
				atmo.Density = 0.26
				atmo.Offset = 0.10
				atmo.Color = Color3.fromRGB(196, 206, 220)
				atmo.Decay = Color3.fromRGB(118, 124, 136)
				atmo.Glare = 0
				atmo.Haze = 0.5
			end)
			local grade = effect("ColorCorrectionEffect", "TranzitGrade")
			grade.TintColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
			grade.Contrast = 0.05
			grade.Saturation = -0.03
			grade.Brightness = 0
			grade.Enabled = true
			local bloom = effect("BloomEffect", "TranzitBloom")
			bloom.Intensity = 0.05
			bloom.Size = 16
			bloom.Threshold = 1.8
			bloom.Enabled = true
			local rays = effect("SunRaysEffect", "TranzitRays")
			rays.Intensity = 0.02
			rays.Spread = 0.8
			rays.Enabled = true
			local blur = Lighting:FindFirstChild("TranzitMotionBlur")
			if blur then
				blur.Enabled = false
				blur.Size = 0
			end
			local dof = Lighting:FindFirstChild("TranzitDoF")
			if dof then dof.Enabled = false end
		end

		local function restoreLook()
			local saved = _G._TranzitLookSaved
			if type(saved) ~= "table" then return end
			pcall(function() Lighting.GlobalShadows = saved.shadows end)
			pcall(function() Lighting.Brightness = saved.bright end)
			pcall(function() Lighting.Ambient = saved.ambient end)
			pcall(function() Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = saved.outdoor end)
			pcall(function() Lighting.FogStart = saved.fogStart end)
			pcall(function() Lighting.FogEnd = saved.fogEnd end)
			pcall(function() Lighting.FogColor = saved.fogColor end)
			if saved.exposure ~= nil then pcall(function() Lighting.ExposureCompensation = saved.exposure end) end
			if saved.soft ~= nil then pcall(function() Lighting.ShadowSoftness = saved.soft end) end
			if saved.diff ~= nil then pcall(function() Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = saved.diff end) end
			if saved.spec ~= nil then pcall(function() Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = saved.spec end) end
			if saved.tech ~= nil then pcall(function() Lighting.Technology = saved.tech end) end
			if saved.atmo and saved.atmo.inst and saved.atmo.inst.Parent then
				local a = saved.atmo
				pcall(function()
					a.inst.Density = a.Density
					a.inst.Offset = a.Offset
					a.inst.Color = a.Color
					a.inst.Decay = a.Decay
					a.inst.Glare = a.Glare
					a.inst.Haze = a.Haze
				end)
			end
			for _, name in ipairs({"TranzitGrade", "TranzitBloom", "TranzitRays", "TranzitDoF", "TranzitMotionBlur"}) do
				local e = Lighting:FindFirstChild(name)
				if e then e.Enabled = false end
			end
			pcall(function() Lighting.ClockTime = 14 end)
		end

		restoreLook()
		-- richer startup look: once the Visuals page has registered its presets, use PARALLAX Ultra
		-- in "light" mode (no forced Future lighting, no quality change, no motion blur)
		-- Shader preset startup loop removed with the shader feature.

		_G._TranzitApplyLook = _G.PrismApplyLookId
		_G._TranzitRestoreLook = restoreLook
		print("[PARALLAX] look: lighting on")
		local pg = lp:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") or lp:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 8)
		if pg then
			local old = pg:FindFirstChild("TranzitGFX")
			if old then old:Destroy() end
		end
		print("[TRANZIT] menus: ready")
	end)
	if not ok then
		warn("[TRANZIT] menus failed: " .. tostring(err))
	end
end)
-- TRANZIT_END_27y


--========================================================
--  PARALLAX SKIN
--  One shared look for every menu: black glass, silver hairlines, thin
--  futuristic type, near-square corners, the PARALLAX poster behind each
--  window and L-shaped corner marks.  Colors are flattened to monochrome
--  (brightness is kept, so toggles and selected tabs still read), except
--  anything marked with the PXKeep attribute -- the color swatches.
--========================================================
task.defer(function()
    local ok, err = pcall(function()
        local Players = game:GetService("Players")
        local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
        if not lp then return end

        local TARGETS = {
            ReanimHaloMenu = true, PrismHub = true, PrismAdminPanel = true,
            PrismExtras = true, PrismCopier = true, PrismAccessKey = true,
            PrismNametagCard = true, PrismSimpleRail = true, PrismToasts = true,
            EmoteHubGUI = true, FortniteWheelUI = true, HaloMobileWheelBtn = true,
        }
        local KEEP_IMG = {
            ParallaxOrb = true, CustomBackground = true, Bg = true, KeyBg = true, PXBack = true,
        }
        local BRANDS = {
            {"TRANZIT", "PARALLAX"}, {"PRISM", "PARALLAX"}, {"VEXORA", "PARALLAX"},
            {"CYRIS", "PARALLAX"}, {"HALO", "PARALLAX"},
            {"Tranzit", "Parallax"}, {"Prism", "Parallax"}, {"Vexora", "Parallax"},
            {"Cyris", "Parallax"}, {"Halo", "Parallax"},
            {"GREEN RUN", "MULTIVERSE"}, {"Green Run", "Multiverse"},
        }

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- helpers
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local function mono(c)
            if typeof(c) ~= "Color3" then return c end
            local r, g, b = c.R, c.G, c.B
            if math.max(r, g, b) - math.min(r, g, b) < 0.035 then return c end
            local l = 0.299 * r + 0.587 * g + 0.114 * b
            return Color3.new(l, l, l)
        end
        local function monoSeq(seq)
            local out, changed = {}, false
            for i, k in ipairs(seq.Keypoints) do
                local m = mono(k.Value)
                if m ~= k.Value then changed = true end
                out[i] = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(k.Time, m)
            end
            if not changed then return seq end
            return ColorSequence.new(out)
        end
        local function rewrite(t)
            if type(t) ~= "string" or t == "" then return t end
            local n = t
            for _, p in ipairs(BRANDS) do
                if string.find(n, p[1], 1, true) then
                    n = string.gsub(n, p[1], p[2])
                end
            end
            return n
        end
        local function kept(d)
            local p = d
            for _ = 1, 14 do
                if not p then return false end
                local okA, v = pcall(function() return p:GetAttribute("PXKeep") end)
                if okA and v then return true end
                p = p.Parent
                if p and p:IsA("ScreenGui") then return false end
            end
            return false
        end
        local function monoProp(d, prop)
            local okG, v = pcall(function() return d[prop] end)
            if not okG then return end
            local m = mono(v)
            if m ~= v then pcall(function() d[prop] = m end) end
        end
        local keptCache = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
        local function hookColor(d, prop)
            monoProp(d, prop)
            local okS, sig = pcall(d.GetPropertyChangedSignal, d, prop)
            if okS and sig then
                local busy = false
                sig:Connect(function()
                    if busy then return end
                    local k = keptCache[d]
                    if k == nil then
                        k = kept(d)
                        keptCache[d] = k
                    end
                    if k then return end
                    local v = d[prop]
                    local r, g, b = v.R, v.G, v.B
                    local mx = r > g and (r > b and r or b) or (g > b and g or b)
                    local mn = r < g and (r < b and r or b) or (g < b and g or b)
                    if mx - mn >= 0.035 then
                        local l = 0.299 * r + 0.587 * g + 0.114 * b
                        busy = true
                        d[prop] = Color3.new(l, l, l)
                        busy = false
                    end
                end)
            end
        end

        local done = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- depth: a faint light edge and top sheen on raised buttons and panels
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local depthBudget = 60
        local function hasLayout(d)
            return d:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIGridStyleLayout") ~= nil
        end
        local function depthOne(d)
            if depthBudget <= 0 then return end
            if hasLayout(d) or d:FindFirstChild("PXSheen") then return end
            local isBtn = d:IsA("TextButton") or d:IsA("ImageButton")
            if isBtn or not d:IsA("Frame") then return end
            if d.BackgroundTransparency > 0.8 then return end
            local sz = d.AbsoluteSize
            if isBtn then
                if sz.X < 40 or sz.Y < 20 then return end
            else
                if sz.X < 140 or sz.Y < 54 then return end
            end
            local corner = d:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
            local sheen = Instance.new("Frame")
            sheen.Name = "PXSheen"
            sheen.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            sheen.BackgroundTransparency = 0
            sheen.BorderSizePixel = 0
