            sheen.Active = false
            sheen.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, isBtn and 0.5 or 0.42, 0)
            sheen.ZIndex = d.ZIndex + 1
            sheen:SetAttribute("PXKeep", true)
            local g = Instance.new("UIGradient")
            g.Rotation = 90
            g.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, isBtn and 0.84 or 0.9),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
            })
            done[g] = true
            g.Parent = sheen
            if corner then
                local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
                c.CornerRadius = corner.CornerRadius
                done[c] = true
                c.Parent = sheen
            end
            sheen.Parent = d
            depthBudget = depthBudget - 1
        end

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- skin a single instance
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local function skinOne(d)
            if done[d] or not d.Parent then return end
            if string.sub(d.Name, 1, 4) == "PXFx" then done[d] = true return end
            done[d] = true
            if kept(d) then
                -- swatches keep their colors but still get the thin type
                if d:IsA("UICorner") then
                    local r = d.CornerRadius
                    if r.Scale == 0 and r.Offset > 6 then
                        d.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, math.max(2, math.floor(r.Offset * 0.45 + 0.5)))
                    end
                end
                return
            end

            if d:IsA("GuiObject") then
                if d:IsA("ImageLabel") or d:IsA("ImageButton") then
                    if not KEEP_IMG[d.Name] then hookColor(d, "ImageColor3") end
                end
                if not (d:IsA("ImageLabel") and KEEP_IMG[d.Name]) then
                    hookColor(d, "BackgroundColor3")
                end
                if d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton") or d:IsA("TextBox") then
                    hookColor(d, "TextColor3")
                    if d:IsA("TextBox") then hookColor(d, "PlaceholderColor3") end
                    -- type
                    pcall(function()
                        if d:GetAttribute("PXFont") then return end
                        d:SetAttribute("PXFont", true)
                        local f = d.Font
                        local bold = (f == Enum.Font.GothamBold or f == Enum.Font.GothamBlack
                            or f == Enum.Font.SourceSansBold or f == Enum.Font.ArialBold)
                        local sz = d.TextSize
                        if bold and sz >= 14 and not d:IsA("TextBox") and #d.Text <= 36 and not d.TextScaled then
                            d.Font = Enum.Font.Michroma
                            d.TextSize = math.max(9, math.floor(sz * 0.72))
                        elseif d.Font ~= Enum.Font.Code then
                            d.Font = Enum.Font.Jura
                            if not d.TextScaled and sz < 22 then d.TextSize = sz + 1 end
                        end
                    end)
                    -- brand words
                    if not d:IsA("TextBox") then
                        pcall(function()
                            local t = d.Text
                            local n = rewrite(t)
                            if n ~= t then d.Text = n end
                        end)
                        pcall(function()
                            d:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
                                local t = d.Text
                                if #t < 4 then return end
                                local l = string.lower(t)
                                if string.find(l, "tranzit", 1, true) or string.find(l, "prism", 1, true)
                                    or string.find(l, "vexora", 1, true) or string.find(l, "cyris", 1, true)
                                    or string.find(l, "halo", 1, true) or string.find(l, "green run", 1, true) then
                                    local n = rewrite(t)
                                    if n ~= t then d.Text = n end
                                end
                            end)
                        end)
                    end
                end
                if d:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
                    hookColor(d, "ScrollBarImageColor3")
                    pcall(function() d.ScrollBarThickness = math.min(d.ScrollBarThickness, 3) end)
                end
                pcall(depthOne, d)
            elseif d:IsA("UICorner") then
                local r = d.CornerRadius
                if r.Scale == 0 and r.Offset > 6 then
                    d.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, math.max(2, math.floor(r.Offset * 0.45 + 0.5)))
                end
            elseif d:IsA("UIStroke") then
                hookColor(d, "Color")
                pcall(function()
                    if d.Thickness > 1.2 then d.Thickness = 1 end
                end)
            elseif d:IsA("UIGradient") then
                pcall(function() d.Color = monoSeq(d.Color) end)
            end
        end

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- window decoration: poster behind the window + corner marks
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local function decorate(win)
            if win:FindFirstChild("PXDecor") then return end
            if win:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIGridStyleLayout") then return end
            local sz = win.AbsoluteSize
            if sz.X < 220 or sz.Y < 140 then return end
            local A = _G._ParallaxAssets

            -- poster, unless the window already carries a background image
            local has = win:FindFirstChild("Bg", true) or win:FindFirstChild("CustomBackground", true)
                or win:FindFirstChild("KeyBg", true) or win:FindFirstChild("PXBack", true)
            if not has then
                local img = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
                img.Name = "PXBack"
                img.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                img.BorderSizePixel = 0
                img.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
                img.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop
                img.ImageTransparency = 0.12
                img.ZIndex = 0
                img.Active = false
                local a = A and A.bg()
                if a then img.Image = a end
                img.Parent = win
                local wc = win:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
                if wc then
                    local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
                    c.CornerRadius = wc.CornerRadius
                    done[c] = true
                    c.Parent = img
                end
            end

            local deco = Instance.new("Frame")
            deco.Name = "PXDecor"
            deco.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            deco.BorderSizePixel = 0
            deco.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
            deco.ZIndex = 250
            deco.Active = false
            deco.Parent = win
            deco:SetAttribute("PXKeep", true)

            -- glass: light falls off from the top edge, the bottom sinks into shadow
            local wcorner = win:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
            local function wash(ay, h, color, t0, t1)
                local f = Instance.new("Frame")
                f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, ay)
                f.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, ay, 0)
                f.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, h, 0)
                f.BackgroundColor3 = color
                f.BorderSizePixel = 0
                f.ZIndex = 249
                f.Active = false
                local g = Instance.new("UIGradient")
                g.Rotation = 90
                g.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, t0),
                    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, t1),
                })
                done[g] = true
                g.Parent = f
                if wcorner then
                    local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
                    c.CornerRadius = wcorner.CornerRadius
                    done[c] = true
                    c.Parent = f
                end
                f.Parent = deco
            end
            wash(0, 0.3, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.93, 1)
            wash(1, 0.28, Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 1, 0.78)

            local L, T, INSET = 14, 1, 5
            local function bar(ax, ay, px, py, w, h)
                local f = Instance.new("Frame")
                f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay)
                f.Position = UDim2.new(px, 0, py, 0)
                f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
                f.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 240, 248)
                f.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
                f.BorderSizePixel = 0
                f.ZIndex = 250
                f.Active = false
                f.Parent = deco
            end
            for _, c in ipairs({ {0, 0}, {1, 0}, {0, 1}, {1, 1} }) do
                local ax, ay = c[1], c[2]
                local ox = ax == 0 and INSET or -INSET
                local oy = ay == 0 and INSET or -INSET
                local function place(w, h)
                    local f = Instance.new("Frame")
                    f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay)
                    f.Position = UDim2.new(ax, ox, ay, oy)
                    f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
                    f.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 240, 248)
                    f.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
                    f.BorderSizePixel = 0
                    f.ZIndex = 250
                    f.Active = false
                    f.Parent = deco
                end
                place(L, T)
                place(T, L)
            end

            -- hairline that fades out toward both ends along the top edge
            local line = Instance.new("Frame")
            line.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
            line.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 0)
            line.Size = UDim2.new(0.7, 0, 0, 1)
            line.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 248, 255)
            line.BorderSizePixel = 0
            line.ZIndex = 250
            line.Active = false
            line.Parent = deco
            local g = Instance.new("UIGradient")
            g.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.25),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
            })
            g.Parent = line
            done[g] = true
        end

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- wiring
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local skinned = {}
        local function skinGui(sg)
            if skinned[sg] then return end
            skinned[sg] = true
            for _, d in ipairs(sg:GetDescendants()) do
                pcall(skinOne, d)
            end
            sg.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
                task.defer(function() pcall(skinOne, d) end)
            end)
        end
        local decoTries = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
        local function windowsOf(sg)
            for _, w in ipairs(sg:GetChildren()) do
                if w:IsA("Frame") then
                    local n = decoTries[w] or 0
                    if n < 5 and not w:FindFirstChild("PXDecor") then
                        decoTries[w] = n + 1
                        pcall(decorate, w)
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        local hooked = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
        local function scan()
            local hosts = {}
            local pg = lp:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
            if pg then hosts[#hosts + 1] = pg end
            pcall(function()
                if type(gethui) == "function" then
                    local h = gethui()
                    if h then hosts[#hosts + 1] = h end
                end
            end)
            pcall(function()
                local cg = game:GetService("CoreGui")
                local _ = cg.Name
                hosts[#hosts + 1] = cg
            end)
            for _, host in ipairs(hosts) do
                if not hooked[host] then
                    hooked[host] = true
                    pcall(function()
                        host.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c)
                            if c:IsA("ScreenGui") and TARGETS[c.Name] then
                                task.defer(function() pcall(skinGui, c) end)
                            end
                        end)
                    end)
                end
                pcall(function()
                    for _, c in ipairs(host:GetChildren()) do
                        if c:IsA("ScreenGui") and TARGETS[c.Name] then
                            skinGui(c)
                            windowsOf(c)
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
        end

        _G._ParallaxSkin = { mono = mono, skin = skinGui, scan = scan }

        task.spawn(function()
            for pass = 1, 90 do
                pcall(scan)
                if pass == 3 or pass == 8 or pass == 20 then
                    pcall(function()
                        if _G._ParallaxAssets then _G._ParallaxAssets.refresh() end
                    end)
                end
                task.wait(pass < 20 and 1 or 3)
            end
        end)
        print("[PARALLAX] skin: ready")
    end)
    if not ok then warn("[PARALLAX] skin failed: " .. tostring(err)) end
end)

--========================================================
--  PARALLAX MOTION
--  One layer that makes every menu move: windows pop in (and the main one
--  pops out), pages slide and fade their contents in when you switch tabs,
--  every button lights up on hover and ripples when pressed, text boxes
--  glow while you type, and window borders carry a slow travelling glint.
--  Everything is created on demand, nothing runs per frame except the border
--  glint on windows you can actually see.  _G.PrismAnim.enabled = false stops it.
--========================================================
task.defer(function()
    local ok, err = pcall(function()
        local Players = game:GetService("Players")
        local TS = game:GetService("TweenService")
        local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
        local RS = game:GetService("RunService")
        local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
        local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
        local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
        if not lp then return end

        if _G.PrismAnim and _G.PrismAnim.destroy then pcall(_G.PrismAnim.destroy) end
        local M = { enabled = true }
        _G.PrismAnim = M
        local conns = {}
        local function keep(c) conns[#conns + 1] = c return c end
        function M.destroy()
            M.enabled = false
            for _, c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
            conns = {}
        end
        local function live() return _G.PrismAnim == M and M.enabled end

        local GUIS = {
            ReanimHaloMenu = true, PrismHub = true, PrismAdminPanel = true, PrismExtras = true,
            PrismCopier = true, PrismChat = true, PrismAccessKey = true, PrismNametagCard = true,
            PrismSimpleRail = true, EmoteHubGUI = true, FortniteWheelUI = true,
        }
        local WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        local function tw(o, t, props, style, dir)
            local tween = TS:Create(o, TweenInfo.new(t, style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, dir or Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props)
            tween:Play()
            return tween
        end
        local function cancelAll(st)
            for _, t in ipairs(st.tw or {}) do pcall(function() t:Cancel() end) end
            st.tw = {}
        end
        local function shown(obj)
            local p = obj
            while p do
                if p:IsA("GuiObject") then
                    if not p.Visible then return false end
                elseif p:IsA("ScreenGui") then
                    return p.Enabled
                end
                p = p.Parent
            end
            return false
        end
        local function copyCorner(from, to)
            local uc = from:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
            if uc then
                local n = Instance.new("UICorner")
                n.Name = "PXFxCorner"
                n.CornerRadius = uc.CornerRadius
                n.Parent = to
            end
        end

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- windows: pop in / pop out, travelling border glint
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local winState = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
        local function scaleOf(win)
            local sc = win:FindFirstChild("PXFxScale")
            if not sc then
                sc = Instance.new("UIScale")
                sc.Name = "PXFxScale"
                sc.Scale = 1
                sc.Parent = win
            end
            return sc
        end
        local function shine(win)
            if not win.ClipsDescendants then return end
            local f = Instance.new("Frame")
            f.Name = "PXFxShine"
            f.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
            f.BorderSizePixel = 0
            f.Active = false
            f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(-0.3, 0.5)
            f.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.28, 1.6)
            f.Rotation = 14
            f.ZIndex = 400
            local g = Instance.new("UIGradient")
            g.Name = "PXFxGrad"
            g.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.9),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
            })
            g.Parent = f
            f.Parent = win
            tw(f, 0.75, { Position = UDim2.fromScale(1.3, 0.5) }, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)
            Debris:AddItem(f, 0.9)
        end
        local function popIn(win)
            if not live() or not win.Parent then return end
            local st = winState[win]
            if not st then st = { tw = {} } winState[win] = st end
            local now = os.clock()
            if st.running and now - (st.started or 0) < 0.12 then return end
            local sz = win.AbsoluteSize
            if sz.X < 160 or sz.Y < 90 then return end
            local sc = scaleOf(win)
            cancelAll(st)
            if st.running then
                win.Position = st.pos
                win.BackgroundTransparency = st.fade
            else
                st.pos = win.Position
                st.fade = win.BackgroundTransparency
            end
            st.running, st.started = true, now
            local token = (st.token or 0) + 1
            st.token = token
            sc.Scale = 0.9
            win.Position = st.pos + UDim2.fromOffset(0, 22)
            if st.fade < 0.98 then win.BackgroundTransparency = math.min(1, st.fade + 0.45) end
            st.tw[#st.tw + 1] = tw(sc, 0.42, { Scale = 1 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
            st.tw[#st.tw + 1] = tw(win, 0.4, { Position = st.pos }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
            if st.fade < 0.98 then
                st.tw[#st.tw + 1] = tw(win, 0.3, { BackgroundTransparency = st.fade })
            end
            pcall(shine, win)
            task.delay(0.5, function()
                if st.token == token and win.Parent then
                    st.running = false
                    sc.Scale = 1
                    win.Position = st.pos
                    win.BackgroundTransparency = st.fade
                end
            end)
        end
        function M.pop(win) popIn(win) end

        -- animated close; cb runs when it has finished (the window is then hidden by cb)
        function M.close(win, cb)
            if not live() or not win or not win.Parent or not win.Visible then
                if cb then cb() end
                return
            end
            local st = winState[win]
            if not st then st = { tw = {} } winState[win] = st end
            if st.closing then return end
            local sc = scaleOf(win)
            cancelAll(st)
            if st.running then
                win.Position = st.pos
                win.BackgroundTransparency = st.fade
                sc.Scale = 1
            else
                st.pos = win.Position
                st.fade = win.BackgroundTransparency
            end
            st.closing = true
            st.running = false
            st.token = (st.token or 0) + 1
            st.tw[#st.tw + 1] = tw(sc, 0.17, { Scale = 0.92 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
            st.tw[#st.tw + 1] = tw(win, 0.17, { Position = st.pos + UDim2.fromOffset(0, 14) }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
            if st.fade < 0.98 then
                st.tw[#st.tw + 1] = tw(win, 0.17, { BackgroundTransparency = math.min(1, st.fade + 0.5) })
            end
            task.delay(0.18, function()
                if cb then pcall(cb) end
                if win.Parent then
                    sc.Scale = 1
                    win.Position = st.pos
                    win.BackgroundTransparency = st.fade
                end
                st.closing = false
            end)
        end

        local spins = {}
        local function addGlint(win)
            for _, c in ipairs(win:GetChildren()) do
                if c:IsA("UIStroke") and c.Thickness >= 1 and not c:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient") then
                    local g = Instance.new("UIGradient")
                    g.Name = "PXFxGlint"
                    g.Color = ColorSequence.new({
                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)),
                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.3, Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150)),
                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.65, Color3.fromRGB(190, 190, 190)),
                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)),
                    })
                    g.Parent = c
                    spins[#spins + 1] = { g = g, win = win }
                    return
                end
            end
        end

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- pages: slide + stagger the first few children in
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local revState = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
        local running = 0
        local function finishReveal(obj, st)
            if st.pos and obj.Parent then obj.Position = st.pos end
            for _, k in ipairs(st.kids or {}) do
                if k[1].Parent then k[1].BackgroundTransparency = k[2] end
            end
            st.kids = nil
            if st.running then
                st.running = false
                running = math.max(0, running - 1)
            end
        end
        local function reveal(obj)
            if not live() or not obj.Parent or not obj.Visible or not shown(obj) then return end
            local st = revState[obj]
            if not st then st = { tw = {} } revState[obj] = st end
            local now = os.clock()
            if now - (st.at or 0) < 0.35 then return end
            local sz = obj.AbsoluteSize
            if sz.X < 200 or sz.Y < 110 then return end
            local par = obj.Parent
            local inLayout = par and par:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIGridStyleLayout") ~= nil
            if inLayout then return end
            if st.running then
                cancelAll(st)
                finishReveal(obj, st)
            end
            if running >= 8 then return end
            st.at = now
            st.running = true
            running = running + 1
            local token = (st.token or 0) + 1
            st.token = token
            st.pos = obj.Position
            obj.Position = st.pos + UDim2.fromOffset(0, 16)
            st.tw[#st.tw + 1] = tw(obj, 0.34, { Position = st.pos }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
            local kids, n = {}, 0
            for _, c in ipairs(obj:GetChildren()) do
                if c:IsA("GuiObject") and c.Visible and c.BackgroundTransparency < 0.97 and string.sub(c.Name, 1, 4) ~= "PXFx"
                    and c.Name ~= "PXBack" and c.Name ~= "PXDecor" then
                    n = n + 1
                    kids[n] = { c, c.BackgroundTransparency }
                    if n >= 10 then break end
                end
            end
            st.kids = kids
            for i, k in ipairs(kids) do
                k[1].BackgroundTransparency = 1
                task.delay((i - 1) * 0.035, function()
                    if st.token == token and k[1].Parent then
                        tw(k[1], 0.26, { BackgroundTransparency = k[2] })
                    end
                end)
            end
            task.delay(0.8, function()
                if st.token == token and st.running then
                    finishReveal(obj, st)
                end
            end)
        end

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- buttons: hover glow + press ripple
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local function fxOk(b)
            if not b.Parent then return false end
            local s = b.AbsoluteSize
            if s.X < 16 or s.Y < 12 or s.X * s.Y > 160000 then return false end
            if b:GetAttribute("PXNoFx") then return false end
            if b.BackgroundTransparency >= 0.99 then
                if b:IsA("TextButton") and b.Text == "" then return false end
                if b:IsA("ImageButton") and b.Image == "" then return false end
            end
            return true
        end
        local hov = nil -- { b = button, ov = overlay }
        local function dropHover(h)
            if not h then return end
            local ov = h.ov
            if ov and ov.Parent then
                tw(ov, 0.18, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
                Debris:AddItem(ov, 0.25)
            end
        end
        local function hoverOn(b)
            if not live() or not fxOk(b) then return end
            if hov and hov.b == b then return end
            dropHover(hov)
            local ov = Instance.new("Frame")
            ov.Name = "PXFxHover"
            ov.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
            ov.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            ov.BorderSizePixel = 0
            ov.Active = false
            ov.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
            ov.ZIndex = b.ZIndex + 1
            copyCorner(b, ov)
            ov.Parent = b
            tw(ov, 0.12, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.9 })
            hov = { b = b, ov = ov }
        end
        local function hoverOff(b)
            if hov and hov.b == b then
                dropHover(hov)
                hov = nil
            end
        end
        local ripples = 0
        local function press(b, x, y)
            if not live() or not fxOk(b) or ripples >= 6 then return end
            if hov and hov.b == b and hov.ov.Parent then tw(hov.ov, 0.06, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.8 }) end
            local ap, as = b.AbsolutePosition, b.AbsoluteSize
            local lx, ly = as.X / 2, as.Y / 2
            if type(x) == "number" and type(y) == "number" then
                local inset = 0
                pcall(function() inset = GuiService:GetGuiInset().Y end)
                for _, yy in ipairs({ y, y - inset, y + inset }) do
                    local cx, cy = x - ap.X, yy - ap.Y
                    if cx >= 0 and cy >= 0 and cx <= as.X and cy <= as.Y then
                        lx, ly = cx, cy
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
            local box = Instance.new("Frame")
            box.Name = "PXFxRip"
            box.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            box.BorderSizePixel = 0
            box.Active = false
            box.ClipsDescendants = true
            box.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
            box.ZIndex = b.ZIndex + 2
            copyCorner(b, box)
            local dot = Instance.new("Frame")
            dot.Name = "PXFxDot"
            dot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            dot.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(lx, ly)
            dot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
            dot.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
            dot.BackgroundTransparency = 0.7
            dot.BorderSizePixel = 0
            dot.Active = false
            dot.ZIndex = b.ZIndex + 2
            local dc = Instance.new("UICorner")
            dc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
            dc.Parent = dot
            dot.Parent = box
            box.Parent = b
            local far = 2 * math.sqrt(math.max(lx, as.X - lx) ^ 2 + math.max(ly, as.Y - ly) ^ 2)
            tw(dot, 0.5, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(far, far), BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
            ripples = ripples + 1
            Debris:AddItem(box, 0.6)
            task.delay(0.6, function() ripples = math.max(0, ripples - 1) end)
        end
        local function release(b)
            if hov and hov.b == b and hov.ov.Parent then tw(hov.ov, 0.15, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.9 }) end
        end

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- text boxes: glow while focused
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local focusSt = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
        local function ownerOk(obj)
            local p = obj
            while p do
                if p:IsA("ScreenGui") then return GUIS[p.Name] == true end
                p = p.Parent
            end
            return false
        end
        keep(UIS.TextBoxFocused:Connect(function(tb)
            if not live() or not ownerOk(tb) then return end
            local stroke = tb:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
            local made = false
            if not stroke then
                stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
                stroke.Name = "PXFxFocus"
                stroke.Color = WHITE
                stroke.Thickness = 1
                stroke.Transparency = 1
                stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
                stroke.Parent = tb
                made = true
            end
            local st = focusSt[tb]
            if not st then
                st = { stroke = stroke, t = stroke.Transparency, th = stroke.Thickness, made = made }
                focusSt[tb] = st
            end
            tw(stroke, 0.18, { Transparency = 0.1, Thickness = math.max(1.5, st.th) })
        end))
        keep(UIS.TextBoxFocusReleased:Connect(function(tb)
            local st = focusSt[tb]
            if not st then return end
            focusSt[tb] = nil
            if st.stroke and st.stroke.Parent then
                if st.made then
                    tw(st.stroke, 0.2, { Transparency = 1 })
                    Debris:AddItem(st.stroke, 0.25)
                else
                    tw(st.stroke, 0.2, { Transparency = st.t, Thickness = st.th })
                end
            end
        end))

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- wiring: find the windows, pages and buttons of every Parallax menu
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local hooked = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
        local queue, qh = {}, 1
        local function depthOf(d, sg)
            local n, p = 0, d
            while p and p ~= sg and n < 40 do
                p = p.Parent
                n = n + 1
            end
            return n
        end
        local function process(d, sg)
            if not d.Parent or hooked[d] then return end
            if string.sub(d.Name, 1, 4) == "PXFx" then return end
            if d:IsA("GuiButton") then
                hooked[d] = true
                keep(d.MouseEnter:Connect(function() if live() then hoverOn(d) end end))
                keep(d.MouseLeave:Connect(function() hoverOff(d) end))
                keep(d.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function(x, y) if live() then press(d, x, y) end end))
                keep(d.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() release(d) end))
            elseif d:IsA("Frame") or d:IsA("CanvasGroup") or d:IsA("ScrollingFrame") or d:IsA("ImageLabel") then
                if d.Name == "PXBack" or d.Name == "PXDecor" then return end
                if d.Parent == sg then
                    if d:IsA("ImageLabel") then return end
                    hooked[d] = true
                    keep(d:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
                        if d.Visible then
                            task.defer(function()
                                if live() and d.Parent and d.Visible and shown(d) then popIn(d) end
                            end)
                        end
                    end))
                    local wsz = d.AbsoluteSize
                    if wsz.X == 0 or (wsz.X >= 160 and wsz.Y >= 90) then addGlint(d) end
                elseif d:IsA("Frame") or d:IsA("ScrollingFrame") or d:IsA("CanvasGroup") then
                    local dep = depthOf(d, sg)
                    if dep <= 6 or not d.Visible then
                        hooked[d] = true
                        keep(d:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
                            if d.Visible then
                                task.defer(reveal, d)
                            else
                                local st = revState[d]
                                if st and st.running then
                                    cancelAll(st)
                                    finishReveal(d, st)
                                end
                            end
                        end))
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        local attached = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
        local function attach(sg)
            if attached[sg] then return end
            attached[sg] = true
            for _, d in ipairs(sg:GetDescendants()) do queue[#queue + 1] = { d, sg } end
            keep(sg.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d) queue[#queue + 1] = { d, sg } end))
            keep(sg:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function()
                if not sg.Enabled then return end
                task.defer(function()
                    for _, w in ipairs(sg:GetChildren()) do
                        if w:IsA("Frame") and w.Visible then popIn(w) end
                    end
                end)
            end))
        end

        local hostHooked = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
        local function scan()
            local hosts = {}
            local pg = lp:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
            if pg then hosts[#hosts + 1] = pg end
            pcall(function()
                if type(gethui) == "function" then
                    local h = gethui()
                    if h then hosts[#hosts + 1] = h end
                end
            end)
            pcall(function()
                local cg = game:GetService("CoreGui")
                local _ = cg.Name
                hosts[#hosts + 1] = cg
            end)
            for _, host in ipairs(hosts) do
                if not hostHooked[host] then
                    hostHooked[host] = true
                    pcall(function()
                        keep(host.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c)
                            if c:IsA("ScreenGui") and GUIS[c.Name] then
                                task.defer(function() attach(c) end)
                            end
                        end))
                    end)
                end
                pcall(function()
                    for _, c in ipairs(host:GetChildren()) do
                        if c:IsA("ScreenGui") and GUIS[c.Name] then attach(c) end
                    end
                end)
            end
        end

        local accum = 0
        keep(RS.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
            if not live() then return end
            -- hook a few new instances per frame so big lists never cause a hitch
            local budget = 70
            while qh <= #queue and budget > 0 do
                local it = queue[qh]
                queue[qh] = false
                qh = qh + 1
                budget = budget - 1
                if it then pcall(process, it[1], it[2]) end
            end
            if qh > 400 and qh > #queue then queue, qh = {}, 1 end
            -- border glint, only for windows that are on screen
            accum = accum + dt
            if accum >= 0.05 then
                accum = 0
                local t = os.clock()
                for i = #spins, 1, -1 do
                    local s = spins[i]
                    if not s.g.Parent or not s.win.Parent then
                        table.remove(spins, i)
                    elseif s.win.Visible and shown(s.win) then
                        s.g.Rotation = (t * 40) % 360
                    end
                end
                -- a hover glow whose button vanished (hidden or destroyed) must not stay lit
                if hov and (not hov.b.Parent or not shown(hov.b)) then
                    dropHover(hov)
                    hov = nil
                end
            end
        end))

        task.spawn(function()
            for pass = 1, 60 do
                pcall(scan)
                task.wait(pass < 15 and 1 or 4)
            end
        end)
        print("[PARALLAX] motion: ready")
    end)
    if not ok then warn("[PARALLAX] motion failed: " .. tostring(err)) end
end)

--========================================================
--  PARALLAX  --  CLONE SELF
--  Spawns a working copy of your avatar next to you (client side: only you see it).
--  It has its own Humanoid, walks, animates, and can be clicked or tapped
--  (ClickDetector + ProximityPrompt) to open a Mic Up style menu:
--  Grab / Drag / Cute / Left Shoulder / Follow / Mimic / Volume / Remove.
--  API: _G.PrismCloneSelf  (spawn, remove, openMenu, closeMenu, refresh, state)
--========================================================
pcall(function()
    local ok, err = pcall(function()
        if _G.PrismCloneSelf and _G.PrismCloneSelf.destroy then pcall(_G.PrismCloneSelf.destroy) end

        local Players = game:GetService("Players")
        local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
        local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
        local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
        local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
        local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
        local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
        local LP = Players.LocalPlayer

        local SHOULDER_OFFSET = Vector3.new(-1.25, 1.75, 0.05) -- relative to your root part
        local SHOULDER_SCALE = 0.5
        local SIDE_OFFSET = Vector3.new(4, 0, 0)

        local API = {}
        local S = {
            model = nil, hum = nil, root = nil, animator = nil,
            conns = {},        -- tied to the current clone
            modeConns = {},    -- tied to the current mode
            mimicConns = {},
            mimicTracks = {},
            tracks = {}, cur = nil, anim = {},
            mode = nil, modeData = {}, mimic = false,
            volume = 100, sounds = {}, footsteps = nil,
            stepConn = nil, acc = 0, heartAcc = 0,
            ui = nil, menuOpen = false, menuConn = nil,
            keepOnRespawn = true, busy = false, token = 0,
            stamps = {}, collide = {}, ptr = nil, ptrTouch = false,
            globalConns = {}, dying = false,
        }

        local function notify(msg, bad)
            if API.onStatus then pcall(API.onStatus, msg, bad) end
        end
        local function cn(list, signal, fn)
            local c = signal:Connect(function(...)
                local ok2, e = pcall(fn, ...)
                if not ok2 then warn("[PARALLAX clone] " .. tostring(e)) end
            end)
            list[#list + 1] = c
            return c
        end
        local function dropAll(list)
            for i = #list, 1, -1 do
                pcall(function() list[i]:Disconnect() end)
                list[i] = nil
            end
        end

        local function myParts()
            local c = LP.Character
            if not c then return nil end
            local h = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local r = c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or c.PrimaryPart
            if h and r and r:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then return c, h, r end
            return nil
        end
        local function cloneAlive()
            return S.model ~= nil and S.model.Parent ~= nil and S.root ~= nil and S.root.Parent ~= nil and S.hum ~= nil
        end

        ---------------------------------------------------------------
        -- animations
        ---------------------------------------------------------------
        local DEFAULT = {
            R15 = { idle = "rbxassetid://507766666", walk = "rbxassetid://507777826", run = "rbxassetid://507767714",
                jump = "rbxassetid://507765000", fall = "rbxassetid://507767968", climb = "rbxassetid://507765644", sit = "rbxassetid://2506281703" },
            R6 = { idle = "rbxassetid://180435571", walk = "rbxassetid://180426354", run = "rbxassetid://180426354",
                jump = "rbxassetid://125750702", fall = "rbxassetid://180436148", climb = "rbxassetid://180436334", sit = "rbxassetid://178130996" },
        }
        local function readAnimIds(char, rig)
            local base = DEFAULT[rig == "R6" and "R6" or "R15"]
            local ids = {}
            for k, v in pairs(base) do ids[k] = v end
            local an = char and char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
            if an then
                local function pick(folder, child)
                    local f = an:FindFirstChild(folder)
                    local a = f and f:FindFirstChild(child)
                    if a and a:IsA("Animation") and a.AnimationId ~= "" then return a.AnimationId end
                end
                ids.idle = pick("idle", "Animation1") or ids.idle
                ids.walk = pick("walk", "WalkAnim") or ids.walk
                ids.run = pick("run", "RunAnim") or ids.run
                ids.jump = pick("jump", "JumpAnim") or ids.jump
                ids.fall = pick("fall", "FallAnim") or ids.fall
                ids.climb = pick("climb", "ClimbAnim") or ids.climb
                ids.sit = pick("sit", "SitAnim") or ids.sit
            end
            return ids
        end
        local function getTrack(name)
            local t = S.tracks[name]
            if t then return t end
            local id = S.anim[name]
            if not id or not S.animator then return nil end
            local a = Instance.new("Animation")
            a.AnimationId = id
            local ok2, tr = pcall(function() return S.animator:LoadAnimation(a) end)
            if ok2 and tr then
                tr.Priority = (name == "idle") and Enum.AnimationPriority.Idle or Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement
                tr.Looped = (name ~= "jump")
                S.tracks[name] = tr
                return tr
            end
        end
        local function play(name, speed)
            if S.cur == name then
                local t = S.tracks[name]
                if t and speed and (name == "walk" or name == "run") then pcall(function() t:AdjustSpeed(speed) end) end
                return
            end
            local old = S.cur and S.tracks[S.cur]
            if old then pcall(function() old:Stop(0.15) end) end
            local t = getTrack(name)
            if t then
                pcall(function() t:Play(0.15) end)
                if speed and (name == "walk" or name == "run") then pcall(function() t:AdjustSpeed(speed) end) end
                S.cur = name
            else
                S.cur = nil
            end
        end

        local function carrying()
            local m = S.mode
            return m == "grab" or m == "drag" or m == "shoulder"
        end

        ---------------------------------------------------------------
        -- volume (footsteps + any sound inside the clone)
        ---------------------------------------------------------------
        local function applyVolume()
            for _, e in ipairs(S.sounds) do
                if e.s and e.s.Parent then pcall(function() e.s.Volume = e.base * (S.volume / 100) end) end
            end
        end
        local function setFootsteps(on)
            local f = S.footsteps
            if not f or not f.Parent then return end
            if on and not f.IsPlaying then pcall(function() f:Play() end)
            elseif not on and f.IsPlaying then pcall(function() f:Pause() end) end
        end

        ---------------------------------------------------------------
        -- build the clone
        ---------------------------------------------------------------
        local function cloneCharacter(char, hum)
            local flipped = {}
            local prev = char.Archivable
            char.Archivable = true
            for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                if not d.Archivable then
                    flipped[#flipped + 1] = d
                    pcall(function() d.Archivable = true end)
                end
            end
            local ok2, m = pcall(function() return char:Clone() end)
            for _, d in ipairs(flipped) do pcall(function() d.Archivable = false end) end
            char.Archivable = prev
            if ok2 and m then return m end
            -- fallback: build from the saved avatar description
            local ok3, desc = pcall(function() return Players:GetHumanoidDescriptionFromUserId(LP.UserId) end)
            if ok3 and desc then
                local ok4, mdl = pcall(function() return Players:CreateHumanoidModelFromDescription(desc, hum.RigType) end)
                if ok4 and mdl then return mdl end
            end
            return nil
        end

        local function sanitize(m)
            for _, d in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do
                if d:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or d:IsA("BillboardGui") or d:IsA("SurfaceGui") or d:IsA("ForceField")
                    or d:IsA("BodyMover") or d:IsA("LinearVelocity") or d:IsA("AlignPosition") or d:IsA("AlignOrientation")
                    or d:IsA("VectorForce") or d:IsA("Highlight") or d:IsA("ClickDetector") or d:IsA("ProximityPrompt")
                    or d:IsA("Tool") or d:IsA("Backpack") then
                    pcall(function() d:Destroy() end)
                end
            end
        end

        local function teardownClone(keepSettings)
            S.token = S.token + 1
            S.dying = true
            -- leave modes without touching a half dead model
            if S.mode then
                S.mode = nil
            end
            dropAll(S.modeConns)
            dropAll(S.mimicConns)
            dropAll(S.conns)
            if S.stepConn then pcall(function() S.stepConn:Disconnect() end) S.stepConn = nil end
            for tr, ctr in pairs(S.mimicTracks) do pcall(function() ctr:Stop(0) end) end
            S.mimicTracks = {}
            for _, t in pairs(S.tracks) do pcall(function() t:Stop(0) end) end
            S.tracks, S.cur, S.sounds, S.footsteps, S.collide = {}, nil, {}, nil, {}
            local m = S.model
            S.model, S.hum, S.root, S.animator = nil, nil, nil, nil
            if m then pcall(function() m:Destroy() end) end
            S.dying = false
        end

        local function stepFn(dt) end -- forward (assigned below)
        local function ensureStep()
            if S.stepConn then return end
            S.stepConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
                local ok2, e = pcall(stepFn, dt)
                if not ok2 then warn("[PARALLAX clone] step: " .. tostring(e)) end
            end)
        end
        local function dropStep()
            if S.stepConn then pcall(function() S.stepConn:Disconnect() end) S.stepConn = nil end
        end

        local setMode, openMenu, closeMenu, refreshMenu, setMimic, buildClone

        local function setupClone(m, cf)
            m.Name = "PXCloneSelf"
            m:SetAttribute("PXClone", true)
            local hum = m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local root = m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not hum or not root then pcall(function() m:Destroy() end) return false end
            m.PrimaryPart = root
            hum.DisplayName = LP.DisplayName .. " (Clone)"
            hum.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.Viewer
            pcall(function() hum.NameDisplayDistance = 70 end)
            pcall(function() hum.HealthDisplayType = Enum.HumanoidHealthDisplayType.AlwaysOff end)
            pcall(function() hum.BreakJointsOnDeath = false end)
            hum.MaxHealth = 100
            hum.Health = 100
            for _, d in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do
                if d:IsA("BasePart") then d.Anchored = false end
            end
            root.Anchored = false
            m:PivotTo(cf)
            m.Parent = Workspace
            S.model, S.hum, S.root = m, hum, root

            local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
            if not animator then
                animator = Instance.new("Animator")
                animator.Parent = hum
            end
            S.animator = animator

            -- footsteps + volume bookkeeping
            S.sounds = {}
            for _, d in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do
                if d:IsA("Sound") then S.sounds[#S.sounds + 1] = { s = d, base = d.Volume } end
            end
            local fs = Instance.new("Sound")
            fs.Name = "PXCloneSteps"
            fs.SoundId = "rbxasset://sounds/action_footsteps_plastic.mp3"
            fs.Looped = true
            fs.RollOffMaxDistance = 60
            fs.Volume = 0.5
            fs.Parent = root
            S.footsteps = fs
            S.sounds[#S.sounds + 1] = { s = fs, base = 0.5 }
            applyVolume()

            -- hover outline
            local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
            hl.Name = "PXCloneHover"
            hl.FillTransparency = 1
            hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            hl.OutlineTransparency = 0.25
            hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
            hl.Enabled = false
            hl.Parent = m

            -- click / tap (mouse and touch) + proximity prompt (touch friendly, keyboard E)
            local cd = Instance.new("ClickDetector")
            cd.MaxActivationDistance = 500
            cd.Parent = m
            cn(S.conns, cd.MouseClick, function() openMenu() end)
            cn(S.conns, cd.MouseHoverEnter, function() hl.Enabled = true end)
            cn(S.conns, cd.MouseHoverLeave, function() hl.Enabled = false end)
            local pp = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
            pp.ActionText = "Clone menu"
            pp.ObjectText = LP.DisplayName .. " (Clone)"
            pp.HoldDuration = 0
            pp.MaxActivationDistance = 12
            pp.RequiresLineOfSight = false
            pp.KeyboardKeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.E
            pp.Parent = root
            cn(S.conns, pp.Triggered, function() openMenu() end)

            -- movement driven animations (event based, no polling)
            cn(S.conns, hum.Running, function(speed)
                if carrying() then return end
                if speed > 0.5 then
                    play(speed > 20 and "run" or "walk", speed / 16)
                    setFootsteps(true)
                else
                    play("idle")
                    setFootsteps(false)
                end
            end)
            cn(S.conns, hum.StateChanged, function(_, new)
                local H = Enum.HumanoidStateType
                if new == H.Jumping then play("jump")
                elseif new == H.Freefall then if not carrying() then play("fall") end
                elseif new == H.Climbing then play("climb")
                elseif new == H.Seated then play("sit")
                elseif new == H.Landed then if not carrying() then play("idle") end end
            end)
            cn(S.conns, hum.Died, function()
                if S.dying or not S.model then return end
                task.delay(1.2, function() if S.model == m then API.refresh() end end)
            end)
            cn(S.conns, m.AncestryChanged, function(_, parent)
                if parent == nil and not S.dying and S.model == m then
                    task.defer(function() if S.model == m or (S.model == nil and not S.dying and S.wanted) then API.refresh() end end)
                end
            end)
            play("idle")
            return true
        end

        function buildClone(cf)
            local char, hum, root = myParts()
            if not char then return false, "You need a living character first." end
            S.anim = readAnimIds(char, hum.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 and "R6" or "R15")
            local m = cloneCharacter(char, hum)
            if not m then return false, "Couldn't copy your character." end
            sanitize(m)
            cf = cf or (root.CFrame * CFrame.new(SIDE_OFFSET))
            if not setupClone(m, cf) then return false, "The copy had no humanoid." end
            return true
        end

        ---------------------------------------------------------------
        -- modes (grab / drag / shoulder / follow / cute)
        ---------------------------------------------------------------
        local function setCollide(on)
            if not S.model then return end
            if on then
                for p, v in pairs(S.collide) do
                    if p.Parent then pcall(function() p.CanCollide = v end) end
                end
                S.collide = {}
            else
                S.collide = {}
                for _, d in ipairs(S.model:GetDescendants()) do
                    if d:IsA("BasePart") then
                        S.collide[d] = d.CanCollide
                        d.CanCollide = false
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        local function neckMotor()
            local m = S.model
            if not m then return nil end
            local head = m:FindFirstChild("Head")
            local n = head and head:FindFirstChild("Neck")
            if n and n:IsA("Motor6D") then return n end
            local torso = m:FindFirstChild("Torso")
            n = torso and torso:FindFirstChild("Neck")
            if n and n:IsA("Motor6D") then return n end
        end

        local function leaveMode(old)
            dropAll(S.modeConns)
            S.modeData = S.modeData or {}
            local d = S.modeData
            if cloneAlive() then
                if old == "grab" or old == "drag" or old == "shoulder" then
                    if d.scaled and S.model then pcall(function() S.model:ScaleTo(d.scaled) end) end
                    setCollide(true)
                    pcall(function() S.hum.Sit = false end)
                    pcall(function() S.hum.PlatformStand = false end)
                    pcall(function() S.root.Anchored = false end)
                    pcall(function()
                        S.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                        S.root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    end)
                    -- stand upright again
                    pcall(function()
                        local p = S.root.Position
                        S.model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(p) * CFrame.Angles(0, select(2, S.root.CFrame:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()), 0))
                    end)
                    pcall(function() S.hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp) end)
                elseif old == "follow" then
                    pcall(function() S.hum:Move(Vector3.zero) S.hum:MoveTo(S.root.Position) end)
                elseif old == "cute" then
                    pcall(function() S.hum.AutoRotate = true end)
                    if d.neck and d.neckC0 then
                        pcall(function() TweenService:Create(d.neck, TweenInfo.new(0.25), { C0 = d.neckC0 }):Play() end)
                    end
                end
                if old then play("idle") end
            end
            S.modeData = {}
        end

        function setMode(newMode)
            if not cloneAlive() then S.mode = nil return end
            if S.mode == newMode then newMode = nil end -- pressing an active mode again cancels it
            local old = S.mode
            S.mode = nil
            leaveMode(old)
            S.mode = newMode
            S.acc, S.heartAcc = 0, 0
            local d = S.modeData
            if newMode == "grab" or newMode == "drag" or newMode == "shoulder" then
                setCollide(false)
                if newMode == "shoulder" then
                    pcall(function()
                        d.scaled = S.model:GetScale()
                        S.model:ScaleTo(d.scaled * SHOULDER_SCALE)
                    end)
                end
                S.root.Anchored = true
                if newMode == "shoulder" then
                    S.hum.Sit = true
                    play("sit")
                else
                    S.hum.PlatformStand = true
                    play("fall")
                end
                if newMode == "drag" then
                    d.started = os.clock()
                    S.ptr, S.ptrTouch = nil, false
                    cn(S.modeConns, UIS.InputChanged, function(input)
                        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
                            S.ptrTouch = false
                        elseif input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                            S.ptr = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y + GuiService:GetGuiInset().Y)
                            S.ptrTouch = true
                        end
                    end)
                    cn(S.modeConns, UIS.InputBegan, function(input, processed)
                        if processed or os.clock() - (d.started or 0) < 0.35 then return end
                        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                            S.ptr = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y + GuiService:GetGuiInset().Y)
                            S.ptrTouch = true
                            -- first tap places the clone, second tap drops it
                            if d.placed then setMode("drag") else d.placed = true end
                        elseif input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                            setMode("drag") -- click drops it
                        end
                    end)
                end
            elseif newMode == "follow" then
                S.root.Anchored = false
            elseif newMode == "cute" then
                S.hum.AutoRotate = false
                local n = neckMotor()
                if n then
                    d.neck, d.neckC0 = n, n.C0
                    pcall(function()
                        TweenService:Create(n, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), { C0 = n.C0 * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(14)) }):Play()
                    end)
                end
            end
            if newMode then ensureStep() elseif not S.mimic then dropStep() end
            if not newMode then dropStep() end
            refreshMenu()
        end

        local function spawnHeart()
            local m = S.model
            local head = m and m:FindFirstChild("Head")
            if not head then return end
            local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
            bb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 34)
            bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
            bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new((math.random() - 0.5) * 2, 1.6, 0)
            bb.Adornee = head
            local t = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            t.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
            t.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            t.Text = "\u{2665}"
            t.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            t.TextScaled = true
            t.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 160)
            t.Parent = bb
            bb.Parent = head
            TweenService:Create(bb, TweenInfo.new(1.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), { StudsOffset = bb.StudsOffset + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0) }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(t, TweenInfo.new(1.5), { TextTransparency = 1 }):Play()
            Debris:AddItem(bb, 1.6)
        end

        function stepFn(dt)
            if not cloneAlive() then
                if S.model and not S.model.Parent then dropStep() end
                return
            end
            local mode = S.mode
            if not mode then dropStep() return end
            local _, myHum, mine = myParts()
            local root, hum = S.root, S.hum
            local alpha = 1 - math.exp(-14 * dt)
            if mode == "grab" then
                if not mine then return end
                local pos = (mine.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.4, -3.6)).Position
                local target = CFrame.lookAt(pos, Vector3.new(mine.Position.X, pos.Y, mine.Position.Z))
                S.model:PivotTo(root.CFrame:Lerp(target, alpha))
            elseif mode == "shoulder" then
                if not mine then return end
                local target = mine.CFrame * CFrame.new(SHOULDER_OFFSET)
                S.model:PivotTo(root.CFrame:Lerp(target, alpha))
            elseif mode == "drag" then
                local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
                if not cam then return end
                local p = (S.ptrTouch and S.ptr) or UIS:GetMouseLocation()
                local ray = cam:ViewportPointToRay(p.X, p.Y)
                local params = RaycastParams.new()
                params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
                local ex = { S.model }
                if LP.Character then ex[#ex + 1] = LP.Character end
                params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ex
                local hit = Workspace:Raycast(ray.Origin, ray.Direction * 800, params)
                local pos
                if hit then
                    pos = hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, hum.HipHeight + root.Size.Y / 2 + 0.3, 0)
                elseif mine then
                    pos = (mine.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -9)).Position
                end
                if pos then
                    local target = CFrame.new(pos) * root.CFrame.Rotation
                    S.model:PivotTo(root.CFrame:Lerp(target, alpha))
                end
            elseif mode == "follow" then
                S.acc = S.acc + dt
                if S.acc < 0.25 then return end
                S.acc = 0
                if not mine then return end
                local off = root.Position - mine.Position
                local flat = Vector3.new(off.X, 0, off.Z)
                local dist = flat.Magnitude
                if dist > 80 then
                    S.model:PivotTo(mine.CFrame * CFrame.new(SIDE_OFFSET))
                elseif dist > 6.5 then
                    local dir = (dist > 0.1) and flat.Unit or mine.CFrame.RightVector
                    hum:MoveTo(mine.Position + dir * 5)
                    if root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude < 1 and dist > 9 then hum.Jump = true end
                else
                    hum:MoveTo(root.Position)
                end
            elseif mode == "cute" then
                if mine then
                    local pos = root.Position
                    local target = CFrame.lookAt(pos, Vector3.new(mine.Position.X, pos.Y, mine.Position.Z))
                    root.CFrame = root.CFrame:Lerp(target, alpha)
                end
                S.heartAcc = S.heartAcc + dt
                if S.heartAcc >= 0.8 then
                    S.heartAcc = 0
                    spawnHeart()
                end
            end
        end

        ---------------------------------------------------------------
        -- mimic: copy emotes / animations you play (event based)
        ---------------------------------------------------------------
        function setMimic(on)
            S.mimic = on and true or false
            dropAll(S.mimicConns)
            for tr, ctr in pairs(S.mimicTracks) do pcall(function() ctr:Stop(0.1) end) end
            S.mimicTracks = {}
            if not on or not cloneAlive() then refreshMenu() return end
            local char, hum = myParts()
            local animator = hum and hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
            if not animator then
                S.mimic = false
                notify("Couldn't find your animator to mimic.", true)
                refreshMenu()
                return
            end
            local skip = {}
            for _, id in pairs(readAnimIds(char, hum.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 and "R6" or "R15")) do skip[id] = true end
            local function copy(tr)
                if not cloneAlive() or S.mimicTracks[tr] then return end
                local a = tr.Animation
                if not a or tr.Priority == Enum.AnimationPriority.Core or skip[a.AnimationId] then return end
                local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
                anim.AnimationId = a.AnimationId
                local ok2, ctr = pcall(function() return S.animator:LoadAnimation(anim) end)
                if not ok2 or not ctr then return end
                ctr.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
                ctr.Looped = tr.Looped
                pcall(function() ctr:Play(0.1, 1, tr.Speed) end)
                pcall(function() ctr.TimePosition = tr.TimePosition end)
                S.mimicTracks[tr] = ctr
                local sc
                sc = tr.Stopped:Connect(function()
                    pcall(function() ctr:Stop(0.1) end)
                    S.mimicTracks[tr] = nil
                    if sc then sc:Disconnect() end
                end)
                S.mimicConns[#S.mimicConns + 1] = sc
            end
            cn(S.mimicConns, animator.AnimationPlayed, copy)
            for _, tr in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do pcall(copy, tr) end
            refreshMenu()
        end

            local vl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            vl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            vl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
            vl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            vl.TextSize = 13
            vl.TextColor3 = C.txt
            vl.Text = "Volume  100%"
            vl.Parent = vrow
            ui.vol = vl
            local function vbtn(text, x0, delta)
                local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
                b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 28)
                b.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x0, 4)
                b.BackgroundColor3 = C.hover
                b.Text = text
                b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
                b.TextSize = 16
                b.TextColor3 = C.txt
                b.Parent = vrow
                rnd(b, 7)
                b.Activated:Connect(function()
                    S.volume = math.clamp(S.volume + delta, 0, 200)
                    applyVolume()
                    vl.Text = "Volume  " .. S.volume .. "%"
                end)
            end
            vbtn("-", 4, -25)
            vbtn("+", W - 24 - 38, 25)

            local rm = Instance.new("TextButton")
            rm.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 338)
            rm.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W - 24, 40)
            rm.BackgroundColor3 = C.red
            rm.Text = "Remove Clone"
            rm.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            rm.TextSize = 14
            rm.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            rm.Parent = frame
            rnd(rm, 10)
            rm.Activated:Connect(function() API.remove() end)

            S.ui = ui
            return ui
        end

        function refreshMenu()
            local ui = S.ui
            if not ui then return end
            for key, e in pairs(ui.btns) do
                local on = (S.mode == key) or (key == "mimic" and S.mimic)
                e.active = on
                e.b.BackgroundColor3 = on and C.on or C.card
            end
            local stop = ui.btns.cancel
            if stop then
                local any = S.mode ~= nil or S.mimic
                stop.b.Text = any and "Stop" or "Idle"
                stop.b.TextTransparency = any and 0 or 0.5
            end
            ui.vol.Text = "Volume  " .. S.volume .. "%"
        end

        local function placeMenu()
            local ui = S.ui
            if not ui or not ui.frame.Visible then return end
            local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
            local vp = cam and cam.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
            local x, y = vp.X - ui.W - 24, (vp.Y - ui.H) / 2
            if cloneAlive() and cam then
                local head = S.model:FindFirstChild("Head") or S.root
                local sp, vis = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position)
                if vis and sp.Z > 0 then
                    x = sp.X + 70
                    if x + ui.W > vp.X - 8 then x = sp.X - 70 - ui.W end
                    y = sp.Y - ui.H / 2
                end
            end
            x = math.clamp(x, 8, math.max(8, vp.X - ui.W - 8))
            y = math.clamp(y, 8, math.max(8, vp.Y - ui.H - 8))
            ui.frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(x), math.floor(y))
        end

        function openMenu()
            if not cloneAlive() then return false end
            local ui = buildUi()
            refreshMenu()
            ui.frame.Visible = true
            ui.scale.Scale = 0.9
            TweenService:Create(ui.scale, TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), { Scale = 1 }):Play()
            S.menuOpen = true
            placeMenu()
            if S.menuConn then S.menuConn:Disconnect() end
            S.menuConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
                if not S.menuOpen then return end
                if not cloneAlive() then closeMenu() return end
                placeMenu()
            end)
            return true
        end

        function closeMenu()
            S.menuOpen = false
            if S.menuConn then pcall(function() S.menuConn:Disconnect() end) S.menuConn = nil end
            local ui = S.ui
            if ui and ui.frame.Visible then
                local t = TweenService:Create(ui.scale, TweenInfo.new(0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), { Scale = 0.92 })
                t.Completed:Connect(function() if not S.menuOpen and ui.frame then ui.frame.Visible = false end end)
                t:Play()
            end
        end

        -- tapping / clicking empty world closes the card
        S.globalConns[#S.globalConns + 1] = UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
            if processed or not S.menuOpen then return end
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                task.delay(0.05, function() if S.menuOpen and not S.justOpened then closeMenu() end end)
            end
        end)

        ---------------------------------------------------------------
        -- public API
        ---------------------------------------------------------------
        function API.remove()
            local had = S.model ~= nil
            S.wanted = false
            closeMenu()
            teardownClone()
            dropStep()
            if S.ui then refreshMenu() end
            if had then notify("Clone removed.") end
            return had
        end

        function API.spawn()
            if S.busy then return false end
            S.busy = true
            S.wanted = true
            local ok2, res, msg = pcall(function()
                closeMenu()
                teardownClone()
                -- orphans from an older run
                for _, o in ipairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do
                    if o.Name == "PXCloneSelf" then pcall(function() o:Destroy() end) end
                end
                return buildClone(nil)
            end)
            S.busy = false
            if not ok2 then
                S.wanted = false
                notify("Clone failed: " .. tostring(res), true)
                return false
            end
            if not res then
                S.wanted = false
                notify(msg or "Couldn't create the clone.", true)
                return false
            end
            notify("Clone spawned. Click or tap it (or press E near it) for the menu.")
            return true
        end

        function API.refresh()
            if S.busy then return false end
            -- rate limit so a clone that keeps dying can't loop forever
            local now = os.clock()
            local keep = {}
            for _, t in ipairs(S.stamps) do if now - t < 15 then keep[#keep + 1] = t end end
            S.stamps = keep
            if #S.stamps >= 4 then
                S.wanted = false
                notify("Clone kept failing, stopped. Press Clone Self to try again.", true)
                return false
            end
            S.stamps[#S.stamps + 1] = now
            S.busy = true
            local cf = cloneAlive() and S.root.CFrame or nil
            local mode, mimic, wasOpen = S.mode, S.mimic, S.menuOpen
            local ok2, res = pcall(function()
                teardownClone()
                return buildClone(cf)
            end)
            S.busy = false
            if not ok2 or not res then
                notify("Couldn't rebuild the clone yet. It will retry when your character is ready.", true)
                return false
            end
            if mimic then setMimic(true) end
            if mode and mode ~= "drag" then setMode(mode) end
            if wasOpen then openMenu() end
            notify("Clone refreshed.")
            return true
        end

        function API.openMenu() return openMenu() end
        function API.closeMenu() closeMenu() end
        function API.state()
            return { exists = cloneAlive(), mode = S.mode, mimic = S.mimic, volume = S.volume, keep = S.keepOnRespawn }
        end
        function API.setKeepOnRespawn(v) S.keepOnRespawn = v and true or false end

        -- respawn: rebuild the clone from the new character
        S.globalConns[#S.globalConns + 1] = LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
            if not S.model and not S.wanted then return end
            if not S.keepOnRespawn then return end
            local my = os.clock()
            S.respawnStamp = my
            task.spawn(function()
                pcall(function() char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10) end)
                pcall(function() char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10) end)
                for _ = 1, 24 do
                    local ok2, loaded = pcall(function() return char:HasAppearanceLoaded() end)
                    if ok2 and loaded then break end
                    task.wait(0.25)
                end
                task.wait(0.5)
                if S.respawnStamp ~= my or not S.wanted or LP.Character ~= char then return end
                -- a respawn is a fresh start, not a failure
                S.stamps = {}
                API.refresh()
            end)
        end)

        function API.destroy()
            S.wanted = false
            teardownClone()
            dropStep()
            if S.menuConn then pcall(function() S.menuConn:Disconnect() end) end
            dropAll(S.globalConns)
            if S.ui and S.ui.gui then pcall(function() S.ui.gui:Destroy() end) end
            S.ui = nil
            if _G.PrismCloneSelf == API then _G.PrismCloneSelf = nil end
        end

        _G.PrismCloneSelf = API
        print("[PARALLAX] clone self: ready")
    end)
    if not ok then warn("[PARALLAX] clone self failed: " .. tostring(err)) end
end)

-- ==========================================================================
--  PARALLAX CRASH SHIELD
--  Runs by default. Turn it off with  _G.PrismShield = false
--  Layer 2 on top of Settings > Anti Crash. Only ever removes or tones down
--  things OTHER people put into your game. Your own avatar, clone and the
--  Parallax windows are never touched.
-- ==========================================================================
task.spawn(function()
    pcall(function()
        local Players = game:GetService("Players")
        local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
        local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")
        local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
        if not lp then return end

        -- a re-execute replaces the old shield instead of stacking a second one
        if type(_G._PrismCrashShieldStop) == "function" then pcall(_G._PrismCrashShieldStop) end
        local conns = {}
        local alive = true
        local function on() return alive and _G.PrismShield ~= false end
        local stats = { chat = 0, gui = 0, flood = 0, avatar = 0, lag = 0 }
        _G._PrismCrashShieldStats = stats
        _G._PrismCrashShieldStop = function()
            alive = false
            for _, c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
            conns = {}
        end
        local function hold(c) conns[#conns + 1] = c return c end

        -- ----- who is "mine" ------------------------------------------------
        local function myClone()
            local api = rawget(_G, "_HaloReanimateAPI") or rawget(_G, "ReanimateAPI")
            local c
            pcall(function() if api and api.get_clone then c = api.get_clone(lp) end end)
            return c
        end
        local function isMine(inst)
            local char = lp.Character
            if char and (inst == char or inst:IsDescendantOf(char)) then return true end
            local cl = myClone()
            if cl and (inst == cl or inst:IsDescendantOf(cl)) then return true end
            local real
            pcall(function()
                local api = rawget(_G, "_HaloReanimateAPI") or rawget(_G, "ReanimateAPI")
                if api and api.get_real_character then real = api.get_real_character() end
            end)
            if real and (inst == real or inst:IsDescendantOf(real)) then return true end
            return false
        end
        local function isOurName(n)
            n = string.lower(tostring(n))
            return n:find("^prism") or n:find("^reanim") or n:find("^halo") or n:find("^tranzit") or n:find("^parallax")
        end
        local function ours(inst)
            local p = inst
            while p and p ~= game do
                if isOurName(p.Name) then return true end
                p = p.Parent
            end
            return false
        end

        -- ----- 1. chat bombs ------------------------------------------------
        -- very long lines, walls of stacked accents and rich-text tag floods are a known way to freeze a client
        local function badText(t)
            if type(t) ~= "string" then return false end
            if #t > 900 then return true end
            local tags = 0
            for _ in string.gmatch(t, "<") do
                tags = tags + 1
                if tags > 24 then return true end
            end
            local marks = 0
            local ok = pcall(function()
                for _, cp in utf8.codes(t) do
                    if (cp >= 0x300 and cp <= 0x36F) or (cp >= 0x1AB0 and cp <= 0x1AFF) or (cp >= 0x20D0 and cp <= 0x20FF) then
                        marks = marks + 1
                        if marks > 18 then return end
                    end
                end
            end)
            if marks > 18 then return true end
