            if not ok and #t > 200 then return true end
            if #t > 300 and not t:find("%s") then return true end
            return false
        end
        pcall(function()
            local old = TextChatService.OnIncomingMessage
            TextChatService.OnIncomingMessage = function(message)
                local props
                if old then
                    local okO, r = pcall(old, message)
                    if okO then props = r end
                end
                if on() then
                    local mine = false
                    pcall(function() mine = message.TextSource and message.TextSource.UserId == lp.UserId end)
                    if not mine and badText(message.Text) then
                        props = props or Instance.new("TextChatMessageProperties")
                        props.Text = "[blocked: crash-style message]"
                        stats.chat = stats.chat + 1
                    end
                end
                return props
            end
        end)

        -- ----- 2. floods of one kind of object ------------------------------
        -- how many of each class may appear in one second before the extras are dropped
        local LIMIT = {
            Sound = 150, Highlight = 60, Sparkles = 100, Fire = 200, Smoke = 200,
            ParticleEmitter = 300, Beam = 300, Trail = 300, Explosion = 6,
            Decal = 1500, Texture = 1500, SurfaceGui = 300, BillboardGui = 200,
            Tool = 100, Accessory = 600, Humanoid = 60, PointLight = 400, SpotLight = 300,
            SurfaceLight = 300, ForceField = 100,
        }
        local counts = {}
        local startAt = os.clock()   -- first seconds of a join are busy with normal loading, so don't judge them
        local windowAt = os.clock()
        local killQueue = {}
        local function drop(inst)
            if not inst or not inst.Parent then return end
            if isMine(inst) or ours(inst) then return end
            killQueue[#killQueue + 1] = inst
        end
        hold(workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(inst)
            local lim = LIMIT[inst.ClassName]
            if not lim then return end
            if not on() or os.clock() - startAt < 8 then return end
            local n = (counts[inst.ClassName] or 0) + 1
            counts[inst.ClassName] = n
            if n > lim and #killQueue < 3000 then
                drop(inst)
            end
        end))

        -- ----- 3. other players' avatars -----------------------------------
        -- round robin, one player per tick, so it never costs a frame spike
        local function tameAvatar(char)
            if not char or not char.Parent or isMine(char) then return end
            local acc, hum, snd = 0, 0, 0
            local descs = char:GetDescendants()
            if #descs > 6000 then
                -- an avatar with thousands of parts is an attack, not an outfit
                for _, d in ipairs(descs) do
                    if d:IsA("Accessory") or d:IsA("Tool") then pcall(function() d:Destroy() end) end
                end
                stats.avatar = stats.avatar + 1
                return
            end
            for i, d in ipairs(descs) do
                local cls = d.ClassName
                if cls == "Accessory" then
                    acc = acc + 1
                    if acc > 30 then pcall(function() d:Destroy() end) stats.avatar = stats.avatar + 1 end
                elseif cls == "Humanoid" then
                    hum = hum + 1
                    if hum > 1 then pcall(function() d:Destroy() end) stats.avatar = stats.avatar + 1 end
                elseif cls == "Sound" then
                    snd = snd + 1
                    pcall(function()
                        if snd > 8 or d.Volume > 10 then d.Playing = false d.Volume = 0 stats.avatar = stats.avatar + 1 end
                    end)
                elseif cls == "ParticleEmitter" then
                    pcall(function()
                        if d.Rate > 60 or d.Lifetime.Max > 20 then d.Enabled = false stats.avatar = stats.avatar + 1 end
                    end)
                elseif cls == "Highlight" or cls == "Explosion" then
                    pcall(function() d:Destroy() end)
                    stats.avatar = stats.avatar + 1
                elseif d:IsA("BasePart") then
                    pcall(function()
                        local s = d.Size
                        if s.X > 60 or s.Y > 60 or s.Z > 60 or s.X ~= s.X or s.Y ~= s.Y or s.Z ~= s.Z then
                            d:Destroy()
                            stats.avatar = stats.avatar + 1
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
        local rr = 0
        task.spawn(function()
            while alive do
                task.wait(0.45)
                if on() then
                    local list = Players:GetPlayers()
                    if #list > 0 then
                        rr = rr % #list + 1
                        local p = list[rr]
                        if p and p ~= lp and p.Character then pcall(tameAvatar, p.Character) end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)

        -- ----- 4. GUI floods pushed into your screen -----------------------
        local guiBase = {}
        pcall(function()
            local pg = lp:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 5)
            if not pg then return end
            for _, g in ipairs(pg:GetChildren()) do guiBase[g] = true end
            local added = 0
            local at = os.clock()
            hold(pg.ChildAdded:Connect(function(g)
                if not on() or guiBase[g] or ours(g) then return end
                local now = os.clock()
                if now - at > 1 then at, added = now, 0 end
                added = added + 1
                if added > 14 then
                    task.defer(function()
                        pcall(function() if g and g.Parent then g:Destroy() end end)
                        stats.gui = stats.gui + 1
                    end)
                end
            end))
            -- a single GUI stuffed with an absurd number of children
            task.spawn(function()
                while alive do
                    task.wait(2)
                    if on() then
                        for _, g in ipairs(pg:GetChildren()) do
                            if not guiBase[g] and not ours(g) then
                                local n = #g:GetChildren()
                                if n > 1500 then
                                    pcall(function() g:Destroy() end)
                                    stats.gui = stats.gui + 1
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
        end)

        -- ----- 5. emergency brake when the game turns into a slideshow -----
        local slow, savedQ, calmSince, braked = 0, nil, os.clock(), false
        local lastBrake = 0
        local function brake()
            braked = true
            lastBrake = os.clock()
            stats.lag = stats.lag + 1
            pcall(function()
                local r = settings().Rendering
                if savedQ == nil then savedQ = r.QualityLevel end
                r.QualityLevel = Enum.QualityLevel.Level01
            end)
            task.spawn(function()
                local n = 0
                for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                    n = n + 1
                    if n % 2500 == 0 then task.wait() end
                    local cls = d.ClassName
                    if cls == "ParticleEmitter" or cls == "Beam" or cls == "Trail" or cls == "Fire"
                        or cls == "Smoke" or cls == "Sparkles" or cls == "Highlight" then
                        if not isMine(d) and not ours(d) then pcall(function() d.Enabled = false end) end
                    elseif cls == "Explosion" then
                        if not isMine(d) then pcall(function() d:Destroy() end) end
                    elseif cls == "Sound" then
                        if not isMine(d) and not ours(d) then pcall(function() d.Playing = false end) end
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
        hold(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
            local now = os.clock()
            -- reset the per-second flood counters
            if now - windowAt >= 1 then
                windowAt = now
                for k in pairs(counts) do counts[k] = 0 end
            end
            if not on() then return end
            -- drop flooded objects a few at a time
            -- Keep flood cleanup from destroying dozens of instances in one frame.
            local perfGuard = rawget(_G, "_PrismPerfGuard")
            local budget = (perfGuard and perfGuard.pressure) and 3 or 8
            while budget > 0 and #killQueue > 0 do
                local inst = table.remove(killQueue)
                budget = budget - 1
                if inst and inst.Parent then
                    pcall(function() inst:Destroy() end)
                    stats.flood = stats.flood + 1
                end
            end
            -- lag watchdog: under ~3 fps for several frames in a row
            if dt > 0.33 then slow = slow + 1 else slow = math.max(0, slow - 1) end
            if slow >= 4 and now - lastBrake > 10 then
                slow = 0
                brake()
            end
            if braked then
                if dt < 0.04 then
                    if now - calmSince > 8 and now - lastBrake > 12 then
                        braked = false
                        pcall(function()
                            if savedQ ~= nil then settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = savedQ end
                            savedQ = nil
                        end)
                    end
                else
                    calmSince = now
                end
            else
                calmSince = now
            end
        end))

        -- ----- 6. bad numbers on your own character ------------------------
        hold(RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
            if not on() then return end
            local char = lp.Character
            local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not root then return end
            local p = root.Position
            if p.X ~= p.X or p.Y ~= p.Y or p.Z ~= p.Z or math.abs(p.X) > 1e6 or math.abs(p.Y) > 1e6 or math.abs(p.Z) > 1e6 then
                local safe = _G._PrismLastSafeCF
                if typeof(safe) == "CFrame" then
                    pcall(function()
                        root.CFrame = safe
                        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    end)
                end
            else
                _G._PrismLastSafeCF = root.CFrame
            end
        end))

        print("[PARALLAX] crash shield: on")
    end)


end)


-- ================================================================
--  PRISM  --  ASSET PLACEMENT  (ID 11486778910 at world position)
--  Loads the asset and positions it at (-218.9, 3.8, 72253.1).
-- ================================================================
task.spawn(function()
    local _aok, _aerr = pcall(function()
        local assetId = 11486778910
        local targetPos = Vector3.new(-218.9, 3.8, 72253.1)
        local model

        -- Try game:GetObjects first (works in most executors)
        local ok1, res1 = pcall(function()
            local objs = game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. tostring(assetId))
            if objs and objs[1] then
                model = objs[1]
            end
        end)

        -- Fallback: InsertService
        if not model then
            local ok2, res2 = pcall(function()
                model = game:GetService("InsertService"):LoadAsset(assetId)
            end)
        end

        if model then
            model:MoveTo(targetPos)
            model.Parent = workspace
            print("[PARALLAX] Asset " .. tostring(assetId) .. " placed")
        else
            warn("[PARALLAX] Asset " .. tostring(assetId) .. " could not be loaded")
        end
    end)
    if not _aok then
        warn("[PARALLAX] Asset err: " .. tostring(_aerr))
    end
end)

-- ================================================================
-- Double jump was removed. Disconnect connections left by a previous script run.
for _, key in ipairs({
    "_ParallaxDoubleJumpInputConn", "_ParallaxDoubleJumpCharacterConn",
    "_ParallaxDoubleJumpStateConn", "_ParallaxDoubleJumpRigConn", "_ParallaxDoubleJumpKeyConn",
}) do
    local conn=rawget(_G,key)
    if conn then pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end); _G[key]=nil end
end

--  PARALLAX BUILD MODE
--  Menu button BUILD turns on a Fortnite-style grid builder.
--  The piece bar sits in the bottom right. Click a letter to
--  rebind that piece to any key. Left click places, right click
--  deletes, the rotate key turns the piece.
--  Wrapped in a function so these locals don't blow the main
--  chunk's 200-local limit (that was stopping the script loading).
-- ================================================================
task.spawn(function()
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
    local lp = Players.LocalPlayer

    local TILE = 6
    local PIECES = { "Wall", "Floor", "Ramp", "Roof", "Cone" }
    local binds = {
        Wall = Enum.KeyCode.Z,
        Floor = Enum.KeyCode.X,
        Ramp = Enum.KeyCode.C,
        Roof = Enum.KeyCode.V,
        Cone = Enum.KeyCode.B,
        Rotate = Enum.KeyCode.R,
        Edit = Enum.KeyCode.G,
    }
    local enabled = false
    local selected = "Wall"
    local rot = 0
    local rebindId = nil
    local preview = nil
    local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("ParallaxBuilds")
    if not folder then
        folder = Instance.new("Folder")
        folder.Name = "ParallaxBuilds"
        folder.Parent = workspace
    end

    local function loadBinds()
        if type(readfile) ~= "function" then return end
        local ok, raw = pcall(readfile, "ParallaxBuildBinds.json")
        if not ok or type(raw) ~= "string" or raw == "" then return end
        local ok2, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(raw) end)
        if not ok2 or type(data) ~= "table" then return end
        for id, name in pairs(data) do
            if binds[id] ~= nil and type(name) == "string" then
                local ok3, kc = pcall(function() return Enum.KeyCode[name] end)
                if ok3 and kc then binds[id] = kc end
            end
        end
    end

    local function saveBinds()
        if type(writefile) ~= "function" then return end
        local out = {}
        for id, kc in pairs(binds) do
            out[id] = kc.Name
        end
        pcall(writefile, "ParallaxBuildBinds.json", HttpService:JSONEncode(out))
    end
    loadBinds()

    local MATERIALS = {
        Wood = { mat = Enum.Material.Wood, color = Color3.fromRGB(168, 118, 72) },
        Brick = { mat = Enum.Material.Brick, color = Color3.fromRGB(152, 86, 72) },
        Metal = { mat = Enum.Material.DiamondPlate, color = Color3.fromRGB(180, 188, 198) },
    }
    local MAT_ORDER = { "Wood", "Brick", "Metal" }
    local material = "Wood"
    local editing = nil
    local picked = {}
    local boxes = {}

    local function stylePart(p, ghost)
        local info = MATERIALS[material] or MATERIALS.Wood
        p.Anchored = true
        p.CanCollide = not ghost
        p.CanQuery = not ghost
        p.CanTouch = false
        p.CastShadow = not ghost
        p.Material = info.mat
        p.Color = ghost and info.color:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(80, 170, 255), 0.4) or info.color
        p.Transparency = ghost and 0.4 or 0
        p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
        p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
    end

    local function addCell(m, size, cf, r, c, ghost)
        local part = Instance.new("Part")
        part.Size = size
        part.CFrame = cf
        part:SetAttribute("R", r)
        part:SetAttribute("C", c)
        stylePart(part, ghost)
        part.Parent = m
        return part
    end

    local function buildPiece(kind, ghost)
        local m = Instance.new("Model")
        m.Name = "Parallax" .. kind
        m:SetAttribute("Kind", kind)
        m:SetAttribute("Mat", material)
        local s = TILE / 3
        if kind == "Wall" then
            for r = 0, 2 do
                for c = 0, 2 do
                    local x = (c - 1) * s
                    local y = (r - 1) * s
                    addCell(m, Vector3.new(s, s, 0.55), CFrame.new(x, y, 0), r, c, ghost)
                end
            end
        elseif kind == "Floor" then
            for r = 0, 2 do
                for c = 0, 2 do
                    local x = (c - 1) * s
                    local z = (r - 1) * s
                    addCell(m, Vector3.new(s, 0.45, s), CFrame.new(x, 0, z), r, c, ghost)
                end
            end
        elseif kind == "Cone" then
            for r = 0, 2 do
                for c = 0, 2 do
                    local x = (c - 1) * s
                    local z = (r - 1) * s
                    local dist = math.max(math.abs(c - 1), math.abs(r - 1))
                    local h = (3 - dist) * s
                    local y = -TILE / 2 + h / 2
                    addCell(m, Vector3.new(s * 0.98, h, s * 0.98), CFrame.new(x, y, z), r, c, ghost)
                end
            end
        else
            -- ramp and roof: stair steps, low at the front, high at the back
            for r = 0, 2 do
                for c = 0, 2 do
                    local x = (c - 1) * s
                    local z = (r - 1) * s
                    local h = (r + 1) * s
                    local y = -TILE / 2 + h / 2
                    addCell(m, Vector3.new(s * 0.98, h, s * 0.98), CFrame.new(x, y, z), r, c, ghost)
                end
            end
        end
        m.WorldPivot = CFrame.new()
        return m
    end

    local function turnedDir()
        local look = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector
        local d
        if math.abs(look.X) > math.abs(look.Z) then
            d = (look.X >= 0) and Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) or Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0)
        else
            d = (look.Z >= 0) and Vector3.new(0, 0, 1) or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
        end
        for _ = 1, rot % 4 do
            d = Vector3.new(-d.Z, 0, d.X)
        end
        return d
    end

    local function aimHit()
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not cam then return nil end
        local params = RaycastParams.new()
        params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        local ignore = {}
        if lp.Character then ignore[#ignore + 1] = lp.Character end
        local api = rawget(_G, "_HaloReanimateAPI")
        if api and type(api.get_real_character) == "function" then
            local ok, real = pcall(api.get_real_character, lp)
            if ok and typeof(real) == "Instance" then ignore[#ignore + 1] = real end
        end
        if preview then ignore[#ignore + 1] = preview end
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore
        local hit = workspace:Raycast(cam.CFrame.Position, cam.CFrame.LookVector * 90, params)
        if hit then return hit end
        return {
            Position = cam.CFrame.Position + cam.CFrame.LookVector * 14,
            Normal = Vector3.yAxis,
            Instance = nil,
        }
    end

    local function pieceCF(kind)
        local hit = aimHit()
        if not hit then return nil end
        local dir = turnedDir()
        local pos = hit.Position
        local normal = hit.Normal or Vector3.yAxis
        local px = math.floor(pos.X / TILE) * TILE + TILE / 2
        local pz = math.floor(pos.Z / TILE) * TILE + TILE / 2
        local baseY = pos.Y
        local inst = hit.Instance
        if typeof(inst) == "Instance" and inst:IsDescendantOf(folder) then
            local model = inst:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
            if model and model.Parent == folder then
                local cf, size = model:GetBoundingBox()
                if math.abs(normal.Y) > 0.45 then
                    baseY = cf.Position.Y + size.Y / 2
                    px = math.floor(cf.Position.X / TILE) * TILE + TILE / 2
                    pz = math.floor(cf.Position.Z / TILE) * TILE + TILE / 2
                else
                    local flat = Vector3.new(normal.X, 0, normal.Z)
                    if flat.Magnitude < 0.05 then flat = dir else flat = flat.Unit end
                    baseY = cf.Position.Y - size.Y / 2
                    px = math.floor((cf.Position.X + flat.X * TILE) / TILE) * TILE + TILE / 2
                    pz = math.floor((cf.Position.Z + flat.Z * TILE) / TILE) * TILE + TILE / 2
                end
            end
        elseif normal.Y > 0.45 then
            baseY = pos.Y
        else
            local flat = Vector3.new(normal.X, 0, normal.Z)
            if flat.Magnitude > 0.05 then
                flat = flat.Unit
                px = math.floor((pos.X + flat.X * (TILE * 0.5)) / TILE) * TILE + TILE / 2
                pz = math.floor((pos.Z + flat.Z * (TILE * 0.5)) / TILE) * TILE + TILE / 2
            end
            baseY = math.floor(pos.Y / TILE) * TILE
        end
        if kind == "Floor" then
            return CFrame.new(px, baseY + 0.22, pz)
        elseif kind == "Wall" then
            local edge = Vector3.new(
                dir.X ~= 0 and (px + dir.X * (TILE / 2)) or px,
                baseY + TILE / 2,
                dir.Z ~= 0 and (pz + dir.Z * (TILE / 2)) or pz
            )
            return CFrame.lookAt(edge, edge + dir)
        elseif kind == "Ramp" then
            local center = Vector3.new(px, baseY + TILE / 2, pz)
            return CFrame.lookAt(center, center + dir)
        elseif kind == "Roof" then
            local center = Vector3.new(px, baseY + TILE / 2, pz)
            return CFrame.lookAt(center, center - dir)
        end
        return CFrame.new(px, baseY + TILE / 2, pz)
    end

    local function killPreview()
        if preview then
            preview:Destroy()
            preview = nil
        end
    end

    local function updatePreview()
        if not enabled or editing or not workspace.CurrentCamera then
            killPreview()
            return
        end
        if not preview or preview:GetAttribute("Kind") ~= selected or preview:GetAttribute("Mat") ~= material then
            killPreview()
            preview = buildPiece(selected, true)
            preview.Name = "ParallaxBuildPreview"
        end
        local cf = pieceCF(selected)
        if not cf then return end
        preview:PivotTo(cf)
        if not preview.Parent then preview.Parent = workspace end
    end

    local function occupied(cf, kind)
        for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("Model") and child:GetAttribute("Kind") == kind and child ~= preview then
                if (child:GetPivot().Position - cf.Position).Magnitude < 0.8 then
                    return true
                end
            end
        end
        return false
    end

    local function place()
        if not enabled or editing then return end
        local cf = pieceCF(selected)
        if not cf or occupied(cf, selected) then return end
        local m = buildPiece(selected, false)
        m:PivotTo(cf)
        m.Parent = folder
    end

    local function modelFromInst(inst)
        while inst and inst ~= folder do
            if inst.Parent == folder and inst:IsA("Model") then
                return inst
            end
            inst = inst.Parent
        end
    end

    local function aimedBuild()
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not cam then return nil, nil end
        local params = RaycastParams.new()
        params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { folder }
        local hit = workspace:Raycast(cam.CFrame.Position, cam.CFrame.LookVector * 120, params)
        if not hit then return nil, nil end
        return modelFromInst(hit.Instance), hit
    end

    local function clearBoxes()
        for _, b in ipairs(boxes) do
            if b then pcall(function() b:Destroy() end) end
        end
        boxes = {}
    end

    local function paintCell(part, on)
        local info = MATERIALS[(editing and editing:GetAttribute("Mat")) or material] or MATERIALS.Wood
        if on then
            part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(64, 148, 255)
            part.Transparency = 0.12
        else
            part.Color = info.color
            part.Transparency = 0
        end
    end

    local function endEdit(doCut)
        if editing and doCut then
            for part in pairs(picked) do
                if part and part.Parent then
                    part.Transparency = 1
                    part.CanCollide = false
                    part.CanQuery = false
                    part:SetAttribute("Cut", true)
                end
            end
        elseif editing then
            for _, part in ipairs(editing:GetDescendants()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") and part:GetAttribute("Cut") ~= true then
                    paintCell(part, false)
                end
            end
        end
        clearBoxes()
        picked = {}
        editing = nil
    end

    local function beginEdit(model)
        if editing then endEdit(false) end
        if not model then
            model = aimedBuild()
        end
        if not model then return end
        editing = model
        picked = {}
        killPreview()
        for _, part in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") and part:GetAttribute("Cut") ~= true then
                local box = Instance.new("SelectionBox")
                box.Name = "ParallaxEditBox"
                box.Adornee = part
                box.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 245, 255)
                box.LineThickness = 0.035
                box.SurfaceTransparency = 0.82
                box.SurfaceColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 170, 255)
                box.Parent = part
                boxes[#boxes + 1] = box
            end
        end
    end

    local function toggleCell()
        local model, hit = aimedBuild()
        if not editing or model ~= editing or not hit then return end
        local part = hit.Instance
        if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart") or part:GetAttribute("Cut") == true then return end
        picked[part] = not picked[part]
        if not picked[part] then picked[part] = nil end
        paintCell(part, picked[part] == true)
    end

    local function resetPiece()
        if not editing then return end
        local info = MATERIALS[editing:GetAttribute("Mat") or "Wood"] or MATERIALS.Wood
        for _, part in ipairs(editing:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                part:SetAttribute("Cut", nil)
                part.Transparency = 0
                part.CanCollide = true
                part.CanQuery = true
                part.Material = info.mat
                part.Color = info.color
            end
        end
        local model = editing
        endEdit(false)
        beginEdit(model)
    end

    local function removeAimed()
        if editing then return end
        local model = aimedBuild()
        if model then model:Destroy() end
    end

    local pg = lp:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") or lp:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    local oldGui = pg:FindFirstChild("ParallaxBuildGui")
    if oldGui then oldGui:Destroy() end

    local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    gui.Name = "ParallaxBuildGui"
    gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    gui.DisplayOrder = 100000
    gui.Enabled = false
    gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
    gui.Parent = pg

    local bar = Instance.new("Frame")
    bar.Name = "Bar"
    bar.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
    bar.Position = UDim2.new(1, -18, 1, -18)
    bar.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(420, 132)
    bar.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    bar.Parent = gui

    local hint = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    hint.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    hint.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
    hint.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    hint.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16)
    hint.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    hint.TextSize = 11
    hint.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 242, 255)
    hint.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
    hint.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
    hint.Parent = bar

    local matRow = Instance.new("Frame")
    matRow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    matRow.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
    matRow.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -98)
    matRow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(250, 24)
    matRow.Parent = bar
    local matLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    matLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
    matLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right
    matLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
    matLayout.Parent = matRow

    local matBtns = {}
    local function refreshMaterials()
        for name, btn in pairs(matBtns) do
            local on = name == material
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = on and (MATERIALS[name].color) or Color3.fromRGB(28, 32, 40)
            btn.TextColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(20, 16, 12) or Color3.fromRGB(230, 235, 245)
        end
    end
    for _, name in ipairs(MAT_ORDER) do
        local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        btn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(76, 22)
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 32, 40)
        btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        btn.TextSize = 11
        btn.Text = name
        btn.AutoButtonColor = false
        btn.Parent = matRow
        local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
        c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
        c.Parent = btn
        matBtns[name] = btn
        btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            material = name
            killPreview()
            refreshMaterials()
        end)
    end

    local row = Instance.new("Frame")
    row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    row.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
    row.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -20)
    row.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(400, 74)
    row.Parent = bar
    local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    layout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
    layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right
    layout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom
    layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)
    layout.Parent = row

    local keyLabels = {}
    local strokes = {}
    local scales = {}

    local function iconOf(parent, kind)
        local vp = Instance.new("ViewportFrame")
        vp.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        vp.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        vp.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(200, 230, 255)
        vp.LightColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        vp.LightDirection = Vector3.new(-0.4, -1, -0.3)
        vp.Parent = parent
        local savedMat = material
        material = "Metal"
        local m = buildPiece(kind, false)
        material = savedMat
        for _, d in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("BasePart") then
                d.Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 220, 255)
                d.Transparency = 0
                d.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
            end
        end
        m.Parent = vp
        local cam = Instance.new("Camera")
        cam.FieldOfView = 30
        vp.CurrentCamera = cam
        cam.Parent = vp
        local cf, size = m:GetBoundingBox()
        local dist = math.max(size.X, size.Y, size.Z) * 1.45
        cam.CFrame = CFrame.new(cf.Position + Vector3.new(1, 0.78, 1).Unit * dist, cf.Position)
    end

    local function refreshBar()
        for id, lbl in pairs(keyLabels) do
            lbl.Text = (rebindId == id) and "..." or (binds[id] and binds[id].Name or "?")
        end
        for id, stroke in pairs(strokes) do
            local on = id == selected
            stroke.Transparency = on and 0 or 0.65
            stroke.Color = on and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(170, 220, 255)
            stroke.Thickness = on and 2 or 1
        end
        for id, sc in pairs(scales) do
            sc.Scale = (id == selected) and 1.06 or 1
        end
        refreshMaterials()
        if editing then
            hint.Text = "EDIT   click tiles   " .. (binds.Edit and binds.Edit.Name or "G") .. " confirm   right click reset   esc cancel"
        else
            local rotName = binds.Rotate and binds.Rotate.Name or "R"
            local editName = binds.Edit and binds.Edit.Name or "G"
            hint.Text = rotName .. " rotate    " .. editName .. " edit    right click delete    click a letter to rebind"
        end
    end

    local function beginRebind(id)
        rebindId = id
        refreshBar()
    end

    local function makeSlot(id)
        local slot = Instance.new("Frame")
        slot.Name = id
        slot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(56, 74)
        slot.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        slot.Parent = row
        local key = Instance.new("TextButton")
        key.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16)
        key.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        key.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        key.TextSize = 13
        key.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        key.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
        key.Text = binds[id].Name
        key.AutoButtonColor = false
        key.Parent = slot
        keyLabels[id] = key
        key.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            beginRebind(id)
        end)
        local tile = Instance.new("TextButton")
        tile.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 18)
        tile.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(52, 52)
        tile.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 50, 70)
        tile.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
        tile.Text = ""
        tile.AutoButtonColor = false
        tile.Parent = slot
        local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
        corner.Parent = tile
        local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
        stroke.Parent = tile
        strokes[id] = stroke
        local sc = Instance.new("UIScale")
        sc.Parent = slot
        scales[id] = sc
        iconOf(tile, id)
        tile.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if editing then return end
            selected = id
            refreshBar()
        end)
    end

    for _, id in ipairs(PIECES) do
        makeSlot(id)
    end

    local editKey = Instance.new("TextButton")
    editKey.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(56, 22)
    editKey.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 32, 40)
    editKey.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    editKey.TextSize = 11
    editKey.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 235, 245)
    editKey.Text = "EDIT"
    editKey.AutoButtonColor = false
    editKey.Parent = matRow
    local ekc = Instance.new("UICorner")
    ekc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    ekc.Parent = editKey
    editKey.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        beginRebind("Edit")
    end)
    keyLabels.Edit = editKey

    local function assign(id, code)
        for other, kc in pairs(binds) do
            if other ~= id and kc == code then
                binds[other] = binds[id]
            end
        end
        binds[id] = code
        saveBinds()
        refreshBar()
    end

    local function setEnabled(on)
        enabled = on and true or false
        gui.Enabled = enabled
        if not enabled then
            rebindId = nil
            endEdit(false)
            killPreview()
        end
        refreshBar()
        return enabled
    end

    _G._ParallaxToggleBuild = function()
        return setEnabled(not enabled)
    end
    _G._ParallaxBuildOn = function()
        return enabled
    end

    UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
        if rebindId then
            if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
                rebindId = nil
                refreshBar()
                return
            end
            if input.KeyCode ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then
                assign(rebindId, input.KeyCode)
                rebindId = nil
            end
            return
        end
        if not enabled then return end
        if UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
        if editing then
            if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
                endEdit(false)
                refreshBar()
                return
            end
            if input.KeyCode == binds.Edit or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Return then
                endEdit(true)
                refreshBar()
                return
            end
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and not gp then
                toggleCell()
                return
            end
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 and not gp then
                resetPiece()
                refreshBar()
                return
            end
            return
        end
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and not gp then
            place()
            return
        end
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 and not gp then
            removeAimed()
            return
        end
        if gp then return end
        if input.KeyCode == binds.Rotate then
            rot = (rot + 1) % 4
            return
        end
        if input.KeyCode == binds.Edit then
            beginEdit()
            refreshBar()
            return
        end
        if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.One then material = "Wood"; killPreview(); refreshBar(); return end
        if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Two then material = "Brick"; killPreview(); refreshBar(); return end
        if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Three then material = "Metal"; killPreview(); refreshBar(); return end
        for _, id in ipairs(PIECES) do
            if input.KeyCode == binds[id] then
                selected = id
                refreshBar()
                return
            end
        end
    end)

    RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if enabled then updatePreview() end
    end)

    refreshBar()
    print("[PARALLAX] build: wood/brick/metal, G edits")
end)

-- ================================================================
--  PARALLAX HEIGHT
--  Scales the body you see and the body other players see.
--  Applied once from the original sizes, never every frame, and
--  the root is never teleported, so it does not fling or sink.
-- ================================================================
task.spawn(function()
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local lp = Players.LocalPlayer

    local height = 1
    local originals = {}
    local cardOn = false

    local function clampH(h)
        return math.clamp(tonumber(h) or 1, 0.4, 2.6)
    end

    local function isTorso(name)
        return name == "UpperTorso" or name == "LowerTorso" or name == "Torso"
    end

    local function capture(model)
        local data = originals[model]
        if not data then
            data = { parts = {}, motors = {}, atts = {} }
            originals[model] = data
        end
        for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("Motor6D") and not data.motors[d] then
                local c0 = d:GetAttribute("PaxC0")
                local c1 = d:GetAttribute("PaxC1")
                if typeof(c0) ~= "CFrame" then
                    c0 = d.C0
                    d:SetAttribute("PaxC0", c0)
                end
                if typeof(c1) ~= "CFrame" then
                    c1 = d.C1
                    d:SetAttribute("PaxC1", c1)
                end
                data.motors[d] = { c0 = c0, c1 = c1 }
            elseif d:IsA("Attachment") and not data.atts[d] then
                local pos = d:GetAttribute("PaxPos")
                if typeof(pos) ~= "Vector3" then
                    pos = d.Position
                    d:SetAttribute("PaxPos", pos)
                end
                data.atts[d] = pos
            elseif d:IsA("BasePart") and isTorso(d.Name) and not data.parts[d] then
                local stored = d:GetAttribute("PaxSize")
                if typeof(stored) ~= "Vector3" then
                    stored = d.Size
                    d:SetAttribute("PaxSize", stored)
                end
                data.parts[d] = stored
            end
        end
        return data
    end

    local function targets()
        local list, seen = {}, {}
        local function add(m)
            if typeof(m) == "Instance" and m.Parent and not seen[m] then
                seen[m] = true
                list[#list + 1] = m
            end
        end
        add(lp.Character)
        local api = rawget(_G, "_HaloReanimateAPI")
        if api then
            if type(api.get_clone) == "function" then
                local ok, c = pcall(api.get_clone, lp)
                if ok then add(c) end
            end
            if type(api.get_real_character) == "function" then
                local ok, r = pcall(api.get_real_character, lp)
                if ok then add(r) end
            end
        end
        return list
    end

    local function isClone(model)
        local api = rawget(_G, "_HaloReanimateAPI")
        if not api or type(api.get_clone) ~= "function" then return false end
        local ok, c = pcall(api.get_clone, lp)
        return ok and c == model
    end

    local function applyModel(model, h)
        local data = capture(model)
        for part, size in pairs(data.parts) do
            if part.Parent and isTorso(part.Name) then
                part.Size = Vector3.new(size.X, size.Y * h, size.Z)
            end
        end
        for motor, o in pairs(data.motors) do
            if motor.Parent then
                local p0, p1 = motor.Part0, motor.Part1
                local y0 = (p0 and isTorso(p0.Name)) and h or 1
                local y1 = (p1 and isTorso(p1.Name)) and h or 1
                local a, b = o.c0.Position, o.c1.Position
                motor.C0 = CFrame.new(a.X, a.Y * y0, a.Z) * o.c0.Rotation
                motor.C1 = CFrame.new(b.X, b.Y * y1, b.Z) * o.c1.Rotation
            end
        end
        local hipMotor, rootMotor
        for motor in pairs(data.motors) do
            if motor.Name == "LeftHip" or motor.Name == "Left Hip" then hipMotor = motor end
            if motor.Name == "Root" or motor.Name == "RootJoint" then rootMotor = motor end
        end
        if hipMotor and rootMotor and data.motors[hipMotor] and data.motors[rootMotor] and rootMotor.Parent then
            local drop = data.motors[hipMotor].c0.Position.Y * (h - 1)
            local ro = data.motors[rootMotor]
            local a = ro.c0.Position
            local y0 = (rootMotor.Part0 and isTorso(rootMotor.Part0.Name)) and h or 1
            rootMotor.C0 = CFrame.new(a.X, a.Y * y0 - drop, a.Z) * ro.c0.Rotation
        end
        for att, pos in pairs(data.atts) do
            if att.Parent then
                local parent = att.Parent
                if parent:IsA("BasePart") and isTorso(parent.Name) then
                    att.Position = Vector3.new(pos.X, pos.Y * h, pos.Z)
                else
                    att.Position = pos
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local function applyAll(h)
        height = clampH(h)
        _G._ParallaxTorsoHeight = height
        for _, model in ipairs(targets()) do
            applyModel(model, height)
        end
        if type(writefile) == "function" then
            pcall(writefile, "ParallaxHeight.txt", tostring(height))
        end
        if _G._ParallaxHeightRefresh then
            pcall(_G._ParallaxHeightRefresh)
        end
    end

    local function drifted(model)
        local data = originals[model]
        if not data then return true end
        for part, size in pairs(data.parts) do
            if part.Parent and isTorso(part.Name) then
                return math.abs(part.Size.Y - size.Y * height) > 0.08
            end
        end
        return false
    end

    if type(readfile) == "function" then
        local ok, raw = pcall(readfile, "ParallaxHeight.txt")
        if ok and tonumber(raw) then height = clampH(raw) end
    end

    lp.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
        task.delay(0.6, function()
            originals[char] = nil
            if height ~= 1 then applyAll(height) end
        end)
    end)

    task.spawn(function()
        while true do
            task.wait(1)
            if height ~= 1 then
                for _, model in ipairs(targets()) do
                    if drifted(model) then
                        applyModel(model, height)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end)

    local pg = lp:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") or lp:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    local old = pg:FindFirstChild("ParallaxHeightGui")
    if old then old:Destroy() end
    local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    gui.Name = "ParallaxHeightGui"
    gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    gui.DisplayOrder = 90000
    gui.Enabled = false
    gui.Parent = pg

    local card = Instance.new("Frame")
    card.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(214, 176)
    card.Position = UDim2.new(0, 122, 0.5, 20)
    card.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 18, 24)
    card.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
    card.BorderSizePixel = 0
    card.Parent = gui
    local cc = Instance.new("UICorner")
    cc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
    cc.Parent = card
    local cs = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    cs.Color = Color3.fromRGB(90, 140, 210)
    cs.Transparency = 0.35
    cs.Parent = card

    local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 8)
    title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 16)
    title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    title.TextSize = 12
    title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 236, 245)
    title.Text = "HEIGHT"
    title.Parent = card

    local valueLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    valueLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    valueLbl.Position = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0, 8)
    valueLbl.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(58, 16)
    valueLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    valueLbl.TextSize = 12
    valueLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
    valueLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 190, 255)
    valueLbl.Text = "1.00x"
    valueLbl.Parent = card

    local sub = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    sub.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    sub.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 26)
    sub.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 14)
    sub.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    sub.TextSize = 10
    sub.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    sub.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 158, 170)
    sub.Text = "Torso only. Other people see it"
    sub.Parent = card

    local track = Instance.new("TextButton")
    track.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 50)
    track.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 16)
    track.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 36, 46)
    track.Text = ""
    track.AutoButtonColor = false
    track.Parent = card
    local tc = Instance.new("UICorner")
    tc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    tc.Parent = track
    local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
    fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 1)
    fill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 150, 255)
    fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    fill.Parent = track
    local fc = Instance.new("UICorner")
    fc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    fc.Parent = fill

    local presets = {
        { "Tiny", 0.45 },
        { "Short", 0.72 },
        { "Normal", 1 },
        { "Tall", 1.65 },
        { "Giant", 2.4 },
    }
    local presetBtns = {}
    for i, p in ipairs(presets) do
        local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
        b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(36, 22)
        b.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12 + (i - 1) * 39, 78)
        b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 32, 42)
        b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        b.TextSize = 9
        b.Text = p[1]
        b.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(210, 216, 225)
        b.AutoButtonColor = false
        b.Parent = card
        local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
        c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
        c.Parent = b
        presetBtns[i] = b
        b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            applyAll(p[2])
        end)
    end

    local function paint()
        local alpha = (height - 0.4) / (2.6 - 0.4)
        fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(alpha, 0.02, 1), 1)
        valueLbl.Text = string.format("%.2fx", height)
        for i, p in ipairs(presets) do
            local on = math.abs(height - p[2]) < 0.03
            presetBtns[i].BackgroundColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(70, 140, 230) or Color3.fromRGB(28, 32, 42)
            presetBtns[i].TextColor3 = on and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or Color3.fromRGB(210, 216, 225)
        end
    end
    _G._ParallaxHeightRefresh = paint

    local function fromX(x, commit)
        local a = math.clamp((x - track.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(track.AbsoluteSize.X, 1), 0, 1)
        local h = 0.4 + a * (2.6 - 0.4)
        if commit then
            applyAll(h)
        else
            height = h
            paint()
        end
    end
    local dragging = false
    track.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true
            fromX(input.Position.X, false)
        end
    end)
    UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            if dragging then
                dragging = false
                applyAll(height)
            end
        end
    end)
    UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if not dragging then return end
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            fromX(input.Position.X, false)
        end
    end)

    _G._ParallaxSetHeight = function(h)
        applyAll(h)
        return height
    end
    _G._ParallaxToggleHeight = function()
        cardOn = not cardOn
        gui.Enabled = cardOn
        if cardOn then paint() end
        return cardOn
    end

    paint()
    if lp.Character and height ~= 1 then
        task.delay(0.4, function()
            applyAll(height)
        end)
    end
    print("[PARALLAX] height: menu HEIGHT")
end)

-- ================================================================
--  PARALLAX BODY SHRINK
--  Same idea as the trackers, but it shrinks the body instead of
--  stretching it. Scale never goes above 1. The real body is
--  updated in the reanim sync so other people see it.
-- ================================================================
task.spawn(function()
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local lp = Players.LocalPlayer

    local GROUPS = {
        Body = { "UpperTorso", "LowerTorso", "Torso" },
        Head = { "Head" },
        Arms = { "LeftUpperArm", "LeftLowerArm", "LeftHand", "RightUpperArm", "RightLowerArm", "RightHand", "Left Arm", "Right Arm" },
        Legs = { "LeftUpperLeg", "LeftLowerLeg", "LeftFoot", "RightUpperLeg", "RightLowerLeg", "RightFoot", "Left Leg", "Right Leg" },
    }
    local groupOn = { Body = true, Head = true, Arms = true, Legs = true }
    local enabled = false
    local scale = 0.6
    local partOn = {}

    local function rebuildParts()
        table.clear(partOn)
        if not enabled then return end
        for group, names in pairs(GROUPS) do
            if groupOn[group] then
                for _, name in ipairs(names) do
                    partOn[name] = true
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local function models()
        local list, seen = {}, {}
        local function add(m)
            if typeof(m) == "Instance" and m.Parent and not seen[m] then
                seen[m] = true
                list[#list + 1] = m
            end
        end
        add(lp.Character)
        local api = rawget(_G, "_HaloReanimateAPI")
        if api then
            if type(api.get_clone) == "function" then
                local ok, c = pcall(api.get_clone, lp)
                if ok then add(c) end
            end
            if type(api.get_real_character) == "function" then
                local ok, r = pcall(api.get_real_character, lp)
                if ok then add(r) end
            end
        end
        return list
    end

    local function origSize(part)
        local s = part:GetAttribute("ShSize")
        if typeof(s) == "Vector3" then return s end
        local px = part:GetAttribute("PaxSize")
        s = typeof(px) == "Vector3" and px or part.Size
        part:SetAttribute("ShSize", s)
        return s
    end

    local function origMotor(motor)
        local c0 = motor:GetAttribute("ShC0")
        local c1 = motor:GetAttribute("ShC1")
        if typeof(c0) ~= "CFrame" then
            local px = motor:GetAttribute("PaxC0")
            c0 = typeof(px) == "CFrame" and px or motor.C0
            motor:SetAttribute("ShC0", c0)
        end
        if typeof(c1) ~= "CFrame" then
            local px = motor:GetAttribute("PaxC1")
            c1 = typeof(px) == "CFrame" and px or motor.C1
            motor:SetAttribute("ShC1", c1)
        end
        return c0, c1
    end

    local function factor(name)
        if enabled and partOn[name] then return scale end
        return 1
    end

    local function publish()
        local info = { scale = enabled and scale or 1 }
        if enabled then
            for name in pairs(partOn) do
                info[name] = true
            end
        end
        _G._ParallaxBodyShrink = info
    end

    local function apply(setHip)
        rebuildParts()
        publish()
        for _, model in ipairs(models()) do
            for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
                if d:IsA("BasePart") and d.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                    local s = factor(d.Name)
                    if s ~= 1 or d:GetAttribute("ShSize") ~= nil then
                        d.Size = origSize(d) * s
                    end
                elseif d:IsA("Motor6D") and d.Part0 and d.Part1 then
                    local c0, c1 = origMotor(d)
                    local s0 = factor(d.Part0.Name)
                    local s1 = factor(d.Part1.Name)
                    local a, b = c0.Position, c1.Position
                    d.C0 = CFrame.new(a.X * s0, a.Y * s0, a.Z * s0) * c0.Rotation
                    d.C1 = CFrame.new(b.X * s1, b.Y * s1, b.Z * s1) * c1.Rotation
                end
            end
            if setHip and model == lp.Character then
                local hum = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if hum then
                    if typeof(hum:GetAttribute("ShHip")) ~= "number" then
                        hum:SetAttribute("ShHip", hum.HipHeight)
                    end
                    local base = hum:GetAttribute("ShHip")
                    local s = (enabled and (groupOn.Body or groupOn.Legs)) and scale or 1
                    hum.HipHeight = math.max(0.5, base * s + (1 - s) * 0.85)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local parent = SettingsPanel
    if not parent or not parent.Parent then return end

    local card = Instance.new("Frame")
    card.Name = "BodyShrink"
    card.LayoutOrder = -5
    card.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 132)
    card.BackgroundColor3 = C.bg2
    card.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45
    card.BorderSizePixel = 0
    card.Parent = parent
    local cc = Instance.new("UICorner")
    cc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
    cc.Parent = card
    local cs = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    cs.Color = C.glassBorder
    cs.Transparency = 0.6
    cs.Parent = card

    local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 6)
    title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -120, 0, 16)
    title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    title.TextSize = 11
    title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    title.TextColor3 = C.text
    title.Text = "Body Shrink"
    title.Parent = card

    local sub = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    sub.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    sub.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 22)
    sub.Size = UDim2.new(1, -130, 0, 14)
    sub.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    sub.TextSize = 8
    sub.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    sub.TextColor3 = C.text3
    sub.Text = "Shrinks the body. Never stretches. Other people see it."
    sub.Parent = card

    local togBg = Instance.new("Frame")
    togBg.Size = UDim2.new(0, 44, 0, 22)
    togBg.Position = UDim2.new(1, -54, 0, 8)
    togBg.BackgroundColor3 = C.bg4
    togBg.BorderSizePixel = 0
    togBg.Parent = card
    local tgc = Instance.new("UICorner")
    tgc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 11)
    tgc.Parent = togBg
    local knob = Instance.new("Frame")
    knob.Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 16)
    knob.Position = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0, 3)
    knob.BackgroundColor3 = C.white
    knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
    knob.Parent = togBg
    local kc = Instance.new("UICorner")
    kc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
    kc.Parent = knob
    local togBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    togBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    togBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    togBtn.Text = ""
    togBtn.Parent = togBg

    local amt = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    amt.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    amt.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 42)
    amt.Size = UDim2.new(0, 48, 0, 14)
    amt.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    amt.TextSize = 10
    amt.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    amt.TextColor3 = C.accent
    amt.Text = "0.60x"
    amt.Parent = card

    local track = Instance.new("TextButton")
    track.Position = UDim2.new(0, 64, 0, 46)
    track.Size = UDim2.new(1, -78, 0, 8)
    track.BackgroundColor3 = C.bg3
    track.Text = ""
    track.AutoButtonColor = false
    track.Parent = card
    local tc = Instance.new("UICorner")
    tc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
    tc.Parent = track
    local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
    fill.BackgroundColor3 = C.green
    fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    fill.Size = UDim2.new(0.53, 0, 1, 0)
    fill.Parent = track
    local fc = Instance.new("UICorner")
    fc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
    fc.Parent = fill

    local chips = {}
    local order = { "Body", "Head", "Arms", "Legs" }
    for i, name in ipairs(order) do
        local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
        b.Size = UDim2.new(0, 58, 0, 20)
        b.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10 + (i - 1) * 64, 0, 68)
        b.BackgroundColor3 = C.bg3
        b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        b.TextSize = 9
        b.Text = name
        b.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        b.AutoButtonColor = false
        b.Parent = card
        local c2 = Instance.new("UICorner")
        c2.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
        c2.Parent = b
        chips[name] = b
    end

    local hint = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    hint.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    hint.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 96)
    hint.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 28)
    hint.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    hint.TextSize = 8
    hint.TextWrapped = true
    hint.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    hint.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
    hint.TextColor3 = C.text3
    hint.Text = "Pick parts like the trackers, then turn it on. 1.00x is normal. Lower shrinks."
    hint.Parent = card

    local function paint()
        local pct = (1 - scale) / (1 - 0.25)
        fill.Size = UDim2.new(math.clamp(pct, 0, 1), 0, 1, 0)
        amt.Text = string.format("%.2fx", enabled and scale or 1)
        togBg.BackgroundColor3 = enabled and C.green or C.bg4
        knob.Position = enabled and UDim2.new(1, -19, 0, 3) or UDim2.new(0, 3, 0, 3)
        for name, b in pairs(chips) do
            local on = groupOn[name]
            b.BackgroundColor3 = on and C.accent or C.bg4
            b.TextColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0) or C.text2
        end
    end

    local function fromX(x)
        local a = math.clamp((x - track.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(track.AbsoluteSize.X, 1), 0, 1)
        scale = 1 - a * (1 - 0.25)
        paint()
    end

    togBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        enabled = not enabled
        apply(true)
        paint()
    end)
    for name, b in pairs(chips) do
        b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            groupOn[name] = not groupOn[name]
            if enabled then apply(true) end
            paint()
        end)
    end

    local dragging = false
    track.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            dragging = true
            fromX(input.Position.X)
        end
    end)
    UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and dragging then
            dragging = false
            if enabled then apply(true) end
        end
    end)
    UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if dragging and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
            fromX(input.Position.X)
        end
    end)

    task.spawn(function()
        while card.Parent do
            task.wait(1)
            if enabled then
                local drifted = false
                local char = lp.Character
                local part = char and (char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso"))
                if part and partOn[part.Name] then
                    local orig = part:GetAttribute("ShSize")
                    if typeof(orig) == "Vector3" and math.abs(part.Size.Y - orig.Y * scale) > 0.08 then
                        drifted = true
                    end
                elseif part and not part:GetAttribute("ShSize") then
                    drifted = true
                end
                if drifted then apply(false) end
            end
        end
    end)

    paint()
    print("[PARALLAX] body shrink: settings")
end)


-- ================================================================
--  Track Players + don't fall out of the map
-- ================================================================
task.spawn(function()
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
    if not lp then return end

    local MY = {
        ["L Arm"] = { "LeftUpperArm", "LeftLowerArm", "LeftHand", "Left Arm" },
        ["R Arm"] = { "RightUpperArm", "RightLowerArm", "RightHand", "Right Arm" },
        ["L Leg"] = { "LeftUpperLeg", "LeftLowerLeg", "LeftFoot", "Left Leg" },
        ["R Leg"] = { "RightUpperLeg", "RightLowerLeg", "RightFoot", "Right Leg" },
        Head = { "Head" },
    }
    local MY_ORDER = { "L Arm", "R Arm", "L Leg", "R Leg", "Head" }
    local THEIRS = {
        Head = { "Head" },
        Torso = { "UpperTorso", "Torso" },
        ["L Arm"] = { "LeftHand", "LeftLowerArm", "Left Arm" },
        ["R Arm"] = { "RightHand", "RightLowerArm", "Right Arm" },
        ["L Leg"] = { "LeftFoot", "LeftLowerLeg", "Left Leg" },
        ["R Leg"] = { "RightFoot", "RightLowerLeg", "Right Leg" },
    }
    local THEIR_ORDER = { "Head", "Torso", "L Arm", "R Arm", "L Leg", "R Leg" }

    local on = false
    local myLimb = "R Arm"
    local theirPart = "Head"
    local target = nil
    local statusLbl

    local function rig()
        local api = rawget(_G, "_HaloReanimateAPI")
        if api and type(api.get_clone) == "function" then
            local ok, c = pcall(api.get_clone, lp)
            if ok and typeof(c) == "Instance" and c.Parent then return c end
        end
        return lp.Character
    end

    local function findJoint(model, name)
        if not model then return nil end
        for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("Motor6D") and d.Part1 and d.Part1.Name == name then
                return d
            end
            if d:IsA("AnimationConstraint") then
                local att = d.Attachment1
                if att and att.Parent and att.Parent.Name == name then
                    return d
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local function jointWorld(joint)
        if joint:IsA("Motor6D") and joint.Part0 then
            return joint.Part0.CFrame * joint.C0
        end
        local att = joint.Attachment0
        if att and att.Parent then return att.WorldCFrame end
    end

    local function boneLen(joint)
        if not joint then return 1 end
        if joint:IsA("Motor6D") and joint.Part1 then return math.max(joint.Part1.Size.Y, 0.2) end
        local att = joint.Attachment1
        if att and att.Parent and att.Parent:IsA("BasePart") then
            return math.max(att.Parent.Size.Y, 0.2)
        end
        return 1
    end

    local function aimAt(joint, worldPos)
        local base = jointWorld(joint)
        if not base then return end
        local aim = worldPos - base.Position
        if aim.Magnitude < 0.05 then return end
        local localAim = base.Rotation:Inverse() * aim.Unit
        local bone = Vector3.new(0, -1, 0)
        local axis = bone:Cross(localAim)
        if axis.Magnitude > 0.001 then
            local ang = math.acos(math.clamp(bone:Dot(localAim.Unit), -1, 1))
            joint.Transform = CFrame.fromAxisAngle(axis.Unit, ang)
        elseif bone:Dot(localAim) < 0 then
            joint.Transform = CFrame.fromAxisAngle(Vector3.new(1, 0, 0), math.pi)
        else
            joint.Transform = CFrame.new()
        end
    end

    local function theirNames()
        return THEIRS[theirPart] or THEIRS.Head
    end

    local function findPart(char, names)
        for _, name in ipairs(names) do
            local p = char:FindFirstChild(name)
            if p and p:IsA("BasePart") then return p end
        end
    end

    local function markBones()
        local owned = {}
        if on then
            for _, name in ipairs(MY[myLimb] or {}) do
                owned[name] = true
            end
        end
        _G._HaloPartTrackBones = owned
        _G._HaloPartTrackOn = on
    end

    _G._HaloPartTrackApply = function()
        if _G._HaloSpiderActive then return end
        if not on or not target or target.Parent ~= Players then return end
        local model = rig()
        local char = target.Character
        if not model or not char then return end
        local part = findPart(char, theirNames())
        if not part then return end
        local names = MY[myLimb]
        if not names then return end
        local joints = {}
        for _, name in ipairs(names) do
            local j = findJoint(model, name)
            if j then joints[#joints + 1] = j end
        end
        if #joints == 0 then return end
        aimAt(joints[1], part.Position)
        if #joints >= 2 then
            local base = jointWorld(joints[1])
            if base then
                local dist = (part.Position - base.Position).Magnitude
                local upper = boneLen(joints[1])
                local lower = boneLen(joints[2])
                local mult = math.max((dist - upper) / lower, 1)
                local extra = math.max(mult - 1, 0) * lower
                joints[2].Transform = CFrame.new(0, -extra, 0)
            end
            if joints[3] then joints[3].Transform = CFrame.new() end
        end
    end

    local function setStatus()
        if not statusLbl then return end
        if not on then
            statusLbl.Text = "Off"
        elseif not target then
            statusLbl.Text = "Pick a player"
        else
            statusLbl.Text = myLimb .. " → " .. (target.DisplayName or target.Name) .. " " .. theirPart
        end
    end

    -- Anti-void. Reuse raycast state and sample at 10 Hz instead of rebuilding
    -- filters and issuing two raycasts on every Heartbeat.
    local safeCF = nil
    local voidParams = RaycastParams.new()
    voidParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    local voidFilter = {}
    local filterCharacter, filterRefreshAt = nil, 0
    local voidCheckAt = 0
    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        local now = os.clock()
        if now < voidCheckAt then return end
        local perfGuard = rawget(_G, "_PrismPerfGuard")
        voidCheckAt = now + ((perfGuard and perfGuard.pressure) and 0.2 or 0.1)
        local char = lp.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return end
        if char ~= filterCharacter or now >= filterRefreshAt then
            filterCharacter = char
            filterRefreshAt = now + 1
            table.clear(voidFilter)
            voidFilter[1] = char
            local api = rawget(_G, "_HaloReanimateAPI")
            if api and type(api.get_real_character) == "function" then
                local ok, real = pcall(api.get_real_character, lp)
                if ok and typeof(real) == "Instance" and real ~= char then
                    voidFilter[#voidFilter + 1] = real
                end
            end
            if api and type(api.get_clone) == "function" then
                local ok, clone = pcall(api.get_clone, lp)
                if ok and typeof(clone) == "Instance" and clone ~= char and clone ~= voidFilter[2] then
                    voidFilter[#voidFilter + 1] = clone
                end
            end
            voidParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = voidFilter
        end
        local origin = hrp.Position
        local near = workspace:Raycast(origin, Vector3.new(0, -14, 0), voidParams)
        if near and hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y > -60 then
            safeCF = hrp.CFrame
        end
        local far = workspace:Raycast(origin, Vector3.new(0, -250, 0), voidParams)
        local dropped = safeCF and origin.Y < safeCF.Position.Y - 25
        if safeCF and not far and hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y < -20 and (dropped or origin.Y < -80) then
            hrp.CFrame = safeCF + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
            hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum then pcall(function() hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp) end) end
        end
    end)

    local sc = rawget(_G, "ArmTrackersPanel") or ArmTrackersPanel
    if not sc then
        markBones()
        return
    end

    local card = new("Frame", sc, {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 168),
        BackgroundColor3 = C.bg2,
        BackgroundTransparency = 0.45,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
    })
    card.LayoutOrder = 6
    corner(card, 14)
    stroke(card, C.glassBorder, 1, 0.6)

    new("TextLabel", card, {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0, 16),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 8),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = "Track Players",
        TextColor3 = C.text,
        TextSize = 11,
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
    })
    statusLbl = new("TextLabel", card, {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0, 14),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 24),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = "Off",
        TextColor3 = C.text3,
        TextSize = 9,
        Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
    })

    local tBg = new("Frame", card, {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 44, 0, 22),
        Position = UDim2.new(1, -54, 0, 10),
        BackgroundColor3 = C.bg4,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
    })
    corner(tBg, 11)
    local tKnob = new("Frame", tBg, {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 16),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0, 3),
        BackgroundColor3 = C.white,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
    })
    corner(tKnob, 8)
    local tBtn = new("TextButton", tBg, {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = "",
    })
    tBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        on = not on
        markBones()
        setStatus()
        if on then
            tw(tBg, 0.2, { BackgroundColor3 = C.green }):Play()
            tw(tKnob, 0.2, { Position = UDim2.new(1, -18, 0, 3) }):Play()
        else
            tw(tBg, 0.2, { BackgroundColor3 = C.bg4 }):Play()
            tw(tKnob, 0.2, { Position = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0, 3) }):Play()
        end
    end)

    local function chips(y, order, current, setFn)
        local row = Instance.new("Frame")
        row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        row.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, y)
        row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 22)
        row.Parent = card
        local buttons = {}
        local function paint()
            for name, b in pairs(buttons) do
                local sel = name == current()
                b.BackgroundColor3 = sel and C.accent or C.bg4
                b.TextColor3 = sel and Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 14) or C.text
            end
        end
        for i, name in ipairs(order) do
            local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
            b.Size = UDim2.new(0, 52, 1, 0)
            b.Position = UDim2.new(0, (i - 1) * 56, 0, 0)
            b.BackgroundColor3 = C.bg4
            b.BorderSizePixel = 0
            b.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
            b.TextSize = 9
            b.Text = name
            b.TextColor3 = C.text
            b.Parent = row
            corner(b, 6)
            b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                setFn(name)
                markBones()
                paint()
                setStatus()
            end)
            buttons[name] = b
        end
        paint()
    end

    chips(44, MY_ORDER, function() return myLimb end, function(n) myLimb = n end)
    chips(70, THEIR_ORDER, function() return theirPart end, function(n) theirPart = n end)

    local list = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
    list.BackgroundColor3 = C.bg0
    list.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
    list.BorderSizePixel = 0
    list.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 98)
    list.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 62)
    list.ScrollBarThickness = 3
    list.CanvasSize = UDim2.new()
    list.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    list.Parent = card
    corner(list, 8)
    local lay = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    lay.Padding = UDim.new(0, 2)
    lay.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    lay.Parent = list

    local function refreshPlayers()
        for _, ch in ipairs(list:GetChildren()) do
            if ch:IsA("TextButton") then ch:Destroy() end
        end
        local i = 0
        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if plr ~= lp then
                i += 1
                local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
                b.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 18)
                b.BackgroundColor3 = (plr == target) and C.accent or C.bg2
                b.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
                b.BorderSizePixel = 0
                b.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
                b.TextSize = 10
                b.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
                b.Text = "  " .. (plr.DisplayName or plr.Name)
                b.TextColor3 = (plr == target) and Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 14) or C.text
                b.LayoutOrder = i
                b.Parent = list
                corner(b, 4)
                b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                    target = plr
                    setStatus()
                    refreshPlayers()
                end)
            end
        end
        if i == 0 then
            local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
            b.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 18)
            b.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            b.Text = "  nobody else here"
            b.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
            b.TextSize = 10
            b.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
            b.TextColor3 = C.text3
            b.Parent = list
        end
    end
    refreshPlayers()
    Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function() task.delay(0.2, refreshPlayers) end)
    Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr)
        if plr == target then target = nil setStatus() end
        task.delay(0.2, refreshPlayers)
    end)
    markBones()
    setStatus()
    print("[PARALLAX] track players + anti void")
end)

-- ================================================================
--  SPIDER MODE: eight-leg shell, surface crawling, and web swing
--  Added to Arm Trackers as a separate card. All parts are local visuals.
-- ================================================================
task.spawn(function()
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
    if not lp then return end

    if type(_G._ParallaxSpiderShutdown) == "function" then
        pcall(_G._ParallaxSpiderShutdown)
    end
    local oldInput = rawget(_G, "_ParallaxSpiderInputConn")
    if oldInput then pcall(function() oldInput:Disconnect() end) end
    local oldStep = rawget(_G, "_ParallaxSpiderStepConn")
    if oldStep then pcall(function() oldStep:Disconnect() end) end

    local panel
    for _ = 1, 100 do
        panel = rawget(_G, "ArmTrackersPanel") or ArmTrackersPanel
        if panel and panel.Parent then break end
        task.wait(0.1)
    end
    if not (panel and panel.Parent) then return end

    local existingCard = panel:FindFirstChild("SpiderClimbCard")
    if existingCard then existingCard:Destroy() end

    local spiderOn = false
    local spiderSpeed = 18
    local spiderModel, spiderRoot, spiderHumanoid
    local spiderCharacter = nil
    local spiderNormal = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
    local originalHumanoid = nil
    local spiderParts, spiderBeams, spiderAttachments, spiderLegs = {}, {}, {}, {}
    local spiderJoints, savedSpiderTransforms = {}, {}
    local aimMarker, web = nil, nil
    local lastShot = 0
    local cardStatus, toggleBg, toggleKnob, toggleBtn, releaseBtn, speedBtn

    local DEEP = Color3.fromRGB(53, 18, 45)
    local CHITIN = Color3.fromRGB(96, 28, 72)
    local ACCENT = Color3.fromRGB(178, 62, 132)
    local WEB = Color3.fromRGB(242, 226, 240)

    local function currentRig()
        local character
        local api = rawget(_G, "_HaloReanimateAPI") or rawget(_G, "ReanimateAPI")
        local active = false
        pcall(function()
            active = api and type(api.is_reanimated) == "function" and api.is_reanimated() == true
            if active and type(api.get_clone) == "function" then character = api.get_clone(lp) end
        end)
        if active and not (character and character.Parent) then
            character = workspace:FindFirstChild("Reanimation")
        end
        if not (character and character.Parent) then character = lp.Character end
        if not character then return nil end
        local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or character:FindFirstChild("Torso") or character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
        return character, character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"), root
    end

    local function makeRayParams(character)
        local params = RaycastParams.new()
        params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        params.IgnoreWater = true
        local ignore = { character }
        if spiderModel then ignore[#ignore + 1] = spiderModel end
        if aimMarker then ignore[#ignore + 1] = aimMarker end
        if web and web.anchor then ignore[#ignore + 1] = web.anchor end
