        local api = rawget(_G, "_HaloReanimateAPI") or rawget(_G, "ReanimateAPI")
        if api and type(api.get_real_character) == "function" then
            local ok, real = pcall(api.get_real_character, lp)
            if ok and typeof(real) == "Instance" and real ~= character then ignore[#ignore + 1] = real end
        end
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore
        return params
    end

    local function destroyWeb(boost)
        if not web then return end
        local old = web
        web = nil
        local root = spiderRoot
        if old.rope then pcall(function() old.rope:Destroy() end) end
        for _, beam in ipairs(old.beams or {}) do pcall(function() beam:Destroy() end) end
        for _, attachment in ipairs(old.attachments or {}) do pcall(function() attachment:Destroy() end) end
        if old.anchor then pcall(function() old.anchor:Destroy() end) end
        if boost and root and root.Parent then
            local velocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
            local tangent = Vector3.new(velocity.X, velocity.Y, velocity.Z)
            if tangent.Magnitude > 1 then
                root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = tangent + tangent.Unit * 10
            end
        end
        if releaseBtn then releaseBtn.Text = "WEB: READY" end
    end

    local function rememberSpiderJoint(joint)
        if joint and joint:IsA("Motor6D") and savedSpiderTransforms[joint] == nil then
            savedSpiderTransforms[joint] = joint.Transform
        end
    end

    local function clearSpiderVisual()
        for joint, transform in pairs(savedSpiderTransforms) do
            if joint and joint.Parent then pcall(function() joint.Transform = transform end) end
        end
        savedSpiderTransforms = {}
        spiderJoints = {}
        for _, beam in ipairs(spiderBeams) do pcall(function() beam:Destroy() end) end
        for _, attachment in ipairs(spiderAttachments) do pcall(function() attachment:Destroy() end) end
        spiderBeams, spiderAttachments, spiderLegs = {}, {}, {}
        if spiderModel then pcall(function() spiderModel:Destroy() end) end
        spiderModel = nil
        spiderParts = {}
    end

    local function restoreHumanoid()
        local hum, saved = spiderHumanoid, originalHumanoid
        originalHumanoid = nil
        if hum and hum.Parent and saved then
            pcall(function()
                hum.AutoRotate = saved.AutoRotate
                hum.WalkSpeed = saved.WalkSpeed
                hum.JumpPower = saved.JumpPower
                hum.JumpHeight = saved.JumpHeight
            end)
        end
    end

    local function findSpiderJoint(rig, partNames)
        if not rig then return nil end
        local wanted = {}
        for _, name in ipairs(partNames) do wanted[name] = true end
        for _, d in ipairs(rig:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("Motor6D") and d.Part1 and wanted[d.Part1.Name] then
                return d
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    -- Same joint aiming / lower-joint extension method as the Arm Trackers.
    local function aimSpiderJoint(joint, targetPos)
        if not joint or not joint:IsA("Motor6D") or not joint.Part0 then return end
        rememberSpiderJoint(joint)
        local base = joint.Part0.CFrame * joint.C0
        local aim = targetPos - base.Position
        if aim.Magnitude < 0.05 then return end
        local localAim = base.Rotation:Inverse() * aim.Unit
        local bone = Vector3.new(0, -1, 0)
        local axis = bone:Cross(localAim)
        if axis.Magnitude > 0.001 then
            local angle = math.acos(math.clamp(bone:Dot(localAim), -1, 1))
            joint.Transform = CFrame.fromAxisAngle(axis.Unit, angle)
        elseif bone:Dot(localAim) < 0 then
            joint.Transform = CFrame.fromAxisAngle(Vector3.new(1, 0, 0), math.pi)
        else
            joint.Transform = CFrame.new()
        end
    end

    local function extendSpiderJoint(joint, amount)
        if not joint or not joint:IsA("Motor6D") then return end
        rememberSpiderJoint(joint)
        local length = joint.Part1 and math.max(joint.Part1.Size.Y, 0.2) or 1
        joint.Transform = CFrame.new(0, -length * (amount - 1), 0)
    end

    local function resetSpiderJoint(joint)
        if joint and joint:IsA("Motor6D") then
            rememberSpiderJoint(joint)
            joint.Transform = CFrame.new()
        end
    end

    local function makeSpiderVisual(root)
        clearSpiderVisual()
        local rig = spiderCharacter
        if not (rig and rig.Parent and root and root.Parent) then return end
        local specs = {
            { upper = {"RightUpperArm", "Right Arm"}, lower = {"RightLowerArm"}, endPart = {"RightHand"}, side = 1, fore = 1 },
            { upper = {"LeftUpperArm", "Left Arm"}, lower = {"LeftLowerArm"}, endPart = {"LeftHand"}, side = -1, fore = 1 },
            { upper = {"RightUpperLeg", "Right Leg"}, lower = {"RightLowerLeg"}, endPart = {"RightFoot"}, side = 1, fore = -1 },
            { upper = {"LeftUpperLeg", "Left Leg"}, lower = {"LeftLowerLeg"}, endPart = {"LeftFoot"}, side = -1, fore = -1 },
        }
        for index, spec in ipairs(specs) do
            local limb = {
                upper = findSpiderJoint(rig, spec.upper),
                lower = findSpiderJoint(rig, spec.lower),
                endJoint = findSpiderJoint(rig, spec.endPart),
                side = spec.side,
                fore = spec.fore,
                order = index,
            }
            spiderLegs[index] = limb
            rememberSpiderJoint(limb.upper)
            rememberSpiderJoint(limb.lower)
            rememberSpiderJoint(limb.endJoint)
        end
    end

    -- Four real avatar limbs take turns stepping: right arm, left arm,
    -- right leg, left leg. Each limb reaches out and braces before the next.
    local function animateSpiderLegs(moving)
        if not spiderRoot or not spiderRoot.Parent then return end
        local root = spiderRoot
        local right = root.CFrame.RightVector
        local forward = root.CFrame.LookVector
        local up = spiderNormal
        local phaseClock = os.clock() * (moving and 3.4 or 1.1)
        local activeIndex = (math.floor(phaseClock) % 4) + 1
        local swing = math.sin((phaseClock % 1) * math.pi)
        for index, limb in ipairs(spiderLegs) do
            local target = root.Position
                + right * (limb.side * 1.55)
                + forward * (limb.fore * 1.05)
                + up * 0.24
            if moving and index == activeIndex then
                target += forward * (limb.fore * 0.95 * swing) + up * (0.48 * swing)
            end
            aimSpiderJoint(limb.upper, target)
            if limb.lower then
                extendSpiderJoint(limb.lower, (moving and index == activeIndex) and 2.05 or 1.72)
            end
            resetSpiderJoint(limb.endJoint)
        end
    end

    local function restoreRig()
        destroyWeb(false)
        clearSpiderVisual()
        restoreHumanoid()
        spiderHumanoid, spiderRoot = nil, nil
        spiderNormal = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
    end

    local function bindRig(character, humanoid, root)
        if character == spiderCharacter and humanoid == spiderHumanoid and root == spiderRoot then return end
        local wasOn = spiderOn
        restoreRig()
        spiderCharacter = character
        spiderHumanoid, spiderRoot = humanoid, root
        if wasOn and humanoid and root then
            originalHumanoid = {
                AutoRotate = humanoid.AutoRotate,
                WalkSpeed = humanoid.WalkSpeed,
                JumpPower = humanoid.JumpPower,
                JumpHeight = humanoid.JumpHeight,
            }
            humanoid.AutoRotate = false
            humanoid.WalkSpeed = 0
            humanoid.JumpPower = 0
            humanoid.JumpHeight = 0
            makeSpiderVisual(root)
        end
    end

    local function aimRay(character)
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not camera then return nil end
        local mousePos = UIS:GetMouseLocation()
        local unit = camera:ScreenPointToRay(mousePos.X, mousePos.Y)
        local params = makeRayParams(character)
        local hit = workspace:Raycast(unit.Origin, unit.Direction * 500, params)
        return unit, hit
    end

    local function updateAimMarker(character)
        local unit, hit = aimRay(character)
        if not unit then return end
        if not aimMarker then
            aimMarker = Instance.new("Part")
            aimMarker.Name = "ParallaxWebAimPoint"
            aimMarker.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
            aimMarker.Size = Vector3.new(0.18, 0.18, 0.18)
            aimMarker.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
            aimMarker.Color = ACCENT
            aimMarker.Transparency = 0.12
            aimMarker.Anchored = true
            aimMarker.CanCollide = false
            aimMarker.CanTouch = false
            aimMarker.CanQuery = false
            aimMarker.Parent = workspace
            local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
            light.Color = ACCENT
            light.Brightness = 0.65
            light.Range = 4
            light.Parent = aimMarker
        end
        aimMarker.CFrame = CFrame.new(hit and (hit.Position + hit.Normal * 0.07) or (unit.Origin + unit.Direction * 70))
    end

    local function fireWeb()
        if not spiderOn or not spiderRoot or not spiderRoot.Parent then return end
        if os.clock() - lastShot < 0.18 then return end
        lastShot = os.clock()
        destroyWeb(false)
        local ray, hit = aimRay(spiderCharacter)
        if not ray then return end
        local targetPos = hit and hit.Position or (ray.Origin + ray.Direction * 70)

        local anchor = Instance.new("Part")
        anchor.Name = "ParallaxWebAnchor"
        anchor.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
        anchor.Size = Vector3.new(0.16, 0.16, 0.16)
        anchor.CFrame = CFrame.new(targetPos)
        anchor.Color = WEB
        anchor.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
        anchor.Transparency = 0.08
        anchor.Anchored = true
        anchor.CanCollide = false
        anchor.CanTouch = false
        anchor.CanQuery = false
        anchor.Parent = workspace

        local rootAttachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
        rootAttachment.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0.72, -0.35)
        rootAttachment.Parent = spiderRoot
        local anchorAttachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
        anchorAttachment.Parent = anchor
        local rope = Instance.new("RopeConstraint")
        rope.Attachment0 = rootAttachment
        rope.Attachment1 = anchorAttachment
        rope.Length = math.max(3, (targetPos - spiderRoot.Position).Magnitude * 0.94)
        rope.Visible = false
        rope.Restitution = 0.12
        rope.Thickness = 0.04
        rope.Parent = anchor

        local beams, attachments = {}, {rootAttachment, anchorAttachment}
        for i = -1, 1 do
            local from = rootAttachment
            local to = anchorAttachment
            if i ~= 0 then
                from = Instance.new("Attachment")
                from.Position = rootAttachment.Position + Vector3.new(i * 0.055, 0, 0)
                from.Parent = spiderRoot
                to = Instance.new("Attachment")
                to.Position = Vector3.new(i * 0.035, 0, 0)
                to.Parent = anchor
                attachments[#attachments + 1] = from
                attachments[#attachments + 1] = to
            end
            local strand = Instance.new("Beam")
            strand.Attachment0 = from
            strand.Attachment1 = to
            strand.FaceCamera = true
            strand.LightEmission = 0.7
            strand.Color = ColorSequence.new(WEB, Color3.fromRGB(203, 173, 204))
            strand.Width0 = i == 0 and 0.075 or 0.035
            strand.Width1 = i == 0 and 0.04 or 0.02
            strand.CurveSize0 = i * 0.18
            strand.CurveSize1 = -i * 0.16
            strand.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.05, 0.2)
            strand.Parent = spiderRoot
            beams[#beams + 1] = strand
        end
        web = { anchor = anchor, rope = rope, beams = beams, attachments = attachments }
        if releaseBtn then releaseBtn.Text = "WEB: ATTACHED  ·  SPACE TO RELEASE" end

        local radial = (spiderRoot.Position - targetPos).Unit
        local look = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
        local tangent = look - radial * look:Dot(radial)
        if tangent.Magnitude > 0.05 then
            spiderRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = spiderRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity + tangent.Unit * 24 + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
        end
    end

    local function movementOnSurface(normal, humanoid)
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local forward, right
        if math.abs(normal.Y) > 0.65 then
            local look = camera and camera.CFrame.LookVector or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
            local side = camera and camera.CFrame.RightVector or Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
            forward = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
            right = Vector3.new(side.X, 0, side.Z)
            if forward.Magnitude < 0.05 then forward = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end
            if right.Magnitude < 0.05 then right = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) end
            forward, right = forward.Unit, right.Unit
        else
            forward = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) - normal * normal.Y
            if forward.Magnitude < 0.05 and camera then
                forward = camera.CFrame.LookVector - normal * camera.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(normal)
            end
            if forward.Magnitude < 0.05 then forward = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) - normal * normal.Z end
            forward = forward.Unit
            right = forward:Cross(normal)
            if right.Magnitude < 0.05 then right = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) end
            right = right.Unit
        end

        local f = (UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) and 1 or 0) - (UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) and 1 or 0)
        local s = (UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) and 1 or 0) - (UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) and 1 or 0)
        local move = forward * f + right * s
        if move.Magnitude < 0.05 and humanoid then
            local native = humanoid.MoveDirection
            move = native - normal * native:Dot(normal)
        end
        if move.Magnitude > 1 then move = move.Unit end
        return move, forward
    end

    local function crawlStep(dt)
        local character, humanoid, root = currentRig()
        if character ~= spiderCharacter or humanoid ~= spiderHumanoid or root ~= spiderRoot then
            bindRig(character, humanoid, root)
        end
        if not (character and humanoid and root and root.Parent) then return end
        updateAimMarker(character)
        local move, facing = movementOnSurface(spiderNormal, humanoid)
        animateSpiderLegs(move.Magnitude > 0.05)

        if web then
            local radial = (root.Position - web.anchor.Position)
            if radial.Magnitude > 0.1 then
                radial = radial.Unit
                local tangent = move - radial * move:Dot(radial)
                if tangent.Magnitude > 0.05 then
                    root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity + tangent.Unit * (spiderSpeed * dt * 1.4)
                end
            end
            return
        end

        local params = makeRayParams(character)
        local support = workspace:Raycast(root.Position, -spiderNormal * 3.8, params)
        local nextNormal = spiderNormal
        if move.Magnitude > 0.05 then
            local transition = workspace:Raycast(root.Position + spiderNormal * 0.25, move.Unit * 2.8, params)
            if transition and transition.Normal:Dot(spiderNormal) < 0.72 then
                support = transition
                nextNormal = transition.Normal
            end
        end
        if not support then
            local directions = {
                Vector3.new(0, -1, 0), Vector3.new(0, 1, 0),
                Vector3.new(1, 0, 0), Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0),
                Vector3.new(0, 0, 1), Vector3.new(0, 0, -1),
            }
            local nearest
            for _, direction in ipairs(directions) do
                local hit = workspace:Raycast(root.Position, direction * 3.6, params)
                if hit and (not nearest or (hit.Position - root.Position).Magnitude < (nearest.Position - root.Position).Magnitude) then
                    nearest = hit
                end
            end
            support = nearest
            if nearest then nextNormal = nearest.Normal end
        end

        if support then
            spiderNormal = nextNormal
            move, facing = movementOnSurface(spiderNormal, humanoid)
            local offset = root.Size.Y * 0.5 + 0.22
            local position = support.Position + spiderNormal * offset + move * spiderSpeed * dt
            local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
            if camera then
                local view = camera.CFrame.LookVector
                facing = view - spiderNormal * view:Dot(spiderNormal)
            end
            if not facing or facing.Magnitude < 0.05 then
                facing = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) - spiderNormal * Vector3.new(0, 0, -1):Dot(spiderNormal)
            end
            if facing.Magnitude < 0.05 then facing = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) end
            root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(position, position + facing.Unit, spiderNormal)
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        end
    end

    local function setSpider(on)
        spiderOn = on
        _G._HaloSpiderActive = on
        if on then
            local character, humanoid, root = currentRig()
            bindRig(character, humanoid, root)
            if humanoid and root then
                -- bindRig already configured a newly selected rig. When re-enabling
                -- the same rig, capture its restored defaults before freezing it.
                if not originalHumanoid then
                    originalHumanoid = {
                        AutoRotate = humanoid.AutoRotate,
                        WalkSpeed = humanoid.WalkSpeed,
                        JumpPower = humanoid.JumpPower,
                        JumpHeight = humanoid.JumpHeight,
                    }
                    humanoid.AutoRotate = false
                    humanoid.WalkSpeed = 0
                    humanoid.JumpPower = 0
                    humanoid.JumpHeight = 0
                end
                if #spiderLegs == 0 then makeSpiderVisual(root) end
            end
        else
            destroyWeb(false)
            if aimMarker then aimMarker:Destroy(); aimMarker = nil end
            clearSpiderVisual()
            restoreHumanoid()
        end
        if toggleBg then
            toggleBg.BackgroundColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(67, 190, 131) or Color3.fromRGB(45, 48, 58)
            toggleKnob.Position = on and UDim2.new(1, -19, 0, 3) or UDim2.new(0, 3, 0, 3)
        end
        if toggleBtn then toggleBtn.Text = on and "ON" or "OFF" end
        if cardStatus then
            cardStatus.Text = on and "Spider form active  ·  WASD crawl  ·  click to web" or "Off  ·  enable to crawl walls and ceilings"
            cardStatus.TextColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(138, 240, 190) or Color3.fromRGB(160, 166, 184)
        end
    end

    local card = Instance.new("Frame")
    card.Name = "SpiderClimbCard"
    card.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 144)
    card.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 20, 27)
    card.BackgroundTransparency = 0.16
    card.BorderSizePixel = 0
    card.LayoutOrder = 7
    card.Parent = panel
    local cc = Instance.new("UICorner"); cc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14); cc.Parent = card
    local cs = Instance.new("UIStroke"); cs.Color = Color3.fromRGB(176, 67, 138); cs.Transparency = 0.55; cs.Thickness = 1; cs.Parent = card

    local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 9)
    title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -80, 0, 17)
    title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    title.Text = "SPIDER FORM"
    title.TextSize = 11
    title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(246, 237, 247)
    title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    title.Parent = card

    cardStatus = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    cardStatus.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    cardStatus.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 28)
    cardStatus.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 25)
    cardStatus.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    cardStatus.Text = "Off  ·  enable to crawl walls and ceilings"
    cardStatus.TextSize = 9
    cardStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 166, 184)
    cardStatus.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    cardStatus.TextWrapped = true
    cardStatus.Parent = card

    toggleBg = Instance.new("Frame")
    toggleBg.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 22)
    toggleBg.Position = UDim2.new(1, -56, 0, 8)
    toggleBg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 48, 58)
    toggleBg.BorderSizePixel = 0
    toggleBg.Parent = card
    Instance.new("UICorner", toggleBg).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    toggleKnob = Instance.new("Frame")
    toggleKnob.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16)
    toggleKnob.Position = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0, 3)
    toggleKnob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 250)
    toggleKnob.BorderSizePixel = 0
    toggleKnob.Parent = toggleBg
    Instance.new("UICorner", toggleKnob).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    toggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    toggleBtn.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    toggleBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    toggleBtn.Text = "OFF"
    toggleBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    toggleBtn.TextSize = 8
    toggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    toggleBtn.Parent = toggleBg
    toggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() setSpider(not spiderOn) end)

    speedBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    speedBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(104, 24)
    speedBtn.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 61)
    speedBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(33, 36, 46)
    speedBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    speedBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    speedBtn.TextSize = 9
    speedBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 220, 238)
    speedBtn.Text = "CLIMB  18"
    speedBtn.Parent = card
    Instance.new("UICorner", speedBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7)
    speedBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        spiderSpeed = spiderSpeed == 18 and 26 or (spiderSpeed == 26 and 34 or 18)
        speedBtn.Text = "CLIMB  " .. tostring(spiderSpeed)
    end)

    releaseBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    releaseBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(112, 24)
    releaseBtn.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(124, 61)
    releaseBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(33, 36, 46)
    releaseBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    releaseBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    releaseBtn.TextSize = 8
    releaseBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 220, 238)
    releaseBtn.Text = "WEB: READY"
    releaseBtn.Parent = card
    Instance.new("UICorner", releaseBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7)
    releaseBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() destroyWeb(true) end)

    local hint = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    hint.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    hint.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 94)
    hint.Size = UDim2.new(1, -22, 0, 38)
    hint.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    hint.TextSize = 8
    hint.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 155, 171)
    hint.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    hint.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
    hint.TextWrapped = true
    hint.Text = "WASD crawls across floors, walls, and ceilings. Aim at a surface or open air and left-click to fire a web; Space releases the swing."
    hint.Parent = card

    local function shutdown()
        spiderOn = false
        _G._HaloSpiderActive = false
        destroyWeb(false)
        clearSpiderVisual()
        restoreHumanoid()
        if aimMarker then aimMarker:Destroy(); aimMarker = nil end
    end
    _G._ParallaxSpiderShutdown = shutdown

    _G._ParallaxSpiderInputConn = UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
        if not spiderOn or processed or UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            fireWeb()
        elseif (input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Space or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E) and web then
            destroyWeb(true)
        end
    end)
    _G._ParallaxSpiderStepConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        if not spiderOn then return end
        crawlStep(math.min(dt, 0.05))
    end)
    _G._ParallaxSpiderCard = card
    _G._ParallaxSpiderSetEnabled = setSpider
    print("[PARALLAX] spider form: ready")
end)

-- PARALLAX NATURE: denser wind-swaying baseplate grass and layered cherry blossoms.
task.spawn(function()
    local W=game:GetService("Workspace")
    local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
    local previous=rawget(_G,"_ParallaxNatureCleanup"); if type(previous)=="function" then pcall(previous) end
    local folder=W:FindFirstChild("ParallaxNature_Local"); if folder then folder:Destroy() end
    folder=Instance.new("Folder"); folder.Name="ParallaxNature_Local"; folder.Parent=W
    local records,grass,treeParts,connections={},{},{},{}
    local patches,trees,stopped=0,0,false
    local oldWind=W.GlobalWind
    pcall(function() W.GlobalWind=Vector3.new(4,0,2) end)
    local function cleanup()
        if stopped then return end; stopped=true
        for _,c in ipairs(connections) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
        for p,m in pairs(records) do if p and p.Parent then pcall(function() p.Material=m end) end end
        pcall(function() if W.GlobalWind==Vector3.new(4,0,2) then W.GlobalWind=oldWind end end)
        if folder and folder.Parent then folder:Destroy() end
    end
    _G._ParallaxNatureCleanup=cleanup
    local function tint(p)
        local c=p.Color
        return Color3.new(math.clamp(c.R*.36+.10,0,1),math.clamp(c.G*.48+.20,0,1),math.clamp(c.B*.30+.07,0,1))
    end
    local function isPlate(p)
        if not p:IsA("BasePart") or not p.Anchored or not p.CanCollide or p.Transparency>.1 then return false end
        if p.Size.Y>10 or p.Size.X<18 or p.Size.Z<18 or p.CFrame.UpVector.Y<.92 then return false end
        local n=string.lower(p.Name)
        return string.find(n,"baseplate",1,true) or string.find(n,"ground",1,true) or string.find(n,"field",1,true)
            or p.Material==Enum.Material.Grass or p.Size.X*p.Size.Z>=18000
    end
    local function makeGrass(base,rng,list,x,z)
        local phase=rng:NextNumber(0,6.28)
        for i=1,2 do
            local h=rng:NextNumber(.58,1.05); local yaw=rng:NextNumber(0,6.28)
            local blade=Instance.new("WedgePart")
            blade.Name="WindGrassBlade"; blade.Size=Vector3.new(rng:NextNumber(.075,.11),h,.06)
            blade.Material=Enum.Material.Grass; blade.Color=tint(base); blade.Anchored=true
            blade.CanCollide=false; blade.CanTouch=false; blade.CanQuery=false; blade.CastShadow=false
            blade.Parent=folder
            local e={part=blade,base=base,x=x+rng:NextNumber(-.2,.2),z=z+rng:NextNumber(-.2,.2),h=h,yaw=yaw,phase=phase+i}
            grass[#grass+1]=e; list[#list+1]=e
        end
    end
    local function wood(base,a,b,r,color)
        local delta=b-a; if delta.Magnitude<.05 then return end
        local axis=delta.Unit; local ref=math.abs(axis:Dot(Vector3.yAxis))>.94 and Vector3.zAxis or Vector3.yAxis
        local up=(ref-axis*ref:Dot(axis)).Unit; local back=axis:Cross(up).Unit
        local p=Instance.new("Part"); p.Name="CherryTreeBranch"; p.Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder
        p.Size=Vector3.new(delta.Magnitude,r*2,r*2); p.CFrame=base.CFrame*CFrame.fromMatrix((a+b)*.5,axis,up,back)
        p.Material=Enum.Material.Wood; p.Color=color or Color3.fromRGB(92,65,50)
        p.Anchored=true; p.CanCollide=false; p.CanTouch=false; p.CanQuery=false; p.CastShadow=true; p.Parent=folder
        treeParts[#treeParts+1]={part=p,base=base,localCF=base.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(p.CFrame)}
    end
    local function petal(base,pos,rng)
        local colors={Color3.fromRGB(255,224,234),Color3.fromRGB(255,239,242),Color3.fromRGB(245,190,211),Color3.fromRGB(255,210,226)}
        local center=Instance.new("Part"); center.Name="CherryBlossomCenter"; center.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball
        center.Size=Vector3.new(.14,.13,.14); center.Position=base.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(pos)
        center.Color=Color3.fromRGB(238,184,96); center.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
        center.Anchored=true; center.CanCollide=false; center.CanTouch=false; center.CanQuery=false; center.CastShadow=false; center.Parent=folder
        treeParts[#treeParts+1]={part=center,base=base,localPos=pos}
        local count=4; local radius=rng:NextNumber(.18,.24)
        for i=1,count do
            local angle=(i/count)*math.pi*2+rng:NextNumber(-.18,.18)
            local offset=Vector3.new(math.cos(angle)*radius,rng:NextNumber(-.035,.035),math.sin(angle)*radius)
            local p=Instance.new("Part"); p.Name="CherryPetal"; p.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball
            p.Size=Vector3.new(rng:NextNumber(.27,.36),.11,rng:NextNumber(.18,.25))
            local cf=CFrame.new(pos+offset)*CFrame.Angles(rng:NextNumber(-.2,.2),angle,rng:NextNumber(-.28,.28))
            p.CFrame=base.CFrame*cf; p.Color=colors[rng:NextInteger(1,#colors)]; p.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
            p.Anchored=true; p.CanCollide=false; p.CanTouch=false; p.CanQuery=false; p.CastShadow=false; p.Parent=folder
            treeParts[#treeParts+1]={part=p,base=base,localCF=cf}
        end
    end
    local function addTree(base,x,z,rng)
        local root=Vector3.new(x,base.Size.Y*.5,z); local h=rng:NextNumber(10.5,13.5)
        local bark={Color3.fromRGB(82,58,45),Color3.fromRGB(105,76,56),Color3.fromRGB(91,67,54)}
        local trunk=Vector3.new(rng:NextNumber(-.4,.4),0,rng:NextNumber(-.35,.35))
        local a=root
        for i=1,5 do
            local b=root+trunk+Vector3.new(0,h*i/5,0)
            wood(base,a,b,.52-(i-1)*.075,bark[rng:NextInteger(1,#bark)]); a=b
        end
        local crown=root+trunk+Vector3.new(0,h*.72,0)
        for limb=1,7 do
            local angle=(limb/7)*math.pi*2+rng:NextNumber(-.25,.25)
            local reach=rng:NextNumber(3.2,5.0); local rise=rng:NextNumber(1.4,3.2)
            local start=root+trunk+Vector3.new(0,h*rng:NextNumber(.42,.67),0)
            local elbow=start+Vector3.new(math.cos(angle)*reach*.58,rise*.45,math.sin(angle)*reach*.58)
            local tip=start+Vector3.new(math.cos(angle)*reach,rise,math.sin(angle)*reach)
            wood(base,start,elbow,.19,bark[rng:NextInteger(1,#bark)])
            wood(base,elbow,tip,.105,bark[rng:NextInteger(1,#bark)])
            for twig=1,3 do
                local t=twig/4; local joint=start:Lerp(tip,t)
                local side=angle+(twig%2==0 and 1 or -1)*rng:NextNumber(.45,.9)
                local endp=joint+Vector3.new(math.cos(side)*rng:NextNumber(1.1,1.9),rng:NextNumber(.8,1.8),math.sin(side)*rng:NextNumber(1.1,1.9))
                wood(base,joint,endp,.055,bark[rng:NextInteger(1,#bark)])
                local pos=joint:Lerp(endp,.72)+Vector3.new(0,rng:NextNumber(-.2,.55),0)
                petal(base,pos,rng)
            end
            local pos=elbow:Lerp(tip,.76)+Vector3.new(0,rng:NextNumber(-.2,.45),0)
            petal(base,pos,rng)
        end
        -- A loose, irregular crown of small flower clusters fills gaps between branch tips.
        for i=1,12 do
            local angle=rng:NextNumber(0,6.283); local radius=rng:NextNumber(1.1,3.5)
            local pos=crown+Vector3.new(math.cos(angle)*radius,rng:NextNumber(-1.5,1.7),math.sin(angle)*radius)
            petal(base,pos,rng)
        end
        trees+=1
    end
    local function decorate(base)
        if records[base] or patches>=72 or not isPlate(base) then return end
        records[base]=base.Material; pcall(function() base.Material=Enum.Material.Grass end)
        local list={}; connections[#connections+1]=base:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Color"):Connect(function()
            local c=tint(base); for _,e in ipairs(list) do if e.part.Parent then e.part.Color=c end end
        end)
        local rng=Random.new(math.floor(math.abs(base.Position.X*13+base.Position.Z*31))%1000000)
        local n=math.min(math.clamp(math.ceil(base.Size.X*base.Size.Z/10000),6,16),72-patches)
        local cols=math.max(1,math.ceil(math.sqrt(n*base.Size.X/base.Size.Z)))
        local rows=math.max(1,math.ceil(n/cols))
        for i=1,n do
            local col=(i-1)%cols; local row=math.floor((i-1)/cols)
            local cellX=base.Size.X/cols; local cellZ=base.Size.Z/rows
            local x=-base.Size.X*.46+(col+.5)*cellX+rng:NextNumber(-cellX*.28,cellX*.28)
            local z=-base.Size.Z*.46+(row+.5)*cellZ+rng:NextNumber(-cellZ*.28,cellZ*.28)
            makeGrass(base,rng,list,x,z); patches+=1
        end
        if trees<2 and base.Size.X>=90 and base.Size.Z>=90 then
            local x,z=base.Size.X*.39,base.Size.Z*.39
            for _,v in ipairs({{-x,-z},{x,-z},{-x,z},{x,z}}) do
                if trees>=2 then break end; addTree(base,v[1],v[2],rng); task.wait()
            end
        end
    end
    for i,obj in ipairs(W:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("BasePart") then decorate(obj) end
        if i%250==0 then task.wait() end
    end
    connections[#connections+1]=W.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj) if obj:IsA("BasePart") then task.defer(decorate,obj) end end)
    local elapsed=0
    while not stopped and folder.Parent do
        elapsed+=.5
        local camera=W.CurrentCamera; local origin=camera and camera.CFrame.Position
        local originXZ = origin and Vector2.new(origin.X, origin.Z)
        for _,e in ipairs(grass) do
            local p=e.part
            if p.Parent and e.base.Parent then
                local baseCF=e.base.CFrame
                local localPos=Vector3.new(e.x,e.base.Size.Y*.5,e.z)
                local world=baseCF:PointToWorldSpace(localPos)
                local dx,dz=0,0
                if originXZ then dx,dz=world.X-originXZ.X,world.Z-originXZ.Y end
                if not originXZ or dx*dx+dz*dz<90*90 then
                    local sway=math.sin(elapsed*1.55+e.phase)*.22
                    p.CFrame=baseCF*CFrame.new(localPos)*CFrame.Angles(0,e.yaw,sway)*CFrame.new(0,e.h*.5,0)
                end
            end
        end
        task.wait(.5)
    end
end)
